plugins.name: Google Drive
plugins.productIntro: Google Drive 是 Google 的云端文件与协作空间，集中保存并共享文档、表格、演示文稿及其他文件；在 Codex 中适合检索资料、整理文件和提炼文档内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Google Drive is Google’s cloud file and collaboration space for storing and sharing documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and other files; in Codex it is useful for finding source material and organizing documents.

plugins.name: Firecrawl
plugins.description: 搜索网页、提取内容并抓取结构化数据。
plugins.productIntro: Firecrawl 是网页数据采集工具，可搜索网站、提取页面和文档内容，并进行多页抓取或结构化研究。
plugins.productIntroEn: Firecrawl is a service that helps you search and extract web data. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Notion
plugins.description: 读取和管理 Notion 文档与工作流。
plugins.productIntro: Notion 是集文档、知识库、数据库和项目协作于一体的工作空间；在 Codex 中适合检索团队背景、整理研究和把决定沉淀成可复用的页面。
plugins.productIntroEn: Notion is a workspace that combines documents, wikis, databases, and project collaboration; in Codex it is useful for retrieving context, structuring research, and turning decisions into reusable pages.

plugins.name: Google Calendar
plugins.description: 查看和管理 Google 日历事件。
plugins.productIntro: Google 日历是 Google 的日程管理服务，用来安排事件、查看空闲时间并协调会议；在 Codex 中适合把任务要求转成可执行的日程安排。
plugins.productIntroEn: Google Calendar is Google’s scheduling service for events, availability, and meetings; in Codex it is useful for turning task requirements into an executable schedule.

plugins.name: Flaim Fantasy
plugins.productIntro: Flaim 将 ChatGPT 连接到用户的 ESPN、Yahoo 和 Sleeper Fantasy 联赛，以便 ChatGPT 可以使用用户的实际联赛背景来回答有关当前联赛、排名、名单、对决、选秀和选秀权所有权、可用球员、球员搜索、最近联赛转会、联赛信息和过去赛季的问题。它的 11 个工具中有 10 个是只读的。第十一个，refresh_leagues，是一个有界写入，通过用户的连接帐户重新发现联赛，并仅更新 Flaim 自己的连接联赛注册表。
plugins.productIntroEn: Flaim connects ChatGPT to a user's ESPN, Yahoo, and Sleeper fantasy leagues so ChatGPT can answer questions about current leagues, standings, rosters, matchups, drafts and draft-pick ownership, available players, player search, recent league moves, league info, and past seasons using the user's actual league context. Ten of its eleven tools are read-only.

plugins.name: Outlook Calendar
plugins.description: 查看和管理 Outlook 日程。
plugins.productIntro: Outlook Calendar 的主要用途是查看和管理 Outlook 日程。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Outlook Calendar is a service that helps you manage Outlook schedules. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: monday.com
plugins.description: 管理项目、任务与 CRM 流程。
plugins.productIntro: monday.com 是用于项目、任务、流程和 CRM 的可配置工作管理平台；在 Codex 中适合查询项目进展、整理负责人和推动跨团队协作。
plugins.productIntroEn: monday.com is a configurable work-management platform for projects, tasks, workflows, and CRM; in Codex it is useful for checking progress, organizing owners, and coordinating across teams.

plugins.name: Metricool
plugins.description: 分析社交媒体表现并安排内容发布。
plugins.productIntro: Metricool 是社交媒体管理平台，帮助团队分析账号表现、查看排期、寻找合适发布时间，并制作或更新社交媒体内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Metricool is a service that helps you analyze and schedule posts. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Fathom
plugins.description: 读取会议记录并提炼重点与行动项。
plugins.productIntro: Fathom 的主要用途是读取会议记录并提炼重点与行动项。 使用 Fathom 将您的会议背景引入 ChatGPT。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Fathom is a service that helps you your meeting insights. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Granola
plugins.description: 把 Granola 会议上下文带入当前任务。
plugins.productIntro: Granola 的主要用途是把 Granola 会议上下文带入当前任务。 Granola MCP 将您的会议历史记录连接到 Codex，以便您的助手可以在您工作时从过去的对话中提取真实的背景信息。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Granola is a service that helps you add your meeting context. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Todoist: To Do List & Calendar
plugins.description: 管理待办、计划、提醒与日历。
plugins.productIntro: Todoist: To Do List & Calendar 的主要用途是管理待办、计划、提醒与日历。 Todoist 受到超过 4700 万人的信赖，它简化了个人和团队的任务。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Todoist: To Do List & Calendar is a service that helps you planner & Reminders. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Fireflies
plugins.productIntro: Fireflies 应用程序将您的会议和知识直接带入 Codex。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Fireflies app brings your meetings and knowledge directly into Codex.

plugins.name: SharePoint
plugins.productIntro: 使用 SharePoint 汇总网站、页面和文件，提取所有者和状态，并通过连接的 Microsoft SharePoint 应用程序规划安全内容更新。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use SharePoint to summarize sites, pages, and files, extract owners and status, and plan safe content updates through the connected Microsoft SharePoint app.

plugins.name: Airtable
plugins.description: 将结构化数据添加到 ChatGPT
plugins.productIntro: 将操作数据和上下文引入 ChatGPT 对话流程中。您可以通过对话提出问题、创建和更新记录以及分析数据。使用 Airtable 中的数据作为您在 ChatGPT 中所做的工作的输入，例如使用您在 Airtable 中组织的内容构建登录页面。无需离开聊天即可快速更新 Airtable。当您需要快速访问结构化内部数据以通知您的对话时，Airtable for ChatGPT 是理想的选择。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring operational data and context into the flow of your ChatGPT conversations. You can ask questions, create and update records, and analyze your data—all through conversation. Use the data in Airtable as input to the work you’re doing in ChatGPT, like building a landing page using content you’ve organized in Airtable. Make quick updates to Airtable without leaving the chat.

plugins.name: Structured
plugins.productIntro: 结构化将您的所有任务和待办事项合并到一个可视时间轴中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Structured combines all your tasks and to-dos into a single visual timeline.

plugins.name: Trello
plugins.description: 在 Trello 中完成工作
plugins.productIntro: Trello 插件允许 ChatGPT 使用自然语言与您的 Trello 看板、卡片和任务进行交互。 ChatGPT 和 Trello 之间的所有通信都经过加密以保护隐私，并使用安全最佳实践进行身份验证。配置完成后，您可以管理待办事项，而无需在选项卡之间切换。在 ChatGPT 的帮助下开始处理您的 Trello 任务！
plugins.productIntroEn: The Trello plugin lets ChatGPT interact with your Trello boards, cards, and tasks using natural language. All communication between ChatGPT and Trello is encrypted for privacy and authenticated using security best practices. Once configured, you can manage your to-do’s without having to switch between tabs. Start tackling your Trello tasks with the help of ChatGPT!

plugins.name: Dropbox
plugins.description: 查找、整理、创建和分享 Dropbox 文件。
plugins.productIntro: Dropbox 是云端文件存储与共享平台。插件可在 Codex 中查找文件、处理内容、保存生成结果或创建分享链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Dropbox is a service that helps you find, create, and take action. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Wispr Flow
plugins.productIntro: 允许 ChatGPT 访问您的会议记录、操作项目和记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: Allow ChatGPT to access your meeting notes, action items, and transcripts.

plugins.name: Asana
plugins.productIntro: 处理您的 Asana 任务、子任务、评论、截止日期和项目详细信息，以创建摘要、了解优先级并准备清晰的状态更新。
plugins.productIntroEn: Work with your Asana tasks, subtasks, comments, due dates, and project details to create summaries, understand priorities, and prepare clear status updates.

plugins.name: Lucid
plugins.description: 构思、绘制图表并调整团队。
plugins.productIntro: 使用 ChatGPT 直接生成基础 Lucidchart 图表，简化您的工作流程 你的谈话。除了无缝图表创建之外，这种集成还充当数字桥梁，允许 您可以立即搜索、检索、共享和总结您现有的 Lucid 文档 聊天GPT。无论您是要快速启动新的流程图还是从复杂的董事会中提取见解， 您现在可以消除上下文切换的瓶颈，并为您的 AI 提供视觉上下文 需要加速你的工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Simplify your workflow by using ChatGPT to generate foundational Lucidchart diagrams directly from your conversation. Beyond seamless diagram creation, this integration acts as a digital bridge, allowing you to instantly search, retrieve, share, and summarize your existing Lucid documents right within ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Klaviyo
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中跳过手动分析营销活动和流程绩效、解释和建议。报告包括发送状态、点击率和归因收入，以及简单的语言上下文。只需单击“分析”即可深入了解趋势和建议。借助 Klaviyo 应用程序，您将随时了解绩效、抢占机遇，并准备好直接通过对话采取行动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Skip manual analysis with marketing campaign and flow performance, explanations, and recommendations directly in ChatGPT. Reporting includes send status, click rates, and attributed revenue, alongside plain language context. Just click "Analyze" to dive into trends and suggestions.

plugins.name: Plaud
plugins.description: 从普劳德那里获取见解
plugins.productIntro: Plaud 将您的录音连接到 ChatGPT。搜索您的录音，提取结构化信息，生成摘要和工件，并综合整个录音库中的见解 - 所有这些都通过自然对话进行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Plaud connects your voice recordings to ChatGPT. Search across your recordings, extract structured information, generate summaries and artifacts, and synthesize insights from your entire recording library — all through natural conversation.

plugins.name: ClickUp
plugins.description: 从 ChatGPT 运行您的项目
plugins.productIntro: 无需离开 ChatGPT 或 Codex，即可管理任务、与团队协作并交付工作。发表带有线索回复和@提及的评论，以保持对话的进展。在 ClickUp Chat 中发送消息。编写和编辑文档和页面。跟踪时间、设置自定义字段并以自然语言搜索整个工作区。每个操作都会实时同步到 ClickUp，因此团队成员可以立即看到您的更新。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage tasks, collaborate with your team, and ship work without leaving ChatGPT or Codex. Post comments with threaded replies and @mentions to keep conversations moving. Send messages in ClickUp Chat. Write and edit Docs and pages. Track time, set custom fields, and search your entire workspace in natural language.

plugins.name: Opera Browser Connector
plugins.productIntro: 将 Opera 浏览器连接到 ChatGPT。启用后，它可以查看打开的选项卡、读取页面内容、截取页面屏幕截图以及导航到该页面。而且，根据您允许的权限，它还可以查看浏览历史记录并关闭选项卡
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect Opera Browser to ChatGPT. When enabled, it can see open tabs, read page content, take screenshots of the page, and navigate to the page. And, based on the permissions you allow it, it could also view browsing history and close tabs

plugins.name: Linear
plugins.productIntro: 在 Codex 的 Linear 中管理问题、项目和团队工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage issues, projects, and team workflows in Linear from Codex.

plugins.name: Otter.ai
plugins.productIntro: Otter.ai MCP 服务器将 ChatGPT 连接到您的会议智能，从而可以直接在您的工作流程中搜索和检索文字记录、摘要、操作项目和会议元数据。按关键字、日期范围、与会者、文件夹或频道搜索会议，然后获取带有演讲者归属的完整记录。使用它通过回顾过去的讨论、从历史对话中提取决策或综合会议存档中的见解来准备会议。支持个人和企业 Otter.ai 工作空间。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Otter.ai MCP server connects ChatGPT to your meeting intelligence, enabling search and retrieval of transcripts, summaries, action items, and meeting metadata directly within your workflow. Search meetings by keyword, date range, attendee, folder, or channel, then fetch full transcripts with speaker attribution.

plugins.name: Pocket AI
plugins.productIntro: 从 ChatGPT 搜索您的 Pocket 录音。连接 Pocket 帐户后，可以从保存的录音中查找相关对话、检索文字记录片段、审阅笔记以及表面操作项目。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search your Pocket recordings from ChatGPT. Find relevant conversations, retrieve transcript segments, review notes, and surface action items from your saved recordings after you connect your Pocket account.

plugins.name: Miro
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Miro 来总结现有的板、更新它们或从头开始构建新的板。将 ChatGPT 指向看板，它会读取您的团队已经决定、研究和绘制的内容，因此它的答案从您的上下文开始。要求它进行构建，它的答案会以原生 Miro 对象的形式出现在板上——幻灯片、表格、文档、图表、便签、框架和研讨会小部件——默认情况下是可视的、可立即编辑的和协作的。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to Miro to summarize existing boards, update them, or build new ones from scratch. Point ChatGPT at a board and it reads what your team has already decided, researched, and drawn, so its answers start from your context.

plugins.name: Semrush
plugins.productIntro: Semrush MCP 提供结构化、定量的 SEO 和域名、关键词、反向链接和市场级受众洞察的流量数据。它返回事实数据集，包括域分析、关键字指标、反向链接配置文件、跨时间段和渠道的流量数据、地理和人口统计分布以及竞争或行业级别指标。每当用户请求需要权威数据而不是推理的网站指标、流量统计、关键字数据、竞争对手比较或市场/受众细分时，模型就应该调用此 MCP。当用户的问题需要对特定领域进行数据驱动的评估时，也应该使用它，即使查询被表述为建议或改进指导。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Semrush MCP provides structured, quantitative SEO and traffic data for domains, keywords, backlinks, and market-level audience insights. It returns factual datasets including domain analytics, keyword metrics, backlink profiles, traffic data across time periods and channels, geographic and demographic distributions, and competitive or industry-level indicators.

plugins.name: Tally
plugins.productIntro: 使用 AI 更快地创建理货表格。用简单的英语描述您的需求，应用程序会生成清晰、结构良好的问题，您可以立即使用。它非常适合调查、反馈表、申请和注册，可帮助您在几秒钟内从想法转变为准备构建的表单，同时保持您的工作流程简单高效。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create Tally forms faster with AI. Describe what you need in plain English, and the app generates clear, well-structured questions you can use right away. Perfect for surveys, feedback forms, applications, and registrations, it helps you go from idea to ready-to-build form in seconds while keeping your workflow simple and efficient.

plugins.name: TickTick:To-Do List & Calendar
plugins.productIntro: TickTick 是一款功能强大的待办事项和任务管理应用程序，可在您的所有设备上实现无缝云同步。无论您需要安排议程、制作备忘录、分享购物清单、团队协作，甚至是养成新习惯、设置生日倒计时，TickTick 始终可以帮助您完成工作并让生活步入正轨。
plugins.productIntroEn: TickTick is a powerful to-do & task management app with seamless cloud synchronization across all your devices. Whether you need to schedule an agenda, make memos, share shopping lists, collaborate in a team, or even develop a new habit, set countdown for birthdays, TickTick is always here to help you get stuff done and keep life on track.

plugins.name: Krisp
plugins.description: 将会议上下文添加到聊天中
plugins.productIntro: Krisp AI 会议助手 MCP 使您的 AI 助手可以安全地访问您的会议历史记录，包括记录、摘要、行动项目和即将召开的会议。它使您的人工智能能够与您的实际对话中的真实上下文一起工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Krisp AI Meeting Assistant MCP gives your AI assistant secure access to your meeting history, including transcripts, summaries, action items, and upcoming meetings. It enables your AI to work with real context from your actual conversations.

plugins.name: AccurateScribe.ai – Transcribe
plugins.productIntro: AccurateScribe 是一款人工智能驱动的语音转文本和转录应用程序，专为现代工作流程而构建。它采用先进的 Whisper 技术，可提供快速、准确的 Whisper 转录，并将音频和视频安全地转换为可读、可编辑的文本。
plugins.productIntroEn: AccurateScribe is an AI-powered speech-to-text and transcription app built for modern workflows. Powered by advanced Whisper technology, it delivers fast, accurate Whisper transcription and securely converts audio and video into readable, editable text.

plugins.name: CVpop - Resume & CV Builder
plugins.description: 您的下一份工作从这里开始
plugins.productIntro: CVpop 可帮助您直接在 ChatGPT 中创建和定制专业简历。描述您的经验和职业目标以生成结构化简历，然后通过对话完善其内容并在交互式编辑器中预览更改。探索小部件中的模板、颜色、字体和布局，然后在准备好后在 CVpop 中安全地继续。
plugins.productIntroEn: CVpop helps you create and customize professional CVs directly in ChatGPT. Describe your experience and career goals to generate a structured CV, then refine its content through conversation and preview changes in an interactive editor. Explore templates, colors, fonts, and layouts in the widget, then continue securely in CVpop when you are ready.

plugins.name: Smartsheet US
plugins.productIntro: 让 Smartsheet 成为您的 AI 工作流程的原生部分。让人工智能分析项目时间表、创建图表来总结工作表信息，所有这些都通过对话进行。 Smartsheet 连接器消除了手动数据输入和重复更新，让您专注于决策，而 AI 处理细节。利用人工智能改变您管理项目的方式，人工智能可以理解您的 Smartsheet 数据并对其采取行动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Make Smartsheet a native part of your AI workflow. Ask your AI to analyze project timelines, create graphs to summarize your sheet information, all through conversation. The Smartsheet connector eliminates manual data entry and repetitive updates, letting you focus on decisions while AI handles the details.

plugins.name: Calendly
plugins.productIntro: 将 Calendly 引入 ChatGPT，通过简单的提示执行计划操作。创建和更新活动类型、生成安排链接、调整可用性、预订或取消会议等 — 一切尽在 ChatGPT 中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring Calendly into ChatGPT to take scheduling actions through simple prompts. Create and update event types, generate scheduling links, adjust availability, book or cancel meetings, and more — right in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Whimsical
plugins.productIntro: Whimsical 应用程序通过强大的白板扩展了 ChatGPT： · 要求@whimsical 根据您当前的对话生成漂亮的流程图、思维导图、线框图、序列图、便签或其他类型的视觉内容。 · 根据后续提示进行更新或在 Whimsical 应用程序中打开以进行编辑、共享和协作。 · 从异想天开的工作区中搜索并引用现有白板。
plugins.productIntroEn: Whimsical app extends ChatGPT with a powerful whiteboard: · Ask @whimsical to generate beautiful flowcharts, mind maps, wireframes, sequence diagrams, sticky notes or other type of visual content based on your current conversation. · Update it with follow-up prompts or open in Whimsical app to edit, share and collaborate.

plugins.name: joblet.ai - AI Job Search
plugins.description: 让人工智能为您找到合适的工作。
plugins.originalDescription: Let AI find you the right job.
plugins.productIntro: 在 joblet.ai，我们认为找到合适的工作不应该感觉像是一份全职工作。我们正在构建一个由人工智能驱动的市场，将人才与顶级机会无缝连接起来，消除传统求职板的噪音、无休止的滚动和摩擦。
plugins.productIntroEn: At joblet.ai, we believe landing the right job shouldn’t feel like a full-time job. We’re building an AI-powered marketplace that seamlessly connects talent with top opportunities - cutting out the noise, endless scrolling, and friction of traditional job boards.

plugins.name: tldv
plugins.productIntro: 访问 Google Meet、Zoom、Team 和现场会议记录。您的以及您的团队和公司的人员。
plugins.productIntroEn: Access Google Meet, Zoom, Teams, and in-person meeting transcripts. Yours, and those from your team & company.

plugins.name: Read AI
plugins.description: AI 会议记录和文字记录
plugins.productIntro: Read AI 是一款适用于 Zoom、Google Meet 和 Microsoft Teams 的人工智能会议记录员和会议助手。记录会议并获取 AI 会议记录、摘要、文字记录、行动项目、关键问题和决策。
plugins.productIntroEn: Read AI is an AI meeting notetaker and meeting assistant for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. Record meetings and get AI meeting notes, summaries, transcripts, action items, key questions, and decisions.

plugins.name: Zite
plugins.description: 构建应用程序并管理数据
plugins.productIntro: Zite 通过 ChatGPT 帮助用户检查、查询、分析和更新其私有工作区数据，包括数据库、表、字段、记录和聚合。它还可以基于该数据构建、编辑和发布应用程序，并将工作流程和集成保存到用户的 Zite 工作区。
plugins.productIntroEn: Zite helps users inspect, query, analyze, and update their private workspace data through ChatGPT, including databases, tables, fields, records, and aggregations. It can also build, edit, and publish apps on that data, with workflows and integrations, saved to the user's Zite workspace.

plugins.name: Eraser
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 Claude 生成、创建、读取和更新 Eraser 工作区中的图表、文档和文件。让 Eraser 成为 AI 工作流程的原生部分 - 用自然语言描述系统，让您的代理生成完整的图表，从代码或对话创建丰富的技术文档，并管理整个工作区的文件。所有更改都会保存到您的橡皮擦帐户中，并可通过应用程序进行访问。
plugins.productIntroEn: Generate, create, read, and update diagrams, documents and files in your Eraser workspace directly from Claude. Make Eraser a native part of your AI workflow – describe a system in natural language and have your agent generate a complete diagram, create rich technical docs from code or conversations, and manage files across your workspace.

plugins.name: Resume Builder
plugins.productIntro: Resume 使 ChatGPT 能够分析、改进和生成专业的、ATS 友好的简历。上传 PDF 或 DOCX 简历，以确定关键差距、强化经验要点，并通过有针对性的建议完善影响力。然后，Resume 将这些改进转化为干净、结构化且可下载的 PDF 简历，针对可读性和申请人跟踪系统进行了优化 - 全部都在 ChatGPT 对话中，无需从头开始。
plugins.productIntroEn: Resume enables ChatGPT to analyze, improve, and generate professional, ATS-friendly resumes. Upload a PDF or DOCX resume to identify key gaps, strengthen experience bullets, and refine impact with targeted suggestions.

plugins.name: Atlassian Rovo
plugins.productIntro: Atlassian Rovo MCP 服务器将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到您的 Atlassian 工作区，因此您可以直接通过对话使用 Jira、Confluence、Bitbucket、Loom 等。 查找并总结 Jira 问题、创建和更新票证、转换状态以及添加评论，而无需切换选项卡。搜索、阅读、起草和编辑具有完整上下文的 Confluence 页面。 服务器支持读取和写入操作，让您可以实时检索信息并采取操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Atlassian Rovo MCP Server connects ChatGPT and Codex to your Atlassian workspace, so you can work with Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Loom, and more directly from your conversation. Find and summarize Jira issues, create and update tickets, transition statuses, and add comments without switching tabs. Search, read, draft, and edit Confluence pages with full context.

plugins.name: Flourish
plugins.productIntro: Flourish 应用程序将 ChatGPT 变成真正 Flourish 项目的图表制作助手。为其提供数据并描述您想要强调的见解或您想要讲述的故事。它会选择合适的模板，准备数据，在您的 Flourish 帐户中创建可视化效果，并为您提供编辑链接。您可以掌控 Flourish 中的最终润色和发布。没有屏幕截图或一次性代码。只是交互式、可编辑的图表，其中包含您的计划包含的访问、协作、品牌和发布功能。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Flourish App turns ChatGPT into a chart-making assistant for real Flourish projects. Give it data and describe the insight you want to highlight or the story you want to tell. It chooses a suitable template, prepares the data, creates the visualization in your Flourish account, and gives you an edit link. You stay in control of the final polish and publishing in Flourish.

plugins.name: Enhancv
plugins.productIntro: Enhancv 将您的简历格式化为专业的 PDF — 无需离开 ChatGPT。
plugins.productIntroEn: Enhancv formats your resume into a professional PDF — without leaving ChatGPT.

plugins.name: RewriteLy Humanizer
plugins.description: 自然地重写 AI 文本
plugins.productIntro: RewriteLy Humanizer 有助于将人工智能生成的文本转化为自然、听起来像人类的文字。
plugins.productIntroEn: RewriteLy Humanizer helps turn AI-generated text into natural, human-sounding writing.

plugins.name: Kickresume
plugins.description: 生成 ATS 友好的简历
plugins.productIntro: Kickresume 让每个人都能简单、快速地制作专业的、能赢得工作的简历。只需开始对话并描述您的经验、技能和目标即可。 Kickresume 将把所有这些转换成 PDF 简历，使用专业的简历模板找到工作。每个简历模板均基于招聘人员批准、ATS 友好的模板构建，旨在通过申请人跟踪系统并给招聘经理留下深刻印象。从转行者到应届毕业生，只需通过聊天即可创建一份脱颖而出的简历。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kickresume makes building a professional, job-winning resume simple and fast for everyone. Just start a conversation and describe your experience, skills, and goals. Kickresume will turn all that into a PDF resume that lands jobs using professional resume templates.

plugins.name: MindMap AI
plugins.productIntro: MindMap AI 可让您在 ChatGPT 内创建、搜索、查看、编辑、设计样式和导出思维导图，并在工作时在聊天中查看它们的呈现。根据主题、头脑风暴或您共享的任何内容创建导图：PDF、文档、图像、粘贴的文本或 ChatGPT 可以读取的网页。然后通过聊天不断完善它：扩展分支，添加关系箭头来构建概念图，用摘要括号对想法进行分组，并重新组织结构。在思维导图、逻辑图和组织结构图布局之间切换、应用主题并在完成后导出。
plugins.productIntroEn: MindMap AI lets you create, search, view, edit, style, and export mind maps right inside ChatGPT, and see them rendered in the chat as you work. Create a map from a topic, a brainstorm, or anything you share: PDFs, documents, images, pasted text, or web pages ChatGPT can read.

plugins.name: Seamless
plugins.description: 寻找线索并自动化外展
plugins.productIntro: 您的整个销售渠道都在 ChatGPT 内。 Seamless.AI 将勘探、外展和活动管理连接到一个对话中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your entire sales pipeline, inside ChatGPT. Seamless.AI connects prospecting, outreach, and campaign management to a single conversation.

plugins.name: MeetGeek
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中访问会议数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Access meeting data directly in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Prompt Perfect
plugins.productIntro: 将提示管理和分析直接集成到您的 ChatGPT 工作流程中。使用该应用程序将简单的请求转变为上下文丰富的结构化提示，或通过内置评分和反馈来评估您的提示。轻松浏览、自定义并保存您最喜爱的提示。当您需要在重复或复杂的工作流程中应用严格的即时工程标准时，Prompt Perfect 就是理想的选择。
plugins.productIntroEn: Integrate prompt management and analysis directly into your ChatGPT workflow. Use the app to turn simple requests into structured context-rich prompts or evaluate your prompting with built-in scoring and feedback. Browse, customize, and save your favorite prompts with ease.

plugins.name: Resume.io
plugins.productIntro: Resume.io 可帮助您在几分钟内创建出色的、适合 ATS 的简历和专业的求职信。
plugins.productIntroEn: Resume.io helps you create standout, ATS-friendly resumes and professional cover letters in minutes.

plugins.name: Speechify
plugins.productIntro: 将任何文本转化为具有优质名人声音的自然语音。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn any text into natural speech with premium celebrity voices.

plugins.name: Xmind
plugins.productIntro: Xmind for ChatGPT 将您的想法转化为思维导图——只需聊天即可。 用简单的语言描述一个项目、目标或主题，Xmind 将其组织成结构化的可视化地图，以便您一目了然地看到其中的联系。一键在完整的 Xmind 应用程序中打开它以进行更深入的编辑。 非常适合计划、学习、记笔记和头脑风暴。
plugins.productIntroEn: Xmind for ChatGPT turns your ideas into mind maps — just by chatting. Describe a project, goal, or topic in plain words, and Xmind organizes it into a structured visual map so you can see the connections at a glance. One click opens it in the full Xmind app for deeper editing. Great for planning, learning, note-taking, and brainstorming.

plugins.name: IHate.ai Humanaizer
plugins.productIntro: 让人工智能写作听起来更人性化，检查文本阅读的自然程度，并将凌乱的草稿变成干净的 Markdown。 Humanize 显示快速预览并突出显示更改的内容 - 当您想要完全重写、并排比较或导出时，请打开 ihate.ai。人工智能检测会对你的散文听起来是否人性化进行评分。格式完善了结构和标题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Make AI writing sound human, check how natural your text reads, and turn messy drafts into clean Markdown. Humanize shows a quick preview and highlights what changed — open ihate.ai when you want the full rewrite, side-by-side diff, or export. AI detection scores how human your prose sounds. Format polishes structure and headings.

plugins.name: Grain
plugins.description: 您的 AI 会议数据层
plugins.productIntro: Grain 通过 Google Meet、Zoom、Microsoft Teams 和 Webex 记录和转录您的会议，然后生成丰富的文字记录、AI 驱动的笔记、行动项目、辅导记分卡等。 Grain MCP 连接器使 ChatGPT 可以直接访问您的会议库、记录、笔记和 CRM 交易数据。使用 Grain + ChatGPT 更快地完成后续步骤，从语义上查找关键对话，分析客户反馈模式，生成交易运行状况报告，根据实际内容起草后续电子邮件，并指导您的销售团队。
plugins.productIntroEn: Grain records and transcribes your meetings across Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Webex, then generates enriched transcripts, AI-powered notes, action items, coaching scorecards, and more. The Grain MCP connector gives ChatGPT direct access to your meeting library, transcripts, notes, and CRM deal data.

plugins.name: SlideForge
plugins.productIntro: SlideForge 将简单语言请求或结构化数据转换为可编辑的 PowerPoint 文件。询问 KPI 摘要、项目状态仪表板、路线图或比较 — SlideForge 会在大约一秒钟内呈现可下载的 .pptx，并提供内联预览，以便您可以在对话中检查结果。文件可在 PowerPoint、Google 幻灯片和 Keynote 中打开。
plugins.productIntroEn: SlideForge turns a plain-language request or structured data into an editable PowerPoint file. Ask for a KPI summary, a project status dashboard, a roadmap, or a comparison — SlideForge renders a downloadable .pptx in about a second, with an inline preview so you can check the result in the conversation. Files open in PowerPoint, Google Slides, and Keynote.

plugins.name: Whisper Transcribe AI
plugins.productIntro: WhisperTranscribe 是一款 AI 转录应用程序，可将音频、视频、会议、讲座、访谈、播客、语音备忘录、网络研讨会和 YouTube 链接转换为 ChatGPT 内的准确文字记录、字幕、说明文字和摘要。它支持语音转文本、音频转文本、视频转文本、会议转录、播客转录、讲座转录、采访转录、字幕生成、进度跟踪、最近的工作历史记录、已完成的记录审核和共享链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: WhisperTranscribe is an AI transcription app that converts audio, video, meetings, lectures, interviews, podcasts, voice memos, webinars, and YouTube links into accurate transcripts, subtitles, captions, and summaries inside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Riverside
plugins.productIntro: Riverside 是一个用于创建视频和播客的端到端平台。连接后，您可以编辑录音、剪切社交媒体剪辑、发布到所有频道、起草所有剧集资产以及查找录音中的任何时刻。需要 Grow 套餐或以上套餐的 Riverside 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: Riverside is an end-to-end platform for creating videos and podcasts. Once connected, you can edit your recordings, cut clips for social media, publish to all your channels, draft all your episode assets, and find any moment across your recordings. Requires a Riverside account on a Grow plan or above.

plugins.name: Wrike
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 访问您的 Wrike 工作区，以计划、确定优先级、更新和跟踪工作。将聊天转化为您的团队可以查看和执行的项目、任务和时间表。提取会议记录、分配所有者、设置截止日期 - 所有这些都无需切换工具。直接通过 ChatGPT 让您的团队不断前进。
plugins.productIntroEn: Access your Wrike workspace directly from ChatGPT to plan, prioritise, update and track work. Turn chats into projects, tasks, and timelines your team can see and execute. Pull in meeting notes, assign owners, set due dates - all without switching tools. Keep your team moving forward, right from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: WPWriter
plugins.productIntro: WPWriter 将 ChatGPT 连接到 WordPress，以便用户可以直接从聊天窗口管理他们的网站。
plugins.productIntroEn: WPWriter connects ChatGPT to WordPress so users can manage their sites directly from a chat window.

plugins.name: ResumeBoost
plugins.productIntro: 简历助推器可帮助您在聊天中创建、定制和改进专业简历。打开应用程序，选择 8 种风格（经典、现代、行政、创意、终端、侧边栏、瑞士、自然）之一，填写您的详细信息，然后下载精美的 PDF。使用“空缺”模式为特定职位发布定制简历，或使用“改进”模式通过人工智能反馈增强现有简历。
plugins.productIntroEn: Resume Booster helps you create, tailor, and improve professional resumes right inside chat. Open the app, pick one of 8 styles (Classic, Modern, Executive, Creative, Terminal, Sidebar, Swiss, Nature), fill in your details, and download a polished PDF. Use "vacancy" mode to tailor your resume for a specific job posting, or "improve" mode to enhance an existing resume with AI feedback.

plugins.name: Camtasia
plugins.productIntro: Camtasia 只需通过单个屏幕捕获即可生成清晰的操作视频。在几秒钟内将一张或多张屏幕截图转换为带旁白的教学视频。 Final videos support learning outcomes by pairing scripted directions with animated cursor movements and other transitional features, including zoom and pan effects.
plugins.productIntroEn: Camtasia generates clear how-to videos from nothing more than a single screen capture. Transform one or more screenshots into a narrated instructional video in seconds. Final videos support learning outcomes by pairing scripted directions with animated cursor movements and other transitional features, including zoom and pan effects.

plugins.name: Presentations Craft
plugins.productIntro: 轻松创建令人惊叹的演示文稿，以便您可以在编辑器中共享和编辑。
plugins.productIntroEn: Creates Stunning presentations easily so you can share and EDIT in the editor.

plugins.name: Reclaim.ai
plugins.productIntro: Reclaim.ai 将智能时间管理直接引入 ChatGPT，帮助您规划、保护和优化您的日程安排
plugins.productIntroEn: Reclaim.ai brings intelligent time management directly into ChatGPT, helping you plan, protect, and optimize your schedule

plugins.name: Coda
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Coda 工作区，使其能够读取文档、查询表以及执行创建或更新行等操作。使用 ChatGPT 搜索信息、管理项目并自动化由 Coda 中的数据支持的工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connects ChatGPT to your Coda workspace, allowing it to read docs, query tables, and take actions like creating or updating rows. Use ChatGPT to search for information, manage projects, and automate workflows powered by the data in Coda.

plugins.name: Weavely Forms & Surveys
plugins.productIntro: 免费创建调查、注册表、潜在客户捕获表、NPS 和 CSAT 调查等。没有模板，没有拖放。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create surveys, registration forms, lead capture forms, NPS and CSAT surveys, and more for free. No templates, no drag-and-drop.

plugins.name: Manus
plugins.productIntro: Manus 是一个自主 AI 代理，您可以直接在 ChatGPT 中将复杂的任务委托给它。 Manus 不仅仅生成内容，还管理从单个指令到成品的整个项目。您可以通过要求有关特定主题的“幻灯片”来使用它来创建专业演示文稿。告诉它为您的项目“构建一个网站”，它将提供一个功能齐全的实时网站。要求它为您的营销活动“制作视频”，您将获得精美的最终剪辑。或者，让它对任何主题进行“广泛研究”，以获得包含综合发现和来源的综合报告。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manus is an autonomous AI agent that you can delegate complex tasks to directly within ChatGPT. Instead of just generating content, Manus manages entire projects from a single instruction to a finished product. You can use it to create professional presentations by asking for 'slides' on a specific topic.

plugins.name: Agentic Search by Liner
plugins.productIntro: Liner 是一种代理人工智能搜索，可利用实时网络数据和引用来源查找、验证和总结答案。提出问题，Liner 会搜索实时网络，抓取和抓取当前页面，并返回一个有根据的答案，您可以根据原始来源进行事实检查 - 最新的新闻和最新信息，而不是过时的训练数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Liner is an agentic AI search that finds, verifies, and summarizes answers with real-time web data and cited sources. Ask a question and Liner searches the live web, scrapes and crawls current pages, and returns a grounded answer you can fact-check against the original source — the latest news and up-to-date information, not stale training data.

plugins.name: Foxit PDF Editor
plugins.productIntro: Foxit PDF Editor for ChatGPT 可帮助您无缝管理和转换 PDF。上传、删除或比较文档；创建可共享的链接；编辑、重新排序、旋转、拆分或合并页面；将文件与各种格式相互转换；以及压缩或线性化 PDF——所有这些都在 ChatGPT 内完成。在几秒钟内构建有组织的数据包 - 为学生、专业人士或任何需要快速 PDF 解决方案而无需离开聊天的人做好准备。
plugins.productIntroEn: Foxit PDF Editor for ChatGPT helps you manage and transform PDFs seamlessly. Upload, delete, or compare documents; create shareable links; edit, reorder, rotate, split, or merge pages; convert files to and from various formats; and compress or linearize PDFs—all within ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Agentic Slides by SlidesGPT
plugins.description: 制作演示文稿和幻灯片
plugins.productIntro: 使用 SlidesGPT 通过 AI 生成演示文稿。首先，指定演示文稿应讨论的主题。接下来，您将收到演示文稿的拟议大纲。在您同意大纲后，SlidesGPT 将生成您的演示幻灯片。 最后就可以导出到PowerPoint了
plugins.productIntroEn: Use SlidesGPT to generate presentations with AI. First, name a topic that the presentation should be about. Next, you'll receive a proposed outline for your presentation. After you agree to the outline, SlidesGPT will generate your presentation slides. Finally you can export to PowerPoint

plugins.name: HappyScribe
plugins.productIntro: HappyScribe：搜索记录和会议记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect HappyScribe to give ChatGPT on-demand access to your organization's conversational memory: every transcript, meeting recording, interview, and quote, speaker-attributed, verbatim, in 150+ languages.

plugins.name: xTiles
plugins.productIntro: xTiles 将您的 ChatGPT 对话转变为有组织的可视化项目。不要在分散的聊天线程中丢失研究、计划或想法，而是要求 ChatGPT 将它们直接构建到 xTiles 工作区中的页面、任务和布局中。将头脑风暴变成项目板，将旅行想法变成计划页面，或者将杂乱的笔记变成您可以重新访问、编辑和分享的清晰内容 - 所有这些都无需离开对话。
plugins.productIntroEn: xTiles turns your ChatGPT conversations into organized, visual projects. Instead of losing research, plans, or ideas in scattered chat threads, ask ChatGPT to structure them directly into pages, tasks, and layouts inside your xTiles workspace.

plugins.name: Goodnotes
plugins.description: 将人工智能见解转化为文档
plugins.productIntro: 将人工智能见解转化为文档。 立即将 ChatGPT 对话转换为可编辑的 Goodnotes 文件。无论您有文本、流程图还是图像，都可以将您的想法从聊天转移到页面上进行完善、注释和共享。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn AI insights into documents. Instantly convert ChatGPT conversations into editable Goodnotes files. Whether you’ve got text, flowcharts, or images, move your ideas from the chat to the page to refine, annotate, and share.

plugins.name: Google Contacts
plugins.description: 参考已保存的联系方式
plugins.productIntro: 搜索 Google 通讯录和目录条目，按姓名、电子邮件、公司或域名查找人员，然后阅读电子邮件、电话、地址、生日和组织等联系人详细信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search Google Contacts and directory entries to find people by name, email, company, or domain, then read contact details such as email, phone, address, birthday, and organization.

plugins.name: Hjarni Notes
plugins.description: 你的笔记，你的人工智能的记忆。
plugins.productIntro: Hjarni 是您的人工智能可以实际使用的知识库。
plugins.productIntroEn: Hjarni is a knowledge base your AI can actually use.

plugins.name: Capacities
plugins.productIntro: 能力将互联的笔记和结构化数据结合在一起，因此您关心的一切都成为一个对象，无论是一个人、您正在阅读的一本书、您正在开展的项目还是您想要探索的想法。物体具有结构、属性和联系，它们会成长为你思想的活生生的网络。
plugins.productIntroEn: Capacities brings together connected note-taking and structured data so everything you care about becomes an object, whether it’s a person, a book you’re reading, a project you’re working on or an idea you want to explore. Objects have structure, properties and connections that grow into a living network of your thoughts.

plugins.name: WP Agent
plugins.description: 使用 AI 撰写博客并运行 WordPress
plugins.productIntro: WordPress 的 AI 博客和内容完全由 ChatGPT 管理 — 连接您的网站一次，ChatGPT 就可以编写、编辑、发布、安排、SEO 优化和端到端维护。 WP Agent 是无密钥的：您无需携带 AI API 密钥。
plugins.productIntroEn: AI blogging and content for WordPress, managed entirely from ChatGPT — connect your site once and ChatGPT can write, edit, publish, schedule, SEO-optimize, and maintain it end to end. WP Agent is keyless: you don't bring an AI API key.

plugins.name: SpeakApp
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您在 SpeakApp 中捕获的所有内容 — 会议、语音笔记、讲座。询问所说的内容，提取摘要和行动项目，并将该上下文带入您的工作或代码中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to everything you've captured in SpeakApp — meetings, voice notes, lectures. Ask what was said, pull summaries and action items, and bring that context into your work or code.

plugins.name: Shippo
plugins.productIntro: 运输，无需繁琐的工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Shipping, without the busywork.

plugins.name: NeoSapien
plugins.description: 您的私人人工智能助理
plugins.productIntro: NeoSapien：您的私人人工智能助理。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect NeoSapien to bring your memories, transcripts, and reminders from Neo 1 into ChatGPT.

plugins.name: QRCM
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中生成可定制的二维码。 Supports 7 types: URLs, WiFi networks, contacts (vCard), calendar events, email, phone numbers, and plain text.交互式小部件提供实时预览和样式选项，包括 6 点图案、自定义颜色、角样式、带有文本标签的框架和徽标上传。
plugins.productIntroEn: Generate customizable QR codes directly in ChatGPT. Supports 7 types: URLs, WiFi networks, contacts (vCard), calendar events, email, phone numbers, and plain text. An interactive widget provides live preview with styling options including 6 dot patterns, custom colors, corner styles, frames with text labels, and logo upload. Download high-quality PNG or SVG files instantly.

plugins.name: CALL-E
plugins.productIntro: Call-E helps you delegate everyday phone calls to an AI assistant.要求它致电企业、检查可用性、进行预订、提出问题、传递消息或代表您与某人跟进。
plugins.productIntroEn: Call-E helps you delegate everyday phone calls to an AI assistant. Ask it to call a business, check availability, make a reservation, ask a question, deliver a message, or follow up with someone on your behalf.

plugins.name: AgentMail
plugins.description: AI 代理的电子邮件收件箱
plugins.productIntro: AgentMail 为人工智能代理提供了自己的电子邮件收件箱。通过此连接器，代理（或者您，在 ChatGPT 中）可以即时启动专用收件箱，然后完全通过工具调用发送、接收、回复和转发电子邮件，其中包含完整的线程上下文、草稿和附件。
plugins.productIntroEn: AgentMail gives AI agents their own email inboxes. Through this connector, an agent (or you, in ChatGPT) can spin up a dedicated inbox on the fly, then send, receive, reply to, and forward email, with full thread context, drafts, and attachments, entirely through tool calls.

plugins.name: Docusign
plugins.productIntro: 通过 Docusign 提供支持的智能自动化简化合同管理。超越简单的执行，让复杂的协议工作流程变得毫不费力。使用自然语言创建和发送合同，立即显示续订日期和关键义务等见解，并自动化工作流程，使您的业务更快、更少摩擦。
plugins.productIntroEn: Simplify contract management with intelligent automation powered by Docusign. Go beyond simple execution to make complex agreement workflows effortless. Use natural language to create and send a contract, instantly surface insights like renewal dates and key obligations, and automate workflows that keep your business moving faster and with less friction.

plugins.name: Circleback
plugins.productIntro: Circleback 是一款人工智能记事本，可以捕获并组织您对话中的所有内容。它记录和转录您的会议、写下清晰的笔记并分配行动项目。
plugins.productIntroEn: Circleback is an AI notetaker that captures and organizes everything from your conversations. It records and transcribes your meetings, writes clear notes, and assigns action items.

plugins.name: Awesome Record (voice + sound)
plugins.description: 音频、音乐、通过麦克风讲话
plugins.productIntro: 在 ChatGPT 中录制音频的一种快速简单的方法。
plugins.productIntroEn: A quick easy way to record audio in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Sider Recorder & Transcriber
plugins.productIntro: Side Recorder & Transcriber 支持录音并将语音内容转换为文本和有组织的摘要。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sider Recorder & Transcriber supports audio recording and transforms spoken content into text and organized summaries.

plugins.name: Jotform
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 内创建、编辑和分析表单。只需描述您的需求，Jotform 就会生成一个完整的表单，您可以通过对话进行完善。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create, edit, and analyze forms directly inside ChatGPT. Simply describe what you need, and Jotform generates a complete form that you can refine through conversation.

plugins.name: MindMap
plugins.productIntro: MindMap 将大纲转变为 ChatGPT 内的交互式、可折叠的思维导图。粘贴或描述主题，MindFlow 会呈现一个可视化地图，您可以通过平移/缩放和全屏进行探索。单击任何节点即可获得即时说明，以便您可以更快地学习、计划、参与或集思广益。
plugins.productIntroEn: MindMap turns outlines into interactive, collapsible mind maps inside ChatGPT. Paste or describe a topic and MindFlow renders a visual map you can explore with pan/zoom and fullscreen. Click any node for an instant explanation so you can study, plan, onboard, or brainstorm faster.

plugins.name: FormHug
plugins.productIntro: 在 ChatGPT 内创建用于注册、调查、测验、评估和预订的表格。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create forms for registrations, surveys, quizzes, assessments, and bookings inside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: 24/7 Calendar
plugins.productIntro: 从 ChatGPT 检查挂历的快速简便方法。看看日期如何排列，检查星期六是什么时候，看看距离月底还有多长时间......
plugins.productIntroEn: A quick easy way to check a wall calendar from ChatGPT. See how the dates line up, check when Saturday falls, see how long until the end of the month...

plugins.name: PDF Editor PRO by Playgram
plugins.description: 编辑和注释 PDF 文档
plugins.productIntro: 直接在浏览器中轻松编辑、注释和签署 PDF 文档。 PDF Editor Pro 允许您修改文本、添加图像、突出显示重要部分以及使用简单的文本提示编辑 PDF。
plugins.productIntroEn: Easily edit, annotate, and sign PDF documents right in your browser. PDF Editor Pro lets you modify text, add images, highlight important sections, and edit PDFs using simple text prompts.

plugins.name: Miyo
plugins.productIntro: Miyo 允许用户搜索本地笔记和知识库、阅读完整文件、浏览文件夹和索引文件，以及通过连接的桌面应用程序在本地文件夹中创建或编辑文件。
plugins.productIntroEn: Miyo lets users search their local notes and knowledge base, read full files, browse folders and indexed files, and create or edit files in local folders through the connected desktop app.

plugins.name: Forms AI
plugins.productIntro: 表单很容易需要，但构建起来却很烦人。每个问题类型、每个分节符、每个设置都是另一次点击 - 当回复到达时，阅读它们本身就是一件苦差事。这个插件将所有内容都转移到对话中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Forms are easy to need and annoying to build. Every question type, every section break, every setting is another click - and by the time responses arrive, reading them is its own chore. This plugin moves all of it into the conversation.

plugins.name: Adobe Acrobat
plugins.productIntro: Adobe Acrobat for ChatGPT 可帮助您无缝转换和组织文档。编辑、重新排序、旋转、拆分或合并页面；将 PDF 转换为其他格式或编辑敏感细节；并使用 OCR 从扫描件中提取文本。您还可以在几秒钟内压缩文件并构建有组织的数据包。非常适合学生、专业人士以及任何想要快速、可靠的 PDF 解决方案而无需打开其他应用程序的人。
plugins.productIntroEn: Adobe Acrobat for ChatGPT helps you transform and organize documents seamlessly. Edit, reorder, rotate, split, or merge pages; convert PDFs to other formats or redact sensitive details; and extract text from scans with OCR. You can also compress files and build organized packets in seconds.

plugins.name: B&A: Diagrams
plugins.productIntro: 🎯 信息图和可视化 💾 图表、图表 + 分析 📊 对于代码：数据库、UX、ERD、PlantUML！对于业务和数据分析：流程图、时间表等！
plugins.productIntroEn: 🎯 INFOGRAPHICS & VISUALIZATION 💾 DIAGRAMS, CHARTS + ANALYSIS 📊 For CODE: Database, UX, ERD, PlantUML! For Business & Data Analysis: Flowchart, Timeline & more!

plugins.name: Unabyss
plugins.description: 您的 AI 上下文层
plugins.productIntro: Unabyss 是您的个人人工智能上下文层。连接您已使用的应用程序（LinkedIn、您的网站、Notion、Gmail、Slack、GitHub），Unabyss 会自动提取、构建并保持您的上下文最新。然后，您使用的任何人工智能工具（包括 ChatGPT）都可以在您需要时提取正确的上下文。 不再需要在每次谈话开始时重新解释你的角色、你的项目、你的语气或你的公司。您的上下文存在于一个地方，随着来源的变化而保持最新，并伴随您在您使用的每个人工智能工具中移动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Unabyss is your personal context layer for AI. Connect the apps you already use — LinkedIn, your website, Notion, Gmail, Slack, GitHub — and Unabyss extracts, structures, and keeps your context up to date automatically. Then any AI tool you use, including ChatGPT, can pull exactly the right context when you need it.

plugins.name: Mem
plugins.description: 保存和搜索笔记和会议
plugins.productIntro: 通过连接您的 Mem 知识库，为 ChatGPT 提供您第二大脑的完整背景。在您的 AI 笔记本中搜索上下文、捕捉和回忆想法、将聊天内容保存到新笔记中、编辑和更新生活文档以及组织您的 AI 工作区 — 只需询问 ChatGPT。用于：从会议记录、深入研究、个人知识管理 (PKM)、知识库构建、任务管理、优先级划分和内容开发中综合和提取行动项目。示例提示：“在我的笔记中搜索定价策略，并通过研究验证我们的想法。
plugins.productIntroEn: Give ChatGPT the full context of your second brain by connecting your Mem knowledge base. Search your AI notebook for context, capture and recall ideas, save chats into new notes, edit and update living docs, and organize your AI workspace — simply by asking ChatGPT.

plugins.name: CamScanner
plugins.description: OCR 和 AI 提取文本
plugins.productIntro: CamScanner for ChatGPT 可帮助您无缝弥合物理文档和数字智能之间的差距。上传、扫描并识别任何图像中的文本；使用 OCR 提取高精度数据供 ChatGPT 进行分析、总结或翻译；只需单击一下即可捕获手写或打印内容。您还可以将复杂的照片转换为结构化文本，以进行即时 AI 处理。非常适合学生、专业人士以及任何想要快速、可靠的图像到文本解决方案而无需打开其他应用程序的人。
plugins.productIntroEn: CamScanner for ChatGPT helps you bridge the gap between physical documents and digital intelligence seamlessly. Upload, scan, and identify text from any image; extract high-precision data with OCR for ChatGPT to analyze, summarize, or translate; and capture handwritten or printed content in a single click. You can also turn complex photos into structured text for instant AI processing.

plugins.name: Instant Website
plugins.productIntro: InstantSite 可让您使用 AI 生成网站。 根据简短的描述创建页面结构、内容和布局，然后编辑并发布您的网站。
plugins.productIntroEn: InstantSite lets you generate websites using AI. Create page structure, content, and layout from a short description, then edit and publish your site.

plugins.name: Werify
plugins.productIntro: Werify 在 ChatGPT 中为用户提供了自己的 WhatsApp 存档——他们从聊天导出导入的对话或从他们连接的号码捕获的对话。他们可以找到对话，一次一页阅读其记录（包括语音注释，作为文本），在其中搜索并列出其附件。在用户批准的情况下，它还可以执行以下操作：在主动捕获下向对话发送一条短信（一条消息，首先与用户确认），通过配对代码将 WhatsApp 号码连接到 Werify，只有用户可以在手机上完成该操作，开始或停止从连接的号码捕获聊天（仅限新消息…
plugins.productIntroEn: Werify gives users their own WhatsApp archive inside ChatGPT — conversations they imported from a chat export or captured from a number they connected. They can find a conversation, read its transcript a page at a time (voice notes included, as text), search inside it and list its attachments.

plugins.name: Egnyte
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 Codex 处理存储在 Egnyte 中的文档和文件。跨文件夹搜索、检索相关文件并提取关键信息来回答问题或生成摘要。
plugins.productIntroEn: Work with documents and files stored in Egnyte directly from Codex. Search across folders, retrieve relevant files, and extract key information to answer questions or generate summaries.

plugins.name: Basic Memory Cloud
plugins.description: 为您的 AI 工具提供一个内存
plugins.originalDescription: One memory for your AI tools
plugins.productIntro: 基本记忆为您提供持久的知识库：您的笔记、决策、研究和项目背景，存储为您拥有的纯 Markdown 文件。您的人工智能保存到基本内存中的任何内容，您都可以打开和编辑。您编写的任何内容，您的人工智能都可以找到并进行构建。
plugins.productIntroEn: Basic Memory gives you a persistent knowledge base: your notes, decisions, research, and project context, stored as plain Markdown files you own. Anything your AI saves to Basic Memory, you can open and edit. Anything you write, your AI can find and build on.

plugins.name: Formula Genius
plugins.description: Excel、表格、SQL 和正则表达式
plugins.productIntro: 生成、解释、调试、验证和比较 Excel 和 Google Sheets 的公式。创建 SQL 查询、正则表达式模式、VBA 宏、Google Apps 脚本和 Airtable 脚本。当您需要电子表格逻辑或自动化帮助以在 ChatGPT 中获得清晰、可审查的结果时，请使用 Formula Genius。
plugins.productIntroEn: Generate, explain, debug, validate, and compare formulas for Excel and Google Sheets. Create SQL queries, regex patterns, VBA macros, Google Apps Script, and Airtable scripts. Use Formula Genius when you need spreadsheet logic or automation help with clear, reviewable results inside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Canvs.io whiteboard
plugins.productIntro: Canvs 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中创建和编辑协作白板。该应用程序可以从形状布局或美人鱼图生成新板，检查现有板元素，以及更新或删除用户私人 Canvs 工作区中保存的画布内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Canvs helps users create and edit collaborative whiteboards in ChatGPT. The app can generate new boards from shape layouts or Mermaid diagrams, inspect existing board elements, and update or delete saved canvas content inside the user's private Canvs workspace.

plugins.name: Jotform Apps
plugins.description: 使用 AI 构建无代码应用程序
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 内构建功能齐全的无代码应用程序。只需描述您想要什么，Jotform AI App Builder 就会创建一个即用型应用程序，您可以通过对话进行自定义。
plugins.productIntroEn: Build fully functional no-code apps directly inside ChatGPT. Simply describe what you want, and Jotform AI App Builder creates a ready-to-use app you can customize through conversation.

plugins.name: A.I. Slides by Brightdeck
plugins.description: 创建幻灯片和演示文稿
plugins.productIntro: 在 2 分钟内生成适合高管的品牌演示。与幻灯片完全兼容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Generate a C-suite-ready, on-brand presentation in 2 minutes. Fully compatible with powerpoint.

plugins.name: Norton
plugins.description: 通过网络和电子邮件验证诈骗
plugins.productIntro: Stay protected while you chat.诺顿将基于 AI 的实时诈骗检测直接带入您的 ChatGPT 体验，并由 Norton Genie AI 助手提供支持。共享可疑电子邮件、文本、消息、图像或链接以进行即时分析和清晰的网络安全指导，帮助您在点击之前避免网络钓鱼、诈骗和恶意内容。您还可以询问有关安全、隐私、身份保护和设备性能的日常问题，并在聊天时获得可信答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Stay protected while you chat. Norton brings real-time, AI-powered scam detection directly into your ChatGPT experience, backed by the Norton Genie AI assistant. Share suspicious emails, texts, messages, images, or links for instant analysis and clear cyber safety guidance to help you avoid phishing, scams, and malicious content before you click.

plugins.name: Gong
plugins.productIntro: Kong 为您的 ChatGPT 工作流程带来了深入的收入洞察，帮助团队提出问题、生成简报，并从 Kong AI OS 数据中揭示风险、异议、后续步骤和利益相关者背景。
plugins.productIntroEn: Gong brings deep revenue insights into your ChatGPT workflows, helping teams ask questions, generate briefs, and surface risks, objections, next steps, and stakeholder context from Gong AI OS data.

plugins.name: FoundRole Jobs
plugins.description: 查找工作、远程岗位、简历与薪资信息。
plugins.productIntro: FoundRole 是一款人工智能职位搜索和职位申请跟踪器。按职位、地点、工资、发布日期和工作类型（远程、在家工作或现场工作）搜索实时工作委员会。 Save the roles you want to your tracker. 每份工作都有真实的数据来判断：薪资洞察与市场价格、带有信任等级的幽灵工作信号、H-1B 担保人状态和电子验证状态。
plugins.productIntroEn: FoundRole is an AI job search and job application tracker. Search a live job board by title, location, salary, date posted, and work type: remote, work-from-home, or on-site. Save the roles you want to your tracker. Every job comes with real data to judge it by: salary insights versus market rates, ghost-job signals with a trust grade, H-1B sponsor status, and E-Verify status.

plugins.name: Upplai
plugins.description: 检查简历 ATS 分数
plugins.productIntro: Upplai 的 ATS 简历检查器会分析您的简历与职位描述的匹配程度，并提供 ATS 风格的兼容性评分以及详细的关键字见解。
plugins.productIntroEn: Upplai’s ATS resume checker analyzes how well your resume matches a job description and provides an ATS-style compatibility score along with detailed keyword insights.

plugins.name: TimerTime
plugins.description: 快速简单的 ChatGPT 计时器
plugins.productIntro: TimerTime：快速简单的 ChatGPT 计时器。
plugins.productIntroEn: A fast, simple way to set a timer in a ChatGPT conversation, and play a sound when finished.

plugins.name: WebsitePublisher
plugins.productIntro: 通过对话构建和发布完整的网站。 通过 MCP 连接来管理页面、表单、资产等。
plugins.productIntroEn: Build and publish complete websites through conversation. Connect via MCP to manage pages, forms, assets and more.

plugins.name: TRIGGERcmd
plugins.description: 在您的计算机上运行命令
plugins.productIntro: TRIGGERcmd 是一项云服务，允许您在计算机上运行命令。 您安装代理，然后创建一组您希望能够在计算机上运行的命令。 You can give each command an MCP tool description so ChatGPT will know what it does and how it can use the command's parameters.
plugins.productIntroEn: TRIGGERcmd is a cloud service that allows you to run commands on your computers. You install the agent, then create a set of commands you want to be able run on the computer. You can give each command an MCP tool description so ChatGPT will know what it does and how it can use the command's parameters. Or you can use the two built-in MCP tools: list_commands and run_command.

plugins.name: Spkr - Chat to Podcast Episode
plugins.description: AI 聊天 -> 播客剧集
plugins.productIntro: ChatGPT Spkr 应用程序允许订阅者将任何 ChatGPT 答案转换为播客剧集以供以后收听。
plugins.productIntroEn: The ChatGPT Spkr app allows subscribers to convert any ChatGPT answer to a podcast episode for later listening.

plugins.name: Slides AI
plugins.productIntro: Slides AI 可帮助您根据几乎任何输入快速创建清晰、结构化的演示文稿。在几秒钟内将简单的想法、文本、PDF 或链接转变为随时可用的幻灯片。
plugins.productIntroEn: Slides AI helps you quickly create clear, structured presentations from almost any input. Turn a simple idea, text, PDF, or link into a ready-to-use slide deck in seconds.

plugins.name: BluTranslate
plugins.productIntro: BluTranslate 可让您通过交互式 Bluente 小部件翻译 ChatGPT 中上传的文档。上传文件，选择目标语言和翻译选项，启动翻译任务，跟踪进度并下载翻译结果。该应用程序处理文档翻译工作流程，并且不会在聊天中生成临时翻译文本。
plugins.productIntroEn: BluTranslate lets you translate uploaded documents in ChatGPT through an interactive Bluente widget. Upload a file, choose target language and translation options, start the translation task, track progress, and download the translated result. The app handles document translation workflows and does not generate ad-hoc translation text in chat.

plugins.name: Autocalls AI
plugins.description: 构建并运行人工智能电话代理
plugins.productIntro: Autocalls 可让您构建和运行 AI 电话代理 - 现在您可以直接从 ChatGPT 执行此操作，无需切换到仪表板。 Describe what you want, and your assistant takes it from there.
plugins.productIntroEn: Autocalls lets you build and run AI phone agents — and now you can do it straight from ChatGPT, without switching to a dashboard. Describe what you want, and your assistant takes it from there.

plugins.name: 2+2 Calculator
plugins.productIntro: 一个简单的计算器，用于执行加法、减法、乘法和除法，就在 ChatGPT 中！
plugins.productIntroEn: A simple calculator for performing addition, subtraction, multiplication and division, right in ChatGPT!

plugins.name: Kalender Sync
plugins.productIntro: Kalender Sync 连接您的日历 - Google、Microsoft Outlook、Apple iCloud、GMX、WEB.DE 和任何 CalDAV 或 iCal 源 - 因此 ChatGPT 可以回答有关您的空闲时间的问题、查找空闲时间、查找约会并为您创建活动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kalender Sync connects your calendars — Google, Microsoft Outlook, Apple iCloud, GMX, WEB.DE and any CalDAV or iCal source — so ChatGPT can answer questions about your availability, find open slots, look up appointments and create events for you.

plugins.name: Career Adapter
plugins.description: 根据任何工作定制您的简历
plugins.originalDescription: Tailor your resume to any job
plugins.productIntro: 当用户想要针对特定职位发布调整、定制、定制、重写、润色或优化其简历，或者需要帮助申请某个职位时，请使用此功能。生成可下载的专业格式的 PDF 简历，保存到用户的 Career Adapter 帐户，内容经过重写以符合发布的要求。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use this when the user wants to adapt, tailor, customize, rewrite, polish, or optimize their resume for a specific job posting, or wants help applying to a role. Produces a downloadable, professionally-formatted PDF resume saved to the user's Career Adapter account, the content rewritten to match the posting's requirements.

plugins.name: Mapify
plugins.description: 将任何事物变成思维导图
plugins.productIntro: Mapify 将文本、文档、网页、YouTube 链接、音频、视频、图像和研究提示转变为交互式思维导图。用户可以直接渲染 Markdown 或启动私有 Mapify 任务来处理源材料、处理后续澄清并返回可缩放层次结构以探索概念、会议记录、媒体和研究结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Mapify turns text, documents, webpages, YouTube links, audio, video, images, and research prompts into interactive mind maps. Users can render Markdown directly or start private Mapify tasks that process source material, handle follow-up clarification, and return zoomable hierarchies for exploring concepts, meeting notes, media, and research findings.

plugins.name: OneNote (Beta)
plugins.description: 阅读、导出、组织和安全更新 OneNote
plugins.originalDescription: Read, export, organize, and safely update OneNote
plugins.productIntro: 使用 OneNote 查找和总结笔记本内容、将个人页面导出为 Markdown 文件、组织部分和页面，以及通过连接的 Microsoft OneNote 应用安全地创建或更新个人和共享笔记。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use OneNote to find and summarize notebook content, export personal pages as Markdown files, organize sections and pages, and safely create or update personal and shared notes through the connected Microsoft OneNote app.

plugins.name: Tweek
plugins.productIntro: Tweek 是一款简约的每周计划和待办事项应用程序。连接它即可直接从 ChatGPT 查看和管理您的 Tweek 日历、每周任务和某天列表 — 列出您一周的活动，以自然语言创建、更新、完成和删除任务，将任务分解为子任务，并使用批量工具同时处理多个任务。通过 OAuth 2.1，每个操作的范围仅限于您自己的帐户；助手充当您的角色，永远不会看到其他用户的数据。最适合快速、自然语言的任务捕获和每周回顾。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tweek is a minimal weekly planner and to-do app. Connect it to view and manage your Tweek calendars, weekly tasks and someday-lists directly from ChatGPT — list what's on your week, create, update, complete and delete tasks in natural language, break a task into subtasks, and act on many tasks at once with bulk tools. Every action is scoped to your own account over OAuth 2.

plugins.name: Dropbox Dash
plugins.description: 人工智能了解您的工作
plugins.productIntro: Dropbox Dash 将您最喜爱的工作场所应用程序中的知识转移到一个安全的地方。借助适用于 ChatGPT 的 Dash 应用程序，您可以直接在对话中使用这些知识。
plugins.productIntroEn: Dropbox Dash brings knowledge from your favorite workplace apps into one secure place. With the Dash app for ChatGPT, you can use that knowledge directly in your conversations.

plugins.name: Happenstance
plugins.productIntro: Happenstance 使用自然语言搜索您的职业网络以找到合适的人。结果显示相互联系并按关系强度排名，帮助您找到最温暖的介绍路径。深入研究任何人以获得包含职业历史和专业知识的全面资料。非常适合销售、招聘、风险投资和业务发展。
plugins.productIntroEn: Happenstance searches your professional network using natural language to find the right people. Results surface mutual connections and rank by relationship strength, helping you find the warmest intro path. Deep research anyone to get comprehensive profiles with career history and expertise. Ideal for sales, recruiting, venture capital, and business development.

plugins.name: SurveyMonkey
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中构建调查、分析回复并发现见解。 无需切换工具即可搜索调查、查看结果、生成摘要并探索趋势。轻松将反馈转化为团队、客户、员工等明确的后续步骤。
plugins.productIntroEn: Build surveys, analyze responses, and uncover insights directly in ChatGPT. Search your surveys, review results, generate summaries, and explore trends without switching tools. Easily turn feedback into clear next steps for teams, customers, employees, and more.

plugins.name: Cambiante: Content Manager
plugins.productIntro: Cambiante LinkedIn Content Manager 可帮助租户工作区创建 LinkedIn 草稿、附加生成的图像、审核内容、批准或拒绝帖子、安排帖子、明确发布批准的内容以及通过 ChatGPT 检查审核日志和分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: Cambiante LinkedIn Content Manager helps tenant workspaces create LinkedIn drafts, attach generated images, review content, approve or reject posts, schedule posts, explicitly publish approved content, and inspect audit logs and analytics through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Revise
plugins.productIntro: Revise 将 ChatGPT 和其他人工智能代理连接到功能齐全的文字处理器。创建、导入、搜索和编辑真实文档；跨数百页进行协作；将 AI 编辑作为跟踪更改进行审核；管理布局、脚注和协作者；并导出为 DOCX、PDF、Markdown、HTML 或纯文本。
plugins.productIntroEn: Revise connects ChatGPT and other AI agents to a fully featured word processor. Create, import, search, and edit real documents; collaborate across hundreds of pages; review AI edits as tracked changes; manage layouts, footnotes, and collaborators; and export to DOCX, PDF, Markdown, HTML, or plain text.

plugins.name: Awesome Slides
plugins.description: 带视频和旁白的幻灯片
plugins.productIntro: 一站式人工智能幻灯片应用程序：创建、编辑幻灯片并将其导出为带有画外音的视频，一切都在一个地方完成。 快速将任何主题、文本、PDF 或 URL 转换为专业设计的 PowerPoint 演示文稿。借助人工智能驱动的内容生成，您可以通过对话编辑每个细节，并将您的作品导出为可编辑的 PPTX 或带画外音的视频。
plugins.productIntroEn: One-stop AI slide app: create, edit, and export slides as videos with voice-overs, all in one place. Quickly turn any topic, text, PDF, or URL into a professionally designed PowerPoint presentation. With AI-powered content generation, you can edit every detail through conversation and export your work as an editable PPTX or a video with voiceover.

plugins.name: Sociality.io for social media
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Sociality.io 工作区，以在一次对话中分析社交媒体表现、竞争对手活动和后期结果。要求 ChatGPT 审查帐户指标、比较跟踪的竞争对手、总结内容表现并查找 Facebook、Instagram、X、LinkedIn、YouTube 和 TikTok 的模式。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your Sociality.io workspace to analyze social media performance, competitor activity, and post-level results in one conversation. Ask ChatGPT to review account metrics, compare tracked competitors, summarize content performance, and find patterns across Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, and TikTok.

plugins.name: Lnk.Bio
plugins.description: 添加、编辑 Lnk 并设置其样式。
plugins.originalDescription: Add, edit, and style your Lnk.
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 Claude 管理您的整个 Lnk.Bio 个人资料。添加、编辑、安排和重新排序链接。创建页面，添加标题、简介和按钮等内容块。为 Instagram、TikTok 等设置社交图标。浏览并应用主题、自定义颜色和字体或设置壁纸。让 Lnk.Bio 成为您的 AI 工作流程的原生部分，这样您就可以通过对话更快地构建和更新您的链接生物页面。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage your entire Lnk.Bio profile directly from Claude. Add, edit, schedule, and reorder links. Create pages, add content blocks like titles, bios, and buttons. Set up social icons for Instagram, TikTok, and more. Browse and apply themes, customize colors and fonts, or set wallpapers. Make Lnk.

plugins.name: AI Wisebase
plugins.productIntro: 一种与您自己的信息聊天的简单方法。
plugins.productIntroEn: A Simple Way to Chat with Your Own Information.

plugins.name: AnyPDF - Your PDF Converter
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 内无缝管理和转换您的文档。这款一体化 PDF 实用程序可让您以专业的精度立即压缩、转换、合并和编辑文件。 非常适合学生、专业人士以及任何想要快速、可靠的 PDF 解决方案而无需打开其他应用程序的人。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage and transform your documents seamlessly right inside ChatGPT. This all-in-one PDF utility allows you to compress, convert, merge, and edit your files instantly with professional precision. Ideal for students, professionals, and anyone who wants fast, reliable PDF solutions without opening another app.

plugins.name: Nifty
plugins.description: 您的工作中心，通过聊天运行
plugins.originalDescription: Your work hub, run from chat
plugins.productIntro: 连接 Nifty 直接通过聊天构建和运行您的项目。让你的助手创建一个包含阶段、任务、所有者和截止日期的项目——几秒钟内它就会在 Nifty 中上线。在您的工作空间中进行搜索、生成状态报告、显示停滞的任务以及发回更新，所有这些都无需离开对话。 Nifty 仍然是您团队的单一事实来源，因此您的 AI 创建的所有内容都经过组织、共享并准备运行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect Nifty to build and run your projects straight from chat. Ask your assistant to create a project with phases, tasks, owners, and due dates — it’s live in Nifty in seconds. Search across your workspace, generate status reports, surface stalled tasks, and post updates back, all without leaving the conversation.

plugins.name: Smallpdf
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Smallpdf ChatGPT 应用程序，可以压缩您提交的 PDF、电子邮件以及您需要的任何内容，而不会降低质量。需要将 PDF 转换为 Word 文件？简单的;您甚至可以使用 OCR 使文档可编辑。您还可以将图像、Word、Excel 和 PowerPoint 文件转换为 PDF，而无需离开 ChatGPT。继续在 Smallpdf 网站上进行合并、签名、编辑等操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: With the Smallpdf ChatGPT App, compress your PDFs for submissions, emails, and whatever you need, without reducing quality. Need to convert a PDF to a Word file? Easy; you can even use OCR to make the document editable. You can also convert images, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files to PDF, all without leaving ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Jotform Sign
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Jotform Sign 直接在 ChatGPT 内创建、发送和签署文档。只需描述您的需求，Jotform 就会生成一个可供签名的文档，您可以通过对话进行自定义。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create, send, and sign documents directly inside ChatGPT with Jotform Sign. Simply describe what you need, and Jotform generates a signature-ready document you can customize through conversation.

plugins.name: AI Passport
plugins.description: 跨人工智能应用程序的便携式存储器
plugins.productIntro: AI Passport 是您使用的 AI 应用程序自己的内存层。保存一次偏好、决定、项目或注释，然后在任何连接的助手中调用它，这样您就不再重复自己。您始终掌控一切：正常保存会在您批准提案时到达，每个应用程序都会获得您选择的类别的精确、可撤销的通行证，因此没有助手可以全面访问所有内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: AI Passport is your own memory layer for the AI apps you use. Save a preference, decision, project, or note once and recall it in any connected assistant, so you stop repeating yourself. You stay in control: normal saves arrive as proposals you approve, and each app gets an exact, revocable pass to a category you choose, so no assistant gets blanket access to everything.

plugins.name: Dunzo - Task Assistant
plugins.productIntro: Dunzo 是一款会话任务助手，可帮助您通过自然对话捕获和组织任务。
plugins.productIntroEn: Dunzo is a conversational task assistant that helps you capture and organize tasks through natural conversation.

plugins.name: omi
plugins.productIntro: Omi 让 ChatGPT 检索和管理您的 Omi 记忆和对话历史记录。使用它来搜索过去的对话、查看对话详细信息、列出记住的事实以及在 Omi 帐户中创建、编辑或删除私人记忆
plugins.productIntroEn: Omi lets ChatGPT retrieve and manage your Omi memories and conversation history. Use it to search past conversations, review conversation details, list remembered facts, and create, edit, or delete private memories in your Omi account

plugins.name: Voicenotes
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的语音备忘录、文字记录和 Al 会议记录。询问有关过去对话、会议的问题，重新浮现被遗忘的想法，并使用您的口语上下文通过 ChatGPT 起草、计划和完成工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your voice memos, transcripts and Al meeting notes. Ask questions about past conversations, meetings, resurface forgotten ideas and use your spoken context to draft, plan and get things done right from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: XMemo
plugins.productIntro: XMemo 为 ChatGPT 提供了一个私有的、持久的工作空间，可以在对话中携带有用的上下文。它可以保存、搜索、调用、读取完整的内存文本、解释、更新和组织偏好、决策、项目背景、参考注释、TODO 和个人分类帐记录。交互式 TODO Board、Ledger 和 Project Workspace 视图将记住的上下文转化为结构化工作，而无需离开 ChatGPT。
plugins.productIntroEn: XMemo gives ChatGPT a private, persistent workspace that carries useful context across conversations. It can save, search, recall, read full memory text, explain, update, and organize preferences, decisions, project context, reference notes, TODOs, and personal Ledger records.

plugins.name: Lawve
plugins.productIntro: 使用从业者直接在 ChatGPT 中分享的法律方法和指南。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use legal methods and guidance shared by practitioners directly in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: TasksBoard
plugins.productIntro: TasksBoard 是一款简单的看板式待办事项应用程序，可将您的所有日常任务保存在一个地方。并排创建多个列表 - 例如工作、个人、杂货或您正在处理的任何项目 - 并在干净、无干扰的板上一目了然地查看所有内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: TasksBoard is a simple, board-style to-do app that keeps all your daily tasks in one place. Create multiple lists side by side - like Work, Personal, Groceries, or any project you're juggling - and see everything at a glance on a clean, distraction-free board.

plugins.name: Simpliciter AI
plugins.productIntro: Simpliciter AI 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Simpliciter 法律研究帐户。它可以帮助您发现可用的法律来源，跨启用的数据库运行语义研究，并通过精确引用检索特定的法规、判例法、法规、行政指南或其他法律材料。
plugins.productIntroEn: Simpliciter AI connects ChatGPT to your Simpliciter legal research account. It helps you discover the legal sources available to you, run semantic research across enabled databases, and retrieve specific statutes, case law, regulations, administrative guidance, or other legal materials by exact reference.

plugins.name: Qarera
plugins.productIntro: Qarera 将您的求职带入 ChatGPT。在 Qarera 的职位数据库中搜索适合您经验的职位，将其保存到看板式的应用程序跟踪器中，并根据特定职位定制您的简历，并清楚地说明更改前后的情况。调出您跟踪的申请并将其移动到申请、面试、录用等阶段，而无需离开聊天室。免费使用。
plugins.productIntroEn: Qarera brings your job search into ChatGPT. Search Qarera's job database for roles that fit your experience, save them to a Kanban-style application tracker, and tailor your resume to a specific job with a clear before/after of what changed. Pull up your tracked applications and move them through stages applied, interviewing, offered etc. without leaving the chat. Free to use.

plugins.name: post bridge
plugins.productIntro: 帖子桥可让您通过一个关联帐户在 10 个社交平台（X、Instagram、TikTok、YouTube、Facebook、LinkedIn、Pinterest、Bluesky、Threads 和 Google Business）上创建、安排和发布帖子。要求 ChatGPT 起草标题、附加媒体、同时在多个平台上安排帖子，或者撤回您已发布的帖子的视图、点赞和评论。它为您处理特定于平台的规则（媒体要求、每个平台的字幕、安排时间）。
plugins.productIntroEn: post bridge lets you create, schedule and publish posts across 10 social platforms - X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads and Google Business - from one connected account. Ask ChatGPT to draft a caption, attach media, schedule a post across several platforms at once, or pull back views, likes and comments for posts you've published.

plugins.name: AI Whisper Voice Note Taker
plugins.productIntro: Whispr Notes 通过语义搜索将您的语音备忘录带入 ChatGPT：它通过含义（而不仅仅是关键字）查找笔记，并将最相关的内容提取到您的对话中。从那里开始，做人工智能会议可以做的任何事情——回忆过去的想法，总结几周的思考，将口头想法转化为草稿和计划，或者根据你已经捕获的内容回答问题。客服人员可以以同样的方式使用它，将您的语音笔记作为上下文。只读且仅限于您的帐户：它只能搜索和获取您自己的笔记，而不能更改它们。
plugins.productIntroEn: Whispr Notes brings your voice memos into ChatGPT with semantic search: it finds notes by meaning, not just keywords, and pulls the most relevant ones into your conversation. From there, do anything an AI session can do - recall past ideas, summarize weeks of thinking, turn spoken thoughts into drafts and plans, or answer questions from what you've already captured.

plugins.name: AnyQR
plugins.productIntro: 与 ChatGPT 一起使用 QR 码非常容易！
plugins.productIntroEn: A really easy to work with QR codes alongside ChatGPT!

plugins.name: Wordy- Highlight+Annotate Text
plugins.productIntro: 阅读和书写任何带有人工智能突出显示的内容，可以随时解释困难的单词、想法、论点和写作技巧。
plugins.productIntroEn: Read and write anything with AI highlighting that explains difficult words, ideas, arguments, and writing techniques as you go.

plugins.name: Funnel
plugins.description: 访问您的所有营销数据
plugins.productIntro: Funnel 将您的所有营销数据、语义和业务背景通过一项值得信赖的集成方式引入 ChatGPT，涵盖 Google Ads、Facebook Ads (Meta)、TikTok Ads、LinkedIn Ads、Google Analytics、Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads)、Shopify、HubSpot 和 600 多个其他平台。
plugins.productIntroEn: Funnel brings all your marketing data, semantics, and business context to ChatGPT in one trusted integration covering Google Ads, Facebook Ads (Meta), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads), Shopify, HubSpot and 600+ other platforms.

plugins.name: Spinach AI
plugins.productIntro: 就在 ChatGPT 内搜索并调用 Spinach 会议中的所有内容。按日期、与会者、项目或主题从过去的任何会议中提取摘要、行动项目和决策，并在记录中查找特定时刻，而无需滚动浏览数小时的笔记。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search and recall everything from your Spinach meetings, right inside ChatGPT. Pull summaries, action items, and decisions from any past meeting by date, attendee, project, or topic — and find specific moments in transcripts without scrolling through hours of notes.

plugins.name: Fibery
plugins.productIntro: 一旦 Fibery MCP 连接到您的工作空间，OpenAI 几乎可以做您自己在 Fibery 中可以做的任何事情 - 读取和写入数据，或重塑您的工作空间结构。
plugins.productIntroEn: Once Fibery MCP is connected to your workspace, OpenAI can do almost anything you can do in Fibery yourself — read and write data, or reshape your workspace structure.

plugins.name: Carly
plugins.description: 电子邮件、CRM 和工作流程
plugins.productIntro: 卡莉是您的电子邮件、CRM 和经常性工作的执行助理。搜索和阅读您的 Gmail 或 Outlook，从您自己的邮箱或 Carly 的邮箱起草和发送回复，并通过文件夹、标签和一键取消订阅来整理收到的内容。保持联系人和 CRM 记录最新、查找人员并直接查询您自己的结构化数据。在连接的日历中查找空闲时间，创建和重新安排会议，并共享尊重您实际可用性的预订页面。
plugins.productIntroEn: Carly is an executive assistant for your email, CRM, and recurring work. Search and read your Gmail or Outlook, draft and send replies either from your own mailbox or from Carly's, and organize what arrives with folders, labels, and one-click unsubscribe. Keep contacts and CRM records current, look people up, and query your own structured data directly.

plugins.name: Sunsama
plugins.description: 今天专注于重要的事情
plugins.productIntro: 唯一适合现代专业人士的任务管理器、日历和每日计划程序。消除干扰，找到心流，做更多有影响力的工作，而不会精疲力竭。数字每日计划表可帮助您保持平静并保持专注。
plugins.productIntroEn: The only task manager, calendar, and daily planner for modern professionals. Eliminate distractions, find flow, and do more high-impact work without burning out. The digital daily planner that helps you feel calm and stay focused.

plugins.name: RemindMeIQ
plugins.description: 通过提醒保持井井有条
plugins.productIntro: 将日常任务变成清晰的提醒。按照优先级、类别和循环时间表整理清单上的所有内容。通过积分、级别、成就和进度跟踪保持动力。这个应用程序适合所有年龄段。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn everyday tasks into clear reminders. Keep everything on your list organized with priorities, categories, and recurring schedules.. Stay motivated with points, levels, achievements, and progress tracking. This app is suitable for all ages.

plugins.name: agent.spot
plugins.description: 查找并比较人工智能工具
plugins.productIntro: agent.spot 帮助用户发现 AI 工具、检查索引产品配置文件、比较命名产品、寻找替代品、评估硬需求、探索最近添加的工具以及通过 ChatGPT 组装多工具工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: agent.spot helps users discover AI tools, inspect indexed product profiles, compare named products, find alternatives, evaluate hard requirements, explore recently added tools, and assemble multi-tool workflows through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Taskaid AI
plugins.productIntro: Taskaid AI 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 管理私人任务、任务列表和日常计划。它可以查找活动任务和列表，创建或更新任务和任务列表，以及读取或替换 Taskaid 中显示的每日计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: Taskaid AI helps users manage private tasks, task lists, and daily plans from ChatGPT. It can find active tasks and lists, create or update tasks and task lists, and read or replace the daily plan shown in Taskaid.

plugins.name: SignNow
plugins.description: 自动化电子签名工作流程
plugins.productIntro: 无需切换工具即可更快地签署文档。 SignNow MCP 服务器将 Codex 直接连接到您的 SignNow 帐户，让您可以通过对话管理整个电子签名工作流程。发送签名请求、从模板创建文档并预填充它们、跟踪邀请状态以及检索签名文​​件 - 所有这些都通过用简单的语言描述您的需求来实现。无论您是在处理合同、协议还是审批，Codex 都会处理 SignNow 操作，以便您可以专注于工作而不是追逐签名。
plugins.productIntroEn: Get documents signed faster without switching between tools. The SignNow MCP server connects Codex directly to your SignNow account, letting you manage the entire eSignature workflow through conversation. Send signature requests, create documents from templates and pre-fill them, track invite statuses, and retrieve signed files — all by describing what you need in plain language.

plugins.name: Empirical
plugins.productIntro: 人工智能的内存基础设施 记忆无处不在。 拥有你的人工智能记忆。经验为人工智能系统提供跨工具和会话的持久记忆。它将事件、实体、目标和反射存储为连接的节点，因此上下文保持可移植性，而不是锁定到一个模型或一个聊天。
plugins.productIntroEn: Memory Infrastructure For AI Memory that follows you everywhere. Own your AI memory. Empirical gives AI systems persistent memory across tools and sessions. It stores events, entities, goals, and reflections as connected nodes so context stays portable instead of being locked to one model or one chat.

plugins.name: ConvertAPI
plugins.description: 文件转换和 PDF 工具
plugins.productIntro: ConvertAPI 直接在 ChatGPT 对话中转换、处理和提取 500 多种格式的文件中的数据。上传文件，描述您想要的内容，然后获取结果以供下载。
plugins.productIntroEn: ConvertAPI converts, processes, and extracts data from files in over 500 formats - directly in your ChatGPT conversation. Upload a file, describe what you want, and get the result back ready to download.

plugins.name: Visualping
plugins.productIntro: 直接在聊天中跟踪任何网站上的更改。 要求 Visualping 监视页面并在发生变化时收到通知。
plugins.productIntroEn: Track changes on any website directly in chat. Ask Visualping to monitor a page and get notified when something changes.

plugins.name: iScanner
plugins.description: 扫描并制作 PDF 文件
plugins.productIntro: 需要快速处理文档？ iScanner 为聊天带来了人工智能驱动的编辑功能。 使用 iScanner，您可以： 上传多个文件并将其合并为一个看起来像扫描件的 PDF 文件 利用 AI 增强文档 — 消除模糊、修复失真并锐化边缘 裁剪和旋转文档以获得更清晰的外观 直接在文档中添加和自定义文本 应用各种过滤器来自定义您的文档 无论您是学生、专业人士还是任何忙碌的人，iScanner 都可以让您快速轻松地进行文档管理。只需上传、增强和导出，无需离开聊天室。
plugins.productIntroEn: Need to handle a document fast? iScanner brings AI-powered editing right to the chat. With iScanner, you can: Upload and combine multiple files into a single PDF file that looks like a scan Enhance documents with AI—remove blur, fix distortion, and sharpen edges Crop and rotate documents for a cleaner look Add and customize text directly in your documents Apply various filters to customi…

plugins.name: Social Post Previewer
plugins.productIntro: 为 Instagram、Threads、Facebook、X、YouTube、TikTok 和 Instagram Stories 创建逼真的社交帖子模型。发布前检查标题、图像和平台布局。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create realistic social post mockups for Instagram, Threads, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram Stories. Review the caption, image, and platform layout before publishing.

plugins.name: Primitive Email
plugins.productIntro: Primitive Email 允许用户创建代理就绪的电子邮件地址、阅读和搜索入站邮件、发送新消息、在线程中回复、管理域和 Webhook、检查传递历史记录以及对来自 ChatGPT 的电子邮件路由进行故障排除。
plugins.productIntroEn: Primitive Email lets users create an agent-ready email address, read and search inbound mail, send new messages, reply in threads, manage domains and webhooks, inspect delivery history, and troubleshoot email routing from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Superhuman Docs
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Super human Docs 工作区，使其能够读取文档、查询表以及执行创建或更新行等操作。使用 ChatGPT 搜索信息、管理项目并自动化由 Super human Docs 中的数据支持的工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connects ChatGPT to your Superhuman Docs workspace, allowing it to read docs, query tables, and take actions like creating or updating rows. Use ChatGPT to search for information, manage projects, and automate workflows powered by the data in Superhuman Docs.

plugins.name: MoveMate: Gym Workout Tracker
plugins.description: 安排锻炼、跟踪统计数据
plugins.productIntro: MoveMate 将您的训练数据连接到 ChatGPT。询问您的锻炼历史、锻炼量和个人记录；跟踪特定升降机的进展情况；搜索MoveMate的练习库（包括您自己的自定义练习）；并安排计划锻炼，该锻炼会在您选择的日期显示在 MoveMate 应用程序中。读取您的统计数据是免费的 - 安排锻炼需要连接的 MoveMate 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: MoveMate connects your training data to ChatGPT. Ask about your workout history, volume, and personal records; track progression on specific lifts; search MoveMate's exercise library (including your own custom exercises); and schedule a planned workout that shows up in your MoveMate app on the date you choose.

plugins.name: NoveLand
plugins.description: 小説執筆支援と設定資料の管理
plugins.originalDescription: 小説執筆支援と設定資料の管理
plugins.productIntro: NoveLand：小説執筆支援と設定資料の管理。
plugins.productIntroEn: NoveLandは、物語を書くためのエディタと、書いた小説を公開して読める投稿サイトを兼ねたサービスです。本アプリを繋ぐと、NoveLandに置いてある作品のデータをChatGPTの会話から直接読み書きできます。

plugins.name: Cognito MCP
plugins.productIntro: 无需离开 ChatGPT 即可创建表单并管理您的数据。描述您需要的表单并立即构建它，然后查询提交的内容，提取文件和文档，并在收到回复时进行条目更改。无论您是要设置新的受理表单、检查待处理的申请还是检索已签名的文档，您的表单数据都在您需要时就在那里。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create forms and manage your data without leaving ChatGPT. Describe the form you need and build it instantly, then query submissions, pull files and documents, and make entry changes as responses come in. Whether you're setting up a new intake form, checking on pending applications, or retrieving a signed document, your form data is right there when you need it.

plugins.name: CraftNote
plugins.productIntro: CraftNote 允许登录用户搜索、浏览和阅读自己的笔记以及直接与他们共享的笔记，包括文字记录、摘要、与会者和操作项目，并从自己的索引笔记中按语义检索相关摘录。
plugins.productIntroEn: CraftNote lets signed-in users search, browse, and read their own notes and notes shared directly with them, including transcripts, summaries, attendees, and action items, and semantically retrieve relevant excerpts from their own indexed notes.

plugins.name: TwinMind
plugins.productIntro: TwinMind 捕捉您在会议、讲座和面对面对话中所说和听到的一切。它自动转录、总结、主动提供建议和任务，并持续为您的人工智能第二大脑构建上下文。 TwinMind 是一款利用人工智能作为您的第二大脑的生产力工具。它捕捉了听到、看到和说过的一切——随着您与 TwinMind 的互动和参与越多，它就会与您一起成长，从而构建您数字生活的全面背景。
plugins.productIntroEn: TwinMind captures everything you say and hear in your meetings, lectures, and in-person conversations. It automatically transcribes, summarizes, proactively offers suggestions and tasks, and continuously builds context for your AI Second Brain. TwinMind is a productivity tool leveraging AI to function as your second brain.

plugins.name: OneSignal
plugins.productIntro: OneSignal MCP 服务器使人工智能代理能够直接访问 OneSignal 的客户参与平台。代理可以探索用户、细分、消息、模板和分析；回答产品和活动问题；解决交付和参与问题；产生见解；并帮助创建跨推送、电子邮件、短信、RCS、应用内消息传递和实时活动的个性化全渠道消息传递。
plugins.productIntroEn: The OneSignal MCP server gives AI agents direct access to OneSignal’s customer engagement platform. Agents can explore users, segments, messages, templates, and analytics; answer product and campaign questions; troubleshoot delivery and engagement issues; generate insights; and help create personalized omnichannel messaging across push, email, SMS, RCS, in-app messaging, and Live Activit…

plugins.name: NoteItHub
plugins.description: 将聊天变成任务和笔记
plugins.productIntro: Noteithub 允许您根据对话创建 TODO 列表，并将重要的聊天保存为日记条目。
plugins.productIntroEn: Noteithub lets you create TODO lists from conversations and save important chats as journal entries.

plugins.name: Kamai
plugins.productIntro: Kamai 是一个为承包商、分包商、估算员和施工团队构建的人工智能蓝图分析和施工起飞平台。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kamai is an AI blueprint analysis and construction takeoff platform built for contractors, subcontractors, estimators, and construction teams.

plugins.name: 1-2-3-List
plugins.description: 通过 ChatGPT 创建和使用列表！
plugins.productIntro: 在 ChatGPT 中创建和使用列表的最佳方式。
plugins.productIntroEn: The best way to create and work with lists in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: 30 Minute Timer
plugins.productIntro: 30 分钟计时器可帮助用户在 ChatGPT 内启动可视倒数计时器或创建持久的全屏网络计时器链接。用户可以选择分钟或秒的持续时间、视觉背景、进度图标、最终文本、声音系列、中途警报、重复声音和计时器控件，例如暂停、恢复、停止和重新启动。
plugins.productIntroEn: 30 Minute Timer helps users start visual countdown timers inside ChatGPT or create persistent fullscreen web timer links. Users can choose minute or second durations, visual backgrounds, progress icons, final text, sound family, halfway alerts, repeat sound, and timer controls such as pause, resume, stop, and restart.

plugins.name: Artist Growth
plugins.description: 专为 AI 打造的音乐 Ops
plugins.productIntro: 艺术家成长是音乐行业团队在其业务中实际协作的方式——巡演、促销、项目、购票以及其间的一切。
plugins.productIntroEn: Artist Growth is how music industry teams actually collaborate across their business — tours, promo, projects, ticket-buys, and everything in between.

plugins.name: Reed.co.uk
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中查找来自 Reed.co.uk 的相关职位和课程。搜索列表、探索工作详细信息并查找学习选项以帮助您下​​一步的职业发展。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover relevant jobs and courses from Reed.co.uk directly in ChatGPT. Search listings, explore job details, and find learning options to help with your next career move.

plugins.name: StepCue
plugins.productIntro: StepCue 将杂乱的学习任务变成简短的、有指导的重点课程。告诉它你需要做什么，它就会创建一个简单的计时器计划，一次一个明确的步骤。如果您分心，StepCue 可以让您快速重置，这样您就可以返回到会话，而不必过度思考下一步该做什么。
plugins.productIntroEn: StepCue turns messy study tasks into short, guided focus sessions. Tell it what you need to work on, and it creates a simple timer plan with one clear step at a time. If you get distracted, StepCue gives you a quick reset so you can return to the session without overthinking what to do next.

plugins.name: DeckCraft Slides
plugins.productIntro: 轻松创建令人惊叹的演示文稿，以便您可以在编辑器中共享和编辑。
plugins.productIntroEn: Creates Stunning presentations easily so you can share and EDIT in the editor.

plugins.name: smry
plugins.productIntro: 阅读公共文章和 YouTube 视频中干净、基于来源的文本。使用 smry 无需离开 ChatGPT 即可总结要点、比较来源、回答问题以及提取简短引用。 smry 不会绕过硬付费墙或私人访问控制。
plugins.productIntroEn: Read clean, source-grounded text from public articles and YouTube videos. Use smry to summarize key points, compare sources, answer questions, and pull short quotes without leaving ChatGPT. smry does not bypass hard paywalls or private access controls.

plugins.name: Carryo
plugins.productIntro: Carryo 将您在 ChatGPT 中构建的内容转变为真实的实时网页。在聊天中创建演示文稿、幻灯片、提案、报告、登陆页面、仪表板、邀请函、作品集或单页网站，然后说“发布此内容” - Carryo 托管 HTML 并在几秒钟内返回可共享链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Carryo turns what you build in ChatGPT into real, live web pages. Create a presentation, slide deck, proposal, report, landing page, dashboard, invitation, portfolio, or one-page website in chat, then say 'publish this' - Carryo hosts the HTML and hands back a shareable link in seconds.

plugins.name: Apilio
plugins.productIntro: Apilio 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的智能家居自动化平台。查看和管理您的设备、变量和逻辑块。创建新的自动化规则、检查条件并触发操作 - 全部通过自然对话进行。支持涂鸦、Philips Hue、Tado、eWeLink、IFTTT、Alexa、Webhooks 和 REST API。
