plugins.productIntroEn: Apilio connects ChatGPT to your smart home automation platform. View and manage your devices, variables, and logicblocks. Create new automation rules, check conditions, and trigger actions - all through natural conversation. Supports Tuya, Philips Hue, Tado, eWeLink, IFTTT, Alexa, Webhooks and REST API.

plugins.name: Post Metadata Extractor
plugins.productIntro: 帖子元数据提取器从社交媒体发布请求中提取结构化元数据字段。
plugins.productIntroEn: Post Metadata Extractor extracts structured metadata fields from social media posting requests.

plugins.name: Roam Research
plugins.productIntro: 此应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到用户授予的漫游图，以便代理可以读取和写入图。使用此应用程序，ChatGPT 可以帮助您执行以下操作：搜索和检索页面或块、运行漫游和数据记录查询、附加注释、创建页面或块、编辑内容、管理注释以及在允许时删除选定的页面或块。
plugins.productIntroEn: This app connects ChatGPT to the user's granted Roam graphs so that the agent can read from and write to the graphs. Using this app, ChatGPT can assist you by doing: search and retrieve pages or blocks, run Roam and datalog queries, append notes, create pages or blocks, edit content, manage comments, and delete selected pages or blocks when permitted.

plugins.name: Archivist AI
plugins.productIntro: Archivist AI 允许用户在 ChatGPT 中浏览和编辑他们的桌面活动记忆：活动、角色、会话、故事节拍、时刻、派系、位置、项目、任务、日记、日记文件夹、实体链接和实体图像。写入工具可以创建、更新和删除记录（取决于调用者的权限和agent_write范围），并且可以生成或上传实体图像。
plugins.productIntroEn: Archivist AI lets users browse and edit their tabletop campaign memory in ChatGPT: campaigns, characters, sessions, story beats, moments, factions, locations, items, quests, journals, journal folders, entity links, and entity images. Write tools can create, update, and delete records (subject to the caller's permissions and agent_write scope) and can generate or upload entity images.

plugins.name: Patsnap Patent Paper Search
plugins.productIntro: 一款专业工具，可同时在 Patsnap 全球专利和文献数据库中进行深入、集成的搜索。它支持自然语言查询、语义搜索和关键字搜索，并以精确的预过滤功能为后盾，可高效、准确地检索科学和专利情报。该 MCP 还允许用户以 Markdown 格式获取专利或文献的基本书目数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: A professional tool enabling deep, integrated search across the Patsnap global patent and literature databases simultaneously. It supports natural language queries, semantic search, and keyword search, backed by precise pre-filtering capabilities for efficient and accurate retrieval of scientific and patent intelligence.

plugins.name: smarts.bio: AI for biology
plugins.productIntro: smarts.bio 将真正的生物信息学平台引入 ChatGPT。用简单的英语描述您的分析，并根据您自己的数据运行实际的工具和管道 - 无需编写脚本或设置。
plugins.productIntroEn: smarts.bio brings a real bioinformatics platform into ChatGPT. Describe your analysis in plain English and run actual tools and pipelines on your own data — no scripting or setup required.

plugins.name: Vocci
plugins.productIntro: Vocci 将您的语音记忆带入 ChatGPT。连接您的 Vocci 帐户以搜索您的铃声录音、文字记录、AI 摘要、笔记和文件，然后将捕获的对话转化为有用的工作。让 ChatGPT 为您准备会议、总结最近的会议、查找决策和后续行动、从记录中恢复详细信息、创建每周摘要或将语音注释转变为产品简介。 Vocci 仅读取您的请求所需的上下文，并返回简洁的、基于来源的结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Vocci brings your voice memory into ChatGPT. Connect your Vocci account to search your ring recordings, transcripts, AI summaries, notes, and files, then turn captured conversations into useful work.

plugins.name: FindIp
plugins.productIntro: FindIP 按含义搜索专利，而不仅仅是关键字。用通俗易懂的语言描述问题、解决方案或技术，并获得美国、中国、日本、韩国和欧洲最相关的专利。探索申请趋势，深入研究特定部分和权利要求，并分析专利格局——所有这些都来自对话。
plugins.productIntroEn: FindIP searches patents by meaning, not just keywords. Describe a problem, a solution, or a technology in plain language and get the most relevant patents across the US, China, Japan, Korea, and Europe. Explore filing trends, drill into specific sections and claims, and analyze the patent landscape — all from the conversation.

plugins.name: draftmend
plugins.productIntro: ChatGPT 中的 Draftmend 应用程序可帮助用户将 ChatGPT 的文档反馈转化为建议的编辑，他们可以查看、修改并导出为 DOCX 和 PDF 文件。 Draftmend 尝试尽力将任何输入的格式保存到任何输出中。
plugins.productIntroEn: draftmend app in ChatGPT helps users turn document feedback from ChatGPT into proposed edits they can review, modify, and export as DOCX and PDF files. draftmend attempts best-effort formatting preservation from any input into any output.

plugins.name: NewTwos
plugins.description: 捕获列表、待办事项和笔记
plugins.productIntro: NewTwos 是一个快速记下事情的地方。此连接器允许 ChatGPT 将待办事项和注释添加到正确的列表、设置提醒、完成和组织项目以及搜索您捕获的所有内容 - 处理与 NewTwos 应用程序相同的数据，范围仅限于您批准的权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: NewTwos is a fast place to write things down. This connector lets ChatGPT add to-dos and notes to the right list, set reminders, complete and organize items, and search everything you've captured — working on the same data as the NewTwos apps, scoped to the permissions you approve.

plugins.name: Smartsheet EU
plugins.productIntro: 让 Smartsheet 成为您的 AI 工作流程的原生部分。让人工智能分析项目时间表、创建图表来总结工作表信息，所有这些都通过对话进行。 Smartsheet 连接器消除了手动数据输入和重复更新，让您专注于决策，而 AI 处理细节。利用人工智能改变您管理项目的方式，人工智能可以理解您的 Smartsheet 数据并对其采取行动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Make Smartsheet a native part of your AI workflow. Ask your AI to analyze project timelines, create graphs to summarize your sheet information, all through conversation. The Smartsheet connector eliminates manual data entry and repetitive updates, letting you focus on decisions while AI handles the details.

plugins.name: Idea To Prototype Beta
plugins.productIntro: Idea To Prototype Beta 将粗略的产品创意转化为有限的、可审查的原型规划包。它在实施开始之前创建源库存、反通用门、机会备忘录、屏幕图、原型简介、设计合同、构建规范和验证清单。
plugins.productIntroEn: Idea To Prototype Beta turns rough product ideas into bounded, reviewable prototype planning packages. It creates source inventory, anti-generic gate, opportunity memo, screen map, prototype brief, design contract, build spec, and verification checklist before implementation begins.

plugins.name: SlideSpeak
plugins.description: 根据提示进行 AI 演示
plugins.productIntro: SlideSpeak 将您的提示变成精美的演示文稿，而无需离开 ChatGPT。描述主题和受众，通过实时幻灯片预览观看聊天中生成的演示文稿，然后在 SlideSpeak 编辑器中打开完成的演示文稿以对其进行自定义、共享或导出。 Generation 使用您的 SlideSpeak 帐户中包含的积分。
plugins.productIntroEn: SlideSpeak turns your prompt into a polished presentation without leaving ChatGPT. Describe the topic and audience, watch the deck generate right in the chat with live slide previews, then open the finished presentation in the SlideSpeak editor to customize, share, or export it. Generation uses the credits included with your SlideSpeak account.

plugins.name: Mygentic
plugins.description: 与您的工作应用程序聊天
plugins.productIntro: MyGentic 连接您的工作应用程序，帮助您从一个地方搜索、理解您的个人工作知识并采取行动。
plugins.productIntroEn: MyGentic connects your work apps and helps you search, understand, and act on your personal work knowledge from one place.

plugins.name: awork
plugins.productIntro: awork 是创意机构的现代项目管理工具。
plugins.productIntroEn: awork is the modern project management tool for creative agencies.

plugins.name: Decktopus AI
plugins.productIntro: 根据主题或提示创建完整的 AI 生成的演示文稿。 Decktopus 构建大纲、编写幻灯片内容并添加相关视觉效果。查看并编辑您的演示文稿，然后通过链接共享或将其导出为 PowerPoint 或 PDF。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create a complete AI-generated presentation from a topic or prompt. Decktopus builds the outline, writes the slide content, and adds relevant visuals. Review and edit your presentation, then share it by link or export it as a PowerPoint or PDF.

plugins.name: UseMyContext.ai
plugins.productIntro: UseMyContext 为 ChatGPT 提供了用户自己的上下文：他们是谁的编译配置文件、工作和个人生活的单独配置文件、它可以阅读的上传文档以及引用的答案和精确的表查询，以及其他人故意与他们共享的上下文。除了一个工具之外，每个工具都是可读的： suggest_update 会在 UseMyContext.ai 上提交用户亲自审阅的未决建议，而 ChatGPT 中的任何内容都无法修改他们的个人资料或文件。
plugins.productIntroEn: UseMyContext gives ChatGPT the user's own context: a compiled profile of who they are, separate profiles for work and personal life, uploaded documents it can read with cited answers and exact table queries, and contexts other people have deliberately shared with them. Every tool is a read except one: suggest_update files a pending suggestion the user reviews personally on UseMyContext.

plugins.name: CorretorIA
plugins.productIntro: 纠正、重写和理解巴西葡萄牙语的文本。 CorretorIA 并排显示了原始内容和结果，总结了主要调整并提供了针对不同上下文的重写风格。
plugins.productIntroEn: Corrija, reescreva e entenda textos em português brasileiro. O CorretorIA mostra o original e o resultado lado a lado, resume os principais ajustes e oferece estilos de reescrita para diferentes contextos.

plugins.name: Contentful
plugins.productIntro: Contentful 应用程序使 AI 代理可以访问您的 Contentful 空间，使他们能够执行内容管理操作。安装后，该应用程序为空间管理员提供了一个简单的仪表板，以准确控制人工智能客户端可以使用哪些 Contentful 工具：为审计内容的营销团队启用只读访问权限，或为构建代理工作流程的开发人员解锁写入工具。每个空间都有自己的配置。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Contentful App makes your Contentful spaces accessible to AI agents, enabling them to perform content management operations. Once installed, the app gives space admins a simple dashboard to control exactly which Contentful tools are available to AI clients: enable read-only access for marketing teams auditing content, or unlock write tools for developers building agentic workflows.

plugins.name: Network Solutions
plugins.productIntro: 网络解决方案域搜索助手可以快速、简单且对话式地查找可用域。用户无需一次搜索一个名称，而是可以用简单的语言描述他们的想法，并立即检查相关扩展中的域可用性。该助理可帮助完善名称、提出替代方案并快速识别准备注册的选项。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Network Solutions Domain Search Assistant makes finding an available domain fast, simple, and conversational. Instead of searching one name at a time, users can describe their idea in plain language and instantly check domain availability across relevant extensions. The assistant helps refine names, suggest alternatives, and quickly identify options that are ready to register.

plugins.name: Document360
plugins.productIntro: Document360 MCP 帮助授权用户搜索知识库内容、检查项目版本和类别树、创建和更新文章或类别、发布或取消发布内容以及通过 ChatGPT 的工作流分配移动文档。
plugins.productIntroEn: Document360 MCP helps authorized users search knowledge base content, inspect project versions and category trees, create and update articles or categories, publish or unpublish content, and move documents through workflow assignments from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Dex
plugins.productIntro: Dex 帮助您管理 ChatGPT 中的个人和职业关系。查找和更新联系人、组织标签和组、记录笔记、管理提醒和保持联系节奏，以及查看即将到来的生日和后续活动。搜索连接的邮箱元数据、管理连接的日历事件以及阅读或请求引用的有关联系人的公共网络研究。
plugins.productIntroEn: Dex helps you manage personal and professional relationships in ChatGPT. Find and update contacts, organize tags and groups, log notes, manage reminders and keep-in-touch cadence, and review upcoming birthdays and follow-ups. Search connected mailbox metadata, manage connected calendar events, and read or request cited public-web research on contacts.

plugins.name: KaiCalls
plugins.description: 人工智能接听您的业务电话
plugins.productIntro: KaiCalls 将您的人工智能连接到您的商务电话系统。要求它读取您最近的通话和文字记录，检查线索、语音邮件、文本、活动和通话分析，并通过您自己的 KaiCalls 代理拨打外线电话。一切都仅限于您自己的帐户，因此助手可以处理您真实的手机活动，而不是封闭的仪表板。阅读工具可以回答诸如今天谁打电话、他们想要什么以及哪些线索是热门等问题；当您要求时，单一操作工具可以让您自己的客服人员回拨电话。
plugins.productIntroEn: KaiCalls connects your AI to your business phone system. Ask it to read your recent calls and transcripts, check leads, voicemails, texts, campaigns, and call analytics, and place outbound calls through your own KaiCalls agent. Everything is scoped to your own account, so the assistant works with your real phone activity instead of a closed dashboard.

plugins.name: Dovetail
plugins.productIntro: 在 Codex 内连接 Dovetail，无需离开对话即可将客户反馈转化为决策。在您的 Dovetail 工作区中搜索相关项目、注释、文档和主题，并立即返回结果。询问诸如“总结影响企业更新对话的主要摩擦点”之类的问题，即可在几秒钟内找到证据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect Dovetail inside Codex to turn customer feedback into decisions without leaving your conversation. Search your Dovetail workspace for relevant projects, notes, docs, and themes, and get results back instantly. Ask things like “Summarize top friction points impacting enterprise renewal conversations” to surface evidence in seconds.

plugins.name: Super Carl
plugins.productIntro: Super Carl 结合了 LinkedIn、Gmail、X 和 Instagram 上的大规模人员和公司数据、专业意图信号和关系情报，因此 ChatGPT 可以帮助用户找到合适的人，通过其网络绘制最温暖的路径，并运行关系驱动的招聘、销售、筹款、合作伙伴关系和后续工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Super Carl combines large-scale people and company data, professional intent signals, and relationship intelligence across LinkedIn, Gmail, X, and Instagram so ChatGPT can help users find the right person, map the warmest path through their network, and run relationship-driven workflows for recruiting, sales, fundraising, partnerships, and follow-up.

plugins.name: PDF Reader Pro
plugins.productIntro: 使用附件或上传小部件在 ChatGPT 中转换 PDF 和 Office 文件、压缩 PDF、合并文档、提取表格以及管理 PDF 页面。结果以可下载文件的形式返回。
plugins.productIntroEn: Convert PDFs and Office files, compress PDFs, merge documents, extract tables, and manage PDF pages in ChatGPT using attachments or an upload widget. Results are returned as downloadable files.

plugins.name: Fieldy
plugins.description: 回忆一下菲尔迪的谈话
plugins.productIntro: Fieldy 允许用户检索和查看他们在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中记录的真实对话。用户可以浏览最近的对话或特定日期范围，打开对话及其记录，并检查确切的记录行。所有可用的工具都是只读的。
plugins.productIntroEn: Fieldy lets users retrieve and review their recorded real-world conversations in ChatGPT and Codex. Users can browse recent conversations or a specific date range, open a conversation with its transcript, and inspect exact transcript lines. All available tools are read-only.

plugins.name: DeeplyClear
plugins.description: 创建可共享的思维导图
plugins.productIntro: DeeplyClear 是一款交互式思维导图和视觉思维工具，可将复杂的想法、对话、研究、笔记、计划、文档和代码库转换为可编辑、可共享的思维导图和视觉知识图。
plugins.productIntroEn: DeeplyClear is an interactive mind map and visual thinking tool that turns complex ideas, conversations, research, notes, plans, documents, and codebases into editable, shareable mindmaps and visual knowledge maps.

plugins.name: ApplyArc
plugins.productIntro: 在申请之前了解您的简历实际证明了什么。粘贴职位发布和您的简历，或附上一份 PDF/DOCX 简历。 ApplyArc 将每项规定的要求映射到准确的简历证据，在交互式适合报告中显示诚实的差距，仅根据经过验证的事实起草求职信，并在有证据支持的指导下将同一工作转变为面试问题。它从不发明经验或预测招聘结果。无需帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: Know what your CV or resume actually proves before you apply. Paste a job post and your CV, or attach one PDF/DOCX resume. ApplyArc maps each stated requirement to exact CV evidence, shows honest gaps in an interactive Fit Report, drafts a cover letter only from verified facts, and turns the same job into interview questions with evidence-backed guidance.

plugins.name: BIA Edge
plugins.productIntro: BIA Edge 通过检索判例法、法规和条例、机构政策、未发布的决定、有效性和引文处理、签证公告、EOIR 统计数据、学说数据和刑法文本，帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中研究美国移民法。它的 42 个工具是只读的，并返回基于源的记录和警告以供模型评估。它不提供法律建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: BIA Edge helps users research U.S. immigration law in ChatGPT by retrieving case law, statutes and regulations, agency policy, unpublished decisions, validity and citation treatment, visa bulletins, EOIR statistics, doctrine data, and criminal-code text. Its 42 tools are read-only and return source-grounded records and warnings for the model to evaluate. It does not provide legal advice.

plugins.name: Alteryx Insights
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的组织在 Alteryx One 中配置的数据。用简单的语言探索业务问题，获得基于受监管数据的可信答案，并摆脱“发生了什么？”的问题。到“接下来我们应该看什么？”无需切换工具。使用 Alteryx One 了解业务绩效、调查驱动程序、准备更新并根据团队已经依赖的数据更快地做出决策。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to the data your organization has configured in Alteryx One. Explore business questions in plain language, get trusted answers grounded in governed data, and move from "what's happening?" to "what should we look at next?" without switching tools.

plugins.name: Postly
plugins.productIntro: Postly 可帮助您直接从 ChatGPT 创建、安排、发布和管理社交媒体和电子邮件活动。连接您的帐户、上传媒体、起草内容、安排活动、监控发布活动以及跟踪绩效分析 - 所有这些都在一个工作流程中完成。
plugins.productIntroEn: Postly helps you create, schedule, publish, and manage social media and email campaigns directly from ChatGPT. Connect your accounts, upload media, draft content, schedule campaigns, monitor publishing activity, and track performance analytics - all in one workflow.

plugins.name: PomoDial
plugins.description: 番茄工作法专注计时器
plugins.productIntro: PomoDial 是一款番茄钟专注计时器，它会在时钟开始之前询问您正在做什么。告诉 ChatGPT 您的意图，开始定时会话，PomoDial 会跟踪您的焦点历史记录、连续记录和进度。会话与您在 pomodial.com 上的帐户同步，您可以在其中查看您的意图日记、解锁表盘并在排行榜上竞争。
plugins.productIntroEn: PomoDial is a Pomodoro focus timer that asks what you're working on before the clock starts. Tell ChatGPT your intention, start a timed session, and PomoDial tracks your focus history, streaks, and progress. Sessions sync with your account at pomodial.com where you can view your intention journal, unlock dial faces, and compete on the leaderboard.

plugins.name: Memoket
plugins.productIntro: Memoket 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 找到他们的私人录音并检索对话元数据、转录证据、摘要和摘要。
plugins.productIntroEn: Memoket helps users find their private recordings and retrieve conversation metadata, transcript evidence, briefs, and summaries through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Linkly URL Shortener
plugins.description: 营销人员的 URL 缩短器
plugins.productIntro: 营销人员的 URL 缩短器
plugins.productIntroEn: URL Shortener for Marketers

plugins.name: Adzviser
plugins.productIntro: Adzviser 将您的营销数据导入 ChatGPT。
plugins.productIntroEn: Adzviser brings your marketing data into ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Sign.com
plugins.productIntro: 借助 Sign.com ChatGPT 应用程序，用户可以起草协议、合同和其他文档，将其转换为可供签名的 PDF，然后直接在 Sign.com 中打开以进行签名或发送以供签名。用户可以根据简单的提示或自己的 HTML 生成文档，然后继续在 Sign.com 上进行签名过程，以收集签名、管理签名并最终确定文档。
plugins.productIntroEn: With the Sign.com ChatGPT app, users can draft agreements, contracts, and other documents, convert them into signing-ready PDFs, and open them directly in Sign.com to sign or send for signature. Users can generate documents from simple prompts or their own HTML, then continue the signing process on Sign.com to collect signatures, manage signers, and finalize documents.

plugins.name: Productive
plugins.description: 在一个地方运行您的工作
plugins.originalDescription: Run your work in one place
plugins.productIntro: Productive 应用程序将 OpenAI 连接到您的 Productive 组织，让您能够通过对话方式访问您的运营平台。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Productive app connects OpenAI to your Productive organization, giving you conversational access to your operations platform.

plugins.name: Templafy
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 内容和公司知识转化为适合业务的 PowerPoint 演示文稿。 Templafy 将 ChatGPT 连接到您批准的文档代理、品牌主题和最佳实践内容。索取演示文稿，选择公司认可的主题，并生成品牌 PPTX。禁止复制。无需重新格式化。无需手动清理。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn ChatGPT content and company knowledge into business-ready PowerPoint presentations. Templafy connects ChatGPT to your approved document agents, brand themes, and best-practice content. Ask for a deck, pick a company-approved theme, and generate a branded PPTX. No copying. No reformatting. No manual cleanup.

plugins.name: Open Context
plugins.productIntro: 开放上下文可让您在整个 AI 工作流程中存储、组织和重用上下文。您可以将配置文件、文档、说明和其他结构化信息保存在一个位置，然后在需要时将所需内容准确加载到对话或工具中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Open Context lets you store, organize, and reuse context across your AI workflows. You can save profiles, documents, instructions, and other structured information in one place, then load exactly what you need into a conversation or tool when you need it.

plugins.name: ButlerBrain
plugins.productIntro: ButlerBrain 为您的人工智能提供持久记忆。保存想法、搜索笔记、抓取网页、管理日历事件和上传文档，所有这些都可以通过任何人工智能助手进行访问。您的大脑与包括 Obsidian 在内的多种工具原生集成，并且每个记忆都可以在语义上进行搜索。
plugins.productIntroEn: ButlerBrain gives your AI a persistent memory. Save thoughts, search notes, crawl web pages, manage calendar events, and upload documents, all accessible across any AI assistant. Your brain integrates natively with several tools including Obsidian, and every memory is semantically searchable.

plugins.name: Listen Later
plugins.productIntro: Listen Later 允许用户将用户批准的 ChatGPT 文本、URL 和 PDF 文件发送到 Listen Later，以便将它们转换为播客音频并通过用户的 Listen Later feed 进行传送。
plugins.productIntroEn: Listen Later lets users send user-approved ChatGPT text, URLs, and PDF files to Listen Later so they can be converted into podcast audio and delivered through the user's Listen Later feed.

plugins.name: Compare Text
plugins.productIntro: 并排比较两个版本的文本，看看到底发生了什么变化。该应用程序以绿色突出显示添加内容，以红色突出显示删除内容，并清楚地显示未更改的文本。非常适合审查编辑、比较草稿版本、跟踪文档更改或查看对您的写作进行了哪些修改。获取任意两个文本之间差异的即时视觉反馈，以及有关添加、删除和修改的详细统计数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Compare two versions of text side-by-side and see exactly what changed. This app highlights additions in green, deletions in red, and shows unchanged text clearly. Perfect for reviewing edits, comparing draft versions, tracking document changes, or seeing what modifications were made to your writing.

plugins.name: Outliner
plugins.productIntro: 在 ChatGPT 中将想法或上传的文件转化为清晰的轮廓。 要求 Outliner 构建融资方案、规划产品发布或撰写论文；它会立即构建一个逻辑层次结构，您可以提升、修剪或删除——让您在格式化时进行思考。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn an idea or an uploaded file into a clean outline right inside ChatGPT. Ask Outliner to structure a pitch deck, map a product launch, or shape an essay; it instantly builds a logical hierarchy you can promote, trim, or delete — letting you think while it formats.

plugins.name: Fattura24
plugins.productIntro: 将您的 Fattura24 帐户连接到 ChatGPT，并以自然语言查询您的管理和会计数据，无需打开报告、在各个部分之间导航或构建手动分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: Collega il tuo account Fattura24 a ChatGPT e interroga i tuoi dati gestionali e contabili in linguaggio naturale, senza aprire report, navigare tra sezioni o costruire analisi manuali.

plugins.name: Formbyte
plugins.productIntro: 在 ChatGPT 内快速启动表单创建。要求 Formbyte 快速开展调查、注册表单、民意调查，然后在同一线程中完善或分析结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Jump-start form creation inside ChatGPT. Ask Formbyte to whip up surveys, signup forms, polls—then refine or analyze results right in the same thread.

plugins.name: Context Link
plugins.productIntro: 您的企业遍布一千个地方。为 ChatGPT 提供一种与所有内容对话的方式。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your business lives in a thousand places. Give ChatGPT a single way to talk to all of it.

plugins.name: Rebarly
plugins.description: 使用 ChatGPT 构建代码
plugins.productIntro: 我们帮助建筑师和工程师有效地使用人工智能。我们以简单有效的方式提供对 IBC、IRC 和 UFGS 代码的访问。您的 ChatGPT 现在可以说出代码，从而节省时间和金钱。
plugins.productIntroEn: We help architects and engineers effectively use AI. We provide access to the IBC and IRC and UFGS code in a simple and effective way. Your ChatGPT can now speak the code saving time and money.

plugins.name: Content Brief Extractor
plugins.productIntro: 内容摘要提取器从内容请求文本中提取结构化内容摘要字段。它返回主题、目标受众、渠道、截止日期、缺失字段和错误。它不编写内容、创建营销策略、选择渠道、安排帖子、发布内容或调用外部系统。该应用程序是无状态的、只读的，并且仅处理当前请求的提交文本。
plugins.productIntroEn: Content Brief Extractor extracts structured content brief fields from content request text. It returns topic, target audience, channel, deadline, missing fields, and errors. It does not write content, create marketing strategy, choose channels, schedule posts, publish content, or call external systems.

plugins.name: Smartsheet AU
plugins.productIntro: 让 Smartsheet 成为您的 AI 工作流程的原生部分。让人工智能分析项目时间表、创建图表来总结工作表信息，所有这些都通过对话进行。 Smartsheet 连接器消除了手动数据输入和重复更新，让您专注于决策，而 AI 处理细节。利用人工智能改变您管理项目的方式，人工智能可以理解您的 Smartsheet 数据并对其采取行动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Make Smartsheet a native part of your AI workflow. Ask your AI to analyze project timelines, create graphs to summarize your sheet information, all through conversation. The Smartsheet connector eliminates manual data entry and repetitive updates, letting you focus on decisions while AI handles the details.

plugins.name: Jade Note
plugins.productIntro: Jade Note 作为持久内存层，让 ChatGPT 能够安全地访问您的个人笔记。通过 MCP，ChatGPT 可以按关键字或含义搜索笔记、阅读类别上下文、创建和附加笔记、建议链接并保持知识井井有条。 OAuth 身份验证、按类别访问控制、更改预览、版本历史记录和回滚使 AI 辅助内存安全透明，同时保持相同的 Markdown 笔记在 Jade Note Web 应用程序中可编辑。
plugins.productIntroEn: Jade Note gives ChatGPT secure access to your personal notes as a persistent memory layer. Through MCP, ChatGPT can search notes by keyword or meaning, read category context, create and append notes, suggest links, and keep knowledge organized.

plugins.name: Recordo
plugins.productIntro: Recordo 帮助用户捕获 ADHD 任务和笔记、检索保存的项目、计划当天、选择下一个要关注的任务、完成重复性或一次性任务，以及通过 ChatGPT 更新任务计划。这些工具在用户的私人 Recordo 帐户上运行，并通过交互式小部件返回重点计划或下一步视图。
plugins.productIntroEn: Recordo helps users capture ADHD tasks and notes, retrieve saved items, plan the current day, pick the next task to focus on, complete recurring or one-off tasks, and update task plans through ChatGPT. The tools operate on the user's private Recordo account and return focused schedule or next-step views with interactive widgets.

plugins.name: A-Z Links
plugins.description: 聊天中易于访问的链接
plugins.productIntro: 如果您发现很难看到 ChatGPT 对话中的链接，只需使用此应用程序即可。
plugins.productIntroEn: If you find it hard to see the links in ChatGPT conversations, just use this app.

plugins.name: OctoEverywhere
plugins.description: 监视和控制 3D 打印机
plugins.productIntro: OctoEverywhere 帮助用户监控连接的 3D 打印机、检查实时打印状态和 AI 故障检测、查看网络摄像头快照和文件列表、调试和修复常见的 3D 打印问题，以及通过 ChatGPT 使用权限控制的打印机命令。
plugins.productIntroEn: OctoEverywhere helps users monitor their connected 3D printers, check live print status and AI failure detection, view webcam snapshots and file listings, debug and fix common 3D printing issues, and use permission-controlled printer commands through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: DotSpark
plugins.description: 让你的人工智能理性像你一样
plugins.originalDescription: Make your AI reason like you
plugins.productIntro: 现在每个人都用同样的人工智能思考，它悄悄地将原创性变成了自信的平均水平。 DotSpark 是一面镜子，让您保持自己的判断力。连接一次，您的助手会在每次对话开始时读取您的思维盾，并在整个会话中遵循它：在同意之前提出质疑，首先让您推理，保留您的想法并表达您的想法。当您工作时，它会捕获您的思维残余 - 见解（“点”）、它们之间的联系（“火花”）以及定期读取您的想法 - 将其记录到您的个人 DotSpark 图表中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Everyone now thinks with the same AI, which quietly flattens originality into a confident average. DotSpark is the mirror that keeps your judgment yours. Connect it once and your assistant reads your Thinking Shield at the start of every conversation and follows it for the whole session: challenge before agreeing, make you reason first, keep your ideas and voice yours.

plugins.name: Plate
plugins.productIntro: 团队和人工智能代理的最小项目管理。人员和人工智能代理并肩工作，规划工作、跟踪任务并保持项目进展。结构：工作区、项目、部分和任务。
plugins.productIntroEn: Minimal project management for teams and AI agents. Plan work, track tasks, and keep projects moving forward with people and AI agents working side by side. Structure: workspaces, projects, sections, and tasks.

plugins.name: DocuSeal
plugins.productIntro: DocuSeal 允许您从 PDF 创建文档模板、发送它们进行电子签名并跟踪签名状态 - 所有这些都通过简单的对话完成。搜索模板，将文档发送给多个签名者，并在不离开聊天的情况下检查谁签名了。
plugins.productIntroEn: DocuSeal lets you create document templates from PDFs, send them for e-signing, and track signing status - all through a simple conversation. Search your templates, send documents to multiple signers, and check who has signed without leaving the chat.

plugins.name: Nuwa
plugins.productIntro: 将您的女娲笔连接至 ChatGPT。使用自然语言搜索、回忆和总结您的手写笔记。询问您今天写了什么，查找有关特定主题的笔记，浏览您的笔记本，或查看您的笔迹的渲染图像 - 所有这些都无需离开对话。 Nuwa 将您的纸笔笔记变成 AI 工作流程的一部分。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Nuwa Pen to ChatGPT. Search, recall, and summarize your handwritten notes using natural language. Ask what you wrote today, find notes about a specific topic, browse your notebooks, or view a rendered image of your handwriting — all without leaving the conversation. Nuwa turns your pen-and-paper notes into part of your AI workflow.

plugins.name: Moknah
plugins.productIntro: Moknah 将文本和文档转换为听起来自然的语音和完整的有声读物，特别是对阿拉伯语以及许多其他语言的大力支持。粘贴文本或上传 PDF、Word 或 EPUB，选择语音，并生成可预览和下载的音频。对于阿拉伯语，它会自动添加变音符号 (tashkeel) 并对文本进行规范化，以便单词发音正确，并具有可选的情感和诗歌模式。将较长的作品分成章节，为每个部分设置不同的声音，并在导出之前检查质量。生成音频需要 Moknah 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: Moknah turns text and documents into natural-sounding speech and complete audiobooks, with especially strong support for Arabic alongside many other languages. Paste text or upload a PDF, Word, or EPUB, choose a voice, and generate audio you can preview and download.

plugins.name: AI Delivery Evidence Checker
plugins.productIntro: 检查您提供的交付材料和测试证据是否支持 AI 编码完成声明。提取可验证的标准，识别受支持和不受支持的工作，找到证据差距，并生成结构化的交付判决 - 所有这些都无需访问存储库或修改代码。
plugins.productIntroEn: Check whether AI coding completion claims are supported by the delivery materials and test evidence you provide. Extract verifiable criteria, identify supported and unsupported work, find evidence gaps, and generate a structured delivery verdict—all without accessing repositories or modifying code.

plugins.name: D-Tools Cloud
plugins.productIntro: D-Tools Cloud 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 D-Tools Cloud 帐户，以便您可以询问有关管道、报价、项目、客户、帐户运行状况、采购风险和相关业务数据的只读问题。该应用程序可以确认您的连接、列出可访问的帐户、针对授权帐户询问 D-Tools 问题，以及通过规范源链接检索可靠的 D-Tools 帮助中心指南，而无需创建、更新、发送或批准租户记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: D-Tools Cloud connects ChatGPT to your D-Tools Cloud account so you can ask read-only questions about pipeline, quotes, projects, clients, account health, procurement risk, and related business data.

plugins.name: Truffle Journal
plugins.productIntro: 从人工智能聊天中获取见解——将最精彩的部分保存在笔记中，以便稍后立即回忆起来。
plugins.productIntroEn: Harvest the insights from AI chats—save the best parts with your note, recall them instantly later.

plugins.name: 6sense
plugins.productIntro: 将您的 AI 助手连接到 6sense，以使用自然语言检索帐户见解。直接在工作流程中访问帐户数据、6QA 趋势、关键字活动和营销活动效果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your AI assistant to 6sense to retrieve account insights using natural language. Access account data, 6QA trends, keyword activity, and campaign performance directly in your workflow.

plugins.name: BrightHire
plugins.productIntro: BrightHire 帮助用户搜索面试记录、检索笔录、人工智能笔记、面试指南、记分卡、职位描述、候选人摘要、安排的面试背景以及他们有权查看的辅导报告。
plugins.productIntroEn: BrightHire helps users search interview records, retrieve transcripts, AI notes, interview guides, scorecards, job descriptions, candidate summaries, scheduled interview context, and coaching reports they are authorized to view.

plugins.name: firestorage.ai
plugins.productIntro: 将文件上传到 firestorage.ai 并接收共享链接、将文件添加到现有共享、查看最近上传的内容或将文件发送到 AI 地址收件箱。
plugins.productIntroEn: Upload files to firestorage.ai and receive a share link, add files to an existing share, view recent uploads, or send a file to an AI Address inbox.

plugins.name: ChatData Sync
plugins.description: 跟踪您描述的任何内容
plugins.productIntro: ChatData Sync 将 ChatGPT 变成您的个人跟踪助手。用简单的英语描述您想要跟踪的内容，它会创建一个私人结构化跟踪器，您可以直接在聊天中填写、搜索和更新。一个连接可以管理多个工作流程跟踪器，例如客户发票、花园日志、锻炼和维护记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: ChatData Sync turns ChatGPT into your personal tracking assistant. Describe what you want to track in plain English, and it creates a private structured tracker you can fill, search, and update directly in chat. One connection can manage multiple trackers for workflows like client invoices, garden logs, workouts, and maintenance records.

plugins.name: MarcoPolo
plugins.description: 安全的人工智能数据工作空间
plugins.productIntro: MarcoPolo 启动了一个安全容器，ChatGPT 可以在其中处理您的实际数据。使用从未暴露给模型的范围凭证连接到您的数据库、API、S3、lakehouse、CRM、Jira、日志等。
plugins.productIntroEn: MarcoPolo spins up a secure container where ChatGPT can work with your actual data. Connect to your databases, APIs, S3, lakehouses, CRMs, Jira, logs and much more—using scoped credentials that are never exposed to the model.

plugins.name: StoryChief
plugins.productIntro: StoryChief 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 搜索、检查、创建和更新工作区内容，包括文章、社交帖子、网页、时事通讯、播客、视频脚本、网络研讨会和电子书。该应用程序返回编辑器链接、评论上下文、调度字段和媒体详细信息，以便用户可以在 StoryChief 中继续审阅、批准和发布。
plugins.productIntroEn: StoryChief helps users search, inspect, create, and update workspace content from ChatGPT, including articles, social posts, webpages, newsletters, podcasts, video scripts, webinars, and ebooks. The app returns editor links, comment context, scheduling fields, and media details so users can continue review, approval, and publishing in StoryChief.

plugins.name: Meeting Summarizer
plugins.productIntro: Chat Everywhere 的 Meeting Summarizer 可帮助用户查找过去的会议，检索摘要、报告和思维导图，搜索带时间戳的文字记录证据，并使用该上下文在 ChatGPT 中准备后续会议和草稿。访问权限仅限于经过身份验证的合格帐户拥有的会议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Meeting Summarizer by Chat Everywhere helps users find past meetings, retrieve summaries, reports, and mind maps, search timestamped transcript evidence, and use that context to prepare follow-ups and drafts in ChatGPT. Access is limited to meetings owned by the authenticated eligible account.

plugins.name: VaultSage
plugins.productIntro: VaultSage 帮助用户上传文本文件作为持久 AI 内存、浏览和搜索存储的知识、使用文件上下文与 VaultSage AI 聊天、检查存储指标、将文件组织到目录中、创建共享链接以及删除过时的文件。
plugins.productIntroEn: VaultSage helps users upload text files as persistent AI memory, browse and search stored knowledge, chat with VaultSage AI using file context, inspect storage metrics, organize files into directories, create share links, and remove outdated files.

plugins.name: IMEI Checker by Kelpom
plugins.description: 通过 IMEI 识别任何手机
plugins.originalDescription: Identify any phone by its IMEI
plugins.productIntro: Kelpom 帮助用户识别与 15 位 IMEI 关联的手机或平板电脑型号。它使用 Kelpom 的内部 TAC 缓存和提供商支持的查找后备功能，返回设备营销名称、品牌或制造商以及型号（如果有）。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kelpom helps users identify the phone or tablet model associated with a 15-digit IMEI. It returns the device marketing name, brand or manufacturer, and model number when available, using Kelpom's internal TAC cache with a provider-backed lookup fallback.

plugins.name: Wistia
plugins.description: 管理您的 Wistia 内容
plugins.productIntro: Wistia 的 MCP 服务器可让您从 ChatGPT 管理整个视频库。在您已经工作的地方上传视频、进行批量更新、管理内容访问以及通过快速提示检查网络研讨会或视频性能。内置技能使您能够大规模自动化视频和网络研讨会工作流程，从而推动真正的业务增长。
plugins.productIntroEn: Wistia's MCP server lets you manage your entire video library from ChatGPT. Upload videos, make bulk updates, manage content access, and check webinar or video performance with quick prompts where you already work. Built-in skills enable you to automate your video and webinar workflows at scale that drive real business growth.

plugins.name: Hevy
plugins.description: 与您的 Hevy 数据交互
plugins.productIntro: Hevy 的 ChatGPT 应用程序可让您制定锻炼计划并将其直接保存到您的 Hevy 帐户。您还可以分析您的锻炼数据（例如，“@hevy 为我制定了 4 天的训练计划，以便今年夏天获得成功”、“@hevy 根据我过去 20 次的锻炼，您能给我哪些改进建议？”）
plugins.productIntroEn: Hevy's ChatGPT app let's you build workout plans and save them directly to your Hevy account. You can also analyse your workout data (e.g. "@hevy build my a 4 day split to get jacked this summer", "@hevy based on my my past 20 workouts what tips can you give me to improve?")

plugins.name: App Atlas
plugins.description: 查找 ChatGPT 和 Claude 应用程序
plugins.productIntro: Atlas 是 ChatGPT 和 Claude 应用程序的可搜索目录。按类别、用例或关键字询问应用程序，Atlas 会返回一个干净的匹配结果表格，以便您一目了然地比较选项。对于探索环境的开发人员、为任务寻找合适工具的用户以及任何对当今存在的人工智能原生应用程序感到好奇的人来说，它都非常有用。 Atlas 不涵盖 ChatGPT 和 Claude 生态系统之外的通用软件，不处理应用程序安装或购买，也不提供与构建、编码或配置应用程序相关的意图。
plugins.productIntroEn: Atlas is a searchable directory of ChatGPT and Claude apps. Ask for apps by category, use case, or keyword and Atlas returns a clean table of matching results so you can compare options at a glance. It is useful for developers scouting the landscape, users looking for the right tool for a task, and anyone curious about what AI-native apps exist today.

plugins.name: LibreJustice
plugins.productIntro: LibreJustice 帮助用户研究法国和欧洲判例法，并检索在特定日期阅读的法律文本。它搜索法国行政、司法、宪法、庇护和数据保护机构以及欧洲法院的决定，并过滤法院、结果、日期和引用的条款。用户可以打开决定的全文，搜索法国立法和精选条约或外国法规，检索文章的版本历史记录，并查看自己保存的活动。
plugins.productIntroEn: LibreJustice helps users research French and European case law and retrieve legal texts as they read on a specific date. It searches decisions from French administrative, judicial, constitutional, asylum and data-protection bodies as well as European courts, with filters for court, outcome, date and cited provisions.

plugins.name: STORM Brains4Ai
plugins.description: 安全地自动化人工智能工作流程
plugins.productIntro: STORM Brains4Ai 帮助团队使用受管理的工具运行人工智能驱动的工作流程，用于知识搜索、内容生成、提供商模拟、产品目录查找、结账会话创建和 GeoQode 执行。
plugins.productIntroEn: STORM Brains4Ai helps teams run AI-powered workflows with governed tools for knowledge search, content generation, provider simulation, product catalog lookup, checkout session creation, and GeoQode execution.

plugins.name: Guides
plugins.productIntro: Guides 是 ChatGPT 中生活个人笔记本的协作编辑器。随着时间的推移，阅读结构、框架大纲、填写和修改页面——偏好概况、膳食计划、学习旅程。对用户帐户的 OAuth；指南是主要工件，而不是聊天记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: Guides is a collaborative editor for living personal notebooks in ChatGPT. Read structure, scaffold outlines, fill and revise pages over time—preference profiles, meal plans, learning journeys. OAuth to the user's account; the guide is the primary artifact, not chat history.

plugins.name: Zeiko Agents
plugins.description: 部署和管理 AI 代理
plugins.productIntro: 从 ChatGPT 和 Codex 创建、配置、部署和操作帐户范围的 Zeiko 代理和团队，并获得相应更改的批准。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create, configure, deploy, and operate account-scoped Zeiko agents and teams from ChatGPT and Codex, with approvals for consequential changes.

plugins.name: Wave AI Note Taker
plugins.productIntro: Wave AI Note Taker 可帮助用户搜索私人会议、通话和录音，比较各个会议的讨论情况，检索发言者归属的文字记录，审查操作项目，并将会议组织到文件夹中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Wave AI Note Taker helps users search their private meetings, calls, and recordings, compare discussions across sessions, retrieve speaker-attributed transcripts, review action items, and organize sessions into folders.

plugins.name: Spoki
plugins.description: 自动化您的通信人工智能
plugins.productIntro: Spoki 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Spoki 临时帐户，以便用户可以检查联系人、活动、票证、列表、模板、自动化和 CRM 记录，然后通过 MCP 工具执行支持的 Spoki 工作流程更新。
plugins.productIntroEn: Spoki connects ChatGPT to the Spoki staging account so users can inspect contacts, campaigns, tickets, lists, templates, automations, and CRM records, then perform supported Spoki workflow updates through the MCP tools.

plugins.name: InvoiceCraft AI
plugins.productIntro: InvoiceCraft AI 帮助服务企业根据客户、服务、定价、存款、折扣、税收、到期日、付款方式、货币和模板输入创建结构化发票。它返回行项目、总计、付款说明、滞纳金注释和客户就绪的发票消息。
plugins.productIntroEn: InvoiceCraft AI helps service businesses create structured invoices from client, service, pricing, deposit, discount, tax, due date, payment method, currency, and template inputs. It returns line items, totals, payment instructions, a late-fee note, and a client-ready invoice message.

plugins.name: Dijin Memory
plugins.description: 通过 AI 调用记忆
plugins.productIntro: Dijin 是您的数字生活和人工智能代理的**内存层** - 一个开放的、所有者签名的、引用或拒绝的存储，用于存储您的决策、行动项目、实体和证据引用。
plugins.productIntroEn: Dijin is the **Memory Layer** for your digital life and AI agents — an open, owner-signed, cite-or-refuse store of your decisions, action items, entities, and evidence citations.

plugins.name: Tallyfy Workflow Automation
plugins.description: 通过聊天运行您的工作流程
plugins.productIntro: 连接 Tallyfy 并直接通过聊天运行您的工作流程。启动和跟踪流程、完成和分配任务、管理审批、在整个组织中搜索以及构建或更新模板，所有这些都在您自己的 Tallyfy 帐户中进行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect Tallyfy and run your workflows right from chat. Launch and track processes, complete and assign tasks, manage approvals, search across your organization, and build or update templates, all in your own Tallyfy account.

plugins.name: Sitemate
plugins.productIntro: ChatGPT 中的 Sitemate 应用程序可让您在一处搜索、查询施工和项目管理数据并与之交互。访问 Sitemate（包括 Dashpivot）中存储的信息，使用自然语言来表达见解、跟踪进度并立即回答问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Sitemate app in ChatGPT lets you search, query, and interact with your construction and project management data in one place. Access information stored across Sitemate, including Dashpivot, using natural language to surface insights, track progress, and answer questions instantly.

plugins.name: GTD Brain: Getting Things Done
plugins.description: 在聊天中管理您的 GTD 看板
plugins.originalDescription: Manage your GTD board in chat
plugins.productIntro: GTD Brain 将您的“完成事情”板带入 ChatGPT。询问您的盘子里有什么，它会显示您询问的确切部分 - 您的收件箱、您的下一步行动、您的项目或您正在等待的人 - 作为答案的一部分内联呈现。在一行中将新项目捕获到收件箱、在列之间移动卡片以及标记已完成的事情，所有这些都可以通过聊天完成。您的主板与 GTD Brain 网络、Android 和 iOS 应用程序保持同步。需要 GTD Brain 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: GTD Brain brings your Getting Things Done board into ChatGPT. Ask what's on your plate and it shows the exact slice you asked about — your inbox, your next actions, your projects, or who you're waiting on — rendered inline as part of the answer. Capture new items to your inbox in one line, move cards between columns, and mark things done, all from chat.

plugins.name: PeopleRun AI v.2
plugins.productIntro: PeopleRun AI 帮助用户将想法转化为清晰的工作包，其中包含目标、来源、证据和下一步行动。它旨在审查产品工作、保持构建上下文井井有条，并为 ChatGPT 或其他 AI 工具准备交接。
plugins.productIntroEn: PeopleRun AI helps users turn an idea into a clear work packet with a goal, sources, proof, and next action. It is designed for reviewing product work, keeping build context organized, and preparing handoffs for ChatGPT or other AI tools.

plugins.name: DNS Doctor
plugins.description: 扫描、修复并验证您的 DNS
plugins.productIntro: DNS Doctor 扫描、修复和验证域的 DNS，并返回确定性结论以及由验证引擎生成的复制粘贴修复记录（RFC 语法加上 SPF 10 查找计数器）——绝不是法学硕士的猜测。它诊断电子邮件身份验证（SPF、DMARC、DKIM）、MX、DNS 运行状况、黑名单列表和域/SSL 过期；审核谁可以通过其 SPF 包含作为域传递发送；从六个有利位置验证 DNS 更改是否已在全球范围内传播；构建对齐门控 DMARC 强制升级（p=仅当服务器派生的对齐门通过时拒绝…
plugins.productIntroEn: DNS Doctor scans, fixes and verifies a domain's DNS and returns deterministic verdicts plus copy-paste fix records generated by a validating engine (RFC grammar plus the SPF 10-lookup counter) — never an LLM guess.

plugins.name: IQLand
plugins.productIntro: IQLand 将美国街道地址转变为开发商级房产报告。解决地块问题，阅读其分区和可建造的信封，估算建筑成本，根据建筑计划库运行 SmartBuild 可行性，拉动可比销售，并生成完整的评估 IQ（成本方法 + 调整后的比较 + 调节后的价值）。专为评估美国房地产的投资者、开发商、代理商和评估师而打造。所有工具都是只读的：它们从 IQLand 的分区、成本和建筑规划服务以及公共地块/列表数据中查找和获取数据，并且从不创建、修改或删除记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: IQLand turns a U.S. street address into a developer-grade property report. Resolve a parcel, read its zoning and buildable envelope, estimate construction cost, run SmartBuild feasibility against a library of architectural plans, pull comparable sales, and generate a full Appraisal IQ (cost approach + adjusted comps + reconciled value).

plugins.name: Hemelion
plugins.productIntro: Hemelion 决策工具为 ChatGPT 带来了两条反思路径：用于构建困难的、不受监管的决策的清晰性，以及用于在没有诊断或固定个性标签的情况下检查重复出现的响应模式的 MindScan。它可以选择适当的路径，从四个明确的评级中评估决策准备情况，并解释 Hemelion 的公共方法、保障措施和证据边界。这些工具是免费的，不需要帐户，并且不会访问私人扫描或报告。
plugins.productIntroEn: Hemelion Decision Tools brings two reflection paths to ChatGPT: Clarity for structuring difficult, non-regulated decisions and MindScan for examining recurring response patterns without diagnosis or fixed personality labels. It can choose the appropriate path, assess decision readiness from four explicit ratings, and explain Hemelion’s public method, safeguards, and evidence boundaries.

plugins.name: Lyssna
plugins.productIntro: Lyssna 的 MCP 服务器将您的研究数据连接到 ChatGPT，因此您可以询问您的研究并从实际数据中获取答案，而不是猜测。
plugins.productIntroEn: Lyssna's MCP server connects your research data to ChatGPT, so you can ask about your studies and get answers pulled from your actual data instead of a guess.

plugins.name: WeTransfer
plugins.description: 使用 WeTransfer 发送文件
plugins.productIntro: 直接通过 WeTransfer 对话发送文件。
plugins.productIntroEn: Send files straight from your conversation with WeTransfer.

plugins.name: Newsmind — RSS for your AI
plugins.description: 阅读并搜索您的 RSS 源
plugins.originalDescription: Read and search your RSS feeds
plugins.productIntro: Newsmind 将您的 RSS 订阅连接到 ChatGPT。询问最新消息并从您选择的来源获取简报；按关键字或含义搜索您的提要；将同一个故事分组到各个渠道；为文章加注星标并进行组织；并设置对主题的关注，以便下次您询问时匹配正在等待。跨对话读取位置同步，并通过 OPML 一步导入现有订阅。
plugins.productIntroEn: Newsmind connects your RSS subscriptions to ChatGPT. Ask what's new and get briefings from the sources you chose; search your feeds by keyword or by meaning; group the same story across outlets; star and organize articles; and set watches on topics so matches are waiting next time you ask. Read position syncs across conversations, and existing subscriptions import in one step via OPML.

plugins.name: Workjournal
plugins.description: 为您的项目提供共享内存
plugins.productIntro: Workjournal 是一种结构化工作日志，专为多代理和多团队成员协作而构建。直接从 ChatGPT 或任何 AI 代理记录决策、会话理由和项目注释。每个条目都可以在您的团队中立即搜索和共享。使用 Workjournal 揭示过去决策背后的背景，在代理之间移交工作，并实时记录项目演变的原因。
plugins.productIntroEn: Workjournal is a structured work journal built for multi-agent and multi-teammate collaboration. Log decisions, session rationale, and project notes directly from ChatGPT or any AI agent. Every entry is instantly searchable and shareable across your team.

plugins.name: ScalperIntel AI
plugins.productIntro: ScalperIntel AI 回答有关 ScalperIntel 指标的问题，并让经过验证的客户无需离开聊天即可管理自己的许可证。
plugins.productIntroEn: ScalperIntel AI answers questions about ScalperIntel's indicators and lets verified customers manage their own licenses without leaving the chat.

plugins.name: FlagStat
plugins.productIntro: FlagStat 帮助腰旗橄榄球项目获得有关得分、统计数据、报告、规则集和赛季运作的清晰答案。教练、体育总监、联赛组织者和记分员可以使用它来了解 ChatGPT 内的实时评分、电影审查工作流程、导出、合规性需求和程序设置。
plugins.productIntroEn: FlagStat helps flag football programs get clear answers about scoring, stats, reports, rulesets, and season operations. Coaches, athletic directors, league organizers, and scorekeepers can use it to understand live scoring, film review workflows, exports, compliance needs, and program setup inside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Owll
plugins.productIntro: Owll是一款人工智能笔记产品，用于会议、录音、文档、图像和其他内容。 Owll for ChatGPT 连接到用户授权的 Owll 库，允许用户搜索笔记、浏览文件夹、查看笔记详细信息和 AI 生成的摘要，以及根据请求访问或导出成绩单。当前版本提供只读访问权限，无法创建、编辑或删除笔记。
plugins.productIntroEn: Owll is an AI note-taking product for meetings, recordings, documents, images, and other content. Owll for ChatGPT connects to a user’s authorized Owll library, allowing them to search notes, browse folders, view note details and AI-generated summaries, and access or export transcripts upon request. The current version provides read-only access and cannot create, edit, or delete notes.

plugins.name: Matchbox
plugins.description: 寻找解决任何问题的工具
plugins.productIntro: Matchbox 可帮助您找到解决实际问题的正确产品或工具。用简单的语言描述您遇到的困难 - “我总是忘记吃药”，“我需要跟踪三种货币的费用” - Matchbox 会返回与您的情况相匹配的特定产品，并根据它们的适合程度而不是它们的受欢迎程度进行排名。它显示了鲜为人知和较新的工具以及已建立的工具，因此您可以发现一般搜索和列表文章错过的选项。
plugins.productIntroEn: Matchbox helps you find the right product or tool for a real problem. Describe what you're struggling with in plain language — "I keep forgetting to take my medication," "I need to track expenses across three currencies" — and Matchbox returns specific products matched to your situation, ranked by how well they fit rather than how popular they are.

plugins.name: TaskNotify
plugins.productIntro: 大多数重复任务每次运行时都会通知您，即使没有发生任何变化。 TaskNotify 为 ChatGPT 提供了一条与您的私人 Telegram 聊天的直接线路，因此只有当结果、警报或更新确实值得您关注时它才能联系到您。
plugins.productIntroEn: Most recurring tasks notify you every time they run—even when nothing changed. TaskNotify gives ChatGPT a direct line to your private Telegram chat, so it can reach you only when a result, alert, or update is actually worth your attention.

plugins.name: Qu Review
plugins.productIntro: 在对话中就任何 ChatGPT 回复获得独立的第二意见。 Qu Review 使用独立 AI 审核员小组从多个角度批判性地检查 ChatGPT 告诉您的内容，然后将他们的发现合并成一份清晰、可操作的报告。
plugins.productIntroEn: Get an independent second opinion on any ChatGPT response, right in the conversation. Qu Review uses a panel of independent AI reviewers to critically examine what ChatGPT told you from multiple angles, then combines their findings into one clear, actionable report.

plugins.name: CloudConvert
plugins.productIntro: 使用 CloudConvert 将强大的文件转换和处理功能引入 ChatGPT。处理文档、图像、音频、视频、电子书、档案等，无需在单独的工具之间切换。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring powerful file conversion and processing into ChatGPT with CloudConvert. Work with documents, images, audio, video, ebooks, archives, and more—without switching between separate tools.

plugins.name: Sally AI
plugins.description: 在会议中查找任何内容
plugins.productIntro: 莎莉记录、抄写和总结会议。该应用程序可让 ChatGPT 搜索这些会议、阅读摘要和文字记录、管理会议产生的任务，并将 Sally 助理发送到即将举行的在线会议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sally records, transcribes and summarizes meetings. This app lets ChatGPT search those meetings, read summaries and transcripts, manage the tasks that came out of them, and send the Sally assistant into an upcoming online meeting.

plugins.name: Product Listing Validator
plugins.productIntro: 产品列表验证程序会在审核或发布之前检查产品列表数据是否包含必填字段。它返回结构化的完整性结果，其中包含现有字段、缺失字段和验证错误，帮助卖家和产品团队快速发现不完整的列表信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Product Listing Validator checks whether product listing data includes the required fields before review or publishing. It returns a structured completeness result with present fields, missing fields, and validation errors, helping sellers and product teams quickly spot incomplete listing information.

plugins.name: Aide Calendar: AI Planner
plugins.description: 事件的屏幕截图和语音
plugins.productIntro: Aide Calendar 是一款适用于 iPhone 和 iPad 的日历和任务应用程序 - 现在位于 ChatGPT 中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Aide Calendar is a calendar & task app for iPhone and iPad — now in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Responsive
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到响应式，以便经过身份验证的用户可以搜索批准的公司内容、列出和创建内容库问答、查找标签、集合、业务部门、必填字段和公司用户、创建和检查分配的项目、生成初稿响应、运行应答代理、管理项目评论、创建接收以及更新响应式内的应答工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connects ChatGPT to Responsive so authenticated users can search approved company content, list and create Content Library Q&A, look up tags, collections, business units, required fields, and company users, create and inspect assigned projects, generate first-draft responses, run Answer Agent, manage project comments, create intakes, and update answer workflows inside Responsive.

plugins.name: Octopad
plugins.productIntro: Octopad 是构建者的人工智能大脑：人工智能按照共享方法组织工作和知识的工作空间。
plugins.productIntroEn: Octopad is the AI brain for builders: the workspace where AIs organize work and knowledge following a shared method.

plugins.name: Fyrebox
plugins.productIntro: Fyrebox 是一款面向创作者、营销人员和教育工作者的无代码交互式测验和表单生成器。 Fyrebox 应用程序允许用户直接从 ChatGPT 在自己的 Fyrebox 帐户中构建和管理测验。用户可以根据提示创建琐事、个性、评估和分支场景测验；编辑问题、答案、评分和分支逻辑；自定义颜色、字体、徽标、背景、潜在客户捕获表单和结果页面；生成AI背景图片；从模板开始；克隆或删除测验；并查看测验答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Fyrebox is a no-code interactive quiz and form builder for creators, marketers, and educators. The Fyrebox app lets users build and manage quizzes in their own Fyrebox account directly from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Simplified
plugins.productIntro: Simplified 将您的营销工作空间带入 ChatGPT。生成 AI 图像和视频、根据文本创建语音、在 13 个互联渠道上起草和发布社交帖子、管理品牌套件、项目和任务、规划内容日历和活动以及分析社交表现 - 所有这些都无需离开对话。
plugins.productIntroEn: Simplified brings your marketing workspace into ChatGPT. Generate AI images and video, create speech from text, draft and publish social posts across 13 connected channels, manage brand kits, projects and tasks, plan content calendars and campaigns, and analyze social performance — all without leaving the conversation.

plugins.name: mytesla.io
plugins.description: 用人工智能控制你的特斯拉
plugins.productIntro: 您的 Tesla 应用程序已发送命令。这是这个插件做不到的。 mytesla.io 将您的汽车插入人工智能已知的一切内容——您的日历、天气、日常生活——并决定何时采取行动。要求一个结果，而不是一个按钮：“在我最后一次会议结束时让机舱冷却”，“在早上 7 点之前充电到 100%，仅限非高峰时段”，“如果预计今晚会霜冻，请在我第一次会议之前除霜。”设置一次，它就会自行运行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your Tesla app already sends commands. This plugin is what it can't do. mytesla.io plugs your car into everything your AI already knows — your calendar, the weather, your routines — and decides when to act.

plugins.name: MotionHub
plugins.description: 通过 AI 管理 MotionHub
plugins.productIntro: 使用人工智能管理媒体制作项目。访问任务、脚本、日历、看板、带有文字记录和 AI 分析的媒体文件、联系人和团队日程安排。使用自然语言搜索片段，按主题、演讲者或内容查找剪辑 - 即使确切的关键字不匹配也是如此。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage media production projects with AI. Access tasks, scripts, calendars, boards, media files with transcripts and AI analysis, contacts, and team scheduling. Search footage using natural language to find clips by topic, speaker, or content — even when exact keywords don't match.

plugins.name: COR
plugins.productIntro: COR 通过查找客户、项目、任务、协作者、标签、附件和时间日志，以及创建或更新项目、任务、评论、附件、协作者、标签和记录时间，帮助用户从 ChatGPT 管理其 COR 工作区。
plugins.productIntroEn: COR helps users manage their COR workspace from ChatGPT by finding clients, projects, tasks, collaborators, labels, attachments, and time logs, and by creating or updating projects, tasks, comments, attachments, collaborators, labels, and logged time.

plugins.name: MusicBook Pro
plugins.productIntro: MusicBook Pro 是音乐家的私人生产力工作区。它在连接的 Mac 上搜索用户批准的歌曲创作库文本和音乐元数据，检查歌曲、草稿、创意、项目和曲目列表，并在不更改现有作品的情况下创建新的创意或曲目列表。
plugins.productIntroEn: MusicBook Pro is a private productivity workspace for musicians. It searches user-approved songwriting-library text and music metadata on a connected Mac, inspects Songs, Drafts, Ideas, Projects and Setlists, and creates new Ideas or Setlists without changing existing work.

plugins.name: Nudges
plugins.description: 通过电子邮件发送提醒
plugins.productIntro: 只需告诉 ChatGPT 要记住什么以及何时记住即可。 Nudges 会确认确切的时间，然后在到期时通过电子邮件发送给您。无需安装应用程序，没有电话号码，没有设置数量上限，也没有付费专区。
plugins.productIntroEn: Just tell ChatGPT what to remember and when. Nudges confirms the exact time, then emails you the moment it's due. No app to install, no phone number, no cap on how many you set, and no paywall.

plugins.name: Project Kickoff Pack
plugins.productIntro: 将提供的项目材料和确认的项目转化为结构化的启动包。提取项目目标、角色、职责、里程碑、风险和启动条件。提议的项目已明确分开并从当前可交付成果中排除。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn supplied project material and confirmed items into a structured kickoff pack. Extract project goals, roles, responsibilities, milestones, risks, and kickoff conditions. Proposed items are clearly separated and excluded from the current deliverable.

plugins.name: Ladder Pick
plugins.productIntro: Ladder Pick 使随机 1:1 匹配变得有趣且公平——就在 ChatGPT 中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ladder Pick makes random 1:1 matching fun and fair — right inside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: withPICA
plugins.productIntro: withPICA 在一个地方组织和管理您的整个音乐目录 - 您的作品、录音、制作人员、分割、权利和版税。
plugins.productIntroEn: withPICA organizes and manages your whole music catalogue in one place — your works, recordings, credits, splits, rights, and royalties.

plugins.name: Loops
plugins.description: 使用 ChatGPT 运行循环
plugins.productIntro: 无需离开 ChatGPT 即可使用循环。管理联系人和邮件列表、发送事务电子邮件、处理事件以及通过 Loops API 访问其他可用内容。只需告诉 ChatGPT 您想做什么即可。
plugins.productIntroEn: Work with Loops without leaving ChatGPT. Manage contacts and mailing lists, send transactional emails, work with events, and access everything else available through the Loops API. Just tell ChatGPT what you want to do.

plugins.name: Codex Tasks (Internal/CCA)
plugins.description: 内部 CCA 任务适配器
plugins.productIntro: 使用内部 CCA 远程任务适配器选择已注册的 Codex 环境、创建持久任务并检查其进度。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use the internal CCA remote-task adapter to select a registered Codex environment, create durable tasks, and inspect their progress.

plugins.name: ElevenLabs
plugins.productIntro: ElevenLabs 帮助用户创建和管理语音代理、审查对话、管理知识和工具以及生成语音、图像、视频和自定义语音。
plugins.productIntroEn: ElevenLabs helps users create and manage voice agents, review conversations, manage knowledge and tools, and generate speech, images, video and custom voices.

plugins.name: Wolfee
plugins.description: 您的会议在 ChatGPT 内进行。
plugins.productIntro: Wolfee 记录、转录和分析您的会议，然后将这些情报提供给您的人工智能助手。连接 Wolfee，询问有关任何会议的自然语言问题：提取完整的记录、显示行动项目和承诺、按含义（不仅仅是关键字）搜索整个会议历史记录、查看视频记录，以及查看 Wolfee 接下来将记录哪些即将举行的日历会议。所有访问都是只读的，并且仅限于您自己的数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Wolfee records, transcribes, and analyzes your meetings, then makes that intelligence available to your AI assistant. Connect Wolfee to ask natural-language questions about any meeting: pull a full transcript, surface action items and commitments, search your entire meeting history by meaning (not just keywords), review video recordings, and see which upcoming calendar meetings Wolfee wi…

plugins.name: GigHQ.ai
plugins.productIntro: GigHQ.ai 帮助用户查找公司和就业市场信号、检查赞助和申请详细信息、管理私人工作申请和注释、审查管道运行状况以及通过 ChatGPT 记录 GigHQ 内的职业成就。
plugins.productIntroEn: GigHQ.ai helps users look up company and job-market signals, inspect sponsorship and application details, manage private job applications and notes, review pipeline health, and document career achievements inside GigHQ from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Airepoto
plugins.productIntro: Airepoto 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的会议录音、文字记录和 AI 摘要。
plugins.productIntroEn: Airepoto connects ChatGPT to your meeting recordings, transcripts, and AI summaries.

plugins.name: Weave
plugins.productIntro: Weave Fabric 是人工智能的个人记忆层。将其连接到 ChatGPT，您的助手最终会了解您生活的细节：您的人、偏好、日常事务、购买、日历和历史记录。 您可以在 Fabric iOS 应用程序中建立您的记忆。捕捉快速笔记，填写有关您生活的各个部分（食物、工作、健康、旅行等）的简短调查问卷，或者连接 Gmail、Google Calendar、Apple Health、YouTube、Eventbrite、Receipts、Instagram、Link…
plugins.productIntroEn: Weave Fabric is a personal memory layer for AI. Connect it to ChatGPT and your assistant finally knows the specifics of your life: your people, preferences, routines, purchases, calendar, and history. You build your memory in the Fabric iOS app.

plugins.name: Ranked AI
plugins.description: 管理您的 SEO 和 PPC
plugins.productIntro: Ranked AI 提供行业领先的 AI SEO 和 PPC 软件，并集成了完全托管的服务。我们将人工智能与行业资深人士相结合，他们知道如何帮助您在传统搜索和人工智能搜索中对网站进行排名。使用我们的集成应用程序管理您的传统和人工智能搜索关键字、审核、反向链接、报告等。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ranked AI provides industry leading AI SEO & PPC software, with a fully managed service integrated into it. We combine AI with industry veterans that know how to help you rank your website on traditional & AI search. Manage your traditional & AI search keywords, audits, backlinks, reports and more with our integrated app.

plugins.name: Is It Down? Availability Check
plugins.productIntro: 需要知道网站是否已关闭？输入它的地址，我会为您检查。
plugins.productIntroEn: Need to know if a website is down? Type its address and I’ll check it for you.

plugins.name: Vasara
plugins.productIntro: Vasara 将 ChatGPT 与立陶宛的主要法律来源连接起来：国家立法、欧盟法规和指令以及宪法法院、最高法院、最高行政法院、欧盟法院和欧洲人权法院的判例法。
plugins.productIntroEn: Vasara connects ChatGPT to Lithuania's primary legal sources: national legislation, EU regulations and directives, and case law from the Constitutional Court, Supreme Court, Supreme Administrative Court, the Court of Justice of the EU, and the European Court of Human Rights.

plugins.name: Operator Powers
plugins.description: 操作和成长的人工智能技能
plugins.originalDescription: AI skills to operate and grow
plugins.productIntro: Operator Powers 是一组实用的人工智能技能，适合那些想要在工作中增强能力的非技术操作员。 使用这些技能来改进工作方式、了解客户真正想要什么、创建内容和设计、对决策进行压力测试、加强报价和销售页面以及推出数字产品。每项技能都处理特定的任务并完成可交付成果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Operator Powers is a collection of practical AI skills for non-technical operators wanting to power up in their work. Use these skills to improve how work gets done, understand what customers really want, create content and designs, pressure test decisions, strengthen offers and sales pages, and launch digital products. Every skill handles a specific task and finished deliverable.

plugins.name: 99Tables
plugins.description: 格式化网格中的数据和记录
plugins.productIntro: 一种在 ChatGPT 中使用表的快速简单方法。
plugins.productIntroEn: A quick easy way to work with tables in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Symbol
plugins.productIntro: Symbol 帮助用户保存笔记、决策、文档、片段和其他胶囊内容，然后通过 ChatGPT 搜索、编辑、参考、组织和共享这些知识。
plugins.productIntroEn: Symbol helps users save notes, decisions, docs, snippets, and other capsule content, then search, edit, reference, organize, and share that knowledge through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Reportei
plugins.productIntro: Reportei 是专为代理机构设计的营销报告和仪表板平台 和营销团队。它提供了一个统一的数据层，您的所有客户端 性能数据被存储、结构化并且可访问。
plugins.productIntroEn: Reportei is a marketing reporting and dashboard platform designed for agencies and marketing teams. It provides a unified data layer where all your client performance data is stored, structured, and accessible.
plugins.developerName: REPORTEI DADOS, TECNOLOGIA E SOLUÇÕES PARA INTERNET LTDA

plugins.name: Shchebitka AI Planner
plugins.description: 人工智能驱动的个人规划师
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的个人规划器。添加任务、注释、事件和联系人 - 或询问您的日程安排 - 全部通过自然对话进行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your personal planner. Add tasks, notes, events, and contacts — or ask what's on your schedule — all through natural conversation.

plugins.name: Heptabase
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Heptabase 知识库。搜索和阅读卡片、期刊、PDF、标签、数据库和白板；在交互式阅读器中查看所选卡片；创建和编辑笔记；更新属性；并将现有对象放置在白板上。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your Heptabase knowledge base. Search and read cards, journals, PDFs, tags, databases, and whiteboards; view selected cards in an interactive reader; create and edit notes; update properties; and place existing objects on whiteboards.

plugins.name: LIAM
plugins.productIntro: LIAM 是个人记忆助手。它可以保存并回忆您想要在对话中保留的事实、偏好和注释；存储和搜索您的联系人；保留多步骤食谱和例程；并记录您的膳食和收据以及每日营养和支出摘要。您可以输入请求或仅上传照片（收据、餐食、名片或便条），LIAM 会读取它并自动将其归档在正确的位置（餐厅收据会同时记录为费用和餐食）。仅存储提取的文本/值，而不存储原始图像。 示例用例 “记住，我更喜欢飞机上靠窗的座位——把它标记为‘旅行’。
plugins.productIntroEn: LIAM is a personal memory assistant. It saves and recalls the facts, preferences, and notes you want to keep across conversations; stores and searches your contacts; keeps multi-step recipes and routines; and logs your meals and receipts with daily nutrition and spending summaries.

plugins.name: Customer Info Validator
plugins.productIntro: 检查客户或销售线索记录是否包含所有必需的信息。该应用程序可识别现有字段和缺失字段，支持自定义字段要求，并正确处理 0 和 false 等有效值。它是只读的，不会对客户进行评分、预测销售结果、更新 CRM 记录或执行外部操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Check whether customer or sales lead records contain all required information. The app identifies present and missing fields, supports custom field requirements, and treats valid values such as 0 and false correctly. It is read-only and does not score customers, predict sales outcomes, update CRM records, or perform external actions.

plugins.name: Diverge
plugins.productIntro: 你的简历永远不会再过时。 Diverge 将您的 AI 助手连接到您的职业档案，因此您可以更新它，根据任何工作进行定制，并只需通过聊天即可下载精美的 PDF。为不同的角色保留多个角色，并查看共享简历的表现如何。没有表格，没有复制粘贴。只要告诉你的助理就可以了。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your resume should never be out of date again. Diverge connects your AI assistant to your professional profile, so you update it, tailor it to any job, and download a polished PDF just by chatting. Keep multiple personas for different roles, and see how your shared resume performs. No forms, no copy-paste. Just tell your assistant, and it's done.

plugins.name: FlowSavvy
plugins.productIntro: FlowSavvy 自动将您的任务变成现实的时间表。使用 ChatGPT 创建、更新、完成和组织任务、管理日历事件、查看日程安排、确定工作优先级以及使用自然语言计划您的一天。 FlowSavvy 会根据您现有的承诺自动安排任务，在计划发生变化时进行调整，并帮助您在截止日期前完成任务，而无需手动重新安排日历。
plugins.productIntroEn: FlowSavvy turns your tasks into a realistic schedule automatically. Use ChatGPT to create, update, complete, and organize tasks, manage calendar events, view your schedule, prioritize work, and plan your day using natural language.

plugins.name: Hoaster
plugins.description: 将网页内容发布到 URL
plugins.originalDescription: Publish web content to a URL
plugins.productIntro: 立即将您在 ChatGPT 中制作的内容转变为真实的实时网页。登陆页面、单页浏览器、信息图表、图表、图像：Hoaster 为其提供真正属于您的公共链接，即使在您自己的域中也是如此。只需说“发布”，它就会在线。无需设置，无需代码，无需字符串。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn what you make in ChatGPT into a real, live web page, instantly. A landing page, a one-pager, an infographic, a chart, an image: Hoaster gives it a public link that's truly yours, even on your own domain. Just say "publish it," and it's online. No setup, no code, no strings.

plugins.name: Rosetta
plugins.productIntro: Rosetta 帮助用户搜索、创建和组织私人笔记、提醒和保存的链接，包括其类别、标签和生命周期状态。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rosetta helps users search, create, and organize private notes, reminders, and saved links, including their categories, tags, and lifecycle status.

plugins.name: Tenet Careers
plugins.description: 搜索特尼特医疗保健职位
plugins.productIntro: 按角色、关键字或地点搜索 Tenet Healthcare 医院和设施网络中的当前职位。查看 ChatGPT 中的匹配机会，然后打开职位发布以继续申请。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search current jobs across Tenet Healthcare’s network of hospitals and facilities by role, keyword, or location. Review matching opportunities in ChatGPT, then open the job posting to continue the application.

plugins.name: Tolstoy Library
plugins.productIntro: Tolstoy Library 将您的视频和图像内容带入 ChatGPT。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tolstoy Library brings your video and image content into ChatGPT.

plugins.name: MyAreaReport
plugins.productIntro: MyAreaReport 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 内探索英国邮政编码、输出代码和基于地点的区域情报。它检索有关犯罪、洪水警报、房地产价格、道路交通和附近燃油价格的官方公共数据，然后在丰富的仪表板中显示结果，并提供更深入的深入视图。
plugins.productIntroEn: MyAreaReport helps users explore UK postcode, outcode, and place-based area intelligence inside ChatGPT. It retrieves official public data for crime, flood warnings, property prices, road traffic, and nearby fuel prices, then presents the results in a rich dashboard with deeper drill-down views.

plugins.name: 1to1 Mate
plugins.description: 每 1:1 的 AI 背景
plugins.productIntro: 1to1 Mate 是一款围绕一对一会议构建的关系管理应用程序。
plugins.productIntroEn: 1to1 Mate is a relationship management app built around 1:1 meetings.

plugins.name: Octopus.do
plugins.productIntro: Octopus.do 构建站点地图：页面树，每个页面一堆块，每个块一个线框。这会将其连接到 ChatGPT 应用程序。阅读现有项目（其页面、块和结构）或将描述或草图转换为完整的站点地图：创建页面、添加线框块、移动和重组树，所有这些都在一批中完成。通过您自己的 octopus.do 帐户通过 OAuth 运行；助手只能看到您已经有权访问的项目。
plugins.productIntroEn: Octopus.do builds sitemaps: a tree of pages, each page a stack of blocks, each block a wireframe. This connects that to ChatGPT app. Read an existing project — its pages, blocks, and structure — or turn a description or a sketch into a full sitemap: create pages, add blocks with wireframes, move and restructure the tree, all in one batch. Runs through your own octopus.

plugins.name: StorageChain
plugins.productIntro: 搜索并读取您的组织已连接到 StorageChain BYOC 的文件。在支持的云存储库中查找允许的文档，阅读支持的内容以及 StorageChain 中的开源引用。现有组织、连接和文件夹权限将应用于每个请求。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search and read files your organization has connected to StorageChain BYOC. Find permitted documents across supported cloud repositories, read supported content, and open source citations in StorageChain. Existing organization, connection, and folder permissions are applied to each request.

plugins.name: Floaro
plugins.description: ChatGPT 中您的 eBay 业务
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 Floaro 帐户以直接在 ChatGPT 中访问市场信息。查看连接的市场帐户、产品总数、销售业绩、选定时间段内销售的产品以及没有模板的列表。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Floaro account to access marketplace information directly in ChatGPT. View connected marketplace accounts, product totals, sales performance, products sold during selected periods, and listings without templates.

plugins.name: Speechdub
plugins.productIntro: Speechdub 可帮助您将文本导入文档库、浏览和编辑保存的文档，以及使用预设声音生成自然语音。使用 app.speechdub.com/settings/api 中的 Speechdub API 密钥进行连接。创建文档会使用您的文档配额；语音合成使用与网络应用程序相同的信用钱包。
plugins.productIntroEn: Speechdub helps you import text into your document library, browse and edit saved documents, and generate natural speech with preset voices. Connect with a Speechdub API key from app.speechdub.com/settings/api. Creating documents uses your document quota; speech synthesis uses the same credit wallet as the web app.

plugins.name: Stable Baseline
plugins.productIntro: Stable Baseline 是一个端到端、由代理管理的工作区，用于文档、图表、白板、规划和共享知识图（您团队的大脑）。在 ChatGPT 中，您可以使用 Markdown 创作和编辑实时文档，其中包含 40 多种嵌入式图表（流程图、BPMN、序列、思维导图、甘特图等）；生成像素完美的图表和白板，并将它们以 PNG、JPEG 或 SVG 格式返回；从单个提示设计整个白板；用简单的语言即时生成信息图表；规划工作的阶段、任务、依赖关系和时间表；记录风险和改进…
plugins.productIntroEn: Stable Baseline is an end-to-end, agent-managed workspace for documentation, diagramming, whiteboarding, planning, and a shared knowledge graph (your team's brain). From ChatGPT you can author and edit living documents in Markdown with 40+ types of embedded diagrams (flowcharts, BPMN, sequence, mind maps, Gantt, and more); generate pixel-perfect diagrams and whiteboards and get them back…

plugins.name: RFP Response Checker
plugins.description: 检查 RFP 响应覆盖范围
plugins.productIntro: RFP 响应检查器是一项只读服务，可从用户提供的 RFP 文本中提取明确规定的要求，并检查提供的响应是否满足每个要求。它返回与证据相关的结果，显示已解决、部分解决和未解决的项目，而不会发明未声明的要求。
plugins.productIntroEn: RFP Response Checker is a read-only service that extracts explicitly stated requirements from user-provided RFP text and checks whether a supplied response addresses each requirement. It returns evidence-linked results showing addressed, partially addressed, and not addressed items without inventing unstated requirements.

plugins.name: dochost.io
plugins.productIntro: dochost 允许用户从 ChatGPT 发布 Markdown 或 HTML 作为托管页面、获取干净的可共享链接、检查其帐户限制、列出和审查已发布的页面、更新页面内容以及删除不再需要在线的页面。
plugins.productIntroEn: dochost lets users publish Markdown or HTML from ChatGPT as hosted pages, get clean shareable links, inspect their account limits, list and review published pages, update page content, and delete pages they no longer want online.

plugins.name: Anchor
plugins.productIntro: Anchor 为 ChatGPT 提供了一个共享驱动器，可以在其中创建文件并将其组织到文件夹中。 ChatGPT 可以读写 HTML、Markdown (MD)、JSON、CSV 和其他文本格式的文件，设计类型表并使用 SQL 查询它们。它可以移动文件、制作副本并使一切井井有条。它创建的每个文件、表和文件夹都可以与您的团队共享，而 Anchor 则负责处理存储、权限和版本控制。登录一次，无需 API 密钥，无需设置，ChatGPT 只会触及您可以访问的内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Anchor gives ChatGPT a shared drive where it can create files and organize them in folders. ChatGPT can read and write files in HTML, Markdown (MD), JSON, CSV, and other text formats, design typed tables, and query them with SQL. It can move files around, make copies, and keep everything organized.

plugins.name: Priority Guardian
plugins.productIntro: 优先守护者——您的优先事项值得的不仅仅是良好的意愿。
plugins.productIntroEn: Priority Guardian — Your priorities deserve more than good intentions.

plugins.name: Juridata
plugins.description: 搜索摩洛哥法律和裁决
plugins.productIntro: Juridata 将摩洛哥法律研究直接引入 ChatGPT。搜索数千份法院判决（判例）和法律文本，然后在几秒钟内打开完整文档 - 不再需要挖掘分散的数据库。
plugins.productIntroEn: Juridata brings Moroccan legal research directly into ChatGPT. Search thousands of court decisions (jurisprudence) and legal texts, then open the full document in seconds — no more digging through scattered databases.

plugins.name: HaitiDocs
plugins.productIntro: HaitiDocs 从精心策划的公共图书馆查找并返回来自海地的经济材料：跨指标、文档、世界银行项目、地图图层和新闻进行搜索；打开完整的文档或数据系列及其来源归属和引用；将引用的段落落实并起草简报和分析笔记；并检索地图层 GeoJSON 以进行显示或空间分析。每个结果都带有源发布者、新鲜度和引用，因此该应用程序充当查找者和转发者，而不是基础数据的作者。
plugins.productIntroEn: HaitiDocs finds and returns sourced Haiti economic material from a curated public library: search across indicators, documents, World Bank projects, map layers, and news; open a full document or data series with its source attribution and citation; pull cited passages to ground and draft briefings and analytical notes; and retrieve map-layer GeoJSON for display or spatial analysis.

plugins.name: Twistly AI Presentation Maker
plugins.productIntro: Twistly 将您的想法、笔记和文档转变为可立即编辑的 PowerPoint 演示文稿。描述主题、粘贴文本或共享文件（TXT、PPTX、PDF、DOCX、XLS 或 HTML），Twistly 会在几秒钟内构建包含多达 50 张幻灯片的结构化幻灯片，这些幻灯片具有清晰的布局和匹配的视觉效果。从 50 多个模板中进行选择，以保持一致的品牌外观。 一切都以原生、完全可编辑的 .
plugins.productIntroEn: Twistly turns your ideas, notes, and documents into ready-to-edit PowerPoint presentations. Describe a topic, paste in text, or share a file (TXT, PPTX, PDF, DOCX, XLS, or HTML), and Twistly builds a structured deck of up to 50 slides with clear layouts and matching visuals in seconds. Pick from 50+ templates to keep a consistent, on-brand look.

plugins.name: DailyHero
plugins.productIntro: DailyHero 帮助家长使用 ChatGPT 了解家庭任务进度、积分、奖励和近期活动，然后为孩子创建家长管理的任务和奖励。它可以读取 DailyHero 家庭数据，并在家长授予创建访问权限时创建任务或奖励。它无法批准任务完成、兑换奖励、直接更改积分、管理儿童个人资料或执行帐户和隐私操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: DailyHero helps parents use ChatGPT to understand family task progress, points, rewards, and recent activity, then create parent-managed tasks and rewards for their children. It can read DailyHero family data and create tasks or rewards when the parent grants create access.

plugins.name: Form Field Extractor
plugins.productIntro: 表单字段提取器从用户提供的表单文本中提取字段名称和值，并返回结构化字段结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Form Field Extractor extracts field names and values from user-provided form text and returns a structured field result.

plugins.name: CodeQR - Link and QR Analytics
plugins.description: 可编辑、可追踪的二维码
plugins.productIntro: CodeQR 创建短链接和 QR 码，在打印或共享后仍可编辑。每个代码都编码一个短链接而不是目的地本身，因此您可以更改它的通向位置而无需重新打印任何内容，并且每次扫描和点击都会记录时间、国家/地区和设备。它适合这样的工作：代码必须在创建之日起就一直存在：每个房产列表、每个客户、每个证书、每个职位发布或登录页面移动的印刷活动都有一个代码。
plugins.productIntroEn: CodeQR creates short links and QR codes that stay editable after they are printed or shared. Each code encodes a short link instead of the destination itself, so you can change where it leads without reprinting anything, and every scan and click is recorded with time, country, and device.

plugins.name: HG Insights - RGI
plugins.productIntro: HG Insights - 收入增长情报使销售团队能够即时访问全面的潜在客户数据。 获取任何公司的技术堆栈、公司结构、决策者联系人、IT 支出见解和合同情报。 只需按名称或域名询问公司，即可发现由 HG Insights 数据支持的可操作销售情报。 需要 HG Insights 的 RGI 开发人员或 RGI 代理帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: HG Insights - Revenue Growth Intelligence gives sales teams instant access to comprehensive prospect data. Get technology stacks, company firmographics, decision-maker contacts, IT spending insights, and contract intelligence for any company. Simply ask about a company by name or domain to uncover actionable sales intelligence powered by HG Insights data.

plugins.name: Plane
plugins.description: 使用 Plane 推进工作
plugins.productIntro: Plane 将用户的 Plane 工作区带入 ChatGPT。用户可以浏览项目和工作项、创建和更新任务和史诗、使用 Plane 查询语言过滤和计数工作、计划周期、模块和里程碑、对接收队列进行分类、管理版本及其变更日志、维护页面和集合、跟踪客户及其请求、记录时间以及调整标签、状态、估计和自定义属性 - 所有这些都通过针对自己工作区的经过身份验证的 Plane API 进行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Plane brings the user's Plane workspace into ChatGPT. Users can browse projects and work items, create and update tasks and epics, filter and count work with Plane Query Language, plan cycles, modules, and milestones, triage the intake queue, manage releases and their changelogs, maintain pages and collections, track customers and their requests, log time, and adjust labels, states, esti…

plugins.name: PDF Translator
plugins.productIntro: 1. 独家并排视图 即时验证：与原生 ChatGPT 不同，我们的分屏模式可让您逐段比较原始文本和翻译文本，以进行即时准确性检查。 2. 保留原始布局 格式保留：保持表格、图表和文本布局完美的结构，以便您可以轻松阅读 - 不再出现格式损坏的情况。 3. 全球语言支持 50 多种语言：以专业的精度轻松将英语翻译成西班牙语、法语翻译成德语等。 4. 下载并立即使用 干净的 PDF 输出：立即获取可下载、保留布局的 PDF。
plugins.productIntroEn: 1. Exclusive Side-by-Side View Instant Verification: Unlike native ChatGPT, our split-screen mode lets you compare original and translated text paragraph by paragraph for instant accuracy checks. 2. Preserve Original Layout Format Retention: Keeps tables, charts, and text layout perfectly structured so you can read with ease—no more broken formatting. 3.

plugins.name: Cleared Colorado Jobs
plugins.description: 查找科罗拉多州已批准的工作
plugins.productIntro: 已批准的科罗拉多工作可帮助用户在指定的科罗拉多工作场所找到需要秘密、绝密或 TS/SCI 许可的当前直接雇主职位空缺。用户可以浏览有界的工作场所、雇主、许可、测谎仪和新鲜度过滤器；检查当前工作；发现可用的过滤器；或检索可引用的公共工作来源。该插件是匿名且只读的，它从不应用、保存、发布或更改数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Cleared Colorado Jobs helps users find current direct-employer openings at named Colorado workplaces that require a Secret, Top Secret, or TS/SCI clearance. Users can browse with bounded workplace, employer, clearance, polygraph, and freshness filters; inspect a current job; discover available filters; or retrieve citeable public job sources.

plugins.name: OnceHub
plugins.productIntro: OnceHub 允许经过身份验证的用户通过 ChatGPT 管理自己的会议、预订日历和中心、预订链接以及定期或特定日期的可用性。
plugins.productIntroEn: OnceHub lets authenticated users manage their own meetings, booking calendars and hubs, booking links, and recurring or date-specific availability through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: AI Attorney Pakistan
plugins.productIntro: AI律师通过只读法律语料库帮助用户研究巴基斯坦法律。 它可以找到巴基斯坦的判决和先例，检索案件的完整细节 通过 ID 或法律报告引用已知案例，并从中查找相关条款 巴基斯坦的法案、条例、法典、规则、条例和宪法。
plugins.productIntroEn: AI Attorney helps users research Pakistani law through a read-only legal corpus. It can find Pakistani judgments and precedents, retrieve the full details of a known case by ID or law-report citation, and locate relevant provisions from Pakistani Acts, Ordinances, codes, rules, regulations, and the Constitution.

plugins.name: Linko
plugins.description: 使用您的 Linko 知识
plugins.productIntro: Linko 允许用户从 ChatGPT 访问和更新其 Linko 知识工作区。 OAuth 帐户链接后，用户可以获取笔记、创建或编辑笔记、列出主题、查找资源以及将链接或书籍添加到其私人 Linko 图书馆。
plugins.productIntroEn: Linko lets users access and update their Linko knowledge workspace from ChatGPT. Users can fetch notes, create or edit notes, list subjects, find resources, and add links or books to their private Linko library after OAuth account linking.

plugins.name: Markdown by mdedit.ai
plugins.productIntro: 直接从对话中创建私人 Markdown 文档并将其保存在 mdedit.ai 中。在工作区中查找并修改已保存的文档，然后根据需要发布或取消发布可共享链接。发布始终需要您的明确确认。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create and save private Markdown documents in mdedit.ai directly from your conversation. Find and revise saved documents across your workspaces, then publish or unpublish a shareable link when you choose. Publishing always requires your explicit confirmation.

plugins.name: Tela
plugins.description: 带有语义搜索的团队 wiki
plugins.productIntro: tela 是一个 Markdown 原生团队 wiki，其中 AI 代理是一流的参与者。将 ChatGPT 连接到您团队的知识库，以大规模阅读、编写和维护文档。 • 语义搜索（“研究”）— 按含义回答问题，从整页正文中返回已标记的来源分歧的组装基础 • 关键字搜索 — 排名、片段突出显示的全文查找 • 创作 — 创建、更新和外科手术式修补页面；移动、删除、通过公共链接共享 • 知识健康 — 显示近乎重复的页面、识别未解答的问题、建议链接 • Atlas —…
plugins.productIntroEn: tela is a markdown-native team wiki where AI agents are first-class participants. Connect ChatGPT to your team's knowledge base to read, write, and maintain docs at scale. • Semantic search ("research") — answer questions by meaning, returning assembled grounding from full page bodies with flagged source disagreements • Keyword search — ranked, snippet-highlighted full-text lookup • Auth…

plugins.name: Userflow
plugins.productIntro: 将您的 Userflow 帐户连接到官方 Userflow MCP 以查询产品采用数据并直接在 ChatGPT 中构建。询问流程、细分、用户和分析（完成率、NPS、调查响应和事件数据），以了解用户如何浏览您的产品并找到他们陷入困境的地方，然后让 ChatGPT 创建答案指向的细分、流程、图表或仪表板。每次写入都会作为草稿返回给您审阅；没有您，任何内容都无法发布，无需离开 ChatGPT。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Userflow account to the official Userflow MCP to query product adoption data and build directly in ChatGPT. Ask about flows, segments, users, and analytics (completion rates, NPS, survey responses, and event data) to see how users move through your product and find where they get stuck—then have ChatGPT create the segment, flow, chart, or dashboard the answer points to.

plugins.name: KinicMemory
plugins.description: 所有保存的信息都集中在一处
plugins.originalDescription: All saved info in one place
plugins.productIntro: Kinic 是一种人工智能存储器，用于在一个地方查看信息。 它将书签、电子邮件、笔记等整合到一个统一的、有组织的视图中。 您还可以探索其他人分享的有用的精选内容。 目前为只读，它使信息易于浏览和访问。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kinic is an AI memory for viewing information in one place. It brings together bookmarks, emails, notes, and more into a single, organized view. You can also explore useful, curated content shared by others. Currently read-only, it makes information easy to browse and access.

plugins.name: Walla
plugins.productIntro: 从 ChatGPT 构建和管理 Walla 表单：创建表单、添加和编辑问题（包括条件跳转逻辑、外观和页面部分）、将其发布给受访者，并在自动屏蔽 PII 的情况下读取提交的回复。用户还可以连接 Webhook 自动化，将响应传递到自己的端点，企业团队可以根据自然语言描述构建可重用的自定义字段类型。六个内置参考文档描述了表单模型和编辑负载，以便助手可以在第一次尝试时进行正确的编辑。
plugins.productIntroEn: Build and manage Walla forms from ChatGPT: create a form, add and edit questions (including conditional jump logic, appearance, and page sections), publish it for respondents, and read submitted responses with PII automatically masked.

plugins.name: PDF4me
plugins.productIntro: PDF4me 为您的所有 PDF 提供智能且高效的解决方案。 使用 PDF4me 提高您的工作效率：访问关键数据、进行编辑以及直接将文件转换为 PDF - 一切都在 ChatGPT 中进行。从单文档转换到大型数据文件，PDF4me 都在。
plugins.productIntroEn: PDF4me delivers an intelligent and efficient solution for all your PDFs. Boost your productivity with PDF4me: access crucial data, make edits, and convert files to PDFs directly —all in ChatGPT. From single-document conversion to mega data files, PDF4me is there.

plugins.name: Adszy
plugins.description: 只读 PPC 帐户见解
plugins.productIntro: Adszy 提供通过 Adszy 连接的帐户的只读 PPC 分析，包括帐户运行状况、预算节奏、浪费的支出、不批准、异常、拍卖见解和期间比较。它与 Google Ads 帐户配合使用，无法创建或更改广告系列。 Adszy 是独立开发的，不受 Google 认可或运营。
plugins.productIntroEn: Adszy provides read-only PPC analysis of accounts connected through Adszy, including account health, budget pacing, wasted spend, disapprovals, anomalies, auction insights, and period comparisons. It works with Google Ads accounts and cannot create or change campaigns. Adszy is independently developed and is not endorsed or operated by Google.

plugins.name: Edito-Pdf
plugins.productIntro: Edito-Pdf 允许您搜索、阅读和分析已被 Omissis 系统假名或匿名化的文档。使用 ChatGPT，您可以在个人驱动器和共享驱动器中查找文件、提取其文本并生成专业报告或摘要。当需要发送恢复真实数据的文档时，Omissis 会自动执行去假名化操作，并将结果发送到您的电子邮件中，而不会在对话中暴露敏感信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Edito-Pdf lets you search, read, and analyze documents that have been pseudonymized or anonymized by the Omissis system. Using ChatGPT, you can locate files across your personal drive and shared drives, extract their text, and generate professional reports or summaries.

plugins.name: Trackunit IrisX
plugins.description: 将车队数据转化为行动
plugins.productIntro: 查询您的 Trackunit 车队、识别故障和闲置资产、创建警报和访问密钥、更新资产数据并自动生成定期报告。需要有效的 Trackunit IrisX 订阅。
plugins.productIntroEn: Query your Trackunit fleet, identify faults and idle assets, create alerts and access keys, update asset data, and automate recurring reports. Requires an active Trackunit IrisX subscription.

plugins.name: Userbrain
plugins.description: 访问您的用户测试数据
plugins.productIntro: 探索您的用户测试数据、总结反馈并更快地发现可操作的见解。用通俗易懂的语言询问有关测试、参与者、任务和结果的问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Explore your user test data, summarize feedback, and uncover actionable insights faster. Ask questions about tests, participants, tasks, and findings in plain language.

plugins.name: Atlas AI Agent
plugins.productIntro: Atlas AI Agent 将您的 Atlas 工作区带入 ChatGPT，将三名助手集中在一处。
plugins.productIntroEn: Atlas AI Agent brings your Atlas workspace into ChatGPT, with three assistants in one place.

plugins.name: Timezone Buddy
plugins.productIntro: Timezone Buddy 帮助人们跨时区工作。它可以查找 IANA 时区的当前时间、跨多个时区转换特定日期和时间并自动处理夏令时，并为分布式团队查找重叠的会议窗口。
plugins.productIntroEn: Timezone Buddy helps people work across time zones. It can look up the current time for an IANA time zone, convert a specific date and time across multiple time zones with daylight saving time handled automatically, and find overlapping meeting windows for distributed teams.

plugins.name: CarVault
plugins.productIntro: CarVault 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 CarVault 帐户，以列出车辆、查看燃油和拥有成本、检查即将到来的提醒以及添加燃油、费用、服务记录或里程表读数。每当您询问您的汽车、车辆历史记录、维护或所有权记录时，请使用 CarVault。
plugins.productIntroEn: CarVault connects ChatGPT to your CarVault account to list vehicles, review fuel and ownership costs, check upcoming reminders, and add fuel, expenses, service records, or odometer readings. Use CarVault whenever you ask about your cars, vehicle history, maintenance, or ownership records.

plugins.name: Chat2Doc
plugins.description: 将聊天另存为可编辑文档
