plugins.productIntro: 不要让临时谈话消失。 Chat2Doc 可帮助您保存、查看和聊天您的历史记录。将您的聊天变成可编辑文档的永久知识库。 1. 保存重要的东西 - 保存 ChatGPT 历史记录：将聊天保存为可编辑文档以捕获和完善见解。 2.查看保存的历史记录 - 即时访问：点击“查看历史记录”按钮，可直接在聊天窗口中浏览您保存的聊天记录。 3. 与你的历史聊天 - 使用您的知识库：要求 ChatGPT 根据您的收藏生成新内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Don't let your temporary conversations disappear. Chat2Doc helps you save, view, and chat with your history. Turn your chats into a permanent Knowledge Base of editable documents. 1. Save What Matters - Save ChatGPT History: Save chats as editable documents to capture and refine insights. 2.

plugins.name: memorystore.in
plugins.productIntro: MemoryStore 是一个人工智能驱动的库，可将您的短视频库转变为完全可搜索的第二大脑。直接在 ChatGPT 中，您可以找到这些视频、记住一些内容，并立即从您的个人库中检索准确的文字摘录或有针对性的摘要。通过弥合“稍后保存”和“今天查找”之间的差距，该集成可确保您积累的每一条内容都被主动索引、语义可搜索并可立即访问，以支持您的日常工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: MemoryStore is an AI-powered vault that transforms your short video library into a fully searchable second brain. Directly within ChatGPT, you can find those videos, remember something, and instantly retrieve exact transcript excerpts or targeted summaries from your personal library.

plugins.name: Smart Planner AI
plugins.productIntro: 计划您的一周，将目标转化为可管理的步骤，并与家人、朋友或团队协调工作。 Smart Planner AI 为 ChatGPT 提供您的任务、计划偏好、进度和符合条件的同步日历上下文。在此起草计划，进行审查，并在批准后保存。在共享空间中，创建空间、管理成员、分配重复任务和子任务、检查隐私安全成员的可用性，并跟踪每个成员的工作量和记录的贡献。共享变更可以通知成员；日历和提醒操作可能会影响连接的服务。
plugins.productIntroEn: Plan your week, turn a goal into manageable steps, and coordinate work with family, friends, or a team. Smart Planner AI gives ChatGPT your tasks, planning preferences, progress, and eligible synced calendar context. Draft plans here, review them, and save only after approval.

plugins.name: TextExpander
plugins.productIntro: TextExpander 帮助用户从其 TextExpander 帐户中搜索、读取、创建、更新、移动和删除片段和片段组，并在获得授权后检查个人资料、组织成员和使用统计数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: TextExpander helps users search, read, create, update, move, and delete snippets and snippet groups from their TextExpander account, plus inspect profile, organization member, and usage statistics data when authorized.

plugins.name: Onplana
plugins.productIntro: Onplana 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的项目组合。用一句话描述工作，它会一步为您构建项目：史诗、任务、估计、依赖关系和计划日期。使用混合 BM25 + 矢量搜索跨项目、任务、冲刺、风险、评论和 wiki 进行搜索。读取项目状态、更新任务、记录时间、表面投资组合级别的见解并生成状态报告，所有这些都由组织的计划和角色权限控制，并对每个操作进行审核。专为在 2026 年 9 月停用之前从 Microsoft Project Online 迁移的团队而构建。
plugins.productIntroEn: Onplana connects ChatGPT to your project portfolio. Describe the work in a sentence and it builds the project for you: epics, tasks, estimates, dependencies and scheduled dates, in a single step. Search across projects, tasks, sprints, risks, comments, and wiki with hybrid BM25 + vector search.

plugins.name: Docket
plugins.productIntro: Docket AI 让您的销售知识立即成为您的超能力。销售代表可以直接从统一的 Sales Knowledge Lake™ 中获取产品、竞争、技术和客户问题的准确、按需答案。在经过验证的公司情报的指导下，销售代表可以自信地处理异议，发现潜在客户的详细信息，并当场制定个性化的答复。
plugins.productIntroEn: Docket AI makes your sales knowledge your instant superpower. Sales reps get accurate, on-demand answers to product, competitive, technical, and customer questions—pulled directly from your unified Sales Knowledge Lake™. Guided by verified company intel, reps handle objections confidently, uncover prospect details, and craft personalised responses on the spot.

plugins.name: toflow.ai
plugins.productIntro: 连接到 toflow.ai 来探索、丰富和运行多渠道外展，这一切都通过 ChatGPT 进行。使用职位、资历、行业、公司规模和地点等过滤器搜索人员和公司。丰富联系人以查找经过验证的电子邮件、电话号码和 LinkedIn 个人资料。建立和管理列表，然后通过电子邮件、LinkedIn 和 WhatsApp 将联系人添加到外展序列中。无需离开聊天即可创建交易、记录通话、创建任务以及跟踪电子邮件打开情况。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect to toflow.ai to prospect, enrich, and run multi-channel outreach, all through ChatGPT. Search for people and companies using filters like title, seniority, industry, company size, and location. Enrich contacts to find verified emails, phone numbers, and LinkedIn profiles. Build and manage lists, then add contacts to outreach sequences via email, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp.

plugins.name: AI App Readiness Checker
plugins.description: 检查 AI 应用程序准备情况
plugins.productIntro: 正式提交前审核AI App身份、MCP工具合约、提交材料。根据固定的规则集获取结构化的准备情况调查结果和最终裁决。此只读插件不会访问外部系统、部署应用程序、提交评论或保证批准。
plugins.productIntroEn: Review AI App identity, MCP tool contracts, and submission materials before formal submission. Get structured readiness findings and a final verdict under a fixed ruleset. This read-only plugin does not access external systems, deploy apps, submit reviews, or guarantee approval.

plugins.name: SuperMCP
plugins.productIntro: SuperMCP 根据以色列在线超市的购物清单定价，并告诉您哪家商店将其运送到您的地址，价格最低。
plugins.productIntroEn: SuperMCP prices a shopping list against Israeli online supermarkets and tells you which store delivers it for the least, to your address.

plugins.name: AirPrompter
plugins.productIntro: AirPrompter 帮助用户查找、检查、创建、改进和运行已保存的 AirPrompter 提示以及从 ChatGPT 保存的 AirPrompter 工作流程。当用户明确提及 AirPrompter、空气提示器、AirPrompter 保存的提示或 AirPrompter 保存的工作流程时使用它。
plugins.productIntroEn: AirPrompter helps users find, inspect, create, improve, and run saved AirPrompter prompts and saved AirPrompter workflows from ChatGPT. Use it when the user explicitly mentions AirPrompter, air prompter, an AirPrompter saved prompt, or an AirPrompter saved workflow.

plugins.name: Temponia
plugins.productIntro: Temponia 是一款时间跟踪和时间表应用程序，适合自由职业者、代理机构和内部团队，他们希望记录自己的工作时间，但又不想让自己感觉是一件苦差事。
plugins.productIntroEn: Temponia is a time-tracking and timesheet app for freelancers, agencies, and in-house teams who want their hours logged without it feeling like a chore.

plugins.name: Contextick
plugins.description: 保存一次，在任何 AI 中调用
plugins.originalDescription: Save once, recall in any AI
plugins.productIntro: Contextick 是人工智能的个人知识层。保存任何文本一次 — 一个决定、一个想法、一个代码片段、研究笔记——以及您连接的人工智能 稍后可以在相关的时候通过意义将其带回来。
plugins.productIntroEn: Contextick is a personal knowledge layer for your AI. Save any text once — a decision, an idea, a code snippet, research notes — and the AIs you connect can bring it back later by meaning, right when it's relevant.

plugins.name: CrowdHum
plugins.productIntro: CrowdHum 允许演示者创建现场观众民意调查并从聊天中读取结果。在新房间中创建投票，向现有房间代码添加更多投票（一个二维码，多个投票），获取实时或最终投票结果，列出您的会议和投票，阅读人工智能会议回顾，并邀请共同所有者。可视化模式包括柱漂移、上升气泡、词云、2x2网格、排名和问答。现场主持人表演（展示、暂停、投票流）保留在 CrowdHum 网络应用程序中。
plugins.productIntroEn: CrowdHum lets presenters create live audience polls and read their results from chat. Create a poll in a new room, add more polls to an existing room code (one QR, many polls), fetch live or final vote tallies, list your sessions and polls, read an AI session recap, and invite a co-owner. Visualization modes include column drift, rising bubbles, word cloud, 2x2 grid, ranking, and Q&A.

plugins.name: Riido
plugins.productIntro: Riido 帮助用户检查工作区和团队，管理组件、待办事项和会议，并通过经过身份验证的 Riido 工作流程更新会议正文、链接、董事会条目、状态、标签、成员、优先级和评论。
plugins.productIntroEn: Riido helps users inspect workspaces and teams, manage components, backlogs, and meetings, and update meeting bodies, links, board entries, statuses, labels, members, priorities, and comments through authenticated Riido workflows.

plugins.name: GoLinks
plugins.productIntro: GoLinks 将长 URL 转换为安全、人类可读的 Go 链接，帮助团队更快地查找、访问和共享工作场所知识。
plugins.productIntroEn: GoLinks helps teams find, access, and share workplace knowledge faster by turning long URLs into secure, human-readable go links.

plugins.name: ToolMatch
plugins.productIntro: 描述从精选目录中查找相关 ChatGPT 应用程序的任务或问题。每个结果都解释了为什么它适合并强调了重要的局限性。 ToolMatch 链接到 ChatGPT 中的应用程序页面，无需登录，并且不销售产品或处理付款。
plugins.productIntroEn: Describe a task or problem to find relevant ChatGPT apps from a curated catalog. Each result explains why it fits and highlights important limitations. ToolMatch links to app pages in ChatGPT, requires no login, and does not sell products or process payments.

plugins.name: Docs AI
plugins.productIntro: 撰写清晰、引人入胜的描述，突出显示您的插件的功能以及人们为什么会喜欢它。关注具体的用户价值，避免夸大、误导性的主张。这将公开显示在您的插件的目录页面上。 将 ChatGPT 直接连接到您的文档，因此起草和修改文档与您的其余工作在同一位置进行：无需在聊天窗口和浏览器选项卡之间来回复制文本。
plugins.productIntroEn: Write a clear, engaging description that highlights what your plugin does and why people will love it. Focus on concrete user value and avoid exaggerative, misleading claims. This will appear publicly on your plugin’s directory page.

plugins.name: Bitmovin
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到涵盖所有产品的单个 Bitmovin MCP 服务器。分析可观测性数据、深入了解广告效果、使用 Player 流式传输视频、管理编码作业、运行 Stream Lab 测试等等 - 所有这些都使用自然语言。借助 MCP 应用程序，通过交互式图表可视化 QoE 和广告指标，并直接在聊天中流式传输 DASH 或 HLS 播放。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to a single Bitmovin MCP Server covering every product. Analyze Observability data, get insights on your ad performance, stream video with Player, manage Encoding jobs, run Stream Lab tests, and much more — all using natural language. With MCP Apps, visualize QoE and ad metrics through interactive charts and stream DASH or HLS playback directly in the chat.

plugins.name: fairw.ai
plugins.description: 您在 ChatGPT 中的会议
plugins.productIntro: Fairwai 是一个会议智能平台，可以转录和分析您的通话、视频会议和面对面对话。此连接器为 ChatGPT 提供了对您的会议数据的只读访问权限：按语义或关键字搜索过去的会议，获取 AI 生成的任何会议报告（决策、要点、行动项目）、读取原始记录并列出即将发生的日历事件 - 所有这些范围都限于您已参加或被授予团队访问权限的会议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Fairwai is a meeting intelligence platform that transcribes and analyzes your calls, video meetings, and in-person conversations. This connector gives ChatGPT read-only access to your meeting data: search past meetings semantically or by keyword, fetch the AI-generated report of any meeting (decisions, key points, action items), read raw transcripts, and list upcoming calendar events — a…

plugins.name: Craft
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中访问您的 Craft 文档，以起草新内容、完善现有笔记或在工作区中查找信息。添加注释、格式化文档、重新组织知识或搜索您上周写的内容。非常适合那些想要捕捉想法、编辑文档或从笔记中提取上下文而无需切换应用程序的人。
plugins.productIntroEn: Access your Craft documents directly in ChatGPT to draft new content, refine existing notes, or find information across your workspace. Add notes, format documents, reorganize knowledge, or search for something you wrote last week. Ideal for anyone who wants to capture ideas, edit documents, or pull context from their notes without switching apps.

plugins.name: AI Note Maker
plugins.productIntro: 将录音、讲座、文档和语音笔记转变为结构化、可定制的笔记。选择一种格式（从会议和销售拜访笔记到学习指南、项目更新、访谈摘要等），然后在生成可以保存、复制或共享的笔记之前查看记录和提示。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn recordings, lectures, documents, and voice notes into structured, customizable notes. Choose a format—from meeting and sales-call notes to study guides, project updates, interview summaries, and more—then review the transcript and prompt before generating notes you can save, copy, or share.

plugins.name: Contract Information Extractor
plugins.productIntro: 合同信息提取器帮助 ChatGPT 组织用户提供的合同文本中明确规定的信息。它将合同元数据、现有条款、当事人义务、可交付成果、截止日期和依赖关系提取到结构化结果中。它不评估合法性、有效性、公平性、可执行性或法律风险，也不提供法律建议或建议合同变更。
plugins.productIntroEn: Contract Information Extractor helps ChatGPT organize information explicitly stated in user-supplied contract text. It extracts contract metadata, existing clauses, party obligations, deliverables, deadlines, and dependencies into structured results.

plugins.name: Caipi
plugins.productIntro: Caipi 是您的 AI 助手构建的私人工作区。注释、数据、仪表板、整页，甚至小型 Web 应用程序，您的代理可以直接创建和更新它们。您可以通过任何设备管理和使用所有内容，而不仅仅是阅读。
plugins.productIntroEn: Caipi is a private workspace your AI assistant builds in. Notes, data, dashboards, full pages, even small web apps, your agent creates and updates them directly. You manage and use all of it from any device, not just read it.

plugins.name: SimplePost
plugins.productIntro: SimplePost 帮助用户直接从 ChatGPT 使用连接的社交媒体帐户：列出帐户、上传媒体、验证草稿、跨平台预览帖子、发布或安排帖子、保存和管理草稿，以及打开显示时段和帖子活动的交互式日、周或月计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: SimplePost helps users work with their connected social media accounts directly from ChatGPT: list accounts, upload media, validate drafts, preview posts across platforms, publish or schedule posts, save and manage drafts, and open an interactive day, week, or month schedule showing slots and post activity.

plugins.name: Squish
plugins.productIntro: Squish 将公共视频 URL 转换为 ChatGPT 可以读取的带时间戳的联系表。用户可以查看剪辑中发生的情况，按时间码引用视觉时刻，并重复放大开始和结束范围以解析更精细的时刻。
plugins.productIntroEn: Squish turns a public video URL into timestamped contact sheets that ChatGPT can read. Users can review what happens across a clip, cite visual moments by timecode, and repeatedly zoom into a start and end range to resolve finer moments.

plugins.name: Traspion
plugins.productIntro: Traspion 将音频和视频转录工作流程直接引入 ChatGPT。连接您的 Traspion 帐户以查找最近的文件、阅读已完成的文字记录和翻译、上传用于转录的媒体、重命名文件、导出内容以及保存批准的文字记录编辑 — 所有这些都通过自然对话进行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Traspion brings audio and video transcription workflows directly into ChatGPT. Connect your Traspion account to find recent files, read completed transcripts and translations, upload media for transcription, rename files, export content, and save approved transcript edits—all through natural conversation.

plugins.name: Fraghab
plugins.productIntro: Fraghab 是一位香水系列经理。它会追踪您拥有的瓶子和醒酒器、每个瓶子和醒酒器中还剩下多少、您穿着什么、何时穿着以及您正在储蓄什么。
plugins.productIntroEn: Fraghab is a fragrance collection manager. It tracks the bottles and decants you own, how much is left in each, what you wore and when, and what you are saving up for.

plugins.name: CarMax Careers
plugins.productIntro: CarMax Careers 帮助求职者探索 CarMax Careers 的空缺职位。按职位、地点或两者进行搜索 - 助理会显示相关机会，并让您在申请前深入了解详细信息。由 Appcast 提供支持。
plugins.productIntroEn: CarMax Careers helps job seekers explore open roles at CarMax Careers. Search by job title, location, or both — the assistant surfaces relevant opportunities and lets you dig into the details before applying. Powered by Appcast.

plugins.name: SavedIt
plugins.description: 查找您保存的任何内容
plugins.productIntro: SavedIt 帮助人们从 ChatGPT 恢复和组织他们保存的互联网。它可以对所有者范围内的库进行计数和搜索，检查保存的项目详细信息，发现和查询私人收藏，保存链接，更新注释或标签，管理收藏成员资格和共享，以及仅删除特定选择的资源。
plugins.productIntroEn: SavedIt helps people recover and organize their saved internet from ChatGPT. It can count and search an owner-scoped library, inspect saved-item details, discover and query private collections, save links, update notes or tags, manage collection membership and sharing, and delete only specifically selected resources.

plugins.name: Voarq
plugins.productIntro: Voarq 帮助建筑公司直接在 ChatGPT 中管理日常运营。审查项目、截止日期、跟踪时间、客户、每周方向和财务数据。创建和更新项目、客户、时间表、注释、费用、提案、计时器、项目阶段、客户访问、通知和公共应用程序内容。 Voarq 在进行影响较大的变更之前分析当前的办公室环境，并在需要时要求确认。每周方向是只读的，无法通过插件删除或重新生成。帐户设置、密码、安全性、订阅、计费和外部汇款不在该插件的范围内。
plugins.productIntroEn: Voarq helps architecture firms manage day-to-day operations directly in ChatGPT. Review projects, deadlines, tracked time, clients, Weekly Direction, and financial data. Create and update projects, clients, schedules, notes, expenses, proposals, timers, project stages, client access, notifications, and public app content.

plugins.name: CI HUB
plugins.description: 管理您的 DAM 资产
plugins.productIntro: CI HUB 帮助用户搜索和浏览连接的 DAM、存储提供商、图像服务。检查和下载文件和品牌套件，上传和组织资产和文件夹。
plugins.productIntroEn: CI HUB helps users search and browse connected DAMs, storage providers, images services. Inspect and download files and brand kits, upload and organize assets and folders.

plugins.name: Oi
plugins.productIntro: Oi 帮助您发现、安装和使用可重用的 AI 代理上下文来进行实际工作。浏览公共和私人代理上下文，选择适合您任务的一个，然后在 ChatGPT 或 Codex 中启动它，并提供清晰的说明和设置。团队可以标准化他们如何使用人工智能进行设计、工程、研究、支持和其他工作流程，而无需每次都重写提示。
plugins.productIntroEn: Oi helps you discover, install, and use reusable AI agent contexts for real work. Browse public and private agent contexts, pick one that fits your task, and launch it in ChatGPT or Codex with clear instructions and setup. Teams can standardize how they use AI for design, engineering, research, support, and other workflows without rewriting prompts every time.

plugins.name: Aerion
plugins.productIntro: Aerion 帮助经过身份验证的用户检查来自 ChatGPT 的项目、时间跟踪、人员配置、审批和分析数据。用户可以查找和描述 Aerion 记录、创建或更新允许的记录、提交自己的时间条目以及在其 Aerion 权限允许时执行审批工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Aerion helps authenticated users inspect their project, time tracking, staffing, approval, and analytics data from ChatGPT. Users can find and describe Aerion records, create or update permitted records, submit their own time entries, and perform approval workflows when their Aerion permissions allow it.

plugins.name: VoiceCursor Dictionary
plugins.productIntro: 查看并安全管理 macOS、iOS 和 Android 的 VoiceCursor 词典中的手动单词和文本替换，并在更改前进行明确确认。
plugins.productIntroEn: View and safely manage manual words and text replacements in your VoiceCursor dictionaries for macOS, iOS, and Android, with explicit confirmation before changes.

plugins.name: Rox
plugins.productIntro: Rox 帮助用户从 Rox 工作区查找和分析经过身份验证的销售数据，包括客户、交易、联系人、笔记、电子邮件、会议、文档、组织结构图和 Slack 活动。该应用程序公开了一个引导数据界面：用户可以发现可用的数据功能，检查每个功能的架构和工作流程指南，然后调用只读功能来回答销售和帐户情报问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rox helps users find and analyze authenticated sales data from their Rox workspace, including accounts, deals, contacts, notes, emails, meetings, documents, org charts, and Slack activity. The app exposes a guided data interface: users can discover available data functions, inspect each function's schema and workflow guidance, then invoke read-only functions to answer sales and account i…

plugins.name: RescueTime
plugins.productIntro: RescueTime 帮助用户了解他们跟踪的活动、查看项目时间历史记录、比较个人类别和生产力水平的时间、检查当前的焦点状态以及明确启动或停止焦点会话和计时器。
plugins.productIntroEn: RescueTime helps users understand their tracked activity, review project-time history, compare time across personal categories and productivity levels, inspect current focus state, and explicitly start or stop focus sessions and timers.

plugins.name: CoDiscover
plugins.description: 寻找负责任的人工智能用例
plugins.productIntro: CoDiscover 帮助人们将真实的工作挑战转化为实际的人类人工智能用例。它发现、比较和强化生产力、影响力、包容性和创新方面的机会，然后提出具有明确的人类责任、权衡、非人工智能替代方案以及执行/修改/停止标准的最低测试。
plugins.productIntroEn: CoDiscover helps people turn real work challenges into practical Human-AI use cases. It finds, compares, and sharpens opportunities across productivity, impact, inclusion, and innovation, then proposes a minimum test with explicit human accountability, trade-offs, non-AI alternatives, and Go/Revise/Stop criteria.

plugins.name: CloudMindMaps
plugins.productIntro: CloudMindMaps 将您在 ChatGPT 中讨论的任何内容转变为清晰的交互式思维导图。要求它绘制会议笔记、报告、阅读列表、项目计划或只是一个主题——CloudMindMaps 构建想法并在聊天中返回带有内联预览的实时地图。
plugins.productIntroEn: CloudMindMaps turns anything you're discussing in ChatGPT into a clear, interactive mind map. Ask it to map meeting notes, a report, a reading list, a project plan, or just a topic — CloudMindMaps structures the ideas and returns a live map with an inline preview, right in the chat.

plugins.name: Browser Use
plugins.productIntro: 使用安全的云浏览器研究公共网站、完成用户批准的浏览器任务、继续现有会话并实时观看浏览器工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use a secure cloud browser to research public websites, complete user-approved browser tasks, continue existing sessions, and watch the browser work live.

plugins.name: Jotter
plugins.description: 在 AI 聊天之间携带上下文
plugins.productIntro: Jotter 会保存一次 AI 对话中重要的内容，因此您无需在下一次对话中重新解释自己。说“记下这个”，Jotter 就会私下保存一条笔记，或者整个对话的交接摘要。在稍后的新聊天中，或在另一个人工智能助手中，说“加载我的最新笔记”，然后从上次停下的地方继续，保持你的决定、偏好和后续步骤不变。您还可以直接在聊天中按关键字搜索您的笔记、列出它们或删除它们。除非您提出要求，否则不会保存任何内容，也不会自动删除任何内容，并且您的笔记对您来说是私人的。
plugins.productIntroEn: Jotter saves what matters from one AI conversation so you never have to re-explain yourself in the next. Say 'jot this' and Jotter privately saves a note, or a handoff summary of the whole conversation. In a new chat later, or in a different AI assistant, say 'load my latest jot' and pick up where you left off, with your decisions, preferences, and next steps intact.

plugins.name: GoSearch
plugins.productIntro: GoSearch 将您的 AI 助手连接到您组织的知识库。提出问题并从您的团队已使用的应用程序（例如 Google Drive、Slack、Jira、Notion 等 100 多个应用程序）中获取答案，所有这些都集中在一个地方。
plugins.productIntroEn: GoSearch connects your AI assistant to your organization's knowledge base. Ask a question and get answers pulled from the apps your team already uses, like Google Drive, Slack, Jira, Notion, and 100+ more, all in one place.

plugins.name: Buildory
plugins.productIntro: Buildory 帮助创客审查进度、搜索结构化项目知识、准备有针对性的执行交接、维护任务和项目结构以及管理链接的资源和版本化工件。读取访问权限仅限于明确启用的项目； Pro和Creator用户可以分别授权受控更新。不支持永久删除、项目发布和会员变更。
plugins.productIntroEn: Buildory helps makers review progress, search structured project knowledge, prepare focused execution handoffs, maintain tasks and project structure, and manage linked resources and versioned artifacts. Read access is scoped to explicitly enabled projects; Pro and Creator users can separately authorize controlled updates.

plugins.name: Pocket Informant

plugins.productIntroEn: Pocket Informant helps users retrieve projects, calendars, contexts, tags, tasks, events, and notes from their private account, then create new projects, calendars, contexts, tags, tasks, events, and notes.

plugins.name: VaDa Genius

plugins.productIntroEn: VaDa Genius helps you understand the energy in your home using your real energy data.

plugins.productIntroEn: Bring an AI-powered visual design workflow into ChatGPT and Codex. Create, refine, review, and export polished, editable designs through natural conversation.

plugins.productIntroEn: Connect KDAN PDF to ChatGPT to prepare PDFs before you send them out. Ask ChatGPT to compare versions, remove selected pages, redact sensitive details, compress large files, or set and update PDF passwords. It helps keep proposals, reports, contracts, and other important documents ready before you share them with clients or teammates.

plugins.name: Dovetail Regulatory
plugins.productIntro: Dovetail Regulatory 将医疗技术团队从 ChatGPT 连接到其 Dovetail 工作区。用户可以检查设备和任务、搜索和编辑监管文档和数据密钥、管理可追溯性链接和评论、研究标准和 FDA 510(k)、调用项目知识以及运行监管研究和审查代理。
plugins.productIntroEn: Dovetail Regulatory connects medtech teams to their Dovetail workspace from ChatGPT. Users can inspect devices and tasks, search and edit regulatory documents and data keys, manage traceability links and comments, research standards and FDA 510(k)s, recall project knowledge, and run regulatory research and review agents.

plugins.name: Release Notes Coverage Checker
plugins.description: 检查发行说明覆盖范围
plugins.productIntro: 从用户提供的变更列表、交付报告、提交摘要和测试结果中提取结构化的发布项目。将这些项目与用户提供的发行说明进行比较，以识别已覆盖、缺失和描述不一致的更改，并提供源证据进行审查。该插件仅分析当前请求中提供的文本。它不访问存储库、运行测试、验证实施、重写发行说明或发布版本。
plugins.productIntroEn: Extract structured release items from user-provided change lists, delivery reports, commit summaries, and test results. Compare those items with user-provided release notes to identify covered, missing, and inconsistently described changes, with source evidence for review. The plugin analyzes only the text supplied in the current request.

plugins.name: HOUSE ’N’ STARS
plugins.productIntro: HOUSE 'N' STARS 是 ChatGPT 的只读 AI 原生豪华房地产数据集连接器。
plugins.productIntroEn: HOUSE ’N’ STARS is a read-only AI-native luxury real estate dataset connector for ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Aphex

plugins.name: CoachPilot

plugins.productIntroEn: O CoachPilot é o sistema de gestão de personal trainers — alunos, prescrição de treino, avaliações físicas, histórico de sessões, agenda e financeiro. Conectando sua conta, você consulta e ajusta a sua carteira sem sair da conversa: "quem não treina há mais de 10 dias?", "como está a evolução de agachamento da Marina?", "monta o treino B dela para esta semana respeitando a anamnese".

plugins.name: Europacific Tracking
plugins.productIntro: 在几秒钟内跟踪您的 Europacific Logistika 货运。输入任何参考信息 — 位置文件夹 (PF) 编号、集装箱编号、MBL 或 HBL 编号、运输订单或预订编号 — 并获取当前状态、始发地 → 目的地航线、船舶和承运人、ETA 以及最新里程碑，显示在清晰的状态卡中。该应用程序是只读的，仅返回货运物流（没有定价或个人数据）。
plugins.productIntroEn: Track your Europacific Logistika shipment in seconds. Enter any reference — Position Folder (PF) number, container number, MBL or HBL number, transport order, or booking number — and get the current status, origin → destination route, vessel and carrier, ETA, and the latest milestone, shown in a clear status card.

plugins.name: item
plugins.productIntro: item 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的私人 CRM 工作区。您可以搜索、查找、创建、更新和删除联系人、公司、交易和自定义对象；管理列表、保存的视图、注释和任务；并要求自然语言人工智能助手对您的 CRM 数据、电子邮件和会议历史记录进行分析和推理。
plugins.productIntroEn: item connects ChatGPT to your private CRM workspace. You can search, look up, create, update, and delete contacts, companies, deals, and custom objects; manage lists, saved views, notes, and tasks; and ask a natural-language AI assistant to analyze and reason across your CRM data, emails, and meeting history.

plugins.name: Upfluence
plugins.productIntro: 发现合适的创作者并开展您的活动，而无需浏览多个平台。只需用简单的语言描述您要查找的内容，ChatGPT 就会返回由 Upfluence 搜索引擎提供支持的结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover the right creators and run your campaigns without navigating multiple platforms. Simply describe what you're looking for in plain language, and ChatGPT will return results powered by Upfluence's search engine.

plugins.name: Constructable
plugins.productIntro: 开创了管理施工的新方法。 Constructable for ChatGPT 将项目数据转化为对话 - 询问哪些内容未完成、哪些内容已过期或昨天现场发生了什么，并在几秒钟内获得直接答案。连接您的 Constructable 帐户，直接从聊天中提取项目状态、RFI、提交内容和每日报告，无需挖掘。
plugins.productIntroEn: Break ground on a new way to manage construction. Constructable for ChatGPT turns project data into a conversation — ask what's open, what's overdue, or what happened in the field yesterday, and get a straight answer in seconds. Connect your Constructable account to pull project status, RFIs, submittals, and daily reports straight from chat, no digging required.

plugins.name: stierproducts
plugins.description: 产品等级列表，全部引用
plugins.productIntro: 208 个产品类别的 S 到 F 等级列表是通过整合专家评论和所有者报告的独立研究而构建的。每个位置都被引用，每个引用都带有出处、逐字引用、谁说的以及我们是否获取了链接并确认了它。董事会的评级有两种方式：研究表明要避免的产品会发布在底层而不是被删除，因此您会得到购买指南遗漏的一半。产品带有 GTIN 条形码，并且在制造商发布条形码的地方还带有发布日期。没有附属链接，也没有赞助展示位置：没有品牌可以付费进入董事会。
plugins.productIntroEn: S-to-F tier lists for 208 product categories, built by consolidating independent research runs over expert reviews and owner reports. Every placement is cited, and every citation carries the outlet, a verbatim quote, who said it, and whether we fetched the link and confirmed it.

plugins.name: Mosaiq Labs
plugins.description: 您公司的人工智能大脑
plugins.originalDescription: The AI brain of your firm
plugins.productIntro: 从核心文档（IC 备忘录、DDQ、提案）开始，将您的专业知识编码到为您的工作流程提供支持的自定义 AI 代理中
plugins.productIntroEn: Starting with core documents - IC memos, DDQs, Proposals - encode your expertise into custom AI agents that power your workflows

plugins.name: Native Soil

plugins.productIntro: Native Soil 保存 AI 聊天的工作状态（决策、上下文和计划），并允许您将其加载到任何其他模型、客户端或提供商中。切换工具，达到上下文限制，或者明天再回来，从上次停下的地方继续，而不是重新解释所有内容。每次保存的内容在存储之前都会经过检查和评分，秘密和私人数据将被剥离，并且聊天中的任何内容都不会被更改或删除。在共享项目中，负载是通过召回检查来测量的，因此您可以看到实际结转的内容以及需要审查的内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Native Soil saves the working state of your AI chat (the decisions, the context, and the plan) and lets you load it in any other model, client, or provider. Switch tools, hit a context limit, or come back tomorrow, and pick up where you left off instead of re-explaining everything.

plugins.name: Weft

plugins.productIntroEn: Weft is a Scrumban task manager: a kanban board for flow, sprints for focus, no standups or ceremonies. It's built for solo founders, indie makers, and small startup teams who ship without a project manager.

plugins.productIntroEn: Plan training programs, log workouts, check benchmarks, and get personalised coaching advice directly from ChatGPT. plugins.name: RaidRunner

plugins.productIntro: 搜索您的企业内容
plugins.productIntroEn: Search your enterprise content

plugins.name: Rize
plugins.productIntro: Rize 帮助用户检查跟踪的时间、应用程序和网站活动、项目、客户、任务、团队工作量和盈利能力数据。 MCP 工具支持列出和创建时间条目、批准人工智能建议、添加工作注释、管理客户/项目/任务/团队成员，以及在用户经过身份验证的 Rize 工作区中审查合同盈利能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rize helps users inspect tracked time, app and website activity, projects, clients, tasks, team workloads, and profitability data. The MCP tools support listing and creating time entries, approving AI suggestions, adding work notes, managing clients/projects/tasks/team members, and reviewing contract profitability inside the user's authenticated Rize workspace.

plugins.name: Consult with Roy
plugins.description: 与罗伊的礼宾代理交谈
plugins.productIntro: Consult with Roy 是 ROY 的 Apps SDK 应用程序 — 技术咨询。它解释了 Roy 的产品组合和产品，在内嵌 ChatGPT 卡中展示案例研究，捕捉您的目标，用 Roy 精心策划的礼宾指导进行回答，并将财务、法律、定价、合同和低信任度问题上报给 Roy 个人。技能涵盖吸收、发现、展示、咨询答案、会议提案、回忆和人工交接。身份通过电子邮件进行验证，参与记录保留在 Roy 的工作空间中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Consult with Roy is the Apps SDK app for ROY — Technology Consultation. It explains Roy's portfolio and offerings, shows case studies in inline ChatGPT cards, captures your goal, answers with Roy's curated concierge guidance, and escalates finance, legal, pricing, contracts, and low-confidence matters to Roy personally.

plugins.name: Memco Shared Memory
plugins.productIntro: （人类和代理组成的）团队共享知识，以便所有人都能获得一个人学到的经验教训。代理很聪明，但他们不知道您的内部实践、IP 和遗留代码。共享内存填补了这些空白，并且比 RAG 更有效。
plugins.productIntroEn: Teams (of humans and agents) share knowledge so that lessons learned by one are available to all. Agents are smart but they don't know your internal practices, IP, and legacy code. Shared memory fills-in those gaps, and is orders of magnitude more effective than RAG.

plugins.name: OWOX Data Marts
plugins.productIntro: OWOX 数据集市将 ChatGPT/Codex 连接到您公司的受管分析层。数据分析师在您自己的仓库（BigQuery、Snowflake、Databricks、Redshift、Athena）之上定义可信数据集市（指标、维度和联接逻辑）。从 ChatGPT/Codex，您可以通过自然语言搜索发现正确的数据集市、检查其字段、查询受管理的数据并通过服务器端总计（根据分析师定义的指标和联接计算，从未从原始表猜测）获得答案，并管理定期报告运行计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: OWOX Data Marts connects ChatGPT/Codex to your company's governed analytics layer. Data Analysts define trusted data marts — metrics, dimensions, and join logic — on top of your own warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, Athena).

plugins.name: the brand id
plugins.productIntro: 品牌 ID 允许经过身份验证的用户将其实时品牌资料连接到 ChatGPT。该插件从用户连接的品牌数据中返回只读品牌上下文、复制指导、社交指导、视觉指导和资产简要指导。
plugins.productIntroEn: the brand id lets authenticated users connect their live brand profile to ChatGPT. The plugin returns read-only brand context, copy guidance, social guidance, visual guidance, and asset brief guidance from the user's connected brand data.

plugins.name: decisionpoint.io
plugins.productIntro: 使用层次分析法 (AHP) 进行结构化决策，这是一种经过验证的比较选项和解决权衡的框架。
plugins.productIntroEn: Structured decision-making using the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) , a proven framework for comparing options and resolving trade-offs.

plugins.name: CopyCharm
plugins.description: 访问您的 CopyCharm 上下文
plugins.productIntro: CopyCharm 是一个上下文工作台，用于保存和重用提示、注释、喜爱的剪辑和策划的工作上下文。
plugins.productIntroEn: CopyCharm is a context workbench for saving and reusing prompts, notes, favorite clips, and curated working context.

plugins.name: Channel99
plugins.productIntro: Channel99 实时市场情报将 Codex 直接连接到 Channel99 的绩效营销情报。让人工智能助理实时访问统一的 B2B 营销数据和见解。由 Channel99 的高级归因、帐户识别和人工智能驱动的分析提供支持。 Channel99 连接支持自然语言查询，提供准确的活动绩效、支出效率、受众参与度和跨渠道归因洞察，从而消除手动数据提取、孤立的仪表板和复杂的 API 工程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Channel99 real time go to market intelligence connects Codex directly to Channel99’s performance marketing intelligence. giving AI assistants real-time access to unified B2B marketing data and insights.. Powered by Channel99’s advanced attribution, account identification, and AI-driven analytics.

plugins.name: Find Your Great
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中查询您的工作活动、职业分数和影响数据。通过对话提取 Slack 消息、GitHub PR、线性问题、会议记录和决定来总结您的一周、准备一对一或起草利益相关者更新。
plugins.productIntroEn: Query your work activity, career scores, and impact data directly in ChatGPT. Pull in Slack messages, GitHub PRs, Linear issues, meeting transcripts, and decisions to summarize your week, prep for 1-on-1s, or draft stakeholder updates — all through conversation.

plugins.name: table
plugins.productIntro: 表将 ChatGPT 连接到您的关系工作区，以便您可以在需要时找到联系人上下文，并将新详细信息保存回您的人员智能工具。
plugins.productIntroEn: table connects ChatGPT to your relationship workspace, so you can find contact context when you need it and save new details back to your people intelligence tool.

plugins.name: ShareWatch
plugins.description: 保护 Google Workspace 的安全
plugins.productIntro: ShareWatch 为 ChatGPT 提供对 Google Workspace 文件的经过审核的限定范围访问权限。用户可以查找、阅读、创建、格式化、更新、组织、预览、转换和保护 Google 文档、表格、幻灯片、文件夹和上传的文件，同时 ShareWatch 强制执行每个文件的访问控制。
plugins.productIntroEn: ShareWatch gives ChatGPT scoped, audited access to Google Workspace files. Users can find, read, create, format, update, organize, preview, convert, and protect Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, folders, and uploaded files while ShareWatch enforces per-file access controls.

plugins.name: Teleprompter.com
plugins.productIntro: 起草、修改和组织您在镜头上阅读的脚本，而无需离开对话。连接您的 Teleprompter.com 帐户，ChatGPT 可以与您一起编写脚本，然后将其直接保存到您的工作区，归档到正确的文件夹中，并为您的下一次拍摄做好准备。
plugins.productIntroEn: Draft, revise, and organize the scripts you read on camera, without leaving the conversation. Connect your Teleprompter.com account and ChatGPT can write a script with you, then save it straight to your workspace, filed in the right folder and ready for your next take.

plugins.name: PostSyncer
plugins.productIntro: 从 ChatGPT 安排和发布社交媒体帖子。 PostSyncer 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Instagram、TikTok、YouTube、X (Twitter)、LinkedIn、Facebook、Threads、Bluesky、Pinterest、Telegram 和 Mastodon 帐户 - 来自一个应用程序的 11 个网络。
plugins.productIntroEn: Schedule and publish social media posts from ChatGPT. PostSyncer connects ChatGPT to your Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Telegram and Mastodon accounts - 11 networks from one app.

plugins.name: PingPrompt
plugins.productIntro: PingPrompt 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 创建、搜索、组织和安全地编辑可重用的提示工件。该应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到用户的 PingPrompt 工作区，以便可以将提示保存到项目中，在 PingPrompt 编辑器中打开，从第一次保存开始进行版本控制，并通过拒绝丢失或模糊编辑的经过验证的补丁进行更新。
plugins.productIntroEn: PingPrompt helps users create, search, organize, and safely edit reusable prompt artifacts from ChatGPT. The app connects ChatGPT to the user's PingPrompt workspace so prompts can be saved into projects, opened in the PingPrompt editor, versioned from the first save, and updated through validated patches that refuse missing or ambiguous edits.

plugins.name: GoFloaters
plugins.productIntro: GoFloaters 让您可以轻松地从您的 ChatGPT 对话中找到印度各地的专业会议室和日通办公空间。
plugins.productIntroEn: GoFloaters makes it effortless to find professional meeting rooms and day-pass coworking spaces across India - right from your ChatGPT conversation.

plugins.name: Partoska
plugins.productIntro: 聚会结束后，您是否曾花费数小时寻找散布在聊天组、电子邮件线程和随机云文件夹中的照片？帕托斯卡解决了这个问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ever spent hours chasing down photos scattered across chat groups, email threads, and random cloud folders after a party? Partoska fixes that.

plugins.name: Keypup
plugins.productIntro: Keypup 是一个工程分析平台，允许软件开发团队联合来自 Git（例如 GitHub）和项目管理（例如 Jira）平台的数据，以了解其开发过程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Keypup is the engineering analytics platform allowing software development teams to federate data from Git (e.g., GitHub) and project management (e.g., Jira) platforms to gain visibility into their development process.

plugins.name: Nomad Helper
plugins.productIntro: 从授权的 Telegram 聊天中查找有关申请和获得西班牙数字游牧签证的第一手经验。 Nomad Helper 对每个问题都开始新的多语言研究，跟踪直至完成，并返回简明的结果以及原始消息的链接。每个用户只能搜索分配给其帐户的聊天。独立服务；不隶属于 Telegram。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find first-hand experiences from authorized Telegram chats about applying for and obtaining Spain's digital nomad visa. Nomad Helper starts fresh multilingual research for every question, follows it through completion, and returns concise findings with links to original messages. Each user can search only the chats assigned to their account.

plugins.name: CiteLaw
plugins.productIntro: ChatGPT 内有完整的法律研究和公司管理工具包。
plugins.productIntroEn: A complete legal research and firm-management toolkit inside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Roux
plugins.productIntro: Roux 帮助用户与队友、客户或利益相关者开展有针对性的对话，跟踪响应进度，并将注重隐私的综合结果带回到他们的工作中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Roux helps users launch focused conversations with teammates, customers, or stakeholders, track response progress, and bring privacy-conscious synthesized findings back into their work.

plugins.name: Runa
plugins.productIntro: Runa 将您授权的会议知识带入 ChatGPT。搜索会议摘要和批准的文件夹文档，检索最近或主题匹配的会议，审查决策和关键要点，列出未完成的操作项目，并使用 Runa 最新的同步日历上下文为即将举行的会议做好准备。
plugins.productIntroEn: Runa brings your authorized meeting knowledge into ChatGPT. Search meeting summaries and approved folder documents, retrieve recent or topic-matched meetings, review decisions and key takeaways, list open action items, and prepare for upcoming meetings using Runa’s latest synchronized calendar context.

plugins.name: Mallary
plugins.description: 在社交媒体上发帖和回复
plugins.originalDescription: Post and reply on social media
plugins.productIntro: 使用 ChatGPT 中的 Mallary 来发布和安排帖子、上传媒体、阅读和回复评论以及检查连接的社交媒体帐户中的帖子和受众结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use Mallary in ChatGPT to publish and schedule posts, upload media, read and reply to comments, and check post and audience results across your connected social media accounts.

plugins.name: PlatoForms
plugins.productIntro: PlatoForms 是一个在线表单生成器，适用于 Web 表单、可填写的 PDF 表单和 PDF 文档。该插件连接您的 PlatoForms 帐户，以便您可以在对话中处理您自己的表单及其提交内容，而无需打开仪表板。
plugins.productIntroEn: PlatoForms is an online form builder for web forms, fillable PDF forms and PDF documents. This plugin connects your PlatoForms account so you can work with your own forms and their submissions in conversation, instead of opening the dashboard.

plugins.name: NivaDesk
plugins.productIntro: NivaDesk 帮助定制订单工作室通过 ChatGPT 管理订单、客户、个人笔记、任务、日程安排和财务摘要。连接 NivaDesk 工作区后，用户可以搜索订单、查看仪表板摘要、检查允许的财务信息、创建个人注释和更新订单状态。
plugins.productIntroEn: NivaDesk helps custom-order studios manage orders, customers, personal notes, tasks, schedules and financial summaries from ChatGPT. After connecting a NivaDesk workspace, users can search orders, view dashboard summaries, check permitted financial information, create personal notes and update order statuses.

plugins.name: SourcePRD
plugins.productIntro: SourcePRD 读取您的代码库并编写产品故事：人们进来的门、内部区域以及每项功能 - 它是什么、人们如何使用它以及实现它的文件。不是计划；今天代码中存在的产品。
plugins.productIntroEn: SourcePRD reads your codebase and writes the product story: the doors people come in through, the areas inside, and every capability — what it is, how people use it, and the files that implement it. Not the plan; the product as it exists in the code today.

plugins.name: Vibe AI
plugins.productIntro: 将每一次对话变成有组织的、可搜索的记忆。 Vibe AI 是第一个上下文 AI 工作区 - 与 Vibe Dot 和 Vibe Bot 配合使用，它可以捕获所说内容并让您的工作继续进行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn every conversation into organized, searchable memory. Vibe AI is the 1st contextual AI workspace — paired with Vibe Dot and Vibe Bot, it captures what's said and keeps your work moving.

plugins.name: Talonic
plugins.description: 提取数据并与文档交谈
plugins.originalDescription: Extract data and talk to docs
plugins.productIntro: Talonic 帮助用户将 PDF、扫描件、发票、合同、证书、报表和表单等文档转换为经过架构验证的 JSON。 用户可以提取结构化字段、将文档转换为 Markdown、搜索和过滤其 Talonic 工作区、管理可重用的提取模式、检查文档状态、请求浏览器上传链接以及查看信用余额信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Talonic helps users turn documents such as PDFs, scans, invoices, contracts, certificates, statements, and forms into schema-validated JSON. Users can extract structured fields, convert documents to markdown, search and filter their Talonic workspace, manage reusable extraction schemas, check document status, request browser upload links, and view credit balance information.

plugins.name: Cinch
plugins.productIntro: Cinch 通过列出公司和项目、检查任务和评论、创建项目工作、更新任务字段以及添加任务评论，帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中处理项目管理数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Cinch helps users work with their project management data in ChatGPT by listing companies and projects, inspecting tasks and comments, creating project work, updating task fields, and adding task comments.

plugins.name: IAJUS
plugins.productIntro: IAJUS 帮助研究巴西判例法、合格先例和立法。其 28 个 MCP 工具搜索 IAJUS 法律语料库，并在需要时阅读官方公共资源。结果包括出处和官方链接（如果有）。该应用程序不会通过私人标识符搜索人员，也无法归档、签署或修改法庭记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: IAJUS helps research Brazilian case law, qualified precedents, and legislation. Its 28 MCP tools search the IAJUS legal corpus and, when needed, read official public sources. Results include provenance and official links when available. The app does not search people by private identifiers and cannot file, sign, or modify court records.

plugins.name: Delivery Report Extractor
plugins.productIntro: 从人工智能开发交付报告中提取结构化信息，包括摘要、更改的文件、实施项目、修复、测试和注释。该应用程序可帮助用户快速整理工程报告中的交付详细信息。它仅分析提供的文本，不会修改代码、访问外部系统或执行部署操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Extract structured information from AI development delivery reports, including summaries, changed files, implementation items, fixes, tests, and notes. This app helps users quickly organize delivery details from engineering reports. It only analyzes provided text and does not modify code, access external systems, or perform deployment actions.

plugins.name: Algolia Productivity
plugins.description: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Algolia
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Algolia 帐户，以解锁工作流程中的超级自动化。 Algolia Productivity 允许用户使用用户范围的 OAuth 访问通过 ChatGPT 搜索和获取记录、探索索引、检查其设置和分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your Algolia account to unlock supercharged automations on your workflows. Algolia Productivity lets users search and fetch records, explore indices, inspect their settings and analytics through ChatGPT using user-scoped OAuth access.

plugins.name: Hero by Vivun
plugins.productIntro: 来认识一下 Hero，您的销售人工智能队友。 Hero 可以加入您的通话、撰写后续内容、研究账户，并帮助您推动每笔交易。此连接器提供 ChatGPT 对您的 Hero 数据的只读访问权限，因此无论您在哪里工作得最好，都可以获取 Hero 的见解。
plugins.productIntroEn: Meet Hero, your AI teammate for Sales. Hero can join your calls, write your follow-ups, research accounts, and help you keep every deal moving. This connector provides ChatGPT read-only access to your Hero data so you can get Hero’s insights wherever you work best.

plugins.name: Memocore
plugins.productIntro: Memocore 为 ChatGPT 提供持久内存，可承载每次对话。保存一次事实、偏好、项目和笔记（对您私有或与团队共享），Memocore 会在相关时自动调用它们，因此您再也不会重复上下文。
plugins.productIntroEn: Memocore gives ChatGPT persistent memory that carries across every conversation. Save facts, preferences, projects, and notes once — private to you or shared with a team — and Memocore recalls them automatically whenever they're relevant, so you never repeat context again.

plugins.name: Bravos AI
plugins.description: 训练和管理您的聊天机器人
plugins.productIntro: Bravos AI 允许企业创建根据自己的内容（网站、文档、产品目录）进行训练的人工智能聊天机器人，并将其部署在自己的网站或 WhatsApp 上。此应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Bravos 帐户，以便您无需打开仪表板即可管理一切：检查客户的要求、审核机器人用于每个答案的来源、修复知识差距、更新机器人的指令、系统提示和语气，并根据您的计划跟踪使用情况。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bravos AI lets businesses create AI chatbots trained on their own content (website, documents, product catalogs) and deploy them on their website or WhatsApp. This app connects ChatGPT to your Bravos account so you can manage everything without opening the dashboard: check what your customers asked, audit which sources the bot used for each answer, fix knowledge gaps, update your bot's i…

plugins.name: LASEC
plugins.productIntro: LASEC 帮助您在一个地方构建和管理网络治理：风险分析、审计、登记、安全措施、行动计划和摘要。
plugins.productIntroEn: LASEC vous aide à structurer et piloter votre gouvernance cyber au même endroit : analyses de risques, audits, registres, mesures de sécurité, plans d’actions et synthèses.

plugins.name: Clarier
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Clarier 工作区，以查看组织的 AI 工具、供应商风险报告、AI 使用情况、请求、批准和合规性见解。您可以准备新的 AI 工具请求或工具更新，查看建议的更改，并在 Clarier 应用它们之前明确确认。 Clarify 使用您现有的公司成员资格、角色和权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your Clarier workspace to review your organization’s AI tools, vendor risk reports, AI usage, requests, approvals, and compliance insights. You can prepare a new AI-tool request or tool update, review the proposed changes, and explicitly confirm before Clarier applies them. Clarier uses your existing company membership, role, and permissions.

plugins.name: Flatre
plugins.productIntro: Flatre 帮助房地产经纪人、交易协调员和经纪团队保持交易从第一次接触到成交。它将联系人、属性、交易、任务、展示、文档、佣金、日历和团队工作流程集成到一个共享工作区中，以便每个人都可以看到需要注意的内容以及发生的变化。
plugins.productIntroEn: Flatre helps real estate agents, transaction coordinators, and brokerage teams keep deals moving from first contact to closing. It brings contacts, properties, transactions, tasks, showings, documents, commissions, calendars, and team workflows into one shared workspace, so everyone can see what needs attention and what changed.

plugins.name: Menti
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Menti 免费创建交互式演示文稿。无论您是在线演示还是现场演示，Menti 都可以帮助您使用实时民意调查、现场测验、问答和文字云来吸引观众。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create interactive presentations for free with Menti. Whether you’re presenting online or in-person, Menti helps you engage your audience using real-time polls, live quizzes, Q&As and word clouds.

plugins.name: Global Database
plugins.productIntro: 使用直接来自官方政府登记处的数据查找超过 195 个国家/地区的任何公司。
plugins.productIntroEn: Look up any company across 195+ countries using data sourced directly from official government registries.

plugins.name: Storydoc
plugins.productIntro: Storydoc 将您的演示模板从对话中转变为完成的个性化演示文稿。浏览 Storydoc 帐户中的模板，填充变量以为特定客户创建新版本，或使用 AI 向导从头开始生成全新的套牌。每套牌都会登陆您的 Storydoc 帐户，并以可共享的短 URL 形式返回。您还可以询问您的套牌的表现如何，并获取参与总数、热门故事和版本以及按设备和位置进行的细分。
plugins.productIntroEn: Storydoc turns your presentation templates into finished, personalized decks from a conversation. Browse the templates in your Storydoc account, fill their variables to create a new version for a specific client, or generate a brand-new deck from scratch with the AI wizard. Every deck lands in your Storydoc account and comes back as a shareable short URL.

plugins.name: Izifete
plugins.description: 查找附近的活动供应商
plugins.productIntro: Izifete 可以帮助您在法国组织一场活动——婚礼、生日、洗礼、企业研讨会或聚会——找到经过验证的当地专业人士，并在您做出承诺之前为您提供切合实际的规划数据。按行业和城市搜索 15 个活动行业：餐饮服务商、街头小吃、DJ、摄影师、摄像师、照相亭、装饰师、娱乐、糕点师、花店、设备租赁、私人厨师、化妆师、美发师和接待场所。每个结果都是 izifete.fr 上真实发布的个人资料，显示其城市、交易和评级。
plugins.productIntroEn: Izifete helps you organise an event in France - a wedding, a birthday, a christening, a corporate seminar or a party - by finding verified local professionals and giving you realistic planning figures before you commit.

plugins.name: Atlas Red
plugins.productIntro: Atlas Red 是结构化思维导图的工作区。导图是一棵主题树，导图中的每个主题都共享相同的作者定义的字段（纯文本或键入的字段，例如带有自己的选项、数字或日期的选择），因此导图的行为就像您可以看到的小型数据库。
plugins.productIntroEn: Atlas Red is a workspace for structured mind maps. A map is a tree of topics, and every topic in a map shares the same author-defined fields — plain text, or typed ones like a select with its own options, a number or a date — so a map behaves like a small database you can see.

plugins.name: Backstory
plugins.productIntro: Backstory 将 ChatGPT 连接到您团队的交易和帐户历史记录 - 每封电子邮件、会议、通话和 CRM 记录。询问管道风险、利益相关者参与或后续步骤。根据实际发生的情况获取答案，而不仅仅是 CRM 中记录的内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Backstory connects ChatGPT to your team's deal and account history - every email, meeting, call, and CRM record. Ask about pipeline risk, stakeholder engagement, or next steps. Get answers based on what actually happened, not just what got logged in your CRM.

plugins.name: RuleFoundry
plugins.productIntro: RuleFoundry 查找您创建的或分配给您的提取，显示其状态和 RuleFoundry 链接，并使已完成的提取中的最终工件可用作规划、代码、文档和分析的引用源材料。在您确认确切的主题、可选描述和参与者后，它可以为您或外部电子邮件地址创建一个提取请求。 RuleFoundry 自动发送外部邀请。 RuleFoundry 中仍然会发生提取会话；该插件无法启动、执行、继续、完成、重新发送、修改或删除它们。
plugins.productIntroEn: RuleFoundry finds Extractions you created or that were assigned to you, shows their status and RuleFoundry link, and makes finalized artifacts from completed Extractions available as cited source material for planning, code, documents, and analysis.

plugins.name: LlamaParse
plugins.productIntro: LlamaParse 插件允许用户和代理在处理任何格式或文件类型的文档时利用多种功能：解析（付费和免费）、模式提取、分类、拆分和索引 + 检索。
plugins.productIntroEn: The LlamaParse plugin lets users and agents leverage several features when processing documents in any format or file type: parsing (both paid and free), schema extraction, classification, splitting, and indexing + retrieval.

plugins.name: Memova.ai
plugins.productIntro: Memova 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中处理自己的会议记录。该应用程序可以搜索和总结 Memova 笔记和成绩单、审查操作项目、检查和运行具有受保护的进度写入的私人自动化任务，并帮助用户建立自己的 LLM Wiki 式知识库。
plugins.productIntroEn: Memova helps users work with their own meeting notes in ChatGPT and Codex. The app can search and summarize Memova notes and transcripts, review action items, inspect and run private automation tasks with guarded progress writes, and help users set up their own LLM Wiki-style knowledge base.

plugins.name: Sydium
plugins.productIntro: Sydium 以您自己的声音运行您的社交媒体。连接您的 Sydium 帐户，ChatGPT 可以按照您实际写作的方式起草字幕（从您已经发布的内容中学习），安排或发布到最多十个平台（Instagram、TikTok、YouTube、LinkedIn、X、Facebook、Pinterest、Bluesky、Threads、Mastodon）、检查帖子的执行情况、提取今天的内容创意以及管理即将到来的队列 - 编辑、重新安排或取消任何仍安排的内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sydium runs your social media in your own voice. Connect your Sydium account and ChatGPT can draft captions the way you actually write (learned from what you have already published), schedule or publish to up to ten platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads, Mastodon), check how posts performed, pull today's content idea, and manage the upc…

plugins.name: Planday
plugins.description: 管理 Planday 日程安排
plugins.productIntro: 直接连接到您的 Planday 帐户，完全通过自然对话来管理日程安排、轮班和团队缺勤。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect directly to your Planday account to manage scheduling, shifts, and team absences entirely through natural conversation.

plugins.name: Sunate
plugins.description: 从 ChatGPT 管理您的 CRM
plugins.productIntro: 将您的 Sunate 工作区连接到 ChatGPT 和 Codex，以自然语言管理日常 CRM 工作。查找并更新联系人、潜在客户、交易、任务、管道、任务和私人报价草稿；检查屋顶报告；并准备潜在客户开发请求。访问遵循每个成员的 Sunate 权限，敏感操作需要确认。需要启用 OpenAI 集成的 Sunate 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Sunate workspace to ChatGPT and Codex to manage everyday CRM work in natural language. Find and update contacts, leads, deals, tasks, pipelines, assignments, and private quote drafts; check roof reports; and prepare lead-generation requests. Access follows each member's Sunate permissions, and sensitive actions require confirmation.

plugins.name: NugIt
plugins.productIntro: NugIt.ai 帮助您保持值得再次寻找的 ChatGPT 答案。在有用的答案下方输入“NugIt”，将其保存为私人图书馆中的私人标题 Nug。随着时间的推移，NugIt.ai 会成为您想要查找和再次使用的有用答案的可搜索之家。
plugins.productIntroEn: NugIt.ai helps you keep the ChatGPT answers worth finding again. Type “NugIt” beneath a useful answer to save it as a private, titled Nug in your personal library. Over time, NugIt.ai becomes a searchable home for the useful answers you want to find and use again.

plugins.name: Cribly
plugins.productIntro: 代理家庭库存和组织内存
plugins.productIntroEn: Agentic Home Inventory and Organization Memory

plugins.name: FilesAnywhere
plugins.description: 人工智能保护企业文件安全
plugins.productIntro: 使用此工具通过自然语言查询与 FilesAnywhere 中存储的文件进行交互。它使用户能够搜索、总结、比较和提取文档中的信息，而无需手动查看每个文件。该工具适用于处理存储的文档以快速查找关键详细信息、分析内容或直接从文件数据生成见解。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use this tool to interact with files stored in FilesAnywhere through natural language queries. It enables users to search, summarize, compare, and extract information from documents without manually reviewing each file. This tool is appropriate when working with stored documents to quickly locate key details, analyze content, or generate insights directly from file data.

plugins.name: Steady
plugins.originalDescription: Stay in sync with your team
plugins.productIntro: Steady 将有关工作中发生的情况的完整上下文引入您的 ChatGPT 工作流程。它不断地提炼出您的工具和团队的计划、进度和活动，因此每次对话都从完整的故事开始，而不是从一张白纸开始。补上您错过的内容，询问有关项目和目标的问题，或直接从 ChatGPT 发布更新。
plugins.productIntroEn: Steady brings complete context about what's going on at work into your ChatGPT workflows. It continuously distills plans, progress, and activity across your tools and teams — so every conversation starts with the full story instead of a blank slate. Catch up on what you missed, ask questions about projects and goals, or post updates directly from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Free Marathi Biodata Maker
plugins.description: 创建马拉地语生物数据
plugins.productIntro: 直接在聊天中用马拉地语或英语创建婚姻生物数据（lagna biodata）。分享一些详细信息 - 姓名、教育、家庭背景、星座 - 并在几秒钟内获得精美的、可立即共享的 PDF。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create a marriage biodata (lagna biodata) in Marathi or English, directly in chat. Share a few details — name, education, family background, horoscope — and get back a polished, ready-to-share PDF within seconds.

plugins.name: Clipform
plugins.productIntro: Clipform 构建由视频支持的交互式、移动优先的表单、测验和调查 - 所有这些都来自聊天。创建表单，添加问题和内容步骤，生成 AI 配音和视频，附加您自己的图像或剪辑，并获取实时、可共享的链接 - 然后读回您构建的结构。
plugins.productIntroEn: Clipform builds interactive, mobile-first forms, quizzes, and surveys powered by video - all from chat. Create a form, add question and content steps, generate AI voiceover and video, attach your own images or clips, and get a live, shareable link - then read back the structure of what you built.

plugins.name: Formspry
plugins.productIntro: Formspry 允许 ChatGPT 在您的 Formspry 帐户中创建和管理在线表单。根据描述创建表单、添加字段、发布或关闭表单、检索可共享链接、查看回复以及查看分析（例如视图和完成率）。将其用于反馈、注册、潜在客户捕获和调查。
plugins.productIntroEn: Formspry lets ChatGPT create and manage online forms in your Formspry account. Create forms from a description, add fields, publish or close forms, retrieve shareable links, review responses, and view analytics such as views and completion rates. Use it for feedback, registrations, lead capture, and surveys.

plugins.name: Discipline Rewards (D/R)
plugins.description: 随时随地计划。在 D/R 中执行。
plugins.productIntro: 想要养成更好的习惯、坚持目标、改善健康、加强日常生活或制定个人成长计划？ ChatGPT 可以帮助您集思广益，构建目标，建立习惯系统，并根据您想要实现的目标制定问责计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: Want to build better habits, stay consistent with goals, improve your health, strengthen your routines, or create a plan for personal growth? ChatGPT can help you brainstorm ideas, structure goals, build habit systems, and create accountability plans tailored to what you're trying to achieve.

plugins.name: Breeze
plugins.productIntro: Breeze 将您的项目引入 ChatGPT，以便您可以通过描述您的需求来管理工作。询问“什么逾期了？”、“给我发布项目的概述”或“找到有关客户引导的任务”——然后得到清晰、直接的答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Breeze brings your projects into ChatGPT, so you can manage work by describing what you need. Ask "what's overdue?", "give me an overview of the launch project", or "find the task about customer onboarding" — and get a clear, straight answer.

plugins.name: TrackTogether
plugins.productIntro: TrackTogether 帮助人们创建跟踪器、管理清单任务、与朋友协作以及通过 ChatGPT 跟踪进度。
plugins.productIntroEn: TrackTogether helps people create trackers, manage checklist tasks, collaborate with friends, and follow progress through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Call Me
plugins.description: 致电您的人工人员寻求答案
plugins.productIntro: Call Me 可以让人工智能代理拨打人类的电话，大声说出问题，并将口头答案作为文本返回。代理还可以发送消息、接收回复并将每个任务组织为对话线程。内置演示线路（号码 5550001234）会自动接听电话和短信，因此无需安装手机应用程序即可尝试完整循环。
plugins.productIntroEn: Call Me lets AI agents ring a human's phone, speak a question aloud, and return the spoken answer as text. Agents can also send messages, receive replies, and keep each task organized as a conversation thread. A built-in demo line (number 5550001234) answers calls and texts automatically, so the full loop can be tried without installing the phone app.

plugins.name: Markup AI
plugins.productIntro: 标记 AI 在一次调用中根据组织配置的质量检查来审查草稿：品牌声音漂移、未经批准的术语、违反风格指南、难以阅读的句子、人工智能听起来的措辞、不受支持或有风险的声明、缺少来源和人工智能搜索准备情况。用户在 ChatGPT 中共享内容，可选择说明他们想要实现的目标，并获取运行的检查、任何配置警告以及标记的问题位置、解释和建议的更正。团队还可以使用选定的角色、品牌语音配置文件、风格指南或内容配置文件运行一组明确的命名检查，并列出其组织可用的检查和配置。
plugins.productIntroEn: Markup AI reviews drafts against an organization's configured quality checks in a single call: brand voice drift, unapproved terminology, style-guide violations, hard-to-read sentences, AI-sounding phrasing, unsupported or risky claims, missing sourcing, and AI-search readiness.

plugins.name: F-AI Contract Template Finder
plugins.productIntro: 查找与所选过滤器匹配的法律文档模板的链接。涵盖合同、协议、政策、决议、信件和其他法律文件。
plugins.productIntroEn: Finds links to legal document templates that match the selected filters. Covers contracts, agreements, policies, resolutions, letters, and other legal documents.

plugins.name: AB Projects
plugins.description: MS Team 的 AI 行动
plugins.productIntro: AB (ActionBridge) 在您的 AI 代理和 Microsoft Teams 之间提供安全可靠的集成层。它使您的模型能够直接与工作空间交互，将被动的人工智能见解转变为团队日常运营的积极参与者。
plugins.productIntroEn: AB (ActionBridge) provides a secure and reliable integration layer between your AI agents and Microsoft Teams. It enables your models to interact directly with your workspace, transforming passive AI insights into active participants in your team's daily operations.

plugins.name: Contextli
plugins.productIntro: Contextli 将您的语音笔记和转录内容转变为可搜索的第二大脑。连接它即可调出您自己的笔记和上下文，并搜索您捕获的所有内容，而无需离开聊天室。
plugins.productIntroEn: Contextli turns your voice notes and transcriptions into a searchable second brain. Connect it to pull up your own notes and contexts, and search across everything you have captured, without leaving the chat.

plugins.name: RiverScript
plugins.productIntro: 使用 RiverScript 捕获并转录您在计算机上可以听到的所有内容，然后将您的转录内容带入您的 ChatGPT 工作流程中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Capture and transcribe everything you can hear on your computer with RiverScript, then bring your transcripts into your ChatGPT workflow.

plugins.name: mfloow
plugins.description: mflow：人工智能工作流程平台
plugins.productIntro: mfloow 是一个业务流程改进平台，它使用人工智能提供端到端支持，从可视化操作到确保改进成功嵌入整个组织。
plugins.productIntroEn: mfloow is a business process improvement platform that uses AI to provide end-to-end support, from visualizing operations to ensuring that improvements are successfully embedded across the organization.

plugins.name: wiserwork
plugins.productIntro: wiserwork 是一个面向团队的人工智能会议平台，可将会议转化为可搜索的知识和完成的工作。在 ChatGPT 中，用户可以查看同步的会议日程、检索记录和摘要，以及查找决策和行动项目。
plugins.productIntroEn: wiserwork is an AI meeting platform for teams that turns meetings into searchable knowledge and finished work. In ChatGPT, users can review their synchronized meeting schedule, retrieve transcripts and summaries, and find decisions and action items.

plugins.name: Octen
plugins.productIntro: Octen 通过 Octen 托管的 MCP 服务器提供来自网络的 ChatGPT 实时信息：具有与查询相关的突出显示和过滤器的实时网络搜索、专用新闻垂直、用于研究和比较的广泛多角度搜索、用于阅读和基础答案的干净 URL 到 Markdown 提取，以及（仅限测试版）图像和视频搜索。用户通过 OAuth 连接他们的 Octen 帐户；无需配置 API 密钥。
plugins.productIntroEn: Octen gives ChatGPT live information from the web through Octen's hosted MCP server: real-time web search with query-relevant highlights and filters, a dedicated news vertical, broad multi-angle search for research and comparisons, clean URL-to-markdown extraction for reading and grounding answers, and (invite-only beta) image and video search.

plugins.name: GPS-Ortung24
plugins.productIntro: GPS-Ortung24 将您的人工智能助手连接到您的车队。用简单的语言询问车辆在哪里、哪些车辆正在移动或停放、行驶了多远、是否有任何警报，或生成上个月符合 GoBD 的日志 - 并获得包括纯文本地址的即时答案。访问权限是严格只读和多租户的：每个客户通过 OAuth 使用自己的 GPS-Ortung24 帐户登录，并且只能看到自己的车辆。司机均采用化名；计费数据永远不会暴露。
plugins.productIntroEn: GPS-Ortung24 connects your AI assistant to your vehicle fleet. Ask in plain language where a vehicle is, which vehicles are moving or parked, how far they drove, whether there were any alerts, or generate a GoBD-compliant logbook for last month — and get an instant answer including plain-text addresses.

plugins.name: Namp
plugins.productIntro: Namp MCP 帮助经过身份验证的用户查找项目、注释、备忘录、会议纪要、讨论区、成员和文件，以及创建或更新私有项目工作区内容并通过 ChatGPT 上传项目文件。
plugins.productIntroEn: Namp MCP helps authenticated users find projects, notes, memos, meeting minutes, boards, members, and files, plus create or update private project workspace content and upload project files through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Mantic
plugins.productIntro: Mantic 帮助用户探索有关地缘政治、商业、政策、市场、技术和文化的概率预测。搜索可访问的问题和仪表板，检查预测及其可用推理，比较预测历史记录，并探索条件场景和概率分布。保存并修改问题草稿，然后创建问题并使用您的 Mantic 帐户的问题创建配额请求一次性预测。预测访问可以在您的帐户设置下生成计费使用量。
plugins.productIntroEn: Mantic helps users explore probabilistic forecasts about geopolitics, business, policy, markets, technology, and culture. Search accessible questions and dashboards, inspect forecasts and their available reasoning, compare forecast history, and explore conditional scenarios and probability distributions.

plugins.name: Domus - Homeowners Ai
plugins.productIntro: Domus 是一个家庭中心，可以记住您忘记的事情。询问您的房屋情况，然后让 ChatGPT 采取行动：查找您的炉子采用的过滤器，检查哪些设备保修即将失效，记录您刚刚进行的维修，添加新设备及其型号、序列号和保修，或者打开检查报告等文档并进行审查。 Domus 保留您拥有的每件财产的动态记录 - 电器、文件、维护计划和空气过滤器 - 在网络、iOS 和 Android 上同步。该插件可以读取和更新您的 Domus 主页。
plugins.productIntroEn: Domus is a home hub that remembers what you forget. Ask about your home and let ChatGPT act on it: look up what filter your furnace takes, check which appliance warranties are about to lapse, log a repair you just did, add a new appliance with its model, serial, and warranty, or open a document like an inspection report and review it.

plugins.name: CodeWords
plugins.productIntro: CodeWords 允许您直接通过对话构建、部署和运行自动化工作流程和网站。描述您想要自动化或构建的内容，CodeWords 会处理剩下的事情 - 编写代码、连接您的服务、部署到云以及安排运行。构建部署到您自己的 URL 的全栈 Web 应用程序，或连接到 Slack、Gmail、Notion 以及数百种其他服务和集成的后端自动化。当出现问题时，请调出日志并直接从聊天中修复它。
plugins.productIntroEn: CodeWords lets you build, deploy, and run automation workflows and websites directly from conversation. Describe what you want to automate or build, and CodeWords handles the rest - writing the code, connecting your services, deploying to the cloud, and scheduling runs.

plugins.name: TracX Logis
plugins.description: 跟踪发货并在全球范围内预订
plugins.productIntro: 使用 TX Logis 轻松进行全球运输和跟踪
plugins.productIntroEn: Effortless Global Shipping and Tracking with TX Logis

plugins.name: Composio
plugins.productIntro: Composio 协调用户授权服务中的多步骤工作。它发现请求所需的工具，检索其输入要求，跨应用程序运行相关步骤，并将结果合并为一个响应。
plugins.productIntroEn: Composio coordinates multi-step work across the user's authorized services. It discovers the tools needed for a request, retrieves their input requirements, runs dependent steps across apps, and combines the results into one response.

plugins.name: Dayalogs
plugins.description: 人工智能调查实地工作控制。
plugins.productIntro: Dayalogs 为团队提供了调查创作工具、分发工作流程以及通过他们自己的人工智能进行的全面现场工作控制。它有助于创建、验证、预览和管理模式优先的在线调查，并通过范围内的 OAuth MCP 连接支持调查定义、翻译、受访者链接、链接集、嵌入、活动、受众、审核轮次、品牌、样式、响应和导出。
plugins.productIntroEn: Dayalogs gives teams survey authoring tools, distribution workflows and full fieldwork control from their own AI. It helps create, validate, preview, and manage schema-first online surveys, with support for survey definitions, translations, respondent links, LinkSets, embeds, campaigns, audiences, review rounds, branding, styles, responses and exports through a scoped OAuth MCP connectio…

plugins.name: SousAI
plugins.productIntro: SousAI 可让您将 ChatGPT 生成或找到的任何食谱直接保存到您的 SousAI 帐户中（包括成分、步骤、准备/烹饪时间和标签），以便在 SousAI 应用程序中显示即可使用，无需复制粘贴。
plugins.productIntroEn: SousAI lets you save any recipe ChatGPT generates or finds directly into your SousAI account — ingredients, steps, prep/cook time, and tags included — so it shows up ready to use in the SousAI app, no copy-pasting required.

plugins.name: tugesto
plugins.productIntro: tugesto 是发展公司管理的助手：在同一环境中进行薪资、人力资源、时间登记、员工门户、计费、会计、税务和法律合规。 ChatGPT 可以帮助您解决疑虑、了解流程并探索如何通过专为公司、自由职业者、代理机构和咨询公司设计的 SaaS 解决方案自动执行任务、减少错误并集中日常运营。
plugins.productIntroEn: tugesto es el asistente para evolucionar la gestión de tu empresa: nóminas, RRHH, registro horario, portal del empleado, facturación, contabilidad, fiscalidad y cumplimiento legal en un mismo entorno.

plugins.name: Hive
plugins.description: 通过 ChatGPT 管理工作
plugins.productIntro: Hive 帮助用户管理项目、操作、文件、消息、CRM 记录、活动、时间跟踪、仪表板和工作区自动化。它还可以使用配置的集成，例如 Salesforce、电子邮件、日历、QuickBooks、MCP 服务器和 HTTP 连接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Hive helps users manage projects, actions, files, messages, CRM records, campaigns, time tracking, dashboards, and workspace automation. It can also use configured integrations such as Salesforce, email, calendar, QuickBooks, MCP servers, and HTTP connections.

plugins.name: A Seat Awaits
plugins.productIntro: A Seat Awaits 可帮助授权用户通过 ChatGPT 管理活动座位。付费订阅者可以按层获得规划工具，包括活动创建、宾客搜索、表格创建、宾客分配、宾客列表导入、容量检查和活动运行状况审查。授权运营商和批准的合作伙伴可以在获得授权后检索汇总营销、收入、流量、注册、订阅、定价和合作伙伴支付指标。
plugins.productIntroEn: A Seat Awaits helps authorized users manage event seating through ChatGPT. Paid subscribers receive planner tools by tier, including event creation, guest search, table creation, guest assignment, guest-list import, capacity checks, and event health reviews.

plugins.name: eIgreja
plugins.productIntro: eIgreja 帮助领导者和成员使用仪表板：它根据培训和帮助手册解释工作区（礼拜、日程、活动、图书馆等）、屏幕、任务以及谁可以做什么。仅供查看——不修改教会数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: eIgreja helps leaders and members use the dashboard: it explains workspaces (Worship, Schedules, Events, Library, and others), screens, tasks, and who can do what, based on the Training and Help manual. View-only—does not modify church data.

plugins.name: DocHub
plugins.productIntro: ChatGPT 的 DocHub 可帮助您处理文档工作（从创建到签署请求），而无需切换工具。使用自然语言创建即用型 PDF 并对其进行优化。填写表单字段、准备和发送签名请求以及跟踪进度 — 所有这些都在一次对话中完成。
plugins.productIntroEn: DocHub for ChatGPT helps you handle document work — from creation to sign requests — without switching tools. Use natural language to create ready-to-use PDFs and refine them. Fill form fields, prepare and send sign requests, and track progress — all in one conversation.

plugins.name: FeedBoss
plugins.description: LinkedIn 帖子的起草和评分
plugins.productIntro: FeedBoss 将您的助手连接到您的 LinkedIn 内容工作区。它根据您自己的知识库，用您保存的声音起草帖子，在发布任何内容之前根据读者反应质量检查对草稿进行评分，保存您可以编辑的草稿，并安排批准的草稿在您每次确认的时间发布到 LinkedIn。它还报告分析、每周发帖一致性条纹，以及刷新的高绩效帖子墙以获取灵感。
plugins.productIntroEn: FeedBoss connects your assistant to your LinkedIn content workspace. It drafts posts in your saved voice grounded in your own knowledge base, scores a draft against a reader-reaction quality check before anything is published, saves drafts you can edit, and schedules approved drafts to publish to LinkedIn at a time you confirm each time.

plugins.name: FunkyTime
plugins.productIntro: FunkyTime 帮助用户检查项目和客户、跟踪工作时间和运行计时器、管理相关费用以及通过 ChatGPT 查看时间和账单摘要。
plugins.productIntroEn: FunkyTime helps users inspect projects and clients, track working time and running timers, manage related expenses, and review time and billing summaries through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: KaoJai.ai
plugins.productIntro: 真正了解您和您的业务的聊天机器人伴侣。 - 询问KaoJai.ai平台相关信息 - 通过聊天界面帮助企业管理admin.kaojai.ai平台中的设置和配置 - 查找在KaoJai平台注册的企业的可用性
plugins.productIntroEn: A chatbot companion who truly understand you and your business. - Ask information related to KaoJai.ai Platform - Help business manage setting and configuration in admin.kaojai.ai platform via chat interface - Find availability of the business who register in KaoJai platform

plugins.name: Hydrosight
plugins.productIntro: Hydrosight 将您的土壤传感器连接到 ChatGPT，这样您就可以检查实时和历史土壤湿度、温度和盐度数据，查看天气状况和预报，并使用简单的问题做出更好的灌溉决策。
plugins.productIntroEn: Hydrosight connects your soil sensors to ChatGPT, so you can check real-time and historical soil moisture, temperature and salinity data, review weather conditions and forecasts, and make better irrigation decisions using simple questions.

plugins.name: iLovePDF
plugins.productIntro: 直接在聊天中处理 PDF。上传文件以对其进行压缩、合并、分割或转换（PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint 或图像）。您还可以通过添加水印、使用页码组织文件以及使用 OCR 从扫描文档中提取文本来保护文件。 iLovePDF 专为日常文档任务而设计，可帮助您快速、安全地管理文件。
plugins.productIntroEn: Work with PDFs directly in chat. Upload a file to compress, merge, split, or convert it (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or images). You can also protect files by adding watermarks, organize them with page numbers, and extract text from scanned documents using OCR. Designed for everyday document tasks, iLovePDF helps you manage files quickly and securely.

plugins.name: Readplace
plugins.productIntro: Readplace 是一款稍后阅读的应用程序，您的助手可以直接使用它来保存搜索的原始来源。在对话中保存链接，它会出现在您在浏览器和手机上阅读的同一个队列中，并填充标题、摘录和清晰的阅读器视图。
plugins.productIntroEn: Readplace is a read-it-later app your assistant can work with directly to dave original sources of your searches. Save a link mid-conversation and it lands in the same queue you read from in the browser and on your phone, with the title, excerpt, and a clean reader view filled in.

plugins.name: QRStuff
plugins.productIntro: 生成、定制和分析动态和静态 QR 码。为 URL、vCard、Wi-Fi 网络等创建自定义样式的 QR 码，并立即跟踪扫描分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: Generate, customize, and analyze dynamic and static QR codes. Create custom-styled QR codes for URLs, vCards, Wi-Fi networks, and more, and track scan analytics instantly.

plugins.name: Jackpot
plugins.productIntro: Jackpot 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的品牌资产库，以便您可以搜索资产、浏览视觉图库、检查集合和执行、准备聊天安全预览、更新元数据、运行预览编辑，以及选择性地将资产附加到您已授权的连接目的地。
plugins.productIntroEn: Jackpot connects ChatGPT to your brand asset library so you can search assets, browse visual galleries, inspect collections and executions, prepare chat-safe previews, update metadata, run preview edits, and optionally attach assets to connected destinations you already authorized.

plugins.name: VesselTwin
plugins.productIntro: 连接 VesselTwin 向 ChatGPT 询问您已保存的船舶记录。 VesselTwin 新手？访问 Vesseltwin.io 创建免费帐户，然后选择“连接”并登录。基本访问权限显示批准的船只、维护、设备和文档元数据。 Owner Pro 客户可以单独选择让 ChatGPT 读取他们拥有的船只的私人记录，包括提取的文档文本。可选的第二个权限允许 ChatGPT 将建议的注释、清单、维护条目和测量结果发送到 VesselTwin 收件箱以供所有者审核。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect VesselTwin to ask ChatGPT about the boat records you already keep. New to VesselTwin? Visit vesseltwin.io to create a free account, then select Connect and sign in. Basic access shows approved boat, maintenance, equipment, and document metadata. Owner Pro customers can separately opt in to let ChatGPT read private records, including extracted document text, for boats they own.

plugins.name: Promptbanken
plugins.productIntro: Promptbanken 是一个开放的、精心策划的库，为市政当局、学校、公司、协会和个人提供即用型提示模板。在目录中搜索任务，完整获取所选模板，然后直接在 ChatGPT 中按照提示包一步步操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Promptbanken is an open, curated library of ready-to-use prompt templates for municipalities, schools, companies, associations, and individuals. Search the catalog for a task, fetch a chosen template in full, and follow a prompt package step by step — directly in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: AutoRFP.ai
plugins.productIntro: AutoRFP.ai 是一个准确性第一的 AI 平台，适用于 RFP、安全调查问卷和 DDQ。该插件将 ChatGPT 连接到您的实时 RFP、DDQ 或安全调查问卷项目以及基于源的内容库。
plugins.productIntroEn: AutoRFP.ai is an accuracy-first AI platform for RFPs, security questionnaires, and DDQs. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your live RFP, DDQ or security questionnaire projects and source-grounded content library.

plugins.name: Codex Replay
plugins.description: 在应用程序内或系统浏览器中运行独立重播。
plugins.originalDescription: Run independent replays in the in-app or system browser.
plugins.productIntro: 在可用的环回端口上启动独立的 Codex Replay 控制器。在 Codex Desktop 和 Codex CLI 中，首选可用的 Codex 应用内浏览器，否则使用系统浏览器。选择一个或多个历史 Claude 线程，选择共享 Codex 模型，并启动其独立实现。单独检测每个线程的历史状态和配置，并在需要时提供详细信息。单独或聚合查看已完成的比较，同时剩余线程继续。默认选择可用的 GPT-5.6 Sol、Terra 和 Luna 模型。
plugins.productIntroEn: Start an independent Codex Replay controller on an available loopback port. In both Codex Desktop and Codex CLI, prefer an available Codex in-app browser and otherwise use your system browser. Select one or more historical Claude threads, choose shared Codex models, and start their isolated implementations.

plugins.name: FamilyWise HQ
plugins.productIntro: FamilyWise HQ 是一款家庭组织者和膳食计划程序，可帮助您管理 ChatGPT 中的共享计划。计划每周膳食，保存食谱和配菜，管理杂货和购物清单，并组织您的 FamilyWise 日历、提醒、家务和日常事务。
plugins.productIntroEn: FamilyWise HQ is a family organizer and meal planner that helps you manage shared plans in ChatGPT. Plan weekly meals, save recipes and side dishes, manage grocery and shopping lists, and organize your FamilyWise calendar, reminders, chores and routines.

plugins.name: todo mate
plugins.productIntro: 使用 todo mate 管理您的待办事项列表。 - 检索特定日期范围内的任务 - 将任务标记为已完成 - 添加新任务 - 为任务设置基于时间的通知 - 获取类别列表
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage your to-do list with todo mate. - Retrieve tasks for a specific date range - Mark tasks as completed - Add new tasks - Set time-based notifications for tasks - Fetch category lists

plugins.name: CapMind
plugins.description: 搜索您的 Capmind 录音
plugins.productIntro: Capmind 将您的个人录音和会议情报连接到 ChatGPT。
plugins.productIntroEn: Capmind connects your personal recordings and meeting intelligence to ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Socra Cortex
plugins.productIntro: Socra Cortex 将您的特定知识和工作转化为可重用的基础设施，您的代理可以跨工具和时间阅读、思考和采取行动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Socra Cortex turns your specific knowledge and work into reusable infrastructure your agents read, think, and act on across tools and time.

plugins.name: Rezi Resume Builder
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 Rezi 帐户以列出和阅读简历、创建新简历、更新简历内容以及搜索职位列表。为特定职位量身定制简历，修改各个部分，或根据您的背景构建新简历。更改将直接保存到您的 Rezi 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Rezi account to list and read resumes, create new resumes, update resume content, and search job listings. Tailor a resume for a specific role, revise individual sections, or build a new resume from your background. Changes are saved directly to your Rezi account.

plugins.name: Slidely
plugins.productIntro: Slidely 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 创建、导入、审阅和编辑 PowerPoint 演示文稿。用户可以开始一个新的幻灯片或导入现有的 .pptx、选择设计系统、使用 Slidely 起草和渲染幻灯片、审查建议的幻灯片并将批准的幻灯片添加到演示文稿中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Slidely helps users create, import, review, and edit PowerPoint presentations from ChatGPT. Users can start a new deck or import an existing .pptx, choose a design system, have Slidely draft and render slides, review the proposed slides, and add the approved ones to their presentation.

plugins.name: Genesys
plugins.description: 您在 AI 应用程序中的记忆力
plugins.productIntro: Genesys 为您的 AI 提供因果记忆图 - 不是记忆事实的列表，而是一个活生生的网络，其中每个记忆都是一个节点，每个关系都是类型化的因果边，并且每次检索都可以解释。询问为什么某个记忆会出现，Genesys 会显示其相关性分数、因果连接性和重新激活历史记录。追踪记忆如何连接并遵循从决定到结果的完整因果链。
plugins.productIntroEn: Genesys gives your AI a causal memory graph — not a list of remembered facts, but a living network where every memory is a node, every relationship is a typed causal edge, and every retrieval can be explained. Ask why a memory surfaced and Genesys shows its relevance score, causal connectivity, and reactivation history.

plugins.name: Zentrik
plugins.productIntro: Zentrik 是产品操作系统和产品团队的第二大脑。在 ChatGPT 中，在授权工作区中搜索客户证据、追踪机会背后的证据、发现重复的问题并捕获新证据以供审查。
plugins.productIntroEn: Zentrik is the product operating system and second brain for product teams. In ChatGPT, search an authorized workspace for customer evidence, trace opportunities to the proof behind them, spot repeated problems, and capture new evidence for review.

plugins.name: Axiomyx Personal
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到您在 Axiomyx Personal 中选择和索引的文件中的证据。搜索你的证据，检索相关段落，并检查其来源。访问权限是只读的：该插件不会修改您的源文件或运行命令。 Axiomyx Personal 必须已安装、运行、在线并连接。您在桌面应用程序中批准连接。您的索引保留在您的计算机上；请求的证据通过经过身份验证的中继传输到您连接的人工智能服务。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to evidence from files you select and index in Axiomyx Personal. Search your evidence, retrieve relevant passages, and check their source provenance. Access is read-only: this plugin does not modify your source files or run commands. Axiomyx Personal must be installed, running, online, and connected. You approve the connection in the desktop app.

plugins.name: AIOProductOS
plugins.description: 一张记录上的产品工作
plugins.productIntro: AIOProductOS 将 ChatGPT 连接到一个产品工作区，其中收入、客户反馈、产品分析、交付工作和代码都挂在一个共享的客户记录上。用户阅读看板和产品大脑，捕获反馈作为见解并将其链接到功能，运行收入加权的 NPS、NRR、漏斗和保留分析，管理 OKR、冲刺和发布，处理支持收件箱，以及创建或更新任务 - 所有这些都针对他们自己经过身份验证的工作空间。
plugins.productIntroEn: AIOProductOS connects ChatGPT to a product workspace where revenue, customer feedback, product analytics, delivery work and code all hang off one shared customer record. Users read the board and the product brain, capture feedback as insights and link it to features, run revenue-weighted NPS, NRR, funnel and retention analysis, manage OKRs, sprints and releases, work the support inbox, a…

plugins.name: F-AI: Contract Review
plugins.productIntro: 审查所提供的合同是否存在潜在的内部冲突、歧义、缺失条款、商业或运营风险，并仔细考虑潜在的法律问题。只读界面将每个发现与相关合同语言连接起来，并让您选择要讨论的发现。该插件提供问题发现和一般信息，而不是接受、拒绝、签署或修改合同的法律建议或建议。其开发商不是律师事务所，使用时并不建立律师-客户关系。
plugins.productIntroEn: Reviews a supplied contract for potential internal conflicts, ambiguity, missing terms, commercial or operational risks, and carefully grounded potential legal issues. The read-only interface connects each finding to the relevant contract language and lets you choose which findings to discuss.

plugins.name: JobIQ Jobsuche
plugins.productIntro: JobIQ 职位搜索在瑞士 JobIQ 工作委员会上查找空缺职位。按关键字、职业组、地点和工作量进行搜索，查看职位、雇主和简短摘要，然后在 JobIQ 上打开原始列表。
plugins.productIntroEn: JobIQ Job Search finds open roles on the Swiss JobIQ job board. Search by keyword, occupation group, location, and workload, see title, employer, and a short summary, then open the original listing on JobIQ.

plugins.name: Centennial Arts Email
plugins.description: 搜索并阅读您的电子邮件
plugins.productIntro: 托管的只读电子邮件连接器，可列出帐户和文件夹、搜索消息、读取选定的消息文本、分析有限的电子邮件活动以及重建对话。它无法发送、起草、回复、转发、移动、删除、标记、标记邮件已读或下载附件。
plugins.productIntroEn: A managed, read-only email connector that lists accounts and folders, searches messages, reads selected message text, analyzes bounded email activity, and reconstructs conversations. It cannot send, draft, reply, forward, move, delete, flag, mark mail read, or download attachments.

plugins.name: Astro Jyotish
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 Hidden World 帐户以创建和管理 Jyotish 图表、查看 D-1 和 D-9 图表图像，并请求出生解释、预测、Prashna、Panchanga 和 Kraine AI 指导。由拥有 20 多年经验的专业占星师 Volodymyr Kraine 创建。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Hidden World account to create and manage Jyotish charts, view D-1 and D-9 chart images, and request natal interpretations, forecasts, Prashna, Panchanga, and Kraine AI guidance. Created by professional astrologer Volodymyr Kraine, with more than 20 years of experience.

plugins.name: Arkon Vault
plugins.description: 让 AI 工作持续进行
plugins.productIntro: 通过一个私有连续性层，让项目在 ChatGPT、Codex、Claude 和其他 AI 工具之间移动。 Arkon Vault 找到正确的项目环境，在工作开始前运行预检，记录决策并创建结构化交接，以便每个人工智能都可以从相同的愿景和下一步继续。使用它来搜索共享项目内存，防止并行分叉，检查点进度，并为下一个会话留下明确的收尾信息。工作空间是私密隔离的，连接使用范围内的 OAuth 访问，并且 Arkon Sync 可以选择捕获支持的本地会话。
plugins.productIntroEn: Keep projects moving across ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, and other AI tools with one private continuity layer. Arkon Vault finds the right project context, runs a preflight before work starts, records decisions, and creates structured handoffs so every AI can continue from the same vision and next step.

plugins.name: Simply-Useful
plugins.originalDescription: Manage your tasks and your day
plugins.productIntro: 从 ChatGPT 访问和管理您的 Simply-Useful 帐户。用简单的语言安排你的一天：审查你的议程和优先事项，赶上逾期的工作，看看其他人分配给你什么——所有这些都在一个请求中。根据您的想法创建和安排任务，将它们分组到项目中，添加清单和标签，并将约会直接发送到您的 Google 日历。您还可以将任务交给您的联系人并跟进评论；任何影响他人的事情都需要先得到您的确认。每项更改都会立即与简单有用的移动和网络应用程序同步。
plugins.productIntroEn: Access and manage your Simply-Useful account from ChatGPT. Organize your day in plain language: review your agenda and priorities, catch up on overdue work, and see what others have assigned to you — all in one ask. Create and schedule tasks as you think of them, group them into projects, add checklists and tags, and send appointments straight to your Google Calendar.

plugins.name: Savantis Memory
plugins.productIntro: Savantis Memory 为您的助手提供一份属于您的记忆。回忆对话中的偏好和决策，在用户批准的情况下添加新记忆，将它们组织到空间中，并管理优先于推断记忆的确认参考。矛盾仍然可见，而不是被默默地覆盖，并且每个项目都可以更正、导出或删除。
plugins.productIntroEn: Savantis Memory gives your assistants one memory that belongs to you. Recall preferences and decisions across conversations, add new memories with user approval, organize them into spaces, and manage confirmed references that take priority over inferred memories. Contradictions remain visible instead of being silently overwritten, and each item can be corrected, exported, or deleted.

plugins.name: ArtifactBridge
plugins.description: 搜索文档，提出更改建议
plugins.productIntro: ArtifactBridge 将 ChatGPT 连接到您团队的文档工作区。搜索和阅读存储的文档、创建托管文档、讨论更改并提交建议以供审核。受管文件的变更需要经过授权的人工审核；业主无需审核时可直接更新工作文件。您还可以组织文档、协调代理室中的工作以及通过共享链接发布版本。根据您的工作区配置，评论可能会镜像到 Google Docs 或 Notion，提案可能会通知 Slack，活动事件可能会传递到外部 Webhook。访问和审查权限仍然适用。
plugins.productIntroEn: ArtifactBridge connects ChatGPT to your team's document workspace. Search and read stored documents, create managed documents, discuss changes, and submit proposals for review. Governed document changes require an authorized human review; owners can update working documents directly when review is not required.

plugins.name: Klee
plugins.productIntro: Klee 转录您的会议并将其提供给 ChatGPT。搜索和查询您的成绩单（“我们在哪里讨论了预算？”）、检索文档、检查您的剩余时间、使用词汇和参与者组织项目、准备会议并安排 Teams 会议。敏感行为总是需要您的确认。需要一个 Klee 帐户（在 klee-app.com 上免费试用 5 小时）。应用程序和成绩单是法语优先 - 专为法语会议而构建。
plugins.productIntroEn: Klee transcribes your meetings and makes them available to ChatGPT. Search and query your transcripts ("where did we discuss the budget?"), retrieve documents, check your remaining hours, organize projects with their vocabulary and participants, prepare sessions and schedule Teams meetings. Sensitive actions always ask for your confirmation.

plugins.name: Kumbukum
plugins.productIntro: Kumbukum 允许 ChatGPT 访问用户经过身份验证的私有内存工作区。用户可以搜索和检索笔记、记忆和项目元数据，然后根据请求创建新的私人笔记和记忆。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kumbukum gives ChatGPT access to a user's authenticated private memory workspace. Users can search and retrieve notes, memories, and project metadata, then create new private notes and memories when requested.

plugins.name: Jicoo
plugins.productIntro: Jicoo 帮助授权团队成员通过 ChatGPT 检查预订、日程安排、活动类型、路由表单、主持人分配规则、组织用户、会议工件和 Webhook 端点设置。当用户明确要求进行更改时，它还支持创建或更新预订、日程、事件类型、路由表单、主机分配和 Webhook 配置记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: Jicoo helps authorized team members inspect bookings, schedules, event types, routing forms, host assignment rules, organization users, meeting artifacts, and webhook endpoint settings through ChatGPT. It also supports creating or updating booking, schedule, event type, routing form, host assignment, and webhook configuration records when the user explicitly asks to make those changes.

plugins.name: UserTold
