plugins.productIntro: UserTold 在产品内部进行经同意的访谈，并让 ChatGPT 检查源链接证据、设计和管理研究、将发现转化为经过审查的工作，并明确将准备好的工作提交到 GitHub 或 Linear。
plugins.productIntroEn: UserTold runs consented interviews inside a product and lets ChatGPT inspect source-linked Evidence, design and manage Studies, turn findings into reviewed Work, and explicitly hand ready Work to GitHub or Linear.

plugins.name: Convy
plugins.productIntro: Convy 帮助家庭直接从 ChatGPT 管理共享购物清单和任务。用户可以检查家庭环境、查看购物和任务列表、根据请求打开紧凑的可视面板、添加多个购物项目、创建任务以及将现有项目或任务标记为已完成或待处理。所有写入操作仅限于用户的私人 Convy 家庭数据并需要确认。
plugins.productIntroEn: Convy helps households manage shared shopping lists and tasks directly from ChatGPT. Users can inspect household context, view shopping and task lists, open compact visual panels on request, add multiple shopping items, create tasks, and mark existing items or tasks as completed or pending. All write actions are limited to the user's private Convy household data and require confirmation.

plugins.name: NexoRush
plugins.productIntro: 根据您的项目所需的技能和专业知识发现自由职业者。 NexoRush 帮助您找到相关的公开资料、探索专业技能并确定适合您的项目的专业知识。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover freelance professionals based on the skills and expertise your project needs. NexoRush helps you find relevant public profiles, explore professional skills, and identify the right expertise for your project.

plugins.name: Reflect
plugins.description: 从您的人力资源数据中获取答案
plugins.originalDescription: Get answers from your HR data
plugins.productIntro: Reflect 就在 ChatGPT 内将您的人力资源和劳动力数据转化为答案。用简单的语言提问，Reflect 直接查询您的人员分析：员工人数、营业额、招聘、薪酬等，无需导出或电子表格。它还显示法律和合规报告背后的数据（BDESE、Egapro 指数、欧盟薪酬透明度）。它探索您可以查看的数据目录，运行结构化分析查询，并在需要时处理高级 SQL。只读且安全的设计：每个请求都会尊重您现有的 Reflect 权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: Reflect turns your HR and workforce data into answers, right inside ChatGPT. Ask in plain language and Reflect queries your people analytics directly: headcount, turnover, recruitment, compensation and more, with no export or spreadsheet. It also surfaces the figures behind your legal and compliance reports (BDESE, Egapro index, EU pay transparency).

plugins.name: Joinways
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 管理查询、建立报价、检查空间可用性并生成活动场地的宴会活动订单 (BEO)。无需离开对话，即可确定新潜在客户的资格、起草婚礼或公司活动的报价、更新预订状态、发送后续电子邮件或对已确认的收入进行分析。中威帮助活动场地团队处理从首次查询到确认预订的所有事务。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage inquiries, build quotes, check space availability, and generate banquet event orders (BEOs) for event venues directly from ChatGPT. Qualify a new lead, draft a quote for a wedding or corporate event, update a booking's status, send a follow-up email, or pull analytics on confirmed revenue — without leaving the conversation.

plugins.name: DealKeep
plugins.productIntro: DealKeep 是购买终身软件优惠的用户的跟踪器。连接它并用简单的语言询问您已经拥有的堆栈：“我有什么可用于电子邮件营销？”，“在购买之前我是否已经拥有类似的东西？”，“哪些退款窗口即将关闭？”或“我的工具创始人是否会保持沉默？”五个只读工具涵盖了它——搜索您的工具，检查购买的重复项，提取一个许可证的完整详细信息，列出您的交易，并显示创始人风险信号。
plugins.productIntroEn: DealKeep is the tracker for people who buy lifetime software deals. Connect it and ask, in plain language, about the stack you already own: "What do I have for email marketing?", "Do I already own something like this before I buy it?", "Which refund windows are about to close?", or "Are any of my tools' founders going quiet?" Five read-only tools cover it — search your tools, check a pur…

plugins.name: RealtyAds
plugins.productIntro: RealtyAds MCP 连接允许您全面管理所有 RealtyAds 属性。 RealtyAds 门户中提供的所有功能现在都可以直接在 ChatGPT 中使用。您可以创建和编辑广告、保存广告以供以后使用、查看效果和拉取报告，以及询问产品和支持问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: The RealtyAds MCP connection allows you fully manage all your RealtyAds properties. All functionality available in the RealtyAds portal is now available directly in ChatGPT. You can create and edit ads, save ads for later use, view performance and pull reports, and ask product and support questions.

plugins.name: Ellie
plugins.productIntro: Ellie 帮助用户在其私人 Ellie Planner 帐户中查看、搜索、创建、更新、完成和删除任务，并使用列表和标签组织这些任务。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ellie helps users review, search, create, update, complete, and delete tasks in their private Ellie Planner account, and organize those tasks with lists and labels.

plugins.name: Task Tool
plugins.productIntro: 验证任务工具可用性或创建、获取、列出和更新托管任务及其私有 Markdown 计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: Verify Task Tool availability or create, get, list, and update managed tasks and their private Markdown plans.

plugins.name: Plugin Creator
plugins.productIntro: 将您的想法、说明和日常任务转化为插件。描述您希望插件做什么，Plugin Creator 会帮助您构建它。通过完善其说明、添加技能或更改其工作方式来改进现有插件。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn your ideas, instructions, and everyday tasks into plugins. Describe what you want your plugin to do, and Plugin Creator helps you build it. Improve an existing plugin by refining its instructions, adding skills, or changing how it works.

plugins.name: Gumnut Photos
plugins.productIntro: Gumnut Photos 帮助用户搜索和浏览他们的私人照片库、检查图像内容、将资产组织到相册和人物中、更新元数据以及通过 ChatGPT 安全地管理上传和垃圾。
plugins.productIntroEn: Gumnut Photos helps users search and browse their private photo libraries, inspect image contents, organize assets into albums and people, update metadata, and safely manage uploads and trash through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: OSuite.ai
plugins.description: 审查有风险的人工智能行为
plugins.productIntro: OSuite.ai 帮助团队在重要的人工智能操作发生之前对其进行审查。它可以将有风险的工作转入批准，检查操作是否已获准继续，总结运行时风险，并保留审核、批准和完成内容的审计记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: OSuite.ai helps teams review important AI actions before they happen. It can route risky work into approval, check whether an action is cleared to continue, summarize runtime exposure, and keep an audit-ready record of what was reviewed, approved, and completed.

plugins.name: Figr
plugins.productIntro: Figr 是一款面向产品团队的人工智能设计工具。它创建 UI、存储您的设计系统并跟踪您的产品决策背后的推理。该 MCP 让 ChatGPT 读取您的 Figr 项目。打开任何设计，提取工件代码，搜索您的用户体验库，并在任何对话中使用您的产品上下文。
plugins.productIntroEn: Figr is an AI design tool for product teams. It creates UI, stores your design system, and tracks the reasoning behind your product decisions. This MCP lets ChatGPT read your Figr projects. Open any design, extract artifact code, search your UX library, and use your product context in any conversation.

plugins.name: Fixture and Finish
plugins.productIntro: Fixture and Finish 是一个为定制住宅建筑商、室内设计师和设计建造公司打造的选择和采购平台。该插件将您的项目数据导入 ChatGPT，以便您可以在任何地方（办公室、工作现场或手机）以简单语言提出问题。 要求 ChatGPT ：
plugins.productIntroEn: Fixture and Finish is a selections and procurement platform built for custom home builders, interior designers, and design-build firms. This plugin brings your project data into ChatGPT so you can ask questions in plain language from anywhere — the office, the job site, or your phone. Ask ChatGPT to:

plugins.name: Curaiz Remote Jobs
plugins.productIntro: 寻找与您的经验、目标和符合条件的地点相匹配的新远程工作。描述您想要的工作以及您可以在哪里合法工作； Curaiz 搜索当前的远程职位，并返回最强的候选人，包括职位、公司、申请人地点、薪资（如注明）以及直接列表链接。要求提供完整的详细信息以查看要求、公司背景和应用程序 URL。 Curaiz 是只读的，绝不会代表您应用、发送消息或更改数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find fresh remote jobs matched to your experience, goals, and eligible locations. Describe the work you want and where you can legally work; Curaiz searches current remote postings and returns the strongest candidates with role, company, applicant locations, salary when stated, and a direct listing link.

plugins.name: Textxt
plugins.description: 搜索您的 Texttxt 聊天记录
plugins.productIntro: Textxt 允许用户将其 Textxt 帐户连接到 ChatGPT，以便他们可以在对话中搜索、总结和检索自己可读的 Textxt 聊天内容。连接器是只读的：它可以列出最近的聊天、搜索消息、获取搜索结果的上下文以及从选定的聊天/主题中读取最近的消息。它不发送、编辑、删除或发布消息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Textxt lets users connect their Textxt account to ChatGPT so they can search, summarize, and retrieve their own readable Textxt chats in conversation. The connector is read-only: it can list recent chats, search messages, fetch context for a search result, and read recent messages from a selected chat/topic. It does not send, edit, delete, or publish messages.

plugins.name: Meetly
plugins.description: 将会议转化为有用的工作
plugins.productIntro: Edge First AI 的 Meetly 让用户可以找到他们明确同步的会议并检索标记演讲者的证据。然后，打包的技能可以帮助主机利用其本机功能进行总结、研究、绘制、教学、计划和创建产品文档。
plugins.productIntroEn: Meetly by Edge First AI lets users find meetings they explicitly sync and retrieve speaker-tagged evidence. Packaged skills then help the host summarize, research, map, teach, plan, and create product documents with its native capabilities.

plugins.name: Support Ticket Validator
plugins.productIntro: 支持票证验证程序在人工处理或移交之前检查支持票证数据是否包含必填字段。它返回包含已检查字段、当前字段、缺失字段和验证错误的结构化完整性结果，帮助支持团队识别不完整的票证信息，而无需修改外部系统。
plugins.productIntroEn: Support Ticket Validator checks whether support ticket data contains the required fields before human processing or handoff. It returns a structured completeness result with checked fields, present fields, missing fields, and validation errors, helping support teams identify incomplete ticket information without modifying external systems.

plugins.name: timr
plugins.productIntro: timr 帮助用户检查当前活动和余额、查看时间和里程记录、启动或停止计时器、添加或更新条目以及通过 ChatGPT 管理多天休假。
plugins.productIntroEn: timr helps users inspect current activity and balances, review time and mileage records, start or stop timers, add or update entries, and manage multi-day leave through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Cleverfy
plugins.productIntro: Cleverfy 为 ChatGPT 带来了时间控制：签入和签出、检查您当前的状态、查看您的时间、请求缺勤以及通过自然说话纠正遗忘。对于团队来说，它可以通过指导操作、角色权限和清晰的体验来帮助监控状态、审批和签到，以保持工作日正常进行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Cleverfy lleva el control horario a ChatGPT: ficha entrada y salida, consulta tu estado actual, revisa tus horas, solicita ausencias y corrige olvidos hablando de forma natural. Para equipos, ayuda a supervisar presencia, aprobaciones y registros con acciones guiadas, permisos por rol y una experiencia clara para mantener la jornada laboral al día.

plugins.name: Tenzo AI MCP
plugins.description: 询问有关 Tenzo 数据的问题
plugins.productIntro: 向你的招聘数据询问任何事情。 Tenzo AI MCP 服务器将您的 AI 助手连接到您的招聘渠道，因此您无需点击屏幕，只需询问：谁申请了该职位、每个候选人的立场、他们在 AI 筛选电话中的表现以及本周发生了什么变化。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ask your recruiting data anything. The Tenzo AI MCP server connects your AI assistant to your hiring pipeline, so instead of clicking through screens you can just ask: who applied for this role, where each candidate stands, how they did on their AI screening call, and what's changed this week.

plugins.name: Synaply
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到您组织的权限感知知识。 Synaply 搜索互联的电子邮件、聊天、文件、代码、日历、CRM 记录、见解和人员；阅读经过验证的源文件；追踪决策和结果；并让用户分享持久的见解以促进整个组织的学习。结果仅限于经过身份验证的用户的工作区权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to your organization's permission-aware knowledge. Synaply searches across connected email, chat, files, code, calendars, CRM records, insights, and people; reads verified source documents; traces decisions and outcomes; and lets users share durable insights for org-wide learning. Results are limited to the authenticated user's workspace permissions.

plugins.name: Signeasy
plugins.productIntro: Signeasy 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查看帐户活动、查找文档和合同、检查签名状态、发送提醒以及准备或发送签名请求。
plugins.productIntroEn: Signeasy helps users review account activity, find documents and contracts, inspect signature status, send reminders, and prepare or send signature requests through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: xpost
plugins.productIntro: 将对话变成发布的社交帖子。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn a conversation into published social posts.

plugins.name: Sive.Host Domain Finder
plugins.productIntro: Sive.Host Domain Finder 可帮助您检查域名是否可用、比较域名价格、发现替代名称以及查看托管计划。它使搜索变得简单，并在您准备好继续使用 Sive.Host 时显示清晰的后续步骤。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sive.Host Domain Finder helps you check whether a domain is available, compare domain prices, discover alternative names, and view hosting plans. It keeps the search simple and shows clear next steps when you are ready to continue on Sive.Host.

plugins.name: Wazu
plugins.description: 搜索并保存 Wazu 内存
plugins.productIntro: Wazu 将 ChatGPT 连接到用户授权的个人和群组内存。它可以检查活动的 Wazu 范围，列出允许的群组，检索最近或主题匹配的证据，水合完整的项目和文档段落，通过 Hive Map 探索相关证据，检索有界媒体引用，并将用户授权的摘要、文本或媒体保存到显式群组中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Wazu connects ChatGPT to the user's authorized personal and cohort memory. It can inspect the active Wazu scope, list permitted cohorts, retrieve recent or topic-matched evidence, hydrate complete items and document passages, explore related evidence through Hive Map, retrieve bounded media references, and save user-authorized summaries, text, or media into an explicit cohort.

plugins.name: Ideaflow
plugins.productIntro: Ideaflow 帮助用户确认其登录帐户，打开其笔记应用程序 URL，并通过 ChatGPT 搜索、过滤、阅读、列出主题标签、链接、创建、编辑、组织、发布、删除和恢复个人笔记和文件夹。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ideaflow helps users confirm their signed-in account, open their notes app URL, and search, filter, read, list hashtags, link, create, edit, organize, publish, delete, and restore personal notes and folders through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Private PDF Tools
plugins.description: 私密处理 PDF 文件
plugins.productIntro: 使用隐私优先的工作流程合并、压缩、转换和重命名 PDF 和图像。
plugins.productIntroEn: Merge, compress, convert, and rename PDFs and images with a privacy-first workflow.

plugins.name: Qflow
plugins.productIntro: Qflow 是一个活动管理平台，可让您创建活动、管理宾客列表、跟踪签到并实时监控出席情况。 Qflow 在全球大型活动中处理了超过 6000 万条与会者记录，可以处理从宾客注册和批量导入到团队分配和现场活动统计的所有事务。按姓名、电子邮件或条形码搜索客人，按标签或门票类型过滤，并获取实时出勤明细——所有这一切都通过自然对话进行。需要 Qflow 帐户才能连接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Qflow is an event management platform that lets you create events, manage guest lists, track check-ins, and monitor attendance in real time. With over 60 million attendee records processed across large-scale events worldwide, Qflow handles everything from guest registration and bulk imports to team assignments and live event statistics.

plugins.name: Letsfind
plugins.description: 创建民意调查并查找日期
plugins.productIntro: Letsfind 根据聊天中的描述创建群组投票。说出您想要提议的日期，或者人们应该选择哪些选项，您就会收到一个可供分享的链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Letsfind creates group polls from a description in the chat. Say which dates you want to propose, or which options people should choose between, and you get back a link to share.

plugins.name: bryny
plugins.description: 跟踪您的 bryny 操作
plugins.productIntro: bryny MCP 服务器将您的 AI 助手连接到突尼斯 bryny 履行和物流平台上您自己的运营数据。将实体商品存储在布里尼仓库的商家可以用简单的语言询问他们的订单进展情况、哪些产品缺货、包裹在哪里以及他们的履行活动进展如何，而无需打开仪表板。
plugins.productIntroEn: bryny MCP Server connects your AI assistant to your own operational data on the bryny fulfilment and logistics platform in Tunisia. Merchants who store their physical goods in bryny warehouses can ask, in plain language, how their orders are progressing, which products are running out of stock, where a parcel is, and how their fulfilment activity is doing — without opening a dashboard.

plugins.name: NewsTune Studio
plugins.productIntro: NewsTune Studio 帮助 ChatGPT 和 Codex 检查现有系列、制作私人剧集、等待完成、返回直接剧集链接、比较授权声音、开放安全声音选择或同意克隆交接、发布批准的公共页面和 RSS 源，并准备用户完成的分发到播客平台。
plugins.productIntroEn: NewsTune Studio helps ChatGPT and Codex inspect existing series, produce private episodes, wait for completion, return direct episode links, compare authorized voices, open secure voice-selection or consented-cloning handoffs, publish approved public pages and RSS feeds, and prepare user-completed distribution to podcast platforms.

plugins.name: Elodus
plugins.productIntro: Elodus 帮助团队组织软件开发工作区、阅读和编写结构化文档、管理工作订单和数据模型、探索研究和资助来源，以及通过 ChatGPT 维护连接的项目工件。
plugins.productIntroEn: Elodus helps teams organize software-development workspaces, read and author structured documents, manage work orders and data models, explore research and grant sources, and maintain connected project artifacts through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Jaggle
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Jaggles 以搜索、审查、组织和安全更新经过权限过滤的工作区工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to Jaggle to search, review, organize, and safely update permission-filtered workspace work.

plugins.name: Instrumentl
plugins.productIntro: 非营利组织的工具集成。让 Instrumentl 成为您的 AI 工作流程的原生部分 - 一个智能合作伙伴，可帮助您直接在 ChatGPT 中更快地查找、赢得和管理资助。
plugins.productIntroEn: Instrumentl integration for nonprofits. Make Instrumentl a native part of your AI workflow – an intelligent partner that helps you find, win, and manage grants faster, directly in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Acceptance Criteria Extractor
plugins.productIntro: 从需求、用户故事、规范和测试说明中提取明确书面的验收标准。它返回结构化结果，而不会生成缺失的标准、评估需求或执行外部操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Extracts explicitly written acceptance criteria from requirements, user stories, specifications, and testing notes. It returns structured results without generating missing criteria, evaluating requirements, or performing external actions.

plugins.name: Whalesync
plugins.description: 应用程序之间的双向同步
plugins.productIntro: Whalesync 可在您的团队已使用的工具（Airtable、Webflow、HubSpot、Salesforce、Notion、Postgres 等）之间保持数据同步，双向同步在每个应用程序中都具有原生的感觉。
plugins.productIntroEn: Whalesync keeps data in sync between the tools your team already uses — Airtable, Webflow, HubSpot, Salesforce, Notion, Postgres, and more — with two-way sync that feels native in every app.

plugins.name: Skylar
plugins.productIntro: Skylar 帮助授权制作团队寻找人员、模特、设计师、演出和活动；检查准备情况、票务、入场和文件；并通过预览、收据和撤消进行受管控的内部更改。
plugins.productIntroEn: Skylar helps authorized production teams find people, models, designers, shows, and events; inspect readiness, ticketing, admission, and documents; and make governed internal changes with previews, receipts, and undo.

plugins.name: Tako
plugins.productIntro: Tako 帮助用户从专有数据集和实时网络中以引用支持的图表形式查找当前数据和指标，检索底层结果内容，检查可用数据覆盖范围，并从用户提供的结构化数据创建可共享的公共图表链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tako helps users find current data and metrics from proprietary datasets and the live web as citation-backed charts, retrieve the underlying result content, check available data coverage, and create shareable public chart links from user-provided structured data.

plugins.name: Axis
plugins.description: 让你的日常生活系统化
plugins.productIntro: 安讯士帮助人们跟踪和管理财务、关系、知识、习惯和焦点。其工具仅在 OAuth 同意后读取私人帐户数据并创建、更新或删除记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: Axis helps people track and manage finances, relationships, knowledge, habits, and focus. Its tools read private account data and create, update, or delete records only after OAuth consent.

plugins.name: NextClip
plugins.productIntro: NextClip 可帮助您将任何 YouTube 视频转换为短片。粘贴链接，选择您的设置 - 剪辑长度、宽高比、帧布局和时刻焦点 - 人工智能会找到最佳时刻并自动添加标题和挂钩文本。您可以获得带有标题、描述和病毒式传播得分的剪辑。您可以导出为 MP4，并从对话中直接将剪辑发布或安排到 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube Shorts、LinkedIn 和 Facebook。
plugins.productIntroEn: NextClip helps you turn any YouTube video into short-form clips. Paste a link, choose your settings — clip length, aspect ratio, frame layout, and moment focus — and the AI finds the best moments and adds captions and hook text automatically. You get clips with title, description, and virality scores.

plugins.name: Oracle Analytics
plugins.description: 探索仪表板、构建分析并使用报告
plugins.originalDescription: Explore dashboards, build analyses, and work with reports
plugins.productIntro: 在组织的 Oracle BI 工作区中将问题转化为答案。需要通过本地浏览器访问 ChatGPT Desktop 或桌面 Codex；不适用于 Web、移动或云支持的任务。探索仪表板、深入了解变化、比较期间并导出报告。创建或编辑分析和仪表板，并根据要求安排报告。通过浏览器使用登录帐户可用的 Oracle BI 企业版、Oracle Analytics 和 BI Publisher 功能。需要您组织的 BI URL 和访问权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn questions into answers in your organization's Oracle BI workspace. Requires local browser access in ChatGPT Desktop or desktop Codex; not available on web, mobile, or cloud-backed tasks. Explore dashboards, drill into changes, compare periods, and export reports. Create or edit analyses and dashboards, and schedule reports when requested.

plugins.name: Pocket Bartender
plugins.description: 鸡尾酒配方和调酒应用程序
plugins.productIntro: Pocket Bartender 是一个参考库，包含 700 多种饮品配方——鸡尾酒、烈酒、潘趣酒、咖啡、冰沙和 86 种非酒精饮料，其中包括 113 种官方 IBA 经典饮品。
plugins.productIntroEn: Pocket Bartender is a reference library of 700+ drink recipes — cocktails, shots, punches, coffees, smoothies and 86 non-alcoholic options, including 113 official IBA classics.

plugins.name: SuperPrompter
plugins.productIntro: SuperPrompter 允许巴士、目光、保护和实际提示以及 ChatGPT 的私人用户，以及 Studio 中的收藏夹和地毯。
plugins.productIntroEn: SuperPrompter permite buscar, leer, guardar y actualizar prompts y guiones privados desde ChatGPT, con favoritos y carpetas de un nivel para cuentas Studio.

plugins.name: FORTVISION
plugins.description: 管理营销活动和潜在客户
plugins.productIntro: FORTVISION 将营销活动带入一个工作空间。规划和管理营销活动，跟踪线索和对话，协调外展和自动化，并保持跨渠道的关键营销工作井井有条。
plugins.productIntroEn: FORTVISION brings marketing activity into one workspace. Plan and manage campaigns, track leads and conversations, coordinate outreach and automations, and keep key marketing work organized across channels.

plugins.name: Jibble
plugins.productIntro: 根据独立用户评论，Jibble 是评价最高的时间跟踪和考勤软件。通过无限用户的永久免费时间跟踪，团队可以跟踪时间、出勤、项目、休假等。
plugins.productIntroEn: Jibble is the highest-rated time tracking and attendance software according to independent user reviews. With free-forever time tracking for unlimited users, teams can track hours, attendance, projects, time off, and more.

plugins.name: My AskAI
plugins.description: 搜索我的 AskAI 帮助
plugins.productIntro: 查找“我的 AskAI”产品、设置、集成、API、功能、定价和故障排除信息。搜索公共知识库，阅读完整的文档和 OpenAPI 文件，并根据每月支持票量估算定价。所有工具都是公共且只读的。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find My AskAI product, setup, integration, API, feature, pricing, and troubleshooting information. Search the public knowledge base, read complete documentation and OpenAPI files, and estimate pricing from monthly support-ticket volume. All tools are public and read-only.

plugins.name: Softr
plugins.description: 构建业务应用程序和工具
plugins.productIntro: Softr 是一款人工智能应用程序构建器，可将您的数据转化为应用程序、门户和自动化。此连接器使 ChatGPT 可以直接访问您的 Softr 工作区，因此您可以在一次对话中将想法转变为可运行的、已发布的应用程序。
plugins.productIntroEn: Softr is an AI app builder that turns your data into apps, portals, and automations. This connector gives ChatGPT direct access to your Softr workspace, so you can go from an idea to a working, published app in a single conversation.

plugins.name: Esment
plugins.productIntro: Esment 为 ChatGPT 提供了关于事实、偏好、决策和项目背景的持久、可检查的内存。它可以调用相关上下文，保存持久信息，更新或忘记内存，以及读取属于经过身份验证的用户的组织页面（本地创建，尚未在云中可用）和内存块。
plugins.productIntroEn: Esment gives ChatGPT persistent, inspectable memory for facts, preferences, decisions, and project context. It can recall relevant context, save durable information, update or forget memories, and read organized pages (created locally, not yet available in the cloud) and memory blocks belonging to the authenticated user.

plugins.name: TEAM 30 — AI Company OS
plugins.description: 规划 31 个 AI 角色的工作
plugins.productIntro: TEAM 30 将目标分配给正确的专家角色，将项目转变为范围锁定的计划，并确定需要明确批准的行动。第一个公共版本是只读的：它不会发送消息、花钱、删除数据、发布内容或连接私人帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: TEAM 30 routes a goal to the right specialist role, turns projects into scope-locked plans, and identifies actions that need explicit approval. The first public version is read-only: it does not send messages, spend money, delete data, publish content, or connect private accounts.

plugins.name: NoClick
plugins.description: 构建并运行 AI 工作流程
plugins.productIntro: 构建、测试和部署自动化工作流程。 NoClick 让自动化变得触手可及 - 连接您最喜欢的工具，添加逻辑和 AI 步骤，让您的工作流程节省您的时间。
plugins.productIntroEn: Build, test, and deploy automated workflows. NoClick makes automation accessible — connect your favorite tools, add logic and AI steps, and let your workflows save your time.

plugins.name: Navan
plugins.description: 计划旅行并管理请求的预订
plugins.originalDescription: Plan travel and manage requested bookings
plugins.productIntro: 通过浏览器中的 Navan 计划商务旅行、比较选项、管理请求的预订以及查看费用。需要通过本地浏览器访问 ChatGPT Desktop 或桌面 Codex；不适用于 Web、移动或云支持的任务。由 OpenAI 构建和维护。使用组织的 Web 界面和登录帐户的现有权限；浏览器可用性、产品版本和角色决定了支持的操作。不包括 API 或 MCP 连接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Plan business travel, compare options, manage requested bookings, and review expenses through Navan in your browser. Requires local browser access in ChatGPT Desktop or desktop Codex; not available on web, mobile, or cloud-backed tasks. Built and maintained by OpenAI.

plugins.name: CherryDrop
plugins.productIntro: CherryDrop 是您的个人收件箱，其中包含您在使用 AI 时发现的所有内容。直接从对话中将注释、链接、代码片段和文件保存到您的私人 CherryDrop 帐户中，然后随时从网络应用程序或其他 AI 代理中搜索并重新访问它们。
plugins.productIntroEn: CherryDrop is your personal inbox for everything you find while working with AI. Save notes, links, code snippets, and files into your private CherryDrop account straight from the conversation, then search and revisit them any time from the web app or from another AI agent.

plugins.name: Vertical Bar Agent
plugins.productIntro: Vertical Bar Agent 帮助授权团队检查 CrossCheck 快照和流程挖掘数据、分析依赖关系和遥测、构建基础简报、管理测试套件和发布包，并通过 ChatGPT 运行受管理的 NetSuite 工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Vertical Bar Agent helps authorized teams inspect CrossCheck snapshots and process-mining data, analyze dependencies and telemetry, build grounded Briefings, manage test suites and release packages, and run governed NetSuite workflows through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Jessie Script Director
plugins.productIntro: Jessie Script Director：指导性产品视频脚本。
plugins.productIntroEn: A public-submission package for the Jessie Approved Script Director workflow. It guides one creative decision at a time, protects product facts and claims, reviews scripts, and plans Simplified Chinese JiMeng 出镜 prompts while preserving English spoken dialogue
plugins.developerName: BEAUTY RECIPE AESTHETICS HOUSE PTE. LTD.

plugins.name: Butiksoft
plugins.description: 在 ChatGPT 中管理您的酒店
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Butiksoft 酒店管理系统以管理日常酒店运营。检查预订和空房情况、查看客人和房间信息、管理预订、访问运营数据以及直接通过 ChatGPT 执行支持的酒店管理任务。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your Butiksoft hotel management system to manage day-to-day hotel operations. Check reservations and availability, review guest and room information, manage reservations, access operational data, and perform supported hotel management tasks directly through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: B2 Portal
plugins.productIntro: B2 Portal 将客户电子邮件、笔记、文字记录和附件转换为可供审核的 CoreBridge V2 RFQ。搜索授权客户和 QuickProducts、解决草案决定、应用明确的定制定价，并仅在提交最终摘要并获得明确的运营商批准后将当前的确切询价推送至 CoreBridge。推送成功后，打开返回的CoreBridge预估和准确的B2 Portal审核页面。
plugins.productIntroEn: B2 Portal turns customer emails, notes, transcripts, and attachments into review-ready CoreBridge V2 RFQs. Search authorized customers and QuickProducts, resolve draft decisions, apply explicit custom-line pricing, and push the exact current RFQ to CoreBridge only after presenting the final summary and receiving explicit operator approval.

plugins.name: Adagio
plugins.productIntro: 使用您的 Adagio 帐户通过精确的操作规范和兼容性检查来检查、创建、验证和安全更新科学管道。管道执行和本地文件访问仍保留在 Adagio Desktop 中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use your Adagio account to inspect, create, validate, and safely update scientific pipelines with exact action specifications and compatibility checks. Pipeline execution and local file access remain in Adagio Desktop.

plugins.name: Kong
plugins.productIntro: 随心所欲地与以前的会议录音聊天。
plugins.productIntroEn: Chat with recordings of your previous meetings to your heart's content.

plugins.name: Giraffe
plugins.description: 保持你的人工智能项目清晰
plugins.productIntro: Giraffe 让您的 AI 项目在 ChatGPT 和其他兼容的 AI 助手中保持清晰和最新。从您使用的任何人工智能工具中保存和检索项目背景、决策、事实、注释、开放式问题和文档。
plugins.productIntroEn: Giraffe keeps your AI projects clear and current across ChatGPT and other compatible AI assistants. Save and retrieve project context, decisions, facts, notes, open questions, and documents from whichever AI tool you are using.

plugins.name: Transcriptor
plugins.description: 视频文字记录和元数据
plugins.productIntro: Transcriptor 让 ChatGPT 可以像处理文本一样处理视频。粘贴来自 YouTube、Twitter/X、Instagram、TikTok、Twitch、Vimeo、Facebook、Bilibili、VK、Dailymotion 或 Reddit 的链接，并要求提供摘要、带有时间戳的引用、章节列表、出版商和观看次数或给定时间码的静止帧。
plugins.productIntroEn: Transcriptor lets ChatGPT work with video the way it works with text. Paste a link from YouTube, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Vimeo, Facebook, Bilibili, VK, Dailymotion or Reddit and ask for a summary, a quote with its timestamp, the chapter list, the publisher and view counts, or the still frame at a given timecode.

plugins.name: PiggyTask
plugins.productIntro: PiggyTask 通过硬币和奖励帮助父母安排孩子的家务。使用 OAuth 连接一次，然后要求 ChatGPT 列出子项、创建强制性或奖励任务、分配池任务或标记已完成的家务。访问权限仅限于您批准的家庭，并且可以随时在 PiggyTask 设置中撤销。 PiggyTask 是独立的，不隶属于 OpenAI。
plugins.productIntroEn: PiggyTask helps parents organize kids’ chores with coins and rewards. Connect once with OAuth, then ask ChatGPT to list children, create mandatory or bonus tasks, assign pool tasks, or mark chores done. Access stays scoped to the family you approve and can be revoked anytime in PiggyTask settings. PiggyTask is independent and not affiliated with OpenAI.

plugins.name: Employee Surveys & eNPS
plugins.productIntro: 员工调查和 eNPS 指导领导者设计、审查和完善公司特定的员工调查，然后可以选择将批准的版本保存为可重复使用的模板或在 FeedbackPulse 中未启动的草稿。
plugins.productIntroEn: Employee Surveys & eNPS guides leaders through designing, reviewing, and refining a company-specific employee survey, then optionally saving the approved version as a reusable template or unlaunched draft in FeedbackPulse.

plugins.name: Word Counter
plugins.productIntro: 使用与 ibm.io/wordcount 相同的规则对草稿、论文和片段进行准确的字数和字符计数。返回单词、字符、句子、段落和阅读时间。包括一个聊天内小部件，用于快速可视化摘要。文本在内存中进行处理，而不是存储。对于具有文字目标的私人编辑，请链接到完整的离线浏览器应用程序。
plugins.productIntroEn: Accurate word and character counts for drafts, essays, and snippets — using the same rules as ibm.io/wordcount. Returns words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and reading time. Includes an in-chat widget for quick visual summary. Text is processed in memory and not stored. For private editing with word goals, link to the full offline browser app.

plugins.name: Hypothèques en ligne
plugins.productIntro: 获取法国土地登记文件的即时定价：抵押状态报告 (état Hypothécaire)、财产契约副本、公寓法规 (RDC) 和描述性分割声明 (EDD)。
plugins.productIntroEn: Get instant pricing for French land-registry documents: mortgage status reports (état hypothécaire), property deed copies, condominium regulations (RDC) and descriptive division statements (EDD).

plugins.name: Sonjapgo
plugins.description: 继续利用人工智能进行项目
plugins.productIntro: Sonjapgo 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的项目、任务、共享工作文档、工作报告和私人思想分支。用户可以查找并继续当前工作，创建项目和任务，记录和完成工作，并通过经过身份验证的工作流程安全地预览、应用、检查或恢复行级文档更改。 Sonjapgo 保持项目上下文连接，以便 ChatGPT 可以利用最新的项目、任务、文档和报告信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sonjapgo connects ChatGPT to your projects, tasks, shared working documents, work reports, and private thought branches. Users can find and continue current work, create projects and tasks, record and complete work, and safely preview, apply, inspect, or restore line-level document changes through authenticated workflows.

plugins.name: StewAI
plugins.productIntro: StewAI 帮助人们发现批准的 AI 工作流程、预览所需的输入、估计积分、运行选定的工作流程以及检索声明的最终结果，而无需管理 API 密钥。
plugins.productIntroEn: StewAI helps people discover approved AI workflows, preview their required inputs, estimate credits, run selected workflows, and retrieve declared final results without managing an API key.

plugins.name: Notit
plugins.description: 使用 Notit 笔记进行学习
plugins.productIntro: 将 Notit 连接到 ChatGPT 以查看您的课程、讲座、笔记、成绩单、摘要、关键字、考试要点和快速评论。搜索您的学习材料并根据您的 Notit 帐户中已存储的内容提出问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect Notit to ChatGPT to review your courses, lectures, Notes, transcripts, summaries, keywords, exam points, and Quick Reviews. Search your study materials and ask questions grounded in content already stored in your Notit account.

plugins.name: App Submission Process Tracker
plugins.description: 调试应用程序以进行测试
plugins.productIntro: 应用程序提交流程跟踪器是一个调试应用程序，用于验证插件提交流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: App Submission Process Tracker is a debug app used to validate plugin submission flows.

plugins.name: Ambiguous Workspace
plugins.description: 人类+人工智能的工作空间
plugins.productIntro: 模糊是人类与人工智能协作的工作空间。从头开始重建的 17 个生产力应用程序可让工作在文档、邮件、聊天、表格、CRM、日历等之间流畅进行。每个人工智能同事都有自己的身份，并且与团队其他成员一样使用相同的应用程序和相同的数据。您可以向其发送电子邮件、在聊天中向其发送消息、为其分配任务或在评论中 @提及它。最多 5 人的团队可以免费使用所有 17 个应用程序，代理可以在一分钟内通过 CLI 或 MCP 开始使用。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ambiguous is the workspace for human-AI collaboration. 17 productivity apps rebuilt from scratch to make work flow across Docs, Mail, Chat, Sheets, CRM, Calendar, and more. Each AI coworker has its own identity and works in the same apps and on the same data like the rest of the team. You can send it an email, message it in chat, assign it a task, or @mention it in a comment.

plugins.name: Clio
plugins.description: 在克里奥中访问文森特
plugins.productIntro: 将文森特的法律情报带入法典。通过访问 Clio 图书馆和 Clio 案卷，研究法律、分析案卷并制定案例策略，并引用底层来源。您的事务和公司数据在 Clio 中得到安全管理。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring Vincent’s legal intelligence into Codex. Research the law, analyze dockets and develop case strategy with access to Clio Library and Clio Docket, with citations back to the underlying sources. Your matters and firm data stay securely governed in Clio.

plugins.name: Frasma
plugins.productIntro: Frasma 帮助授权团队审查项目工作、搜索链接的项目知识以及从 ChatGPT 创建、更新或移动私人看板任务。
plugins.productIntroEn: Frasma helps authorized teams review project work, search linked project knowledge, and create, update, or move private Kanban tasks from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Weekloop
plugins.productIntro: Weekloop 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的私人营销工作区，以便您可以在一次对话中查看业务背景、Spark 想法、每周计划、生成的内容和生产状态。您可以创建和修改私人草稿，记录批准或修订决定，并（在明确确认后）开始制作批准的内容。发布、安排、消息传递、支付和订阅购买仍然在 ChatGPT 之外。
plugins.productIntroEn: Weekloop connects ChatGPT to your private marketing workspace so you can review business context, Spark ideas, weekly plans, generated content, and production status in one conversation. You can create and revise private drafts, record approvals or revision decisions, and (after explicit confirmation) start production for approved content.

plugins.name: Neurnav
plugins.productIntro: Neurnav 通过 ChatGPT 内的 Git 风格工作流程帮助您管理长篇文档（例如研究笔记和报告）。打开报告，准确查看您正在处理的分支和修订版本，并与清晰的差异、分阶段编辑和审查就绪的集成请求进行协作。每个更改都可以携带来源元数据（人工智能建议与人工批准），以便您可以放心地发布和共享。您可以共享最新快照的公共链接，而不会丢失可追溯性或上下文。
plugins.productIntroEn: Neurnav helps you manage long-form documents—like research notes and reports—with Git-style workflows inside ChatGPT. Open a report, see exactly which branch and revision you’re working on, and collaborate with clear diffs, staged edits, and review-ready integration requests. Every change can carry provenance metadata (AI suggestion vs.

plugins.name: OpusClip
plugins.productIntro: OpusClip 将 AI 视频编辑带入 ChatGPT。将长视频转换为 TikTok、Instagram Reels 和 YouTube Shorts 的短片，并具有人工智能选择的精彩片段、自动重新构图和动画字幕。 从受支持来源的公开或未列出的视频链接开始，或使用已上传到 OpusClip 的视频。通过对话进行编辑：剪切不需要的部分、删除填充词和停顿以及自定义标题。您的编辑将保存到您的 OpusClip 工作区。
plugins.productIntroEn: OpusClip brings AI video editing into ChatGPT. Turn long videos into short clips for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, with AI-selected highlights, automatic reframing, and animated captions. Start with a public or unlisted video link from a supported source, or use videos already uploaded to OpusClip.

plugins.name: Page2AI
plugins.productIntro: Page2AI 将单个公共网页（仅您明确提供的 URL）转换为 LLM 上下文的干净 Markdown：提取主要内容、删除样板、保留标题、代码块、表格和链接、带有源 URL 和标题的可选 YAML frontmatter。按需且只读：无爬行、无账户、应用程序不存储数据。它不会绕过付费墙、登录、速率限制或任何网站的访问控制；私有网络和云元数据 URL 被拒绝；响应的上限为 10 MB，并具有强制超时和每个 IP 的速率限制。
plugins.productIntroEn: Page2AI converts a single public web page — only the URL you explicitly provide — into clean Markdown for LLM context: main content extracted, boilerplate dropped, headings, code blocks, tables and links preserved, optional YAML frontmatter with the source URL and title. On-demand and read-only: no crawling, no accounts, no data stored by the application.

plugins.name: Atoll
plugins.productIntro: Atoll 帮助人们和 AI 代理检查项目、跟踪工作，并通过 ChatGPT 创建、链接、读取和修改持久的 PRD 和实施计划作为私有工作空间工件。
plugins.productIntroEn: Atoll helps people and AI agents inspect projects, track work, and create, link, read, and revise durable PRDs and implementation plans as private workspace Artifacts through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: ewePro
plugins.productIntro: 该插件允许您在 ewePro 帐户内管理您的羊。即时提出问题并获得见解。 在 ewepro.com 注册一个帐户
plugins.productIntroEn: This plugin allows you to manage your sheep inside your ewePro account. Ask questions and gain insights on the fly. Sign up for an account at ewepro.com

plugins.name: Mary
plugins.productIntro: Mary 让您可以直接从 ChatGPT 提取、询问和验证事件的完整事实记录。每个答案都来自您的文档，并引用了来源，包括遗漏的内容以及原因。
plugins.productIntroEn: Mary lets you extract, interrogate, and verify the complete fact record of a matter directly from ChatGPT. Every answer comes from your documents with the source cited, including what was left out, and why.

plugins.name: VATES
plugins.productIntro: VATES 从您组织自己的知识库中回答问题。用您自己的语言提问，并获得基于您的材料的答案，可追溯到确切的来源条目。没有矢量数据库，也没有嵌入步骤——知识以简单的、人类可读的文本形式存储，并在您询问时进行解释，因此更新会立即生效，并且每个答案都可以进行审核。
plugins.productIntroEn: VATES answers questions from your organization's own knowledge base. Ask in your own language and get answers grounded in your material, traceable to the exact source entry. There is no vector database and no embedding step — knowledge is stored as plain, human-readable text and interpreted at the moment you ask, so updates take effect instantly and every answer can be audited.

plugins.name: BrainOrder
plugins.productIntro: 将您的 BrainOrder 帐户连接到 ChatGPT 或 Codex，以自然语言管理个人规划。浏览列表和文件夹，查看议程，以及创建、完成、重命名、移动、安排、暂停或删除任务、提醒和​​注释。 OAuth 权限将读取、写入和删除访问权限分开。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your BrainOrder account to ChatGPT or Codex to manage personal planning in natural language. Browse lists and folders, review your agenda, and create, complete, rename, move, schedule, snooze, or delete tasks, reminders, and notes. OAuth permissions separate read, write, and delete access.

plugins.name: OpusClip AI Producer
plugins.productIntro: 在聊天中创建可编辑的头像视频。上传素材、直接剪辑、字幕、重构和动态图形，然后打开 AI Producer 预览进行优化或导出。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create an editable talking-head video in chat. Upload footage, direct cuts, captions, reframing, and motion graphics, then open the AI Producer preview to refine or export.

plugins.name: Rig
plugins.description: 管理本地应用程序和端口
plugins.productIntro: Rig 将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到 Rig 的公共云 MCP (https://api.userig.app/mcp)，以便您可以列出项目、检查运行状况和状态、查看哪个项目拥有端口、读取最近的日志以及在链接到您的 Rig 帐户的计算机上启动/停止/重新启动项目。审阅者将沙箱演示令牌与固定项目一起使用（不需要私人 Mac）。当 Rig 在 Mac 上打开并在本地链接时，完整的本地主机日志尾部和高级集线器工具即可工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rig connects ChatGPT and Codex to Rig’s public cloud MCP (https://api.userig.app/mcp) so you can list projects, check health and status, see which project owns a port, read recent logs, and start/stop/restart projects on machines linked to your Rig account. Reviewers use a sandbox demo token with fixture projects (no private Mac required).

plugins.name: TaskView
plugins.productIntro: TaskView 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的自托管项目工作区。查找并组织项目、看板、任务、标签和依赖项；使用您授权的权限创建和更新工作项。
plugins.productIntroEn: TaskView connects ChatGPT to your self-hosted project workspace. Find and organize projects, boards, tasks, tags, and dependencies; create and update work items with the permissions you authorize.
plugins.developerName: Nikolai Giman pr Računarsko programiranje HAND SCREAM GNL Novi Sad

plugins.name: DocketDrafter
plugins.description: 起草并格式化法律文件
plugins.productIntro: DocketDrafter 在 ChatGPT 中为律师提供了一个私人的、公司特定的文档工作区。它可以帮助用户的代理人重复使用以前的工作，以公司首选的法庭格式起草和修改法律文件，保留版本历史记录，生成干净的Word文件和红线，管理源文档以及跟踪引文检查工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: DocketDrafter gives attorneys a private, firm-specific document workspace in ChatGPT. It helps the user's agent reuse prior work, draft and revise legal documents in the firm's preferred court formatting, preserve version history, produce clean Word files and redlines, manage source documents, and track citation-checking work.

plugins.name: Stashiro
plugins.productIntro: Stashiro 是一个视觉工作空间，用于跨空间和看板收集、组织和开发想法。需要现有的 Stashiro 付费帐户。使用 ChatGPT 浏览和搜索您的工作区、查看本机卡片并保存注释、链接、表格、图表、图像和结构化内容，并在更改前进行范围访问和确认。
plugins.productIntroEn: Stashiro is a visual workspace for collecting, organizing, and developing ideas across Spaces and boards. An existing paid Stashiro account is required. Use ChatGPT to browse and search your workspace, view native cards, and save notes, links, tables, charts, images, and structured content with scoped access and confirmation before changes.

plugins.name: Schemon
plugins.productIntro: Schemon 通过 ChatGPT 帮助用户管理客户和提供商工作区中的约会、消息、注释、提醒和通知。
plugins.productIntroEn: Schemon helps users manage appointments, messages, notes, reminders, and notifications across their customer and provider workspaces through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: May or Shall
plugins.description: 搜索并引用您的案例档案
plugins.originalDescription: Search and cite your case file
plugins.productIntro: May 或Shall 是处理法律事务的工作空间。您阅读了案例包， 每一段值得保留的段落都会成为一张永久承载其意义的卡片 准确引用及其来源：文档、页面、段落。
plugins.productIntroEn: May or Shall isa workspace for legal matters. You read the case bundle, and every passage worth keeping becomes a card that permanently carries its exact quote and its source: the document, the page, the paragraph.

plugins.name: Mums!
plugins.productIntro: 妈妈们！在私人或家庭厨房中存储最终的食谱和不可变的食谱版本。只有用户连接自己的妈妈后，ChatGPT 才能查找、读取、保存和更新食谱！帐户。妈妈们！不生成菜谱、调用 OpenAI API、出售数据​​或提供付费功能。
plugins.productIntroEn: Mums! stores finalized recipes and immutable recipe versions in private or family kitchens. ChatGPT can find, read, save, and update recipes only after the user connects their own Mums! account. Mums! does not generate recipes, call the OpenAI API, sell data, or provide paid features.

plugins.name: iManage Work
plugins.description: 受管辖的知识。人工智能准备好了。
plugins.productIntro: 将受管理的 iManage 内容安全地连接到 ChatGPT。搜索、阅读和组织文档，检查工作区和文件夹，以及上传或更新内容 - 所有这些都受权限限制且可审核。随着您的 AI 策略的发展，AI 可以访问您位于 iManage 中的文档，无需批量导出或复制。
plugins.productIntroEn: Securely connect governed iManage content to ChatGPT. Search, read, and organize documents, inspect workspaces and folders, and upload or update content - all permission-bound and auditable. AI accesses your documents where they live in iManage, without requiring bulk exports or replication, as your AI strategy evolves.

plugins.name: PostFast
plugins.productIntro: PostFast 是一款社交媒体管理工具。该插件连接您现有的 PostFast 工作区，以便您可以在对话中运行发布工作流程，而无需打开仪表板。
plugins.productIntroEn: PostFast is a social media management tool. This plugin connects your existing PostFast workspace so you can run your posting workflow in conversation instead of opening the dashboard.

plugins.name: Jamie
plugins.description: 访问您的会议历史记录
plugins.productIntro: 将您的会议引入 ChatGPT。询问您的工作，利用对话上下文并完成工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring your meetings into ChatGPT. Ask about your work, draw on conversation context, and get work done.

plugins.name: PandaDoc
plugins.productIntro: 在 ChatGPT 中创建任何协议并将其发送以进行电子签名，而无需离开对话。描述您的需求，观察它的形成，添加收件人，然后发送。您的 AI 草稿会自动成为一份完善的、可供签名的协议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create any agreement in ChatGPT and send it for e-signature without leaving the conversation. Describe what you need, watch it take shape, add your recipients, and send. Your AI draft becomes a polished, signature-ready agreement automatically.

plugins.name: anew
plugins.productIntro: anew 将文档自包含的 HTML、片段或纯文本编码为携带页面本身的可公开解析的 URL。无需帐户或信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: anew encodes self-contained HTML documents, fragments, or plain text into publicly resolvable URLs that carry the page itself. No account or information is required.

plugins.name: Relativity
plugins.productIntro: Relativity MCP 服务器旨在让 AI 助手通过模型上下文协议访问 Relativity aR 功能，模型上下文协议是一种开放标准，用于通过 MCP 客户端将 AI 工具连接到外部数据和服务。作为系统管理员，您可以使用它来执行日常任务，例如管理事务、配置工作区、授予访问权限和检查系统使用情况。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Relativity MCP server is designed to give AI assistants access to Relativity aiR capabilities through Model Context Protocol, an open standard for connecting AI tools to external data and services through MCP clients. As a system administrator, you can use it to perform day-to-day tasks such as managing matters, configuring workspaces, granting access, and reviewing system usage.

plugins.name: Checklist
plugins.productIntro: Checklist 可帮助您直接从 ChatGPT 查找和管理清单、创建新清单、更新任务以及构建可重用模板。
plugins.productIntroEn: Checklist helps you find and manage checklists, create new ones, update tasks, and build reusable templates directly from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Company Knowledge
plugins.description: 跨互联来源查找决策、文档和项目背景
plugins.originalDescription: Find decisions, documents, and project context across connected sources
plugins.productIntro: 公司知识可帮助您在公司的互联来源中查找决策、文档、所有者和最近的项目更新。提出问题并获得带有引文的简洁答案，以便您可以查看信息的来源。
plugins.productIntroEn: Company Knowledge helps you find decisions, documents, owners, and recent project updates across your company's connected sources. Ask a question and get a concise answer with citations so you can review where the information came from.

plugins.name: Glean
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Glean 的远程 MCP 服务器将企业环境引入 ChatGPT 和您的 AI 工具。搜索组织的所有连接数据源 - 文档、wiki、代码存储库等。按姓名、角色或专业知识查找员工。阅读特定文档、访问 Gmail 和 Outlook 电子邮件以及查找会议详细信息。自定义代理工作流程可实现为您的组织量身定制的强大自动化功能。收集您的 AI 助手的企业内存 — 确保 ChatGPT 和其他支持 MCP 的应用程序无论您在哪里工作，都能深入了解您公司的环境。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring enterprise context to ChatGPT and your AI tools with Glean's Remote MCP server. Search across all your organization's connected data sources—documents, wikis, code repositories, and more. Find employees by name, role, or expertise. Read specific documents, access Gmail and Outlook emails, and lookup meeting details.

plugins.name: YouTrack
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 YouTrack 以查找和总结问题、创建和更新工作、管理受让人、链接、标签和评论、记录时间以及搜索或更新知识库文章。 需要在 YouTrack 中自动注册 OAuth 客户端。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to YouTrack to find and summarize issues, create and update work, manage assignees, links, tags, and comments, log time, and search or update knowledge base articles. Requires automatic OAuth client registration in YouTrack.

plugins.name: Canva
plugins.description: 创建、检查并编辑 Canva 设计。
plugins.productIntro: Canva 是面向非设计师与设计团队的在线视觉设计平台，提供模板、排版、图片和协作编辑能力；在 Codex 中适合把文字需求转成设计任务并迭代成品。
plugins.productIntroEn: Canva is an online visual design platform for individuals and teams, with templates, layout, media, and collaborative editing; in Codex it is useful for turning written briefs into design work and iterating on the result.

plugins.name: Viewmax
plugins.description: 生成和编辑短视频、图片、配音与字幕。
plugins.productIntro: Viewmax 是面向社交媒体的视频制作平台，可生成和编辑短视频、图片、配音、广告素材和字幕。
plugins.productIntroEn: Viewmax is a service that helps you create videos with AI. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Higgsfield
plugins.description: 使用多种图像与视频生成模型。
plugins.productIntro: Higgsfield 的主要用途是使用多种图像与视频生成模型。 在 ChatGPT 中使用 Higgsfield 创建图像、视频、品牌内容和网站。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Higgsfield is a service that helps you every image and video model. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Runway
plugins.description: 使用生成式模型制作视频。
plugins.productIntro: Runway 的主要用途是使用生成式模型制作视频。 Runway 允许用户使用其 Runway 帐户直接从 ChatGPT 生成和编辑图像、视频和音频。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Runway is a service that helps you generate with every AI model. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Figma
plugins.description: 读取 Figma 设计并支持设计到代码。
plugins.productIntro: Figma 是基于云端的界面设计与原型协作平台，支持多人编辑、组件和设计交付；在 Codex 中适合读取设计上下文并把界面方案推进到代码。
plugins.productIntroEn: Figma is a cloud-based interface design and prototyping platform for collaborative editing, components, and handoff; in Codex it is useful for reading design context and carrying interface work into code.

plugins.name: invideo
plugins.description: 通过文字描述制作带画面和配音的视频。
plugins.productIntro: invideo 是文本驱动的视频制作平台，把脚本、画面、配音和音乐整合为可分享的视频。
plugins.productIntroEn: invideo is a service that helps you create videos of any length. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Mobbin
plugins.description: 搜索 UI 与 UX 设计案例和参考。
plugins.productIntro: Mobbin 的主要用途是搜索 UI 与 UX 设计案例和参考。 Mobbin 是移动应用程序、Web 应用程序和网站的 UI 和 UX 设计参考的行业标准。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Mobbin is a service that helps you find UI & UX design references. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: AI Voice Generator
plugins.description: 把文字生成自然语音和配音文件。
plugins.productIntro: AI Voice Generator 是文字转语音工具，可根据脚本生成自然配音并返回音频文件，适合旁白和口播素材制作。
plugins.productIntroEn: AI Voice Generator is a service that helps you create AI voiceovers. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: OpenArt
plugins.productIntro: OpenArt 的主要用途是创建图像与视频。 无需离开 ChatGPT，即可在 OpenArt 上创建图像和视频。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: OpenArt is a service that helps you create images and videos. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Visla Video Maker
plugins.productIntro: Visla Video Maker 可帮助用户根据在 ChatGPT 中起草的脚本创建带旁白的视频。用户可以共享视频想法或源材料，例如文本、文档、PDF 或 URL，ChatGPT 会根据该输入生成脚本。然后，维斯拉使用该脚本创建带有素材和背景音乐的解说视频。用户可以从 ChatGPT 对话中打开 Visla 上生成的项目，以继续编辑、导出或下载最终视频。需要 Visla 帐户才能注册并登录才能使用这些功能。
plugins.productIntroEn: Visla Video Maker helps users create narrated videos from scripts drafted in ChatGPT. Users can share a video idea or source materials such as text, documents, PDFs, or URLs, and ChatGPT generates a script from that input. Visla then uses the script to create a narrated video with stock footage and background music.

plugins.name: HeyGen
plugins.description: 创建 AI 视频和头像
plugins.productIntro: HeyGen帮助用户直接通过ChatGPT创建和管理AI视频、头像、语音、翻译、模板、品牌资产和相关媒体。
plugins.productIntroEn: HeyGen helps users create and manage AI videos, avatars, voices, translations, templates, brand assets, and related media directly through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Picsart
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Picsart AI 模型创建和编辑图像、视频、音频和文本。编写和渲染媒体场景，检查模型参数和信用估计，跟踪生成作业，以及浏览、保存和组织 Picsart Drive 中的文件。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create and edit images, videos, audio, and text with Picsart AI models. Compose and render media scenes, inspect model parameters and credit estimates, track generation jobs, and browse, save, and organize files in Picsart Drive.

plugins.name: Product Design
plugins.productIntro: 将早期想法转化为团队可以审查的原型。探索产品方向、审核用户流程、研究用户摩擦、从实时 URL 制作原型，并使静态屏幕截图具有交互性。从书面简介、URL、屏幕截图或现有设计开始，然后在构建之前比较视觉方向。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn early ideas into prototypes teams can review. Explore product directions, audit user flows, research user friction, prototype from a live URL, and make static screenshots interactive. Start with a written brief, URL, screenshot, or existing design, then compare visual directions before building.

plugins.name: MyFonts
plugins.productIntro: 按个性、流派、用例、美学、行业发现字体，或直接从图像中识别字体。描述您的项目、心情、风格、创意方向或在聊天中上传图像，并获得符合您意图的精选字体推荐。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover fonts by personality, genre, use case, aesthetics, industry — or identify fonts directly from an image. Describe your project, mood, style, creative direction or upload an image in chat and get curated font recommendations that match your intent.

plugins.name: Magnific
plugins.productIntro: 使用 ChatGPT 中的 Magnific 将想法转化为最终的视觉效果。在一个地方访问每个图像、音频、视频生成模型。运行多步骤创意工作流程。升级到 4K、重新点亮、添加画外音、构建 3D 模型。从任何设计中自动提取图层。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn ideas into finished visuals with Magnific in ChatGPT. Access every image, audio, video generative models in one place. Run multi-step creative workflows. Upscale to 4K, relight, add voiceovers, build 3D models. Auto-extract layers from any design.

plugins.name: Gamma
plugins.productIntro: 借助 Gamma，您可以直接在 ChatGPT 内将您的想法转化为精美、专业的内容。无论您是起草宣传材料、营销简报还是团队更新，Gamma 都可以帮助您创建精美的品牌演示文稿、文档、社交帖子和网页，而无需离开您的工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: With Gamma, you can turn your ideas into polished, professional content directly inside ChatGPT. Whether you're drafting a pitch deck, marketing brief, or team update, Gamma helps you create beautiful, on-brand presentations, documents, social posts, and webpages, without leaving your workflow.

plugins.name: VEED Video Generator
plugins.description: 使用 AI 生成视频
plugins.productIntro: 选择你的角色。选择你的声音。生成您的视频。就是这么简单。浏览栩栩如生的角色和自然的声音库，然后观看您的想法以精美的、可分享的视频形式变为现实——没有相机，没有工作人员。非常适合创作者、营销人员以及任何想要在几分钟内获得专业品质视频的人。
plugins.productIntroEn: Pick your character. Pick your voice. Generate your video. It's that simple. Browse a library of lifelike characters and natural-sounding voices, then watch your idea come to life as a polished, share-ready video — no cameras, no crew. Perfect for creators, marketers, and anyone who wants pro-quality videos in minutes.

plugins.name: B12 Website Generator
plugins.description: 在几秒钟内创建一个网站
plugins.productIntro: B12 网站生成器可让您直接在 ChatGPT 内创建专业、有吸引力且用户友好的网站。只需用简单的语言描述您的业务或项目，该应用程序就会立即生成一个适合您的目标和品牌的完整网站。
plugins.productIntroEn: B12 Website Generator lets you create a professional, engaging, and user-friendly website directly inside ChatGPT. Just describe your business or project in plain language, and the app instantly generates a complete website tailored to your goals and brand.

plugins.name: Creative Claw
plugins.productIntro: 在 ChatGPT 中创建视频、产品广告、图像和配音。将照片制作成动画，将脚本变成多场景影片，或者制作带有旁白和字幕的创作者风格的产品广告。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create videos, product ads, images and voiceovers in ChatGPT. Animate a photo, turn a script into a multi-scene film, or make a creator-style product ad with narration and captions.

plugins.name: to3D
plugins.description: 将 2D 图像转换为 3D glTF
plugins.productIntro: to3D帮助用户将2D图像转换为简单的3D glTF模型。您可以上传图像、预览生成的 3D 结果并将其导出以供进一步编辑或在设计工具中使用。该应用程序旨在使基本的 3D 转换快速且易于使用，即使对于没有专业 3D 软件经验的用户也是如此。
plugins.productIntroEn: to3D helps users convert 2D images into simple 3D glTF model. You can upload an image, preview the generated 3D result, and export it for further editing or use in design tools. The app is designed to make basic 3D conversion fast and accessible, even for users without professional 3D software experience.

plugins.name: AI Video Maker
plugins.description: 制作带有文字提示的视频

plugins.productIntroEn: The easiest way to generate incredible videos with the leading state of the art model, Seedance 2 and 2.5.

plugins.name: fal
plugins.productIntro: 您的 AI 图像、视频、音频和 3D 生成创意合作伙伴。使用 fal 将想法转化为产品照片、电影剪辑、社交活动、配音和游戏资产。从提示或参考图像开始，获得选择模型的帮助，并通过图像编辑和对话完善您的创作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your creative partner for AI image, video, audio, and 3D generation. Turn ideas into product photos, cinematic clips, social campaigns, voiceovers, and game assets with fal. Start with a prompt or reference image, get help choosing a model, and refine your creations through image editing and conversation.

plugins.name: Adobe Express
plugins.productIntro: Adobe Express for ChatGPT 可帮助您免费创建设计。开始使用模板进行创作、自定义文本、调整颜色以及交换图像以匹配您的风格。好奇它还能做什么？只需在聊天中询问即可。
plugins.productIntroEn: Adobe Express for ChatGPT helps you create designs for free. Start creating with templates, customize text, adjust colors, and swap images to match your style. Curious what else it can do? Just ask in the chat.

plugins.name: Adobe
plugins.productIntro: Adobe 解锁了更多通过对话创建和完成工作的方式。 Adobe 连接器以前以 Photoshop 形式提供，现在为 Creative Cloud 和 Acrobat 提供创造力和生产力功能。描述您想要制作或更改的内容，Adobe 可以帮助您将想法、图像、视频和文档转化为精美的输出 - 从编辑照片和创建 PDF 到设计社交资产、调整视频大小、搜索 Creative Cloud 资产以及生成数据驱动的文档。 关键能力：
plugins.productIntroEn: Adobe unlocks more ways to create and get work done from the conversation. Previously available as Photoshop, the Adobe connector now brings creativity and productivity capabilities across Creative Cloud and Acrobat.

plugins.name: Midify
plugins.description: 创作、编辑、播放 MIDI 音乐
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Midify 将您的音乐创意转化为优美的歌曲。无论您脑子里有旋律还是只是一种氛围，Midify 都会充当您的 AI 副驾驶来创作、编辑和增强您的音乐。只需要求 Midify 生成和弦进行、修复和声或将简单的循环扩展为完整的编曲即可。它会分析您的曲目并提供智能建议，让您可以直接在聊天中构建复杂的 MIDI 作品。无需音乐理论。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn your musical ideas into polished songs with Midify. Whether you have a melody in your head or just a vibe, Midify acts as your AI co-pilot to compose, edit, and enhance your music. Simply ask Midify to generate a chord progression, fix a harmony, or expand a simple loop into a full arrangement.

plugins.name: VisualSong
plugins.description: 创建音乐反应视觉效果
plugins.productIntro: VisualSong 将创意提示转变为 ChatGPT 内的实时音频反应视觉。在播放器中选择本地音频文件，然后观看对其频谱和历史记录的视觉响应。音频保留在您的设备上，并且永远不会上传到 VisualSong。不需要单独的 VisualSong 帐户、付款或持久存储。
plugins.productIntroEn: VisualSong turns a creative prompt into a real-time audio-reactive visual inside ChatGPT. Choose a local audio file in the player and watch the visual respond to its spectrum and history. Audio stays on your device and is never uploaded to VisualSong. No separate VisualSong account, payment, or persistent storage is required.

plugins.name: Shutterstock
plugins.description: 通过 Shutterstock 激发创意
plugins.productIntro: 搜索库存库以查找与用户指定的主题、风格、情绪或设置相匹配的候选图像、视频、音乐和音效，并返回带水印的预览 URL 和基本元数据以供选择。当用户想要浏览或选择现有库存媒体（包括多个分组图像搜索）而不是生成、编辑、许可或下载文件时使用。
plugins.productIntroEn: Searches stock libraries to find candidate images, videos, music, and sound effects that match user-specified subjects, styles, moods, or settings, returning watermarked preview URLs with basic metadata for selection. Use when users want to browse or choose existing stock media (including multiple grouped image searches), not to generate, edit, license, or download files.

plugins.name: Descript
plugins.productIntro: Descript 是一个视频编辑器，您可以通过对话进行指导。
plugins.productIntroEn: Descript is a video editor you can direct through conversation.

plugins.name: WalkMyPlan — Floor Plans in 3D
plugins.description: 通过聊天进行 3D 家居设计
plugins.productIntro: 描述你想要的家——“一座 10 x 10 的房子，有一间主卧室和一间私人浴室、两间儿童房、一个开放式厨房和客厅、一个种有树木的花园”——WalkMyPlan 会一次性建造它：真实的墙壁、门、窗户、家具和花园。打开实时链接并以 3D 方式浏览它。
plugins.productIntroEn: Describe the home you want — "a 10 by 10 house with a master bedroom and a private bathroom, two kids' rooms, an open kitchen and living room, a garden with trees" — and WalkMyPlan builds it in one go: real walls, doors, windows, furniture and garden. Open the live link and walk through it in 3D.

plugins.name: Pixlie
plugins.productIntro: Pixlie Prompt Coach 可帮助您在打开 Pixlie 工作室之前编写更好的 AI 视频提示。
plugins.productIntroEn: Pixlie Prompt Coach helps you write better AI video prompts before you open the Pixlie studio.

plugins.name: Creative Production
plugins.description: 从简介或产品图像创建营销视觉效果。
plugins.originalDescription: Create marketing visuals from a brief or product image.
plugins.productIntro: 创意制作帮助营销人员将简介、产品图像、报价或现有资产转化为团队可以审查的视觉选项。用它来探索活动创意、概念图像、情绪板、产品植入、广告方向、列表图像、社交帖子和可重复使用的样式。从简介或图像开始，比较最强的选项，然后根据您需要的渠道调整所选方向。
plugins.productIntroEn: Creative Production helps marketers turn a brief, product image, offer, or existing asset into visual options the team can review. Use it to explore campaign ideas, concept images, mood boards, product placements, ad directions, listing images, social posts, and reusable styles.

plugins.name: Insta Website Builder
plugins.productIntro: InstaSite 允许您使用 AI 生成网站。 根据简短的描述创建页面结构、内容和布局，然后编辑并发布您的网站。
plugins.productIntroEn: InstaSite lets you generate websites using AI. Create page structure, content, and layout from a short description, then edit and publish your site.

plugins.name: Instavar Remotion Templates
plugins.productIntro: 从五个开源 Remotion 模板创建结构化本地视频。无需帐户或 API 密钥即可获取模板指南、VideoSpec 架构、入门示例、渲染说明和安全错误诊断。渲染保留在您自己的工作区中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create structured local videos from five open-source Remotion templates. Get template guidance, VideoSpec schemas, starter examples, render instructions, and safe error diagnosis without an account or API key. Rendering stays in your own workspace.

plugins.name: 123 Piano
plugins.productIntro: 在 ChatGPT 中弹奏钢琴/键盘并与 AI 讨论您的演奏的一种简单有趣的方式！
plugins.productIntroEn: An easy fun way to play the piano/keyboard in ChatGPT and discuss your performance with the AI!

plugins.name: Morphix
plugins.productIntro: 大多数创造性工作并不会止于第一代。 Morphix 涵盖了整个路径，从第一个提示到您实际移交的文件：一个信用池中的每个主要图像、视频和音频模型。
plugins.productIntroEn: Most creative work does not stop at the first generation. Morphix covers the whole path, from the first prompt to the file you actually hand over: every major image, video, and audio model in one credit pool.

plugins.name: MangaBoom
plugins.description: 将文本和聊天变成漫画
plugins.productIntro: 您的私人人工智能漫画家。在几秒钟内将故事、聊天记录和概念转换为动态的全彩漫画。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your personal AI Manga Artist. Convert stories, chat logs, and concepts into dynamic, full-color comics in seconds.

plugins.name: Krikey AI Animation
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Krikey AI 动画制作音乐视频动画。 Select a 3D character, a music genre, and a topic (for example a birthday card, a marketing video or a how-to tutorial), then animate your cartoon character using AI Text to Animation.
plugins.productIntroEn: Animate Music Videos with Krikey AI Animation. Select a 3D character, a music genre, and a topic (for example a birthday card, a marketing video or a how-to tutorial), then animate your cartoon character using AI Text to Animation. Download a high-res video export and share these 3D visuals with AI-generated music, animations, anime and cute cartoon characters.

plugins.name: Instant Website
plugins.productIntro: InstantSite 允许您使用 AI 和手动编辑生成网站。 根据简短的描述创建页面结构、内容和布局，然后编辑并发布您的网站。
plugins.productIntroEn: InstantSite lets you generate websites using AI and manual editing. Create page structure, content, and layout from a short description, then edit and publish your site.

plugins.name: HZplan
plugins.productIntro: HZplan 将平面图图像或书面尺寸转换为您的助手可以推理的结构化、可编辑的家居平面图。用户可以创建和完善房间、墙壁、门窗、家具和表面饰面；导入并校准平面图图像；检查尺寸和拓扑；添加注释和自定义属性；进行有针对性的几何编辑；从参考图像创建材料；生成 3D 对象模型；并将楼层导出为 PNG 或 SVG。
plugins.productIntroEn: HZplan turns floor-plan images or written dimensions into structured, editable home plans your assistant can reason about. Users can create and refine rooms, walls, doors, windows, furniture, and surface finishes; import and calibrate floor-plan images; inspect dimensions and topology; add notes and custom attributes; make targeted geometry edits; create materials from reference images;…

plugins.name: BioRender
plugins.productIntro: 搜索 BioRender 的科学模板库，找到您的文件，并使用 AI 生成自定义初稿图形。结果和预览直接显示在您的对话中，每个项目都链接回 BioRender，以便您可以打开并继续编辑。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search BioRender's library of scientific templates, find your files, and generate custom first-draft figures with AI. Results and previews appear right in your conversation, and every item links back to BioRender so you can open and keep editing.

plugins.name: Genspark AI Slides
plugins.productIntro: 利用 AI 即时创建专业演示文稿。从任何主题或内容生成精美的幻灯片。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create professional presentations instantly with AI. Generate beautiful slides from any topic or content.

plugins.name: LogoGenic Image Generator
plugins.productIntro: 输入描述，选择样式或格式，然后生成不同尺寸的图像。该应用程序对于设计师、开发人员、内容创建者以及任何需要无需手动绘图的视觉效果的人来说非常有用。
plugins.productIntroEn: Enter a description, select a style or format, and generate images in different sizes. The app is useful for designers, developers, content creators, and anyone who needs visuals without manual drawing.

plugins.name: Alpix
plugins.description: 在共享罐上绘制像素艺术
plugins.originalDescription: Draw pixel art on a shared can
plugins.productIntro: Alpix 可让您和人工智能在实时共享画布上协作绘制像素艺术。描述任何形状或场景，人工智能就会绘制它。每个像素都归因于人工智能模型和放置它的用户，因此每个人的贡献都是可见的！
plugins.productIntroEn: Alpix lets you and an AI collaboratively paint pixel art on a live shared canvas. Describe any shape or scene and the AI draws it. Every pixel is attributed to the AI model and the user who placed it, so contributions are visible to everyone !

plugins.name: VideoZero
plugins.productIntro: 曾经被一道无法想象的数学题困住了吗？希望您能够说明算法，但没有时间手动制作所有内容的动画？ VideoZero 生成您学习、可视化和解释复杂概念所需的视频。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ever been stuck on a math problem you can’t quite picture? Wished you could illustrate an algorithm, but don’t have time to animate everything by hand? VideoZero generates the video you need to learn, visualize, and explain complex concepts.

plugins.name: TalkGen
plugins.productIntro: 生成专业的谈话视频。上传您自己的照片或选择头像，从多种语言中进行选择，并获得完美口型同步的结果。非常适合社交媒体、营销和培训。
plugins.productIntroEn: Generate professional talking videos. Upload your own photo or choose an avatar, select from various languages, and get results with perfect lip-sync. Ideal for social media, marketing, and training.

plugins.name: Color Designer - Palette Maker
plugins.productIntro: 在几秒钟内获得完美的色彩创意。请 ChatGPT 推荐可以很好搭配的颜色，然后将它们视为可以立即使用的简单调色板。您可以保留您喜欢的颜色、删除您不喜欢的颜色、更改任何颜色或添加新颜色。我们的目标是帮助您从一个想法转变为一个有用的调色板，而不会陷入困境或花费很长时间进行小选择。
plugins.productIntroEn: Get perfect color ideas in seconds. Ask ChatGPT to suggest colors that work well together, then see them as a simple palette you can use right away. You can keep the colors you like, remove the ones you do not, change any color, or add new ones. The goal is to help you move from an idea to a useful color palette without getting stuck or spending a long time making small choices.

plugins.name: BlitzReels
plugins.productIntro: BlitzReels 帮助您将录音变成短视频。在 ChatGPT 中，您可以查找现有项目和媒体、导入您有权使用的视频、创建带字幕的剪辑、编辑时间线、生成视频资源以及导出完成的文件。操作使用您连接的 BlitzReels 工作区，并在敏感导入或相似使用之前要求确认。
plugins.productIntroEn: BlitzReels helps you turn recordings into short videos. In ChatGPT, you can find existing projects and media, import a video you have permission to use, create captioned clips, edit timelines, generate video assets, and export finished files. Actions use your connected BlitzReels workspace and ask for confirmation before sensitive imports or likeness use.

plugins.name: Apixel
plugins.productIntro: Apixel 是一款人工智能驱动的图像生成器，可在几秒钟内将您的文本变成令人惊叹的视觉效果。它可以准确地渲染图像中的文本，非常适合海报、徽标和社交媒体内容。无需设计技能。只需输入您的想法，然后让 Apixel 完成剩下的工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Apixel is an AI-powered image generator that turns your text into stunning visuals in seconds. It accurately renders text within images, making it perfect for posters, logos, and social media content. No design skills needed. Just type your idea and let Apixel do the rest.

plugins.name: Amazing Drawing
plugins.productIntro: 使用 ChatGPT 进行绘画的最佳方式！
plugins.productIntroEn: The best way to draw with ChatGPT!

plugins.name: AI Color Picker - Design Tool
plugins.productIntro: 选择您喜欢的任何颜色并与 AI 讨论。
plugins.productIntroEn: Pick any color you like and talk about it with AI.

plugins.name: Supericons
plugins.description: 更快地找到正确的图标
plugins.productIntro: Supericons 帮助人们通过含义、UI 角色、库、样式或支持的语言查找和预览 SVG 图标。它可以为产品界面的多达 20 个部分推荐一致的图标集，显示视觉预览，并在选择图标时返回准确的 SVG 代码。
plugins.productIntroEn: Supericons helps people find and preview SVG icons by meaning, UI role, library, style, or supported language. It can recommend a consistent icon set for up to 20 parts of a product interface, show visual previews, and return exact SVG code when an icon is selected.

plugins.name: Autodesk Product Help
plugins.description: 连接 Autodesk 产品文档

plugins.productIntroEn: The Autodesk® Product Help Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server connects AI agents directly to Autodesk’s official product documentation across 110+ products including Autodesk Fusion®, AutoCAD®, Revit®, Inventor®, Maya®, Civil 3D®, and more. As a secure, read-only interface, it allows AI tools to search, navigate, and retrieve trusted Autodesk help content.

plugins.name: B&A: Draw Sketches

plugins.productIntroEn: Create quick sketches, diagrams, notes, and visual ideas on a simple whiteboard canvas. Use freehand drawing, shapes, lines, arrows, and text to map out thoughts, explain concepts, or brainstorm visually.

plugins.name: Hypernatural

plugins.productIntroEn: Bring your ideas to life as compelling videos, without breaking your flow. Hypernatural turns the conversations you’re already having in ChatGPT into shareable stories and ads, making it simple to bring in your creative vision and brand, so every video feels uniquely yours.

plugins.name: Deep Art AI

plugins.productIntro: 为设计师提供的 AI 字体配对。

plugins.name: Beautiful.ai

plugins.productIntro: Beautiful.ai ChatGPT 应用程序可帮助您跳过空白幻灯片，在几秒钟内将粗略的想法转变为清晰、可立即工作的演示文稿。直接在 ChatGPT 中集思广益、起草和完善您的内容，然后立即将其转换为设计精美的演示文稿。在聊天中添加幻灯片、更新内容或重组整个流程，或在 Beautiful.ai 中打开您的幻灯片以实现完全的创意控制。非常适合推介、报告、策略讨论或您快速需要的任何平台，而无需牺牲质量。用它来：
plugins.productIntroEn: The Beautiful.ai ChatGPT app helps you skip the blank slide and turn rough ideas into clear, work-ready presentations in seconds. Brainstorm, draft, and refine your content directly in ChatGPT, then instantly transform it into a beautifully designed presentation. Add slides, update content, or restructure the entire flow all within the chat, or open your deck in Beautiful.

plugins.name: UX Pilot
