plugins.description: 重新调整网络研讨会内容的用途
plugins.productIntro: Sequel 可帮助您将网络研讨会对话转化为书面内容。连接您的 Sequel 帐户以访问网络研讨会记录并从您的活动中生成博客文章、社交媒体内容、时事通讯和其他营销资产。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sequel helps you turn webinar conversations into written content. Connect your Sequel account to access webinar transcripts and generate blog posts, social media content, newsletters, and other marketing assets from your events.

plugins.name: Kolbo.AI
plugins.productIntro: Kolbo.AI 帮助用户创建和编辑图像、视频、音乐、语音、声音和 3D 资产，然后将结果组织到项目、文档、审阅空间和同步媒体库中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kolbo.AI helps users create and edit images, video, music, speech, sound, and 3D assets, then organize the results in projects, documents, review spaces, and a synchronized media library.

plugins.name: PoolVisionIA
plugins.productIntro: PoolVisionIA 生成您未来花园中游泳池的逼真模拟。使用手机或平板电脑拍摄照片，几分钟内即可看到结果。可视化决策支持工具，对法国行政程序没有监管价值。
plugins.productIntroEn: PoolVisionIA génère une simulation photoréaliste de votre future piscine dans votre jardin. Prenez une photo depuis votre téléphone ou tablette, visualisez le résultat en quelques minutes. Outil d'aide à la décision visuelle, sans valeur réglementaire pour les démarches administratives françaises.

plugins.name: Poster Maker
plugins.productIntro: 海报制作器可帮助您将您的想法变成专业海报，而无需离开聊天室。 只需描述您需要的内容 - 生日邀请、餐厅优惠、节日问候、商业促销、活动传单或社交媒体帖子 - 海报制作工具就会搜索其模板库以找到最匹配的设计。它直接在 ChatGPT 中显示个性化预览，而不是通用示例。 添加名称、日期、价格、折扣、联系电话或业务信息等详细信息，海报制作工具会自动将您的内容放入选定的设计中，以便您可以看到最终海报的外观。
plugins.productIntroEn: Poster Maker helps you turn your ideas into professional posters without leaving the chat. Simply describe what you need—a birthday invitation, restaurant offer, festival greeting, business promotion, event flyer, or social media post—and Poster Maker searches its template library to find the best matching designs.

plugins.name: PostNitro
plugins.productIntro: PostNitro MCP 服务器允许人工智能助手和代理——Claude（桌面、代码和 Cowork）、Cursor、ChatGPT 和任何其他模型上下文协议客户端——创建轮播和图像帖子、管理品牌套件和连接的社交帐户，并直接安排帖子。
plugins.productIntroEn: The PostNitro MCP server lets AI assistants and agents — Claude (Desktop, Code, and Cowork), Cursor, ChatGPT, and any other Model Context Protocol client — create carousels and image posts, manage brand kits and connected social accounts, and schedule posts directly.

plugins.name: Morphed
plugins.description: 创建 AI 图像和视频
plugins.productIntro: Morphed 帮助用户规划和创建 AI 图像和视频、估算信贷成本、组织项目工作以及审查工作区的生成结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Morphed helps users plan and create AI images and videos, estimate credit costs, organize work in projects, and review generation results from their workspace.

plugins.name: DropTrack
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中使用 DropTrack 分析您的曲目。上传音频、使用现有的 DropTrack 曲目或提供 SoundCloud 或 Spotify 链接来检查结构化曲目分析和标签，然后为唱片公司、DJ、博主和播放列表策展人发现个性化提交机会。将这些见解转化为实际推广：探索播放列表、组织联系人和列表、准备活动草稿、审查活动和观众表现、管理广告和资产，以及创建新闻稿、艺术家简介和艺术品。
plugins.productIntroEn: Analyze your tracks with DropTrack directly from ChatGPT and Codex. Upload audio, use an existing DropTrack track, or provide a SoundCloud or Spotify link to inspect structured track analysis and tags, then discover personalized submission opportunities for record labels, DJs, bloggers, and playlist curators.

plugins.name: Wixel
plugins.productIntro: 您的人工智能设计合作伙伴，就在 ChatGPT 中。从聊天中生成徽标、图像、演示文稿和视频，或上传您自己的图像进行编辑。只需描述您的需求，Wixel 就会生成专业设计，您可以立即下载和使用，或在 Wixel 编辑器中进行微调。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your AI design partner, right in ChatGPT. Generate logos, images, presentations, and videos from the chat, or upload your own image to edit. Just describe what you need, and Wixel generates professional designs that you can download and use right away, or fine-tune in the Wixel editor.

plugins.name: Appllama
plugins.description: 研究顶级 iOS 应用的屏幕
plugins.originalDescription: Study screens of top iOS apps
plugins.productIntro: Appllama 是收入最高的移动应用程序的设计库：它们的屏幕、流程、入门和付费专区，以及收入背景。该平台为世界各地的创始人、设计师和产品团队提供服务，帮助他们设计人们喜欢使用的应用程序。
plugins.productIntroEn: Appllama is the design library of the highest grossing mobile apps: their screens, flows, onboarding and paywalls, with revenue context. The platform serves founders, designers and product teams across the world to help them design apps people love to use.

plugins.name: skima
plugins.productIntro: 使用 ChatGPT 生成最多 8 个示意性平面图概念作为 CAD 绘图，然后在 skima 经过验证的 2D 和 3D 查看器中打开私人结果，或从聊天中返回的链接下载 PDF、DXF 和 GLB 文件。生成的概念是早期设计研究，而不是施工文件或许可决定。
plugins.productIntroEn: Generate up to 8 schematic floorplan concepts as CAD drawings with ChatGPT, then open the private results in skima’s authenticated 2D and 3D viewer or download PDF, DXF, and GLB files from the links returned in chat. Generated concepts are early-stage design studies, not construction documents or permitting determinations.

plugins.name: Voicepanel
plugins.description: 获取有关您产品的反馈
plugins.productIntro: 衡量真实的人们对新产品、原型、消息传递等的看法。让 AI 进行数百次反馈会议，以便您可以充满信心地启动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Measure what real people think about new products, prototypes, messaging, and more. Let AI conduct 100s of feedback sessions so you can launch with confidence.

plugins.name: Havi Slides
plugins.productIntro: Havi 可以立即将粗略的想法转化为精美的、可供演示的幻灯片。 从提示、一些注释或粗略的大纲开始。该应用程序构建叙述、布局和设计，以便您可以专注于您的消息传递。以零设计工作量构建美观的幻灯片。
plugins.productIntroEn: Havi transforms rough ideas into polished, presentation-ready slides instantly. Start with a prompt, a few notes, or a rough outline. The app builds the narrative, layout, and design so you can stay focused on your messaging. Build aesthetic slides with zero design effort.

plugins.name: Flatma
plugins.productIntro: 根据文本提示创建定制橱柜和家具。 Flatma 生成具有真实尺寸和面板厚度的可编辑 3D 模型，因此您可以调整尺寸、架子、抽屉、材料和其他细节。设计衣柜、厨柜、书桌、桌子、架子等。在 flatma.com 上打开您的项目以获取详细图纸和切割清单。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create custom cabinets and furniture from a text prompt. Flatma generates an editable 3D model with real dimensions and panel thicknesses, so you can adjust sizes, shelves, drawers, materials, and other details. Design wardrobes, kitchen cabinets, desks, tables, shelves, and more. Open your project on flatma.com for detailed drawings and cut lists.

plugins.name: VoiceLabs
plugins.description: 文本转语音和文字记录
plugins.productIntro: VoiceLabs 是一个基于浏览器的语音工作室，用于文本转语音和转录。 VoiceLabs 插件可让 ChatGPT 直接使用您的语音库：列出您帐户上的语音配置文件、在缺少语音时提供内置预设语音、从文本生成语音音频、将音频剪辑转录为文本、浏览您保存的捕获以及检查您之前开始生成的一代的状态。
plugins.productIntroEn: VoiceLabs is a browser-based voice studio for text-to-speech and transcription. The VoiceLabs plugin lets ChatGPT work with your voice library directly: list the voice profiles on your account, provision a built-in preset voice when one is missing, generate spoken audio from text, transcribe an audio clip to text, browse your saved captures, and check the status of a generation you start…

plugins.name: Incarn
plugins.description: 将家庭老照片制作成动画
plugins.productIntro: Incarn 将旧照片变成栩栩如生的短视频。附上一张家庭照片（或粘贴公共图像 URL），人工智能会添加微妙、自然的动作——温柔的眨眼、淡淡的微笑、轻柔的呼吸。专为古老的家庭和祖先肖像而设计。预付积分、高清结果，可在聊天中预览之前/之后的结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Incarn turns old photos into short, lifelike videos. Attach a family photo (or paste a public image URL) and the AI adds subtle, natural motion — gentle blinks, a faint smile, soft breathing. Made for old family and ancestor portraits. Prepaid credits, HD result, with a before/after preview right in the chat.

plugins.name: SSHOW
plugins.description: 设计和制作幻灯片动画
plugins.productIntro: SSHOW 是一种设计工具，其中一个画布可以容纳您的布局、其运动以及 你从中给出的演示。连接这个插件，你的助手就可以在里面工作 您已经在 SSHOW 编辑器中打开的项目：它读取场景并 对象，添加或更改文本、形状、图像和关键帧，并采取 截图来检查自己的工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: SSHOW is a design tool where one canvas holds your layout, its motion, and the presentation you give from it. Connect this plugin and your assistant works inside the project you already have open in a SSHOW editor: it reads the scenes and objects, adds or changes text, shapes, images and keyframes, and takes a screenshot to check its own work.

plugins.name: The Altiora Codex Oracle
plugins.productIntro: Altiora Codex Oracle 是一个用于个人、精神和创造性反思的数字环境。用户可以打开一卡、三卡或五卡阅读，对于多卡阅读，可以选择完整阅读、核心信息或个人传输。 Oracle 支持英语和荷兰语，读数可以保存为文档或 PDF。它旨在供个人反思和启发，不能取代医疗、法律、财务或其他专业建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Altiora Codex Oracle is a digital environment for personal, spiritual, and creative reflection. Users can open one-card, three-card, or five-card readings and, for multi-card readings, choose between a Full Reading, Core Message, or Personal Transmission. The Oracle supports both English and Dutch, and readings can be saved as a document or PDF.

plugins.name: Dramatica
plugins.productIntro: Dramatica 帮助经过身份验证的作家检查保存的故事和故事形式，检索先前的故事开发上下文，比较规范示例，验证结构约束，并在不丢失 Dramatica 上下文的情况下进行准确确认的更改。
plugins.productIntroEn: Dramatica helps authenticated writers inspect saved Stories and Storyforms, retrieve prior story-development context, compare canonical examples, validate structural constraints, and make exact confirmed changes without losing Dramatica context.

plugins.name: Flixly
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Flixly 的精选目录和您现有的积分从 ChatGPT 创建图像和短视频。比较支持的模型和估计成本，开始一代工作，并遵循同一工作在对话中得到可用的结果。您的 Flixly 历史记录中出现了几代人。该集成不支持购买或订阅。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create images and short videos from ChatGPT using Flixly’s curated catalog and your existing credits. Compare supported models and estimated costs, start one generation job, and follow that same job to a usable result in the conversation. Generations appear in your Flixly history. The integration does not support purchases or subscriptions.

plugins.name: Videomagic
plugins.productIntro: Videomagic 将 ChatGPT 中讨论的主题、粘贴的摘要、公共 URL 和附加文件转换为视频。 ChatGPT 根据当前上下文创作视频描述；该应用程序不会请求或传输原始对话历史记录。用户可以在不离开 ChatGPT 的情况下查看待处理的草稿、确认渲染、调整视频设置、跟踪进度以及播放已完成的媒体。
plugins.productIntroEn: Videomagic turns topics discussed in ChatGPT, pasted briefs, public URLs, and attached files into videos. ChatGPT authors a video description from the current context; the app does not request or transmit raw conversation history. Users can review a pending draft, confirm rendering, adjust video settings, track progress, and play completed media without leaving ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Arrayco Crew Hub
plugins.productIntro: 打开 Arrayco Crew Hub 并搜索 BC Building Code 2024 和 WorkSafeBC OHS 法规中的只读参考。结果链接到官方来源，仅供施工参考，而不是针对特定项目的专业建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Open Arrayco Crew Hub and search read-only references from the BC Building Code 2024 and WorkSafeBC OHS Regulation. Results link to official sources and are intended for construction reference, not project-specific professional advice.

plugins.name: OEG AI Studio
plugins.description: 使用 OEG 创建图像
plugins.productIntro: OEG AI Studio 将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 直接连接到每个用户的 OEG 帐户。用户可以检查服务状态、探索图像和视频模型、查看自己的头像和工作、估算生成成本，并且只有在明确的成本批准后才能创建一张付费图像。安装插件并不授予访问权限；每个用户都使用自己的 OEG 凭据登录。
plugins.productIntroEn: OEG AI Studio connects ChatGPT and Codex directly to each user's OEG account. Users can check service status, explore image and video models, view their own avatars and jobs, estimate generation costs, and create one paid image only after explicit cost approval. Installing the plugin does not grant access; every user signs in with their own OEG credentials.

plugins.name: Air
plugins.productIntro: Air 了解您的品牌、组织您的库并扩展创意，同时让人们参与最重要的事情。
plugins.productIntroEn: Air understands your brand, organizes your library, and scales creative while keeping humans involved where they matter most.

plugins.name: Mirelo
plugins.productIntro: 从文本或视频生成和编辑声音效果、拟音和氛围。扩展现有音频并替换选定的音频区域。使用音频到 MIDI 转录将现有录音转换为 MIDI 和乐谱。使用您的 Mirelo 帐户和积分。
plugins.productIntroEn: Generate and edit sound effects, foley, and ambience from text or video. Extend existing audio and replace selected audio regions. Convert existing recordings into MIDI and notation with Audio-to-MIDI transcription. Uses your Mirelo account and credits.

plugins.name: Content Lab
plugins.productIntro: 内容实验室帮助学习者在专用网站上设置品牌记忆、徽标、参考材料和多个受众档案，然后重复使用 ChatGPT 中保存的上下文来起草 Facebook 标题、TikTok 脚本和图像简介。数据按用户和教室分开。内容实验室不要求学员或讲师提供单独的 OpenAI API 密钥。
plugins.productIntroEn: Content Lab helps learners set up Brand Memory, logos, reference materials, and multiple audience profiles on a dedicated website, then reuse that saved context in ChatGPT to draft Facebook captions, TikTok scripts, and image briefs. Data is separated by user and classroom. Content Lab does not require learners or instructors to provide a separate OpenAI API key.

plugins.name: Vocuno
plugins.description: 创建和编辑 AI 音乐
plugins.productIntro: 根据提示或您自己的歌词创建原创歌曲，然后在 ChatGPT 中处理音频。 Vocuno 可以修剪、混合、母带、分离主干、清理录音、转换声音和文件格式、检测节奏和扩展歌曲。它连接到您现有的 Vocuno 帐户，以便生成和处理的音频保留在您的库中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create original songs from a prompt or your own lyrics, then work with audio inside ChatGPT. Vocuno can trim, mix, master, separate stems, clean up recordings, convert voices and file formats, detect tempo, and extend a song. It connects to your existing Vocuno account so generated and processed audio stays in your library.

plugins.name: DevMotion
plugins.productIntro: DevMotion 帮助用户创建云动画项目、添加可编辑图层并对其进行动画处理、导入或生成媒体、检查帧以及渲染来自 ChatGPT 的成品视频。
plugins.productIntroEn: DevMotion helps users create cloud animation projects, add and animate editable layers, import or generate media, inspect frames, and render finished videos from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Aspicio
plugins.description: 查看和检查 DXF 图纸
plugins.productIntro: Aspicio 将 DXF CAD 绘图转换为 ChatGPT 可以使用的东西：结构化事实（单位、边界、具有实际绘制颜色的图层、实体计数和绘图的文本内容）、渲染的 PNG 图像以及具有平移、缩放、图层切换和全屏功能的交互式聊天查看器。将其指向绘图 URL 或粘贴 DXF 文本即可读取标题块和尺寸值、检查图层结构以及目视检查平面图、模切布局和机械零件，而无需离开对话。
plugins.productIntroEn: Aspicio turns DXF CAD drawings into things ChatGPT can work with: structured facts (units, bounds, layers with the colors actually drawn, entity counts, and the drawing's text content), rendered PNG images, and an interactive in-chat viewer with pan, zoom, layer toggles, and fullscreen.

plugins.name: kernelCAD
plugins.description: 简单英语到 CAD 模型
plugins.productIntro: kernelCAD 将自然语言描述转化为真实的参数化 CAD 模型。请求零件、支架、外壳或机构，kernelCAD 会编写由真正的 BREP 内核 (OpenCascade) 支持的可编辑 .kcad.ts 源代码，然后让您检查拓扑、运行设计检查（干扰、可制造性、可达性、负载）并导出到 STEP/STL。每个模型都会在对话中的交互式 3D 查看器中打开，因此您可以旋转、缩放和查看零件，而无需离开 ChatGPT。
plugins.productIntroEn: kernelCAD turns natural-language descriptions into real, parametric CAD models. Ask for a part, bracket, enclosure, or mechanism and kernelCAD writes editable .kcad.ts source backed by a true BREP kernel (OpenCascade), then lets you inspect topology, run design checks (interference, manufacturability, reachability, load), and export to STEP/STL.

plugins.name: Malloy Studio
plugins.productIntro: 从简单的文本提示生成可定制的动态图形。创建动画标题、图表、下三分之一、社交叠加、产品视觉效果等，然后调整设计并将其导出以在视频中使用。 Malloy Studio 可帮助创作者和视频编辑者制作动态图形，而无需在 After Effects 中从头开始。
plugins.productIntroEn: Generate customizable motion graphics from simple text prompts. Create animated titles, charts, lower thirds, social overlays, product visuals, and more, then adjust the design and export it for use in your videos. Malloy Studio helps creators and video editors make motion graphics without starting from scratch in After Effects.

plugins.name: Heyzine Flipbooks
plugins.productIntro: Heyzine Flipbooks 帮助用户将文档转换为交互式在线翻页书、管理出版物和书架、搜索页面文本、配置访问权限以及通过 ChatGPT 生成嵌入代码。
plugins.productIntroEn: Heyzine Flipbooks helps users convert documents into interactive online flipbooks, manage publications and bookshelves, search page text, configure access, and generate embed code through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Widemile
plugins.productIntro: 将创意简报转变为结构化的 Widemile 制作：规划项目、生成图像、视频、音频和音乐资产、组织结果、编辑制作界面以及预览已完成的媒体内联。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn a creative brief into a structured Widemile production: plan projects, generate image, video, audio, and music assets, organize results, edit production surfaces, and preview completed media inline.

plugins.name: AI Fashion Designer
plugins.originalDescription: Design a garment end to end
plugins.productIntro: 人工智能时装设计师帮助设计师将想法转化为成品时装作品。开发服装、创建技术平面、可视化模型设计、生成编辑和时装秀内容，并构建可共享的作品集来展示您的作品、直接向品牌推销并探索工作机会。
plugins.productIntroEn: AI Fashion Designer helps designers turn ideas into finished fashion work. Develop garments, create technical flats, visualize designs on models, generate editorial and runway content, and build a shareable portfolio to present your work, pitch directly to brands, and explore job opportunities.

plugins.name: Inkroost
plugins.productIntro: Inkroost 帮助创作者规划漫画、网络漫画和漫画系列，定义一致的角色和设置，生成和审查页面艺术，添加可访问的文本，并提交完成的章节以供 ChatGPT 审核。
plugins.productIntroEn: Inkroost helps creators plan comic, webtoon, and manga series, define consistent characters and settings, generate and review page art, add accessible text, and submit finished chapters for moderation from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Loomly
plugins.productIntro: 在 Loomly 中规划、组织和管理社交媒体内容。使用 ChatGPT 查看日历、帖子、帖子想法和库内容，并在 Loomly 帐户中创建草稿帖子和帖子想法。
plugins.productIntroEn: Plan, organize, and manage social media content in Loomly. Use ChatGPT to review calendars, posts, post ideas, and library content, and to create draft posts and post ideas in your Loomly account.

plugins.name: 3aqel Arabic Creative
plugins.description: 创建阿拉伯语设计和音频
plugins.productIntro: 为优惠、公告和社交帖子创建可编辑的阿拉伯语动态图形设计。浏览真实模板，填充文本和颜色，然后在 3aqel 中打开您的个性化设计以预览、编辑和请求导出。创建设计是免费的，不需要帐户。可共享的设计链接将在 7 天后过期；聊天工具不会呈现视频或发送电子邮件。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create editable Arabic motion graphic designs for offers, announcements and social posts. Browse real templates, fill their text and colors, then open your personalized design in 3aqel to preview, edit and request export. Creating a design is free and does not require an account. Shareable design links expire after seven days; the chat tool does not render video or send email.

plugins.name: Rendemo
plugins.productIntro: Rendemo 将产品录音转变为交互式演示。使用 Rendemo 浏览器扩展完善并发布您录制的演示，将任何网站转变为托管的点击式沙箱演示，并构建在您自己的实时应用程序中运行的交互式产品导览 - 然后使用一个脚本标签将其中任何一个嵌入到您的网站上。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rendemo turns product recordings into interactive demos. Polish and publish the demos you record with the Rendemo browser extension, turn any website into a hosted click-through sandbox demo, and build interactive product tours that run inside your own live app — then embed any of them on your site with one script tag.

plugins.name: Musamimuk
plugins.productIntro: Musamimuk 是一位人工智能设计编辑。登录后，ChatGPT 可以列出您的设计、创建空白画布、根据提示生成可编辑的海报、制作库图像、删除背景、分析拥有的图像或创建 QR 代码。设计在 Musamimuk 应用程序中打开以完成编辑。图像生成使用您的 Musamimuk 硬币。
plugins.productIntroEn: Musamimuk is an AI design editor. After you sign in, ChatGPT can list your designs, create a blank canvas, generate an editable poster from a prompt, make a library image, remove a background, analyze an owned image, or create a QR code. Designs open in the Musamimuk app to finish editing. Image generation uses your Musamimuk coins.

plugins.name: Goldie
plugins.productIntro: Goldie 是按需印刷卖家的设计策略师。分析畅销书以了解其畅销原因，将这些成分转化为新鲜的原创概念，将一种设计扩展为完整的产品线，为您的利基市场生成适合市场的短语，揭示新兴趋势，并为您的商店绘制交叉利基市场。 Goldie 还可以检查设计文件是否可以打印。它旨在帮助您更快地创建原创的、具有商业头脑的设计。
plugins.productIntroEn: Goldie is a design strategist for print-on-demand sellers. Analyze a bestseller to see why it sells, turn those ingredients into fresh original concepts, expand one design into a full product line, generate market-ready phrases for your niche, surface emerging trends, and map crossover niches for your shop. Goldie can also check whether a design file is print-ready.

plugins.name: VideoGen
plugins.description: 使用 AI 创建和编辑视频
plugins.originalDescription: Create and edit videos with AI
plugins.productIntro: 使用您的 VideoGen 帐户从 ChatGPT 创建专业、可编辑的视频和媒体。随时在 videogen.io 上完善项目。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create professional, editable videos and media from ChatGPT with your VideoGen account. Refine projects anytime on videogen.io.

plugins.name: FLORA
plugins.productIntro: FLORA 插件允许用户直接从对话中生成、组织和迭代视觉资产——英雄图像、情绪板、生活方式镜头、宣传图形。当与 Notion、Google Drive 或 Slack 等其他互联工具一起使用时，相同的对话可以提取上下文并将结果写回到团队已经工作的地方。身份验证是通过您现有的 FLORA 帐户进行的 OAuth。
plugins.productIntroEn: The FLORA plugin lets users generate, organize, and iterate on visual assets — hero images, moodboards, lifestyle shots, promo graphics — directly from a conversation. When used alongside other connected tools like Notion, Google Drive, or Slack, the same conversation can pull in context and write results back to where the team already works.

plugins.name: PosterMyWall
plugins.productIntro: PosterMyWall 将设计模板带入您的聊天中。描述您需要什么 - 盛大的开业传单、迎婴派对邀请函、乐队徽标、Instagram 促销帖子；并浏览对话中出现的模板选项。
plugins.productIntroEn: PosterMyWall brings design templates into your chat. Describe what you need - a grand opening flyer, a baby shower invitation, a band logo, an Instagram sale post; and browse template options that appear right in the conversation.

plugins.name: Drivethrough
plugins.productIntro: 描述您想要的网站，几秒钟内即可上线。无需代码，无需设置，无需学习网站构建器 - 您说出您想要的内容，ChatGPT 构建它，Drivethrough 将其放到网上。
plugins.productIntroEn: Describe the website you want, and it's live in seconds. No code, no settings, no website builder to learn - you say what you want, ChatGPT builds it, and Drivethrough puts it online.

plugins.name: Davia Creation
plugins.productIntro: Davia Creation 帮助创作者构建和修改私人 Davia 游戏草稿。选择一个游戏，检查它的世界文件，并更新它的前提、规则、统计数据、角色、地点和位置。
plugins.productIntroEn: Davia Creation helps creators build and revise private Davia game drafts. Select a game, inspect its world files, and update its premise, rules, stats, characters, places, and placements.

plugins.name: Proposal.Biz
plugins.productIntro: 只需一个提示，即可在 60 秒内创建专业、设计精美的商业文档。只需描述您的需求，剩下的就交给人工智能吧。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create professional, beautifully designed business documents from a single prompt in under 60 seconds. Just describe what you need and let AI do the rest.

plugins.name: Embroidery File Converter
plugins.productIntro: 将 PNG、JPG、SVG 和 WebP 图稿数字化为绣花设计，或在 PES、DST、JEF、VP3、EXP 等机器格式之间转换现有绣花文件。上传文件以创建私人针迹预览，然后在 ChatGPT 中查看线程渲染的针迹、尺寸、线颜色、警告和生产指标。
plugins.productIntroEn: Digitize PNG, JPG, SVG, and WebP artwork into embroidery designs, or convert existing embroidery files between machine formats such as PES, DST, JEF, VP3, EXP, and more. Upload a file to create a private stitch preview, then review thread-rendered stitches, dimensions, thread colours, warnings, and production metrics in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: AINSOF
plugins.productIntro: AINSOF 帮助电影制作人和创作者找到原创音乐、从参考中发现类似曲目、分析视频以获取配乐推荐、预览曲目、构建提示表以及请求曲目交付或许可支持。
plugins.productIntroEn: AINSOF helps filmmakers and creators find original production music, discover similar tracks from a reference, analyze video for soundtrack recommendations, preview tracks, build cue sheets, and request track delivery or licensing support.

plugins.name: Sequencer
plugins.description: 创建与编辑 AI 视频。
plugins.productIntro: Sequencer 可帮助用户规划视频项目、生成图像、视频和音频资源、编辑场景和时间线、审查剪辑以及通过 ChatGPT 导出完成的视频。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sequencer helps users plan video projects, generate image, video, and audio assets, edit scenes and timelines, review cuts, and export finished videos through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Clipwave Video & Image Maker
plugins.description: 创建 AI 图像和视频
plugins.productIntro: 描述图像或视频，选择格式，然后在连接的 Clipwave 工作区中生成它。创建产品照片、社交视觉效果和徽标概念，然后检查您这一代人的状态。需要 Clipwave 帐户和可用的发电积分。
plugins.productIntroEn: Describe an image or video, choose the format, and generate it in your connected Clipwave workspace. Create product shots, social visuals and logo concepts, then check the status of your generation. A Clipwave account and available generation credits are required.

plugins.name: Synthesia
plugins.productIntro: Synthesia 可以将您正在制作的任何内容转变为成品的品牌视频。
plugins.productIntroEn: Synthesia turns whatever you're working on into a finished, on-brand video.

plugins.name: Butter
plugins.productIntro: Butter 是一款视频编辑器，可让您和您的团队与人工智能进行协作。 Butter MCP 可以吸收您的资源和背景，并帮助您制作具有专业动作的广告。您可以通过完全手动控制继续在浏览器中编辑任何 Butter 项目：更改副本、在画布上移动内容、在时间轴上重新定时等等。使用人工智能帮助您快速行动，并且永远不会失去控制或质量。
plugins.productIntroEn: Butter is the video editor that lets you and your team collaborate with AI. The Butter MCP can pull in your assets and context and help you create ads with professional motion. You can continue to edit any Butter project in the browser with full manual control: change copy, move things around on canvas, retime on the timeline, and more.

plugins.name: ShotClick
plugins.productIntro: ShotClick 是一个剧本编辑器：专业格式化、锁定场景编号、修订通道、制作细目以及 .fdx 导入和导出。
plugins.productIntroEn: ShotClick is a screenplay editor: professional formatting, locked scene numbers, revision passes, production breakdown, and .fdx import and export.

plugins.name: Sonilo
plugins.productIntro: 通过简单的提示或公共视频链接生成完全许可的 AI 音乐、背景音乐、音效和视频配乐。 Sonilo 可以将音频与视频相匹配，保持语音清晰，将音乐或音效混合到新视频中，并在画外音下自动降低背景音乐。将其用于社交视频、产品演示、播客、广告、游戏、演示等。
plugins.productIntroEn: Generate fully licensed AI music, background music, sound effects, and video soundtracks from a simple prompt or a public video link. Sonilo can match audio to your video, keep speech clear, mix music or sound effects into a new video, and automatically lower background music under voiceovers. Use it for social videos, product demos, podcasts, ads, games, presentations, and more.

plugins.name: Clueso
plugins.description: 根据提示编辑或创建视频
plugins.originalDescription: Edit or create video by prompt
plugins.productIntro: Clueso MCP 为 Chatgpt 提供了一个完整的视频制作工具箱，连接到您的 Clueso 工作区。 Clueso 将屏幕录像、幻灯片、文档或简单的提示转变为成品视频和分步书面指南；这个连接器将所有内容都放在聊天中。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Clueso MCP gives Chatgpt a complete video production toolbox, connected to your Clueso workspace. Clueso turns screen recordings, slide decks, documents, or a plain prompt into finished videos and step-by-step written guides; this connector puts all of it in the chat.

plugins.name: AdKraft
plugins.productIntro: AdKraft 将产品照片转化为成品视频广告。给它一个产品名称、一个简短的描述和一些照片链接，它就会编写脚本、生成镜头、添加 16 种语言中任意一种的画外音，然后交回您可以发布的 MP4——纵向、方形或横向，通常需要两到五分钟。广告是在您自己的 AdKraft 帐户上制作并使用其积分；新帐户从免费积分开始，您可以在不离开聊天室的情况下检查余额或列出您制作的广告。
plugins.productIntroEn: AdKraft turns product photos into finished video ads. Give it a product name, a short description and a few photo links, and it writes the script, generates the footage, adds a voiceover in any of 16 languages and hands back an MP4 you can post — in portrait, square or landscape, usually in two to five minutes.

plugins.name: Namsiang Thai Voice
plugins.productIntro: 按性别、年龄、个性和角色分配泰语配音；在戏剧、配音和旁白中逐行表达情感和节奏；然后直接在 ChatGPT 中创建、跟踪、播放和下载私人音频，而无需暴露提供商 API 密钥或语音 ID。
plugins.productIntroEn: Cast Thai voices by gender, age, personality, and role; direct emotion and pacing line by line for drama, dubbing, and narration; then create, track, play, and download private audio directly in ChatGPT without exposing provider API keys or voice IDs.

plugins.name: Quickads
plugins.productIntro: QuickAds 可帮助您研究成功的广告、发现流行趋势并将见解转化为新的广告活动。创建 AI 图像和视频、发布帖子、启动广告活动、运行自动化代理以及分析内容、广告和广告帐户的效果 - 全部从一处完成。
plugins.productIntroEn: QuickAds helps you research successful ads, discover trending hooks, and turn insights into new campaigns. Create AI images and videos, publish posts, launch ad campaigns, run automated agents, and analyze the performance of your content, ads, and ad accounts - all from one place.

plugins.name: Ullbek
plugins.productIntro: 用简单的语言描述您的业务或想法，Ullbek 会围绕它构建一个真实的自定义网站 - 为您编写的实际页面，而不是带有天花板的模板块。通过实时预览链接观看它的组合，以简单的语言询问任何更改，并在准备好后将其发布到网络上。每个网站都会获得一个免费地址，其中包括免费托管；高级托管连接您自己的自定义域。无需模板，无需拖放，无需编码——您描述它，它就构建好了，它就是实时的。
plugins.productIntroEn: Describe your business or idea in plain words and Ullbek builds a real, custom website around it — actual pages written for you, not template blocks with a ceiling. Watch it come together through live preview links, ask for any change in plain language, and publish it to the web when it's ready.

plugins.name: Remotion
plugins.productIntro: Remotion：精心制作视频。
plugins.productIntroEn: Build videos programmatically with Remotion and React. Covers animations, timing, audio, captions, 3D, transitions, charts, text effects, and more.

plugins.name: 굿새김 Goodsaegim
plugins.productIntro: Goodsaegim定制商品--亚克力钥匙圈、亚克力支架、贴纸、明信片、照片卡等--从一件开始小批量生产。 非常适合粉丝会员礼物、艺术家商品和用您自己的艺术品制作的一次性礼物。 聊天选择产品和选项（尺寸、数量、配件） ，获取实时报价 包括增值税和运费，一旦规格结算，将收到链接，引导您完成艺术品上传和付款。 在生产前检查您的文件是否已打印就绪。 由制造商自行在韩国制造；仅在韩国境内发货。 涵盖11种产品，包括选项信息、报价和订单链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Goodsaegim makes custom goods — acrylic keyrings, acrylic stands, stickers, postcards, photo cards and more — in small runs starting from a single piece. Ideal for fan merch, artist goods, and one-off gifts made from your own artwork.

plugins.name: AI Humanizer
plugins.productIntro: 使用终极 AI Humanizer 工具将 AI 生成的内容转换为自然的、类似人类的文本。这款人工智能到人类的文本转换器可以轻松地将人工智能的输出转换为人性化文本。

Edit, design, and add features from chat, connect tools in one click, add smart agents, schedule tasks on autopilot, and track analytics If you can describe it, you can build it with Base44.

plugins.productIntroEn: Use Netlify to inspect deployment state, manage sites, and pair the Netlify app with the curated deployment skill for preview and production workflows.

plugins.name: GSC Wizard
plugins.productIntro: GSC 向导将 ChatGPT 连接到您自己的 Google Search Console 属性，以便您可以用简单的语言分析 SEO 性能。询问效果摘要、您的热门查询和页面、两个时期之间的排名变化、内容衰减、关键词蚕食、点击率与位置曲线或完整的 SEO 报告，并获得完整的答复。每个分析都是在服务器端针对数据仓库进行计算，而不是将数千个原始行流式传输到模型中，因此结果快速、准确且高效。
plugins.productIntroEn: GSC Wizard connects ChatGPT to your own Google Search Console properties so you can analyze SEO performance in plain language. Ask for a performance summary, your top queries and pages, ranking changes between two periods, content decay, keyword cannibalization, CTR-versus-position curves, or a full SEO report, and get a finished answer back.

plugins.name: TinyFish
plugins.productIntro: TinyFish 帮助 ChatGPT 回答网络问题并完成用户主导的浏览器工作流程。它可以搜索网络、读取特定页面，并运行实时浏览器会话来执行需要交互的任务，例如导航网站、单击、填写表单、检查页面状态或在网络应用程序中工作。将其用于特定要求的任务；它不适用于广泛的爬行、批量 URL 处理或未指定的第三方访问。
plugins.productIntroEn: TinyFish helps ChatGPT answer web questions and complete user-directed browser workflows. It can search the web, read specific pages, and run a live browser session for tasks that require interaction, such as navigating a site, clicking, filling forms, checking page state, or working inside a web app.

plugins.name: Resend
plugins.productIntro: Resend 帮助用户使用自己的 Resend 凭据发送交易电子邮件、检查传送和请求日志、管理受众、域、模板、广播、自动化、Webhooks、API 密钥和 ChatGPT 的 OAuth 授权。
plugins.productIntroEn: Resend helps users send transactional email, inspect delivery and request logs, manage audiences, domains, templates, broadcasts, automations, webhooks, API keys, and OAuth grants from ChatGPT using their own Resend credentials.

plugins.name: WordPress.com
plugins.description: 使用 WordPress 构建和发布
plugins.productIntro: 描述您的需求，WordPress 会构建它：作品集、餐厅菜单、博客、在线商店。告诉 WordPress 有关您的业务、您的受众以及您需要哪些页面的信息。它规划网站、编写内容、选择设计并在 WordPress.com 上发布。
plugins.productIntroEn: Describe what you need and WordPress builds it: a portfolio, a restaurant menu, a blog, an online store. Tell WordPress about your business, your audience, what pages you need. It plans the site, writes the content, picks a design, and launches it on WordPress.com.

plugins.name: Context7
plugins.productIntro: 法学硕士依赖于有关您使用的图书馆的过时或通用信息。您会得到基于一年前的训练数据的过时代码示例和甚至不存在的幻觉 API。
plugins.productIntroEn: LLMs rely on outdated or generic information about the libraries you use. You get outdated code examples based on year-old training data and hallucinated APIs that don't even exist.

plugins.name: Datadog
plugins.productIntro: Datadog MCP Server 可帮助用户调查可观测性数据、检查仪表板和笔记本、加载 Datadog 技能指南、搜索 Datadog 实体、查看变更故事，并通过 ChatGPT 对此范围连接可视化 Datadog 指标、日志、跟踪、RUM 事件、事件、主机、监视器和事件。
plugins.productIntroEn: Datadog MCP Server helps users investigate observability data, inspect dashboards and notebooks, load Datadog skill guidance, search Datadog entities, review change stories, and visualize Datadog metrics, logs, traces, RUM events, incidents, hosts, monitors, and events through ChatGPT for this scoped connection.

plugins.name: Replit
plugins.description: 将您的想法转化为真正的应用程序
plugins.originalDescription: Turn your ideas into real apps
plugins.productIntro: Replit 将您的想法变成真实的、可运行的网络应用程序和网站，无需编码或设置。用简单的语言描述您想要什么，Replit 的 AI 代理会为您构建一个工作应用程序（前端、后端、数据库和根据需要进行身份验证），然后托管它，以便您可以立即使用和共享它。保持对话以完善和扩展您的应用程序，询问功能如何工作，或检查它是否准备好部署。它非常适合快速原型设计、快速实验、内部工具以及将想法转化为您实际上可以像您描述的一样快地运行的东西。
plugins.productIntroEn: Replit turns your ideas into real, running web apps and websites, with no coding or setup required. Describe what you want in plain language and Replit's AI Agent builds a working app for you (frontend, backend, database, and auth as needed), then hosts it so you can use and share it right away.

plugins.name: Tavily
plugins.productIntro: AI 代理的 Web 基础设施层。专门构建的 Web API，用于实时搜索、抓取、爬行和结构化数据检索。人工智能原生企业信赖 Tavilly 的数据丰富、研究、RAG 管道和自主人工智能系统，确保提供新鲜、准确和可扩展的智能。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Web Infrastructure Layer for AI Agents. A purpose-built web API for real-time search, scraping, crawling, and structured data retrieval. AI-native enterprises trust Tavily for data enrichment, research, RAG pipelines, and autonomous AI systems-ensuring fresh, accurate, and scalable intelligence.

plugins.name: Convex
plugins.productIntro: Convex 通过反应式、类型安全的后端帮助用户构建和扩展 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 应用程序。该应用程序为 ChatGPT 新项目、现有前端集成、生产扩展问题和捆绑的 Convex 快速入门操作手册提供了具体的 Convex 设置指南，以便代理遵循当前的部署、身份验证和组件模式，而不是从过时的内存中手动滚动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Convex helps users build and scale JavaScript and TypeScript apps with a reactive, type-safe backend. The app gives ChatGPT concrete Convex setup guidance for new projects, existing frontend integrations, production scaling questions, and the bundled Convex quickstart runbook so agents follow the current deployment, auth, and component patterns instead of hand-rolling from stale memory.

plugins.name: SentinelX
plugins.productIntro: SentinelX 允许您从 ChatGPT 管理 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 服务器 - 无需 SSH。在任何 Linux、macOS 或 Windows 主机上安装小型开源代理，ChatGPT 可以运行检查命令、管理服务（systemd、launchd 或 Windows 服务）、读取/搜索/编辑文件、运行脚本、上传文件以及调用 Cloudflare DNS、Resend 和 Telegram 等集成。
plugins.productIntroEn: SentinelX lets you manage your Linux, macOS, and Windows servers from ChatGPT — no SSH required. Install a small open-source agent on any Linux, macOS, or Windows host, and ChatGPT can run inspection commands, manage services (systemd, launchd, or Windows services), read/search/edit files, run scripts, upload files, and call out to integrations like Cloudflare DNS, Resend, and Telegram.

plugins.name: Mermaid Chart
plugins.productIntro: 验证 Mermaid 语法，将图表渲染为高质量 SVG，并立即在交互式 UI 中显示它们，用户可以在其中实时预览、缩放和迭代。
plugins.productIntroEn: Validates Mermaid syntax, renders diagrams as high-quality SVG, and displays them instantly in an interactive UI where users can preview, zoom, and iterate in real time.

plugins.name: GitLab (Beta)
plugins.description: 对 GitLab MR 和 CI/CD 进行分类
plugins.productIntro: 将您的 GitLab 工作流程引入 ChatGPT。探索项目和存储库、管理问题、审查合并请求、解决反馈并调查失败的 CI/CD 检查。准备好后，进行代码更改并打开草稿合并请求。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring your GitLab workflow into ChatGPT. Explore projects and repositories, manage issues, review merge requests, address feedback, and investigate failing CI/CD checks. When you're ready, make code changes and open a draft merge request.

plugins.name: Hugging Face
plugins.description: 检查模型、数据集、空间和研究
plugins.originalDescription: Inspect models, datasets, Spaces, and research
plugins.productIntro: 连接到 Hugging Face Hub 以探索模型和数据集、访问 SDK 文档等。管理机器学习作业并通过 Spaces 连接到数千个人工智能应用程序。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect to the Hugging Face Hub to explore Models and Datasets, access SDK Documentation and more. Manage Machine Learning Jobs and connect to thousands of AI applications via Spaces.

plugins.name: Hercules
plugins.productIntro: Hercules 可以通过与 AI 聊天轻松构建应用程序和网站。
plugins.productIntroEn: Hercules makes it easy to build apps and websites by chatting with AI.

plugins.name: DigitalOcean
plugins.description: 将 Droplet 配置为 Codex 工作区
plugins.originalDescription: Provision a droplet as a Codex workspace
plugins.productIntro: 使用连接的 DigitalOcean 应用程序配置 DigitalOcean Droplet 作为远程 Codex SSH 工作区。
plugins.productIntroEn: Provision and configure a DigitalOcean droplet as a remote Codex SSH workspace using the connected DigitalOcean app.

plugins.name: Namecheap
plugins.productIntro: Namecheap 支持单个或多个域名的域名可用性检查和定价查找。用户可以搜索特定域名，在域名不可用时请求替代建议，并比较不同 TLD 的定价。服务器从 Namecheap 平台返回实时可用性状态和准确定价。最适用于域发现、批量域检查以及帮助用户找到可用的替代方案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Namecheap’s enables domain name availability checking and pricing lookup for single or multiple domains. Users can search for specific domains, request alternative suggestions when domains are unavailable, and compare pricing across different TLDs. The server returns real-time availability status and accurate pricing from Namecheap's Platform.

plugins.name: GitBook
plugins.description: 创建和编辑 GitBook 文档
plugins.productIntro: The GitBook MCP server gives AI agents a full read/write connection to your GitBook organization. Create and configure docs sites, spaces, and sections;起草、编辑和重组内容；打开变更请求并推送更新以供审核；发布 OpenAPI 规范； and manage site customization — all…
plugins.productIntroEn: The GitBook MCP server gives AI agents a full read/write connection to your GitBook organization. Create and configure docs sites, spaces, and sections; draft, edit, and restructure content; open change requests and push updates for review; publish OpenAPI specs; and manage site customization — all through natural conversation, with OAuth sign-in or a personal access token.

plugins.name: Cloudinary
plugins.description: 管理、修改和托管您的图像和视频
plugins.originalDescription: Manage, modify, and host your images & videos
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 Codex 管理、搜索和转换您的 Cloudinary 媒体库。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage, search, and transform your Cloudinary media library — directly from Codex.

plugins.name: ShipStatic
plugins.productIntro: 告诉 ChatGPT 您在线想要什么 - 登陆页面、作品集、个人网站、快速演示 - 该应用程序会立即将其发布到网络上。您立即获得一个真实的、可共享的 URL。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tell ChatGPT what you want online — a landing page, a portfolio, a personal site, a quick demo — and this app publishes it on the web instantly. You get a real, shareable URL right away.

plugins.name: OpenAI Developers
plugins.description: 使用 OpenAI 最佳实践开发 AI 应用程序、代理和 ChatGPT 应用程序
plugins.originalDescription: Develop AI apps, agents, and ChatGPT Apps with OpenAI best practices
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Codex 中的 OpenAI Developers 构建 AI 应用程序、代理和 ChatGPT 应用程序。使用 Agents API 和 OpenAI 托管的沙箱构建代理，或使用 Agents SDK 来实现应用程序拥有的代理循环、切换和护栏。连接到 OpenAI Platform (platform.openai.com) 以配置 API 密钥、在本地部署 Agents SDK 项目、搭建 ChatGPT 应用程序并准备提交工件。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use OpenAI Developers in Codex to build AI applications, agents, and ChatGPT Apps. Build agents with the Agents API and OpenAI-hosted sandboxes, or use the Agents SDK for application-owned agent loops, handoffs, and guardrails. Connect to the OpenAI Platform (platform.openai.

plugins.name: MongoDB Atlas
plugins.productIntro: 管理 MongoDB Atlas 并查询您的数据。连接到任何 MongoDB 集群或 Atlas 项目以运行查询和聚合、检查架构和索引以及读/写文档。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage MongoDB Atlas and query your data. Connect to any MongoDB cluster or Atlas project to run queries and aggregations, inspect schemas and indexes, and read/write documents.

plugins.name: HAPI MCP Registry
plugins.productIntro: MCP 注册表是可公开访问的 MCP 服务器的集中数据库，由 MCP 生态系统中值得信赖的贡献者提供支持。
plugins.productIntroEn: The MCP Registry is a centralized database of publicly accessible MCP servers, supported by trusted contributors in the MCP ecosystem.

plugins.name: Devpost Hackathons
plugins.description: 查找并提交至黑客马拉松
plugins.productIntro: 来自领先的黑客马拉松平台 Devpost。查找黑客马拉松、注册、构建和提交，所有这些都无需离开 ChatGPT。可选的构建助理将引导您完成构思、范围界定和规划，以帮助您交付强大的项目。
plugins.productIntroEn: From Devpost, the leading hackathon platform. Find hackathons, register, build, and submit, all without leaving ChatGPT. An optional build assistant walks you through ideation, scoping, and planning to help you ship a strong project.

plugins.name: Grow My Website
plugins.productIntro: 扫描任何公共网页，了解 11 个 SEO 基础知识，并使用简单的语言“为什么重要”以及每个问题的解决示例，获取 10 步网站增长框架，或查找如何解决特定 SEO 问题
plugins.productIntroEn: Scan any public web page for 11 SEO fundamentals with a plain-language 'why it matters' and example fix for each issue, get a 10-step website growth framework, or look up how to fix a specific SEO issue

plugins.name: Mintlify MCP
plugins.productIntro: 将 Mintlify 连接到 Claude，无需离开对话即可保持文档准确且最新。克劳德可以搜索每个页面，直接阅读和编辑内容，并发布更改。非常适合在产品更改后修复过时的页面，随着产品的增长重新组织部分，或在其记录的代码旁边起草新内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect Mintlify to Claude to keep your documentation accurate and up to date without leaving your conversations. Claude can search across every page, read and edit content directly, and ship changes. Perfect for fixing outdated pages after a product change, reorganizing sections as your product grows, or drafting new content alongside the code it documents.

plugins.name: Code Tytor: Python
plugins.productIntro: 生成干净的 Python 代码，了解其用途，并通过清晰的解释改进现有脚本。练习真实任务、纠正错误并逐步提高您的 Python 技能。
plugins.productIntroEn: Generate clean Python code, understand what it does, and improve existing scripts with clear explanations. Practice real tasks, fix mistakes, and grow your Python skills step by step.

plugins.name: NVIDIA Skills
plugins.description: 找到合适的 NVIDIA 技能
plugins.productIntro: 查找并安装适合 GPU 加速、CUDA、AI 代理、数据加载、训练、推理、机器人、物理 AI、Omniverse、模拟等工作的正确 NVIDIA 技能。该插件会检查 NVIDIA 的实时技能目录，推荐最佳匹配，并提供安装命令和有用的首次提示。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find and install the right NVIDIA skill for work across GPU acceleration, CUDA, AI agents, data loading, training, inference, robotics, Physical AI, Omniverse, simulation, and more. The plugin checks NVIDIA's live skills catalog, recommends the best match, and provides an install command and a useful first prompt.

plugins.name: Hostinger AI Builder
plugins.productIntro: Hostinger AI Builder 让您只需描述您想要的内容即可构建真正的网站和应用程序。专为没有技术背景的人而设计，它可以在几分钟内将想法转化为工作产品。当您对结果感到满意时，只需单击一下即可立即启动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Hostinger AI Builder lets you build real websites and apps just by describing what you want. Designed for people with no technical background, it turns ideas into working products in minutes. When you're happy with the result, launch instantly with one click.

plugins.name: Sent
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 Sent API 帐户以发送和跟踪来自 ChatGPT 的 SMS、WhatsApp 和 RCS 消息。管理联系人和批准的模板，监控交付和消息分析，并检查帐户准备情况、入职状态和余额。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Sent API account to send and track SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS messages from ChatGPT. Manage contacts and approved templates, monitor delivery and messaging analytics, and check account readiness, onboarding status, and balance.

plugins.name: Spaceship
plugins.productIntro: Spaceship 的应用程序支持单个或多个域名的域名可用性检查和定价查找。用户可以搜索特定域名，在域名不可用时请求替代建议，并比较不同 TLD 的定价。服务器从 Spaceship 的产品平台返回实时可用性状态和准确的定价。最适用于域发现、批量域检查以及帮助用户找到可用的替代方案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Spaceship's app enables domain name availability checking and pricing lookup for single or multiple domains. Users can search for specific domains, request alternative suggestions when domains are unavailable, and compare pricing across different TLDs. The server returns real-time availability status and accurate pricing from Spaceship's Product Platform.

plugins.name: AWS Core
plugins.productIntro: 包括常见 AWS 工作流程的 AWS MCP 服务器配置和默认技能。涵盖的领域包括服务选择、基础设施即代码（CDK 和 CloudFormation）、无服务器、容器、数据库、存储、可观察性、计费、SDK 使用和部署。我们向所有 AWS 开发人员推荐此插件。
plugins.productIntroEn: Includes the AWS MCP Server configuration and default skills for common AWS workflows. Covered domains include service selection, infrastructure as code (CDK and CloudFormation), serverless, containers, databases, storage, observability, billing, SDK usage, and deployment. We recommend this plugin for all AWS developers.

plugins.name: Build Web Data Visualization
plugins.description: 设计、构建、测试和导出 Web 数据可视化
plugins.originalDescription: Design, build, test, and export web data visualizations
plugins.productIntro: 使用构建 Web 数据可视化来选择、设计、实施、测试和导出浏览器图表、仪表板、地图、WebGL/Three.js 场景、Canvas/D3 视觉效果、甘特图、UML/软件图表、滚动讲述、报告、PDF 和幻灯片。它强调源支持的数据、可访问的响应式布局、URL 可共享的分析状态以及高级视觉故事的概念优先设计。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use Build Web Data Visualization to choose, design, implement, test, and export browser charts, dashboards, maps, WebGL/Three.js scenes, Canvas/D3 visuals, Gantt charts, UML/software diagrams, scrollytelling, reports, PDFs, and slide decks. It emphasizes source-backed data, accessible responsive layouts, URL-shareable analysis state, and concept-first design for advanced visual stories.

plugins.name: Keenable
plugins.productIntro: Keenable 通过两个只读工具提供 ChatGPT 实时网络访问。 Web 搜索返回查询的排名结果，每个结果都带有标题、URL 和片段。获取页面内容获取任何 URL 并以干净的降价形式返回页面的主要内容，因此 ChatGPT 可以读取刚刚找到的源。
plugins.productIntroEn: Keenable gives ChatGPT live web access through two read-only tools. Web Search returns ranked results for a query, each with a title, URL and snippet. Fetch Page Content takes any URL and returns the page's main content as clean markdown, so ChatGPT can read a source it just found.

plugins.name: Soracom Knowledge
plugins.productIntro: 搜索 Soracom 文档和 API 参考。根据需要查找服务指南、Soracom 用户控制台程序、定价、物联网配方、API 参考、CLI 命令和 SAM 权限，以及官方文档中的基本答案，而不仅仅是依赖培训数据。该服务器由 Soracom 作为共享、只读端点托管 - 它仅搜索和读取文档，不会修改您的任何 Soracom 资源。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search Soracom documentation and API references. Look up service guides, Soracom User Console procedures, pricing, IoT recipes, API references, CLI commands, and SAM permissions on demand, and ground answers in the official documentation instead of relying only on training data.

plugins.name: WorkOS
plugins.description: 管理您的 WorkOS 帐户
plugins.productIntro: WorkOS 将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到您的 WorkOS 工作区，以便您可以用简单的语言管理您的帐户。无需仪表板。
plugins.productIntroEn: WorkOS connects ChatGPT and Codex to your WorkOS workspace so you can manage your account in plain language. No dashboard required.

plugins.name: Engram
plugins.productIntro: Engram 为您的人工智能助手提供长期记忆。它逐字存储您的对话，并使其可按含义进行搜索，因此上下文、决策和偏好可以在整个会话中保留，而不会被遗忘。要求它记住一些事情，并在几天或几周后回忆起来。您的内存是您帐户的私有内存，并且可以在您连接的 MCP 客户端上使用。
plugins.productIntroEn: Engram gives your AI assistant long-term memory. It stores your conversations verbatim and makes them searchable by meaning, so context, decisions, and preferences carry across sessions instead of being forgotten. Ask it to remember something and recall it days or weeks later. Your memory is private to your account and works across the MCP clients you connect.

plugins.name: YepCode

plugins.productIntroEn: YepCode lets you build custom AI tools using your own code with JSON Schema-defined inputs, executed in an isolated sandbox with access to any npm or PyPI package and secure environment variables.

plugins.name: Sticklight
plugins.productIntro: Sticklight 是一款人工智能驱动的构建器，专为想要更快地构建真正的数字产品的专业网络创建者而设计，同时又不影响质量、控制或设计标准。 您首先用自然语言描述您想要创建的内容，Sticklight 会生成一个工作项目，其中的结构、界面和核心逻辑已经就位。从那里，创建者可以完善每个细节 - 手动编辑元素、调整布局和交互，以及在需要时访问底层代码。这使得专业人员能够完全控制每个像素并保持其工作要求的工艺水平。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sticklight is an AI-powered builder designed for professional web creators who want to build real digital products faster - without compromising on quality, control, or design standards. You start by describing what you want to create in natural language, and Sticklight generates a working project with structure, interface, and core logic already in place.

plugins.name: Adalo
plugins.description: 构建和管理无代码应用程序
plugins.productIntro: 完全通过对话构建和管理无代码应用程序。 Adalo 的 ChatGPT 集成让您无需离开聊天即可创建、修改和管理移动和 Web 应用程序。只需描述您想要什么 - Adalo 的人工智能就会为您构建它。
plugins.productIntroEn: Build and manage no-code apps entirely through conversation. Adalo's ChatGPT integration lets you create, modify, and manage mobile and web applications without ever leaving the chat. Just describe what you want — Adalo's AI builds it for you.

plugins.name: Create State
plugins.productIntro: Create State 为您的软件项目提供 ChatGPT 持久内存。将代码片段、架构决策和调试见解保存到个人知识图谱中。在以后的对话中从上次中断的地方继续。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create State gives ChatGPT persistent memory for your software projects. Save code snippets, architectural decisions, and debugging insights to a personal knowledge graph. Pick up exactly where you left off in future conversations.

plugins.name: Hot100.ai
plugins.description: 每周人工智能项目图表
plugins.productIntro: Hot100 可让您搜索和浏览数百个 AI 项目、工具和代理。每周排名并按堆栈、用例和构建器工具（如 Cursor 和 Replit）进行标记。寻找灵感，探索正在发布的产品，并保持在人工智能生态系统的领先地位。
plugins.productIntroEn: Hot100 lets you search and browse hundreds of AI projects, tools, and agents. Ranked weekly and tagged by stack, use case, and builder tools like Cursor & Replit. Find inspiration, explore what’s shipping, and stay on top of the AI ecosystem.

plugins.name: Catalyst by Zoho
plugins.description: 构建、部署和托管应用程序。
plugins.productIntro: Catalyst by Zoho 插件通过 MCP 支持的工作流程和构建、管理和操作 Catalyst 项目的技能扩展了 Codex。
plugins.productIntroEn: Catalyst by Zoho plugin extends Codex with MCP-backed workflows and skills for building, managing, and operating Catalyst projects.

plugins.name: Jam
plugins.productIntro: Jam 的 MCP 是 Jam 录音和开发工具之间的快速通道。将 Jam 链接放入 ChatGPT、VS Code、Cursor、Windsurf 或 Claude 中，整个录制内容（视频、控制台、网络、日志）都会预先打包。无需手动输入重现步骤，无需复制粘贴堆栈跟踪，无需屏幕共享戏剧。您的工具可以获得即时上下文，您可以保持流畅。
plugins.productIntroEn: Jam's MCP is the fast lane between Jam recordings and your dev tools. Drop a Jam link into ChatGPT, VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, or Claude and the whole recording – video, console, network, logs – arrives pre-packaged. No hand-typing repro steps, no copy-paste stack traces, no screen-share drama. Your tools get instant context, you stay in flow.

plugins.name: 3Min API
plugins.description: 无需编码即可创建 API
plugins.productIntro: 3Min API 允许您创建 REST API，而无需编写后端代码。定义 JSON 架构，并通过自动 Webhook 交付、沙箱/生产分离、实时日志和使用统计信息获取完整的 CRUD 端点。通过自然语言管理一切 - 创建端点、测试 API 调用、搜索日志、邀请协作者、部署到生产环境以及生成可立即粘贴的 WordPress 插件片段，以在任何 WordPress 页面上呈现您的端点。
plugins.productIntroEn: 3Min API lets you create REST APIs without writing backend code. Define a JSON schema, and get full CRUD endpoints with automatic webhook delivery, sandbox/production separation, real-time logs, and usage statistics.

plugins.name: Agent Ready
plugins.productIntro: Agent Ready 检查任何网站对于 AI 代理、助手和爬虫的可读性。给它一个 URL，它会根据 Vercel 代理可读性规范、llms.txt 标准和新兴代理协议（MCP 服务器卡、A2A 代理卡、agents.json）扫描站点，然后呈现交互式记分卡：0-100 代理可读性分数、llms.txt 分数以及按站点、页面、llms.txt 和协议分组的每次检查细分 - 每个失败的检查都配有简单的英语修复。
plugins.productIntroEn: Agent Ready checks how readable any website is to AI agents, assistants, and crawlers. Give it a URL and it scans the site against the Vercel Agent Readability Spec, the llms.txt standard, and emerging agent protocols (MCP server cards, A2A agent cards, agents.json), then renders an interactive score card: a 0–100 agent-readability score, an llms.

plugins.name: PageShare
plugins.description: 共享和保护生成的 HTML
plugins.productIntro: PageShare 允许您共享和保护使用 ChatGPT 生成的 HTML 页面。发布新页面和更新现有页面，使用密码或电子邮件规则控制访问，管理自定义域和跟踪链接，以及查看网站的分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: PageShare lets you share and protect HTML pages generated with ChatGPT. Publish new and update existing pages, control access with passwords or email rules, manage custom domains and tracking links, and review analytics for your sites.

plugins.name: Olostep
plugins.productIntro: Olostep 将网络转化为人工智能的干净、结构化数据。使用自然语言搜索网络，将任何 URL 抓取到 Markdown、HTML、JSON 或屏幕截图中，抓取整个网站，并获得基于网络资源的人工智能答案。 Olostep 可靠、经济高效且可扩展至数十亿个请求，让您可以将实时 Web 数据直接提取到 ChatGPT 中，而无需管理浏览器、代理或抓取工具。
plugins.productIntroEn: Olostep turns the web into clean, structured data for AI. Search the web with natural language, scrape any URL into Markdown, HTML, JSON, or screenshots, crawl entire sites, and get AI-powered answers grounded in web sources.

plugins.name: ArmorCodex
plugins.description: 阅读和更新人工智能政策
plugins.productIntro: ArmorCodex 允许您阅读、更新和审查控制 AI 编码代理如何与工具、文件和基础设施交互的策略。使用自然语言设置规则（“拒绝 webfetch”、“需要批准生产数据库更改”）、检查当前策略状态并在工具调用运行之前注册意图计划。由 ArmorIQ 为需要对 AI 代理活动进行治理和审核的团队构建。
plugins.productIntroEn: ArmorCodex lets you read, update, and review the policies that govern how AI coding agents interact with tools, files, and infrastructure. Set rules in natural language ("deny webfetch", "require approval for production database changes"), check current policy state, and register intent plans before tool calls run.

plugins.name: MagicPath
plugins.description: 在共享画布上进行设计
plugins.productIntro: 在共享画布上设计和构建交互式 UI。将本地代码和存储库引入 MagicPath，创建和编辑组件，安装或导出设计，并使用图表、流程图、线框图、用户旅程和注释来绘制想法。
plugins.productIntroEn: Design and build interactive UI on a shared canvas. Bring local code and repositories into MagicPath, create and edit components, install or export designs, and map ideas with diagrams, flowcharts, wireframes, user journeys, and annotations.

plugins.name: Buildy
plugins.description: 适合代理商的个人应用程序
plugins.productIntro: Buildy 是用户及其代理可以共享的个人 Web 应用程序的托管运行时。代理创建一个应用程序，Buildy 为其提供 URL、后端和键值存储，用户可以在 ChatGPT、Claude 和其他代理之间继续使用相同的应用程序和数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Buildy is a hosted runtime for personal web apps that users and their agents can share. An agent creates an app, Buildy gives it a URL, backend, and key-value storage, and the user keeps using the same app and data across ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents.

plugins.name: Botpress
plugins.description: 生产就绪的 AI 代理
plugins.productIntro: 完整的人工智能代理平台
plugins.productIntroEn: The Complete AI Agent Platform

plugins.name: WoWSQL
plugins.productIntro: WoWSQL 允许用户直接从 ChatGPT 管理他们的 PostgreSQL 数据库即服务项目。用户可以列出和检查项目、浏览数据库表、执行 SQL 查询和语句、搜索平台文档、阅读完整的文档页面以及列出文件存储桶 - 所有这些都在其经过身份验证的 WoWSQL 工作区中进行。
plugins.productIntroEn: WoWSQL lets users manage their PostgreSQL database-as-a-service projects directly from ChatGPT. Users can list and inspect projects, browse database tables, execute SQL queries and statements, search platform documentation, read full doc pages, and list file storage buckets — all within their authenticated WoWSQL workspace.

plugins.name: Context.dev
plugins.description: AI 代理的实时网络数据
plugins.originalDescription: Live web data for AI agents
plugins.productIntro: Context 将实时网络和文件转变为 ChatGPT 内干净的、可供代理使用的数据。搜索当前信息、以 Markdown 形式读取已知页面、抓取网站、提取模式形状的 JSON、解析文档、检索公司和品牌情报、检查视觉设计系统、跨数千个 URL 运行异步批量抓取，以及监控网站随时间的有意义的变化。一些抓取工具可以执行明确请求的浏览器操作来显示内容。 Context 不提供一般消息传递、日历、帐户管理或社交发布集成。
plugins.productIntroEn: Context turns the live web and files into clean, agent-ready data inside ChatGPT. Search for current information, read a known page as Markdown, crawl websites, extract schema-shaped JSON, parse documents, retrieve company and brand intelligence, inspect visual design systems, run asynchronous scraping batches across thousands of URLs, and monitor websites for meaningful changes over tim…

plugins.name: Outside Agent
plugins.description: 构建并发布 AI 代理
plugins.productIntro: 外部代理将简单语言简介转换为托管 AI 代理，您可以将其发布到短信、语音和网络，而无需离开编码代理。描述代理应该做什么，它组成完整的配置，将其基于您自己的内容，运行安全审查，然后发布它。创建代理、建立知识库、在发布前预览回复、发布电话号码以及管理您构建的所有内容，所有这些都通过自然对话进行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Outside Agent turns a plain-language brief into a hosted AI agent you can publish to SMS, voice, and web without leaving your coding agent. Describe what the agent should do and it composes the full configuration, grounds it in your own content, runs a safety review, and ships it.

plugins.name: IcePanel
plugins.productIntro: IcePanel 是一款用于软件架构的协作绘图和建模工具。借助 IcePanel 的 MCP，将您的软件架构设计引入 ChatGPT 和 Codex。
plugins.productIntroEn: IcePanel is a collaborative diagramming and modelling tool for software architecture. With IcePanel's MCP, bring your software architecture designs into ChatGPT and Codex.

plugins.name: DNS Inspector
plugins.description: 立即查找 DNS 记录
plugins.productIntro: DNS Inspector 查找任何域的主要 DNS 记录类型（A、AAAA、CNAME、MX、TXT、NS、SOA），并将它们显示在清晰、可读的小部件中，每个值都可以一键刷新和复制到剪贴板。
plugins.productIntroEn: DNS Inspector looks up the main DNS record types (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA) for any domain and displays them in a clear, readable widget, with one-click refresh and copy-to-clipboard for each value.

plugins.name: Twilio Developer Kit
plugins.description: Twilio 在 Twilio 上构建、调试和交付的技能
plugins.originalDescription: Twilio Skills for building, debugging, and shipping on Twilio
plugins.productIntro: 程序知识可指导 AI 编码代理针对任何用例使用正确的 Twilio API。涵盖消息传递、语音、验证、SendGrid 和 30 多种产品的渠道选择、生产最佳实践、合规性要求以及常见陷阱。技能遵循渐进式披露架构 - 您的代理在启动时会看到轻量级元数据，并且仅在任务匹配时才加载完整指导。
plugins.productIntroEn: Procedural knowledge that guides AI coding agents to the right Twilio APIs for any use case. Covers channel selection, production best practices, compliance requirements, and common pitfalls across Messaging, Voice, Verify, SendGrid, and 30+ products.

plugins.name: Statsig
plugins.productIntro: 将您的 Statsig 工作区引入 Codex。产品构建者现在可以在 Codex 对话中直接探索、管理和创建 Statsig 实验、功能门、动态配置等。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring your Statsig workspace into Codex. Product builders can now explore, manage, and create Statsig experiments, feature gates, dynamic configs, and more directly in Codex conversations.

plugins.name: Macaly Cloud
plugins.description: 在 Macaly 上构建和托管应用程序
plugins.originalDescription: Build and host apps on Macaly
plugins.productIntro: Macaly Cloud 允许用户从 ChatGPT 创建、编辑、验证、预览、复制和显式发布托管 Web 应用程序。它提供托管项目沙箱、Git 支持的文件更改、平台功能指南、构建诊断、可共享的实时预览和生产部署。
plugins.productIntroEn: Macaly Cloud lets users create, edit, validate, preview, duplicate, and explicitly publish hosted web apps from ChatGPT. It provides a managed project sandbox, Git-backed file changes, platform capability guides, build diagnostics, shareable live previews, and production deployment.

plugins.name: Temporal
plugins.description: 使用 Temporal 进行开发
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Temporal 的综合指南 — 跨 Python、TypeScript、Go 和 Java SDK 开发工作流程、活动和工作人员；使用 Temporal CLI 进行本地开发和操作；运行和管理自托管临时服务器；并使用 Temporal Cloud 进行生产部署。
plugins.productIntroEn: Comprehensive guidance for working with Temporal — developing workflows, activities, and workers across Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java SDKs; using the Temporal CLI for local development and operations; running and managing self-hosted Temporal Server; and working with Temporal Cloud for production deployments.

plugins.name: Alchemy
plugins.productIntro: Alchemy 帮助开发人员检查 EVM 和 Solana 区块链数据、管理 Alchemy 应用程序和基础设施、审查使用情况以及通过 ChatGPT 配置 Webhooks 和 Gas Manager 策略。
plugins.productIntroEn: Alchemy helps developers inspect EVM and Solana blockchain data, manage Alchemy apps and infrastructure, review usage, and configure webhooks and Gas Manager policies through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Themely Design+Style Generator
plugins.productIntro: 使用 AI 为应用程序、网站、仪表板、登陆页面等创建精美的设计主题。描述您想要什么，探索不同的视觉风格，并排比较想法，并在几秒钟内预览您的概念。无论您是从空白页开始还是刷新现有想法，该工具都可以帮助您快速发现设计方向，而无需高级设计技能。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create beautiful design themes for apps, websites, dashboards, landing pages, and more with AI. Describe what you want, explore different visual styles, compare ideas side by side, and preview your concepts in seconds. Whether you are starting from a blank page or refreshing an existing idea, this tool helps you quickly discover design directions without needing advanced design skills.

plugins.name: ClickHouse
plugins.description: 查看 ClickHouse Cloud 资源并执行只读查询。
plugins.productIntro: ClickHouse 是面向实时分析的数据库平台。插件可检查 ClickHouse Cloud 的组织、服务、表与备份，并执行只读 SQL 查询。
plugins.productIntroEn: ClickHouse is a service that helps you explore ClickHouse Cloud. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Agiflow
plugins.productIntro: Agiflow 是一个共享项目板，用于将计划转变为可跟踪的工作。创建项目，将其分解为工作单元和任务，设置优先级和状态，分配工作，添加评论和附件，并查看整个工作区的进度。使用 Agiflow 计划启动、组织待办事项、运行站立会议、对传入工作进行分类，并使决策与其影响的任务保持联系。更改将保存到经过身份验证的 Agiflow 工作区，您的团队可以在其中查看并继续工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Agiflow is a shared project board for turning plans into trackable work. Create projects, break them into work units and tasks, set priorities and statuses, assign work, add comments and attachments, and review progress across your workspace. Use Agiflow to plan launches, organize backlogs, run standups, triage incoming work, and keep decisions connected to the tasks they affect.

plugins.name: Val Town
plugins.productIntro: Val Town 帮助用户创建、检查、运行和部署应用程序；管理文件、分支、计划、环境变量、SQLite 数据和 Blob 存储；并通过 ChatGPT 调试执行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Val Town helps users create, inspect, run, and deploy apps; manage files, branches, schedules, environment variables, SQLite data, and blob storage; and debug executions through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Aiven
plugins.productIntro: Aiven 官方插件，用于在 Aiven 上配置和管理 PostgreSQL、Kafka 和其他数据服务。包括用于项目、服务和数据库管理的 Aiven MCP 服务器、Kafka 主题和连接器、PostgreSQL 查询、集成以及直接从 AI 助手部署应用程序。
plugins.productIntroEn: Aiven official plugin to provision and manage PostgreSQL, Kafka, and other data services on Aiven. Includes the Aiven MCP Server for project, service, and database management, Kafka topics and connectors, PostgreSQL queries, integrations, and application deployment directly from your AI assistant.

plugins.name: Visily
plugins.productIntro: 将 Visily 设计引入 ChatGPT。查找面板和屏幕，将 Visily 设计转换为响应式应用程序代码，并将面板主题标记应用到您的项目中。使用 OAuth 将 Pro 或 Business 工作区与编辑器许可证连接起来，然后共享 Visily 链接或按名称请求面板。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring Visily designs into ChatGPT. Find boards and screens, turn Visily designs into responsive application code, and apply board theme tokens to your project. Connect a Pro or Business workspace with an editor license using OAuth, then share a Visily link or ask for a board by name.

plugins.name: Honeycomb
plugins.productIntro: Honeycomb 帮助用户调查可观测性数据、检查跟踪和 AI 对话、运行查询和 BubbleUp 分析，以及通过 ChatGPT 管理看板、SLO、触发器、标记和通知收件人。
plugins.productIntroEn: Honeycomb helps users investigate observability data, inspect traces and AI conversations, run queries and BubbleUp analyses, and manage boards, SLOs, triggers, markers, and notification recipients through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: 60fps
plugins.description: 搜索真实的 iOS 交互
plugins.productIntro: 60fps 是一个真实的 iOS 应用程序交互库，从发布的应用程序中记录下来并进行分解，以便 你可以建造它们。
plugins.productIntroEn: 60fps is a library of real iOS app interactions, recorded from shipping apps and broken down so you can build them.

plugins.name: Testifly
plugins.description: 将 Testif 连接到您的代理
plugins.productIntro: Testifly 可帮助开发人员、QA 工程师和产品团队直接从 URL 进行自动化端到端 (E2E) 测试、网站检查和 UI 验证来验证网站和 Web 应用程序。运行基于浏览器的测试来验证用户流、页面行为、重定向、可用性、性能、可访问性和整体站点运行状况，而无需任何设置。无论您是测试生产站点、临时环境、预览部署还是本地环境，Testifly 都能在问题到达用户之前快速识别问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Testifly helps developers, QA engineers, and product teams validate websites and web applications with automated end-to-end (E2E) testing, website checks, and UI validation directly from a URL. Run browser-based tests to verify user flows, page behavior, redirects, availability, performance, accessibility, and overall site health without any setup.

plugins.name: Brainbase MCP
plugins.description: 构建和运营人工智能代理
plugins.productIntro: Brainbase MCP 允许用户从 ChatGPT 和 Codex 创建、检查、更新、测试、部署和监控托管 AI 代理。它支持修订安全的代理更改、注册表技能和 MCP 服务器配置、评估、编排、计划和任务运行，并明确确认破坏性操作以及对用户 Brainbase 工作区的基于 OAuth 的访问。
plugins.productIntroEn: Brainbase MCP lets users create, inspect, update, test, deploy, and monitor managed AI agents from ChatGPT and Codex. It supports revision-safe agent changes, registry skills and MCP server configuration, evaluations, orchestrations, schedules, and task runs, with explicit confirmation for destructive actions and OAuth-based access to the user's Brainbase workspace.

plugins.name: Sugra API
plugins.productIntro: Sugra API 是人工智能代理和决策平台的智能基础设施：跨域主要源数据的一种密钥和一种标准化格式，通过模型上下文协议呈现给代理。该连接器在包含 1,300 多个端点的完整 Sugra 目录中公开了一个小型、稳定的工具界面，聚合了跨数据领域的 130 多个主要来源，包括市场、宏观经济和中央银行、公司备案、公共金融、贸易流、农业、气候和自然事件、海事活动、预测市场、全球新闻、网络情报和实体筛选。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sugra API is intelligence infrastructure for AI agents and decision platforms: one key and one normalized format for cross-domain primary-source data, surfaced to agents through the Model Context Protocol.

plugins.name: MiroMiro
plugins.productIntro: 从任何网站提取设计
plugins.productIntroEn: Extract design from any website

plugins.name: microfn
plugins.productIntro: microfn 是一个沙盒云环境，用于构建、部署和运行小型 JavaScript 函数 - 旨在对 AI 友好。为 ChatGPT 提供自己的工作区来编写函数、部署它们、管理它们的代码和机密，以及运行您已经构建的函数。
plugins.productIntroEn: microfn is a sandboxed cloud environment for building, deploying, and running tiny JavaScript functions - designed to be AI-friendly. Give ChatGPT its own workspace to write functions, deploy them, manage their code and secrets, and run the functions you've already built.

plugins.name: Descope
plugins.description: 将身份验证添加到您的应用程序和 MCP
plugins.originalDescription: Add auth to your apps and MCPs
plugins.productIntro: Descope 为 ChatGPT 带来了一流的身份验证和身份管理体验。通过自然语言管理 Descope 项目中的用户、租户、角色和访问控制。无需离开对话即可构建和修改注册、登录、MFA、SSO 和联合的身份验证流程。为您的 MCP 服务器和 AI 代理配置身份验证、同意和凭证管理，并在需要指导时轻松搜索 Descope 文档。
plugins.productIntroEn: Descope brings a first-class authentication and identity management experience into ChatGPT. Manage users, tenants, roles, and access control across your Descope projects through natural language. Build and modify auth flows for signup, login, MFA, SSO, and federation without leaving the conversation.

plugins.name: API Documentation Checker
plugins.productIntro: 提取API合同详细信息，检查文档是否涵盖所述API合同，并比较API合同版本。结果是结构化的、基于证据的，并且仅限于明确提供的信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Extract API contract details, check whether documentation covers the stated API contract, and compare API contract versions. Results are structured, evidence-based, and limited to explicitly provided information.

plugins.name: Ezoic Setup
plugins.description: 在您的网站上设置 Ezoic 广告
plugins.originalDescription: Set up Ezoic ads on your site
plugins.productIntro: Ezoic 设置可帮助发布商和开发人员在任何网站上实施 Ezoic 广告。用简单的语言提出问题，它会使用基于 Ezoic 官方文档、SDK 和示例的可工作、可复制的代码进行回答 - 广告占位符、showAds 调用、SPA 路由更改处理、同意（Gatekeeper）脚本、WordPress 和 Next.js/React 集成、ads.txt 设置和故障排除。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ezoic Setup helps publishers and developers implement Ezoic ads on any site. Ask a question in plain language and it answers with working, copyable code grounded in Ezoic's official documentation, SDKs, and examples - ad placeholders, showAds calls, SPA route-change handling, consent (Gatekeeper) scripts, WordPress and Next.js/React integrations, ads.txt setup, and troubleshooting.

plugins.name: Git Diff Patcher Bridge
plugins.description: 安全地审查 AI 代码补丁
plugins.productIntro: Git Diff Patcher Bridge 将 ChatGPT 连接到本地 GDP 桌面会话或种子演示工作区。 ChatGPT 可以检查存储库上下文、读取允许的文件、搜索文本、使用 Patch Doctor 诊断统一差异，以及对补丁提案进行排队以供本地审核。桥接器从不自行应用、提交、推送、重置、清理、删除、回滚或运行终端命令。所有存储库更改操作均在 GDP Desktop 内的用户控制之下。
plugins.productIntroEn: Git Diff Patcher Bridge connects ChatGPT to a local GDP Desktop session or a seeded Demo Workspace. ChatGPT can inspect repository context, read allowed files, search text, diagnose unified diffs with Patch Doctor, and queue patch proposals for local review. The bridge never applies, commits, pushes, resets, cleans, deletes, rolls back, or runs terminal commands on its own.

plugins.name: Alpic
plugins.description: 监控您的 MCP 应用程序和服务器
plugins.productIntro: 管理您的项目、调试部署并检查您通过 Alpic 托管的任何 MCP 服务器的分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage your projects, debug deployment, and check analytics for any MCP server you host with Alpic.

plugins.name: Quicknode
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 OpenAI 中管理您的 Quicknode 基础设施。创建和管理端点、监控日志和使用情况、配置安全性和速率限制以及通过一次对话查看账单。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage your Quicknode infrastructure directly in OpenAI. Create and manage endpoints, monitor logs and usage, configure security and rate limits, and review billing from one conversation.

plugins.name: Manufact
plugins.productIntro: Manufact 允许用户在 Manufact Cloud 中部署、监控和管理 MCP 服务器和 MCP 应用程序。该应用程序支持组织查找、服务器和部署管理、GitHub 存储库部署、构建和运行时日志检查以及网关可观察性分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manufact lets users deploy, monitor, and manage MCP servers and MCP Apps in Manufact Cloud. The app supports organization lookup, server and deployment management, GitHub repository deployment, build and runtime log inspection, and gateway observability analytics.

plugins.name: ProductOS
plugins.productIntro: ProductOS 是一个远程优先、人工智能原生开发平台。将 ChatGPT 连接到您的整个云工作区，无需本地克隆。创建和管理项目，使用实时预览 URL 启动隔离的云沙箱，读取和写入文件，运行完整的 shell（npm、git、node）、配置 Postgres 数据库和 S3 存储，并触发生产部署。每个文件更改都会自动同步到 GitHub。非常适合快速原型设计、全栈开发和直接通过聊天进行团队协作。
plugins.productIntroEn: ProductOS is a remote-first, AI-native development platform. Connect ChatGPT to your entire cloud workspace with no local clone needed. Create and manage projects, boot isolated cloud sandboxes with live preview URLs, read and write files, run a full shell (npm, git, node), provision Postgres databases and S3 storage, and trigger production deploys. Every file change auto-syncs to GitHub.

plugins.name: Pathors
plugins.productIntro: 只需几分钟即可构建和部署可用于生产的语音 AI 代理 - 无需编码。
plugins.productIntroEn: Build and deploy production-ready voice AI agents in minutes — no coding required.

plugins.name: MiniUp
plugins.productIntro: MiniUp 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 生成的文件或上传的数据发布简单、模块化的单页和真正的多页免构建 Web 应用程序，托管快速可查询数据集和轻量级表 API，发布与 ArcGIS 兼容的数据集 URL，并管理来自 ChatGPT 的现有站点、文件、图库列表、记录和数据集。
plugins.productIntroEn: MiniUp helps users publish simple, modular single-page, and real multi-page no-build web apps from ChatGPT-generated files or uploaded data, host fast queryable datasets and lightweight table APIs, publish ArcGIS-compatible dataset URLs, and manage existing sites, files, gallery listings, records, and datasets from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Vantage
plugins.productIntro: Vantage 是用于分配和优化云、SaaS 和 AI 成本的记录系统。 Vantage 拥有多种用于优化云支出的工具，并为组织提供先进的 FinOps 工作流程和成本治理。
plugins.productIntroEn: Vantage is the system of record for allocating and optimizing cloud, SaaS, and AI costs. Vantage has multiple tools for optimizing cloud spend and provides organizations with advanced FinOps workflows and cost governance.

plugins.name: aictrl.dev
plugins.productIntro: aictrl.dev 帮助工程团队检查项目背景和待办事项、发现受管理的工作流程、启动版本化工作流程运行、审查运行证据、决定审批关口以及通过 ChatGPT 取消活动运行。
plugins.productIntroEn: aictrl.dev helps engineering teams inspect project context and backlogs, discover governed workflows, start versioned workflow runs, review run evidence, decide approval gates, and cancel active runs through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: OpenAI Ads Conversions
plugins.description: 设置 OpenAI Ads Pixel 和 CAPI 跟踪
plugins.originalDescription: Set up OpenAI Ads Pixel and CAPI tracking
plugins.productIntro: 使用 OpenAI Ads Conversions 指导 Codex 在存储库中添加或扩展测量像素和可选的 Conversions API 工具，并提供本地验证帮助程序以及安全秘密处理、重复数据删除、归因上下文和设置报告的指导。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use OpenAI Ads Conversions to guide Codex through adding or extending Measurement Pixel and optional Conversions API instrumentation in a repository, with local verification helpers and guidance for safe secret handling, deduplication, attribution context, and setup reporting.

plugins.name: Prismic
plugins.productIntro: Prismic MCP 允许用户列出可访问的 Prismic 存储库、检查内容模型（自定义类型和切片）、搜索和获取文档，以及通过创建版本、创建文档、更新文档以及将资产上传到存储库资产库来进行发布范围内的内容更改。
plugins.productIntroEn: Prismic MCP lets users list accessible Prismic repositories, inspect content models (custom types and slices), search and fetch documents, and make release-scoped content changes by creating releases, creating documents, updating documents, and uploading assets to the repository asset library.

plugins.name: Charming
plugins.description: 适合代理商的个人应用程序
plugins.productIntro: Charming 是用户及其代理可以共享的个人 Web 应用程序的托管运行时。代理创建一个应用程序，Charming 为其提供 URL、后端和键值存储，并且用户在 ChatGPT、Claude 和其他代理之间继续使用相同的应用程序和数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Charming is a hosted runtime for personal web apps that users and their agents can share. An agent creates an app, Charming gives it a URL, backend, and key-value storage, and the user keeps using the same app and data across ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents.

plugins.name: Metaplay SDK Docs
plugins.description: 搜索 Metaplay SDK 文档
plugins.productIntro: Metaplay SDK 文档使 ChatGPT 能够访问 Metaplay 的 LLM 优化文档库，包括 SDK 源文件、示例项目、发行说明、CLI 参考以及跨多个 SDK 版本的网站内容。用户可以提出自然语言问题，应用程序会检索最相关的文章，在请求的行范围内读取特定文件，运行 ripgrep 正则表达式搜索，并按模式查找文件。
plugins.productIntroEn: Metaplay SDK Docs gives ChatGPT access to Metaplay's LLM-optimized documentation corpus, including SDK source files, sample projects, release notes, CLI reference, and website content across multiple SDK versions.

plugins.name: Sitelemetry
plugins.productIntro: Sitelemetry 对网站进行安全性、技术 SEO、AI 可见性、分析和跟踪集成、可访问性和性能方面的审核。它返回带有证据、影响和具体补救指导的优先发现结果。公开的、非侵入性的检查可以评估公共网站；受保护的安全模块和全面审核需要经过验证的 Sitelemetry 项目。连接使用带有 PKCE 的 OAuth，并且私有网络目标被阻止。需要 Sitelemetry 帐户；可用的审核和使用限制反映了已分配给连接帐户的访问权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sitelemetry audits websites across security, technical SEO, AI visibility, analytics and tracking integrations, accessibility, and performance. It returns prioritized findings with evidence, impact, and concrete remediation guidance. Public, non-intrusive checks can assess public websites; protected security modules and full audits require a verified Sitelemetry project.

plugins.name: Garchi CMS
plugins.description: 用于管理内容的 MCP 服务器
plugins.productIntro: Garchi CMS 是一种无头 SaaS CMS，用于跨平台（例如网站和应用程序）管理内容。借助此应用程序，您可以使用 MCP 服务器连接到 Garchi CMS，并利用 Chat GPT 的功能管理平台的内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Garchi CMS is a headless SaaS CMS used to manage content across platforms such as websites and apps. With this app, you could connect to Garchi CMS using the MCP server and manage your platform's content levaraging the power of Chat GPT.

plugins.name: Mnemom
plugins.productIntro: Mnemom 是为代理构建的信任基础设施，而不仅仅是为运行它们的人构建的。在一次聊天中，您可以查找代理的持续信任评级（分数、等级及其背后的责任证据），并确认它是经过加密签名的，而不仅仅是断言的。放下您自己的校准卡并立即获得信任回读；声明可验证的身份，且无人参与；并在您的自述文件或代理卡上获得可嵌入的信任评级徽章。每一次阅读都诚实地表达了它所知道的内容：安静的记录读起来就像安静的，永远不会像危险信号一样。系统说的是事实——查看源代码也证明了这一点。
plugins.productIntroEn: Mnemom is trust infrastructure built for agents, not just the humans who run them. In one chat you can look up an agent's Continuous Trust Rating — the score, the grade, and the accountability evidence behind it — and confirm it's cryptographically signed, not merely asserted.

plugins.name: Graffiticode
plugins.productIntro: Graffiticode 让 AI 代理执行经过验证的特定于任务的操作，而不是进行不受限制的 API 调用。通过使用正式的任务语言来验证输入、实施功能并生成结构化工件，Graffiticode 帮助开发人员将其服务公开给 AI 代理，并提供更好的控制、可靠性和可预测的结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Graffiticode lets AI agents perform verified, task-specific operations instead of making unrestricted API calls. By using formal task languages to validate inputs, enforce capabilities, and produce structured artifacts, Graffiticode helps developers expose their services to AI agents with greater control, reliability, and predictable results.

plugins.name: NORMS: Evidence & Scope
plugins.productIntro: NORMS 评估结构化的、经批准的规范性记录对于所声明的目的是否有足够的经过验证的依据。它检查明确的权限、时间适用性、范围、验证、规定分段和结构化条件，然后报告阻碍因素、未知因素和未经检查的领域。缺少或未经验证的所需理由无法关闭。 NORMS 不提供法律建议、证明合规性、解析 PDF 或文档、检索法律、从自由文本推断规范条件、批准合同或修改外部数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: NORMS assesses whether structured, ratified normative records have sufficient verified grounds for a declared purpose. It checks explicit authority, temporal applicability, scope, verification, provision segmentation and structured conditions, then reports blockers, unknowns and unexamined areas. Missing or unverified required grounds fail closed.

plugins.name: StubEngine
plugins.description: 启动实时 API 模拟
plugins.productIntro: StubEngine 将简单的英语需求转化为实时 API 模拟，帮助公司加快 API 交付速度。用户可以生成有效的模拟 API 并管理共享业务工作区中的所有内容。 无论您需要单个模拟端点还是具有相关端点的完整 API 项目，StubEngine 都可以让您更快地进行原型设计、测试和交付集成。 通过减少手动设置并加速模拟创建，团队可以在几分钟内从想法转变为可运行的 API 模拟。
plugins.productIntroEn: StubEngine helps companies speed up API delivery by turning plain-English requirements into live API mocks. Users can generate valid mock APIs and manage everything in a shared business workspace. Whether you need a single mocked endpoint or a full API project with related endpoints, StubEngine makes it faster to prototype, test and ship integrations.

plugins.name: FlawPilot
plugins.description: 网络安全和 SEO 扫描仪
plugins.productIntro: FlawPilot 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的网站健康扫描。要求 ChatGPT 扫描任何实时 URL，FlawPilot 会检查其是否存在安全漏洞、性能瓶颈、基础设施问题和 SEO 问题。 ChatGPT 可以列出您现有的项目、开始新的扫描并检查扫描状态，直到结果准备好并提供优先分数和可操作的见解，所有这些都无需离开您的对话。
plugins.productIntroEn: FlawPilot connects ChatGPT to your website health scans. Ask ChatGPT to scan any live URL, and FlawPilot checks it for security vulnerabilities, performance bottlenecks, infrastructure issues, and SEO problems.

plugins.name: Agent Community
plugins.description: 会员查找和 DMV 工具
plugins.productIntro: 通过确切的名称或别名查找已知的代理社区成员，读取大致的实时社区计数，明确预注册提议的 .agent 身份，并验证实时 DMV 证书颁发。故意不支持广泛的目录搜索。预注册是免费且不具约束力的，不授予域名所有权，拟议的 .agent TLD 仍待 ICANN 批准。
plugins.productIntroEn: Look up a known Agent Community member by exact name or slug, read the roughly-live community count, explicitly pre-register a proposed .agent identity, and verify live DMV certificate issuance. Broad directory search is intentionally unsupported. Pre-registration is free and non-binding, does not confer domain ownership, and the proposed .agent TLD remains pending ICANN approval.

plugins.name: Nimble
plugins.productIntro: Nimble 为代理提供了受管理的、准确的公共网络访问权限，并且每个答案的令牌成本较低。搜索可查找包含排名结果和片段的当前页面。 Extract 从任何 URL 返回干净、结构化的内容，包括需要 JavaScript 或交互的页面。提取模板提供来自已知站点的一致形状的记录。网络搜索代理处理跨多个来源的开放式工作，返回带有引用的结果，用于研究、丰富和数据集构建。
plugins.productIntroEn: Nimble gives agents governed, accurate access to the public web, at a lower token cost per answer. Search finds current pages with ranked results and snippets. Extract returns clean, structured content from any URL, including pages needing JavaScript or interaction. Extraction Templates give consistently shaped records from known sites.

plugins.name: emem
plugins.description: 有关真实地点的签名事实
plugins.productIntro: emem 通过签名的地球观测和地理空间事实回答基于地点的问题。它可以解析地点、检索或具体化可用事实、提供可验证的引用、比较相似的地点以及验证签名收据。
plugins.productIntroEn: emem answers place-based questions with signed Earth-observation and geospatial facts. It can resolve a place, retrieve or materialize available facts, provide verifiable citations, compare similar places, and verify signed receipts.

plugins.name: Sprites
plugins.description: 为 Codex 提供自己的计算机
plugins.productIntro: 为您的代理提供安全可靠的自己的计算机。 Fly 中的 Sprite 是独立的云环境，具有自己的文件系统、URL、服务、检查点和网络策略。该插件将 Codex 连接到 Sprites MCP 服务器，以便 Codex 可以轻松管理这些远程环境。
plugins.productIntroEn: Give your agent its own computer with safety and security. Sprites from Fly are isolated cloud environments with their own filesystem, URL, services, checkpoints, and network policy. This plugin connects Codex to the Sprites MCP server so Codex can manage those remote environments easily.

plugins.name: Alloy
plugins.productIntro: Alloy 将 ChatGPT 连接到您组织的机器人任务和网格存储数据。搜索任务和图像，检查摘要、报告、场景、设备和数据湖表，运行只读分析，创建报告和工件，管理报告自动化，以及执行批准的设备或边缘配置操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Alloy connects ChatGPT to your organization's robot mission and Mesh Storage data. Search missions and images, inspect summaries, reports, scenarios, devices, and data-lake tables, run read-only analysis, create reports and artifacts, manage report automations, and perform approved device or edge-configuration actions.

plugins.name: Noodle Seed
plugins.description: 监控您的 MCP 应用程序
plugins.productIntro: 访问 ChatGPT 中的 Noodle Seed 工作区，可以更快地查找信息、保持井井有条，并让您的工作顺利进行，而无需切换工具。
plugins.productIntroEn: Access your Noodle Seed workspace in ChatGPT to find information faster, stay organized, and keep your work moving without switching tools.

plugins.name: zeroheight
plugins.productIntro: Zeroheight MCP 将 ChatGPT 直接连接到您的设计系统文档。让您的 AI 助手访问您的样式指南（组件、标记、模式和使用规则），以便它可以在生成代码或回答有关设计系统的问题时参考正确的指南。
plugins.productIntroEn: The zeroheight MCP connects ChatGPT directly to your design system documentation. Give your AI assistant access to your styleguide — components, tokens, patterns, and usage rules — so it can reference the right guidelines while generating code or answering questions about your design system.

plugins.name: Magic Patterns
plugins.productIntro: 使您的代理能够原型化想法、产生设计灵感、上传本地 UI 并集成 Magic Patterns 设计。 Magic Patterns 工具集可让您在视觉上与代理就您想要构建的内容保持一致。
plugins.productIntroEn: Enable your agent to prototype ideas, generate design inspiration, upload local UI, and integrate Magic Patterns designs. The Magic Patterns toolset lets you visually align with your agent on what you want to build.

plugins.name: @imqueue
plugins.productIntro: @imqueue 是一个开源 TypeScript 框架，用于构建微服务 通过消息队列而不是 HTTP 进行对话 — 您编写一个类，装饰 您想要发布的方法，并且调用者获得从生成的完全类型的客户端 正在运行的服务。
plugins.productIntroEn: @imqueue is an open-source TypeScript framework for building microservices that talk over a message queue instead of HTTP — you write a class, decorate the methods you want to publish, and callers get a fully-typed client generated from the running service.

plugins.name: ConsentLayer
plugins.productIntro: ConsentLayer 通过 ChatGPT 帮助网站所有者设置和管理 GDPR、CCPA 和 LGPD cookie 同意。它可以配置站点、扫描跟踪技术、配置同意类别和横幅行为、生成安装片段、验证实时安装以及管理持续的合规工作流程，例如扫描仪审查、地理位置规则、cookie 策略和禁止销售请求。
plugins.productIntroEn: ConsentLayer helps website owners set up and manage GDPR, CCPA, and LGPD cookie consent through ChatGPT. It can provision a site, scan for tracking technologies, configure consent categories and banner behavior, generate installation snippets, verify a live installation, and manage ongoing compliance workflows such as scanner reviews, geolocation rules, cookie policies, and Do Not Sell r…

plugins.name: SiteTriage
plugins.originalDescription: Find out why a site is broken
plugins.productIntro: 您的网站刚刚崩溃 - 请询问 SiteTriage 为什么。给它一个 URL 或域，它就会从边缘运行实时只读诊断：DNS 解析和传播、服务器当前提供的确切 TLS 证书（包括 TLS 1.3）、HTTP 状态和重定向链、电子邮件身份验证（SPF、DKIM、DMARC）以及域注册和过期。然后，它会返回最可能的根本原因（按排名）以及具体的修复步骤，而不是猜测。
