plugins.productIntroEn: Your site just broke — ask SiteTriage why. Give it a URL or domain and it runs live, read-only diagnostics from the edge: DNS resolution and propagation, the exact TLS certificate the server is presenting right now (including TLS 1.3), HTTP status and redirect chains, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and domain registration and expiry.

plugins.name: IDrive e2
plugins.description: 管理 IDrive e2 存储
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 IDrive e2 帐户以浏览区域、管理存储桶和对象、配置生命周期和对象锁定设置，并使用自然语言提示生成预签名链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your IDrive e2 account to browse regions, manage buckets and objects, configure lifecycle and Object Lock settings, and generate presigned links using natural-language prompts.

plugins.name: MGS Agile Toolkit
plugins.productIntro: 访问专家、24x7 Scrum 和敏捷辅导、专家级用户故事分割、产品待办事项生成以及访问您的 Mountain Goat Software 视频课程库，就在 ChatGPT 内。
plugins.productIntroEn: Access to expert, 24x7 Scrum and agile coaching, expert level user story splitting, product backlog item generation and access to your Mountain Goat Software video course library, right inside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Opscotch
plugins.productIntro: Opscotch MCP 服务器使人工智能助手能够直接访问 Opscotch 知识和创作工具。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Opscotch MCP Server gives AI assistants direct access to Opscotch knowledge and authoring tools.

plugins.name: omgskills
plugins.description: 寻找值得信赖的代理技能
plugins.productIntro: 从 omgskills 公共目录中发现 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 和其他编码代理的技能。按任务搜索，检查详细的元数据和安装说明，浏览趋势和编辑选择的技能，并探索特定创建者的技能。 omgskills 是只读的：它可以帮助人们查找和评估技能，而无需在设备上安装或更改任何内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other coding agents from the omgskills public catalog. Search by task, inspect detailed metadata and installation instructions, browse trending and editorially selected skills, and explore skills from specific creators.

plugins.name: Prism by Crossdeck
plugins.productIntro: Prism 读取您的实时 Crossdeck 工作区 - 收入、权利、错误、分析、读取成本和客户身份 - 通过 IDENTITY 连接，因此它可以回答单层工具无法解决的跨层问题：哪些付费客户遇到了错误以及他们支付了什么费用，谁在数据库读取中花费最多，以及您的终生价值排行榜的名称。安全且只读：OAuth 2.0 登录（无需粘贴密钥），无写入路径，并且每个数字都是自描述的（它报告“未检测”，而不是未连接表面的假零）。
plugins.productIntroEn: Prism reads your live Crossdeck workspace — revenue, entitlements, errors, analytics, read-cost and customer identity — joined BY IDENTITY, so it answers cross-layer questions no single-layer tool can: which paying customers an error hit and what they pay, who costs the most in database reads, and your lifetime-value leaderboard by name. Secure and read-only: OAuth 2.

plugins.name: AI Task Brief Builder
plugins.productIntro: 将提供的开发材料转化为基于证据的任务目标、测试要求和实施概要。该插件将已确认的需求与未确认的建议分开，保持范围和约束清晰，并在不发明需求的情况下识别缺失的信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn supplied development materials into evidence-based task goals, test requirements, and implementation briefs. The plugin separates confirmed requirements from unconfirmed suggestions, keeps scope and constraints clear, and identifies missing information without inventing requirements.

plugins.name: Stele
plugins.description: 跨 AI 代理共享内存
plugins.productIntro: Stele 为人工智能代理提供了一个共享的、持久的知识图谱和项目任务系统。它可以帮助用户回忆决策和经验教训、检查出处、捕获持久知识、协调已声明的工作以及在 ChatGPT、Codex、Claude、Cursor 和其他 MCP 兼容代理之间保留上下文。
plugins.productIntroEn: Stele gives AI agents a shared, persistent knowledge graph and task system for projects. It helps users recall decisions and lessons, inspect provenance, capture durable knowledge, coordinate claimed work, and preserve context across ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible agents.

plugins.name: Stack Overflow For Agents
plugins.description: 读取并参与面向 AI Agent 的技术知识交流。
plugins.productIntro: Stack Overflow For Agents 是面向 AI Agent 的技术知识交流网络。Agent 可以读取、回复和验证其他 Agent 分享的解决办法，用于减少重复排查。
plugins.productIntroEn: Stack Overflow For Agents is a service that helps you knowledge exchange for agents. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: API Impact Mapper
plugins.description: 地图 API 变更和影响
plugins.productIntro: 提取明确的 API 更改，对重大更改进行分类，并绘制跨消费者、测试和文档的基于证据的影响。仅使用用户提供的事实，不访问外部系统。
plugins.productIntroEn: Extract explicit API changes, classify breaking changes, and map evidence-based impacts across consumers, tests, and documentation. Uses only the facts supplied by the user and does not access external systems.

plugins.name: DocRunic
plugins.productIntro: 将 DocRunic 连接到 ChatGPT 以处理您授权工作区中的文档。搜索和浏览页面，阅读当前内容和版本历史记录，检查页面结构和附件元数据，创建或更新草稿，并根据要求发布文档。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect DocRunic to ChatGPT to work with documentation in your authorized workspaces. Search and browse pages, read current content and version history, inspect page structures and attachment metadata, create or update drafts, and publish documentation when requested.

plugins.name: Resolve AI
plugins.productIntro: 连接 ChatGPT 和 Codex 以解决 AI。启动并引导调查，拉取实时生产环境，并将根本原因调查结果转化为拉取请求。 Resolve 插件通过 MCP 连接 ChatGPT 和 Codex 以解决 AI。 Resolve 的客服人员会加入您的待命轮班，对警报进行分类和调查，并与工程师一起工作，更快地找到根本原因；该插件将该表面直接带入您的编码代理中，以便您可以在已经编码的地方对其进行操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI. Start and steer investigations, pull live production context, and turn root-cause findings into pull requests. The Resolve plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI over MCP.

plugins.name: Cortex — Semantic Memory
plugins.description: 为您的 AI 提供共享内存
plugins.productIntro: Cortex 为 ChatGPT 提供了持久的记忆，可以在对话中保存下来。保存决策和注释，按含义搜索它们，并综合回忆某个主题的已知内容 - 始终具有可追溯的来源。当新信息与您保存的信息相矛盾时，Cortex 会标记冲突，而不是默默地覆盖它。您的数据仍然绑定到您自己的订阅帐户。 SKYNETLAB 产品，受专利保护并已投入生产。
plugins.productIntroEn: Cortex gives ChatGPT a durable memory that survives across conversations. Save decisions and notes, search them by meaning, and get a synthesized recall of what's known on a topic — always with traceable sources. When new information contradicts what you saved, Cortex flags the conflict instead of silently overwriting it. Your data stays bound to your own subscription account.

plugins.name: Suger
plugins.productIntro: Suger 帮助市场团队处理 ChatGPT 中的云市场、CRM、联合销售、集成、计费和知识数据。用户可以查找报价、买家、权利、推荐、集成、工作流程运行、CRM 记录和支持知识，并通过其连接的 Suger 组织执行启用的操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Suger helps marketplace teams work with cloud marketplace, CRM, co-sell, integration, billing, and knowledge data in ChatGPT. Users can look up offers, buyers, entitlements, referrals, integrations, workflow runs, CRM records, and support knowledge, and perform enabled actions through their connected Suger organization.

plugins.name: PR Readiness Check
plugins.description: 检查 PR 审核准备情况
plugins.productIntro: 分析提供的拉取请求材料以获取变更证据、需求调整、测试、风险、回滚以及人工审核的准备情况。它不访问存储库、运行测试、批准或合并拉取请求。
plugins.productIntroEn: Analyzes supplied pull request materials for change evidence, requirement alignment, testing, risks, rollback, and readiness for human review. It does not access repositories, run tests, approve, or merge pull requests.

plugins.name: Camber
plugins.productIntro: Camber 允许用户管理帐户和工作区、发现或创建代理，以及启动和监控直接在 ChatGPT 中运行的代理。
plugins.productIntroEn: Camber lets users manage accounts and workspaces, discover or create agents, and launch and monitor agent runs directly within ChatGPT.

plugins.name: NPMScan
plugins.productIntro: 直接从对话中查找 npm 包元数据、已知漏洞和 CVE 详细信息。 NPMScan 的 MCP 服务器为 AI 代理提供了七个由 npm 注册表、OSV.dev、GitHub 安全公告和 NIST 国家漏洞数据库支持的只读工具：按名称或关键字搜索包，并包含下载计数、依赖包计数以及每个结果的误植检测；安装前检查软件包的安装脚本、维护者​​、许可证、GitHub 星星和下载趋势；检查锁定文件中固定的确切版本；查询一个软件包的漏洞或一次最多查询 100 个漏洞，…
plugins.productIntroEn: Look up npm package metadata, known vulnerabilities, and CVE details directly from a conversation. NPMScan's MCP server gives AI agents seven read-only tools backed by the npm registry, OSV.dev, GitHub Security Advisories, and the NIST National Vulnerability Database: search packages by name or keyword with download counts, dependent-package counts, and typosquat detection on every resul…

plugins.name: mittwald
plugins.productIntro: 从 ChatGPT 管理您的 mittwald (mStudio) 托管基础设施。列出并检查项目、应用程序、服务器和域；配置和管理 MySQL 和 Redis 数据库、用户、备份和备份计划；使用容器、堆栈、cron 作业和卷；配置域名、DNS 区域、虚拟主机、SSL 证书和邮件地址；管理组织和项目成员、SSH 用户和密钥以及 API 令牌。只读工具检查资源，而写入工具代表经过身份验证的用户创建、更新或删除资源。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage your mittwald (mStudio) hosting infrastructure from ChatGPT. List and inspect projects, apps, servers and domains; provision and manage MySQL and Redis databases, users, backups and backup schedules; work with containers, stacks, cron jobs and volumes; configure domains, DNS zones, virtual hosts, SSL certificates and mail addresses; manage organization and project members, SSH use…

plugins.name: ConoHa VPS
plugins.description: 管理您的 ConoHa VPS 服务器
plugins.productIntro: ConoHa VPS 允许用户通过 ChatGPT 管理其现有 ConoHa VPS 帐户中的资源。用户可以列出他们的服务器并检查状态、IP 地址和计划等详细信息；启动、停止和重新启动服务器；注册 SSH 密钥对；创建和管理安全组和安全组规则；附上卷；并删除他们不再需要的资源。该应用程序通过 OAuth 2.1 连接到用户自己的 ConoHa 帐户，并仅在该帐户的资源上运行。此应用程序有意排除会产生新费用的操作，例如创建服务器和卷或调整服务器和卷的大小。
plugins.productIntroEn: ConoHa VPS lets users manage the resources in their existing ConoHa VPS account from ChatGPT. Users can list their servers and inspect details such as status, IP addresses, and plans; start, stop, and reboot servers; register SSH keypairs; create and manage security groups and security group rules; attach volumes; and delete resources they no longer need.

plugins.name: Flyte
plugins.productIntro: 使用基于 Flyte SDK 和文档的技能来编写、运行和部署 Flyte 2 工作流程、应用程序和代理。在 ChatGPT Web 中，搜索 Flyte 文档和 SDK 示例。在配置了 Flyte CLI 的本地 ChatGPT 环境中，运行和管理经过身份验证的 Flyte 集群。
plugins.productIntroEn: Author, run, and deploy Flyte 2 workflows, apps, and agents with skills grounded in the Flyte SDK and documentation. In ChatGPT web, search Flyte docs and SDK examples. In a local ChatGPT environment with the Flyte CLI configured, run and manage your authenticated Flyte cluster.

plugins.name: BasicDeploy
plugins.description: 通过聊天部署应用程序
plugins.productIntro: BasicDeploy 可让您的助手为 Web 应用程序创建实时容器、向其部署代码并对其进行管理 — 所有这些都可以通过聊天进行。每个应用程序都附带自动设置的 PostgreSQL 数据库、S3 兼容的对象存储、环境变量和公共 HTTPS URL。
plugins.productIntroEn: BasicDeploy lets your assistant create a live container for a web app, deploy code to it, and manage it — all from the chat. Each app comes with a PostgreSQL database, S3-compatible object storage, environment variables, and a public HTTPS URL, set up automatically.

plugins.name: zyberspace
plugins.productIntro: ZyberSpace 可让您在几分钟内创建和发布专业商业网站。描述您的业务，选择您的风格，ZyberSpace 将其变成一个实时、移动且可供代理使用的网站。
plugins.productIntroEn: ZyberSpace lets you create and publish professional business websites in minutes. Describe your business, choose your style, and ZyberSpace turns it into a live, mobile and agent-ready website.

plugins.name: Birdie
plugins.productIntro: Birdie 帮助您捕获客户问题并将其转化为清晰的上下文以进行故障排除。
plugins.productIntroEn: Birdie helps you capture customer issues and turn them into clear context for troubleshooting.

plugins.name: Sleuth Skills
plugins.description: 在聊天中使用您的自定义技能
plugins.originalDescription: Use your custom skills in chat
plugins.productIntro: Sleuth Skills 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的个人技能。新库 — 您编写或保存的技能、规则、代理和斜线命令的私人集合。该应用程序可让 ChatGPT 发现您的保管库中的内容并按需加载特定技能的完整内容，因此对话可以遵循您自己的剧本，而不是依赖通用知识。它是只读的：它永远不会修改、删除或共享您的保管库内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sleuth Skills connects ChatGPT to your personal skills.new vault — a private collection of skills, rules, agents, and slash commands you've authored or saved. The app lets ChatGPT discover what's in your vault and load the full content of a specific skill on demand, so conversations can follow your own playbooks instead of relying on generic knowledge.

plugins.name: Knock
plugins.description: 跨渠道向用户发送消息
plugins.productIntro: Knock 是适用于您的产品、营销和交易消息传递的代理优先的客户参与基础设施。一个平台可管理您通过电子邮件、短信、推送、聊天和应用内发送的所有消息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Knock is agent-first customer engagement infrastructure for your product, marketing, and transactional messaging. One platform to manage all your messaging across email, SMS, push, chat, and in-app.

plugins.name: Dependency Upgrade Plan
plugins.productIntro: 根据提供的发布、使用、测试和回滚材料创建基于证据的依赖项升级准备计划。它不会修改存储库、执行升级、运行测试、提交更改或创建拉取请求。
plugins.productIntroEn: Creates evidence-based dependency upgrade preparation plans from supplied release, usage, testing, and rollback materials. It does not modify repositories, execute upgrades, run tests, commit changes, or create pull requests.

plugins.name: Vynix
plugins.productIntro: Vynix MCP 将视觉网站反馈引入 ChatGPT，以便团队可以通过完整的上下文而不是猜测来解决问题。它允许 ChatGPT 访问项目、注释、评论、屏幕截图和 AI 诊断数据，然后帮助您快速确定优先顺序、调查和解决工作。团队可以更新注释状态、添加评论、创建 GitHub 问题以及从一个工作流程生成共享链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Vynix MCP brings visual website feedback into ChatGPT so teams can fix issues with full context instead of guesswork. It lets ChatGPT access projects, annotations, comments, screenshots, and AI diagnosis data, then help you prioritize, investigate, and resolve work quickly. Teams can update annotation status, add comments, create GitHub issues, and generate share links from one workflow.

plugins.name: NeuronSearchLab
plugins.productIntro: 从 ChatGPT 检查和管理您的 NeuronSearchLab 推荐工作区。搜索目录项，了解排名，配置上下文、管道、规则和细分，运行实验和模型训练，以及查看性能分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: Inspect and manage your NeuronSearchLab recommendation workspace from ChatGPT. Search catalogue items, understand rankings, configure contexts, pipelines, rules and segments, run experiments and model training, and review performance analytics.

plugins.name: HOME AI Node
plugins.description: 节点健康状况和任务状态
plugins.productIntro: HOME AI 节点让 ChatGPT 检查 HOME AI 节点的运行状况、运行时状态和跟踪任务。 get_node_status 报告节点是否在线及其存储库状态，get_runtime_state 显示运行时模式和 MCP 协议，get_task_status 查询任务进度。
plugins.productIntroEn: HOME AI Node lets ChatGPT inspect the health, runtime state, and tracked tasks of a HOME AI node. get_node_status reports whether a node is online and its repository state, get_runtime_state shows the runtime mode and MCP protocol, and get_task_status queries task progress.

plugins.name: TALON Knowledge
plugins.description: 搜索 TALON 手册、问答
plugins.productIntro: 一个连接器，可让人工智能代理搜索 TALON 的官方知识库，TALON 是一个用于构建业务应用程序的低代码平台。它搜索数千页官方手册、支持问答、900多个实际功能配置示例的数据库和规范分析，并以源 URL 为证据返回答案。典型用途包括功能设计咨询、配置值查找、错误原因调查、浏览类似的现实示例以及生成的设置的自动验证。
plugins.productIntroEn: A connector that lets AI agents search the official knowledge base of TALON, a low-code platform for building business applications. It searches thousands of pages of official manuals, support Q&A, a database of 900+ real-world function configuration examples, and specification analyses, and returns answers with source URLs as evidence.

plugins.name: HTML/CSS to Image API
plugins.description: HTML 到图像和 URL 屏幕截图
plugins.productIntro: HTML/CSS to Image MCP 服务器让 AI 助手可以通过自然语言指令创建可立即投入生产的图像、网站屏幕截图和 PDF。
plugins.productIntroEn: The HTML/CSS to Image MCP server lets AI assistants create production-ready images, website screenshots, and PDFs through natural-language instructions.

plugins.name: Craftian
plugins.description: 创建完全可用的网络应用程序
plugins.productIntro: 根据提示创建功能齐全的商业软件和 Web 应用程序。使用 Craftian，您可以创建 CRM、任务管理器、库存系统、费用跟踪器、时间跟踪器、工作门户、入职门户、数据表单等。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create fully working business software and web apps from a prompt. With Craftian you can create CRMs, task managers, inventory systems, expense trackers, time trackers, job portals, on-boarding portals, data forms etc.

plugins.name: FluxBuilder
plugins.description: 创建电子商务应用程序
plugins.productIntro: 连接到 FluxBuilder MCP 服务器以管理 WooCommerce、Shopify 和 WordPress 的本机 Flutter 应用程序项目。轻松创建应用程序、重新设计屏幕、更新设置、搜索商店目录、捕获移动预览以及为 App Store、Google Play 和 Web 运行测试或发布版本，所有这些都无需编写代码。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect to the FluxBuilder MCP server to manage native Flutter app projects for WooCommerce, Shopify, and WordPress. Easily create apps, redesign screens, update settings, search store catalogs, capture mobile previews, and run test or release builds for the App Store, Google Play, and web—all without writing code.

plugins.name: EzzyBills
plugins.description: 使用 EzzyBills API 构建应用程序
plugins.productIntro: 访问权威的 EzzyBills 开发人员规范、REST API 合约、身份验证模型以及用于构建 EzzyBills 应用程序（例如审批仪表板、电子邮件响应工作流程和采购订单工具）的集成指南。
plugins.productIntroEn: Access the authoritative EzzyBills developer specification, REST API contracts, authentication models, and integration guidance for building EzzyBills applications such as approval dashboards, email response workflows, and purchase order tools.

plugins.name: Control Plane
plugins.description: 部署并运行云应用程序
plugins.productIntro: Control Plane 将 AWS、GCP、Azure、Oracle Cloud 和您自己的硬件作为一个平台运行容器化应用程序。将 GitHub 或 GitLab 存储库构建到容器中，并将其部署到实时 HTTPS URL，为其提供自定义域，附加 Postgres 或 Redis，并让它自动扩展。从日志、指标和事件中诊断故障，并找到导致云账单膨胀的过度配置工作负载。
plugins.productIntroEn: Control Plane runs containerized apps across AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle Cloud, and your own hardware as one platform. Build a GitHub or a GitLab repo into a container and deploy it to a live HTTPS URL, give it a custom domain, attach Postgres or Redis, and let it autoscale. Diagnose failures from logs, metrics, and events, and find the over-provisioned workloads inflating your cloud bill.

plugins.name: Uizze
plugins.description: 脱颖而出的 UI 设计
plugins.productIntro: Uizze 为编码代理提供免费的 anti-ui-slop Skill 和可选的完整 MCP 访问权限，以访问实时 UI 参考、许可明确的材料和渲染的安全检查。使用该技能检查产品和设计系统，编写设计合同，涵盖所需的状态，并运行有界的完成门。 MCP 通过强大的全屏参考回答一个具体的未解决的 UI 问题，为具体角色找到许可明确的材料，或者选择性地检查渲染的 UI 是否存在可观察到的破损、可访问性、隐私和任务阻塞组合。免费预览版 MCP 仅公开确定性源检查。
plugins.productIntroEn: Uizze gives coding agents a free anti-ui-slop Skill and optional full MCP access to live UI references, license-clear materials, and rendered safety checks. Use the skill to inspect the product and design system, write a design contract, cover required states, and run a bounded finish gate.

plugins.name: Test Failure Triage
plugins.productIntro: 将提供的测试输出转化为清晰的故障列表、基于证据的分类和调查命令。该插件仅根据您提供的信息运行，不会访问代码、CI 系统、存储库或外部服务。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn supplied test output into a clear failure list, evidence-based classifications, and an investigation order. The plugin works only from the information you provide and does not access code, CI systems, repositories, or external services.

plugins.name: BitsWeave
plugins.productIntro: Bitsweave 是用户拥有的 AI 工具上下文层。它存储组织的结构化工作，通过上下文图将其连接，并通过 MCP 将其公开给 Claude。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bitsweave is a user-owned context layer for AI tools. It stores the structured work of your organization, connects it via a context graph and exposes it to Claude over MCP.

plugins.name: Lumen UI
plugins.description: 使用 Lumen 构建接口
plugins.productIntro: Lumen UI 帮助编码代理根据真正的多框架设计系统合约构建可访问的界面。搜索组件目录，检索特定于框架的用法和源，检查 Web 和本机配方，读取语义标记，并遵循 Astro、React、Web Components、React Native、SwiftUI 和 Jetpack Compose 的捆绑 Lumen 工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Lumen UI helps coding agents build accessible interfaces from a real multi-framework design-system contract. Search the component catalog, retrieve framework-specific usage and source, inspect web and native recipes, read semantic tokens, and follow the bundled Lumen workflow for Astro, React, Web Components, React Native, SwiftUI, and Jetpack Compose.

plugins.name: Coval
plugins.productIntro: Coval 帮助团队检查 AI 代理、测试集、角色、指标和评估运行；创建和完善评估资源；启动评估；并向 Sofia 请求基于他们 Coval 组织的只读分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: Coval helps teams inspect AI agents, test sets, personas, metrics, and evaluation runs; create and refine evaluation resources; launch evaluations; and ask Sofia for read-only analysis grounded in their Coval organization.

plugins.name: Watchgoose
plugins.description: 监控 cron 和重复作业
plugins.productIntro: Watchgoose 帮助开发人员监控 cron 作业、备份、Kubernetes 作业和重复脚本。连接一个 Watchgoose 项目来检查检查、计划、保留的状态更改、最近的信号和集成名称。
plugins.productIntroEn: Watchgoose helps developers monitor cron jobs, backups, Kubernetes jobs, and recurring scripts. Connect one Watchgoose project to inspect checks, schedules, retained status changes, recent signals, and integration names.

plugins.name: Replay.io
plugins.productIntro: 时间旅行调试
plugins.productIntroEn: Time travel debugging

plugins.name: ShareThis AI
plugins.description: 管理您的 ShareThis 帐户
plugins.productIntro: ShareThis AI for ChatGPT 让社交共享变得更简单，并且对每个人来说都是免费的。连接您的 ShareThis 帐户以管理应用程序、属性并直接在 ChatGPT 中共享见解。访问适用于网站发布者的强大工具，包括内联共享按钮、粘性共享按钮、GDPR CMP、隐私政策生成器、关注按钮、反应按钮、图像共享按钮和视频共享按钮。
plugins.productIntroEn: ShareThis AI for ChatGPT makes social sharing simpler and free for everyone. Connect your ShareThis account to manage apps, properties, and sharing insights directly within ChatGPT. Access powerful tools for website publishers including Inline Share Buttons, Sticky Share Buttons, GDPR CMP, Privacy Policy Generator, Follow Buttons, Reaction Buttons, Image Share Buttons, and Video Share Bu…

plugins.name: Relewise Developer
plugins.productIntro: 使用适用于 C#、TypeScript/JavaScript、PHP 和 Java 的最新 API 和 SDK 指南构建、审查 Relewise 搜索、推荐、行为跟踪和数据集成并进行故障排除。
plugins.productIntroEn: Build, review, and troubleshoot Relewise Search, Recommendations, behavioral tracking, and data integrations with current API and SDK guidance for C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, PHP, and Java.

plugins.name: BranchDeploy
plugins.description: 部署 Azure DevOps 工作项
plugins.productIntro: BranchDeploy 将 ChatGPT 连接到现有的 Azure DevOps 部署工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: BranchDeploy connects ChatGPT to your existing Azure DevOps deployment workflow.

plugins.name: Prefect
plugins.description: 检查 Prefect 工作流程
plugins.productIntro: 连接 Prefect Cloud 以检查工作流程，诊断失败、延迟或卡住的运行，检查工作区和工作人员健康状况，以及搜索当前的 Prefect 文档和发行说明。托管工具是只读的。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect Prefect Cloud to inspect workflows, diagnose failed, late, or stuck runs, review workspace and worker health, and search current Prefect documentation and release notes. The hosted tools are read-only.

plugins.name: Extend
plugins.productIntro: 从聊天中解析、提取、分类和拆分文档：从 PDF、图像、Office 文件和电子表格中提取字段、表格和行项目，识别文档类型，将文件包分成单独的文档，以及填写 PDF 表单。在真实文档上构建和测试可重用的提取器、分类器和工作流程，然后在 Extend 工作区中大规模运行它们。
plugins.productIntroEn: Parse, extract, classify, and split documents from chat: pull fields, tables, and line items out of PDFs, images, Office files, and spreadsheets, identify document types, break bundles into separate documents, and fill PDF forms. Build and test reusable extractors, classifiers, and workflows on real documents, then run them at scale in your Extend workspace.

plugins.name: Firebase
plugins.description: 构建和管理 Firebase 项目及后端服务。
plugins.productIntro: Firebase 是 Google 的应用后端平台，提供数据库、身份认证、托管等服务；其插件让 Codex 配置项目、查询 Firestore、检查规则并协助部署。
plugins.productIntroEn: Firebase is a service that helps you build and manage Firebase apps. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Redis
plugins.description: 构建 Redis 应用程序
plugins.productIntro: 通过针对数据结构、连接、Redis 搜索、语义缓存、集群、安全性、可观察性和 Iris 代理内存的重点指导，设计、实施、审查 Redis 应用程序并对其进行故障排除。
plugins.productIntroEn: Design, implement, review, and troubleshoot Redis applications with focused guidance for data structures, connections, Redis Search, semantic caching, clustering, security, observability, and Iris agent memory.

plugins.name: MijnSpel
plugins.productIntro: MijnSpel 帮助棋盘游戏设计师在 Creator 或 Studio 中创建和完善可玩的原型、验证项目文件、预览游戏玩法、运行平衡模拟、比较结果并将确认的项目发布到网络上。
plugins.productIntroEn: MijnSpel helps board game designers create and refine playable prototypes in Creator or Studio, validate project files, preview gameplay, run balance simulations, compare results, and publish a confirmed project to the web.

plugins.name: VillageSQL Skills
plugins.productIntro: VillageSQL 的技能，包括从头开始构建扩展以及将 PostgreSQL 扩展移植到 VillageSQL。
plugins.productIntroEn: Skills for VillageSQL including building extensions from scratch and porting PostgreSQL extensions to VillageSQL.

plugins.name: Panderr
plugins.productIntro: 将现有网站引入 Panderr 进行保存、改进或重新设计。从您已有的网站开始，迁移其页面和内容，然后继续在 Panderr 中编辑和管理网站。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring an existing website into Panderr to preserve, improve, or redesign it. Start with the website you already have, migrate its pages and content, then continue editing and managing the site in Panderr.

plugins.name: Armature
plugins.description: 检查 MCP 代理活动
plugins.productIntro: Armature 帮助开发人员检查配置的 MCP 服务器、查看记录的代理会话和用例、调查重复出现的问题以及通过 ChatGPT 报告缺失的应用程序功能。
plugins.productIntroEn: Armature helps developers inspect configured MCP servers, review recorded agent sessions and use cases, investigate recurring issues, and report missing app capabilities through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: WebMCP
plugins.description: 向网站添加可靠的 WebMCP 工具。
plugins.originalDescription: Add reliable WebMCP tools to websites.
plugins.productIntro: WebMCP 帮助检查站点的真实旅程，提出一个小型的任务完成工具界面，通过现有的可信路径实施批准的工具，并端到端验证结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: WebMCP helps inspect a site's real journeys, propose a small task-completing tool surface, implement approved tools through existing trusted paths, and verify the result end to end.

plugins.name: Runpod (Official)
plugins.description: 官方 Runpod 技能 + MCP 服务器 — pod、serverless、runpodctl、flash。
plugins.originalDescription: Official Runpod skills + MCP server — pods, serverless, runpodctl, flash.
plugins.productIntro: 官方 Runpod 代理技能和捆绑的 MCP 服务器：调度到 runpodctl、flash 和配套 CLI 的路由器，以及概念使用指南和有效的黄金路径。
plugins.productIntroEn: Official Runpod agent skills and a bundled MCP server: a router that dispatches to runpodctl, flash, and companion CLIs, plus conceptual usage guidance and worked golden paths.

plugins.name: RideDesk
plugins.productIntro: RideDesk 是一款用于机场接送、司机、 出租车和车辆租赁运营商 — 运行的传输管理软件 每个运营商的预订、报价、司机、发票和付款 他们自己的品牌。
plugins.productIntroEn: RideDesk is booking and dispatch software for airport transfer, chauffeur, taxi and vehicle-rental operators — transfer management software that runs each operator's bookings, quotes, drivers, invoicing and payments under their own brand.

plugins.name: Montra
plugins.description: 向您的代理展示要更改的内容
plugins.originalDescription: Show your agent what to change
plugins.productIntro: Montra 将屏幕截图和屏幕录制转换为代理就绪任务，并附加正确的视觉上下文。与您的团队共享它们，将它们发送到 ChatGPT 和 Codex 等工具，或者只需点击几下即可在您选择的问题跟踪器中自动创建票证。
plugins.productIntroEn: Montra turns screenshots and screen recordings into agent ready tasks with the right visual context attached. Share them with your team, send them to tools like ChatGPT and Codex, or automatically create tickets in your issue tracker of choice in a few clicks.

plugins.name: MCP Conduct Register
plugins.description: 检查 MCP 服务器行为
plugins.productIntro: 该插件公开了 MCP 服务器测量行为的公共记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: This plugin exposes a public register of measured conduct for MCP servers.

plugins.name: Artie
plugins.productIntro: Artie 帮助数据团队设置、检查和操作从数据库和 API 到仓库的变更数据捕获管道。使用它来列出管道和连接器、检查表元数据、配置复制、监控延迟以及管理 SSH 隧道和 PrivateLink 连接等支持基础设施 - 所有这些都在经过身份验证的 Artie 环境中进行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Artie helps data teams set up, inspect, and operate change-data-capture pipelines from databases and APIs into warehouses. Use it to list pipelines and connectors, inspect table metadata, configure replication, monitor lag, and manage supporting infrastructure like SSH tunnels and PrivateLink connections—all within your authenticated Artie environment.

plugins.name: FreakUI
plugins.description: 带有 FreakUI 的原生 Apple 应用
plugins.productIntro: 通过一个提示为 iPhone、iPad 和 macOS 构建单目标、多平台本机 Swift 应用程序。 FreakUI 通过依赖项注入、编程式导航、MVVM 和特定于平台的根视图建立了强大的干净架构基础。其自定义主题初始化、专注于精确的组件、实用程序和扩展为界面提供了独特且一致的标识。除了项目创建之外，专门的 FreakUI 技能还有助于塑造界面部分、添加组件以及随着应用程序的发展而改进界面。
plugins.productIntroEn: Build a single-target, multi-platform native Swift application for iPhone, iPad, and macOS from one prompt. FreakUI establishes a robust clean architecture foundation with dependency injection, programmatic navigation, MVVM, and platform-specific root views.

plugins.name: Smooth Bundle
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Smooth Bundle 以管理 CDN 项目和资产。列出项目、检查资产元数据、上传文件、确认删除资产、清除过时的资产记录以及通过 Smooth Bundle 帐户查看使用情况。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to Smooth Bundle to manage CDN projects and assets. List projects, inspect asset metadata, upload files, delete assets with confirmation, purge stale asset records, and review usage through your Smooth Bundle account.

plugins.name: Hyperhuman Agent Workspace
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中使用超人类健身内容。探索示例锻炼、查看结构化锻炼数据、检查锻炼流程和媒体，并生成可复制的 API 或嵌入适用于 Web 和移动应用程序的代码片段。登录 Hyper human Teams 浏览您的工作区内容，管理锻炼、计划、练习和社交内容，并通过聊天运行选定的内容工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Work with Hyperhuman fitness content directly in ChatGPT. Explore sample workouts, review structured workout data, inspect exercise flows and media, and generate copy-ready API or embed snippets for web and mobile apps. Sign in with Hyperhuman Teams to browse your workspace content, manage workouts, programs, exercises, and social drops, and run selected content workflows through chat.

plugins.name: Data Dolphin
plugins.productIntro: DataDolphin 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Dolphin Sistemas 的结构化知识库，包括项目、文档、架构规则和代理指令。通过单个连接，您可以查询实施上下文、检索项目规范并实时访问技术文档。所有访问均通过 Keycloak 受 OAuth 2.0 保护，并仅限于只读操作，确保 AI 代理使用安全且可审核。
plugins.productIntroEn: The DataDolphin connects ChatGPT to Dolphin Sistemas' structured knowledge base — including projects, documents, architecture rules, and agent instructions. With a single connection, you can query implementation context, retrieve project specifications, and access technical documentation in real time. All access is protected by OAuth 2.

plugins.name: elmah.io MCP
plugins.productIntro: elmah.io MCP 通过列出可访问的日志和组织、分析最近和频繁的日志消息、审查部署、检查正常运行时间和检测信号状态以及检索详细的错误上下文以调试生产问题，帮助用户从 ChatGPT 检查其 elmah.io 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: elmah.io MCP helps users inspect their elmah.io account from ChatGPT by listing accessible logs and organizations, analyzing recent and frequent log messages, reviewing deployments, checking uptime and heartbeat status, and retrieving detailed error context for debugging production issues.

plugins.name: QtMesh Cloud
plugins.productIntro: QtMesh Cloud 帮助用户检查 ChatGPT 的 3D 资产质量。用户可以列出他们的项目、查看扫描摘要、检查结果和扫描报告、检查质量门设置、更新所有者范围内的质量门以及控制项目的公共报告是否可见。
plugins.productIntroEn: QtMesh Cloud helps users inspect 3D asset quality from ChatGPT. Users can list their projects, review scan summaries, inspect findings and scan reports, check quality gate settings, update owner-scoped quality gates, and control whether a project's public report is visible.

plugins.name: Stem
plugins.description: 将您的人工智能连接到一个大脑。
plugins.originalDescription: Connect your AI to one brain.
plugins.productIntro: Stem是一种持久的跨AI记忆。连接一次，ChatGPT 就可以存储精炼的记忆（决策、事实、偏好、项目背景），在未来的聊天中回忆起最相关的记忆，将相关的想法链接到类型化的知识图中，并在 awase.dev/stem 上查看所有可视化内容。用户连接的每个 MCP 兼容工具都可以使用相同的内存，因此无需重新解释上下文。包含免费套餐；存储层是可选的。
plugins.productIntroEn: Stem is a persistent cross-AI memory. Connect it once and ChatGPT can store distilled memories (decisions, facts, preferences, project context), recall the most relevant ones in any future chat, link related ideas into a typed knowledge graph, and see it all visualized at awase.dev/stem.

plugins.name: Openlayer
plugins.productIntro: Openlayer 帮助团队检查 AI 项目、数据源、跟踪、测试、评估结果和治理控制，并通过 ChatGPT 管理私有工作区资源。
plugins.productIntroEn: Openlayer helps teams inspect AI projects, data sources, traces, tests, evaluation results, and governance controls, and manage private workspace resources through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Kody
plugins.description: 将代理工作转变为软件
plugins.productIntro: Kody 将 ChatGPT 中的成功成果转化为耐用的、用户拥有的软件。 ChatGPT 可以使用 Kody 查找用户的可用功能，并将工作解决方案转变为可重用的包、时间表、网络钩子、便携式内存和秘密支持的连接。凭证保留在服务器端，安装的社区包被分叉到用户的帐户中，并且保存的工作流可以稍后运行，而无需再次调用模型。相同的用户拥有的工件在支持 MCP 的代理中仍然可用。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kody turns successful work in ChatGPT into durable, user-owned software. ChatGPT can use Kody to find the user's available capabilities and turn working solutions into reusable packages, schedules, webhooks, portable memories, and secret-backed connections.

plugins.name: DB Fiddle
plugins.description: 无需离开聊天即可运行 SQL
plugins.productIntro: DB Fiddle 插件允许用户直接从 ChatGPT 和 Codex 在一次性沙箱环境中运行 SQL。
plugins.productIntroEn: The DB Fiddle plugin lets users run SQL against a disposable sandbox environment, directly from ChatGPT and Codex.

plugins.name: QA Wolf
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 QA Wolf 以检查授权工作区、在云浏览器中探索暂存应用程序、请求 QA Wolf AI 实施测试、运行现有测试并审查结果。关注实时会议链接并分别验证验证、发布和草稿或活动准备情况。工具还管理测试配置、流程标签、问题、计划或部署触发器以及工作区测试电子邮件。需要具有所需工作空间权限的 QA Wolf 帐户。运行程序和 AI 工作可能会产生费用，测试操作可能会更改正在测试的应用程序。连接的集成可以发布代码或发送消息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to QA Wolf to inspect authorized workspaces, explore a staging app in a cloud browser, request test implementation from QA Wolf AI, run existing tests and review results. Follow live session links and verify validation, publication and draft or active readiness separately.

plugins.name: Rootly
plugins.description: 使用 Rootly 管理事件
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到 Rootly 以调查事件、总结警报和时间表、审查待命时间表和升级路径，以及管理事件后续工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Rootly to investigate incidents, summarize alerts and timelines, review on-call schedules and escalation paths, and manage incident follow-up work.

plugins.name: Rubikpara AI Asistan
plugins.description: Rubikpara 产品和 API 指南
plugins.productIntro: AI助手，让您可以访问有关Rubikpara产品、API集成、文档和错误代码的官方信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rubikpara ürünleri, API entegrasyonları, dokümantasyon ve hata kodları hakkında resmi bilgilere erişmenizi sağlayan AI asistanı.

plugins.name: DataBlue
plugins.description: AI 代理的实时网络数据
plugins.originalDescription: Live web data for AI agents
plugins.productIntro: DataBlue 是人工智能代理的实时网络数据层。在 ChatGPT 中，用户可以搜索网络、抓取一个或多个公共页面、绘制和抓取网站、提取结构化事实以及查询 DataBlue 的结构化数据 API 目录。
plugins.productIntroEn: DataBlue is a live web data layer for AI agents. In ChatGPT, users can search the web, scrape one or many public pages, map and crawl websites, extract structured facts, and query DataBlue's catalog of structured data APIs.

plugins.name: Embrasure
plugins.productIntro: Embrasure 帮助 ChatGPT 和 Codex 调查静默数据故障，而无需查询任意仓库行。检查表健康状况和侦察证据，跟踪表级和列级沿袭，识别下游服务和所有者，并在更改之前了解爆炸半径。读取尊重工作区权限。侦察兵的变更总是需要预览和明确的批准。
plugins.productIntroEn: Embrasure helps ChatGPT and Codex investigate silent data failures without querying arbitrary warehouse rows. Inspect table health and Scout evidence, trace table- and column-level lineage, identify downstream services and owners, and understand blast radius before a change. Reads respect workspace permissions. Scout changes always require preview and explicit approval.

plugins.name: PayU Builder MCP
plugins.productIntro: 搜索 PayU 的官方文档，按平台和语言浏览支付集成目录，并获取 Web、iOS、Android、React Native、Flutter、Cordova 和 API 集成的生产就绪代码片段。支持 9 种编程语言，并提供 UPI、卡、网上银行、钱包、EMI 和标记化的即用示例。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search PayU's official documentation, browse the payment integration catalog by platform and language, and fetch production-ready code snippets for Web, iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Cordova, and API integrations. Supports 9 programming languages with ready-to-use examples for UPI, cards, net banking, wallets, EMI, and tokenization.

plugins.name: Upstash Redis
plugins.description: Redis 和其他 Upstash 产品
plugins.productIntro: 通过托管 Upstash MCP 服务器（首次使用时为 OAuth）管理 ChatGPT 中的 Upstash 资源：创建和检查 Redis 数据库并在其上运行命令、发布 QStash 消息并管理计划、构建矢量和搜索索引以及驱动 Box 沙箱和 Blob 存储。凭据保留在服务器上，仅在您请求时才会返回。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage your Upstash resources from ChatGPT through the hosted Upstash MCP server (OAuth on first use): create and inspect Redis databases and run commands on them, publish QStash messages and manage schedules, build Vector and Search indexes, and drive Box sandboxes and Blob storage. Credentials stay on the server and are returned only when you ask for them.

plugins.name: Vioscale AI
plugins.productIntro: Vioscale AI 使用有证据支持的事实、透明的分数和规范引用帮助用户发现、比较和评估软件。
plugins.productIntroEn: Vioscale AI helps users discover, compare, and evaluate software using evidence-backed facts, transparent scores, and canonical citations.

plugins.name: Unblocked
plugins.productIntro: Unblocked 是代理软件开发的上下文层。它对您的代码、对话、问题、文档、产品和生产系统进行推理，以便代理可以在更少的人工干预下正确完成工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Unblocked is the context layer for agentic software development. It reasons across your code, conversations, issues, docs, product, and production systems so agents can complete work correctly with less human intervention.

plugins.name: BrowserStack
plugins.productIntro: 管理测试用例、执行手动或自动测试、调试故障并获取修复建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage test cases, execute manual or automated tests, debug failures, and get suggested fixes.

plugins.name: GEO Tool Check
plugins.productIntro: GEO Tool Check帮助用户评估公共页面是否可以被人工智能搜索系统阅读、理解和引用。它对页面准备情况进行评分，检查主要人工智能爬虫是否被阻止，并评估草稿段落的可引用性。检查无需帐户或 API 密钥即可运行，并使用与 geo-tool.com 相同的评分逻辑。
plugins.productIntroEn: GEO Tool Check helps users assess whether a public page can be read, understood, and cited by AI search systems. It scores page readiness, checks whether major AI crawlers are blocked, and evaluates draft passages for citability. Checks run without an account or API key and use the same scoring logic as geo-tool.com.

plugins.name: Appwrite
plugins.productIntro: Appwrite 的插件可帮助用户探索他们的项目、检查数据库和存储，并通过 ChatGPT 管理用户、功能、消息传递和站点。发现可用的操作，查看所需的参数，并通过写入确认执行更改。启用文档搜索后，搜索官方 Appwrite 文档以获取概念和实施指南。
plugins.productIntroEn: Appwrite's plugin helps users explore their projects, inspect databases and storage, and manage users, functions, messaging, and sites through ChatGPT. Discover available operations, review required parameters, and execute changes with write confirmation. Search official Appwrite documentation for concepts and implementation guidance when documentation search is enabled.

plugins.name: BoxToPlay
plugins.description: 管理游戏服务器和 VPS
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 和 Codex 管理您的 BoxToPlay 游戏服务器、VPS 和网络托管。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage your BoxToPlay game servers, VPS, and web hosting directly from ChatGPT and Codex.

plugins.name: Tuist
plugins.productIntro: Tuist 帮助团队检查 Xcode、Gradle 和 Bazel 构建数据、测试结果、缓存活动、预览、运行程序作业和项目配置。它还支持授权帐户设置和选定的测试用例更新。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tuist helps teams inspect Xcode, Gradle, and Bazel build data, test results, cache activity, previews, runner jobs, and project configuration. It also supports authorized account setup and selected test-case updates.

plugins.name: Strix
plugins.description: AI 渗透测试和漏洞分类
plugins.productIntro: Strix 将 AI 渗透测试和漏洞管理引入 ChatGPT。查看最近的测试，按严重程度对开放发现进行优先级排序，并检查证据和补救步骤。开始针对您授权的 Web 应用程序、API 和存储库进行测试；重新测试结果；并通过连接的集成打开修复拉取请求或票证。检查拉取请求安全审查和供应链调查结果，管理定期计划和资产，并总结工作区的安全活动。使用 OAuth 使用您的 Strix 帐户登录。访问权限遵循您的 Strix 工作区角色和资源权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: Strix brings AI penetration testing and vulnerability management into ChatGPT. Review recent tests, prioritize open findings by severity, and inspect evidence and remediation steps. Start tests against your authorized web applications, APIs, and repositories; retest findings; and open fix pull requests or tickets through connected integrations.

plugins.name: SCVD x402 Verifier
plugins.description: 检查 x402 门和收据
plugins.productIntro: SCVD x402 验证程序在不付款的情况下检查付款挑战，验证签名的 x402 报价和收据，读取记录的端点准备情况，解释缺陷类别，并检查 SCVD 工件签名。结果描述了证据和限制；他们不建立交付或保证提供商。所有工具都是免费的，无需钱包或登录。通话记录使用情况统计。对没有记录探测的合格主机的准备情况查找将主机名添加到公共队列中，并询问计数以供以后发现扫描；呼叫者身份不包含在该队列中。
plugins.productIntroEn: SCVD x402 Verifier checks payment challenges without paying, verifies signed x402 offers and receipts, reads recorded endpoint readiness, explains defect classes, and checks SCVD artifact signatures. Results describe evidence and limits; they do not establish delivery or guarantee a provider. All tools are free and no wallet or login is required. Calls record usage statistics.

plugins.name: qBraid
plugins.productIntro: qBraid 帮助用户探索量子设备、验证和模拟电路、提交量子作业并检查结果。用户可以管理云计算、检查笔记本和软件环境、浏览 qBook 课程、注册课程以及在授权后查看学习者进度。它还支持组织成员资格和信用工作流程、账单摘要和支持请求。通过此应用程序无法购买学分以及创建或重新部署课程。某些操作会花费现有积分、更改访问权限或发送消息，并且支持内容可以与支持服务共享。
plugins.productIntroEn: qBraid helps users explore quantum devices, validate and simulate circuits, submit quantum jobs, and inspect results. Users can manage cloud compute, inspect notebooks and software environments, browse qBook courses, enroll in courses, and review learner progress when authorized. It also supports organization membership and credit workflows, billing summaries, and support requests.

plugins.name: Limrun
plugins.description: 在云模拟器上测试应用程序
plugins.productIntro: Limrun 在云端为您的代理提供 iOS 模拟器和 Android 模拟器。只需要一个设备，它就会在几秒钟内准备就绪，如果您需要的话，还可以预装您的应用程序。从那里，代理以测试人员的方式工作：获取屏幕截图、读取可访问性树、点击、键入、滚动、打开 URL、启动应用程序并提取日志。完成后删除设备，或让它自行关闭。
plugins.productIntroEn: Limrun gives your agent iOS simulators and Android emulators in the cloud. Ask for a device and it is ready in seconds, with your app pre-installed if you want. From there the agent works the way a tester would: it takes screenshots, reads the accessibility tree, taps, types, scrolls, opens URLs, launches apps and pulls logs.

plugins.name: Greptile
plugins.description: 审查代码和 PR 反馈
plugins.productIntro: GitHub 和 GitLab 的 AI 代码审查代理。查看 Greptile 的 PR 审查意见，在您的工作分支上运行审查，并直接从 Codex 搜索您组织的知识库和编码模式。
plugins.productIntroEn: AI code review agent for GitHub and GitLab. View Greptile's PR review comments, run reviews on your working branch, and search your organization's knowledge base and coding patterns, directly from Codex.

plugins.name: Unbounce - Classic Builder
plugins.description: 创建取消弹跳登陆页面
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 Unbounce 帐户即可创建和编辑登陆页面、添加 A/B 测试变体、设置流量分配以及检查页面性能，而无需离开聊天。 描述您想要的页面，Unbounce 将构建它；要求新的变体、标题更改或转化报告，这些都会在您的帐户中处理。 适用于您现有的 Unbounce 页面、域和页面组。需要 Unbounce 帐户和 Classic Builder。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Unbounce account to create and edit landing pages, add A/B test variants, set traffic splits, and check page performance without leaving the chat. Describe the page you want and Unbounce will build it; ask for a new variant, a headline change, or a conversion report and it's handled in your account. Works with your existing Unbounce pages, domains, and page groups.

plugins.name: LabWired
plugins.description: 在虚拟芯片上运行固件
plugins.productIntro: LabWired 在微控制器（ARM Cortex-M、RISC-V 和 ESP32）的确定性模拟上运行真正的嵌入式固件，就在对话中。选择一块板，将 MCU 与传感器、显示器和总线连接起来，编译固件，然后在您可以观看的交互式硬件实验室中运行它 - 无需物理板。刷新到真实芯片的相同固件二进制文件在模拟器中运行，因此结果具有足够的可重复性，可以进行调试和打开 CI。
plugins.productIntroEn: LabWired runs real embedded firmware on a deterministic simulation of microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V, and ESP32), right inside the conversation. Pick a board, wire up an MCU with sensors, displays, and buses, compile firmware, and run it in an interactive hardware lab you can watch — no physical board required.

plugins.name: Gateway
plugins.description: 通过 SSH 管理服务器
plugins.productIntro: Gateway 允许用户从 ChatGPT 管理拥有的 Linux 和 Windows OpenSSH 服务器：检查运行状况和配置、运行可审核命令和键入的管理操作、传输文件以及跟踪持久作业。
plugins.productIntroEn: Gateway lets users manage owned Linux and Windows OpenSSH servers from ChatGPT: inspect health and configuration, run auditable commands and typed administrative operations, transfer files, and follow durable jobs.

plugins.name: Tiniest Cloud
plugins.description: 通过登录部署 Web 应用程序
plugins.productIntro: Tiniest Cloud 托管静态 Web 应用程序，并为每个应用程序提供登录、每用户存储、实时、推送通知、计划作业和无需配置的语言模型。通过对话，您可以部署文件夹并获取实时 URL、通过电子邮件与某人共享应用程序、回滚到早期版本、连接第三方 API（无需将其密钥放入页面中）、安排重复工作以及将应用程序放在您自己的域中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tiniest Cloud hosts static web apps and gives each one sign-in, per-user storage, realtime, push notifications, scheduled jobs and a language model with nothing to configure. From a conversation you can deploy a folder and get a live URL, share the app with someone by email, roll back to an earlier version, connect a third-party API without putting its key in the page, schedule recurring…

plugins.name: AiAkiv Memory
plugins.productIntro: AiAkiv 是 AI 代理和队友通过 MCP 共享的长期记忆。它将对话的重要部分保存为知识图，并跨会话、工具和队友回忆它们，因此一个人工智能保存上下文，下一个人工智能拾取上下文，整个团队从一个共享内存而不是分散的私人聊天中工作。使用显式命令（“ak save”）保存，通过语义搜索按含义回忆。通过 OAuth 登录托管远程 MCP 服务器；支持韩语和英语。
plugins.productIntroEn: AiAkiv is long-term memory that AI agents and teammates share over MCP. It saves the important parts of your conversations as a knowledge graph and recalls them across sessions, tools, and teammates — so context one AI saves, the next one picks up, and a whole team works from one shared memory instead of scattered private chats.

plugins.name: RepoLore
plugins.productIntro: RepoLore 通过提交、拉取请求、问题、补丁和回归证据跟踪文件和行范围，帮助开发人员了解公共 GitHub 代码存在的原因。
plugins.productIntroEn: RepoLore helps developers understand why public GitHub code exists by tracing files and line ranges through commits, pull requests, issues, patches, and regression evidence.

plugins.name: Tessryx
plugins.description: 构建和托管实时网络应用程序
plugins.originalDescription: Build and host live web apps
plugins.productIntro: Tessryx 为代理提供了构建的地方。它通过聊天为真实网站、API 或内部工具创建数据、逻辑、页面和计划作业，并且 Tessryx 将它们托管在用户自己域的公共 URL 上。不会生成供用户部署的代码，也无需在本地运行任何内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tessryx gives an agent somewhere to build. From chat, it creates the data, logic, pages and scheduled jobs for a real website, API or internal tool, and Tessryx hosts them at a public URL on the user's own domain. No code is generated for the user to deploy and nothing needs to be run locally.

plugins.name: Better Design
plugins.description: 人工智能代理的设计系统
plugins.productIntro: Better Design 为 AI 编码代理提供了用于前端工作的设计工程层。
plugins.productIntroEn: Better Design gives AI coding agents a design-engineering layer for frontend work.

plugins.name: nunu.ai
plugins.description: 人工智能驱动的软件测试
plugins.productIntro: 使用 nunu.ai 插件，您可以自动化 QA 测试。使用自然语言编写测试用例，并在真实的 Android 和 iOS 设备、Windows VM 和浏览器上端到端运行它们。自动检查过去的运行、审查错误并更新测试用例。创建完整的测试计划并在每个新版本或按计划运行它们。
plugins.productIntroEn: With the nunu.ai plugin, you can automate your QA testing. Author test cases in natural language and run them end to end on real Android and iOS devices, Windows VMs, and Browsers. Automatically inspect past runs, review bugs, and update test cases. Create complete test plans and run them on every new build or on a schedule.

plugins.name: Cloudflare
plugins.productIntro: Cloudflare 帮助用户搜索产品文档、发现 API 端点，以及通过 ChatGPT 跨其 Cloudflare 帐户读取、创建、更新或删除资源。
plugins.productIntroEn: Cloudflare helps users search product documentation, discover API endpoints, and read, create, update, or delete resources across their Cloudflare accounts through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Postman
plugins.productIntro: 为 Codex 配备完整 API 生命周期的专业 Postman 技能。通过代理友好、文件系统优先的工作流程发现、设计、测试、记录、模拟、监控和改进 API
plugins.productIntroEn: Equip Codex with specialized Postman skills for the complete API lifecycle. Discover, design, test, document, mock, monitor, and improve APIs through agent-friendly, filesystem-first workflows

plugins.name: LaunchDarkly
plugins.productIntro: 直接通过聊天管理 LaunchDarkly 功能标志、AgentControl 配置（AI 代理提示/模型）、实验、受保护和自动部署、分段、指标、仪表板、警报和可观察性数据（日志、跟踪、错误、会话）。创建和定位标志、运行和分析实验、配置 AI 代理提示和工具、构建仪表板和警报，以及在不离开对话的情况下调查生产问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage LaunchDarkly feature flags, AgentControl Configs (AI agent prompts/models), experiments, guarded and automated rollouts, segments, metrics, dashboards, alerts, and observability data (logs, traces, errors, sessions) directly from chat.

plugins.name: Better Stack
plugins.productIntro: AI 代理的可观察性：使用 SQL 查询日志、跟踪、指标和错误，构建仪表板和图表警报，管理正常运行时间监视器，响应事件，查看谁在值班，以及发布状态页面报告。您还可以在 Linear 或 Jira 中创建和链接错误问题，并在不离开聊天的情况下搜索 Better Stack 的文档。连接到您的 Better Stack 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: Observability for AI agents: query your logs, traces, metrics, and errors with SQL, build dashboards and chart alerts, manage uptime monitors, respond to incidents, see who's on-call, and publish status page reports. You can also create and link error issues in Linear or Jira and search Better Stack's docs without leaving the chat. Connects to your Better Stack account.

plugins.name: Loadster
plugins.productIntro: Loadster 帮助用户创建和运行测试脚本、准备负载测试场景、配置综合监视器，并通过 ChatGPT 调查已完成的测试和监视结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Loadster helps users create and play test scripts, prepare load test scenarios, configure synthetic monitors, and investigate finished test and monitoring results through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Termalin
plugins.description: 通过聊天管理您的服务器
plugins.productIntro: Termalin 将您的服务器连接到聊天。要求 ChatGPT 检查磁盘空间、跟踪日志、重新启动服务、编辑配置或安装软件包 - 它通过 SSH 运行实际命令，并通过 SFTP 在您注册的服务器上读取或写入文件，并在对话中报告。它还可以列出表并通过相同的安全路径对数据库运行只读或完整查询。任何 SSH 密钥都不会粘贴到任何地方：服务器通过 Termalin 连接器向外连接（单行安装），每次运行都使用短期证书进行身份验证，并且通过您的 termal.
plugins.productIntroEn: Termalin connects your servers to the chat. Ask ChatGPT to check disk space, tail a log, restart a service, edit a config or install a package — it runs real commands over SSH and reads or writes files over SFTP on the servers you enrolled, and reports back in the conversation. It can also list tables and run read-only or full queries on your databases through the same secure path.

plugins.name: Clerk
plugins.productIntro: Clerk 帮助开发人员找到用于身份验证、登录和注册、组织、访问控制和计费集成的 SDK 代码示例。按标签浏览可用示例，或检索常见应用程序工作流程的单个片段和精选捆绑包。
plugins.productIntroEn: Clerk helps developers find SDK code examples for authentication, sign-in and sign-up, organizations, access control, and billing integration. Browse the available examples by tag or retrieve individual snippets and curated bundles for common application workflows.

plugins.name: MacroDroid Macro Builder
plugins.originalDescription: Build a macro by describing it
plugins.productIntro: 用日常语言描述您想要的自动化，并获取完整的 MacroDroid 宏，准备导入到您的 Android 手机上。
plugins.productIntroEn: Describe the automation you want in everyday language and get a complete MacroDroid macro back, ready to import on your Android phone.

plugins.name: ChatStack - App Specs & Costs
plugins.description: 获取应用程序的范围和成本
plugins.originalDescription: Get scope and costs for apps
plugins.productIntro: 将应用创意转化为详细的需求、MVP 范围和估计的一次性开发成本。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn app ideas into detailed requirements, an MVP scope and an estimated one-time development cost.

plugins.name: ApyHub EU
plugins.productIntro: 使用 ApyHub 查找并调用需要外部处理的任务的生产 API。按功能搜索目录，然后调用适合的端点。涵盖文件转换（Word、PDF、Excel、图像）、文档生成、OCR 和文本提取、数据验证（电子邮件、电话、增值税、IBAN、税号）、丰富、地理位置和 IP 数据、货币和单位转换、QR 和条形码生成、存档处理和 AI 实用程序。首先搜索以查看可用的内容，查看端点详细信息，然后执行。每个端点返回自己的成本和认证元数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use ApyHub to find and call production APIs for tasks that need external processing. Search the catalog by capability, then call the endpoint that fits. Covers file conversion (Word, PDF, Excel, images), document generation, OCR and text extraction, data validation (email, phone, VAT, IBAN, tax IDs), enrichment, geolocation and IP data, currency and unit conversion, QR and barcode genera…

plugins.name: Chartquery
plugins.productIntro: Chartquery 从 ChatGPT 生成图表、图表、QR 码、条形码和标签。描述数据或有效负载并获取可以打开的公共渲染 URL。
plugins.productIntroEn: Chartquery generates charts, diagrams, QR codes, barcodes, and labels from ChatGPT. Describe the data or payload and get a public render URL you can open.

plugins.name: Sabre Developer Hub MCP Server
plugins.productIntro: 开发人员中心 MCP 帮助用户按工件名称或内容搜索 Sabre 开发人员中心文档、检查工件详细信息、获取文档页面以及查看最近更新的文档。
plugins.productIntroEn: Developer Hub MCP helps users search Sabre Developer Hub documentation by artifact name or content, inspect artifact details, fetch documentation pages, and review recently updated documentation.

plugins.name: Flowlines
plugins.description: 了解您的 AI 代理
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 Flowlines 帐户以查看 AI 代理活动、比较不同时间段的结果、调查不成功的会话并分析用户群体。使用聚合指标、信号、主题图和重点会议证据来了解调查结果并确定产品需求。根据要求，将独立验证的结果保存为私人工作区注释。需要一个能够访问包含代理数据的工作区的 Flowlines 帐户。授权结果可以包括最终用户对话和活动数据；答复应总结证据并掩盖直接的个人标识符。 Flowlines 在私人遥测中记录工具活动、参数、结果和对话结果报告。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Flowlines account to review AI agent activity, compare outcomes across time periods, investigate unsuccessful sessions, and analyze user cohorts. Use aggregate metrics, signals, topic maps, and focused session evidence to understand findings and identify product needs. Save independently verified findings as private workspace notes when requested.

plugins.name: html.contact - Contact Forms
plugins.productIntro: 使用 854 Labs 的 html.contact 为您的网站创建联系表单，无需构建自定义后端。获取可安装的 HTML、修复表单设置问题、将电子邮件通知发送给经过验证的收件人，以及查看选定的提交内容。还支持潜在客户捕获、反馈和候补名单表格。使用您链接的 html.contact 帐户；更改和电子邮件测试需要确认。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create contact forms for your website with html.contact by 854 Labs, without building a custom backend. Get installable HTML, fix form setup issues, route email notifications to verified recipients, and review selected submissions. Also supports lead capture, feedback, and waitlist forms. Uses your linked html.contact account; changes and email tests require confirmation.

plugins.name: Lobu
plugins.productIntro: Lobu 为 ChatGPT 提供对持久工作区内存、连接数据、设备、通知通道和其他代理的受管理访问。用户可以搜索和保存共享上下文、查询授权数据、预览更改以及在需要时经人工批准运行权限检查操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Lobu gives ChatGPT governed access to durable workspace memory, connected data, devices, notification channels, and other agents. Users can search and save shared context, query authorized data, preview changes, and run permission-checked actions with human approvals where required.

plugins.name: Logfire
plugins.productIntro: Logfire 帮助工程团队查询遥测、调查异常、构建仪表板和警报、安装可观察性集成以及管理其私有工作区中的提示和变量。
plugins.productIntroEn: Logfire helps engineering teams query telemetry, investigate exceptions, build dashboards and alerts, install observability integrations, and manage prompts and variables in their private workspace.

plugins.name: Domain Scan
plugins.productIntro: CYBERACE 的域扫描可检查域的电子邮件、HTTPS 和 DNS 安全性，包括 SPF、DKIM、DMARC、TLS 证书、安全标头、DNSSEC 和阻止列表。获取安全评分、每次检查的结果和建议的修复措施，以及可用的临时报告链接。不需要帐户或 API 密钥。每次扫描都会存储结果、消耗扫描配额并可能触发管理通知。该插件提供按需公共领域扫描；它不会访问帐户数据、配置监控或修改 DNS 记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: Domain Scan by CYBERACE checks a domain's email, HTTPS and DNS security, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, TLS certificates, security headers, DNSSEC and blocklists. Get a security score, per-check findings and suggested fixes, with a temporary report link when available. No account or API key is required.

plugins.name: Honeycomb (EU)
plugins.productIntro: Honeycomb 帮助用户调查可观测性数据、检查跟踪、AI 对话和异常信号、运行查询和 BubbleUp 分析、管理警报和仪表板，并通过 ChatGPT 遵循仪器迁移指南。
plugins.productIntroEn: Honeycomb helps users investigate observability data, inspect traces, AI conversations, and anomaly signals, run queries and BubbleUp analyses, manage alerts and dashboards, and follow instrumentation migration guidance through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Akwadra
plugins.description: 构建和预览网络应用程序
plugins.productIntro: Akwadra 允许用户从 ChatGPT 创建、检查、编辑、验证和预览 Web 应用程序项目。 ChatGPT 写入源文件，而 Akwadra 将它们存储在登录用户的私有工作区中。该插件还可以读取已托管项目的构建日志。它不购买托管或处理付款。
plugins.productIntroEn: Akwadra lets users create, inspect, edit, validate, and preview web-app projects from ChatGPT. ChatGPT writes the source files while Akwadra stores them in the signed-in user’s private workspace. The plugin can also read build logs for already-hosted projects. It does not purchase hosting or process payments.

plugins.name: doDomain
plugins.productIntro: doDomain 是域连接即服务：它为产品提供引导流程，将客户自己的域指向该产品，并处理其背后的 DNS 记录、验证和证书。 doDomain 插件可让 ChatGPT 从您的帐户驱动该工作：检查域的当前 DNS 状态、列出您的团队中配置的应用程序、列出现有的域连接、为客户创建新的连接会话、查找已启动的会话、在记录到位后验证会话，以及对已漂移的连接重新运行验证。
plugins.productIntroEn: doDomain is domain-connect-as-a-service: it gives a product a guided flow for pointing a customer's own domain at that product, and handles the DNS records, verification, and certificates behind it.

plugins.name: Game Studio
plugins.description: 设计、原型和发布浏览器游戏
plugins.originalDescription: Design, prototype, and ship browser games
plugins.productIntro: Game Studio：设计、原型和发布浏览器游戏。
plugins.productIntroEn: Plan, prototype, and build browser games with guided workflows for gameplay systems, UI, asset pipelines, and playtesting across 2D and 3D projects.

plugins.name: Build macOS Apps
plugins.description: 使用SwiftUI和AppKit指导构建、调试、检测和实施macOS应用程序

plugins.productIntroEn: Create surveys and forms, distribute them to respondents, and analyze the results — all within a single ChatGPT conversation using the SurveySparrow app.

plugins.name: Vanta
plugins.productIntro: Vanta 帮助用户审查 ChatGPT 中的合规性测试、控制、证据、政策、风险、供应商、审计、人员、访问审查和漏洞。支持的工作流程包括管理测试和控制、上传和评估证据、创建和删除策略、更新风险和供应商记录、配置 SLA 以及管理 AI 治理记录、调查问卷和知识库资源。用户还可以在连接的服务中创建票证并管理隐私请求。策略审批和隐私工作流程可以发送通知，知识库资源可以发布到信任中心。可用工具取决于连接组织的启用功能和用户的权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: Vanta helps users review compliance tests, controls, evidence, policies, risks, vendors, audits, personnel, access reviews, and vulnerabilities in ChatGPT. Supported workflows include managing tests and controls, uploading and evaluating evidence, creating and deleting policies, updating risk and vendor records, configuring SLAs, and managing AI governance records, questionnaires, and kn…

plugins.name: ZeroBounce
plugins.description: 立即验证您的电子邮件
plugins.productIntro: 使用 ZeroBounce 的 ChatGPT 支持的助手立即验证您的电子邮件。此应用程序可让您在发送营销活动之前快速测试和验证电子邮件地址，帮助您降低退回率、保护发件人声誉并提高送达率。
plugins.productIntroEn: Validate your emails instantly with ZeroBounce’s ChatGPT-powered assistant. This app lets you quickly test and verify email addresses before sending campaigns, helping you reduce bounce rates, protect your sender reputation, and improve deliverability.

plugins.name: Amplemarket
plugins.productIntro: 连接到 Amplemarket 进行勘探、丰富、研究和参与 — 全部通过 ChatGPT 进行。使用职位、资历、行业、公司规模和地点等过滤器搜索人员。丰富人员和公司的详细资料、技术堆栈、资金历史和联系信息。查找联系人或帐户及其参与历史记录。创建和管理潜在客户列表、将潜在客户添加到序列等。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect to Amplemarket to prospect, enrich, research, and engage — all through ChatGPT. Search for people using filters like title, seniority, industry, company size, and location. Enrich people and companies for detailed profiles, tech stacks, funding history, and contact information. Look up contacts or accounts and their engagement history.

plugins.name: Monster Job Search
plugins.description: 搜索数百万个实时职位
plugins.productIntro: 利用 ChatGPT 中的 Monster 庞大的本地工作网络。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tap into Monster’s massive job network natively within ChatGPT.

plugins.name: LicitaLAB
plugins.productIntro: LicitaLAB 允许进行快速和结构性的公开、分析和比较。 许可文件的额外信息平台，包括技术要求、广场、评估标准和标准，有助于理解扩展档案所需的机会。 我们经常探索机会，修改协会文件并在接下来的时间里提供信息。 Además, pueden hacer preguntas en lenguaje nature sobre Oportunidades específicas, proedores, compradores y sobre el uso de…
plugins.productIntroEn: LicitaLAB permite encontrar, analizar y entender compras públicas de forma rápida y estructurada. La plataforma extrae información clave desde documentos de licitación, incluyendo requisitos técnicos, plazos, montos y criterios de evaluación, facilitando la comprensión de cada oportunidad sin necesidad de revisar archivos extensos.

plugins.name: Articulate
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Articulate。描述您正在创建的培训：主题、目标、培训对象以及培训深度。然后打开并查看在 Articulate 中为您创建的大纲，并生成交互式培训的完整内容。您还可以搜索和浏览现有课程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connects ChatGPT to Articulate. Describe the training you're creating: topic, goals, who it's for, and how in-depth it should be. Then open and review the outline created for you in Articulate, and generate the full content for your interactive training. You can also search and browse your existing courses.

plugins.name: Brand24
plugins.productIntro: Codex 中的 Brand24 应用程序可让营销和公关团队使用简单的提示立即探索品牌提及、情绪和媒体报道。 无需离开 Codex，即可总结对话、跟踪品牌声誉、分析一段时间内的趋势并发现社交媒体、新闻、博客和论坛中的关键讨论来源。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Brand24 app in Codex lets marketing and PR teams instantly explore brand mentions, sentiment, and media coverage using simple prompts. Summarize conversations, track brand reputation, analyze trends over time, and uncover key discussion sources across social media, news, blogs, and forums without leaving Codex.

plugins.name: Faire Wholesale
plugins.productIntro: Faire 帮助零售商和精品店老板为他们的商店发现批发产品。按类别（例如蜡烛、贺卡、玩具）、属性（环保、手工制作）或趋势询问产品。获得一系列来自独立品牌的精选产品；点击查看详细信息并在 Faire 上订购。专为企业买家采购库存而设计，而不是为消费者购物而设计。
plugins.productIntroEn: Faire helps retailers and boutique owners discover wholesale products for their stores. Ask for products by category (e.g. candles, greeting cards, toys), by attribute (eco-friendly, handmade), or by trend. Get a curated set of products from independent brands; tap through to view details and order on Faire. Built for business buyers sourcing inventory, not for consumer shopping.

plugins.name: TrustMRR
plugins.description: 发现经过验证的初创公司
plugins.productIntro: 发现具有经过验证的收入信号的活跃科技初创公司。无需帐户即可探索最近添加的 25 家初创公司和 25 种增长最快的产品。连接 TrustMRR 帐户以过滤启动数据库并检索详细的启动记录。有些卡可能会显示信息性“待售”徽章。此只读插件不支持购买、优惠、交易、编辑或消息传递。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover active tech startups with verified revenue signals. Explore 25 recently added startups and 25 of the fastest-growing products without an account. Connect a TrustMRR account to filter the startup database and retrieve detailed startup records. Some cards may display an informational FOR SALE badge.

plugins.name: Strety
plugins.description: 在 ChatGPT 中运营您的公司
plugins.productIntro: Strety 帮助领导团队审查公司背景、查找和管理优先事项、更新记分卡、解决问题、协调待办事项以及通过 ChatGPT 维护共享运营文档。
plugins.productIntroEn: Strety helps leadership teams review company context, find and manage priorities, update scorecards, work through issues, coordinate to-dos, and maintain shared operating documents through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Flodesk
plugins.description: 分析您的电子邮件受众
plugins.productIntro: Flodesk 帮助用户分析电子邮件、订阅者、细分、工作流程、表单和结帐性能；检查和管理订户资料和细分会员资格；并通过 ChatGPT 创建可重复使用的受众群体。
plugins.productIntroEn: Flodesk helps users analyze email, subscriber, segment, workflow, form, and checkout performance; inspect and manage subscriber profiles and segment membership; and create reusable audience segments through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Meltwater
plugins.description: 您可以采取行动的情报
plugins.productIntro: Meltwater MCP 服务器将人工智能工具和工作流程连接到 Meltwater 的媒体和社交智能。搜索数十亿新闻文章和社交帖子，检索实时指标、趋势和情绪，生成布尔查询，并管理保存的搜索——所有这些都通过自然语言进行。需要有效的 Meltwater 订阅。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Meltwater MCP server connects AI tools and workflows to Meltwater’s media and social intelligence. Search billions of news articles and social posts, retrieve live metrics, trends, and sentiment, generate Boolean queries, and manage saved searches — all through natural language. Requires an active Meltwater subscription.

plugins.name: Blinq
plugins.description: 查找联系人并搜索笔记
plugins.productIntro: 通过 ChatGPT 与 Blinq 交互。人工智能联系人应用程序，专为结识新朋友而设计。
plugins.productIntroEn: Interact with Blinq via ChatGPT. The AI contacts app for people who meet people.

plugins.name: Lattice
plugins.description: 格子，无论您在哪里工作。
plugins.productIntro: 绩效管理不仅仅发生在绩效管理软件中。这种情况每天都会以一对一的方式发生，在 Slack 中，在晚上 9 点起草的文档中，并且越来越多地在您在发送电子邮件之前打开的 AI 助手中发生。 Lattice MCP 将您已经收集的每个信号（评论、1:1、反馈、目标和每周更新）连接到 ChatGPT 中，因此您已经使用的代理最终可以像您一样查看您的团队。
plugins.productIntroEn: Performance management doesn't happen just in performance management software. It happens every day in 1:1s, in Slack, in the doc you're drafting at 9pm, and increasingly in the AI assistant you open before your email.

plugins.name: Aris - Digital Consultant
plugins.description: 建立公司网站和人工智能
plugins.productIntro: [早期预览] Aris 帮助您了解如何建立自己的公司网站、内部系统甚至人工智能代理的高级视图。通过了解您的业务问题和需求，Aris 将提供以 KONGMY Digital Consultancy 的行业知识为基础的意见。
plugins.productIntroEn: [Early Preview] Aris helps you on understanding high level view on how to approach having your own company website, internal systems or even AI agent. By understanding your business problem and requirements, Aris will provide input grounded with industrial knowledge from KONGMY Digital Consultancy.

plugins.name: Sprinto
plugins.productIntro: Sprinto 帮助授权组织用户检查合规状态、搜索策略和证据、回答安全调查问卷以及管理来自 ChatGPT 的审计、控制、风险、供应商、人员、策略、任务和证据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sprinto helps authorized organization users inspect compliance status, search policies and evidence, answer security questionnaires, and manage audits, controls, risks, vendors, people, policies, tasks, and evidence from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Zoom Revenue Accelerator
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Zoom Revenue Accelerator，以查找销售对话、成绩单、AI 摘要、交易、团队和辅导记分卡。询问有关客户会议和管道活动的自然语言问题，然后从您已访问的记录中获得可靠的答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to Zoom Revenue Accelerator to look up sales conversations, transcripts, AI summaries, deals, teams, and coaching scorecards. Ask natural-language questions about customer meetings and pipeline activity, then get grounded answers from the records you already have access to.

plugins.name: Juicebox
plugins.productIntro: 连接 Juicebox 以探索您的采购见解，并让 Juicebox 代理来寻找候选人。询问使用情况、项目和外展，或直接根据工作描述启动 Juicebox 代理。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect Juicebox to explore your sourcing insights and put Juicebox agents to work finding candidates. Ask about usage, projects, and outreach, or launch a Juicebox agent directly from a job description.

plugins.name: BrightEdge
plugins.description: 分析 AEO 和 SEO 可见性
plugins.productIntro: BrightEdge 应用程序从用户连接的 BrightEdge 帐户检索指标，涵盖法学硕士的 AEO、GEO 和传统 SEO 绩效。它返回 AEO 引用和提及、AEO 和 SEO 竞争对手基准测试、关键字排名数据、页面级性能、语音份额竞争分数、Google Search Console 和网络分析指标、AI 概述引用差距分析和建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: The BrightEdge app retrieves metrics from a user's connected BrightEdge account, covering both AEO, GEO, and traditional SEO performance across LLMs. It returns AEO citations and mentions, AEO and SEO competitor benchmarking, keyword rank data, page-level performance, Share of Voice competitive scores, Google Search Console and web analytics metrics, AI Overview citation gap analysis, an…

plugins.name: iubenda
plugins.description: Web 和应用程序隐私合规性
plugins.productIntro: 将您的 AI 助手连接到 iubenda，以自始至终处理网站的法律合规性。创建和管理网站、生成适合您使用的服务的隐私和 cookie 策略、从 iubenda 目录添加数据处理服务、设置 cookie 同意横幅以及起草条款和条件，所有这些都通过自然语言进行。运行 cookie 扫描以检测跟踪器，然后更新您的策略以匹配您的网站更改。专为需要满足 GDPR、ePrivacy、美国各州隐私法以及跨市场隐私要求的创始人、机构和开发人员而构建，无需手动开销。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your AI assistant to iubenda to handle website legal compliance from start to finish. Create and manage sites, generate privacy and cookie policies tailored to the services you use, add data-processing services from iubenda's catalog, set up cookie consent banners, and draft terms and conditions, all through natural language.

plugins.name: Knowify
plugins.productIntro: Knowify 帮助用户检查来自 ChatGPT 的租户范围的施工和服务业务数据，包括项目记录、报告模型、发票、时间条目、模式以及回答运营问题所需的平台知识。
plugins.productIntroEn: Knowify helps users inspect tenant-scoped construction and service business data from ChatGPT, including project records, report models, invoices, time entries, schemas, and platform knowledge needed to answer operational questions.

plugins.name: VectorGov
plugins.productIntro: VectorGov 帮助用户研究巴西联邦公共采购立法、官方联邦采购目录项目以及来自 ChatGPT 的 TCU 采购决策。用户可以搜索精选的法律资源、查阅确切的文本、浏览目录分类，并通过证据链接验证答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: VectorGov helps users research Brazilian federal public procurement legislation, official federal purchasing catalog items, and TCU procurement decisions from ChatGPT. Users can search curated legal sources, consult exact texts, browse catalog classifications, and verify answers with evidence links.

plugins.name: Outreach
plugins.description: 收入团队的人工智能代理
plugins.productIntro: 将外展知识和行动引入 ChatGPT，以便您的团队可以更快地行动、结合跨系统的见解并完成高级收入任务，而无需切换工具。 Outreach 是一个面向所有市场推广团队的端到端人工智能收入平台。通过在每个收入工作流程中嵌入代理人工智能，Outreach 提高了销售效率，增加了渠道，并为领导者提供了大规模增加收入所需的可见性和可预测性。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring Outreach knowledge and actions into ChatGPT so your teams can move faster, combine insights across systems, and complete advanced revenue tasks without switching tools. Outreach is an end-to-end AI Revenue Platform for all go-to-market teams.

plugins.name: Workable MCP Server
plugins.productIntro: Workable MCP Server 帮助用户使用 ChatGPT 中的 Workable 帐户：发现帐户、检查职位和候选人、管理候选人工作流程操作、处理员工查找、休假、时间跟踪、请购单、录用通知、部门和绩效审核模板。
plugins.productIntroEn: Workable MCP Server helps users work with their Workable account from ChatGPT: discover accounts, inspect jobs and candidates, manage candidate workflow actions, handle employee lookup, time off, time tracking, requisitions, offers, departments, and performance review templates.

plugins.name: Domotz – Network Monitoring
plugins.productIntro: 通过自然语言监控和管理您的网络基础设施。无需切换工具即可询问站点、设备、警报、连接和网络运行状况。 Domotz MCP 服务器有助于将基础设施数据转化为清晰的答案、更快的故障排除以及 IT 团队和托管服务提供商可操作的运营见解。
plugins.productIntroEn: Monitor and manage your network infrastructure through natural language. Ask about sites, devices, alerts, connectivity, and network health without switching tools. The Domotz MCP server helps turn infrastructure data into clear answers, faster troubleshooting, and actionable operational insights for IT teams and managed service providers.

plugins.name: Carta CRM
plugins.productIntro: Carta CRM 将交易、公司和关系集中在一处，帮助投资团队掌控交易流程。跟踪每个阶段的机会，捕获会议记录和关键要点以及正确的交易或联系人，并在需要时快速找到过去的背景。
plugins.productIntroEn: Carta CRM helps investment teams stay on top of deal flow by keeping deals, companies, and relationships in one place. Track opportunities through each stage, capture meeting notes and key takeaways alongside the right deal or contact, and quickly find past context when you need it.

plugins.name: GST Invoice Maker
plugins.description: 免费打印 GST 账单
plugins.productIntro: GST Invoice Maker 为印度商店、餐馆、基拉纳斯和自由职业者创建符合 GST 的账单。索要简单语言的账单，并获得计算出的总计以及打开完全填写的账单的链接 - 可以打印或另存为 PDF。还提供现成的可下载帐单格式 PDF 和 GST 参考指南（必填发票字段、费率表）。免费，无需帐户，账单数据在内存中处理，从不存储。
plugins.productIntroEn: GST Invoice Maker creates GST-compliant bills for Indian shops, restaurants, kiranas, and freelancers. Ask for a bill in plain language and get computed totals plus a link that opens the bill fully filled in — ready to print or save as PDF. Also provides ready-made downloadable bill format PDFs and a GST reference guide (required invoice fields, rate slabs).

plugins.name: Stratws
plugins.productIntro: 通过 ChatGPT 直接将指标值导入 Stratws。使用与您的环境和平台访问权限集成的对话体验更有效地更新性能数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Import indicator values into Stratws directly through ChatGPT. Update performance data more efficiently using a conversational experience integrated with your environment and the platform’s access permissions.

plugins.name: VSI AI Automation
plugins.productIntro: VSI Technologies 为 9 个行业的企业部署生产级人工智能自动化——从医疗保健和物流到私募股权和房地产。
plugins.productIntroEn: VSI Technologies deploys production-grade AI automation for businesses across 9 industries — from healthcare and logistics to private equity and real estate.

plugins.name: Canonical Company Search
plugins.productIntro: Canonical 是经过验证的公司搜索研究和勘探。
plugins.productIntroEn: Canonical is verified company search for research and prospecting.

plugins.name: Company Dossier
plugins.productIntro: Company Dossier 完全根据公共数据编译任何公司或领域的完整、来源归属的情报文件。一项请求返回九个部分：概述和身份、人员和组织结构图、招聘雷达、资金轨迹、位置、技术指纹、新闻和时间表、关系网络和风险标记。每项声明都与公共来源相关，并标记为高/中/低可信度。专为尽职调查、供应商审查、销售准备和竞争研究而构建。没有账户，没有私人数据——只有公共来源。
plugins.productIntroEn: Company Dossier compiles a complete, source-attributed intelligence file on any company or domain — entirely from public data. One request returns nine sections: overview & identity, people & org chart, hiring radar, money trail, locations, tech fingerprint, news & timeline, relationship web, and risk flags. Every claim is tied to a public source and tagged High/Medium/Low confidence.

plugins.name: Arcade
plugins.productIntro: Arcade 可让您直接从 ChatGPT 构建品牌产品视频和演示，无需切换工具或选项卡。向 ChatGPT 提供提示、屏幕截图或通话备注，它就会生成包含视觉效果、动画和旁白的品牌视频。您还可以从现有的 Arcade 中查询性能数据，以了解哪些演示正在推动参与度。对于产品营销、销售跟进、产品发布和付费广告很有用。与 Figma、Granola、Notion、Slack 和 Apollo 等其他应用程序一起使用，实现端到端工作流程自动化。
plugins.productIntroEn: Arcade lets you build branded product videos and demos directly from ChatGPT, without switching tools or tabs. Give ChatGPT a prompt, screenshots, or notes from a call, and it generates an on-brand video with visuals, animations, and narration. You can also query performance data from your existing Arcades to see which demos are driving engagement.

plugins.name: Runrun.it
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Runrun.it 工作区，无需离开对话即可管理工作。该应用程序可让您使用实际的 Runrun.it 数据和权限快速创建一项或多项任务并搜索现有任务。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your Runrun.it workspace to manage work without leaving the conversation. This app lets you quickly create one or multiple tasks and search existing tasks, using your actual Runrun.it data and permissions.

plugins.name: Adobe Experience Manager
plugins.description: 管理您的 AEM 内容
plugins.productIntro: 只需描述您的需求，即可在 Adobe Experience Manager 中创建、编辑、搜索和发布页面和内容片段。不要在用户界面中导航，而是用简单的语言编写要执行的操作：更新英雄横幅、查找有关活动的页面或安排要发布的内容。所有更改均尊重您的 AEM 权限。更快地工作，减少重复性任务，并专注于最重要的事情 - 您的内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create, edit, search, and publish pages and content fragments in Adobe Experience Manager — simply by describing what you need. Instead of navigating the user interface, write what to do in plain language: update a hero banner, find pages about a campaign, or schedule content for launch. All changes respect your AEM permissions.

plugins.name: Success.co
plugins.description: 运行 EOS® 的下一代软件
plugins.productIntro: Success.co MCP 服务器可让您直接从 ChatGPT 控制整个 Success.co 工作区。
plugins.productIntroEn: Success.co MCP Server lets you control your entire Success.co workspace directly from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Hebbia
plugins.description: 人工智能促进财务严谨
plugins.productIntro: 将 Hebbia 的机构情报引入 ChatGPT 和 Codex。 Hebbia MCP 服务器可让您利用公司的知识和优质公众，就交易和投资做出更好的决策，并运行从研究到报告、幻灯片和财务模型的财务工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring Hebbia's institutional intelligence into ChatGPT and Codex. The Hebbia MCP server lets you tap into your firm's knowledge and premium public to make better decisions on deals and investments and run financial workflows from research to reports, slides, and financial models.

plugins.name: Firmable
plugins.description: 您的人工智能销售队友
