plugins.name: AuthorityPrompt GPT
plugins.description: 掌控你的人工智能公司事实
plugins.productIntro: 查看不完整或不一致的人工智能答案背后的业务问题，了解可观察的证据，并采取下一步的确切行动。 AuthorityPrompt 准备有证据支持的更正，在应用之前进行询问，并显示匹配的前后结果，而无需暴露技术 ID 或原始后端数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: See the business problem behind incomplete or inconsistent AI answers, understand the observable evidence, and take the next exact action. AuthorityPrompt prepares evidence-backed corrections, asks before applying them, and shows matched before/after results without exposing technical IDs or raw backend data.

plugins.name: Komplyt Zero
plugins.description: 保留人工智能所知道的内容。
plugins.productIntro: ChatGPT 会在会话之间忘记内容，并将其学到的任何内容锁定在一个工具内。 Komplyt Zero 捕获您对话中的重要内容，并将其转化为您专属的结构化、可搜索的知识库。
plugins.productIntroEn: ChatGPT forgets between sessions and locks whatever it learns inside one tool. Komplyt Zero captures what matters from your conversations and turns it into a structured, searchable knowledge base that stays yours.

plugins.name: 100Hires ATS
plugins.productIntro: 招聘人员使用 100Hires 来跟踪职位、候选人、申请、面试和评估。该连接器可让 ChatGPT 读取您的真实 ATS 数据并对其采取行动 - 在各个阶段之间移动候选人、安排面试、发送模板化的拒绝或外展消息、记录评估以及根据简历创建候选人。适用于您现有的 100Hires 帐户和权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: Recruiters use 100Hires to track jobs, candidates, applications, interviews, and evaluations. This connector lets ChatGPT read your real ATS data and act on it — move candidates between stages, schedule interviews, send templated rejection or outreach messages, log evaluations, and create candidates from resumes. Works with your existing 100Hires account and permissions.

plugins.name: Salesflare
plugins.productIntro: Salesflare 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 查找和管理 CRM 帐户、联系人、机会、管道、标签、任务和用户。该应用程序可以列出 CRM 记录，检查帐户源，创建新帐户、联系人、机会和任务，以及更新用户 Salesflare 工作区中的现有 CRM 记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: Salesflare helps users find and manage CRM accounts, contacts, opportunities, pipelines, tags, tasks, and users from ChatGPT. The app can list CRM records, inspect an account feed, create new accounts, contacts, opportunities, and tasks, and update existing CRM records in the user's Salesflare workspace.

plugins.name: Dover
plugins.productIntro: 将 Dover 的申请人跟踪系统引入 ChatGPT。在 100 多个招聘委员会上发布无限的职位，管理您的候选人渠道，协调面试和日程安排，并直接在与 ChatGPT 的对话中跟踪每个空缺职位的招聘进度。专为希望以更快、更简化的方式来管理招聘的创始人和招聘团队而设计。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring Dover's applicant tracking system into ChatGPT. Post unlimited jobs across 100+ job boards, manage your candidate pipeline, coordinate interviews and scheduling, and track hiring progress across every open role directly within your conversation with ChatGPT. Built for founders and hiring teams who want a faster, more streamlined way to manage recruiting.

plugins.name: Dynamoi
plugins.productIntro: Dynamoi 帮助艺术家和唱片公司使用免费的 Spotify 智能链接和 ChatGPT 的现有音乐推广记录。用户可以创建或刷新免费的 Smart Link 艺术家中心、检查 Smart Link 页面和分析、搜索其 Dynamoi 记录以及查看现有活动状态和绩效。此 ChatGPT 应用程序表面不会收取付款、启动付费活动启动、改变实时活动预算或开始外部 OAuth 连接流；这些步骤保留在 Dynamoi 仪表板中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Dynamoi helps artists and labels work with free Spotify Smart Links and existing music-promotion records from ChatGPT. Users can create or refresh free Smart Link artist hubs, inspect Smart Link pages and analytics, search their Dynamoi records, and review existing campaign status and performance.

plugins.name: Cirra AI
plugins.productIntro: Cirra AI 帮助管理员管理互联的 Salesforce 环境。审核元数据、运行查询和报告、管理用户和权限以及在连接的 Salesforce 组织中进行配置更改。
plugins.productIntroEn: Cirra AI helps admins manage connected Salesforce environments. Audit metadata, run queries and reports, manage users and permissions, and make configuration changes in connected Salesforce orgs.

plugins.name: NewHomeSource
plugins.productIntro: NewHomeSource 帮助用户根据位置、价格、卧室、建筑商和平面图偏好来发现新建住宅和社区。搜索超过 12,000 个新住宅社区 - 世界上最大的新建数据库。比较待售新房的价格、图片和平面图。
plugins.productIntroEn: NewHomeSource helps users discover new construction homes and communities by location, price, bedrooms, builder, and floorplan preferences. Search Over 12,000 New Home Communities - the World's Largest New Construction Database. Compare Pricing, Pictures, and Floor Plans for New Homes for Sale.

plugins.name: Terac
plugins.productIntro: Terac 直接通过聊天将您的 AI 代理与经过验证的人类专家连接起来。描述您需要完成的工作，无论是专家访谈、一轮客户研究、代码审查还是模型评估。我们通过人工确认的报价进行定价，招募和筛选合适的人员，将工作作为结构化结果返回，并仅在经过验证的完成情况下向专家付款。
plugins.productIntroEn: Terac connects your AI agent to verified human experts, right from the chat. Describe the work you need done, whether that's an expert interview, a round of customer research, a code review, or a model evaluation. We price it with a human confirmed quote, recruit and screen the right people, return the work as structured results, and pay experts only on verified completion.

plugins.name: AIMS360 Fashion & Consumer ERP
plugins.description: 时装和服装 ERP 见解
plugins.productIntro: AIMS360 是一个时尚 ERP、服装 ERP 和消费品牌 ERP 平台，将授权的 AIMS360 业务洞察引入 ChatGPT 和 Codex。 分析销售、客户订单、发票收入、未结订单、积压、客户、款式、产品、颜色、尺寸、Shopify 商店、批发和 DTC 渠道、销售代表、季节、利润、逾期发票、应收账款和业务绩效。 AIMS360 专为时尚和服装品牌打造，还为鞋类、珠宝、配饰、美容、保健、户外、家居、婴儿、宠物和其他消费品公司提供服务。
plugins.productIntroEn: AIMS360 is a fashion ERP, apparel ERP, and consumer brand ERP platform that brings authorized AIMS360 business insights into ChatGPT and Codex. Analyze sales, customer orders, invoiced revenue, open orders, backlog, customers, styles, products, colors, sizes, Shopify stores, wholesale and DTC channels, sales representatives, seasons, margins, overdue invoices, accounts receivable, and bu…

plugins.name: AI Leads Scout
plugins.description: 寻找优质 B2B 前景
plugins.productIntro: AI Lead Scout 通过引导 AI 研究帮助企业找到合格的 B2B 潜在客户。
plugins.productIntroEn: AI Lead Scout helps businesses find qualified B2B prospects through guided AI research.

plugins.name: Off Plan AI
plugins.productIntro: 搜索沙特期房项目和实时开发商库存，比较可用单位和当前价格，并直接从 ChatGPT 发送初步预订请求。期房 AI 在提交前重新检查单位可用性和价格，需要明确确认和同意，返回预订 ID，并让用户跟踪开发商确认。帐户链接使用 OAuth。 ChatGPT 不收取任何费用，所有请求仍需得到开发者确认。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search Saudi off-plan projects and live developer inventory, compare available units and current prices, and send a preliminary booking request directly from ChatGPT. Off Plan AI rechecks unit availability and price before submission, requires explicit confirmation and consent, returns a Booking ID, and lets users track developer confirmation. Account linking uses OAuth.

plugins.name: Gem
plugins.description: 分析和管理 Gem 数据
plugins.productIntro: 将 Gem 与 ChatGPT 连接起来，将您的招聘数据带到您的工作地点。借助 Gem MCP，您可以查询招聘分析、提取申请、重新发现过去的人才，并以自然语言执行批量操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect Gem with ChatGPT to bring your recruiting data to where you work. With the Gem MCP, you can query hiring analytics, pull applications, rediscover past talent, and take bulk actions in natural language.

plugins.name: SalesEQ
plugins.productIntro: SalesEQ 将您的会议数据连接到 ChatGPT，以便您可以使用组织的会议上下文查找会议、搜索对话、查看摘要和文字记录、检查相关视频时刻并回答问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: SalesEQ connects your meeting data to ChatGPT so you can find meetings, search conversations, review summaries and transcripts, inspect relevant video moments, and answer questions using your organization's meeting context.

plugins.name: Rapid Wombat
plugins.productIntro: Rapid Wombat 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 检查他们的 SEO 项目仪表板，包括 AI 可见性、网站运行状况、页面速度、内容规划、Search Console 状态、反向链接以及他们拥有的项目的 LLMs.txt 详细信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rapid Wombat helps users inspect their SEO project dashboard through ChatGPT, including AI visibility, site health, page speed, content planning, Search Console status, backlinks, and LLMs.txt details for projects they own.

plugins.name: PublisherChamp
plugins.productIntro: PublisherChamp 帮助作者和出版商分析其关联帐户的图书销售、版税、Kindle Unlimited 阅读量和广告支出。它可以解析书籍和系列、解释出版指标并查找官方 PublisherChamp 指南。
plugins.productIntroEn: PublisherChamp helps authors and publishers analyze book sales, royalties, Kindle Unlimited reads, and advertising spend from their connected account. It can resolve books and series, explain publishing metrics, and find official PublisherChamp guidance.

plugins.name: doola
plugins.description: 在几分钟内组建您的美国有限责任公司
plugins.originalDescription: Form your US LLC in minutes
plugins.productIntro: doola 让您通过对话组建一家美国有限责任公司。告诉代理您想要构建什么，doola 会收集构建详细信息，然后为您提供一个直接链接以完成结账并访问您的仪表板。整个流程需要几分钟。
plugins.productIntroEn: doola lets you form a US LLC through a conversation. Tell the agent what you want to build, doola collects the formation details, then hands you a direct link to complete checkout and access your dashboard. The whole flow takes minutes.

plugins.name: Advanced Web Ranking
plugins.productIntro: 提供对高级网络排名数据和工具的实时访问，从而实现无缝关键字跟踪、SERP 洞察并直接在聊天会话中生成报告。
plugins.productIntroEn: Provides real-time access to Advanced Web Ranking data and tools, enabling seamless keyword tracking, SERP insights, and reporting directly inside the chat session.

plugins.name: Brandi AI
plugins.productIntro: 举办有指导的品牌发现会议，将您的商业故事转化为重点突出、可操作的战略简介。回答有关您的愿景、受众和市场的简单问题，然后获得量身定制的报告，其中包括竞争对手见解、定位想法、信息传递方向和明确的后续步骤。无论您是推出新品牌还是完善现有品牌，该工具都可以帮助您从分散的想法转变为可以与团队、利益相关者或创意合作伙伴分享的自信计划。 PS：如果需要付款，请使用代码“BRANDI”免费访问。
plugins.productIntroEn: Run a guided brand discovery session and turn your business story into a focused, actionable strategy brief. Answer simple questions about your vision, audience, and market, then get a tailored report that includes competitor insights, positioning ideas, messaging direction, and clear next steps.

plugins.name: Kactus
plugins.productIntro: 通过 Kactus 发现并比较会议、异地、研讨会和企业聚会的活动场地。无论您需要自然光的中央会议空间、带卧室的住宅场地，还是需要一个独特的团队体验地点，Kactus 都能帮助您根据位置、容量和活动需求找到正确的选择。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover and compare event venues for meetings, offsites, seminars, and corporate gatherings with Kactus. Whether you need a central meeting space with natural light, a residential venue with bedrooms, or a unique location for a team experience, Kactus helps you find the right option based on location, capacity, and event needs.

plugins.name: YouEx.ai
plugins.description: 将潜在客户转化为收入
plugins.productIntro: YouEx.ai 会收集您即将死去的入站销售线索，并自动处理它们 — 对每一个销售线索进行研究、评分、路由和培育，以便您的销售代表可以专注于销售。只需五分钟即可完成设置，围绕卖家已有的工作方式进行构建。
plugins.productIntroEn: YouEx.ai takes the inbound leads you have dying on the vine and works them automatically — researching, scoring, routing, and nurturing each one so your reps can focus on selling. Five minutes to set up, built around how sellers already work.

plugins.name: Lawstronaut
plugins.originalDescription: Legal data layer for AI tools
plugins.productIntro: Lawstronaut MCP 通过快速、开发人员友好的模型上下文协议服务器，让人工智能代理能够实时、结构化地访问全球立法、法规、判例法和法律元数据。它专为法律人工智能、合规工作流程和企业自动化而构建，提供经过验证的法定数据，具有管辖范围、引文完整性和实时更新，使您能够将人工智能置于准确的法律信息中。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Lawstronaut MCP gives AI agents real-time, structured access to global legislation, regulations, case law and legal metadata through a fast, developer-friendly Model Context Protocol server. Built for legal AI, compliance workflows, and enterprise automation, it delivers verified statutory data with jurisdictional coverage, citation integrity, and live updates, allowing you to ground…

plugins.name: Neartail
plugins.productIntro: 您的菜单每周都会变化。您需要一个可以在几分钟内更新的订单，而不是一个必须重建的电子商务网站。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your menu changes every week. You need an order form you can update in minutes, not an ecommerce site you have to rebuild.

plugins.name: AppReviewBot
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 AppReviewBot 帐户，以便直接在 ChatGPT 中从链接的 Apple App Store 和 Google Play 应用程序访问客户评论和分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your AppReviewBot account to access customer reviews and analytics from your linked Apple App Store and Google Play apps directly in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Simera
plugins.productIntro: 搜索 Simera 精心策划的数据库，其中包含拉丁美洲、中东和其他地区超过 100 万经过审查的远程专业人员。浏览软件工程、销售、营销、运营、设计、数据科学、财务等职位的候选人。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search Simera's curated database of over 1 million vetted remote professionals across Latin America, the Middle East, and other regions. Browse candidates for roles in software engineering, sales, marketing, operations, design, data science, finance, and more.

plugins.name: Nesha
plugins.description: 发现 B2B 合作伙伴
plugins.productIntro: Nesha 使用其 Synergy Engine 帮助创始人、GTM 团队和企业发展领导者找到高度契合的战略合作伙伴。获取联合销售、渠道联盟、技术联盟、上市合作和许可/白标/OEM 的排名建议，以及清晰的“为什么适合”见解和实用的协作方式。单击“请求介绍”即可开始热情的、双重选择加入的介绍。
plugins.productIntroEn: Nesha helps founders, GTM teams, and corporate development leaders find high-fit strategic partners using its Synergy Engine. Get ranked recommendations for co-sell, channel alliances, technology alliances, go-to-market collaborations, and licensing/white-label/OEM with clear “why this fits” insights and practical ways to collaborate.

plugins.name: Customer.io
plugins.productIntro: 无需离开 ChatGPT 或 Codex 即可优化客户旅程。探索您的 Customer.io 工作区，了解营销活动绩效，并在一个互联的工作流程中将见解转化为行动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Optimize customer journeys without leaving ChatGPT or Codex. Explore your Customer.io workspace, understand campaign performance, and turn insights into action in one connected workflow.

plugins.name: ListingForgeAI
plugins.description: 增强您的电子商务列表
plugins.productIntro: ListingForgeAI 从 EAN 条形码、MPN 代码或产品名称查找产品信息，并返回包含标题、描述、技术规格、品牌和图像链接的结构化产品卡。结果以可下载的 Excel 文件形式提供。处理是异步的——应用程序启动任务并报告进度，直到结果准备好。需要 ListingForgeAI 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: ListingForgeAI looks up product information from an EAN barcode, MPN code, or product name and returns a structured product card with title, description, technical specifications, brand, and image links. Results are delivered as a downloadable Excel file. Processing is asynchronous — the app starts a task and reports progress until results are ready. A ListingForgeAI account is required.

plugins.name: Expertise Live Chatbot
plugins.description: 从网站构建聊天机器人
plugins.productIntro: 专业知识人工智能将任何网站变成一个工作人工智能代理，就在 ChatGPT 内部。共享一个 URL，它会读取网站的关键页面，然后训练一个实时代理，使用该网站的实际内容回答问题。整个过程大约需要一分钟。
plugins.productIntroEn: Expertise AI turns any website into a working AI agent, right inside ChatGPT. Share a URL and it reads the site's key pages, then trains a live agent that answers questions using that site's actual content. The whole thing takes about a minute.

plugins.name: Lily Apple Ads
plugins.description: 管理和分析 Apple 广告
plugins.productIntro: Lily Apple Ads 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Apple Ads 效果和关键字级收入归因（RevenueCat、AppsFlyer 等）。按关键字检查应用、帐户、广告系列、广告组、关键字、ROAS 和收入。仅在您确认后才能诊断近期效果、生成优化计划、审查广告系列更改以及应用 Apple Ads 更新。
plugins.productIntroEn: Lily Apple Ads connects ChatGPT to Apple Ads performance and keyword-level revenue attribution (RevenueCat, AppsFlyer, and more). Inspect apps, accounts, campaigns, ad groups, keywords, ROAS, and revenue by keyword. Diagnose recent performance, generate optimization plans, review campaign changes, and apply Apple Ads updates only after your confirmation.

plugins.name: CloudX
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 访问 CloudX 发布商绩效，以跟踪应用程序中的收入、填充率和出价者贡献。提取仪表板摘要、深入了解广告单元、比较需求合作伙伴以及导出原始数据——所有这些都以自然语言进行。按时间范围、国家/地区或设备操作系统进行筛选，无需离开对话即可调查问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Access CloudX publisher performance directly from ChatGPT to track revenue, fill rate, and bidder contributions across your apps. Pull dashboard summaries, drill into ad units, compare demand partners, and export raw data — all in natural language. Filter by time range, country, or device OS to investigate issues without leaving the conversation.

plugins.name: Mentionlytics
plugins.productIntro: Mentionlytics 可以让营销、公关和社交媒体团队探索和分析社交媒体收听数据，而以前在 ChatGPT 上无法获得这些数据。发现在社交媒体、网络、评论和其他受监控媒体上推动讨论的人员、渠道和来源。让 ChatGPT 深入分析您的品牌和竞争对手在社交媒体上的提及，以发现模式和有意义的结论。
plugins.productIntroEn: Mentionlytics lets marketing, PR, and social media teams explore and analyze social media listening data, previously unavailable on ChatGPT. Uncover the people, channels, and sources driving discussion across social media, web, reviews, and other monitored media.

plugins.name: trumpet.app
plugins.productIntro: 直接连接到您的小号工作区并使用您的交易室，无需离开 ChatGPT。建立新的交易室、搜索模板库、提取实时参与数据、显示利益相关者活动和交易健康见解。 非常适合在通话前做好准备、在对话中建立交易室、跟踪交易势头以及准确了解下一步的重点。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect directly to your trumpet workspace and work with your deal rooms without leaving ChatGPT. Build new deal rooms, search your Template library, pull live engagement data, surface stakeholder activity and deal health insights. Perfect for prepping before a call, building a deal room mid-conversation, tracking deal momentum, and knowing exactly where to focus next.

plugins.name: Dathent
plugins.productIntro: Dathent 是品牌的人工智能内容助手。设置您的品牌档案，制定每周内容计划，生成带有标题和视觉效果的帖子草稿，将其安排到 Instagram、Facebook、TikTok、LinkedIn、X、Threads 和 Telegram，并跟踪已发布帖子的表现 - 全部通过聊天进行。未经您的确认，草稿绝不会自动发布。
plugins.productIntroEn: Dathent is an AI content assistant for brands. Set up your brand profile, get a weekly content plan, generate post drafts with captions and visuals, schedule them to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Threads and Telegram, and track how published posts perform — all from chat. Drafts are never auto-published without your confirmation.

plugins.name: neimo.
plugins.productIntro: 通过查询精选知识库、激活合规工作流程和发现关键监管更新来优化监管工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Optimize regulatory work by querying curated knowledge bases, activating compliance workflows, and uncovering key regulatory updates.

plugins.name: GoodBarber
plugins.description: 管理您的 GoodBarber 应用程序
plugins.productIntro: GoodBarber 帮助授权应用程序所有者查看商店数据、管理产品和库存、更新订单运输、创建和编辑 CMS 内容、检查会员资格以及通过 ChatGPT 发送推送通知。
plugins.productIntroEn: GoodBarber helps authorized app owners review shop data, manage products and inventory, update order shipping, create and edit CMS content, inspect memberships, and send push notifications through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Knak
plugins.description: 使用 Knak AI 创建电子邮件
plugins.productIntro: ChatGPT 的 Knak 应用程序可帮助团队直接在 ChatGPT 内使用 Knak AI 创建和管理电子邮件内容。在模型上下文协议 (MCP) 的支持下，该集成简化了 ChatGPT 和 Knak 之间人工智能驱动的电子邮件工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Knak app for ChatGPT helps teams create and manage email content with Knak AI directly inside ChatGPT. Powered by the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the integration streamlines AI-driven email workflows between ChatGPT and Knak.

plugins.name: Abency
plugins.productIntro: Abency 帮助代理机构和营销团队管理品牌、准备和安排社交内容、分析 SEO 和广告效果、审核分析设置、创建新闻通讯和 WordPress 草稿，以及通过 ChatGPT 审查内部工作数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Abency helps agencies and marketing teams manage brands, prepare and schedule social content, analyze SEO and advertising performance, audit analytics setups, create newsletter and WordPress drafts, and review internal work data through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: European Union Tender Search
plugins.description: 搜索 TED 采购通知
plugins.productIntro: 从 Tenders Electronic Daily (TED) 搜索招标。按分类代码、买方国家/地区、通知类型、关键字、值和发布窗口搜索公共欧洲采购通知。此独立应用程序由 Telemark Digital 提供，不隶属于 TED、欧盟或欧盟出版办公室，也不受其认可。每个请求都会返回一个有界的、最小化的 JSON 预览。结果仅供参考，并非法律或采购建议。该应用程序仅接受公共通知过滤器，不会征求个人数据。无需外部帐户、付款方式或购买。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tender search from Tenders Electronic Daily (TED). Search public European procurement notices by classification code, buyer country, notice type, keyword, value, and publication window. This independent app is provided by Telemark Digital and is not affiliated with or endorsed by TED, the European Union, or the Publications Office of the European Union.

plugins.name: Spiffy
plugins.description: 询问您的 Spiffy 数据
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Spiffy，从而可以通过简单语言请求轻松从 Spiffy 应用程序中获取数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to Spiffy, making it easy to get data out of your Spiffy app through plain-language requests.

plugins.name: Searchable
plugins.description: 在 AI 答案中追踪您的品牌
plugins.originalDescription: Track your brand in AI answers
plugins.productIntro: Searchable 衡量品牌在 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Perplexity 和 Google AI Overviews 中的 AI 答案中的显示方式。将其连接起来，即可查看您的可见度得分及其随时间变化的情况、您相对于指定竞争对手的发言权、模型对您的评价、模型在回答您所在类别中的问题时引用了哪些网站，以及人工智能爬虫实际获取和引用了您的哪些页面。
plugins.productIntroEn: Searchable measures how brands appear in AI answers across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. Connect it to see your visibility score and how it moves over time, your share of voice against named competitors, the sentiment of what models say about you, which websites models cite when answering questions in your category, and which of your pages AI crawlers actu…

plugins.name: Skylar
plugins.productIntro: Skylar 通过人工智能驱动的销售实践帮助销售领导者提高团队绩效。您可以查找并启动真实的角色扮演课程，查看辅导进度，并了解您的团队随着时间的推移如何发展。在 ChatGPT 中，Skylar 可以帮助您发现销售代表在哪里需要支持，并选择下一步要进行的正确实践。
plugins.productIntroEn: Skylar helps sales leaders improve team performance through AI-powered sales practice. You can find and launch realistic roleplay sessions, review coaching progress, and see how your team is developing over time. Inside ChatGPT, Skylar helps you spot where reps need support and choose the right practice to run next.

plugins.name: TopCounsel
plugins.productIntro: TopCounsel 使用来自 L Suite 内部法律顾问社区的匿名同行信号帮助用户查找、比较和尽职调查律师事务所和个人律师。它支持按执业领域、地理位置、行业、事项类型和命名公司声誉进行外部顾问发现，同时保持成员匿名。
plugins.productIntroEn: TopCounsel helps users find, compare, and diligence law firms and individual lawyers using anonymized peer signal from The L Suite community of in-house counsel. It supports outside-counsel discovery by practice area, geography, industry, matter type, and named-firm reputation while preserving member anonymity.

plugins.name: Smartling
plugins.productIntro: Smartling 是一个基于云的翻译管理平台，全球品牌使用它来大规模翻译和管理本地化内容。该 MCP 服务器将 Smartling 的翻译和本地化工具直接带入您的 AI 助手中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Smartling is a cloud-based translation management platform used by global brands to translate and manage localized content at scale. This MCP server brings Smartling's translation and localization tools directly into your AI assistant.

plugins.name: Recruiter Roles
plugins.description: 查找招聘人员的职位和薪资
plugins.productIntro: 招聘人员角色是专为招聘人员和人才招聘专业人员构建的招聘委员会。用简单的语言询问并直接从董事会获得实时空缺职位：“薪酬超过 9 万美元的远程招聘人员职位”、“加拿大的医疗保健人才招聘职位”或“本周增加的入门级招聘人员职位”。
plugins.productIntroEn: Recruiter Roles is the job board built only for recruiters and talent acquisition professionals. Ask in plain language and get live openings straight from the board: "remote recruiter jobs paying over $90k", "healthcare talent acquisition roles in Canada", or "entry level recruiter jobs added this week".

plugins.name: Youanai Social
plugins.productIntro: Youanai 帮助用户搜索工作区帖子、社交提要活动、媒体、分析和业务 DNA，然后创建图像支持的草稿、生成媒体、更新业务 DNA，并通过 OAuth 范围的工作区访问权安排未来的社交帖子。
plugins.productIntroEn: Youanai helps users search workspace posts, social feed activity, media, analytics, and Business DNA, then create image-backed drafts, generate media, update Business DNA, and schedule future social posts with OAuth-scoped workspace access.

plugins.name: Ballpark
plugins.description: 从 ChatGPT 进行用户体验研究
plugins.productIntro: Ballpark 将真实的客户研究直接引入 ChatGPT。无需离开对话即可规划研究、招募参与者并分析反馈。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ballpark brings real customer research directly into ChatGPT. Plan studies, recruit participants, and analyse feedback without leaving the conversation.

plugins.name: LandingRabbit
plugins.productIntro: LandingRabbit 帮助创始人、教练和顾问将他们已有的幻灯片、会议记录和任何其他销售材料转变为永不过时的网站
plugins.productIntroEn: LandingRabbit helps founders, coaches, and consultants turn slide decks, meeting notes, and any other sales materials they already have into websites that never go out of date

plugins.name: KODE.link
plugins.description: 管理您的个人简介页面
plugins.productIntro: ChatGPT 中的 KODE.link 应用程序可让您直接从对话中管理和优化您的个人简介页面。使用该应用程序可以在几秒钟内添加、更新和组织您的个人简介页面的链接 - 无需手动编辑。更改页面标题和描述以匹配您的品牌、活动或当前目标，并立即使您的个人简介页面保持最新状态。 为 KODE.link 应用程序提供上下文，例如您想要推广的内容或应如何构建链接，它会建议清晰、有效的更新。
plugins.productIntroEn: The KODE.link app in ChatGPT lets you manage and optimize your link-in-bio page directly from conversation. Use the app to add, update, and organize links for your bio page in seconds — no manual editing required. Change page titles and descriptions to match your brand, campaign, or current goal, and instantly keep your bio page up to date. Give the KODE.

plugins.name: Corporate Weather
plugins.description: DACH 工作场所天气雷达
plugins.productIntro: Corporate Weather 可帮助用户了解 DACH 市场中可见的工作场所天气信号。它将公开的证据式信号（例如招聘活动、公司沟通、DACH 商业新闻指标和工作场所审查模式）转变为冷静、可解释的报告。该应用程序不会预测裁员，也不提供法律建议。它强调了明显的风险信号、冷静的反信号、信心、缺失的证据以及接下来要关注的内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Corporate Weather helps users understand visible workplace-weather signals across the DACH market. It turns public, evidence-style signals such as hiring activity, company communications, DACH business press indicators, and workplace review patterns into a calm, explainable report. The app does not predict layoffs and does not provide legal advice.

plugins.name: Evertrace
plugins.description: 在全球范围内发现新的创始人
plugins.productIntro: Evertrace 是领先的人工智能驱动的风投创始人检测引擎。我们追踪整个数字领域的信号，比其他人更早地发现新兴创始人 - 帮助投资者今天发现明天的创始人。
plugins.productIntroEn: Evertrace is the leading AI-powered founder detection engine for VCs. We trace signals across the digital landscape to uncover emerging founders earlier than anyone else - helping investors discover tomorrow’s founders today.

plugins.name: Gemba
plugins.productIntro: Gemba 帮助 B2B 商业团队通过 ChatGPT 从经过验证的 GEMBA 工作区检查销售、利润、客户、订单、产品、经常账户债务和目标。
plugins.productIntroEn: Gemba helps B2B commercial teams inspect sales, margin, customers, orders, products, current-account debt, and objectives from their authenticated GEMBA workspace through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: SyncERP for Softone
plugins.productIntro: 向 ChatGPT 询问您的 Softone ERP。查找客户详细信息和购买历史记录，按仓库检查产品库存，并查看每个商店和渠道的每日销售和发票。只读 — 每个公司都连接自己的 Softone 安装。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ask ChatGPT about your Softone ERP. Look up customer details and purchase history, check product stock by warehouse, and review daily sales and invoices per store and channel. Read-only — each company connects its own Softone installation.

plugins.name: Manatal
plugins.productIntro: 将 Manatal 引入 ChatGPT。搜索和添加候选人、创建和审查职位以及将候选人与空缺职位进行匹配，所有这些都以简单的语言进行。有了触手可及的招聘数据，您就可以更快地做出重要决策，从候选人入围到会议准备再到管道审核。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring Manatal into ChatGPT. Search and add candidates, create and review jobs, and match candidates to open roles, all in plain language. With your recruiting data within reach, you can move faster on decisions that matter, from candidates shortlisting to meeting preparation to pipeline reviews.

plugins.name: Rings AI
plugins.productIntro: Rings AI 允许用户使用来自 ChatGPT 中的 Rings 租户的私人关系情报。用户可以查找人员和公司，检查活动、笔记、会议、机会、PathPower、推荐路径和 AI 摘要，并创建或更新允许的 Rings 记录，例如任务、笔记、人员、公司和机会。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rings AI lets users work with private relationship intelligence from their Rings tenant in ChatGPT. Users can look up people and companies, inspect activities, notes, meetings, opportunities, PathPower, recommended paths, and AI summaries, and create or update permitted Rings records such as tasks, notes, people, companies, and opportunities.

plugins.name: Denon & Doyle Event Planner
plugins.productIntro: Denon & Doyle Event Planner 可帮助用户探索企业活动服务，为湾区和北加州活动生成最合适的娱乐和制作计划，在交互式小部件中查看计划，并向 Denon & Doyle 团队提交联系请求。
plugins.productIntroEn: Denon & Doyle Event Planner helps users explore corporate event services, generate a best-fit entertainment and production plan for Bay Area and Northern California events, review the plan in an interactive widget, and submit a contact request to the Denon & Doyle team.

plugins.name: BrightSite
plugins.productIntro: BrightSite 是一个网站托管和内容管理平台。连接您的 BrightSite 帐户以构建和编辑页面、布局和可重用组件；撰写、发布和组织博客文章；管理表格并审查提交的内容；上传和组织媒体；配置 SEO、结构化数据、重定向和分析设置；审查网站流量；并管理团队成员和角色。内容编辑首先保存到暂存草稿中，以便您可以查看更改，然后在准备就绪后将其发布到实时网站。暂存站点和完整版本历史记录可让您预览较大的更改并在需要时回滚。
plugins.productIntroEn: BrightSite is a website hosting and content management platform. Connect your BrightSite account to build and edit pages, layouts, and reusable components; write, publish, and organize blog posts; manage forms and review submissions; upload and organize media; configure SEO, structured data, redirects, and analytics settings; review site traffic; and manage team members and roles.

plugins.name: Promptwatch
plugins.description: 跟踪 AI 搜索可见性
plugins.productIntro: Promptwatch 帮助团队衡量其品牌在人工智能搜索中的表现，分析引文和竞争对手，并管理可见性计划背后的提示、监控、内容和项目。
plugins.productIntroEn: Promptwatch helps teams measure how their brand appears in AI search, analyze citations and competitors, and manage the prompts, monitors, content, and projects behind their visibility program.

plugins.name: WorkStory
plugins.productIntro: WorkStory 帮助员工和经理了解他们的组织、反馈、目标、绩效评估和评估周期。它还可以请求选定的队友的反馈。
plugins.productIntroEn: WorkStory helps employees and managers understand their organization, feedback, goals, performance reviews, and review cycles. It can also request feedback from selected teammates.

plugins.name: Startup Name Generator
plugins.description: 获取品牌化的 .com 名称
plugins.productIntro: 生成 .com 立即可用的品牌初创公司名称，实时检查，并检查任何名称的 .com 可用性。免费使用。
plugins.productIntroEn: Generate brandable startup names whose .com is available right now, checked live, and check any name's .com availability. Free to use.

plugins.name: Abacor
plugins.productIntro: Abacor 将您的客户会议和对话转化为专为会计师事务所构建的可搜索、结构化情报。
plugins.productIntroEn: Abacor turns your client meetings and conversations into searchable, structured intelligence, built for accounting firms.

plugins.name: BROSH AI CRM
plugins.description: 面向 AI 专业人士的智能 CRM
plugins.productIntro: BROSH MCP 通过模型上下文协议 (MCP) 将您的 CRM、销售、营销、项目、文档和业务运营直接带入 AI 助手中。 AI 代理无需在应用程序之间切换，而是可以使用 BROSH 工作区中的实时数据安全地访问、分析、更新、管理设置并自动化工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: BROSH MCP brings your CRM, sales, marketing, projects, documents, and business operations directly into AI assistants through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Instead of switching between applications, AI agents can securely access, analyze, update, manage settings, and automate workflows using live data from your BROSH workspace.

plugins.name: NETAQ
plugins.productIntro: NETAQ 是沙特人工智能驱动的数字营销机构助理。估算项目的成本范围（电子商务商店、移动应用程序、广告、社交、SEO 和 GEO、设计、策略），获得正确服务的推荐，保存您的详细信息，以便 NETAQ 团队跟进、查看可用的咨询时段并预订免费咨询。 NETAQ 为沙特阿拉伯和海湾地区提供服务。
plugins.productIntroEn: NETAQ is a Saudi AI-powered digital marketing agency assistant. Estimate a project's cost range (e-commerce store, mobile app, ads, social, SEO & GEO, design, strategy), get a recommendation for the right service, save your details so the NETAQ team can follow up, see available consultation slots, and book a free consultation. NETAQ serves Saudi Arabia and the Gulf.

plugins.name: Pi by Placer.ai
plugins.productIntro: Placer.ai Pi 回答了基于可测量的现实世界行为的业务问题。用简单的语言提出一个完整的分析问题，Pi 会运行完整的 Placer.ai 分析 - 客流量趋势、游客人口统计和旅程、贸易区域、交叉购物以及销售和支出 - 然后返回一个书面答案，其中包含数据诚实警告、它使用的任何网络资源，以及在 Pi 中打开相同分析及其交互式地图的深层链接。完整的分析通常需要几分钟：ask_pi 启动它并返回句柄，get_pi_result 收集答案，在工作运行时报告进度。
plugins.productIntroEn: Placer.ai Pi answers business questions that turn on measured real-world behavior. Ask a full analytical question in plain language and Pi runs a complete Placer.ai analysis - foot traffic trends, visitor demographics and journeys, trade areas, cross-shopping, and sales and spend - then returns a written answer with data-honesty caveats, any web sources it used, and a deep link that open…

plugins.name: Review Buddy- draft AI replies
plugins.productIntro: 对您的在线评论进行完美回复。
plugins.productIntroEn: Write the perfect replies to your online reviews.

plugins.name: Within
plugins.productIntro: 将您组织的流程和运营知识带入您的 AI 助手中。 Within MCP 连接到您的 Within 工作区，以便您可以查询组织的流程、探索将流程链接到系统和团队的流程索引知识图，并根据您的业务实际运行情况提供基本答案，而不是一般性猜测。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring your organization's processes and operational knowledge into your AI assistant. The Within MCP connects to your Within workspace so you can query your organization's processes, explore the process index knowledge graph linking processes to systems and teams, and ground answers in how your business actually runs — not generic guesses.

plugins.name: Notifly
plugins.productIntro: Notifly 是一个营销自动化平台，用于跨移动推送、网络推送、弹出窗口、电子邮件、短信、KakaoTalk 和 Webhooks 等渠道发送和管理客户消息。 团队可以构建基于行为的营销活动和用户旅程、个性化受众、审查交付和转化性能，并通过 SDK、HTTP API 和外部集成连接 Notify。
plugins.productIntroEn: Notifly is a marketing automation platform for sending and managing customer messages across channels such as mobile push, web push, popups, email, SMS, KakaoTalk, and webhooks. Teams can build behavior-based campaigns and user journeys, personalize audiences, review delivery and conversion performance, and connect Notifly through SDKs, HTTP APIs, and external integrations.

plugins.name: Hadaly
plugins.productIntro: Hadaly 是一个领先的企业评估、预售公司组织、数据室准备和交易准备平台。它可以帮助企业主评估公司的价值，跟踪其价值随时间的变化，并了解如何改进它。
plugins.productIntroEn: Hadaly is a leading platform for business valuation, pre-sale company organization, data room preparation, and transaction readiness. It helps business owners estimate the value of their company, track its value over time, and understand how to improve it.

plugins.name: Vettara
plugins.productIntro: Vettara 允许授权工作区用户准备高管搜索简报、创建可编辑的 MCP 搜索会话、启动私人候选人搜索、监控运行状态、审查紧凑的候选人结果以及从 ChatGPT 导出已完成的项目 CSV。访问是通过 Vettara OAuth 强制执行的，每个用户只能看到其 Vettara 工作区权限可用的记录。 Vettara 仅支持采购和研究工作流程，不做出招聘决定。
plugins.productIntroEn: Vettara lets authorized workspace users prepare executive-search briefs, create editable MCP search sessions, launch private candidate searches, monitor run status, review compact candidate results, and export completed project CSVs from ChatGPT. Access is enforced through Vettara OAuth and each user only sees records available to their Vettara workspace permissions.

plugins.name: Trendata Market Intelligence
plugins.productIntro: Trendata 将您连接到实时市场情报和消费者搜索数据。它允许您直接在工作流程中轻松分析全球位置、产品类别以及特定品牌或零售商。通过提供历史搜索量和具体的增长指标，您可以准确地发现消费者偏好和不断变化的市场趋势。它将复杂的数据转化为清晰、可操作的见解，以做出更明智的业务决策。
plugins.productIntroEn: Trendata connects you to real-time market intelligence and consumer search data. It allows you to easily analyze global locations, product categories, and specific brands or retailers directly within your workflow. By providing historical search volumes and concrete growth metrics, you can accurately spot consumer preferences and changing market trends.

plugins.name: Flyweel
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Flyweel MCP 通过 ChatGPT 分析您的 Google 和元广告活动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Analyse your Google and Meta Ads campaigns with ChatGPT using the Flyweel MCP.

plugins.name: Clearskies
plugins.description: 值得您信赖的人工智能带来的收入
plugins.originalDescription: AI you can trust with revenue
plugins.productIntro: Clearskies 是收入 AI 的上下文层。一个连接即可将您的 CRM、电话、电子邮件、日历、Slack 和支持票证转化为每个帐户的单一、始终最新的图片，因此 ChatGPT 可以处理完整的记录，而不是重建上下文并猜测重要的内容。获取赢/输和代表绩效等深入分析，并运行通话前准备、CRM 卫生和交易风险等工作流程。一次组装的上下文是每个团队、工具和代理都可以重用的上下文，并且它会随着数据的增长而改进。
plugins.productIntroEn: Clearskies is the context layer for revenue AI. One connection turns your CRM, calls, email, calendar, Slack, and support tickets into a single, always-current picture of every account, so ChatGPT works across complete records instead of rebuilding context and guessing what matters.

plugins.name: Tough Tongue AI
plugins.productIntro: Tough Tongue AI 帮助团队管理对话练习场景、创建和分析会话、审查绩效以及通过 ChatGPT 操作会议机器人和出站呼叫工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tough Tongue AI helps teams manage conversation-practice scenarios, create and analyze sessions, review performance, and operate meeting-bot and outbound calling workflows through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Nexoya
plugins.productIntro: Nexoya 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Nexoya 工作区，以便营销人员可以提出有关营销组合、营销活动或广告集内容、漏斗步骤、标签、事件、绩效指标、每日趋势、基于回归的归因和预算优化建议的自然语言问题。该应用程序可以帮助用户在不离开 ChatGPT 的情况下总结营销绩效、比较周期和渠道、检查 ROI 和 ROAS、推理趋势并解释最新的优化建议。访问权限仅限于登录用户的 Nexoya 帐户和团队权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: Nexoya connects ChatGPT to a Nexoya workspace so marketers can ask natural-language questions about marketing portfolios, campaign or adset contents, funnel steps, labels, events, performance metrics, daily trends, regression-based attribution, and budget optimization recommendations.

plugins.name: ReportFlow
plugins.productIntro: ReportFlow 可帮助您从可重复使用的模板创建精美、可共享的 PDF 报告和文档。找到正确的模板，提供所需的详细信息，并生成一致的输出，无需手动格式化。通过可选的 Notion 集成，您可以在一个地方管理模板和源内容，并更快、更可靠地生成提案、状态报告、摘要和内部文档等可交付成果。
plugins.productIntroEn: ReportFlow helps you create polished, shareable PDF reports and documents from reusable templates. Find the right template, provide the required details, and generate a consistent output—without manual formatting.

plugins.name: adplane
plugins.description: 管理 Google 广告和元广告
plugins.originalDescription: Manage Google Ads and Meta Ads
plugins.productIntro: Adplane 将您的 Google Ads 和元广告帐户连接到 ChatGPT，以便您可以分析效果并在同一对话中进行更改。
plugins.productIntroEn: Adplane connects your Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts to ChatGPT so you can analyze performance and make changes in the same conversation.

plugins.name: Comscore
plugins.productIntro: 直接在对话中查询 Comscore 的数字和线性电视测量数据。查找网站流量、受众人口统计数据、 任何数字媒体实体的类别排名、交叉访问行为和受众重叠。对于线性电视、搜索网络，探索收视趋势，并从电视 API 中提取结构化数据 - 所有这些都无需离开聊天。
plugins.productIntroEn: Query Comscore's Digital and Linear TV measurement data directly in your conversation. Look up website traffic, audience demographics, category rankings, cross-visiting behavior, and audience overlap for any digital media entity. For linear TV, search networks, explore viewership trends, and pull structured data from the TV API — all without leaving the chat.

plugins.name: UMT-CAR Assistent
plugins.productIntro: UMT-CAR AI助手可帮助您通过聊天快速轻松地获得所有与汽车相关的问题的答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: The UMT-CAR AI Assistant helps you quickly and easily get answers to all your car-related questions via chat.

plugins.name: LawVu
plugins.description: 内部法律团队的操作系统
plugins.productIntro: LawVu 是一款面向企业内部法律团队的法律操作系统，将事务管理、合同生命周期管理、支出、接收、文档和知识库结合在一个统一平台中。
plugins.productIntroEn: LawVu is the legal operating system for in-house corporate legal teams, combining matter management, contract lifecycle management, spend, intake, documents, and a knowledge base in one unified platform.

plugins.name: Partner.io
plugins.description: 运行您的合作伙伴计划
plugins.productIntro: 无需打开单个选项卡即可管理您的 Partner.io 计划。添加合作伙伴、记录和更新潜在客户、记录付款、创建奖励以及建立计划等级 - 只需提出要求即可。您的 AI 助手直接与您的实时 Partner.io 帐户一起工作，因此每次更改都准确地落在您的团队已经工作的地方。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage your Partner.io program without opening a single tab. Add partners, log and update leads, record payments, create rewards, and build program tiers — just by asking. Your AI assistant works directly with your live Partner.io account, so every change lands exactly where your team already works.

plugins.name: Velaris Basic
plugins.productIntro: Velaris Basic 可让您使用简单的语言直接从 ChatGPT 访问客户数据 — 无需仪表板，无需切换选项卡。
plugins.productIntroEn: Velaris Basic lets you access your customer data directly from ChatGPT, using plain language — no dashboards, no switching tabs.

plugins.name: Partnership Leaders Research
plugins.productIntro: 合作伙伴领导者研究可帮助用户搜索并回答 SI、EC75 和 AI 合作伙伴关系研究中基于来源的合作伙伴生态系统问题。它支持自然语言研究答案、证据查找、公司和分类扫描、事件摘要以及基于标题的答案评估以进行测试。
plugins.productIntroEn: Partnership Leaders Research helps users search and answer source-grounded partner ecosystem questions across SI, EC75, and AI-in-partnerships research. It supports natural-language research answers, evidence lookup, company and taxonomy scans, event summaries, and rubric-based answer evaluation for testing.

plugins.name: Civic Marketplace
plugins.productIntro: Civic Marketplace 帮助公共机构寻找合作合同和供应商、创建和管理报价请求以及与供应商沟通。供应商可以响应机会并维护其市场概况。
plugins.productIntroEn: Civic Marketplace helps public agencies find cooperative contracts and suppliers, create and manage quote requests, and communicate with vendors. Suppliers can respond to opportunities and maintain their marketplace profiles.

plugins.name: Coevera
plugins.description: 管理您的 Coevera CRM 数据
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Coevera（以前称为 Pipeliner CRM），并以对话方式处理您的销售数据。使用自然语言查询搜索客户、联系人、潜在客户、机会、任务和约会，然后直接从聊天中创建后续任务或更新交易阶段。服务器支持标准字段、自定义字段和自定义实体，并带有过滤器以进行精确查询。对于准备通话的销售代表、检查管道运行状况的经理以及运行临时报告（无需导出为 CSV）的运营团队来说非常有用。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your Coevera (formerly Pipeliner CRM) and work with your sales data conversationally. Search accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, tasks, and appointments using natural-language queries, then create follow-up tasks or update deal stages directly from chat. The server supports standard fields, custom fields, and custom entities, with filters for precise queries.

plugins.name: 4Degrees
plugins.description: 在 ChatGPT 中点击您的网络
plugins.productIntro: 4Degrees 将您的关系情报和交易流带入 ChatGPT。用简单的英语询问您的联系人、公司和交易——“谁是我成为 Stripe 首席技术官的最温暖途径？”、“按阶段向我展示 B 轮交易”、“今天需要我注意什么？”。您还可以更新您的 CRM（添加标签、记录注释和移动交易阶段），并通过每次更改的预览和确认步骤以及一键撤消。通过 OAuth 将每个队友的范围限定到您的席位已拥有的数据和权限。专为私募市场投资者、并购团队和搜索基金而设计。
plugins.productIntroEn: 4Degrees brings your relationship intelligence and deal flow into ChatGPT. Ask about your contacts, companies, and deals in plain English — "who's my warmest path to a CTO at Stripe?", "show me Series B deals by stage", "what needs my attention today?".

plugins.name: Conduit
plugins.productIntro: Conduit 允许经过身份验证的团队读取他们的工作区目录、联系人、打开的支持票证、预订和联系对话历史记录。此应用程序不会修改记录或发送消息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Conduit lets authenticated teams read their workspace directory, contacts, open support tickets, reservations, and contact conversation history. This app does not modify records or send messages.

plugins.name: Tropic
plugins.productIntro: 软件+人工智能的定价并不公开，因此通过互联网搜索并不能告诉你是否支付过高。热带意志。
plugins.productIntroEn: Software + AI pricing isn't public, so searching the internet won't tell you if you're overpaying. Tropic will.

plugins.name: Ninjo
plugins.description: 管理 AI 参与代理
plugins.productIntro: Ninjo 帮助操作员以简单的语言运行 AI 参与代理：诊断代理的设置并获得优先修复、查看其处理的对话、编辑提示和触发器、审核联系人限制、后续工作流程和围绕其连接的通知，并按自定义属性值对联系人目录进行分段。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ninjo helps operators run their AI engagement agents in plain language: diagnose an agent's setup and get prioritized fixes, review the conversations it handled, edit prompts and triggers, audit the contact limits, follow-up workflows and notifications wired around it, and segment the contact directory by custom-property values.

plugins.name: LZ Virtual Mail
plugins.productIntro: LegalZoom 虚拟邮件可将您的企业和个人邮政邮件数字化，现在您可以直接在 ChatGPT 中查找、理解和管理它。
plugins.productIntroEn: LegalZoom Virtual Mail digitizes your business and personal postal mail and now you can find, understand, and manage it directly in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Unthread
plugins.productIntro: Unthread 是一个面向工程和产品团队的 B2B 支持平台。该插件通过一个紧凑的、发现驱动的工具界面将您的 Unthread 工作区连接到 ChatGPT：搜索底层 Unthread API、按需获取模式，并运行由访问类控制的读或写操作。使用它来调查对话、分类高优先级票证、监控 SLA 和分析、查询您的知识库以及创建或更新票证。
plugins.productIntroEn: Unthread is a B2B support platform for engineering and product teams. This plugin connects your Unthread workspace to ChatGPT through a compact, discovery-driven tool surface: search the underlying Unthread API, fetch schemas on demand, and run read or write operations gated by access class.

plugins.name: Spacebring
plugins.description: 管理您的联合办公空间
plugins.productIntro: Spacebring 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的联合办公空间管理平台，让您可以即时访问企业的运营数据以进行报告、会员支持和日常决策。
plugins.productIntroEn: Spacebring connects ChatGPT to your coworking space management platform, giving you instant access to your business' operational data for reporting, member support, and day-to-day decision-making.

plugins.name: Strella
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 浏览、分析和创建用户研究。让 Strella 融入您的 AI 工作流程 — 这是一个使用 AI 进行深入访谈并生成可行见解的客户研究平台。
plugins.productIntroEn: Browse, analyze, and create user research studies directly from ChatGPT. Make Strella native to your AI workflow — the customer research platform that uses AI to run in-depth interviews and generate actionable insights.

plugins.name: Adthena
plugins.productIntro: 连接到 Adthena 竞争情报平台，分析付费搜索市场、监控竞争对手并直接在 ChatGPT 内发现搜索机会。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect to the Adthena competitive intelligence platform to analyze paid search markets, monitor competitors, and uncover search opportunities directly inside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Pipeline Claims
plugins.description: 审查未识别身份的要求
plugins.productIntro: Pipeline Claims 可帮助用户检查内置的虚构保险需求包或查看虚构或完全去识别化的需求 PDF。它返回有界的、页码的源材料，以提供简洁的、引用的摘要，而不做出责任、承保范围、医疗或和解决定。
plugins.productIntroEn: Pipeline Claims helps users inspect a built-in fictional insurance demand package or review a fictional or fully deidentified demand PDF. It returns bounded, page-numbered source material for concise, cited summaries without making liability, coverage, medical, or settlement decisions.

plugins.name: FormEdge
plugins.productIntro: FormEdge 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 创建、编辑、预览和发布表单和登陆页面，审核提交，管理通知设置、图像资源和保存的页面版本，以及配置工作区设置（自定义域、公共 URL 子域、品牌以及用于通知电子邮件的语言和时区）。
plugins.productIntroEn: FormEdge helps users create, edit, preview, and publish forms and landing pages, review submissions, manage notification settings, image assets, and saved page versions, and configure workspace settings — custom domains, the public URL subdomain, branding, and the language and time zone used for notification emails — through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Relay
plugins.productIntro: Relay 帮助体能教练使用来自 ChatGPT 的私人 Relay 数据。教练可以找到运动员和练习，查看训练日历和训练结果，制定和分配计划，创建和编辑训练，以及在整个区域内制定训练处方。
plugins.productIntroEn: Relay helps strength and conditioning coaches work with their private Relay data from ChatGPT. Coaches can find athletes and exercises, review training calendars and workout results, build and assign programs, create and edit workouts, and progress training prescriptions across a block.

plugins.name: Clerky
plugins.originalDescription: Work with your cap table data
plugins.productIntro: 将 Clerky 提供的股权结构表数据带入对话中。可视化所有权、模型退出并立即获得答案，而无需搜索文书工作。您甚至可以将您的股权结构表数据与初创公司的其他工具结合起来。只需连接您的 Clerky 帐户并选择 ChatGPT 可以访问的团队即可开始。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring your cap table data from Clerky into the conversation. Visualize ownership, model exits, and get instant answers without searching through paperwork. You can even combine your cap table data with your startup’s other tools. Just connect your Clerky account and choose which teams ChatGPT can access to get started.

plugins.name: Campaign Requirement Extractor

plugins.productIntroEn: Campaign Requirement Extractor extracts structured campaign requirement fields from campaign request text. It returns campaign name, objective, channel, budget, deadline, missing fields, source text, and errors.

plugins.name: Nutshell CRM

plugins.productIntroEn: Nutshell brings your CRM into the conversation. Connect your Nutshell account to ChatGPT and instantly ask questions about your pipeline, look up contacts, track leads, and surface sales insights — without leaving your AI tool.

plugins.name: Dreambooth Studio

plugins.productIntroEn: Dreambooth Studio runs self-service photobooths, the kind you find at weddings, events and malls. This app answers questions about them in chat.

plugins.name: Presuo

plugins.productIntroEn: Presuo helps users browse their own construction budgets in ChatGPT, navigate work sections and budget items, inspect quantity items, and run budget-scoped search.

plugins.name: DashThis
plugins.productIntro: DashThis 是一个营销报告平台，可将来自 30 多个营销集成的数据引入代理机构和内部营销团队的仪表板中。此连接器为 ChatGPT 提供对用户 DashThis 帐户上的仪表板的只读访问权限。用户可以列出和搜索仪表板，查看仪表板的设置方式以及为其提供数据的来源，检查支持的报告周期的当前小部件值，将结果与另一个周期进行比较，识别具有源错误的仪表板，并将仪表板结果转换为客户端可用的摘要。
plugins.productIntroEn: DashThis is a marketing reporting platform that brings data from 30+ marketing integrations into dashboards for agencies and in-house marketing teams. This connector gives ChatGPT read-only access to the dashboards on the user's DashThis account.

plugins.name: SAIRYŌ

plugins.productIntroEn: SAIRYŌ helps event organizers and customers use ChatGPT to search their events and reports, fetch event or revenue details, and review ticket-sales KPI snapshots for a requested date range. It will also allow hosts to create their own events with a link to complete on SAIRYŌ's website.

plugins.name: Velaris Intelligence

plugins.productIntroEn: Velaris Intelligence connects to your Velaris data to generate ready-to-use customer success reports on demand. Built for Customer Success Managers who want faster prep without switching between tools. Sign in with your Velaris account to get started.

plugins.name: Ribbon
plugins.productIntro: 使用功能区管理您的候选人渠道和申请人。将您的 ATS（Workday、Ashby、Lever、Greenhouse 和 40 多个不同平台）连接到 Ribbon，并借助 Ribbon 的 ChatGPT 应用程序的强大功能来管理 ChatGPT 中的空缺职位、候选人和应用程序。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage your candidate pipeline and applicants using Ribbon. Connect your ATS (Workday, Ashby, Lever, Greenhouse, and 40+ different platforms) to Ribbon and manage your open roles, candidates, and applications from ChatGPT with the power of Ribbon's ChatGPT app.

plugins.name: Badger Maps (Advanced)
plugins.productIntro: Badger Maps 是排名第一的现场销售平台。
plugins.productIntroEn: Badger Maps is the #1 field sales platform.

plugins.name: Magnetly

plugins.productIntroEn: Magnetly helps you create interactive lead generation tools powered by AI.

plugins.name: ZINT
plugins.description: 经过验证的英国公司数据
plugins.productIntro: ZINT 为 ChatGPT 提供经过验证的英国企业情报，用于勘探、并购和重组研究、投资分析以及风险与合规监控。该应用程序以公司之家记录为基础，并通过新闻、年度账目和网站信号进行丰富，将自由文本公司名称或域名解析为权威的英国标识符，使用结构化财务、治理、部门、地区和事件驱动的过滤器搜索英国公司数据库，检索选定的公司数据字段，按事件类别显示最新新闻，预览年度账目部分，获取分类网站内容，并检查用户的 ZINT 信用余额。
plugins.productIntroEn: ZINT gives ChatGPT verified UK corporate intelligence for prospecting, M&A and restructuring research, investment analysis, and risk and compliance monitoring. Grounded in Companies House records and enriched with news, annual accounts and website signals, the app resolves free-text company names or domains to authoritative UK identifiers, searches the UK company database with structured…

plugins.name: Anagram
plugins.productIntro: Anagram 允许团队分析 ChatGPT 中的站点代理用户对话、参与度和业务影响。它可以查找和读取对话、报告活动和结果，并运行项目范围的只读分析查询。
plugins.productIntroEn: Anagram lets teams analyze Site Agent user conversations, engagement, and business impact in ChatGPT. It can find and read conversations, report activity and outcomes, and run project-scoped, read-only analytics queries.

plugins.name: Ofia Doc Maker

plugins.productIntroEn: Create polished PDF documents directly from a prompt. Ofia drafts and typesets anything; reports, research papers, business plans, proposals and briefs, then lets you revise and export the finished LaTeX document.

plugins.name: Listen Labs

plugins.productIntroEn: Browse your Listen Labs studies, pull response data, review study designs, and surface analysis insights, all without leaving your workflow. Create, edit, and launch new user research studies directly from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: XAPP Analyst

plugins.productIntro: XAPP Analyst 是一个代理，您可以在 ChatGPT 内与其讨论您的销售线索、预订和客户对话。用通俗易懂的语言询问，按位置和推荐来源细分潜在客户，找到推动最高价值潜在客户的来源，并按服务类型和紧急程度发现趋势。提取任何最近线索的完整详细信息，显示可以提高您的搜索引擎优化和搜索广告的房主短语，审查业务和位置背景，并将您的业务与附近的竞争对手进行比较。它可以帮助您从数据中了解您的业务并根据这些知识采取行动。

Ask in plain language to break down leads by location and referring source, find the sources driving your most high‑value leads, and spot trends by service type and urgency.

plugins.name: Beamtrace
plugins.description: 了解 AI 如何对您的业务进行排名
plugins.originalDescription: See how AI ranks your business
plugins.productIntro: Beamtrace 是一个 AI 可见性平台，涵盖 AI 搜索中的可见性指标、提示跟踪、网站优化和声誉管理。它旨在展示当人们向人工智能寻求建议时您的业务如何发展。
plugins.productIntroEn: Beamtrace is an AI visibility platform covering your visibility metrics, prompt tracking, website optimization, and reputation management in AI search. It's built to show how your business holds up when people turn to AI for recommendations.

plugins.name: Wingz by Wingify
plugins.productIntro: Wingz 帮助团队直接从 ChatGPT 分析实验性能、审查行为见解并管理测试活动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Wingz helps teams analyze experimentation performance, review behavior insights, and manage testing campaigns directly from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: SalesBreaker GTM
plugins.description: 安全操作销售工作空间
plugins.productIntro: SalesBreaker GTM 允许 ChatGPT 操作用户的 SalesBreaker 工作区，以进行内部 CRM 更新、集合管理、任务创建、模板草稿、LP/提案草稿、CSV 暂存和销售准备。它无法发送外展、提交表单、执行活动或工作流程、发布页面、导出数据库、更改计费/身份验证、操作基础设施或删除记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: SalesBreaker GTM lets ChatGPT operate the user's SalesBreaker workspace for internal CRM updates, collection management, task creation, template drafts, LP/proposal drafts, CSV staging, and sales preparation. It cannot send outreach, submit forms, execute campaigns or workflows, publish pages, export databases, change billing/authentication, operate infrastructure, or delete records.

plugins.name: Fritto Time Tracker
plugins.productIntro: 团队时间跟踪工具。根据项目和客户记录每日工作时间，提交时间表以供批准并生成报告。经理可以审查、批准或拒绝条目并锁定过去的期间。支持具有多个团队的机构和公司的多租户设置。
plugins.productIntroEn: A time tracking tool for teams. Log daily work hours against projects and clients, submit timesheets for approval and generate reports. Managers can review, approve or reject entries and lock past periods. Supports multi-tenant setups for agencies and companies with multiple teams.

plugins.name: Bynn
plugins.description: 检测图像和 PDF 中的欺诈行为
plugins.originalDescription: Detect Fraud in Images and PDF
plugins.productIntro: 检测图像和 PDF 文档中的欺诈、操纵和 AI 生成的迹象。上传文件，应用程序会分析该文件的真实性信号，例如可能的编辑、合成内容、文档篡改和人工智能生成的视觉效果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Detect signs of fraud, manipulation, and AI generation in images and PDF documents. Upload a file and the app analyzes it for authenticity signals such as possible edits, synthetic content, document tampering, and AI-generated visuals.

plugins.name: Flowlity Co-planner
plugins.productIntro: Flowlity MCP 服务器允许授权用户通过 ChatGPT 从 Flowlity 数据中检查供应链站点、产品、供应商、订单、库存、预测、促销、容量、警报、导入、保存的视图、评论和仪表板 KPI。
plugins.productIntroEn: Flowlity MCP Server lets authorized users inspect supply-chain sites, products, suppliers, orders, inventory, forecasts, promotions, capacity, alerts, imports, saved views, comments, and dashboard KPIs from Flowlity data through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Wialon Platform
plugins.productIntro: Wialon 平台帮助授权车队管理用户了解产品文档、发现 API 端点和架构，并从其 Wialon 平台帐户检索只读数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Wialon Platform helps authorized fleet-management users understand product documentation, discover API endpoints and schemas, and retrieve read-only data from their Wialon Platform account.

plugins.name: ROCKEYE TMS
plugins.productIntro: ROCKEYE 运输管理系统将车队协调、调度处理、行程执行和交付跟踪集中在一个平台内。企业可以计划行程、监控车辆、管理运输订单、跟踪运营费用并获取实时物流见解，以改善对运输工作流程的控制。该系统专为运输商、制造商、分销商和货运运营商打造，可简化路线协调、加快调度流程、提高运营可视性并维护准确的运输记录。工作流程自动化和实时更新有助于减少延误、加强问责制并支持更快的运营决策，使组织能够以更高的透明度和控制力运行高效且可扩展的运输运营。
plugins.productIntroEn: ROCKEYE Transport Management System centralizes fleet coordination, dispatch handling, trip execution, and delivery tracking within a single platform. Businesses can plan trips, monitor vehicles, manage transport orders, track operational expenses, and access real-time logistics insights for improved control across transportation workflows.

plugins.name: StoreAdOps
plugins.productIntro: 连接 StoreAdOps 来审查广告效果、诊断浪费的支出、准备每日利润简报以及创建暂停的营销活动草稿，以便在任何提供商撰写之前进行明确审查。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect StoreAdOps to review advertising performance, diagnose wasted spend, prepare daily profit briefs, and create paused campaign drafts for explicit review before any provider write.

plugins.name: Quotient
plugins.productIntro: Quotient 是一个集人工智能原生平台和智能代理于一体的平台；旨在跨电子邮件、社交媒体、博客和活动规划和执行营销活动，无需使用您已经无法满足的分散工具。
plugins.productIntroEn: Quotient is an AI-native platform and intelligent agent in one; built to plan and execute campaigns across email, social, blog, and events, without the fragmented tools you've outgrown.

plugins.name: Menu Integrado
plugins.productIntro: Menu Integrado 可帮助业务经理通过安全、只读的数据访问更好地了解其运营情况。分析订单、销售、渠道、交付方式、财务交易、财务文件、产品、目录详细信息、技术表和销售历史记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: Menu Integrado helps business managers better understand their operations through secure, read-only access to their data. Analyze orders, sales, channels, delivery methods, financial transactions, fiscal documents, products, catalog details, technical sheets, and sales history.

plugins.name: Appbot
plugins.productIntro: Appbot 帮助用户检查其 Appbot 帐户中跟踪的应用程序，检索过滤的应用程序评论页面，并通过 ChatGPT 汇总评论计数、评级、版本和情绪。
plugins.productIntroEn: Appbot helps users inspect the apps tracked in their Appbot account, retrieve filtered app review pages, and summarize review counts, ratings, versions, and sentiment through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Mindola
plugins.productIntro: Mindola 帮助您将有关您自己、您的工作或您的业务的已批准信息转变为可共享的问答页面。创建一个可审查的 AI 镜头，可以回答问题、解释您的工作、引导访问者进行正确的下一步并保留有用的上下文。您可以控制所包含的内容，并且在您批准之前不会创建任何内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Mindola helps you turn approved information about yourself, your work, or your business into a shareable Q&A page. Create a reviewable AI lens that can answer questions, explain what you do, guide visitors to the right next step, and preserve useful context. You stay in control of what is included, and nothing is created until you approve it.

plugins.name: The Org
plugins.productIntro: The Org 的 MCP 允许您在 The Org 的帐户内工作，以加速潜在客户开发或职位发现过程。使用我们超过 200 万个组织结构图的网络搜索和过滤人员和职位。利用级别、经理和报告等其他地方无法提供的高级过滤器，并了解人员和工作如何融入组织。专为速度和控制而设计：ChatGPT 只能提取您要求的内容，尊重您的帐户边界，并生成可供查看、个性化和使用的输出。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Org’s MCP allows you to work inside your account on The Org to accelerate your lead generation or job discovery process. Search and filter for people and jobs using our network of more than 2 million org charts. Leverage advanced filters available nowhere else like level, manager, and reports and understand how people and jobs fit into the organization.

plugins.name: Data247
plugins.productIntro: Data247 将实时联系人和身份数据引入 ChatGPT，用于识别和验证联系人信息、欺诈活动、TCPA 合规性等。
plugins.productIntroEn: Data247 brings real-time contact and identity data into ChatGPT, for identifying and verifying contact information, fraudulent activity, TCPA compliance, and more.

plugins.name: ClearBounce
plugins.description: 验证并查找电子邮件地址
plugins.productIntro: ClearBounce 在 ChatGPT 内实时验证电子邮件地址。询问某个地址是否可以安全地发送电子邮件，它会运行全面检查 - 语法、MX 记录、实时邮箱检查、一次性和角色帐户检测、拼写错误救援和风险评分 - 返回明确的状态和 0-100 的质量分数。它还可以从姓名和公司域中查找某人的商务电子邮件，并报告您的剩余信用余额。登录使用 OAuth：您的密码永远不会通过聊天传递。新帐户包含 100 个免费积分。
plugins.productIntroEn: ClearBounce verifies email addresses in real time inside ChatGPT. Ask whether an address is safe to email and it runs a full check - syntax, MX records, a live mailbox check, disposable and role-account detection, typo rescue and risk scoring - returning a clear status and a 0-100 quality score.

plugins.name: Meticulate
plugins.productIntro: Meticulate 帮助 B2B 团队发现目标客户、寻找潜在客户、审查和批准出站提案、检查潜在客户活动以及通过 ChatGPT 调整定位和消息传递工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Meticulate helps B2B teams discover target accounts, find prospects, review and approve outbound proposals, inspect prospecting activity, and tune targeting and messaging workflows from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Scribble
plugins.productIntro: Scribble 发送真实的手写卡片。一台机器拿着一支真正的笔，用墨水在每张卡片和信封上书写，然后我们在上面盖章并将其邮寄到美国任何地方。没有什么是印刷字体。
plugins.productIntroEn: Scribble sends real handwritten cards. A machine holds an actual pen and writes each card and envelope in ink, then we stamp it and put it in the post anywhere in the United States. Nothing is a printed font.

plugins.name: Lightbringer
plugins.productIntro: Lightbringer 将人工智能原生平台与我们团队中合格的专利律师相结合，帮助科技公司端到端管理专利流程。我们的服务涵盖创新捕获、知识产权战略、新颖性和自由操作评估、专利申请起草和提交以及通过授权进行起诉。
plugins.productIntroEn: Lightbringer helps technology companies manage the patent process end to end, combining an AI-native platform with qualified patent attorneys on our team. Our service covers innovation capture, IP strategy, novelty and freedom-to-operate assessments, patent application drafting and filing, and prosecution through grant.

plugins.name: Asbie
plugins.description: 您的人工智能商业伙伴
plugins.productIntro: Asbie 是一款人工智能驱动的 CRM 伴侣，可将您的客户和业务数据直接导入 ChatGPT。
plugins.productIntroEn: Asbie is an AI-powered CRM companion that brings your customer and business data directly into ChatGPT.

plugins.name: WareMatch
plugins.productIntro: WareMatch 是第一个 3PL 仓储市场。我们将企业与根据其需求量身定制的 3PL 提供商联系起来。 3PL 运营商会与与其能力相符的品牌进行匹配，而品牌则接受专门满足其特定需求的 3PL 的投标。这是品牌和 3PL 找到合适并获得更好的物流解决方案的直接、透明的方式。
plugins.productIntroEn: WareMatch is the first 3PL warehousing marketplace. We connect businesses with 3pl providers tailored to their needs. 3PL operators get matched with brands that align with their capabilities, while brands receive bids from 3PLs who specialize in their particular needs. It's a direct, transparent way for both Brands and 3PLs to find the right fit and secure better logistics solutions.

plugins.name: Perk
plugins.productIntro: Perk 将您的商务旅行和支出带入 ChatGPT。计划和审查旅行、检查预订、跟踪支出以及提取旅行和费用报告 - 所有这些都无需离开对话。专为希望从自己的旅行和消费数据中快速获得答案的 Perk 客户而设计。
plugins.productIntroEn: Perk brings your business travel and spend into ChatGPT. Plan and review trips, check bookings, track spend, and pull travel and expense reports - all without leaving the conversation. Built for Perk customers who want fast answers from their own travel and spend data.

plugins.name: Justworks
plugins.productIntro: 通过 MCP 从 Justworks 平台了解有关计费时间、工资、保险和其他信息的更多信息
plugins.productIntroEn: Learn more about billing hours, payroll, insurance, and other information from Justworks platform via MCP

plugins.name: Pixelesq
plugins.productIntro: 将您的 Pixelesq 网站连接到 ChatGPT 并通过对话进行管理。通过从 60 多种部分类型中进行选择来创建登陆页面、生成内容并保存准备发布的页面。管理博客文章、团队简介、案例研究和其他结构化内容。监控 Google Search Console 排名、索引状态和网站流量。无需离开 ChatGPT，即可更新 SEO 元数据、创建 URL 重定向并自定义网站主题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Pixelesq website to ChatGPT and manage it through conversation. Create landing pages by choosing from over 60 section types, generate content, and save pages ready to publish. Manage blog posts, team bios, case studies, and other structured content. Monitor Google Search Console rankings, indexing status, and site traffic.

plugins.name: Yohn Wallet Card
plugins.productIntro: Yohn Wallet Card 根据已确认的联系方式创建临时数字名片。它通过电子邮件发送 Apple Wallet、Google Wallet 和索赔链接，并告诉用户确切的到期日期。
plugins.productIntroEn: Yohn Wallet Card creates a temporary digital business card from confirmed contact details. It emails Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, and claim links, and tells the user the exact expiration date.

plugins.name: CalcForms
plugins.productIntro: CalcForms 将工作簿规范或简单语言描述转换为计算表单，让用户测试和发布它们，并提供用于提交、邀请、导出和帐户设置的私有仪表板。
plugins.productIntroEn: CalcForms turns workbook specifications or plain-language descriptions into calculated forms, lets users test and publish them, and provides private dashboards for submissions, invites, exports, and account settings.

plugins.name: Buildfire
plugins.productIntro: Buildfire 帮助应用程序所有者通过 ChatGPT 管理他们的 Buildfire 应用程序。用户可以列出可访问的应用程序、检查已安装的功能、搜索用户、创建用户、分配或删除标签、查看应用程序和插件分析、检查插件内存、查找推送通知组以及通过面向确认的试运行安排推送通知。
plugins.productIntroEn: Buildfire helps app owners manage their Buildfire apps from ChatGPT. Users can list accessible apps, inspect installed features, search users, create users, assign or remove tags, review app and plugin analytics, inspect plugin memory, find push notification groups, and schedule push notifications with confirmation-oriented dry runs.

plugins.name: SEO with Distribb
plugins.productIntro: 您网站的 SEO 文章和反向链接，从 ChatGPT 运行。连接您的 Distribb 帐户，您可以使用真实搜索量和难度数据研究关键字、规划内容日历、撰写 SEO 文章，并将其直接发布到 WordPress、Webflow、Shopify、Wix、Framer、Ghost 或 Notion，而无需离开聊天。
plugins.productIntroEn: SEO articles & backlinks for your website, run from ChatGPT. Connect your Distribb account and you can research keywords with real search volume and difficulty data, plan a content calendar, write SEO articles, and publish them straight to WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, Wix, Framer, Ghost or Notion without leaving the chat.

plugins.name: Pingpong
plugins.productIntro: Pingpong 通过多个 AI 模型依次运行您的问题。每个模型在返回最终答案之前都会挑战并完善工作，并在当前证据重要时提供来源。用它来对不应仅依赖于一种模型的决策、计划、草案和声明进行压力测试。
plugins.productIntroEn: Pingpong runs your question through multiple AI models in sequence. Each model challenges and refines the work before one final answer is returned, with sources when current evidence matters. Use it to pressure-test decisions, plans, drafts, and claims that should not rely on one model alone.

plugins.name: Intellistrata
plugins.productIntro: Intellistrata 将 ChatGPT 与 Intellistrata 地层管理平台连接起来，允许授权用户安全地访问和使用与其管理的房产和业主立案法团相关的信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Intellistrata connects ChatGPT with the Intellistrata strata management platform, allowing authorised users to securely access and work with information relating to the properties and owners corporations they manage.

plugins.name: Pattern Intelligence
plugins.description: 电子商务人工智能。始终开启。
plugins.productIntro: Pattern Intelligence 是一款用于电子商务品牌管理的人工智能代理。询问有关您的业务绩效、购买框健康状况、价格抑制、库存缺口以及亚马逊、沃尔玛等市场趋势的问题，并立即获得专家支持的答案。 Pattern Intelligence 建立在 Pattern 13 年的市场专业知识和 77+T 专有数据点的基础上，全天候监控您的品牌，在风险影响您的损益之前将其暴露出来，并自动解决它们。不再需要等待报告或寻找答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Pattern Intelligence is an AI agent for ecommerce brand management. Ask questions about your business performance, buy box health, price suppression, inventory gaps, and marketplace trends across Amazon, Walmart, and beyond — and get instant, expert-backed answers.

plugins.name: LevelUp
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 LevelUp 帐户来管理您的房地产 CRM、后续任务、管道交易、开放日、品牌资产、培训和来自 ChatGPT 的授权 Listing Exchange 内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your LevelUp account to manage your real estate CRM, follow-up tasks, pipeline deals, open houses, brand assets, training, and authorized Listing Exchange content from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Valuecase
plugins.productIntro: Valuecase MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Valuecase 工作区，让您可以直接通过对话创建、管理和监控数字销售室和入职空间。从模板启动个性化空间、设置自定义属性并过滤您的空间 - 所有这些都无需切换工具。 ChatGPT 获取您空间的完整上下文，以便您可以查看参与度、检查进度并保持面向客户的工作流程从一个地方转移。
plugins.productIntroEn: Valuecase MCP connects ChatGPT to your Valuecase workspace, letting you create, manage, and monitor digital sales rooms and onboarding spaces directly from the conversation. Spin up personalised spaces from templates, set custom properties, and filter your Spaces – all without switching tools.

plugins.name: Rhythm Systems
plugins.productIntro: Rhythm Systems 是面向中端市场业务领导者的战略操作系统。此 AI 连接器使您的 AI 助手可以按用户安全地访问公司的 Rhythm 数据：战略和年度计划、季度目标和 KPI、会议议程、任务、同步周记录、工作记分卡和仪表板。询问目标状态、更新优先级、准备会议和记录笔记 — 所有这些都通过 OAuth 由您现有的 Rhythm 权限控制。需要管理员启用 AI Connector 访问权限的 Rhythm Systems 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rhythm Systems is a strategy operating system for mid-market business leaders. This AI Connector gives your AI assistant secure, per-user access to your company's Rhythm data: strategic and annual plans, quarterly goals and KPIs, meeting agendas, tasks, Week in Sync notes, job scorecards, and dashboards.

plugins.name: Zendesk (Beta)
plugins.description: 调查支持活动并管理 Zendesk 工作
plugins.originalDescription: Investigate support activity and manage Zendesk work
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Zendesk 调查支持票证和客户背景、查看队列和服务指标、处理指南内容、检查 Talk、Chat 和全渠道操作，并通过 OpenAI 连接器执行显式支持更新。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use Zendesk to investigate support tickets and customer context, review queues and service metrics, work with Guide content, inspect Talk, Chat, and Omnichannel operations, and perform explicit support updates through the OpenAI connector.

plugins.name: beglaubigt.de
plugins.productIntro: Beglaubigt 直接在对话中成立了一家德国公司 - GmbH 或 UG (haftungsbeschränkt)。告诉助理您想要成立的公司，它会一步一步收集详细信息：公司名称和目的、股本、股东和董事总经理，以及您希望如何进行公证。当一切准备就绪后，它会返回一个您在浏览器中打开的安全结帐链接 - 助手本身不会处理付款。
plugins.productIntroEn: Beglaubigt sets up a German company — a GmbH or UG (haftungsbeschränkt) — directly in the conversation. Tell the assistant you want to incorporate and it collects the details one step at a time: company name and purpose, share capital, the shareholder(s) and managing director, and how you'd like to notarize.

plugins.name: enercity
plugins.productIntro: 您万物能源的智能伴侣。讨论您的电力或燃气费率，探索您的选择，并获得即时答案 - 由 enercity 提供支持。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your smart companion for all things energy. Chat about your electricity or gas tariff, explore your options, and get instant answers — powered by enercity.

plugins.name: Muninx
plugins.productIntro: Muninx 是小型团队的帮助台。将其连接到 ChatGPT 以搜索支持历史记录、检查和更新票证、创建新票证、起草客户回复以及使用自然语言了解票证活动。非常适合共享收件箱已无法满足需求的初创公司、代理机构和团队。
plugins.productIntroEn: Muninx is a help desk for small teams. Connect it to ChatGPT to search support history, inspect and update tickets, create new tickets, draft customer replies, and understand ticket activity using natural language. Perfect for startups, agencies, and teams that have outgrown a shared inbox.

plugins.name: IQRush
plugins.description: 衡量 AI 搜索可见度
plugins.productIntro: IQRush 帮助团队检查人工智能搜索可见性、引文、品牌提及、情绪、基础来源、趋势变化、页面性能以及关联的 GA4 和 Search Console 分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: IQRush helps teams inspect AI-search visibility, citations, brand mentions, sentiment, grounding sources, trend changes, page performance, and connected GA4 and Search Console analytics.

plugins.name: Scribe
plugins.description: 管理公司电子邮件签名
plugins.productIntro: Scribe 是企业的电子邮件签名管理：IT 设置一次，营销人员运行它，并且无需员工安装任何东西。
plugins.productIntroEn: Scribe is email signature management for enterprise: IT sets it up once, marketing runs it, and no employee ever installs anything.

plugins.name: BuildBetter.ai
plugins.productIntro: BuildBetter 帮助团队跨信号、呼叫、文字记录、文档、知识页面、人员和模式元数据查找产品和客户证据上下文，以便产品和工程工作可以基于经过验证的工作区证据。
plugins.productIntroEn: BuildBetter helps teams find product and customer evidence context across signals, calls, transcripts, documents, knowledge pages, people, and schema metadata so product and engineering work can be grounded in authenticated workspace evidence.

plugins.name: APiM Galaxy
plugins.productIntro: APiM Galaxy 是一款 MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器，由 A Piece of Map Inc. 构建，它将业务开发和市场进入研究添加到您已经使用的 AI（ChatGPT、Claude 或 Claude Code）中。您指定您想要接触的公司或您想要进入的市场，连接器会映射出他们实际合作的人员，找到最热情的介绍路径，并返回优先计划 - 每个关系都根据其来源进行检查，并标记未经验证的关系。完整的研究是免费的，没有使用限制。
plugins.productIntroEn: APiM Galaxy is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, built by A Piece of Map Inc., that adds business-development and market-entry research to the AI you already use — ChatGPT, Claude, or Claude Code.

plugins.name: Connhex
plugins.description: 人工智能原生物联网基础设施
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 与您的 Connhex 工业物联网设备进行交互。检查遥测和设备连接、创建和管理规则，并通过检查设备组状态、检查正常运行时间和调查发生的问题来了解设备的最新情况。
plugins.productIntroEn: Interact with your Connhex industrial IoT devices directly from ChatGPT. Inspect telemetry and device connectivity, create and manage rules, and stay up to date with your devices by checking fleet status, reviewing uptime, and investigating issues as they happen.

plugins.name: Lusca
plugins.productIntro: Lusca 帮助 Shopify 商家将他们的商店和营销帐户连接到 ChatGPT。它会审核目录运行状况、Google Ads 效果、Merchant Center Feed 状态和 Search Console 需求信号，然后准备安全建议和每日报告。任何可能改变商店或营销活动的操作都会显示在批准屏幕中，并且在执行之前需要明确的人工批准。
plugins.productIntroEn: Lusca helps Shopify merchants connect their store and marketing accounts to ChatGPT. It reviews catalog health, Google Ads performance, Merchant Center feed status, and Search Console demand signals, then prepares safe recommendations and daily reports. Any action that could change a store or campaign is shown in an approval screen and requires explicit human approval before execution.

plugins.name: Caretta
plugins.productIntro: Caretta 帮助用户检查他们的销售电话、搜索电话记录和摘要、查看后续待办事项以及从 ChatGPT 创建或更新私人待办事项。
plugins.productIntroEn: Caretta helps users inspect their sales calls, search call transcripts and summaries, review follow-up todos, and create or update private todos from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: SignatureAPI
plugins.productIntro: SignatureAPI 帮助用户创建电子签名信封、从 ChatGPT 上传文档、检查信封状态、取消正在进行的信封、删除最终信封以及在构建请求之前搜索 SignatureAPI 文档。
plugins.productIntroEn: SignatureAPI helps users create e-signature envelopes, upload documents from ChatGPT, inspect envelope status, cancel in-progress envelopes, delete final envelopes, and search SignatureAPI documentation before building requests.

plugins.name: Tariff Code Compliance
plugins.productIntro: 关税代码合规性可帮助用户发现当前的关税系统、研究分类节点和证据、比较替代方案并准备会话本地产品分类建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tariff Code Compliance helps users discover current tariff systems, research classification nodes and evidence, compare alternatives, and prepare a session-local product classification recommendation.

plugins.name: magnews
plugins.productIntro: 使用 ChatGPT 中的 magnews 分析电子邮件活动、时事通讯、营销自动化、工作流程、受众和数据库。查看 magnews 帐户中可用的效果、打开次数、点击次数、转化次数、参与度、内容和趋势，并提供通俗易懂的语言解释和实用建议，将营销数据转化为行动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use magnews in ChatGPT to analyze email campaigns, newsletters, marketing automations, workflows, audiences, and databases. Review performance, opens, clicks, conversions, engagement, content, and trends available in your magnews account, with plain-language explanations and practical recommendations to turn marketing data into action.

plugins.name: OneUp Today
plugins.description: 在 Reddit 上寻找客户
plugins.productIntro: OneUp Today 在 Reddit 上找到已经在描述您的产品解决的问题的人，并将其转变为可审查的外展渠道。使用此插件，您可以查看 OneUp 帐户中运行的营销活动，浏览每个发现的潜在客户及其相关性分数和渠道状态，阅读与任何潜在客户的对话历史记录，并使用 OneUp 的消息编写器起草个性化的开场白。批准的草稿可以排队等待发送，并且您可以在发送之前检查发送准备情况。
plugins.productIntroEn: OneUp Today finds people on Reddit who are already describing the problem your product solves, and turns them into a reviewable outreach pipeline. With this plugin you can review the campaigns running in your OneUp account, browse the leads each one discovered with their relevance scores and funnel status, read the conversation history with any lead, and draft a personalized opener using…

plugins.name: Ray Arceneaux
plugins.productIntro: Ray Arceneaux AI 帮助企业主查明他们的公司是否对 ChatGPT 和 AI 搜索引擎不可见，并准确地向他们展示该怎么做。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ray Arceneaux AI helps business owners find out if their company is invisible to ChatGPT and AI search engines — and shows them exactly what to do about it.

plugins.name: DATAHILL
plugins.description: 上下文、优先顺序和指示
plugins.productIntro: O DATAHILL 与 IA 代理机构和企业情报机构合作，减少信息和决策之间的距离。存在的歌剧，组织背景的谈判，解释变化，优先考虑的重点和东方作为近似的 ações。进行对话、探索指标、达成一致或结果并根据组织环境做出决定 — 这是一个推荐的替代方案。
plugins.productIntroEn: O DATAHILL conecta agentes de IA à camada de inteligência de gestão da sua empresa, reduzindo a distância entre informação e decisão. Opera sobre os sistemas existentes, organiza o contexto do negócio, explica variações, prioriza o que merece atenção e orienta as próximas ações.

plugins.name: Aira
plugins.productIntro: Aira 让企业主查看最近来自 ChatGPT 的 AI 接待员电话。询问今天的通话、最近的通话或最近的通话，然后在交互式通话审核面板中打开摘要、收集的潜在客户详细信息、文字记录片段和录音。
plugins.productIntroEn: Aira lets business owners review recent AI receptionist calls from ChatGPT. Ask for today's calls, recent calls, or the latest call, then open summaries, collected lead details, transcript snippets, and recordings in an interactive call review panel.

plugins.name: IncorpFlow Copilot
plugins.description: 新加坡 CSP 运营助理
plugins.productIntro: IncorpFlow Copilot 适用于经过身份验证的 CSP 租户管理员。它回答产品使用问题，仅读取链接的租户工作区，并可以创建已确认的租户记录，例如后端服务请求、付款后合并票证和 Quotech 支持票证。它还可以发送确认电子邮件，例如选定的公司文件交付、SOA 提醒和导出 OTP。 Copilot 不会在 ChatGPT 内收集受限个人文档、完整个人标识符、支付卡详细信息、健康数据、生物识别数据、SSN 或 PCI 数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: IncorpFlow Copilot is for authenticated CSP tenant admins. It answers product-use questions, reads only the linked tenant workspace, and can create confirmed tenant records such as backend service requests, after-payment incorporation tickets, and Quotech support tickets. It may also send confirmed emails such as selected company-file delivery, SOA reminders, and export OTPs.

plugins.name: Introw PRM
plugins.description: #1 人工智能合作伙伴门户
plugins.productIntro: Introw 是一个合作伙伴关系平台 (PRM)，可让您在几分钟内启动个性化合作伙伴门户 - 所有这些都与您的 CRM（HubSpot 和 Salesforce）集成。 如果您正在与经销商、推荐合作伙伴、分销商、实施合作伙伴等合作，请继续阅读。
plugins.productIntroEn: Introw is a partner relationship platform (PRM) that allows you to launch a personalised partner portal in minutes - all integrated with your CRM (HubSpot & Salesforce). If you're working with resellers, referral partners, distributors, implementation partners,... keep reading.

plugins.name: Intelligo
plugins.productIntro: Intelligo 将风险情报引入 ChatGPT。连接您的 Intelligo 帐户，将背景调查、信用调查以及不良媒体和社交媒体筛查纳入对话中。总结主题的发现和风险标记，比较报告以查看发生的变化，在您的个人资料中搜索名称或关键字，并根据您自己的 Intelligo 数据准备尽职调查报告。登录通过 OAuth 进行保护，ChatGPT 仅访问您的帐户有权查看的数据。需要一个 Intelligo 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: Intelligo brings risk intelligence into ChatGPT. Connect your Intelligo account to pull background checks, credit checks, and adverse-media and social-media screening into the conversation. Summarize a subject's findings and risk flags, compare reports to see what changed, search across your profiles for a name or keyword, and prepare due-diligence write-ups — grounded in your own Intell…

plugins.name: Calendesk
plugins.productIntro: Calendesk 将您的预订管理平台直接连接到 ChatGPT。使用自然语言来管理您的业务：
plugins.productIntroEn: Calendesk connects your booking management platform directly to ChatGPT. Use natural language to manage your business:

plugins.name: BencinaMCP
plugins.productIntro: BencinaMCP 允许用户使用每天早上刷新的官方 CNE 数据询问有关智利燃油价格的自然语言问题。按社区、地区或品牌比较 Gasolina 93、95、97 和 Diesel；找出价格最低或最高的地方；并了解每个当地市场的集中度，包括哪个品牌占主导地位以及占主导地位的程度。
plugins.productIntroEn: BencinaMCP lets users ask natural-language questions about fuel prices in Chile using official CNE data refreshed every morning. Compare Gasolina 93, 95, 97 and Diesel by comuna, region, or brand; find where prices are lowest or highest; and see how concentrated each local market is, including which brand dominates and by how much.

plugins.name: Wheelbase
plugins.productIntro: Wheelbase 将您的租赁业务带入 ChatGPT。连接您的帐户，并以简单的语言询问您的预订、车队、客户和付款情况 - “本周有多少预订？”、“查找 Jane Smith 的预订”、“旅行结束后哪些押金仍处于保留状态？”、“有多少车辆未发布？”。您还可以开始预订或向客户发送结账链接。适用于您现有的轴距帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: Wheelbase brings your rental business into ChatGPT. Connect your account and ask about your bookings, fleet, customers, and payments in plain language — "how many bookings this week?", "look up Jane Smith's reservations", "which deposits are still on hold after the trip ended?", "how many vehicles are unpublished?". You can also start a booking or send a checkout link to a customer.

plugins.name: Arez
plugins.description: 搜索 Arez 官方帮助
plugins.productIntro: Arez 帮助用户找到有关 Arez 功能、设置、工作流程和故障排除的官方指南。它搜索已发布的帮助中心文章，检索相关文章内容，并提供可靠答案的官方源 URL。
plugins.productIntroEn: Arez helps users find official guidance for Arez features, setup, workflows, and troubleshooting. It searches published Help Centre articles, retrieves relevant article content, and provides the official source URLs for grounded answers.

plugins.name: Kangaroo Rewards
plugins.productIntro: Kangaroo Rewards 允许商家查看其关联的忠诚度计划，包括业务详细信息、客户资料、积分和交易历史记录、活动、优惠、兑换奖励、忠诚度设置和绩效指标。它为活动状态、参与率、归因收入和其他汇总报告提供了简单的语言上下文。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kangaroo Rewards lets merchants review their connected loyalty program, including business details, customer profiles, points and transaction history, campaigns, offers, redemption rewards, loyalty settings, and performance metrics. It provides plain-language context for campaign status, engagement rates, attributed revenue, and other aggregate reports.

plugins.name: ClearPolicy
plugins.productIntro: ClearPolicy 帮助组织创建和发布策略文档、管理人员和组、发送电子签名或确认请求、发出提醒以及跟踪 ChatGPT 的文档合规性。
plugins.productIntroEn: ClearPolicy helps organizations create and publish policy documents, manage people and groups, send electronic signature or acknowledgment requests, issue reminders, and track document compliance from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: SignalSumo
plugins.description: 您在 ChatGPT 中的 SEO 数据
plugins.productIntro: SignalSumo 将您的 SEO 帐户连接到 ChatGPT。询问您跟踪的关键字位置及其移动情况，提取真实的 Search Console 查询，检查域的反向链接配置文件，查看您的品牌在 AI 助理答案中出现的频率，并开始技术网站审核。每个答案都来自您自己的 SignalSumo 帐户，其计划限制和配额与网络应用程序相同。需要 Pro 或 Agency 计划的 SignalSumo 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: SignalSumo connects your SEO account to ChatGPT. Ask about your tracked keyword positions and how they've moved, pull real Search Console queries, check a domain's backlink profile, see how often your brand appears in AI assistant answers, and start a technical site audit. Every answer comes from your own SignalSumo account under the same plan limits and quotas as the web app.

plugins.name: Taverity
plugins.productIntro: Taverity 允许用户与助手一起查找联系人列表、预览个人后续文本以及在其 Taverity 帐户中对批准的一次性消息进行排队。排队的消息会显示在 Taverity iPhone 应用程序中，并在批准后从用户自己的 iPhone 号码发送； MCP服务器不直接发送SMS。
plugins.productIntroEn: Taverity lets users work with an assistant to find contact lists, preview personal follow-up texts, and queue approved one-time messages in their Taverity account. Queued messages surface in the Taverity iPhone app and are sent from the user's own iPhone number after approval; the MCP server does not send SMS directly.

plugins.name: Knottle
plugins.description: 顧客・案件・タスク・見積・請求を管理
plugins.originalDescription: 顧客・案件・タスク・見積・請求を管理
plugins.productIntro: Knottle：顧客・案件・タスク・見積・請求を管理。
plugins.productIntroEn: Knottleは、ChatGPTからCRM内の顧客、担当者、案件、活動、タスク、見積、請求を参照・作成・更新できる、日本の小規模事業者向けプラグインです。書き込み、発行、削除は操作種別が明示され、データはテナント単位で分離されます。Google DriveまたはDropboxへのファイル保存にも対応します。

plugins.name: Duckhub QR Menu
