plugins.productIntro: Duckhub QR Menu 是一款餐厅软件，可通过 QR 码菜单和集成点餐将餐饮数字化。食客扫描代码即可在手机上查看数字菜单，无需应用程序或纸张。 AI 助手会生成菜肴描述、将菜单翻译成 14 种语言并创建商品图像。预订通过菜单或 WhatsApp 等应用程序进行管理，并通过仪表板处理确认。在线订购使餐馆可以创建带有菜单和订购功能的网站。餐桌点餐允许食客扫描二维码、选择菜品，然后通过餐桌标识将订单发送到厨房。包括交付管理和员工访问控制。
plugins.productIntroEn: Duckhub QR Menu is restaurant software that digitizes dining with QR code menus and integrated ordering. Diners scan codes to view digital menus on their phones without apps or paper. An AI assistant generates dish descriptions, translates menus into 14 languages, and creates item images.

plugins.name: Nexvio AI
plugins.description: 您的人工智能支持代理
plugins.productIntro: 连接到您的 Nexvio 工作区，通过我们的 MCP 应用程序管理 AI 代理、联系人、支持票证、分析和帮助文档。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect to your Nexvio workspace to manage AI agents, contacts, support tickets, analytics, and help documentation through our MCP App.

plugins.productIntroEn: Itcons.app helps teams manage work reports. This ChatGPT app lets authorized Itcons.app users securely connect their own Itcons.app account and query operational data from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Meteomatics Weather

plugins.productIntroEn: A connector that plugs Meteomatics' weather data directly. Ask natural language questions about real-time and forecast weather, and get instant structured data back, no manual API calls needed.

plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your QRTracker account to access and manage your tracked QR codes directly from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Profit.co

plugins.name: PracticPro

plugins.productIntro: PracticPro 将 ChatGPT 变成您的商务助手。查找联系人、检查工作状态、创建估算和发票、记录活动以及发送电子邮件 - 所有这些都无需离开聊天室。询问诸如“本周有哪些职位空缺？”、“起草史密斯厨房改造的发票”或“通过电子邮件向客户发送更新的估算”之类的问题，PracticPro 会根据您的真实账户进行处理。专为已经在 PracticPro 上运行的承包商、服务企业和小型团队而构建。
plugins.productIntroEn: PracticPro turns ChatGPT into your business assistant. Look up contacts, check job status, create estimates and invoices, log activities, and send emails - all without leaving the chat. Ask things like "what jobs are open this week?", "draft an invoice for the Smith kitchen remodel", or "email the client the updated estimate" and PracticPro handles it against your live account.

plugins.name: Counter

plugins.productIntroEn: Counter connects your builders’-merchant price book to ChatGPT so you can price up a job in seconds. Ask for any material and Counter returns your own agreed prices so your estimates are fast and accurate.

plugins.productIntroEn: inSitu Sales helps manufacturers, wholesalers, and distributors find customers and products; review pricing, inventory, visits, orders, estimates, and invoices; generate customer statements; predict order recommendations; and create or update sales records through ChatGPT.

plugins.productIntroEn: Access your BidPrime leads inboxes including bids, meeting keyword alerts and emerging opportunities - including matching document content for summarizing and evaluating new bids and opportunities.

plugins.name: Recooty

plugins.productIntroEn: Recooty is an AI-powered hiring platform to create job descriptions, post to job boards, and manage applicants.

plugins.name: Checkin
plugins.productIntro: 向 ChatGPT 询问您的 Checkin 帐户可以访问的事件，而无需导出报告。查找活动、参与者、联系人和订单；监控门票销售和签到；审查付款状态和收入；并比较活动表现。所有工具都是只读的，并尊重您现有的签入帐户权限。

All tools are read-only and respect your existing Checkin account permissions.

plugins.name: Sunwise
plugins.description: 太阳能安装商业务应用程序
plugins.productIntro: Sunwise 是一个一体化平台，旨在帮助太阳能安装商更有效地管理和发展业务。该应用程序可帮助您在一个易于使用的工作区中组织项目、跟踪潜在客户、创建提案并协调您的团队。通过集中日常运营，Sunwise 可以节省时间、减少人工工作，并使安装人员更好地了解其销售渠道和正在进行的安装，以便您可以专注于为客户提供出色的太阳能项目。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sunwise is an all-in-one platform designed for solar installers to manage and grow their business more efficiently. The app helps you organize projects, track leads, create proposals, and coordinate your team from a single, easy-to-use workspace.

plugins.name: Lumini
plugins.productIntro: 将您的 AI 助手连接到由 AI 驱动的新西兰政府情报部门 Lumini。搜索立法、跟踪法案、监控咨询并获取有关议会活动的见解，所有这些都适用于您的组织。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your AI assistant to Lumini — AI-powered New Zealand government intelligence. Search legislation, track bills, monitor consultations, and get insights about parliamentary activity, all scoped to your organisation.

plugins.name: New York LLC Publication
plugins.productIntro: 刚刚在纽约成立了一家有限责任公司？在 120 天的截止日期之前查明出版要求、按县出版的费用以及您需要哪些报纸。纽约州所有 62 个县的实时定价。为国内有限责任公司、国外有限责任公司和 PLLC 工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Just formed an LLC in New York? Find out the publication requirement, how much it costs to publish by county, and which newspapers you need — before the 120-day deadline. Live pricing for all 62 NY counties. Works for domestic LLCs, foreign LLCs, and PLLCs.
plugins.developerName: Sandeep Arneja LLC d/b/a LLC Publishers

plugins.name: Influencer Hero
plugins.productIntro: Influencer Hero 是一个针对消费品牌的影响者营销平台。通过此连接器，您可以在对话中运行影响者计划，而无需单击仪表板。
plugins.productIntroEn: Influencer Hero is an influencer marketing platform for consumer brands. This connector lets you run your influencer program in conversation instead of clicking through the dashboard.

plugins.name: El Tasador - Soluna
plugins.productIntro: 亚马逊美国评估师：评估 ASIN 的门控、咨询费用、保护成本和注意事项，以及使用 Ingram Micro 的提示。 Cada usuario conecta su propiacuenta de 亚马逊卖家。
plugins.productIntroEn: Appraiser para Amazon US: evalúa gating por ASIN, consulta precios y fees, guarda costos y notas, y cotiza con la cuenta de Ingram Micro del usuario. Cada usuario conecta su propia cuenta de Amazon Seller.

plugins.name: Gusto
plugins.description: 人员和工资管理，变得简单
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Gusto 插件在 ChatGPT 中完成人员和工资工作，而不仅仅是询问相关问题。准备即将到来的工资单，并根据最近的运行情况进行审查，以在发薪日前发现需要注意的事项。修复时间表，从电子表格中引入工时、小费和报销，或从录用通知书中聘用新员工，所有这些都可以在聊天线程中完成。 ChatGPT 的 Gusto 插件将工资单数据连接到您的现场人员，工具支持结构化数据的详细查询以及需要确认的写入。
plugins.productIntroEn: Get people and payroll work done in ChatGPT with the Gusto plugin, don’t just ask questions about it. Prepare an upcoming payroll and review against recent runs to catch what needs attention before payday. Fix timesheets, bring in hours, tips, and reimbursements from spreadsheets, or onboard a new hire from their offer letter, all in a chat thread.

plugins.name: Candidate Time Extractor
plugins.productIntro: 候选人时间提取器将候选人的可用性消息转换为结构化的面试时间详细信息。它提取可用时间、时区、联系方式、备注、缺失字段、源文本和错误，帮助招聘工作流程更快地组织候选人回复。
plugins.productIntroEn: Candidate Time Extractor turns candidate availability messages into structured interview time details. It extracts available times, timezone, contact details, notes, missing fields, source text, and errors, helping recruiting workflows organize candidate replies faster.

plugins.name: Energy Aspects
plugins.productIntro: Energy Aspects 使人工智能代理可以直接访问专家能源市场情报——研究报告、实时分析师评论以及石油、天然气、电力和相关市场的时间序列数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Energy Aspects gives AI agents direct access to expert energy market intelligence — research reports, real-time analyst commentary, and timeseries data across oil, gas, power, and related markets.

plugins.name: GLG
plugins.productIntro: GLG 让您可以即时访问世界上最大的专家网络。搜索数以千计的专家成绩单，探索跨行业的见解，并查看您自己的研究电话内容 - 所有这些都无需离开您的工作流程。每一个答复均基于由格理集团主持的对话中经过命名、经过验证的专家，为您提供做出更快、更自信的决策所需的主要情报。
plugins.productIntroEn: GLG gives you instant access to the world's largest expert network. Search thousands of expert transcripts, explore insights across industries, and review content from your own research calls — all without leaving your workflow.

plugins.name: Audiense Insights
plugins.productIntro: Audiense Insights 是一个受众细分平台，它超越了人口统计数据，帮助您进行大规模个性化。用它来讲述引起共鸣的故事，做出数据驱动的创意决策，识别有关客户的见解，发现有影响力的人或合作伙伴等等。 ‍
plugins.productIntroEn: Audiense Insights is an audience segmentation platform that looks beyond demographics to help you personalize at scale. Use it to tell stories that resonate, make data-driven creative decisions, identify insights about customers, discover influencer or partners, and more. ‍

plugins.name: DigiTrust Evidence Assistant
plugins.productIntro: DigiTrust Evidence Assistant 是一个用于安全和采购审查的只读公共演示。它列出并总结了合成证据包，生成客户安全的保证摘要，比较准备情况，并生成具有声明到证据链接、验证、出处、调查结果、限制和外部使用资格的确定性 v2 审查。所有数据都是合成的；该应用程序无法批准或授权外部使用、修改记录、通知第三方、处理付款或访问付费客户工作区。https://www.digitranshq.com/contact
plugins.productIntroEn: DigiTrust Evidence Assistant is a read-only public demo for security and procurement review. It lists and summarizes synthetic evidence packets, generates customer-safe assurance summaries, compares readiness, and produces deterministic v2 reviews with claim-to-evidence links, verification, provenance, findings, limitations, and external-use eligibility.

plugins.name: Translations Universe
plugins.productIntro: 获取专业人工翻译、认证和宣誓翻译、MTPE、修订以及网站或 CMS 本地化的实时价格和交付估算。选择语言、数量、主题领域和紧急程度，以获得欧元预估价格和交货时间。该插件仅提供报价，不创建订单或处理付款。
plugins.productIntroEn: Get live price and delivery estimates for professional human translation, certified and sworn translation, MTPE, revision, and website or CMS localization. Choose the languages, volume, subject area and urgency to receive an estimated price in EUR and delivery time. This plugin provides quotations only and does not create orders or process payments.

plugins.name: 20Tabs
plugins.productIntro: 经营酒店业务意味着您的答案分布在报告、仪表板和结单中。使用 20Tabs 连接器，您可以直接询问 ChatGPT。
plugins.productIntroEn: Running a hospitality business means your answers are spread across reports, dashboards, and closing sheets. With the 20Tabs connector, you can just ask ChatGPT instead.

plugins.name: Testlify
plugins.productIntro: Testlify MCP 服务器使 AI 助手能够安全地连接到您的 Testlify 人才评估平台并与之交互。直接通过自然语言访问和管理评估、候选人数据、测试结果和招聘工作流程 — 简化招聘流程、检索候选人绩效分析并自动化评估管理，而无需离开 AI 环境。您说：标语？
plugins.productIntroEn: Testlify MCP Server enables AI assistants to securely connect to and interact with your Testlify talent assessment platform. Access and manage assessments, candidate data, test results, and recruitment workflows directly through natural language—streamlining hiring processes, retrieving candidate performance analytics, and automating assessment management without leaving your AI environm…

plugins.name: SyncMe
plugins.productIntro: SyncMe 是一个多渠道电子商务同步平台，可实时连接 Amazon、Shopify、Meta、Salla、Noon、eBay、Zid 等平台上的库存、订单和产品列表。消除过度销售、减少手动工作并轻松扩展您的在线业务。
plugins.productIntroEn: SyncMe is a multi-channel eCommerce sync platform that connects your inventory, orders, and product listings across Amazon, Shopify, Meta, Salla, Noon, eBay, Zid and more, all in real time. Eliminate overselling, reduce manual work, and scale your online business effortlessly.

plugins.name: Workleap AI
plugins.description: 探索团队健康状况和产出
plugins.productIntro: 询问有关您的团队和组织的简单语言问题，并使用您的 Workleap 帐户中的数据进行回答。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ask plain-language questions about your team and organization—answered with data from your Workleap account.

plugins.name: FileAssist
plugins.productIntro: 使用此工具可通过简单、自然的语言提示处理存储在 FileAssist 中的文档。它允许用户快速查找相关文件、生成摘要、识别文档之间的差异以及提取关键信息，而无需单独打开每个文件。该工具最适合高效查看、分析 FileAssist 平台中存储的内容并从中获取见解。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use this tool to work with documents stored in FileAssist using simple, natural language prompts. It allows users to quickly find relevant files, generate summaries, identify differences between documents, and extract key information without opening each file individually.

plugins.name: YesIQ
plugins.productIntro: YesIQ 审查公共网站页面的故意限制样本，并帮助 ChatGPT 解释组织、评估数字成熟度并识别实际业务、转换、客户体验和人工智能自动化机会。
plugins.productIntroEn: YesIQ reviews a deliberately bounded sample of public website pages and helps ChatGPT explain the organization, assess digital maturity, and identify practical business, conversion, customer-experience, and AI-automation opportunities.

plugins.name: Asva AI
plugins.description: 在 AI 搜索中查看您的品牌
plugins.originalDescription: See your brand on AI search
plugins.productIntro: Asva AI 是一个答案引擎优化平台。该应用程序可让您跨 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Copilot、Grok、Meta AI 和 Google AI 模式读取您品牌的 AI 搜索可见性，并从您自己的品牌套件中生成品牌内容。询问您的品牌被提及的频率、您的发言权份额、哪些领域引用您最多，以及情绪趋势如何。生成内容简介、完整博客、登陆、社交或电子邮件片段、llms.txt 文件以及按需可见性审核。
plugins.productIntroEn: Asva AI is an Answer Engine Optimization platform. This app lets you read your brand's AI search visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Grok, Meta AI, and Google AI Mode, and generate on brand content from your own brand kit. Ask how often your brand is mentioned, what share of voice you hold, which domains cite you most, and how sentiment is trending.

plugins.name: LegisRatio
plugins.productIntro: 我们提供图形驱动的基础设施，用于以编程方式访问欧盟、意大利和地区立法和判例的相互关联的法律语料库，并具有精确的时间版本控制。我们帮助代理将先进的语义搜索、语言分析和实时立法监控集成到高精度的法律技术和研究应用中。
plugins.productIntroEn: We provide a graph-powered infrastructure for programmatic access to an interconnected legal corpus of EU, Italian and Regional legislation and jurisprudence with precise temporal versioning. We empower agents integrating advanced semantic search, linguistic analytics, and real-time legislative monitoring into high-precision legal-tech and research applications.

plugins.name: airfocus
plugins.description: 提供 ChatGPT 产品背景。
plugins.productIntro: 将您的产品上下文引入 ChatGPT。该应用程序为 ChatGPT 提供了对您的实时 Airfocus 路线图、OKR 和客户反馈的权限感知访问权限，因此每个答案都基于您产品的实际情况。查询路线图状态、分类反馈、草案 PRD 和利益相关者更新，并显示跨团队风险。 ChatGPT 还可以直接从对话中创建和更新项目，直接写回airfocus。让 Airfocus 成为您在 ChatGPT 中工作背后的产品大脑。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring your product context into ChatGPT. This app gives ChatGPT permission-aware access to your live airfocus roadmaps, OKRs, and customer feedback, so every answer is grounded in where your product actually stands. Query roadmap status, triage feedback, draft PRDs and stakeholder updates, and surface cross-team risk.

plugins.name: SCOUT for Federal Contracting
plugins.productIntro: SCOUT for Federal Contracting 帮助 govcon 团队搜索活跃的联邦和 SLED 招标、确定 USASpending 奖项的市场规模、跟踪重新竞争渠道、审查 GAO 抗议，并在 ChatGPT 内运行执行机构简报。
plugins.productIntroEn: SCOUT for Federal Contracting helps govcon teams search active federal and SLED solicitations, size markets from USASpending awards, track recompete pipelines, review GAO protests, and run executive agency briefings inside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Policy Doctor
plugins.productIntro: Policy Doctor 将欧盟立法、判例法和游说情报直接引入 ChatGPT 和您的日常工作中。 • 监控和分析欧盟游说活动——搜索会议、跟踪谁游说谁以及游说什么主题——以及公司使用哪些公共事务公司 • 在欧盟透明度登记册上介绍游说组织和目标，例如欧盟官员 • 还包括芬兰立法项目和游说信息 • 专为人工智能工具设计的结构化数据 — 无需离开人工智能工具即可检索、分析政策情报并采取行动 • 草拟文档并将 Policy Doctor 提供给您的数据注入到您…
plugins.productIntroEn: Policy Doctor brings EU legislative, case law and lobbying intelligence directly into ChatGPT and your daily work. • Monitor and analyse EU lobbying activity — search meetings, track who lobbies whom and on what topics – and what public affairs firms are used by companies • Profile lobbying organisations and targets like EU officials across the EU Transparency Register • Also includes Fi…

plugins.name: ProjectBase Beta
plugins.productIntro: ProjectBase AI Assistant 可帮助您使用自然语言与 ProjectBase ERP 进行交互。访问项目记录、检索项目信息、监控财务状况以及执行日常操作任务——所有这些都通过对话界面进行。随着助手的发展，新功能将不断添加。
plugins.productIntroEn: ProjectBase AI Assistant helps you interact with your ProjectBase ERP using natural language. Access project records, retrieve project information, monitor financials, and perform day-to-day operational tasks—all from a conversational interface. New capabilities will continue to be added as the assistant evolves.

plugins.name: Windsor.ai TikTok Ads
plugins.productIntro: Windsor.ai TikTok Ads 将您的 TikTok 广告数据连接到您的 AI 助手，以便您可以用简单的英语分析效果并管理广告活动。发现连接的广告帐户，检查有效字段和选项，并查询任何日期范围内的广告系列、广告组和广告指标（支出、展示次数、点击次数、点击率、每次点击费用和转化次数）。确认后，它还可以暂停或启用广告系列、广告组和广告，并设置广告系列和广告组预算。
plugins.productIntroEn: Windsor.ai TikTok Ads connects your TikTok Ads data to your AI assistant, so you can analyze performance and manage campaigns in plain English. Discover connected ad accounts, inspect valid fields and options, and query campaign, ad group, and ad metrics (spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, and conversions) over any date range.

plugins.name: Dockflow
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中查找海运集装箱位置和运输时间表。输入集装箱号码即可立即获取装货港、卸货港、预计出发和到达日期以及贸易流参考。
plugins.productIntroEn: Look up ocean container locations and shipping schedules directly in ChatGPT. Enter a container number to instantly get port of loading, port of discharge, estimated departure and arrival dates, and tradeflow references.

plugins.name: Automatika Connect
plugins.productIntro: Automatika Connect 是一款只读应用程序，可供经过身份验证的自动售货运营商检查车队健康状况、诊断机器问题、审查销售和产品性能、优先补货、比较使用情况以及了解授权机器遥测的可靠性。它不会重新启动机器、更改价格、创建门票、发送电子邮件、安排访问、将缺货标记为重新装满或为消费者定位公共自动售货机。不要为主要目的是执行操作写入操作的请求调用此应用程序。
plugins.productIntroEn: Automatika Connect is a read-only app for authenticated vending operators to inspect fleet health, diagnose machine issues, review sales and product performance, prioritize restocking, compare usage, and understand reliability from authorized machine telemetry.

plugins.name: Conterminal Shipments
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到一位 Conterminal 承运商或货运代理工作区，并询问有关集装箱运输的只读问题。按集装箱、主提单、参考号、船舶、码头、状态、持有、热装标志或支持的日期进行搜索。检索结果的策划操作快照，包括里程碑和当前操作标志。 Conterminal 会在每次调用时重新检查登录用户、OAuth 客户端、工作区成员资格和发货授权。连接器无法编辑货件、调度司机、刷新提供商、发送消息、上传文档或访问其他组织。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to one Conterminal carrier or freight-forwarder workspace and ask read-only questions about container shipments. Search by container, master bill of lading, reference, vessel, terminal, status, hold, hot-load flag, or supported date. Retrieve a curated operational snapshot for a result, including milestones and current operational flags.

plugins.name: Aivie
plugins.description: 您的营销人工智能助手
plugins.productIntro: Aivie 帮助用户搜索 CRM 联系人、活动、报告、细分、主题和 MJML 电子邮件，然后检查详细信息或通过 ChatGPT 创建和更新私人 Aivie 电子邮件内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Aivie helps users search CRM contacts, campaigns, reports, segments, themes, and MJML emails, then inspect details or create and update private Aivie email content through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Midlyr
plugins.productIntro: Midlyr 帮助金融服务团队处理监管内容、筛选合规风险文本、创建合规事件并跟踪 ChatGPT 的相关分析作业。
plugins.productIntroEn: Midlyr helps financial-services teams work with regulatory content, screen text for compliance risk, create compliance events, and track related analysis jobs from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: magicplan
plugins.productIntro: magicplan 是一款用于现场测量、记录和估算的现场应用程序，广泛应用于财产修复、保险和建筑领域。此连接器为 ChatGPT 提供了对 magicplan 工作区的只读访问权限，因此您可以直接在对话中查看和推理项目数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: magicplan is a field app for measuring, documenting, and estimating on site, widely used in property restoration, insurance, and construction. This connector gives ChatGPT read-only access to a magicplan workspace, so you can review and reason over project data directly in the conversation.

plugins.name: Spot2
plugins.productIntro: Spot2 通过 ChatGPT 帮助用户寻找墨西哥的商业地产。用户可以搜索办公室、工业仓库、零售空间以及出租或出售的土地，在交互式地图上优化结果，并查看包含价格、面积、地址、图像和 Spot2 链接的房产详细信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Spot2 helps users find commercial real estate in Mexico through ChatGPT. Users can search for offices, industrial warehouses, retail spaces, and land for rent or sale, refine results on an interactive map, and view property details with prices, sizes, addresses, images, and Spot2 links.
plugins.developerName: Spot2 Tecnología y Data, S.A.P.I. de C.V.

plugins.name: EventHex
plugins.productIntro: EventHex 帮助活动组织者列出和配置特许经营活动、管理门票和议程、审查注册和分析，以及通过 ChatGPT 构建和发布活动网站。
plugins.productIntroEn: EventHex helps event organizers list and configure franchise events, manage tickets and agendas, review registrations and analytics, and build and publish event websites through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Neria
plugins.productIntro: **Neria 是一位 24/7 的人工智能接待员，可以自动处理您的商务电话。**
plugins.productIntroEn: **Neria is a 24/7 AI receptionist that handles your business calls automatically.**

plugins.name: Threpoly
plugins.productIntro: Threpoly 帮助运营团队了解托管文件传输的运行状况、可用性、性能和安全性。查看当前事件、心跳和预期文件监控、SLA 和性能趋势、工作流程和容量测试、安全建议以及安全 SFTP、FTPS、HTTPS 和 AS2 贸易伙伴配置。访问权限是只读的，并且仅限于您组织的 Threpoly 数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Threpoly helps operations teams understand the health, availability, performance and security of managed file transfers. Review current incidents, heartbeat and expected-file monitoring, SLA and performance trends, workflow and capacity tests, security recommendations, and safe SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS and AS2 trading-partner configuration.

plugins.name: Shallon CSP
plugins.description: 关于 Shalon CSP 的解答
plugins.productIntro: 获取有关 Shallon CSP（Shallon Legal FZ LLC 的商业名称）的准确、可引用的答案，Shallon CSP 是一家位于阿联酋富查伊拉的法律、企业和信托服务提供商，为欧洲和国际市场的客户提供服务。 Courtyard AI 在公司的明确授权下为 Shallon CSP 运行此连接器，并自动保持其内容最新，因此答案来自公司自己发布的信息，而不是过时的第三方来源。
plugins.productIntroEn: Get accurate, citable answers about Shallon CSP (the trading name of Shallon Legal FZ LLC), a UAE-based legal, corporate, and fiduciary services provider based in Fujairah that serves clients across Europe and international markets.

plugins.name: Quilia
plugins.productIntro: Quilia 允许律师事务所用户使用来自 ChatGPT 的私人 Quilia 案件数据。用户可以使用在 Quilia 中拥有的相同访问权限来查看设置状态和公司设置、管理团队成员、位置、品牌、常见问题解答、案例类型、受众、自动化、请求模板、案例、约会、消息、请求、文档、注释、联系人、就业记录和 Quilia 帮助内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Quilia lets law firm users work with their private Quilia case data from ChatGPT. Users can review setup status and firm settings, manage team members, locations, branding, FAQs, case types, audiences, automations, request templates, cases, appointments, messages, requests, documents, notes, contacts, employment records, and Quilia help content using the same access they have in Quilia.

plugins.name: nowo Immobilien
plugins.productIntro: nowo Immobilien 是一家专门从事布伦瑞克地区业务的现代化房地产公司。该应用程序提供了一种直观的、基于位置的方式来发现、购买或出售布伦瑞克及周边地区的房产。
plugins.productIntroEn: nowo Immobilien is a modern real estate company specialising in the Braunschweig region. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in Braunschweig and the surrounding area.

plugins.name: Comuro
plugins.productIntro: Comuro 帮助房地产团队管理来自 ChatGPT 的销售线索、机会、访问、议程和对话见解。提出自然语言问题以找到合格的潜在客户、查看最近的对话、检查预定的访问并了解销售活动，而无需切换工具。
plugins.productIntroEn: Comuro helps real estate teams manage leads, opportunities, visits, agendas, and conversation insights from ChatGPT. Ask natural-language questions to find qualified leads, review recent conversations, check scheduled visits, and understand sales activity without switching tools.

plugins.name: Brava
plugins.productIntro: Brava 将企业的忠诚度计划数据连接到 ChatGPT。它可以解释访问量和记录的收入、比较位置和繁忙时段、在不暴露电话号码或电子邮件地址的情况下识别客户群体、查看过去的公告绩效，以及创建人们必须在 Brava 中查看和发送的预填充公告草稿。如果用户明确请求不支持的 Brava 功能，则可以向 Brava 产品团队记录私有功能请求；它不会执行不受支持的操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Brava connects a business's loyalty-program data to ChatGPT. It can explain visits and recorded revenue, compare locations and busy periods, identify customer cohorts without exposing phone numbers or email addresses, review past announcement performance, and create prefilled announcement drafts that a person must review and send in Brava.

plugins.name: Sales Compass by Luzmo
plugins.productIntro: Sales Compass 帮助用户询问有关授权销售数据的自然语言问题、检查可用数据集和字段，并生成基于 Sales Compass 应用程序的实时 Luzmo 图表，以展示嵌入式分析的最佳实践。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sales Compass helps users ask natural-language questions about authorized sales data, inspect available datasets and fields, and generate live Luzmo charts grounded in the Sales Compass application that demonstrate best practices in embedded analytics.

plugins.name: Popl
plugins.productIntro: Popl 帮助用户发现和丰富业务联系人、检索团队领导、检查活动和成员，以及分析来自 ChatGPT 的事件管道和投资回报率。
plugins.productIntroEn: Popl helps users discover and enrich business contacts, retrieve team leads, inspect campaigns and members, and analyze event pipeline and ROI from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Beacons
plugins.productIntro: Beacons 帮助创作者和人才经理审查业务数据、分析受众和内容、管理店面和公共页面，并通过 ChatGPT 处理品牌交易。
plugins.productIntroEn: Beacons helps creators and talent managers review business data, analyze audiences and content, manage storefronts and public pages, and work with brand deals through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Meu Rastreio
plugins.productIntro: 进行简单的物流控制的规划和调整。通过 Meu Rastreio，您可以轻松征服和组织。
plugins.productIntroEn: Diga adeus às planilhas e abrace o poder do controle logístico simplificado. Com o Meu Rastreio, você conquista agilidade e organização.

plugins.name: JUNE
plugins.productIntro: 这位JUNE代理帮助律师事务所和法律部门查找案件、文件、截止日期、约会、任务、联系人、案件事实和文件事实；创建和更新私人案件记录；并通过 ChatGPT 准备外发信件。访问权限遵循每个用户现有的 JUNE 权限和租户边界。请注意：除非您在为您的组织配置的 JUNE 租户上拥有活跃的 JUNE 帐户，否则您无法使用此插件。
plugins.productIntroEn: This JUNE agent helps law firms and legal departments find cases, documents, deadlines, appointments, tasks, contacts, case facts, and document facts; create and update private case records; and prepare outgoing correspondence through ChatGPT. Access follows each user's existing JUNE permissions and tenant boundaries.

plugins.name: Masha
plugins.description: 您的 CTV 广告系列和指标
plugins.productIntro: Masha 是一个针对 CTV、视频和展示广告的活动管理平台。连接您的 Masha 帐户，以简单的语言询问您自己的广告系列：列出它们，检查按天、设备、地理位置、时间、年龄或电子商务细分的投放和效果指标，并查看您帐户中的广告商和发布商。
plugins.productIntroEn: Masha is a campaign management platform for CTV, video and display advertising. Connect your Masha account to ask about your own campaigns in plain language: list them, check delivery and performance metrics broken down by day, device, geography, hours, age or e-commerce, and review the advertisers and publishers in your account.

plugins.name: Furgonetka
plugins.productIntro: 货车允许您直接在 ChatGPT 中检查货运数据。用户可以查看已订购或已发货的货物列表、跟踪和监控的货物列表、特定包裹的详细信息以及可用承运商的列表。该应用程序用于快速访问与 Furgonetka 用户帐户相关的货运和快递服务信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Furgonetka umożliwia sprawdzanie danych o przesyłkach bezpośrednio w ChatGPT. Użytkownik może wyświetlić listę przesyłek zamówionych lub nadanych, listę przesyłek śledzonych i monitorowanych, szczegóły konkretnej paczki oraz listę dostępnych przewoźników. Aplikacja służy do szybkiego dostępu do informacji o przesyłkach i usługach kurierskich powiązanych z kontem użytkownika w Furgonetka.

plugins.name: Stabile: Loyalty Rewards Agent
plugins.productIntro: Stabile 帮助 ChatGPT 用户检查 Shopify 商家忠诚度条款、估算购物车赚取的积分、在购物者同意的情况下查找奖励选项，并在结帐前兑换符合条件的奖励代码。
plugins.productIntroEn: Stabile helps ChatGPT users check Shopify merchant loyalty terms, estimate points earned for a cart, look up reward options with shopper consent, and redeem eligible reward codes before checkout.

plugins.name: Breakcold
plugins.productIntro: Breakcold 帮助用户查找和更新 CRM 记录、管理任务和笔记、查看收件箱对话和会议、发送消息以及通过 ChatGPT 配置授权工作流集成。
plugins.productIntroEn: Breakcold helps users find and update CRM records, manage tasks and notes, review inbox conversations and meetings, send messages, and configure authorized workflow integrations through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Gateway Tariff Calculator
plugins.description: 美国进口关税和 HTS 代码
plugins.originalDescription: US import duty and HTS codes
plugins.productIntro: 在做出承诺之前计算一下您的进口实际成本。输入 HTS 代码和原产国并获取所欠关税，包括在基本税率之上叠加的每项贸易行为：第 301 条、第 232 条、第 338 条、保障措施、AD/CVD 等，加上政府费用和到岸总额。您还可以查找产品的 HTS 分类，了解美国贸易政策的变化以及接下来生效的内容，每项都有其来源。数据来自实时的美国统一关税表和已发布的贸易行动，引用以便您可以查看。他们正在计划估算，而不是海关裁决。
plugins.productIntroEn: Calculate what your imports actually cost before you commit. Enter an HTS code and country of origin and get the duty owed, including every trade action that stacks on top of the base rate: Section 301, Section 232, Section 338, safeguards, AD/CVD and the rest, plus government fees and the landed total.

plugins.name: Cryotos
plugins.description: Cryotos CMMS SAAS 应用程序
plugins.productIntro: MCP 供维护团队连接到 Cryotos CMMS 应用程序并获取关键详细信息以进行评估。
plugins.productIntroEn: MCP for the Maintenance team to connect to the Cryotos CMMS application and fetch key details for evaluation.

plugins.name: base.com
plugins.productIntro: Base MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Base 帐户，以只读访问您的商店数据。通过 OAuth 2.1 连接后（您通过 Base 屏幕登录并同意），ChatGPT 可以检查帐户详细信息、查找订单、查看产品列表和检查库存水平 - 所有这些都无需离开对话。连接器仅读取数据；它无法创建、修改或删除您的基本帐户中的任何内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Base MCP connects ChatGPT to your Base account for read-only access to your store data. Once connected via OAuth 2.1 (with your login and consent through Base's screen), ChatGPT can check account details, look up orders, review product listings, and check inventory levels — all without leaving the conversation.

plugins.name: SearchFit
plugins.productIntro: SearchFit 跟踪品牌在人工智能助理答案中的出现情况，并帮助缩小差距。了解 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Claude 和 Google AI 是否在买家实际提出的问题中提及您的品牌，以及您与竞争对手的比较情况。从那里，生成文章并将其发布到连接的 CMS、研究关键字、审核网站是否存在技术问题，并报告 Google Search Console 和 Google Analytics 4 以及 AI 可见性。
plugins.productIntroEn: SearchFit tracks how a brand appears in AI assistant answers and helps close the gaps. See whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google AI mention your brand for the questions buyers actually ask, and how you compare with competitors.

plugins.name: Gojiberry
plugins.description: 寻找线索并开展外展活动
plugins.productIntro: Gojiberry 将您的外向销售工作流程引入 ChatGPT。通过免费屏蔽预览搜索 B2B 潜在客户和公司目录，显示完整记录，并通过经过验证的电子邮件和手机号码丰富联系人。将联系人组织到列表中，创建和管理外展活动，查看活动日志，配置潜在客户采购代理，以及阅读和回复统一收件箱中的对话 - 所有这些都通过自然语言进行。需要 Gojiberry 帐户和 app.gojiberry.ai 的 API 密钥。
plugins.productIntroEn: Gojiberry brings your outbound sales workflow into ChatGPT. Search a directory of B2B leads and companies with free masked previews, reveal full records, and enrich contacts with verified emails and mobile phone numbers.

plugins.name: Voluum
plugins.productIntro: Voluum 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 检查广告效果、管理活动和跟踪资产、导出报告以及操作集成和自动化规则。
plugins.productIntroEn: Voluum helps users inspect advertising performance, manage campaigns and tracking assets, export reports, and operate integrations and automation rules through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Faraday
plugins.productIntro: 将 AI 代理连接到您的 Faraday 帐户，以获取客户提供的人员级数据、使用 Faraday 的消费者数据、解析身份、构建受众和模型，并将人员级字段和预测传递到您的目的地。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect an AI agent to your Faraday account to ingest customer-supplied person-level data, use Faraday's consumer data, resolve identities, build audiences and models, and deliver person-level fields and predictions to your destinations.

plugins.name: Iceflower
plugins.productIntro: Iceflower 通过大型北美消费者交易小组回答了有关零售商及其客户的问题：收入和增长、商店足迹、RFM 客户群、交叉购物、保留率、本地买家资料和购物中心排名。每个工具都是只读的，并返回与 Iceflower Web 应用程序显示登录帐户相同的数字。
plugins.productIntroEn: Iceflower answers questions about retail merchants and their customers from a large North American consumer transaction panel: revenue and growth, store footprints, RFM customer segments, cross-shopping, retention, local buyer profiles, and shopping-centre rankings. Every tool is read-only and returns the same numbers the Iceflower web app shows the signed-in account.

plugins.name: upword
plugins.description: 跟踪客户 AI 引用
plugins.productIntro: upword 帮助本地服务企业被 ChatGPT、Google AI Overview 和 Perplexity 等 AI 工具引用。该应用程序为代理机构提供了一种无需离开对话即可检查工作的方法。
plugins.productIntroEn: upword helps local service businesses get cited by AI tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overview, and Perplexity. This app gives agencies a way to check on that work without leaving the conversation.

plugins.name: AuntBird Practice Management
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 AuntBird 实践管理帐户，以安全地访问您有权查看的业务信息，包括客户、业务、时间、账单、发票、付款、费用和实践报告。访问权限由您的 AuntBird 帐户、公司、角色和权限控制。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your AuntBird practice management account to securely access the business information you are authorized to view, including clients, engagements, time, billing, invoices, payments, expenses, and practice reporting. Access is controlled by your AuntBird account, firm, role, and permissions.

plugins.name: JARS LT
plugins.productIntro: JARS.LT 通过现代 REST API 以编程方式访问立陶宛公司注册处 (Registrų centras) 数据。我们的服务允许开发人员和企业将立陶宛官方公司信息快速可靠地集成到他们的应用程序中。除了搜索和详细介绍各个公司的数据外，该应用程序还提供了对立陶宛整体经济进行宏观分析的工具。
plugins.productIntroEn: JARS.LT provides programmatic access to the Lithuanian Company Registry (Registrų centras) data through a modern REST API. Our service allows developers and businesses to integrate official Lithuanian company information into their applications quickly and reliably.

plugins.name: Brief
plugins.productIntro: Brief 帮助产品团队和编码代理检索产品背景、推理策略、查找和管理决策、浏览工作区知识以及连接团队使用的工具。
plugins.productIntroEn: Brief helps product teams and coding agents retrieve product context, reason over strategy, find and manage decisions, browse workspace knowledge, and connect the tools their team uses.

plugins.name: SAMWAD
plugins.productIntro: 连接经过身份验证的 SAMWAD 工作区，以查看工作区状态、检查批准的消息模板、搜索屏蔽的联系人、估计选择加入的受众、查看汇总活动分析并查找收件箱对话。访问权限通过 OAuth 与租户绑定，并且此公开版本是只读的。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your authenticated SAMWAD workspace to review workspace status, inspect approved message templates, search masked contacts, estimate opted-in audiences, review aggregate campaign analytics and find inbox conversations. Access is tenant-bound through OAuth, and this public release is read-only.

plugins.name: Vedetta
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 Vedetta 组织以查看 HSE 观察结果和每日进度报告，获取每日、每周或每月的活动摘要，搜索批准的报告内容并评估自定义字段要求。 Vedetta 保持只读：建议的要求更改必须应用于 Vedetta。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Vedetta organization to review HSE observations and Daily Progress reports, get daily, weekly, or monthly activity summaries, search approved report content, and assess custom-field requirements. Vedetta remains read-only: suggested requirement changes must be applied in Vedetta.

plugins.name: Govly
plugins.productIntro: Govly帮助用户查找和分析政府承包机会、奖项、联系人、采购信号、地点和合同定价；管理保存的搜索和收件箱匹配；并通过 ChatGPT 在工作空间中进行协作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Govly helps users find and analyze government contracting opportunities, awards, contacts, procurement signals, places, and contract pricing; manage saved searches and inbox matches; and collaborate in workspaces through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Qualisend
plugins.description: 验证并清理电子邮件列表
plugins.productIntro: Qualisend 会验证电子邮件地址并清理列表，以便您的邮件到达真实的收件箱并保持较低的退回率。要求它检查单个地址、批次或整个列表 - 您会得到每个地址的明确可交付/有风险/无法交付/未知的判决，以及拼写错误建议和一次性地址和角色地址检测。
plugins.productIntroEn: Qualisend verifies email addresses and cleans lists so your messages reach real inboxes and bounces stay low. Ask it to check a single address, a batch, or a whole list — you get a clear deliverable / risky / undeliverable / unknown verdict for each, with typo suggestions and disposable- and role-address detection.

plugins.name: HAVN AI Real Estate
plugins.description: 顶级 AI 支持的 Open House CRM
plugins.originalDescription: Top AI Powered Open House CRM
plugins.productIntro: HAVN 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的房地产工作区。 借助 HAVN，代理商和团队可以向 ChatGPT 请求有关房产、开放日、联系人、销售线索、任务、媒体、分析和卖家报告的范围内的、许可感知的帮助。 ChatGPT 可以查找相关的 HAVN 记录、总结活动、准备卖家更新、显示房产照片和文件，并在您明确要求时帮助创建或更新支持的记录。 访问权限遵循您的 HAVN 角色和机构权限，因此用户只能查看允许他们使用的数据并对其进行操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: HAVN connects ChatGPT to your real estate workspace. With HAVN, agents and teams can ask ChatGPT for scoped, permission-aware help with properties, open houses, contacts, leads, tasks, media, analytics, and seller reports.

plugins.name: Icebreaker
plugins.productIntro: 无论您是在招聘、销售还是寻找人才，每个人都知道最好的机会来自于利用您现有的网络。
plugins.productIntroEn: Whether you're hiring, selling, or searching, everyone knows that the best opportunities come from leveraging your existing network.

plugins.name: First FMCG
plugins.productIntro: First FMCG 是快速消费品（食品、饮料、零食、家居用品、个人护理品等）的 B2B 批发市场。买家可以搜索供应商的实时库存报价，比较标准化的单件价格，查看报价详细信息，并发送采购请求——供应商身份在接受之前保持匿名。供应商可以直接通过聊天发布和管理自己的报价，包括粘贴的价目表。 0% 佣金，直接联系供应商。
plugins.productIntroEn: First FMCG is a B2B wholesale marketplace for fast-moving consumer goods (food, drinks, snacks, household, personal care and more). Buyers can search live stock offers across suppliers, compare normalized per-piece prices, view offer details, and send purchase requests — supplier identities stay anonymous until they accept.

plugins.name: Jobber
plugins.productIntro: 将您的 Jobber 业务背景引入 ChatGPT。获取答案并针对您的客户、报价、工作、发票和时间表采取行动。用它来查看需要您注意的事项，检查谁欠您钱，计划即将进行的工作，或将客户电子邮件转变为可供审核的报价。在做出更改之前审查并批准更改。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring your Jobber business context into ChatGPT. Get answers and take action across your clients, quotes, jobs, invoices, and schedule. Use it to see what needs your attention, check who owes you money, plan upcoming work, or turn a customer email into a ready-to-review quote. Review and approve changes before they’re made.

plugins.name: Baukosten-Cockpit
plugins.productIntro: Baukosten-Cockpit 帮助房主和项目利益相关者直接在 ChatGPT 中查看和管理建筑项目、成本预测、估算、报价、付款和相关文档。
plugins.productIntroEn: Baukosten-Cockpit helps homeowners and project stakeholders view and manage construction projects, cost forecasts, estimates, offers, payments, and related documents directly in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Simmie
plugins.description: 构建 AI 销售模拟
plugins.productIntro: Simmie MCP 让 ChatGPT 将其对您业务的已知信息以及您提供的任何数据或材料转化为为您的团队定制的销售培训模拟。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Simmie MCP lets ChatGPT turn what it already knows about your business—and any data or materials you provide—into customized sales training simulations for your team.

plugins.name: Syntheia
plugins.productIntro: Syntheia 将律师每天做的两件事引入 ChatGPT。
plugins.productIntroEn: Syntheia brings two things lawyers do every day into ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Worke
plugins.productIntro: Worke 帮助经过身份验证的用户在公司工作空间中查找和检查联系人、查询、合同、资产和贷款、日历事件、出勤状态和购买配对数据，并在一次通话中回答分析问题：合同的执行情况（商定价格、发票、按种类列出的成本、利润）、公司与客户的关系、销售人员在一段时间内的表现以及查询渠道如何转换。每个工具都是只读的，结果受到每个用户现有 Worke 权限的限制。
plugins.productIntroEn: Worke helps authenticated users find and inspect contacts, inquiries, contracts, assets and loans, calendar events, attendance status and purchase-pairing data from their company workspace, and answers analysis questions in one call: how a contract is doing (agreed price, invoiced, costs by kind, margin), what the company has with a customer, how a salesperson performs over a period, and…

plugins.name: ecoExperten Energieausweis
plugins.productIntro: ecoExperten-Connector 将德国能源证书带入人工智能聊天中。任何想要合法租赁或出售住宅物业的人都需要能源证书 - 使用此应用程序，您可以在对话中完全订购它：
plugins.productIntroEn: Der ecoExperten-Connector bringt den deutschen Energieausweis in den KI-Chat. Wer eine Wohnimmobilie vermieten oder verkaufen will, braucht gesetzlich einen Energieausweis — mit dieser App lässt er sich vollständig im Gespräch bestellen:

plugins.name: Events Match
plugins.description: 查找符合您目标的活动
plugins.productIntro: Events Match 帮助创始人、创作者、营销人员、投资者和成长专业人士找到适合他们目标的活动。 告诉它您的角色、行业、地点、舞台、预算和期望的结果，以获得精心策划的活动建议、每场比赛的明确原因、官方活动链接和实用的准备计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: Events Match helps founders, creators, marketers, investors, and growth professionals find events suited to their goals. Tell it your role, industry, location, stage, budget and desired outcome to receive curated event recommendations, clear reasons for each match, official event links and a practical preparation plan.

plugins.name: Gastrosync
plugins.productIntro: Gastrosync 帮助餐饮和酒店团队将查询转化为事件，管理客户、产品、装箱单、操作细节、报价、协议、发票和报告，并安全地维护批准的产品库数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Gastrosync helps catering and hospitality teams turn inquiries into events, manage clients, products, packing lists, operational details, offers, agreements, invoices, and reporting, and safely maintain approved product-library data.

plugins.name: Beentry
plugins.productIntro: Beentry 将您的养蜂记录连接到 ChatGPT。用简单的语言询问您的养蜂场、蜂巢、检查、蜂后、任务、蜂蜜收成、财务和附近疾病警报，并通过聊天记录新的检查、任务或收成。每项更改都会在发生之前得到确认，删除是可逆的，并且助手只能看到您自己登录的 Beentry 帐户中的数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Beentry connects your beekeeping records to ChatGPT. Ask about your apiaries, hives, inspections, queens, tasks, honey harvests, finances and nearby-disease alerts in plain language — and log new inspections, tasks or harvests just by chatting.

plugins.name: Specter
plugins.description: 用于寻找交易的 B2B 数据
plugins.productIntro: Spectre 是一个 B2B 情报平台，可帮助投资专业人士研究公司、投资者和人员，以进行尽职调查、交易搜寻、投资组合监控、竞争分析和关系映射。通过 ChatGPT，您可以从名称、域名、电子邮件或 LinkedIn URL 解析公司或个人，在公司、投资者、融资轮次、收购和 IPO 之间运行自然语言发现搜索，并提取包含融资历史、估值、收入估算、竞争格局以及人才或投资者兴趣信号的深入资料。
plugins.productIntroEn: Specter is a B2B intelligence platform that helps investment professionals research companies, investors, and people for due diligence, deal sourcing, portfolio monitoring, competitive analysis, and relationship mapping.

plugins.name: Pace
plugins.productIntro: Pace 是销售渠道的上下文层。它根据您的 CRM、电子邮件和通话录音预先计算交易情报，然后将其作为每笔交易的实时结构化上下文提供给您的人工智能助手。询问账户的实际情况，获取有证据支持的人工智能风险和预测评估，捕捉已经平静的交易，并准确了解您的团队将在哪里落地。不再需要通过 Salesforce 或 HubSpot 进行挖掘，不再需要猜测。
plugins.productIntroEn: Pace is the context layer for your sales pipeline. It pre-computes deal intelligence from your CRM, emails, and call recordings, then serves it to your AI assistant as live, structured context on every deal.

plugins.name: 1Social
plugins.productIntro: 通过一条消息发布到 Instagram、TikTok、LinkedIn、X (Twitter)、Facebook、Threads 和 Bluesky。 1Social 使每个标题都符合网络的限制，在网络需要图像时发出警告，并最多提前 30 天安排发布。
plugins.productIntroEn: Post to Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Facebook, Threads and Bluesky from a single message. 1Social fits each caption to the network's limit, warns when a network needs an image, and schedules posts up to 30 days ahead.

plugins.name: Tolstoy
plugins.productIntro: Tolstoy 将您的电子商务内容工作流程引入 ChatGPT。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tolstoy brings your ecommerce content workflow into ChatGPT.

plugins.name: VerticalResponse
plugins.description: 联系人、列表和电子邮件
plugins.productIntro: VerticalResponse 帮助用户搜索联系人、检查联系人详细信息、管理联系人列表、随机抽样联系人、导出清理后的联系人数据、创建和更新草稿电子邮件活动、发送测试电子邮件、启动或安排活动并明确确认，以及从 ChatGPT 审查电子邮件活动绩效。该应用程序支持确定性 OAuth 审核演示帐户，对联系人和活动字段使用显式验证的输入，从不公开凭据或原始 API 响应，并且不为活动、联系人或列表实现删除工具。
plugins.productIntroEn: VerticalResponse helps users search contacts, inspect contact details, manage contact lists, sample random contacts, export sanitized contact data, create and update draft email campaigns, send test emails, launch or schedule campaigns with explicit confirmation, and review email campaign performance from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Trooth Network
plugins.productIntro: Trooth 是软件经济的信任网络。该连接器允许 ChatGPT 对话中的任何人在 Trooth 上查找公司当前的、见证的记录，涵盖九个类别，从身份和安全到隐私、人工智能实践和历史，每个类别都有其来源和上次阅读的日期。在依赖一家公司之前先阅读它，在购买之前比较同一类别的两个供应商，对域的公共安全表面进行实时中立的阅读，验证签名的 Trust Ledger 令牌，或者询问 Trooth 的工作原理。公司还可以查询自己的记录，看看买家看到了什么。
plugins.productIntroEn: Trooth is the trust network for the software economy. This connector lets anyone in a ChatGPT conversation look up a company's current, witnessed record on Trooth across nine categories, from identity and security to privacy, AI practices, and history, each with its source and the date it was last read.

plugins.name: EZFlow Pro
plugins.productIntro: EZFlow Pro 将您的承包业务连接到 ChatGPT。询问您的客户、工作、日程安排和资金（未清发票、逾期余额、胜率）并以草稿形式创建估算和发票。在聊天中创建的每个文档都将保留为草稿，直到您审阅并从 EZFlow Pro 发送该文档为止，因此，未经您的签字，客户将无法收到任何文档。新来的？尝试内置的演示工作区 - 无需帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: EZFlow Pro connects your contracting business to ChatGPT. Ask about your customers, jobs, schedule, and money — outstanding invoices, overdue balances, win rates — and create estimates and invoices as drafts. Every document created in chat stays a draft until you review and send it from EZFlow Pro, so nothing reaches a customer without your sign-off.

plugins.name: DiligenceSquared
plugins.productIntro: 访问 DiligenceSquared 市场和商业尽职调查研究。以自然语言搜索项目的采访，提取具有指定专家属性的逐字引用，并检索平台上任何参与的报告部分和基础数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Access DiligenceSquared market and commercial due diligence research. Search across a project's interviews in natural language, pull verbatim quotes with named expert attribution, and retrieve report sections and underlying data for any engagement on the platform.

plugins.name: Conversion
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Conversion 营销数据平台，以检查 CRM 联系人、构建电子邮件、受众、表单和活动、诊断联系人未收到电子邮件或进入工作流程的原因，以及审核与 Salesforce 和其他连接系统的同步失败。只读工具涵盖联系人、机会、活动、表单、工作流程、同步日志和电子邮件性能指标。编写工具可在用户经过身份验证的转换工作区中创建群发电子邮件、受众、营销活动、文件夹、联系人和 CSV 导入。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to the Conversion marketing data platform to inspect CRM contacts, build emails, audiences, forms, and campaigns, diagnose why a contact did not receive an email or enter a workflow, and audit sync failures with Salesforce and other connected systems. Read-only tools cover contacts, opportunities, campaigns, forms, workflows, sync logs, and email performance metrics.

plugins.name: Kreel
plugins.productIntro: Kreel 将 ChatGPT 连接到来自 Shopify、Klaviyo、Meta Ads 和 Google Ads 的标准化电子商务绩效数据。用户询问其关联品牌的收入、ROAS、营销活动、创意、电子邮件性能和异常情况，保留持久的品牌知识库，并根据要求发布托管报告。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kreel connects ChatGPT to normalized ecommerce performance data from Shopify, Klaviyo, Meta Ads, and Google Ads. Users ask about revenue, ROAS, campaigns, creatives, email performance, and anomalies across their connected brands, keep a durable brand knowledge base, and publish hosted reports on request.

plugins.name: Yolando
plugins.description: 跟踪您的 AI 可见性
plugins.productIntro: Yolando 发现新兴趋势，将各个点联系起来，并在市场（或您的竞争对手）看到它到来之前采取行动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Yolando spots emerging trends, connects the dots, and moves before the market – or your competitors – see it coming.

plugins.name: Clozd
plugins.productIntro: Clozd 的 MCP 使收入领导者、销售人员和产品团队能够直接访问 ChatGPT 内的输赢决策情报。以自然语言查询交易结果、竞争洞察和买家反馈 — 由 Clozd 程序已捕获的访谈和数据提供支持
plugins.productIntroEn: Clozd’s MCP gives revenue leaders, sellers, and product teams direct access to win-loss decision intelligence inside ChatGPT. Query deal outcomes, competitive insights, and buyer feedback in natural language — powered by the interviews and data your Clozd program already captures

plugins.name: Sellergoo
plugins.productIntro: Sellergoo 是为在线卖家提供的利润和运营分析服务。您连接已通过销售的商店、市场、支付和会计帐户，Sellergoo 会将订单、费用、退款、商品成本、广告和管理费用汇总在一起，计算出您实际赚取的收入 - 每个渠道、每个产品、每个订单。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sellergoo is a profit-and-operations analytics service for online sellers. You connect the shops, marketplaces, payment and accounting accounts you already sell through, and Sellergoo brings the orders, fees, refunds, cost of goods, advertising and overhead together to work out what you actually earned — per channel, per product, per order.

plugins.name: SourceFlag
plugins.productIntro: SourceFlag 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 扫描直接公共 RFP PDF URL，并接收有限准备情况预览，其中包含截止日期信号、强制性事件信号、附录和问答风险、缺失文档警告、出价/无出价阻止程序以及示例合规性矩阵行。
plugins.productIntroEn: SourceFlag helps users scan direct public RFP PDF URLs from ChatGPT and receive a bounded readiness preview with deadline signals, mandatory event signals, addenda and Q&A risk, missing-document warnings, bid/no-bid blockers, and sample compliance-matrix rows.

plugins.name: Clootrack
plugins.description: 从 VoC 获取消费者洞察
plugins.productIntro: Clootrack 的 Genie 让您可以在 ChatGPT 中以简单的语言探索客户体验数据。询问您的评论、支持票、调查和社交数据中的观点、主题、品牌和产品反馈以及投诉，并根据您自己的来源获得答案，并根据要求提供逐字客户报价（引文）。专为需要从大量非结构化反馈中获得决策洞察力的 CX、产品和营销团队而打造。没有技术设置。
plugins.productIntroEn: Clootrack's Genie lets you explore your customer-experience data in plain language inside ChatGPT. Ask about sentiment, themes, brand and product feedback, and complaints across your reviews, support tickets, surveys and social data and get answers grounded in your own sources, with verbatim customer quotes (citations) on request.

plugins.name: PKB Immobilien
plugins.description: 房地产鲍纳塔尔和卡塞尔
plugins.productIntro: PKB Immobilien 是一家专注于当地的房地产公司，专注于鲍纳塔尔、卡塞尔、卡塞尔区和施瓦尔姆-埃德尔区。该应用程序提供了一种直观的、基于位置的方式来发现、购买或出售整个地区的房产。
plugins.productIntroEn: PKB Immobilien is a locally focused real estate company specializing in Baunatal, Kassel, the Kassel district, and the Schwalm-Eder district. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties throughout the region.

plugins.name: Delivra
plugins.productIntro: 连接 Delivra 帐户，直接在 ChatGPT 中探索电子邮件和短信活动绩效、订阅者活动、参与度指标、热门域名和民意调查结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect a Delivra account to explore email and SMS campaign performance, subscriber activity, engagement metrics, top domains, and poll results directly in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Umamy
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中查询您的 Umamy 招聘渠道。列出活跃的搜寻、查找候选人及其适合度分数、阅读完整的 LinkedIn 消息线程、访问团队笔记以及在整个工作空间中进行管道分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: Query your Umamy recruitment pipeline directly in ChatGPT. List active hunts, look up candidates and their fit scores, read full LinkedIn message threads, access team notes, and pull pipeline analytics across your workspace.

plugins.name: Trussi AI
plugins.productIntro: Trussi AI 将您的 Trussi Roofing CRM 连接到 ChatGPT，以便您的团队可以用简单的语言运行业务。
plugins.productIntroEn: Trussi AI connects your Trussi roofing CRM to ChatGPT so your team can run the business in plain language.

plugins.name: GadgetOS
plugins.productIntro: GadgetOS 是一家孟加拉国手机、笔记本电脑和电子产品商店运行的零售管理系统 — 销售点、按 IMEI 和序列号列出的库存、保修和维修台、供应商以及符合增值税的收据。该连接器为商店的老板和员工提供了一种简单的语言方式来了解他们自己的实时记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: GadgetOS is the retail-management system a Bangladeshi phone, laptop and electronics shop runs on — point of sale, stock by IMEI and serial number, a warranty and repair desk, suppliers, and VAT-compliant receipts. This connector gives the owner and staff of one shop a plain-language way into their own live records.

plugins.name: Gleap
plugins.productIntro: Gleap 将您的客户支持工作区带入 ChatGPT。搜索和分类票证、查找联系人和公司、回复客户或添加内部注释、使您的帮助中心保持最新状态，以及在不离开对话的情况下检查支持指标。
plugins.productIntroEn: Gleap brings your customer support workspace into ChatGPT. Search and triage tickets, look up contacts and companies, reply to customers or add an internal note, keep your help center up to date, and check support metrics without leaving the conversation.

plugins.name: MailSenpai
plugins.productIntro: 借助此应用程序，您可以更快速、更轻松地咨询您的营销活动、创建新的通信、安排交付、读取统计数据以及处理您的帐户数据。 ChatGPT 可以帮助您将简单的请求转化为操作操作，例如准备活动、检查交付状态或分析绩效。
plugins.productIntroEn: With this app, you can consult your campaigns, create new communications, schedule deliveries, read statistics, and work with your account data more quickly and easily. ChatGPT can help you transform simple requests into operational actions, such as preparing a campaign, checking the status of a delivery, or analyzing performance.

plugins.name: MimikFlow
plugins.productIntro: MimikFlow 帮助现有客户通过 AI 助手启动和管理自动化 B2B 勘探。他们可以审查结果和对话、处理草稿和升级、调整营销活动设置以及添加选定的潜在客户，同时 MimikFlow 保留帐户的计划、权限和外展安全限制。
plugins.productIntroEn: MimikFlow helps existing customers launch and manage automated B2B prospecting from their AI assistant. They can review results and conversations, handle drafts and escalations, adjust campaign settings, and add selected prospects while MimikFlow preserves the account's plan, permissions, and outreach safety limits.

plugins.name: Forj
plugins.description: 通过 ChatGPT 运营您的健身房
plugins.productIntro: Forj 帮助健身房会员、教练和业主发现健身房和课程、管理预订和锻炼、审查进度、运营日程和比赛、管理编程和自动化，并通过 ChatGPT 执行确认的会员、消息传递和计费工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Forj helps gym members, coaches, and owners discover gyms and classes, manage bookings and workouts, review progress, operate schedules and competitions, manage programming and automations, and perform confirmed member, messaging, and billing workflows through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Spinify
plugins.productIntro: Spinify 将您的销售竞争数据直接导入 ChatGPT。询问您当前的排名，查看任何活跃比赛的实时排行榜，并准确了解您的表现趋势 - 所有这些都无需离开聊天室。
plugins.productIntroEn: Spinify brings your sales competition data directly into ChatGPT. Ask for your current standings, see a live leaderboard for any active competition, and understand exactly how your performance is trending — all without leaving the chat.

plugins.name: Windsor.ai GBP
plugins.description: 加载 Google 商家资料
plugins.productIntro: Windsor.ai Google Business Profile 将您的 Google Business Profile 数据连接到您的 AI 助手，以便您可以分析本地表现并用简单的英语管理您的列表。发现连接的位置，检查有效字段和选项，以及查询视图、搜索、呼叫、指示请求以及查看任何日期范围内的指标。确认后，它还可以发布或更新帖子、回复评论、上传照片、更新业务信息以及设置常规、特殊或开放和关闭时间。
plugins.productIntroEn: Windsor.ai Google Business Profile connects your Google Business Profile data to your AI assistant, so you can analyze local performance and manage your listing in plain English. Discover connected locations, inspect valid fields and options, and query views, searches, calls, direction requests, and review metrics over any date range.

plugins.name: Pepper Cloud
plugins.description: 读取和管理 CRM 记录
plugins.productIntro: 直接在聊天中使用您的 Pepper Cloud CRM 数据。跨模块查询和更新记录，例如联系人和机会，根据它们记录注释和任务，检查工单状态和详细信息，并查看报价。提取对话摘要和情绪见解，所有这些都基于您的实际 Pepper Cloud 数据。了解更多：https://blog.peppercloud.com/pepper-cloud-assistai-for-chatgpt/
plugins.productIntroEn: Work with your Pepper Cloud CRM data directly in chat. Query and update records across modules like contacts and opportunities, log notes and tasks against them, check ticket status and details, and review quotations. Pull conversation summaries and sentiment insights, all grounded in your actual Pepper Cloud data. Learn more: https://blog.peppercloud.

plugins.name: Pierview
plugins.productIntro: Pierview 帮助用户跟踪并提高其品牌在 ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity、Deepseek 和 Grok 等人工智能搜索平台上的知名度。通过这个应用程序，用户可以提取提及率、排名和声音份额指标，查看哪些域和页面引用了他们的品牌，比较竞争对手的可见度和情绪，查看人工智能助手发送的流量，检查技术人工智能-SEO审核结果，阅读和更新他们的品牌工具包指南，并生成任何日期范围的叙述性绩效报告。
plugins.productIntroEn: Pierview helps users track and improve their brand's visibility across AI search platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Deepseek, and Grok. Through this app, users can pull mention rate, ranking, and share-of-voice metrics, see which domains and pages are citing their brand, compare visibility and sentiment against competitors, review traffic sent by AI assistants, check technica…

plugins.name: Teamspective
plugins.productIntro: Teamspective 是一个领导力支持平台，可帮助领导者通过参与度调查、反馈和协作见解了解其团队。此应用程序使 ChatGPT 能够访问您的 Teamspective 工作区数据，提供以下方面的个性化见解：
plugins.productIntroEn: Teamspective is a Leadership Enablement Platform that helps leaders understand their teams through engagement surveys, feedback, and collaboration insights. This app enables ChatGPT to access your Teamspective workspace data, providing personalized insights about:

plugins.name: Coconut
plugins.productIntro: Coconut for ChatGPT 将您的 Coconut 工作区连接到 ChatGPT，以便您可以检查团队的 AI 代理、审查工作并让任务从您已参与的对话中转移。使用安全的、OAuth 范围的 MCP 工具查看活动的 Coconut 实例、检查运行状况、浏览任务和评论、搜索知识、读取共享上下文、监控计划的作业以及探索可用的连接器。
plugins.productIntroEn: Coconut for ChatGPT connects your Coconut workspace to ChatGPT, so you can check on your team's AI agents, review work, and keep tasks moving from the conversation you're already in. Use secure, OAuth-scoped MCP tools to view active Coconut instances, check health, browse tasks and comments, search knowledge, read shared context, monitor scheduled jobs, and explore available connectors.

plugins.name: Cooperly
plugins.productIntro: 库珀利帮助创始人、团队领导和人员领导者在小问题开始减缓执行之前了解不断发展的团队内部到底发生了什么。 它将团队资料、运营状况检查、每周脉冲信号、目标、招聘背景和团队笔记联系起来，然后将这些背景转化为实际的后续步骤。 在 ChatGPT 中使用 Cooperly 来准备更好的 1:1，发现团队瓶颈，了解压力在哪里，改善团队操作习惯，并检查候选人是否适合您已有的团队。
plugins.productIntroEn: Cooperly helps founders, team leads, and people leaders see what is really happening inside a growing team before small people problems start slowing execution. It connects team profiles, operating health checks, weekly Pulse signals, goals, hiring context, and team notes, and then turns that context into practical next steps.

plugins.name: LegisGraph
plugins.productIntro: 我们提供图形驱动的基础设施，用于以编程方式访问欧盟、意大利和地区立法和判例的相互关联的法律语料库，并具有精确的时间版本控制。我们帮助代理将先进的语义搜索、语言分析和实时立法监控集成到高精度的法律技术和研究应用中。
plugins.productIntroEn: We provide a graph-powered infrastructure for programmatic access to an interconnected legal corpus of EU, Italian and Regional legislation and jurisprudence with precise temporal versioning. We empower agents integrating advanced semantic search, linguistic analytics, and real-time legislative monitoring into high-precision legal-tech and research applications.

plugins.name: Kinevo
plugins.description: 通过人工智能管理您的学生
plugins.productIntro: Kinevo 通过 ChatGPT 直接将私人教练与您的业务的全面管理联系起来。管理学生、创建培训计划、规定练习、跟踪进度、发送消息和监控收入——所有这些都通过自然语言进行。 27 种工具可帮助您实现私人教练日常工作的自动化。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kinevo conecta personal trainers à gestão completa do seu negócio direto pelo ChatGPT. Gerencie alunos, crie programas de treino, prescreva exercícios, acompanhe progresso, envie mensagens e monitore receita — tudo por linguagem natural. 27 ferramentas disponíveis para automatizar sua rotina como personal trainer.

plugins.name: Monask
plugins.productIntro: Monask 帮助用户检查来自经过身份验证的组织的只读 ERP 数据，包括库存、批次、销售订单、批发销售、采购、客户、供应商、仓库、促销、税务发票、交易报表和会计结账。
plugins.productIntroEn: Monask helps users inspect read-only ERP data from their authenticated organization, including inventory, lots, sales orders, wholesale sales, purchases, customers, vendors, warehouses, promotions, tax invoices, transaction statements, and accounting closings.

plugins.name: CampusThreads
plugins.productIntro: CampusThreads 帮助组织管理员运行大使计划：审查操作、协调活动和轮班、管理任务和资源、与大使和潜在客户沟通以及配置他们的工作空间。
plugins.productIntroEn: CampusThreads helps organization administrators run ambassador programs: review operations, coordinate events and shifts, manage tasks and resources, communicate with ambassadors and prospects, and configure their workspace.

plugins.name: JobPhoning
plugins.productIntro: JobPhoning MCP 以只读关键数据 (KPI)、任务、远程操作员、呼叫状态和 JobPhoning 平台的活动时间表（为订单提供者和远程操作员进行外包电话勘探）的形式显示。
plugins.productIntroEn: Le MCP JobPhoning expose en lecture seule les chiffres clés (KPIs), missions, téléopérateurs, états d'appel et timeline d'activité de la plateforme JobPhoning — prospection téléphonique externalisée pour Donneurs d'Ordres et Téléopérateurs.

plugins.name: GETWAB Federal Procurement AI
plugins.productIntro: GETWAB 是一个由人工智能驱动的联邦采购和捕获情报平台，专为联邦承包商、捕获团队和 GovCon 顾问而构建。用简单的英语提出问题，寻找并确定最合适的机会，评估投标/不投标决策、研究机构和市场，识别现任者和竞争对手，并分析历史奖项、分包合同、实体和排除。继续在 GETWAB 平台中进行研究，探索潜在记录、比较市场并制定更深入的捕获策略。
plugins.productIntroEn: GETWAB is an AI-powered federal procurement and capture intelligence platform built for federal contractors, capture teams, and GovCon advisors. Ask questions in plain English to find and qualify best-fit opportunities, assess bid/no-bid decisions, research agencies and markets, identify incumbents and competitors, and analyze historical awards, subcontracts, entities, and exclusions.

plugins.name: Energy-Data.io Degree Days
plugins.productIntro: 获取任何位置的供暖和制冷度日 (HDD/CDD) 以及室外温度、基础温度和日期范围 - 直接在聊天中获取，无需电子表格或手动查找。 专为需要快速标准化能源数据的能源经理、顾问和审计员而设计。按城市或坐标询问度日或温度数据，设置您自己的基础温度，并获得可以直接放入节省计算或 M&V 报告中的干净数字。 由 Energy-Data.io 的天气数据引擎提供支持——与专业能源标准化所使用的来源相同。
plugins.productIntroEn: Get heating and cooling degree days (HDD/CDD) and outside temperatures for any location, base temperature, and date range — straight in chat, no spreadsheets or manual lookups. Built for energy managers, consultants, and auditors who need to weather-normalize energy data fast.

plugins.name: Spott
plugins.productIntro: Spott 帮助招聘团队通过 ChatGPT 查找和管理候选人、公司、工作、申请、面试、任务、笔记、外展和安置。
plugins.productIntroEn: Spott helps recruiting teams find and manage candidates, companies, jobs, applications, interviews, tasks, notes, outreach, and placements through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: mydeetz
plugins.productIntro: 在 mydeetz 上与企业分享您的联系方式。查找公司以了解他们需要哪些信息，然后直接与他们分享您的姓名、电子邮件和其他详细信息，而无需离开 ChatGPT。您还可以保存您的个人资料，以便在联系其他企业时预先填写您的详细信息。系统会向企业发送一封电子邮件通知，其中包含您的共享信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Share your contact details with businesses on mydeetz. Look up a company to see what information they need, then share your name, email, and other details directly with them without leaving ChatGPT. You can also save your profile so your details are pre-filled when contacting other businesses. An email notification is sent to the business with your shared information.

plugins.name: Faida Load Check
plugins.productIntro: Faida 帮助业主运营商和小型承运商对装载报价进行健全检查，并在提交之前延迟索赔。输入车道、里程、报价、燃油、工时、准备情况、经纪人信任或滞留事实； Faida 返回基于成本的指导、警告和简洁的经纪人措辞。它是一个决策辅助工具，而不是负载板或文书工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Faida helps owner-operators and small carriers sanity-check load offers and delay claims before they commit. Enter lane, mileage, offer, fuel, hours, readiness, broker trust, or detention facts; Faida returns cost-based guidance, caveats, and concise broker wording. It is a decision aid, not a load board or paperwork intake.

plugins.name: HomePins
plugins.productIntro: 搜索班加罗尔 6,800 多套经过 RERA 验证的新推出公寓。获取实时定价、拥有时间表、建筑商跟踪记录、预订速度以及到 IT 中心的通勤距离。预订现场访问或直接请求回电。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search 6,800+ RERA-verified new launch apartments in Bangalore. Get live pricing, possession timelines, builder track records, booking velocity, and commute distances to IT hubs. Book site visits or request callbacks directly.

plugins.name: Bark AI
plugins.productIntro: Bark AI 允许 DTC 和电子商务运营商以简单的英语询问商店的数据——销售、客户、受众、活动、细分——并在不离开聊天的情况下根据答案采取行动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bark AI lets DTC and e-commerce operators ask their store's data in plain English — sales, customers, audiences, campaigns, segments — and act on the answer without leaving chat.

plugins.name: FieldCamp
plugins.description: 人工智能现场服务软件
plugins.productIntro: FieldCamp 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的现场服务业务。 查找客户和工作历史记录、检查日程安排和技术人员可用性、创建和更新工作、建立估算和发票、记录付款以及跟踪库存——所有这些都通过对话进行。询问诸如“明天的日程安排是什么？”、“哪些发票逾期了？”或“下周二上午 10 点为客户创建工作”等问题。需要 FieldCamp 帐户；每个操作都尊重您帐户的角色和权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: FieldCamp connects ChatGPT to your field service business. Look up clients and job history, check schedules and technician availability, create and update jobs, build estimates and invoices, record payments, and track inventory — all from a conversation. Ask things like "What's on tomorrow's schedule?", "Which invoices are overdue?", or "Create a job for a client next Tuesday at 10am.

plugins.name: Magnus
plugins.productIntro: Magnus 是一个面向移动和网络应用程序发行商的分析平台。它将来自广告网络、订阅和应用内收入、广告网络货币化、支付提供商结果和第一方产品分析事件的营销支出聚合到一个地方，因此发布商可以询问广告系列、应用程序或实验的实际执行情况。
plugins.productIntroEn: Magnus is an analytics platform for mobile and web app publishers. It aggregates marketing spend from ad networks, subscription and in-app revenue, ad-network monetization, payment-provider outcomes and first-party product-analytics events into one place, so a publisher can ask how a campaign, an app or an experiment is actually performing.

plugins.name: growthroles
plugins.productIntro: Growthroles 跟踪发布这些职位的公司中的每一个开放的营销和增长职位，每晚都会重新检查，以便将封闭的工作删除而不是浪费在您身上。它增加了任何一个招聘委员会都没有的内容：雇主规定的数千个职位的薪酬、整个市场上通过样本大小和日期衡量的薪酬基准，以及每个职位的书面阅读。用简单的语言询问，根据您自己的简历对职位进行排名，并跟踪您申请的职位。
plugins.productIntroEn: growthroles tracks every open marketing and growth role across the companies that publish them, rechecked every night so a closed job is removed rather than wasted on you. It adds what no single job board has: employer-stated pay on thousands of roles, salary benchmarks measured across the whole market with sample sizes and dates, and a written read on each role.

plugins.name: Dobby Ads
plugins.productIntro: Dobby Ads 客户端将您的 DobbyAds 工作区连接到 ChatGPT，以便您可以通过对话管理您的广告运营。查找订单并跟踪其状态、审查可交付成果、检查和过滤发票、管理品牌分配和团队成员以及发送消息 - 所有这些都无需离开聊天室。专为希望以简单语言与其工作空间进行交互而不是手动导航平台的 DobbyAds 客户和代理团队而构建。
plugins.productIntroEn: Dobby Ads Client connects your DobbyAds workspace to ChatGPT so you can manage your advertising operations through conversation. Look up orders and track their status, review deliverables, check and filter invoices, manage brand assignments and team members, and send messages — all without leaving the chat.

plugins.name: Social Bee by HYVE
plugins.productIntro: Social Bee 帮助注册团队规划、创建、审查、安排、发布和衡量品牌范围内的社交内容，同时尊重每个用户的租户、品牌、角色、计划、品牌套件和关联帐户权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: Social Bee helps registered teams plan, create, review, schedule, publish, and measure brand-scoped social content while respecting each user's tenant, brand, role, plan, Brand Kit, and connected-account permissions.

plugins.name: HelpYouSponsor
plugins.productIntro: HelpYouSponsor 允许经过身份验证的 HYS 管理员在 ChatGPT 中的 HYS 工作区中搜索并汇总记录。该应用程序可帮助查看捐赠者、礼物、赞助、接收者、仪表板快照、注释和活动日志、保存的过滤器和保存的报告，同时保留 HYS 权限集和工作区边界。
plugins.productIntroEn: HelpYouSponsor lets authenticated HYS admins search and summarize records from their HYS workspace in ChatGPT. The app helps review donors, gifts, sponsorships, recipients, dashboard snapshots, notes and activity logs, saved filters, and saved reports while preserving HYS permission-set and workspace boundaries.

plugins.name: Meistron
plugins.productIntro: Meistron 是工艺品企业的操作软件。使用人工智能访问，公司将 ChatGPT 与其数据连接起来，并可以查询和维护订单、发票、报价、材料、工作时间和选定的设置。每个区域可设置关闭、读、写权限；外部效果单独释放。 Access 不会触发发送任何信件，不会发出银行详细信息或付款指令，也不会删除任何数据记录。通过电子邮件发送发票还需要两步确认。注册和同意是通过 OAuth 2.1 和 PKCE 完成的。
plugins.productIntroEn: Meistron ist die Betriebssoftware für Handwerksbetriebe. Über den KI-Zugang verbindet ein Betrieb ChatGPT mit seinen Daten und kann Aufträge, Rechnungen, Angebote, Material, Arbeitszeiten und ausgewählte Einstellungen abfragen und pflegen. Die Rechte sind je Bereich auf aus, lesen oder schreiben einstellbar; Außenwirkungen werden separat freigegeben.

plugins.name: SEOcrawl AI
plugins.description: SEO + AI 在聊天中的可见性
plugins.productIntro: 将您的整个 SEO 堆栈引入 ChatGPT。 SEOcrawl AI 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的实时 SEO 数据：Google Search Console 性能（点击次数、展示次数、点击率、排名）、GA4 分析（包括您从 AI 助手收到的流量）以及 SEOcrawl 的 AI 跟踪器，该跟踪器可监控您的品牌在 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 和 Perplexity 上的出现和引用情况。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring your whole SEO stack into ChatGPT. SEOcrawl AI connects ChatGPT to your live SEO data: Google Search Console performance (clicks, impressions, CTR, positions), GA4 analytics including the traffic you receive from AI assistants, and SEOcrawl's AI Tracker, which monitors how your brand appears and gets cited across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity.

plugins.name: Sponja
plugins.description: 将网络研讨会变成管道
plugins.productIntro: Sponja 将您的代表为您的特定交易准备的提案、定价、演示记录和安全文档直接连接到 ChatGPT。询问任何有关您的评估的问题，并仅从这些材料中获得答案，并且每次都会引用来源。当某些内容未涵盖时，Sponja 会告诉您而不是猜测，并提出为您的代表标记它。您还可以询问有关 Sponja 如何工作的一般问题。每个连接器都通过安全登录仅限于一位买家和一笔交易，因此您只能看到自己的材料。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sponja connects the proposal, pricing, demo recording, and security documents your rep prepared for your specific deal directly to ChatGPT. Ask anything about your evaluation and get answers drawn only from those materials, with the source cited every time. When something is not covered, Sponja tells you instead of guessing and offers to flag it for your rep.

plugins.name: Asanify
plugins.description: 管理人力资源工作流程
plugins.productIntro: Asanify 帮助用户估算雇佣成本、查找员工和出勤信息、审查待审批请求以及通过 ChatGPT 批准或拒绝请求。
plugins.productIntroEn: Asanify helps users estimate employment costs, look up employee and attendance information, review pending approval requests, and approve or reject requests through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: SmartTalks.ai
plugins.productIntro: SmartTalks 允许您从 ChatGPT 查询、编辑和分析您的 SmartTalks 工作区。查找用户、联系人、帐户、代理队列、对话历史记录、日程安排、合同和 CRM 记录；检查模板、工作流程和活动配置；并在需要保持数据干净时创建、更新或删除记录。每个操作都在您现有的 SmartTalks 登录名和权限下运行，并且只读查找与变异操作分开，因此可以在运行之前检查更改。
plugins.productIntroEn: SmartTalks lets you query, edit, and analyze your SmartTalks workspace from ChatGPT. Look up users, contacts, accounts, agent queues, conversation history, scheduling, contracts, and CRM records; inspect templates, workflows, and campaign configurations; and create, update, or delete records when you need to keep data clean.

plugins.name: Patlytics
plugins.productIntro: Patlytics 将概念级、人工智能原生专利搜索带入您的助手中：语义搜索，而不是基于关键字的搜索。用简单的散文描述一项发明，获取最相关的专利，查找任何专利的权利要求，搜索科学文献，并提取您自己组织保存的专利，所有这些都通过结构化、可预测的工具（而不是黑匣子）实现。
plugins.productIntroEn: Patlytics brings concept-level, AI-native patent search into your assistant: semantic, not keyword-based. Describe an invention in plain prose and get the most relevant patents, look up any patent's claims, search the scientific literature, and pull your own organization's saved patents, all through structured, predictable tools (not a black box).

plugins.name: Motive Admin
plugins.description: 管理您的 Motive 网站
plugins.productIntro: 该插件使 Motive 经销商客户能够直接在 ChatGPT 内管理他们的网站。
plugins.productIntroEn: The plugin enables Motive dealer customers to manage their website directly inside of ChatGPT.

plugins.name: 4Degrees - KSA
plugins.description: 在 ChatGPT 中点击您的网络
plugins.productIntro: 4Degrees 将您的关系情报和交易流引入 ChatGPT，供沙特阿拉伯地区的团队使用。用简单的英语询问您的联系人、公司和交易——“谁是我成为 Stripe 首席技术官的最温暖途径？”、“按阶段向我展示 B 轮交易”、“今天需要我注意什么？”。您还可以更新您的 CRM（添加标签、记录注释和移动交易阶段），并通过每次更改的预览和确认步骤以及一键撤消。数据由沙特阿拉伯地区提供并保留在其中。通过 OAuth 将每个队友的范围限定到您的席位已拥有的数据和权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: 4Degrees brings your relationship intelligence and deal flow into ChatGPT for teams on our Saudi Arabia region. Ask about your contacts, companies, and deals in plain English — "who's my warmest path to a CTO at Stripe?", "show me Series B deals by stage", "what needs my attention today?".

plugins.name: Inntally
plugins.productIntro: Inntally是酒吧、餐馆和酒店背后的运营平台。该插件可让您询问有关您自己场地的问题，并从现场记录而不是估计中获得答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Inntally is the operations platform behind bars, restaurants and hotels. This plugin lets you ask questions about your own venue and get answers from live records rather than estimates.

plugins.name: CedarAI Data Depot
plugins.description: 通过 Cedar 登录的 ARMS 数据
plugins.productIntro: 登录用户对 Cedar ARMS 铁路数据的只读访问权限：库存、工作订单、运单相关记录、费用、发票、报价、注释和相关查找。突变属于 ARMS UI。用户使用 Cedar 登录名进行身份验证。
plugins.productIntroEn: Read-only access to Cedar ARMS railroad data for the signed-in user: inventory, work orders, waybill-adjacent records, charges, invoices, quotes, notes, and related lookups. Mutations belong in the ARMS UI. Users authenticate with their Cedar login.

plugins.name: Arne Kellmann
plugins.productIntro: 阅读 Arne Kellmann 发布的 AI 架构咨询服务，比较参与类型并查找范围、定价和联系指南。使用源 URL 和摘录搜索已发布的文档。提供英语和德语目录。所有四项咨询服务的收费均为每小时 120 欧元（不含增值税）；范围和可用性需要单独同意。公共信息的获取是免费的。该插件不会预约、发送查询或收取付款。
plugins.productIntroEn: Read Arne Kellmann's published AI architecture consulting services, compare engagement types and find scope, pricing and contact guidance. Search published documents with source URLs and excerpts. English and German catalogs are available. All four consulting services cost EUR 120 per hour excluding VAT; scope and availability require individual agreement.

plugins.name: VybeOS
plugins.productIntro: VybeOS 将单个简介转变为完整的品牌营销活动。创建营销活动，为 Meta、TikTok、YouTube 等生成平台就绪的内容，通过编辑完善文案，并从关联的广告和社交帐户中提取真实的效果指标 - 所有这些都来自对话。
plugins.productIntroEn: VybeOS turns a single brief into complete, on-brand marketing campaigns. Create campaigns, generate platform-ready content for Meta, TikTok, YouTube and more, refine copy through edits, and pull real performance metrics from your connected ad and social accounts — all from the conversation.

plugins.name: Archive
plugins.productIntro: Archive 可帮助团队搜索工作区社交内容和创建者，检查活动、保存的视图、集合、操作和 Webhook，并通过 ChatGPT 管理这些工作区记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: Archive helps teams search workspace social content and creators, inspect campaigns, saved views, collections, operations, and webhooks, and manage those workspace records through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: webfaCeMEdia
plugins.productIntro: webfaCeMEdia 将您的 AI 助手连接到 webfaCeMEdia 平台，以便您可以用简单的语言管理您的网站、联系人、内容草稿、活动和分析。每个请求的范围仅限于您自己的组织，并针对实时平台数据运行；破坏性行为在运行之前会被明确标记。
plugins.productIntroEn: webfaCeMEdia connects your AI assistant to the webfaCeMEdia platform so you can manage your sites, contacts, content drafts, campaigns, and analytics in plain language. Each request is scoped to your own organization and runs against live platform data; destructive actions are clearly flagged before they run.

plugins.name: Chiho AI
plugins.productIntro: Chiho AI 将 ChatGPT 连接到用户的 Telegram 帐户，以便用户可以搜索和阅读对话，组织 CRM 标签、公司、任务、摘要和自动化规则，安全地预览和批准消息和群组操作，以及管理 Telegram 文件夹。
plugins.productIntroEn: Chiho AI connects ChatGPT to a user's Telegram account so they can search and read conversations, organize CRM tags, companies, tasks, summaries, and automation rules, safely preview and approve messages and group actions, and manage Telegram folders.

plugins.name: Semji
plugins.description: 规划和评分 SEO 内容
plugins.productIntro: Semji 是一个面向营销团队的内容平台。该应用程序可以访问用户已经所属的 Semji 工作区，因此可以在对话中驱动编辑管道：使用与应用程序相同的过滤器浏览内容管道，从标题和焦点关键字批量添加草稿到规划中，运行 SEO 和 GEO 关键字分析，并读取每个表面的键入建议（Google 搜索、Google AI 概述、ChatGPT）生成的内容得分。可选的人工智能起草功能是可用的，并且总是首先进入审查状态，因此在没有明确确认的情况下不会将任何内容写入草稿。
plugins.productIntroEn: Semji is a content platform for marketing teams. This app gives access to the Semji workspaces a user already belongs to, so an editorial pipeline can be driven in conversation: browse the content pipeline with the same filters as the app, add drafts to the planning in bulk from titles and focus keywords, run SEO and GEO keyword analyses, and read the resulting Content Score with typed r…

plugins.name: Famulor
plugins.productIntro: Famulor 允许用户在经过身份验证的工作区中检查现有的 AI 助手配置、保存的版本、可用模型、语言、语音和过去的对话历史记录。此只读目录配置文件无法创建或更改助理、发起呼叫、发送消息、启动营销活动、购买电话号码或打开计费流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Famulor lets users inspect existing AI assistant configurations, saved versions, available models, languages, voices, and past conversation history in their authenticated workspace. This read-only directory profile cannot create or change assistants, start calls, send messages, launch campaigns, purchase phone numbers, or open billing flows.

plugins.name: Lightmeter
plugins.productIntro: 从 ChatGPT 管理 Lightmeter 出站营销活动工作区，包括营销活动、潜在客户、电子邮件序列、营销活动创意草稿和批准、Unibox 回复、绩效分析和交付能力见解。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage Lightmeter outbound campaign workspaces from ChatGPT, including campaigns, leads, email sequences, campaign creative drafts and approvals, Unibox replies, performance analytics, and deliverability insights.

plugins.name: Zeck
plugins.description: 连接您的 Zeck.app 数据
plugins.productIntro: 此连接器将允许 Codex 或 ChatGPT 读取存储在您的 Zeck 公司中的信息。它授权使用您现有的 Zeck 用户帐户只能读取您有权查看的信息。连接后，可以读取用户的公司、各公司的Zecks列表以及已发布的Zecks内容。这允许与 Codex 或 ChatGPT 协作以获得安全许可的 Zeck 材料。
plugins.productIntroEn: This connector will allow Codex or ChatGPT to read information stored in your Zeck companies. It authorizes using your existing Zeck user account to only be able to read information you have permission to view. After connected, it can read a user's companies, the list of Zecks in each company, and the contents of published Zecks.

plugins.name: Znajdź Przetargi
plugins.productIntro: ZnajdzPrzetargi.pl 招标搜索引擎是一个可以快速方便地搜索当前招标的工具。它在波兰寻找私人招标、公开招标和公共采购机会。借助先进的过滤器，用户可以根据自己的需求精确定制结果，例如按行业、位置或合同的具体细节。
plugins.productIntroEn: The ZnajdzPrzetargi.pl tender search engine is a tool that enables quick and convenient searching of current tenders. It searches for private tenders, public tenders, and public procurement opportunities in Poland. Thanks to advanced filters, users can precisely tailor the results to their needs, for example by industry, location, or specific details of the contract.

plugins.name: Alvamitra
plugins.productIntro: Alvamitra 帮助用户搜索闭路电视产品和安全设备，根据需要查看库存、规格和产品推荐。用户还可以打开产品页面或联系 Alvamitra 订购实体设备。
plugins.productIntroEn: Alvamitra membantu pengguna mencari produk CCTV dan perangkat keamanan, melihat stok, spesifikasi, dan rekomendasi produk berdasarkan kebutuhan. Pengguna juga dapat membuka halaman produk atau menghubungi Alvamitra untuk melakukan pemesanan perangkat fisik.

plugins.name: Dukkani
plugins.productIntro: 将您的 Dukkani 商店连接到 ChatGPT，通过中央只读连接安全地探索产品、库存、订单、客户和其他允许的商店信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Dukkani store to ChatGPT to securely explore products, inventory, orders, customers, and other permitted store information through a central read-only connection.

plugins.name: Mailrith
plugins.productIntro: Mailrith 帮助用户在一个互联的工作空间中查看订阅者和电子邮件结果、准备和交付广播以及管理序列、自动化、定位和电子邮件模板。
plugins.productIntroEn: Mailrith helps users review Subscribers and email results, prepare and deliver Broadcasts, and manage Sequences, Automations, targeting, and email Templates in one connected workspace.

plugins.name: Nowlun Tracking
plugins.productIntro: Nowlun 将提单转变为实时装运视图。上传文档，或仅粘贴提单号、预订号或集装箱号，然后在聊天中获取当前状态。
plugins.productIntroEn: Nowlun turns a Bill of Lading into a live shipment view. Upload the document, or just paste a BL, booking, or container number, and get the current status back in the chat.

plugins.name: Nuboo
plugins.productIntro: Nuboo 帮助房地产顾问搜索项目和可用地块、查看地块详细信息、比较融资方案和积极促销、通过可下载的 PDF 创建房产和投资报价、管理潜在客户、安排后续活动，以及从其连接的 Nuboo 帐户查看授权销售信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Nuboo helps real estate advisors search projects and available lots, review lot details, compare financing options and active promotions, create property and investment quotes with downloadable PDFs, manage prospects, schedule follow-up events, and review authorized sales information from their connected Nuboo account.

plugins.name: Dowaba AI Configuration
plugins.description: 配置提示和常见问题解答
plugins.productIntro: 使用自然语言查看并安全配置 Dowaba 网站的系统提示、WhatsApp 响应风格和经过验证的常见问题解答。每个更改都会在您明确批准发布之前起草和预览。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use natural language to review and safely configure your Dowaba site's system prompt, WhatsApp response style, and verified FAQs. Every change is drafted and previewed before you explicitly approve publishing.

plugins.name: LoomaScale
plugins.description: 投放元广告和 Google 广告
plugins.productIntro: LoomaScale 帮助用户检查连接的 Google 和 Meta 广告帐户、审查广告系列效果和节奏、研究关键字和搜索词、创建暂停的广告系列以及管理广告系列投放和预算。激活营销活动会开始真正的广告支出；每个创建、激活和预算更改都会根据用户配置的每日支出上限进行验证。
plugins.productIntroEn: LoomaScale helps users inspect connected Google and Meta ad accounts, review campaign performance and pacing, research keywords and search terms, create paused campaigns, and manage campaign delivery and budgets. Activating a campaign starts real ad spend; every create, activation, and budget change is validated against a user-configured daily spend cap.

plugins.name: BetterMenu
plugins.description: 根据食谱构建 FDA 标签
plugins.productIntro: BetterMenu 将配方配方、营养分析和 FDA 标签保留在一个版本系统中，因此在开发结束时合规性不再是一个单独的项目。
plugins.productIntroEn: BetterMenu keeps recipe formulation, nutrition analysis and FDA labeling in one versioned system, so compliance stops being a separate project at the end of development.

plugins.name: LinkupAPI
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 GPT 自动化跨 B2B 渠道的推广。寻找潜在客户、研究人员和公司、个性化并发送您的消息、发送连接请求以及阅读您的收件箱和回复，所有这些都可以通过您自己的连接帐户进行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Automate your outreach across B2B channels, right from your GPT. Find prospects, research people and companies, personalize and send your messages, send connection requests, and read your inbox and replies, all from your own connected accounts.

plugins.name: Ratiba
plugins.productIntro: Ratiba 帮助游猎运营商和旅行团队管理 ChatGPT 中的提案工作流程。该应用程序可以查找和创建客户、搜索住宿和目的地图像、创建和更新行程提案、检查提案详细信息和定价以及翻译提案内容以供客户交付。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ratiba helps safari operators and travel teams manage proposal workflows in ChatGPT. The app can find and create clients, search accommodations and destination imagery, create and update itinerary proposals, inspect proposal details and pricing, and translate proposal content for client delivery.

plugins.name: Jeep
plugins.productIntro: 吉普车
plugins.productIntroEn: Jeep

plugins.productIntro: 101 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的工作空间以进行财务分析和项目运营。使用余额、收入、支出、交易、账单、承包商结算和成本类别来分析公司的财务状况。审查和管理结算和关联转账。搜索项目、任务、评论、团队成员、估算、价目表和 Wiki 页面。创建和编辑财务事件、转账、估算、任务、评论和 Wiki 内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: 101 connects ChatGPT to your workspace for financial analysis and project operations. Analyze company financial health using balances, income, expenses, transactions, bills, contractor settlements, and cost categories. Review and manage settlements and linked transfers. Search projects, tasks, comments, team members, estimates, price lists, and Wiki pages.

plugins.name: Roe
plugins.description: 使用 AI 调查数据
plugins.productIntro: Roe 帮助欺诈、反洗钱、争议和合规团队调查组织数据、运行受治理的代理、审查作业、查询表以及使用策略和知识库。
plugins.productIntroEn: Roe helps fraud, AML, dispute, and compliance teams investigate organization data, run governed agents, review jobs, query tables, and work with policies and knowledge bases.

plugins.name: Pheedback
plugins.productIntro: Peedback 将 ChatGPT 变成您的用户研究助手。列出您的 Pheedback、创建新的 Pheedback 以及浏览回复 - 所有这些都无需离开您的对话。专为想要更快反馈循环的创始人和产品团队而设计。
plugins.productIntroEn: Pheedback turns ChatGPT into your user research assistant. List your Pheedbacks, create new ones, and browse responses — all without leaving your conversation. Built for founders and product teams who want faster feedback loops.

plugins.name: Dcipher Analytics
plugins.productIntro: Dcipher 是一个研究和分析平台，可收集大量外部内容（网络、新闻、社交媒体、您自己的文件）并将其转换为结构化、可分析的数据。此连接器使 ChatGPT 能够访问您的 Dcipher 工作区，因此您可以在对话中使用整个平台。
plugins.productIntroEn: Dcipher is a research and analytics platform that collects large volumes of external content — web, news, social media, your own files — and turns it into structured, analyzable data. This connector gives ChatGPT access to your Dcipher workspace, so you can work through the whole platform in conversation.

plugins.name: CE Cosmos Deep Dive
plugins.description: 精细访问 CE 数据
plugins.productIntro: Cosmos 将 Consumer Edge 的交易数据直接引入 ChatGPT。用简单的英语提出问题，并根据来自数百万张美国信用卡和借记卡的近实时支出数据（涵盖数千个品牌和商家）获得分析师级答案 - 比公司报告提前几周。直接使用交易级数据来构建自定义群组、运行价格点分析并回答聚合无法回答的问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Cosmos brings Consumer Edge's transaction data directly into ChatGPT. Ask questions in plain English and get analyst-grade answers built on near-real-time spend data from millions of US credit and debit cards, covering thousands of brands and merchants — weeks ahead of company reporting.

plugins.name: Prox
plugins.productIntro: 搜索产品目录、检查产品知识树、阅读服务程序和诊断信息，并在 Prox 工作区中进行版本化更正。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search product catalogs, inspect product knowledge trees, read service procedures and diagnostics, and make versioned corrections in your Prox workspace.

plugins.name: Scoutee
plugins.productIntro: Scoutee 搜索欧洲和北美官方期刊和买家平台发布的公共采购公告，每天早上刷新。按关键字、国家/地区和估计价值进行招标，比较买家和截止日期，然后打开一份通知以阅读其程序、CPV 代码和摘录。每个结果都链接到 scoutee.org 上通知的公共页面；完整的描述、买方平台、招标文件、电子邮件提醒和人工智能分析均附带免费的 Scoutee 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: Scoutee searches public procurement notices published by official journals and buyer platforms across Europe and North America, refreshed every morning.
