Ask for tenders by keywords, countries and estimated value, compare buyers and deadlines, then open one notice to read its procedure, CPV codes and an excerpt. Every result links to the notice's public page on scoutee.

plugins.name: Reacher
plugins.description: 管理 TikTok 商店附属机构
plugins.productIntro: Reacher 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 TikTok Shop 联属计划。用简单的语言询问 GMV、创作者、视频、示例和活动，并从实时 Reacher 数据（而不是仪表板）中获取答案。在开放的 TikTok 市场中寻找创作者，了解谁真正推动了销售，审查样品请求和自动化，并提取每周报告背后的数字——针对一家商店或所有商店。创建自动化或回复创建者等写入操作在运行之前会被标记和确认，并且无法通过 ChatGPT 进行资金转移。
plugins.productIntroEn: Reacher connects ChatGPT to your TikTok Shop affiliate program. Ask about GMV, creators, videos, samples and campaigns in plain language and get answers from your live Reacher data instead of a dashboard.

plugins.name: Easy BeeZy
plugins.productIntro: Easy BeeZy 让美容专业人士的一天井井有条。查看今天的日程安排，查找空闲时段，查找客户和您提供的服务，然后预约或将其移至其他时间 - 无需离开聊天室。
plugins.productIntroEn: Easy BeeZy keeps a beauty professional's day in order. Check today's schedule, find free slots, look up a client and the services you offer, then book an appointment or move it to another time — without leaving the chat.

plugins.name: EquipDash
plugins.productIntro: EquipDash 将您的租赁业务连接到 ChatGPT。管理预订、检查产品可用性、处理付款、跟踪库存并生成收入报告——所有这些都通过对话进行。
plugins.productIntroEn: EquipDash connects your rental business to ChatGPT. Manage bookings, check product availability, process payments, track inventory, and generate revenue reports — all through conversation.

plugins.name: Bidaya
plugins.description: 查找 RFP 和公司知识
plugins.productIntro: Bidaya 为建筑、工程和施工团队提供了一个场所，让他们能够找到从事新工作所需的知识和机会。搜索过去的提案、公司文件、简历、项目经验和公司记录，然后发现相关的 RFP 和招标，以及为您的组织量身定制的建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bidaya gives architecture, engineering, and construction teams one place to find the knowledge and opportunities they need to pursue new work. Search past proposals, firm documents, resumes, project experience, and company records, then discover relevant RFPs and tenders with recommendations tailored to your organization.

plugins.name: AgencyAnalytics
plugins.productIntro: AgencyAnalytics 是唯一为营销机构构建的报告和见解平台，现在它直接在 ChatGPT 内部运行。通过超过 85 个集成，将每个客户的营销渠道连接到一个地方，涵盖 SEO、PPC、社交媒体、电子邮件、呼叫跟踪、电子商务等。然后立即查询其中任何一个，无需离开您的 AI 工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: AgencyAnalytics is the only reporting and insights platform built for marketing agencies — and now it works directly inside ChatGPT. Connect every client's marketing channels into one place across SEO, PPC, social media, email, call tracking, ecommerce, and more, with 85+ integrations. Then query any of it, instantly, without leaving your AI workflow.

plugins.name: V7 Go (EU)
plugins.description: 运行工作流程、查询知识
plugins.productIntro: V7 Go 在 ChatGPT 内部将文档和非结构化数据转换为结构化、可查询的信息。发现和配置工作流，在文档上运行它们以提取结构化字段，搜索文件，将文档添加到知识图，以及查询生成的工作流和上下文图数据，以便您获得基于自己来源的答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: V7 Go turns documents and unstructured data into structured, queryable information, right inside ChatGPT. Discover and configure workflows, run them over your documents to extract structured fields, search across your files, add documents to knowledge graphs, and query the resulting workflow and context graph data, so you get answers grounded in your own sources.

plugins.name: Respond.io
plugins.productIntro: Respond.io 帮助团队查找和管理联系人、查看和发送客户消息、更新对话所有权和状态、组织工作区数据以及从 ChatGPT 配置 AI 代理。
plugins.productIntroEn: Respond.io helps teams find and manage contacts, review and send customer messages, update conversation ownership and status, organize workspace data, and configure AI agents from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: LLM Pulse
plugins.description: 追踪人工智能品牌知名度
plugins.productIntro: LLM Pulse 帮助团队监控他们的品牌、竞争对手、提示和来源在人工智能答案中的显示方式。使用它可以直接在 ChatGPT 中探索来自 LLM Pulse 工作区的可见性、提及、引用、观点、推荐和流量信号。
plugins.productIntroEn: LLM Pulse helps teams monitor how their brands, competitors, prompts, and sources appear across AI answers. Use it to explore visibility, mentions, citations, sentiment, recommendations, and traffic signals from your LLM Pulse workspace directly in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Sellerise
plugins.productIntro: Sellerise 将您的亚马逊业务数据引入 ChatGPT - 清晰、结构化且易于分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sellerise brings your Amazon business data into ChatGPT - clear, structured, and ready to analyze.

plugins.name: Brainerce
plugins.productIntro: Brainerce 将由 Brainerce 提供支持的在线商店连接到 ChatGPT，这样您就可以在对话中运行它，而无需点击仪表板。检查库存、查找和更新产品、查看和履行订单、发放和管理折扣代码、查找客户以及编辑店面内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Brainerce connects your Brainerce-powered online store to ChatGPT so you can run it in conversation instead of clicking through a dashboard. Check what is in stock, look up and update products, review and fulfil orders, issue and manage discount codes, find customers, and edit storefront content.

plugins.name: POCKET CFO
plugins.description: 経営相談ビジネスのトータルサポートサービス
plugins.originalDescription: 経営相談ビジネスのトータルサポートサービス
plugins.productIntro: POCKET CFO：経営相談ビジネスのトータルサポートサービス。
plugins.productIntroEn: ご自分のビジネスそのまま相談できます。

plugins.name: GoCodes
plugins.productIntro: 该插件允许您在处理 GoCodes 资产和库存数据时利用人工智能的力量。现在，您可以使用人工智能聊天来回答诸如“最近的压缩机在哪里？”、“我今天需要完成哪些任务？”等问题。还有更多。现在，您可以在智能手机上仅使用语音 ChatGPT 与 GoCodes 对话。
plugins.productIntroEn: This plugin allows you to harness the power of AI while working with your GoCodes Asset & Inventory data. Now you can use AI chat to answer questions like 'Where's my nearest compressor?', 'What tasks do I need to work on today?' and much more. On your smartphone you can now talk to GoCodes using just your voice ChatGPT.

plugins.name: PaidSync
plugins.productIntro: PaidSync 可让 ChatGPT 通过一个连接在 13 个平台上操作您自己的付费媒体帐户：Google Ads、Meta、TikTok、LinkedIn、Snapchat、Reddit、Pinterest、Microsoft 和 ChatGPT 广告，以及 Google Analytics (GA4)、Gootle Tag Manager (GTM)、Search Console 和 Merchant Center。
plugins.productIntroEn: PaidSync lets ChatGPT operate your own paid media accounts across 13 platforms from one connection: Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat, Reddit, Pinterest, Microsoft, and ChatGPT Ads, plus Google Analytics (GA4), Gootle Tag Manager (GTM), Search Console, and Merchant Center.

plugins.name: UGC VZ
plugins.description: 寻找真正的 UGC 创作者 (DACH)
plugins.productIntro: UGC VZ 是德语区（德国、奥地利、瑞士，又名 DACH 地区）真实、经过验证的 UGC 创作者的免费目录，包含作品集和社交媒体证明 - 没有人工智能头像内容。品牌通过自由文本查询、城市、主题或验证级别搜索目录，检查个人创建者资料，并故意请求联系。 UGC VZ 随后通过电子邮件将创作者的联系方式发送给品牌；该目录不收取佣金。典型的工作流程：搜索创建者、查看个人资料、触发外展请求并轮询其交付状态。
plugins.productIntroEn: UGC VZ is a free directory of real, verified UGC creators in the German-speaking region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland aka DACH Region) with portfolio and social-media proof - no AI-avatar content. Brands search the directory by free-text query, city, topics, or verification level, inspect individual creator profiles, and deliberately request contact.

plugins.name: Beat Breeze
plugins.productIntro: Beat Breeze 是一个适用于酒店、餐厅、咖啡馆和零售店的背景音乐平台。将其连接到 ChatGPT，只需询问即可管理场地中的音乐：查看每个区域中正在播放的内容、向上或向下调整区域、切换播放列表、为活动临时播放某些内容或安排稍后更改。每个操作都尊重您登录的 Beat Breeze 帐户的权限：助手只能查看和控制您有权管理的区域，计划的更改需要明确确认，并且您可以随时从仪表板撤销连接。对于现有 Beat Breeze 客户。
plugins.productIntroEn: Beat Breeze is a background-music platform for hotels, restaurants, cafes, and retail. Connect it to ChatGPT to manage the music in your venues just by asking: see what's playing in each zone, turn a zone up or down, switch playlists, temporarily play something for an event, or schedule a change for later.

plugins.name: Rinkta
plugins.productIntro: Rinkta 将您的专业服务工作区连接到 ChatGPT。跨任务、客户、项目和计费条目进行搜索；读取工作区、成员、任务、项目、客户和条目详细信息；无需离开对话即可创建新任务和客户。财务数据（客户、项目和计费条目）仅返回给其角色授予财务访问权限的工作区成员。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rinkta connects your professional services workspace to ChatGPT. Search across tasks, clients, projects, and billable entries; read workspace, member, task, project, client, and entry details; and create new tasks and clients without leaving the conversation. Financial data (clients, projects, and billable entries) is only returned to workspace members whose role grants financial access.

plugins.name: Sweescape
plugins.productIntro: Sweescape 是一款面向组织者的一体化活动管理套件 - 票务、徽章、签到、分析和受众活动。此连接器可让您直接从 ChatGPT 运行自己的 Sweescape 工作区。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sweescape is an all-in-one event management suite for organizers — ticketing, badges, check-in, analytics, and audience campaigns. This connector lets you run your own Sweescape workspace directly from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Website Auditor
plugins.description: 审核站点和 AI 可见性
plugins.productIntro: 看看人工智能助手是否真的推荐您的业务。网站审核员向 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 和 Perplexity 提出真实客户会问的问题，报告答案中列出了哪些企业，并添加了 SEO、安全标头、断开链接和性能检查 - 整体 AI 可见性得分 (0-100)、每个引擎的细分、竞争对手比较以及持续的每周监控。内置示例报告不需要 API 密钥，也无需设置，因此您可以在连接帐户之前准确查看完整报告的外观。
plugins.productIntroEn: See whether AI assistants actually recommend your business. Website Auditor puts the questions a real customer would ask to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, reports which businesses get named in the answers, and adds SEO, security-header, broken-link and performance checks — an overall AI-visibility score (0–100), a per-engine breakdown, competitor comparisons, and ongoing weekly…

plugins.name: TruthScan
plugins.description: 识别人工智能生成的图像
plugins.productIntro: 使用 TruthScan 插件来识别图像是真实的、AI 生成的还是经过 Photoshop 处理的。使用此工具可以阻止欺诈者并保护自己。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use the TruthScan plug-in to identify if images are real or AI-generated or photoshopped. Use this tool to stop fraudsters and protect yourself.

plugins.name: Mextic
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 Mextic 帐户，以简单的语言询问您的车队， 无需打开仪表板或生成报告。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Mextic account to ask about your vehicle fleet in plain language, without opening the dashboard or generating reports.

plugins.name: Kometrics
plugins.productIntro: Kometrics 将您已经在 Stripe、Paddle、Creem 或 Asaas 上运行的计费转化为您可以信赖的订阅指标：MRR、ARR、流失率、ARPA、LTV、群组及其下方的移动分类账。询问 MRR 是如何移动的，它会逐月读取真实的序列；询问它为何移动，它会打开该号码背后的单个客户动向，指出谁注册、扩展或流失。询问谁有风险，它会列出他们以及每个人持有的 MRR；询问现金，它会报告未来 30、60 或 90 天内到期的续订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kometrics turns the billing you already run on Stripe, Paddle, Creem or Asaas into subscription metrics you can trust: MRR, ARR, churn, ARPA, LTV, cohorts and the movement ledger underneath them. Ask how MRR moved and it reads the real series month by month; ask why it moved and it opens the individual customer movements behind the number, naming who signed up, expanded or churned.

plugins.name: Salesforce
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Salesforce Agentforce Sales 发现对象元数据、构建客户和机会简介、审查管道和预测风险、运行提供商本机 SOQL 请求、管理客户计划、汇总通话记录、将潜在客户分配给 Agentforce Lead Nurturing、读取记录以及通过第三方 MCP 应用程序执行显式记录创建或更新。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use Salesforce Agentforce Sales to discover object metadata, build account and opportunity briefs, review pipeline and forecast risk, run provider-native SOQL requests, manage account plans, summarize call transcripts, assign leads to Agentforce Lead Nurturing, read records, and perform explicit record creates or updates through the third-party MCP app.

plugins.name: ChatGPT Admin
plugins.description: 为工作区所有者或管理员管理 ChatGPT 工作区。
plugins.originalDescription: Manage ChatGPT workspaces for workspace owners or admins.
plugins.productIntro: 专为 ChatGPT 工作区所有者和管理员而构建，用于管理成员、组、角色、权限、GPT 和技能，并查看代理和审核日志。监控 Chat、Codex 和 Work 的使用情况和计费，并管理使用限制和警报。仅在 ChatGPT 工作和 Codex 模式下可用。包括具有显式访问选择、私人凭证输入和批准的读取验证的替代身份验证设置指南。
plugins.productIntroEn: Built for ChatGPT workspace owners and admins to manage members, groups, roles, permissions, GPTs, and Skills, and review Agents and audit logs. Monitor usage and billing across Chat, Codex, and Work, and manage usage limits and alerts. Available only in ChatGPT Work and Codex modes.

plugins.name: D&B Commercial Graph
plugins.productIntro: Dun & Bradstreet 通过 D&B Commercial Graph™ 提供有关全球数亿企业的结构化、背景丰富的见解，该模型通过模型上下文协议 (MCP) 原生传输到 OpenAI 中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Dun & Bradstreet delivers structured, context-rich insights on hundreds of millions of businesses globally through the D&B Commercial Graph™ delivered natively into OpenAI through Model Context Protocol (MCP).

plugins.name: PostHog
plugins.description: 分析 PostHog 中的产品数据。
plugins.productIntro: PostHog 的主要用途是分析 PostHog 中的产品数据。 PostHog 让您的 AI 代理能够直接访问您的产品分析、功能标记、实验、错误跟踪、调查、日志和 LLM 分析。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: PostHog is a service that helps you analyze your product data. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Data
plugins.description: 用已有数据调查产品和业务问题，并生成可信的分析结论。
plugins.productIntro: Data 是 OpenAI 提供的数据分析插件，可连接已有数据仓库、商业智能工具与文档，调查业务指标变化，并把结果整理成图表、报表或建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Data is a service that helps you answer questions with data. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Helium 10
plugins.description: 分析亚马逊卖家的关键词、商品和广告数据。
plugins.productIntro: Helium 10 是面向亚马逊卖家的运营分析平台，可查询关键词、商品 ASIN、广告效果、利润和排名数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Helium 10 is a service that helps you access your Helium 10 data. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Amplitude
plugins.description: 查询产品事件、指标、实验与仪表板。
plugins.productIntro: Amplitude 是产品分析平台，用事件、指标、实验和仪表板理解用户行为；插件让 Codex 查询这些数据并整理洞察。
plugins.productIntroEn: Amplitude is a service that helps you analyze your product data. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Blockscout Blockchain Data
plugins.description: 查询区块链交易、钱包、代币和合约数据。
plugins.productIntro: Blockscout 是区块链浏览与数据平台，可查询多个 EVM 网络上的钱包、交易、代币、NFT 和智能合约信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Blockscout Blockchain Data is a service that helps you find & analyze blockchain data. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Mixpanel
plugins.description: 查询和分析 Mixpanel 产品数据。
plugins.productIntro: Mixpanel 的主要用途是查询和分析 Mixpanel 产品数据。 直接在 ChatGPT 中查询和分析您的 Mixpanel 数据。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Mixpanel is a service that helps you query and analyze Mixpanel. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Coupler.io
plugins.description: 连接 400 多种应用并分析其数据。
plugins.productIntro: Coupler.io 的主要用途是连接 400 多种应用并分析其数据。 通过连接到 Coupler.io 数据流，分析 ChatGPT 中的多渠道营销、财务、销售、电子商务和其他业务数据 – 从数百个来源查询营销、销售和财务指标。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Coupler.io is a service that helps you connect to your business data. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Serpstat
plugins.description: 查询 SEO 数据、关键词与竞争对手研究。
plugins.productIntro: Serpstat 的主要用途是查询 SEO 数据、关键词与竞争对手研究。 构建语义关键词集群，从 1000 多个类别中发现尚未开发的市场利基，并进行全面的竞争对手分析。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Serpstat is a service that helps you sEO data and keyword research. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Waldo
plugins.description: 分析品牌信息、认知与市场表现。
plugins.productIntro: Waldo 的主要用途是分析品牌信息、认知与市场表现。 Waldo 通过将专业技能与外部数据和经过身份验证的工作空间环境相结合，帮助用户研究品牌、广告、社交对话、趋势并捕获工作空间情报。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Waldo is a service that helps you your brand intelligence engine. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Typeform
plugins.productIntro: 无需离开 ChatGPT 即可构建表单、联系人列表和自动化。使用自然语言分析您的表单和调查数据，创建数据丰富的联系人资料，并构建将表单受访者转变为客户的自动化。 Typeform 让您可以轻松理解客户数据并对其采取行动，而无需切换工具。
plugins.productIntroEn: Build forms, contact lists, and automations without leaving ChatGPT. Use natural language to analyze your form and survey data, create data-rich contact profiles, and build automations that turn your form respondents into customers. Typeform makes it easy to understand and act on your customer data—without switching tools.

plugins.name: Tableau (MCP only; EOL soon)
plugins.productIntro: 此基于 MCP 的插件将很快被弃用，请切换使用新的 Tableau 插件。
plugins.productIntroEn: This MCP based plugin will be deprecated shortly, please switch usage to the new Tableau Plugin.

plugins.name: BlazeSQL
plugins.description: 查询您的 SQL 数据库
plugins.productIntro: BlazeSQL 让 ChatGPT 和 Codex 使用所有必要的上下文查询您的数据库或仓库，以获得正确的答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: BlazeSQL lets ChatGPT and Codex query your database or warehouse with all the necessary context to get the correct answers.

plugins.name: Hex
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Hex Agent 回答数据问题并启动新的分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: Answer data questions and spin up new analyses with the Hex Agent.

plugins.name: CData Connect AI
plugins.description: 无需询问即可获得答案
plugins.productIntro: Connect AI 可与云数据仓库、关系数据库、数据湖站、分析平台等配合使用，因此您可以通过对话探索和分析数据。使用您的数据作为您在 ChatGPT 中所做的工作的输入，例如将产品遥测与发布计划相关联以调查用户参与度。在 Connect AI 中，您可以跨具有定义的关系和语义上下文的源构建虚拟数据集，并将它们呈现为专用工具 - 因此 ChatGPT 以您的企业理解的方式处理您的数据，而不仅仅是其存储方式。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect AI works with cloud data warehouses, relational databases, data lakehouses, analytics platforms and more so you can explore and analyze your data through conversation. Use your data as input to the work you're doing in ChatGPT, like correlating product telemetry with the release schedule to investigate user engagement.

plugins.name: MotherDuck
plugins.description: 从您的数据中获取答案
plugins.productIntro: 将 AI 助手连接到您的 MotherDuck 数据仓库。使用自然语言探索、可视化和管理数据——无需 SQL 技能。创建潜水：交互式可视化，可让您保存并与团队共享答案，了解最新数据。无需语义模型或​​预配置即可处理现实世界的数据。您的人工智能助手就像数据分析师一样，反复探索、验证、分析和可视化数据来回答您的问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect AI assistants to your MotherDuck data warehouse. Explore, visualize, and manage data using natural language–no SQL skills required. Create Dives: interactive visualizations that let you save and share answers with your team, staying up-to-date with your latest data. Works with real-world data without requiring semantic models or pre-configuration.

plugins.name: Coupler.io
plugins.description: 分析来自 400 多个应用程序的数据
plugins.productIntro: 通过连接到 Coupler.io 数据流，分析 Codex 中的多渠道营销、财务、销售、电子商务和其他业务数据。从 Google Ads、Facebook、HubSpot 和 Salesforce 等平台获取原始数据并将其转换为可操作的情报，从而利用准确、最新的业务信息做出更智能、更快速的决策。
plugins.productIntroEn: Analyze multi-channel marketing, financial, sales, e-commerce, and other business data within Codex by connecting to your Coupler.io data flows. Fetch and transform raw data from platforms like Google Ads, Facebook, HubSpot, and Salesforce into actionable intelligence for smarter, faster decision-making with accurate, up-to-date business information.

plugins.name: Porter Metrics
plugins.productIntro: Porter 将您的营销和电子商务数据导入 ChatGPT。连接来自 Facebook Ads、Google Ads、Shopify、GA4、TikTok Ads、LinkedIn Ads 和 Porter 中其他支持平台的帐户，然后用简单的英语提出问题 - “上周哪些营销活动带来了最多的收入？”、“昨天各个渠道的支出比较如何？” — 并从您的授权帐户中实时获取答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Porter brings your marketing and ecommerce data into ChatGPT. Connect accounts from Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, GA4, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other supported platforms in Porter, then ask questions in plain English — "Which campaigns drove the most revenue last week?", "How did spend compare across channels yesterday?" — and get answers pulled live from your authorized accoun…

plugins.name: Powerset Research
plugins.description: 访问 Powerset 研究数据
plugins.productIntro: Powerset Research (https://research.powerset.co/) 是 Powerset (https://powerset.co/) 的一份技术期刊，我们在其中分析技术趋势、发布分析结果并提供免费工具来帮助创始人。该应用程序允许任何人通过 ChatGPT 访问 Powerset Research 的底层数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Powerset Research (https://research.powerset.co/) is a technical journal from Powerset (https://powerset.co/) where we analyze tech trends, publish analytics, and provide free tools for helping founders. This app allows anyone to access the data underlying Powerset Research via ChatGPT.

plugins.name: SkyWatch
plugins.productIntro: 一站式搜索和探索 Vantor、Planet、Airbus 等顶级提供商的卫星图像。 SkyWatch 可让您按位置、日期、分辨率和云量查找存档图像，比较不同提供商的价格，并浏览可用的卫星和产品。结果包括在 SkyWatch Explore 上查看和订购图像的直接链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search and explore satellite imagery from top providers including Vantor, Planet, Airbus, and more, all in one place. SkyWatch lets you find archive imagery by location, date, resolution, and cloud cover, compare pricing across providers, and browse available satellites and product offerings. Results include direct links to view and order imagery on SkyWatch Explore.

plugins.name: Metorik
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中与您的 Shopify 或 WooCommerce 销售数据聊天。提出诸如“我们最赚钱的客户来自哪里？”之类的问题。或“本季度哪些产品流行？”并直接从您的商店获得实时答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Chat with your Shopify or WooCommerce sales data directly in ChatGPT. Ask questions like "Where do our most profitable customers come from?" or "Which products are trending this quarter?" and get real-time answers pulled straight from your store.

plugins.name: Ramp Data
plugins.productIntro: Ramp Data MCP 使 ChatGPT 用户能够从 50,000 多家企业的数十亿美元实际企业支出中获取 Ramp 数据，包括 Ramp Rate（供应商采用、定价和转换趋势）和 AI 指数（企业在 AI 上的支出方式）。 Ramp Data 被创始人、采购主管、研究人员、投资者和政策分析师使用，并被《纽约时报》、《华尔街日报》、彭博社等领先出版物引用。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ramp Data MCP enables ChatGPT users to access Ramp Data from billions of dollars in real corporate spend across 50,000+ businesses, including Ramp Rate (vendor adoption, pricing, and switching trends) and the AI Index (how businesses are spending on AI).

plugins.name: GIS Cloud
plugins.description: 创建地图和 GIS 分析
plugins.productIntro: GIS Cloud 是一个云地理空间平台，被 60 多个国家/地区的政府、公用事业和现场团队使用。
plugins.productIntroEn: GIS Cloud is a cloud geospatial platform used by governments, utilities, and field teams in 60+ countries.

plugins.name: Kwater
plugins.productIntro: K-water（韩国水资源公司）的官方实时水数据服务。询问韩国水坝和河流的水坝蓄水量、流入/排水、河流水位、降雨量以及水质——每 10 分钟更新一次。
plugins.productIntroEn: Official real-time water data service by K-water (Korea Water Resources Corporation). Ask about dam storage levels, inflow/discharge, river water levels, rainfall, and water quality across South Korea's dams and rivers — updated every 10 minutes.

plugins.name: Similarweb
plugins.description: 网络、应用程序、搜索和市场数据
plugins.productIntro: 使用Similarweb 的市场情报数据研究ChatGPT 内的任何网站或应用程序。分析竞争对手的流量、发现热门关键词、探索受众人口统计数据以及跨行业的基准绩效——所有这些都通过简单的提示进行。询问诸如“显示耐克的流量来源细分”或“阿迪达斯对哪些关键字进行排名？”之类的问题。无需切换工具即可获得实时见解。无论您是营销人员、分析师、投资者还是策略师，Similarweb 都可以帮助您立即将竞争性问题转化为答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Research any website or app inside ChatGPT using Similarweb's market intelligence data. Analyze competitor traffic, uncover top keywords, explore audience demographics, and benchmark performance across industries—all through simple prompts.

plugins.name: BigGeo AI
plugins.productIntro: BigGeo AI 将空间智能带入您的聊天中，让您可以提出问题并获得由真实世界位置数据提供支持的答案。无需搜索地图或原始数据，只需询问并获得有关位置及其关联方式的清晰、相关的答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: BigGeo AI brings spatial intelligence into your chat, allowing you to ask questions and get answers powered by real-world location data. Instead of searching through maps or raw data, simply ask and get clear, relevant answers about locations and how they relate.

plugins.name: ThoughtSpot Spotter
plugins.description: 用自然语言向业务数据提问并分析洞察。
plugins.productIntro: ThoughtSpot Spotter 是自然语言数据分析助手，让业务团队对已连接的数据提问、追查指标变化并验证分析结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: ThoughtSpot Spotter is a service that helps you your AI data analyst. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Leo - Running Coach
plugins.productIntro: Leo 是一位与您交谈的跑步教练。连接您的 Strava 或 Suunto 帐户一次，Leo 就会围绕您的目标比赛制定定期训练计划，然后根据您完成的锻炼和您的感受每周进行调整 - 无需额外的传感器。
plugins.productIntroEn: Leo is a running coach you talk to. Connect your Strava or Suunto account once, and Leo builds a periodized training plan around your goal race, then adapts it week after week based on your completed workouts and how you feel — no extra sensors needed.

plugins.name: Minter.io
plugins.productIntro: Minter.io 帮助用户检查连接的社交媒体报告，发现可用的分析指标，并通过 ChatGPT 从 Instagram、TikTok、X、Facebook、LinkedIn 和 Threads 查询报告数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Minter.io helps users inspect connected social media reports, discover available analytics metrics, and query report data from Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Threads through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Sixtyfour Intelligence
plugins.productIntro: 部署 AI 代理来调查人员和公司、解析身份、映射关系并显示风险信号 - 所有这些都通过单个 API 完成。
plugins.productIntroEn: Deploy AI agents that investigate people and companies, resolve identities, map relationships, and surface risk signals — all through a single API.

plugins.name: Book Report
plugins.description: 分析您的作者销售数据
plugins.productIntro: 图书报告从 Kindle Direct Publishing、Draft2Digital 和许多其他领先的图书出版平台导入并组织您的销售数据。通过此应用程序，您可以授予 ChatGPT 访问该销售数据的权限。它可以总结趋势、比较时间段、识别热门书籍和系列、按发行商或市场细分收入、回答后续问题等等。您无需四处寻找所需的数据，只需询问即可获得。访问权限是只读的：应用程序可以检索报告和目录上下文，但无法修改图书报告数据、帐户或连接的发布帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: Book Report imports and organizes your sales data from Kindle Direct Publishing, Draft2Digital, and many more leading book publishing platforms. With this app, you can give ChatGPT access to that sales data. It can summarize trends, compare time periods, identify top books and series, break down earnings by distributor or marketplace, answer follow-up questions, and much more.

plugins.name: Mixpanel Headless
plugins.description: 使用 Python 分析 Mixpanel 数据
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Mixpanel Headless 技能安装和验证 mixpanel_headless Python SDK，发现 Mixpanel 模式，运行分段、漏斗、保留、流量和用户配置文件分析，并从 Codex 构建或检查 Mixpanel 仪表板。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use Mixpanel Headless skills to install and authenticate the mixpanel_headless Python SDK, discover Mixpanel schemas, run segmentation, funnel, retention, flow, and user-profile analyses, and build or inspect Mixpanel dashboards from Codex.

plugins.name: StatsHawk
plugins.productIntro: StatsHawk 为 ChatGPT 提供真实的当前运动数据，而不是根据训练数据进行猜测。询问任何一场比赛，并获取 NBA、WNBA、MLB、NFL、NHL、KBO、NCAA 篮球和橄榄球以及包括英超联赛在内的主要足球比赛的比分、赛程表、排名、统计数据、名单和球员查询，所有这些都标准化为一个一致的形状，统计数据在统计数据发布后几分钟内即可到达。
plugins.productIntroEn: StatsHawk gives ChatGPT real, current sports data instead of guesses from training data. Ask about any game and get scores, schedules, standings, box scores, rosters, and player lookups across NBA, WNBA, MLB, NFL, NHL, KBO, NCAA basketball and football, and major soccer competitions including the Premier League, all normalized into one consistent shape, with numbers landing within minute…

plugins.name: Omni
plugins.productIntro: Omni 允许用户使用来自 ChatGPT 的组织受管商业智能数据。该应用程序可以列出可用的 Omni 模型、选择问题的最佳主题、生成并运行单个分析查询、启动 Omni 的完整 AI 助手进行更深入的多步骤分析、检查助手工作状态以及搜索 Omni 文档。
plugins.productIntroEn: Omni lets users work with their organization's governed business intelligence data from ChatGPT. The app can list available Omni models, select the best topic for a question, generate and run a single analytical query, start Omni's full AI assistant for deeper multi-step analysis, check the assistant job status, and search Omni documentation.

plugins.name: Amplitude EU
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 Amplitude 工作区以搜索图表和仪表板、查询指标和实验结果、探索事件和属性以及创建或更新图表、仪表板和警报 - 无需离开对话。 Amplitude 是产品智能平台，团队用来了解用户行为、衡量影响并决定下一步要构建什么。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Amplitude workspace to search charts and dashboards, query metrics and experiment results, explore events and properties, and create or update charts, dashboards, and alerts — without leaving the conversation. Amplitude is the product intelligence platform teams use to understand user behavior, measure impact, and decide what to build next.

plugins.name: PagePulse
plugins.description: 跟踪 SEO 和页面更改
plugins.productIntro: PagePulse 将您的 Google Search Console 数据、Google Analytics 4 指标以及检测到的页面更改历史记录引入 ChatGPT。按项目、页面或主题询问您的网站，并根据您的实际分析获得答案。 独特的角度是相关性。 PagePulse 跟踪检测到的每一项页面更改（标题重写、内容更新、架构编辑、链接更改），并按重要性对每一项进行评分。
plugins.productIntroEn: PagePulse brings your Google Search Console data, Google Analytics 4 metrics, and detected on-page change history into ChatGPT. Ask about your sites by project, page, or topic and get answers grounded in your actual analytics. The unique angle is correlation.

plugins.name: ChartMogul
plugins.productIntro: ChartMogul 的 MCP 服务器使人工智能助手能够安全地访问您的订阅分析和客户数据。使用自然语言分析 MRR、ARR、流失、保留、群组、订阅、收入趋势和客户活动。调查业务绩效、识别增长机会、发现客户流失驱动因素、探索客户关系并回答有关 SaaS 业务的复杂问题。它专为创始人以及市场推广、产品和财务团队打造，可将 ChartMogul 数据转化为可操作的见解和更快的决策。
plugins.productIntroEn: ChartMogul’s MCP server gives AI assistants secure access to your subscription analytics and customer data. Analyze MRR, ARR, churn, retention, cohorts, subscriptions, revenue trends, and customer activity using natural language.

plugins.name: Tenzo
plugins.productIntro: Tenzo 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的餐厅数据。用简单的英语询问有关所有地点的销售、劳动力、保险、平均支票、商品组合、客户评论和经理日志的问题。该应用程序读取您在 Tenzo 仪表板中看到的相同指标和维度，尊重您现有的用户权限和业务访问权限，并且可以将有用的查询作为卡片和仪表板保存回您的 Tenzo 帐户中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tenzo connects ChatGPT to your restaurant data. Ask questions in plain English about sales, labour, covers, average check, item mix, customer reviews and manager logs across all your locations. The app reads the same metrics and dimensions you already see in your Tenzo dashboard, respects your existing user permissions and business access, and can save useful queries back as cards and da…

plugins.name: Brand & Market Social Research
plugins.productIntro: 使用关键字、语言过滤器和排除搜索最近的公共社交帖子，了解品牌提及、市场需求、客户反馈、产品需求和新兴趋势。每个请求都会运行有界的按需搜索并返回最小化的 JSON。它从不访问私人帖子、通过身份跟踪人员或连续运行。品牌与市场社会研究是一款独立的 Telemark Digital 应用程序。无需外部帐户、付款方式或购买。 Telemark Digital 资助免费搜索，但须遵守每日和每月共享容量限制。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search recent public social posts for brand mentions, market demand, customer feedback, product needs, and emerging trends using keywords, language filters, and exclusions. Each request runs a bounded on-demand search and returns minimized JSON. It never accesses private posts, tracks people by identity, or runs continuously.

plugins.name: Deepnote
plugins.description: 使用代理运行数据工作流
plugins.productIntro: Deepnote 为团队提供了一个用于笔记本、SQL、应用程序和数据工作流的协作工作空间。该插件可帮助 OpenAI 处理连接的 Deepnote 项目、检查和运行笔记本，并将工作区上下文转化为有用的分析和可共享的结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Deepnote gives teams a collaborative workspace for notebooks, SQL, apps, and data workflows. This plugin helps OpenAI work with connected Deepnote projects, inspect and run notebooks, and turn workspace context into useful analysis and shareable results.

plugins.name: Propalt

plugins.productIntroEn: Propalt property data & insights for UK real estate professionals. AI powered property valuations (AMV) for individual property and whole portfolios. Live and historic real estate selling and renting data including comparables. Location insights including convenience, risks, schools, crime, public & private services. Location & market analytics showing historic trends and predictions.

plugins.name: Polar Analytics
plugins.description: 连接您的电子商务数据

plugins.productIntroEn: Turn ChatGPT into your data analyst. Ask questions about your Shopify store, Meta Ads, Google Ads, and other channels in plain language. Get answers on ROAS, CAC, top-performing SKUs, profit margins, and more, all pulled from Polar’s semantic layer for accuracy. Supports multi-store setups and works with major ecommerce integrations, including TikTok Ads and Klaviyo.

plugins.name: Atlan
plugins.productIntro: Atlan 是企业人工智能的上下文层。将 ChatGPT 连接到您组织的上下文存储库：您的 AI 代理需要准确回答的知识、数据和语义。使用 Atlan 的代理技能来搜索和发现企业上下文、遍历端到端沿袭、访问受管理的数据定义和术语表、执行 SQL、管理元数据图并确保数据质量，因此您向 ChatGPT 提出的每个问题都基于可信的组织上下文。
plugins.productIntroEn: Atlan is the context layer for enterprise AI. Connect ChatGPT to your organisation's context repos: the knowledge, data, and semantics your AI agents need to answer accurately. Use Atlan's agent skills to search and discover enterprise context, traverse end-to-end lineage, access governed data definitions and glossaries, execute SQL, curate your metadata graph, and ensure data quality, s…

plugins.name: GSC SEO & Content Planner

plugins.productIntroEn: Connect Google Search Console to analyze finalized search performance, uncover keyword and content opportunities, compare ranking changes, and plan SEO articles using data from the SMEPost organizations you authorize. Access is read-only: the plugin cannot edit content, publish, or write to Google Search Console.

plugins.name: Catchr
plugins.productIntro: Catchr 帮助营销人员和代理机构直接在 ChatGPT 中处理他们的营销数据。 询问有关活动绩效的问题，比较互联来源的结果，并将原始指标转化为为客户和团队提供清晰的报告见解。
plugins.productIntroEn: Catchr helps marketers and agencies work with their marketing data directly in ChatGPT. Ask questions about campaign performance, compare results across connected sources, and turn raw metrics into clear reporting insights for clients and teams.

plugins.name: Tango MCP

plugins.productIntroEn: Tango provides a unified API and MCP for federal procurement data. Tango is built by govcon experts and software developers who understand the pain of stitching together multiple government data sources. Designed specifically for public-sector builders and for AI-ready data consumers.

plugins.productIntroEn: Lytical automatically captures website activity and turns it into useful insights so you can understand traffic, behavior, and trends without digging through analytics reports. It helps you quickly answer questions like what changed, why it changed, and what to do next.

plugins.name: JoomPulse

plugins.productIntroEn: JoomPulse gives you instant access to MercadoLivre Brazil's marketplace data through natural language queries. Analyze product listings, categories, sellers, pricing trends, reviews, and keywords — all powered by a structured data warehouse.

plugins.name: Landstack

plugins.name: Property Hazard MCP

plugins.name: AWS Data Analytics

plugins.productIntroEn: Kindora gives nonprofits and researchers direct access to the philanthropic funding landscape. Search grantmakers by name, cause area, geography, size, or classification; review IRS 990 financial summaries and grant histories; find open foundation and government grant opportunities; analyze giving patterns; and browse philanthropy jobs.

plugins.name: Customer Journey Analytics

plugins.productIntroEn: Adobe Customer Journey Analytics helps authorized users discover data views, dimensions, metrics, segments, date ranges, projects, and audiences; run ranked CJA reports; inspect component definitions; and create or update reusable CJA components and Workspace projects through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Fr8Labs Analytics

plugins.productIntroEn: Ask your freight-forwarding data anything — shipments, revenue, costs, margins, P&L, and AR/AP ageing — in plain language, and turn answers into charts, dashboards, and scheduled email reports, straight from your Fr8Labs FMS. Every query is scoped to your own company's data: results are read from a tenant-isolated analytics warehouse, and reports email only to your own domain.

plugins.name: Master Metrics

plugins.name: PolicyNote

Copula and paid workflows are not included in this ChatGPT version.

plugins.name: Windsock
plugins.productIntro: Windsock 估算通用航空飞机的市场价值，并提供该估算背后的支持市场数据。输入飞机的尾号（N 号）即可获取该品牌和型号的估计当前市场价值、可比飞机以及近期价格趋势。 您可以用简单的语言提出后续问题——航空电子设备、大修后的发动机时间、损坏历史或位置如何影响价值；类似的飞机通常需要多长时间才能出售；以及更广泛的细分市场如何发展。 Windsock 还提取美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 的注册详细信息、适航指令和机场级别的信息，包括当前天气和燃油价格预测。
plugins.productIntroEn: Windsock estimates the market value of general aviation aircraft and provides the supporting market data behind that estimate. Enter an aircraft's tail number (N-number) to get an estimated current market value, comparable aircraft, and recent price trends for that make and model.

plugins.name: Evidence Studio
plugins.productIntro: Evidence 是一款人工智能驱动的 BI 工具，用于使用 SQL 和 Markdown 发布报告。此连接器允许 ChatGPT 代表您安全地处理您组织的实时数据和发布的报告，并且范围仅限于您自己的权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: Evidence is an AI-powered BI tool for publishing reports using SQL and Markdown. This connector lets ChatGPT work with your organization's live data and published reports on your behalf - securely, and scoped to your own permissions.

plugins.name: Reverse Contact
plugins.productIntro: 反向联系将电子邮件地址、姓名或 LinkedIn URL 转换为专业资料。询问电子邮件地址背后的人是谁，总结人员及其工作的公司，或按职位、行业、员工人数和地点搜索人员和公司。
plugins.productIntroEn: Reverse Contact turns an email address, a name, or a LinkedIn URL into a professional profile. Ask who is behind an email address, summarise a person and the company they work for, or search people and companies by job title, industry, headcount and location.

plugins.name: Trace
plugins.productIntro: Trace 为代理提供有关公司使用哪些技术、与谁合作以及雇用谁的结构化数据。询问任何公司的技术堆栈、集成生态系统或最近的招聘信号，Trace 都会返回结构化答案。创建列表来监控一段时间内的变化。对于客户研究、市场分析、竞争洞察或发现公司何时采用新工具或合作伙伴非常有用。
plugins.productIntroEn: Trace gives agents structured data on what technologies companies use, who they partner with, and who they're hiring. Ask about any company's tech stack, integration ecosystem, or recent hiring signals, and Trace returns structured answers. Create lists to monitor changes over time.

plugins.name: Temso
plugins.description: 在 AI 聊天中跟踪您的品牌
plugins.originalDescription: Track your brand in AI chats
plugins.productIntro: Temso 跟踪您的品牌在人工智能助手中的知名度 - 声音份额、情绪、他们引用的来源以及建议的改进行动。连接 Temso，以自然语言询问您的 AI 可见性数据，并将实时分析直接引入聊天中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Temso tracks your brand's visibility across AI assistants — share of voice, sentiment, which sources they cite, and recommended actions to improve. Connect Temso to ask about your AI-visibility data in natural language and pull live analytics straight into the chat.

plugins.name: Centiment
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 浏览和分析您的 Centment 组织、工作区、调查和调查回复。 Centiment MCP 服务器提供对您已有权查看的调查数据的安全、只读访问，使您无需离开 ChatGPT 即可轻松发现调查、检查响应并总结调查结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Browse and analyze your Centiment organizations, workspaces, surveys, and survey responses directly from ChatGPT. The Centiment MCP Server provides secure, read-only access to survey data you already have permission to view, making it easy to discover surveys, inspect responses, and summarize findings without leaving ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Amplifyr
plugins.productIntro: Amplifyr 使 ChatGPT 能够直接访问您品牌的 AI 可见性分析。用简单的英语提问，即可立即获得关于声音份额、行业排名、KPI、引用、情绪以及人们在 AI 模型中询问像您这样的品牌的问题的答案。数据仅适用于您的组织。没有 SQL。没有仪表板。就问吧。
plugins.productIntroEn: Amplifyr gives ChatGPT direct access to your brand's AI visibility analytics. Ask in plain English and get instant answers on share of voice, industry rankings, KPIs, citations, sentiment, and the questions people are asking about brands like yours across AI models. Data is scoped to your organisation only. No SQL. No dashboards. Just ask.

plugins.name: Azadea One
plugins.description: 受监管的 Azadea BI 见解
plugins.productIntro: Azadea One 为获得批准的企业用户提供跨绩效营销、CRM、电子商务、实体店、电子商务运营、客户分析和营销预算的只读汇总见解。 OAuth 和集线器权限强制访问。它从不公开原始 SQL、原始表、凭据、客户标识符或写入操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Azadea One gives approved business users read-only aggregate insights across performance marketing, CRM, ecommerce, physical stores, ecommerce operations, Customer Analytics, and marketing budgets. OAuth and hub permissions enforce access. It never exposes raw SQL, raw tables, credentials, customer identifiers, or write actions.

plugins.name: Enterpret
plugins.productIntro: Enterpret 帮助团队了解客户在支持请求、销售电话、应用程序评论、调查、Slack 等方面的言论。提出自然语言问题以查找投诉趋势、功能请求、细分特定模式和直接客户报价。结果基于您的客户上下文图表，并包含返回源记录的链接，以便产品、GTM 和领导团队可以根据上下文采取行动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Enterpret helps teams understand what customers are saying across support tickets, sales calls, app reviews, surveys, Slack, and more. Ask natural-language questions to find complaint trends, feature requests, segment-specific patterns, and direct customer quotes.

plugins.name: Peec AI
plugins.description: 跨法学硕士跟踪您的品牌
plugins.productIntro: 监控和分析您的品牌在人工智能搜索引擎中的知名度。跟踪您的知名度、情绪和声音份额，并与竞争对手进行比较。
plugins.productIntroEn: Monitor and analyze your brand's visibility across AI search engines. Track your visibility, sentiment, and share of voice and compare to competitors.

plugins.name: Extract
plugins.productIntro: Extract 可帮助团队检查数据连接器和管道运行状况、配置源和目标、管理连接计划和流、查看运行历史记录、排除故障以及启动批准的手动运行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Extract helps teams inspect data connectors and pipeline health, configure sources and destinations, manage connection schedules and streams, review run history, troubleshoot failures, and start approved manual runs.

plugins.name: Remedy Legal
plugins.description: 查找英国合法住房数据
plugins.productIntro: 输入英国邮政编码，即可在清晰的交互式地图上探索与合法住房相关的信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Type a UK postcode to explore legal housing-related information on a clear, interactive map.

plugins.name: Appskyline
plugins.productIntro: 询问有关您在 Appskyline 中跟踪的移动应用程序的问题。无需离开 ChatGPT，即可查看商店标识、跟踪的关键字以及当前的 iOS App Store、Google Play 和 Microsoft Store 排名。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ask questions about the mobile apps you track in Appskyline. Review store identities, tracked keywords, and current iOS App Store, Google Play, and Microsoft Store rankings without leaving ChatGPT.

plugins.name: WitCloud
plugins.productIntro: WitCloud 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的营销、销售和电子商务数据。用简单的语言提出问题并直接从业务数据中获得答案 - 无需编写 SQL 即可探索客户、营销活动、收入和趋势。 WitCloud 使用您的业务上下文来保持答案的相关性。所有访问都是只读的。
plugins.productIntroEn: WitCloud connects ChatGPT to your marketing, sales, and ecommerce data. Ask questions in plain language and get answers straight from your business data - explore customers, campaigns, revenue, and trends without writing SQL. WitCloud uses your business context to keep answers relevant. All access is read-only.

plugins.name: Quanti IA
plugins.productIntro: Quanti Analytics 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的营销数据仓库（BigQuery、Snowflake、Redshift），让您可以通过自然语言即时访问跨渠道广告数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Quanti Analytics connects ChatGPT to your marketing data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift), giving you instant access to cross-channel advertising data through natural language.

plugins.name: Carbon Arc
plugins.productIntro: Carbon Arc MCP 服务器是一个商业智能平台，通过提供对私有数据的访问，将自然语言问题转化为决策见解。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Carbon Arc MCP Server is a business intelligence platform that converts natural language questions into insights for decision-making by providing access to private data.

plugins.name: Formester
plugins.productIntro: 通过 ChatGPT 读取并分析表单提交。使用自然语言搜索提交内容，按日期或状态进行过滤，并获取 AI 生成的见解（例如情绪、类别和摘要）并保存回自定义字段。处理文件附件，包括 PDF 和图像。适用于基于 Formester 构建的任何表单。
plugins.productIntroEn: Read and analyze form submissions through ChatGPT. Search submissions with natural language, filter by date or status, and get AI-generated insights like sentiment, categories, and summaries and saved back as custom fields. Process file attachments including PDFs and images. Works with any form built on Formester.

plugins.name: Padel Analyst
plugins.productIntro: 立即获得有关专业板球的答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Get instant answers about professional padel.

plugins.name: august
plugins.productIntro: august 为您的企业需要了解的人员构建数字孪生。数字孪生是真实用户的镜子，他们接受数据训练，像现实生活中的用户一样思考、决策和响应。
plugins.productIntroEn: august builds Digital Twins of the people your business needs to understand. Digital Twins are mirrors of your real users trained on your data to think, make decisions and respond like their real-life counterparts.

plugins.name: Clarivate IPOne CM Trademarks
plugins.productIntro: Clarivate IPOne CompuMark 商标 MCP 可帮助团队在全球商标注册中更快地搜索、审查和验证商标。它结合了广泛的管辖范围和灵活的商标名称、语音变体、申请人、类别、商品和服务以及申请详细信息的搜索选项。用户可以快速评估结果量、检索记录详细信息、访问商品文本以及打开全文记录，使该服务器非常适合品牌清理、手表支持和商标研究工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Clarivate IPOne CompuMark Trademark MCP helps teams search, review, and validate trademarks faster across global trademark registers. It combines broad jurisdiction coverage with flexible search options for mark names, phonetic variations, applicants, classes, goods and services, and filing details.

plugins.name: Webless
plugins.description: 分析人工智能搜索获取
plugins.productIntro: Webless 将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到经过身份验证的 Webless 分析工作区。询问网站搜索需求、内容参与度、访问者旅程、获取来源和意图差距。该插件读取当前的分析目录，运行租户范围的语义查询，并可以在网络隔离的沙箱中计算比较或可视化。它不接受原始 SQL 或允许用户选择其他租户的数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Webless connects ChatGPT and Codex to your authenticated Webless analytics workspace. Ask about website search demand, content engagement, visitor journeys, acquisition sources, and intent gaps. The plugin reads the current analytics catalog, runs tenant-scoped semantic queries, and can calculate comparisons or visualizations in a network-isolated sandbox.

plugins.name: AIDA Platform
plugins.productIntro: AIDA 帮助电影和娱乐专业人士分析电影、影院、放映时间、预售、票房结果、历史上座率和观众预测。用自然语言提出问题来比较性能、跟踪预售进度、审查时间表、检查实现的市场结果以及跨多个数据域组合信号。访问权限取决于您组织的 AIDA 权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: AIDA helps cinema and entertainment professionals analyze movies, theaters, showtimes, presales, box office results, historical occupancy, and audience forecasting. Ask questions in natural language to compare performance, track presale pace, review schedules, inspect realized market results, and combine signals across multiple data domains.

plugins.name: Ezoic Analytics
plugins.productIntro: Ezoic Analytics 让发布商可以在 ChatGPT 中探索他们的网站分析。询问有关您 Ezoic 域中的综合浏览量、访问量、参与度、广告展示次数、视频效果和收入指标（例如 EPMV）的问题。通过过滤和排序，按日期、页面、国家/地区、设备、流量来源和数十个其他维度分解数据 - 这些数据与 Ezoic 大数据分析仪表板相同。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ezoic Analytics lets publishers explore their website analytics in ChatGPT. Ask questions about pageviews, visits, engagement, ad impressions, video performance, and revenue metrics like EPMV across your Ezoic domains.

plugins.name: SEO Programático
plugins.productIntro: 用自然语言检查您的网站的运行情况。
plugins.productIntroEn: Consultá en lenguaje natural cómo está funcionando tu sitio.

plugins.name: Datadog Experiments
plugins.productIntro: 该插件是与 Datadog 产品分析、功能标记和实验进行代理交互的最佳方式
plugins.productIntroEn: This plugin is the best way to agentically interact with Datadog Product Analytics, Feature Flagging, and Experimentation

plugins.name: Otto by PassBy
plugins.productIntro: Otto 为美国各地的实体店提供真实的零售情报。
plugins.productIntroEn: Otto provides real-world retail intelligence for physical stores across the United States.

plugins.name: Homesage.ai
plugins.productIntro: Homesage.ai 将 ChatGPT 转变为房地产分析师，提供超过 1.55 亿套美国住宅物业的投资者级数据。连接一次，然后用简单的语言询问估价、可比销售额、租金和翻转回报、装修成本、业主详细信息和完整的房产报告。没有电子表格或手动数据提取。
plugins.productIntroEn: Homesage.ai turns ChatGPT into a real estate analyst with investor-grade data on 155M+ US residential properties. Connect once, then ask in plain language for valuations, comparable sales, rental and flip returns, renovation costs, owner details, and Full Property Reports. No spreadsheets or manual data pulls.

plugins.name: Sweet Analytics
plugins.description: 向您的数据询问任何事情。
plugins.productIntro: Sweet 使用关联的 Sweet 数据帮助电子商务团队了解销售、营销、客户、产品、折扣、退款和利润绩效。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sweet helps ecommerce teams understand sales, marketing, customer, product, discount, refund, and profit performance using their connected Sweet data.

plugins.name: Fullmetrix
plugins.productIntro: Fullmetrix 允许在线商店所有者以简单的语言查询他们的电子商务分析。它报告组织中所有活跃商店的订单、总销售额、净收入、税收、运输、已售商品以及独特客户、新客户和回头客。结果可以按日期、商店、国家/地区、客户类型或任何日期范围内的订单状态进行分组，并应用每个组织的收入规则。多个组织的帐户可以针对特定组织。
plugins.productIntroEn: Fullmetrix lets online store owners query their e-commerce analytics in plain language. It reports orders, gross sales, net revenue, taxes, shipping, items sold, and unique, new, and returning customers across all active stores in an organization.

plugins.name: Influencers Club
plugins.productIntro: Influencers Club 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Instagram、TikTok、YouTube、X、Twitch 和 OnlyFans 上的创作者数据。用通俗易懂的语言提出问题——“在 Instagram 上寻找拥有 10 万以上粉丝且参与度超过 3% 的健身创作者”——然后获得一份排名列表，您可以据此采取行动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Influencers Club connects ChatGPT to creator data across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Twitch, and OnlyFans. Ask in plain language — "find fitness creators on Instagram with 100k+ followers and 3%+ engagement" — and get back a ranked list you can act on.

plugins.name: WaveMaster AI
plugins.productIntro: WaveMaster AI 帮助用户和代理商咨询 57 个国家和 6 大洲超过 916 个地点的冲浪预报、海况和海滩排名。该插件允许您直接在 ChatGPT 中搜索有关波浪、风、涌浪、潮汐、温度和冲浪得分的信息，并组织数据以支持快速决定何时何地冲浪。
plugins.productIntroEn: WaveMaster AI ajuda usuários e agentes a consultar previsões de surf, condições do mar e rankings de praias em mais de 916+ spots em 57 países e 6 continentes. O plugin permite buscar informações sobre ondas, vento, swell, maré, temperatura e score de surf diretamente no ChatGPT, com dados organizados para apoiar decisões rápidas sobre onde e quando surfar.

plugins.name: Subtext
plugins.productIntro: **潜台词是为代理而不是人类构建的会话重放。**
plugins.productIntroEn: **Subtext is session replay built for agents instead of humans.**

plugins.name: Pokeka
plugins.productIntro: pokeka 是分级神奇宝贝交易卡的市场参考。用简单的语言询问——甚至是像“Moonbreon”这样的收藏家昵称——并获得准确的卡标识（卡组和编号）、具有日期、30/90 天趋势和稀缺信号的代表性市场价值。它涵盖日语、英语和简体中文卡，每种语言都有单独的市场数据轨道。数据来自经过验证的拍卖结果并不断刷新。
plugins.productIntroEn: pokeka is a market reference for graded Pokémon trading cards. Ask in plain language — even collector nicknames like "Moonbreon" — and get the exact card identity (set and number), a representative market value with date, 30/90-day trend, and scarcity signals. It covers Japanese, English, and Simplified-Chinese cards with a separate market-data track for each language.

plugins.name: AirOps
plugins.description: 工艺内容。赢得人工智能搜索
plugins.productIntro: 直接通过 ChatGPT 访问您的 AirOps 工作区、品牌套件和 AEO（人工智能引擎优化）分析。监控您的品牌在人工智能搜索结果中的表现、分析引用率并优化您的内容策略。
plugins.productIntroEn: Access your AirOps workspaces, Brand Kits, and AEO (AI Engine Optimization) analytics directly through ChatGPT. Monitor your brand's performance in AI search results, analyze citation rates, and optimize your content strategy.

plugins.name: SiteTrax.io
plugins.productIntro: SiteTrax.io 是一款面向授权团队的物流运营分析应用程序。搜索共享项目和堆场，检查集装箱和供应链设备检测，检查摄像头运行状况和异常情况，分析视频和图像，检索审核反馈，并对状态、数量、活动和序列指标运行服务器端分析。查找 SiteTrax.io 物流定义并获取可用于研究的报告，包括劳动力效率、收入和成本降低机会。创建已确认的电子邮件警报和计划摘要以进行匹配检测。
plugins.productIntroEn: SiteTrax.io is a logistics operations analytics app for authorized teams. Search shared projects and yards, inspect container and supply chain equipment detections, review camera health and anomalies, analyze videos and images, retrieve audit feedback, and run server-side analytics for status, volume, activity, and sequence metrics. Look up SiteTrax.

plugins.name: Sleekplan
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 使用您的 Sleekplan 工作区 - 反馈板、路线图、变更日志和调查。
plugins.productIntroEn: Work with your Sleekplan workspace — feedback board, roadmap, changelog, and surveys — directly from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Refiner
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 Refiner 帐户以使用 ChatGPT 分析调查回复。使用自然语言发现趋势和新兴主题，总结来自 NPS、CSAT 和其他应用内调查的反馈。询问有关调查结果的问题，确定满意度的关键驱动因素，并快速显示定性反馈中的模式，以更好地了解您的用户并改进您的产品。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Refiner account to analyze survey responses with ChatGPT. Uncover trends and emerging topics, summarize feedback from NPS, CSAT, and other in-app surveys using natural language. Ask questions about your survey results, identify key drivers of satisfaction, and quickly surface patterns in qualitative feedback to better understand your users and improve your product.

plugins.name: Jepto
plugins.productIntro: Jepto 连接到您的营销堆栈，让人工智能在您的整个客户组合中发挥作用，这样您就可以花更少的时间提取报告，而有更多的时间做出重要的决策。
plugins.productIntroEn: Jepto connects to your marketing stack and puts AI to work across your entire client portfolio, so you spend less time pulling reports and more time making decisions that matter.

plugins.name: Alation
plugins.productIntro: Alation 将可信的企业数据上下文引入 ChatGPT。
plugins.productIntroEn: Alation brings trusted enterprise data context into ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Alizé
plugins.productIntro: Alizé 是一个面向法律专业人士的法律数据库和搜索引擎。通过此连接器，您的助手可以根据真实文档而不是凭记忆进行回答，并为您提供可以打开和检查的引文。
plugins.productIntroEn: Alizé is a legal database and search engine for law professionals. With this connector, your assistant answers from the real documents instead of from memory, and gives you a citation you can open and check.

plugins.name: Repuso
plugins.productIntro: Repuso 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的评论监控：从 50 多个平台（Google、TripAdvisor、Trustpilot、G2、App Store 等）获取标准化评论，每个平台都带有情绪标签和即时翻译。询问 AI 见解 - 客户称赞哪些内容以及需要解决哪些问题 - 以及每个配置文件的 AI 评论摘要。跟踪官方评级历史记录，与您监控的竞争对手资料进行比较，标记工作流程的评论，并管理新评论和评级更改事件的签名网络钩子。
plugins.productIntroEn: Repuso connects ChatGPT to your review monitoring: fetch normalized reviews from 50+ platforms (Google, TripAdvisor, Trustpilot, G2, App Store and more), each with a sentiment label and on-the-fly translation. Ask for AI insights - what customers praise and what to fix - and AI review summaries per profile.

plugins.name: Lazyweb
plugins.description: 真实的应用屏幕和 A/B 测试
plugins.originalDescription: Real app screens and A/B tests
plugins.productIntro: Lazyweb 在您设计之前为 ChatGPT 提供真实的产品证据。搜索来自顶级应用程序的 281k+ 真实屏幕和流程、20k+ 移动 A/B 测试结果以及真实的实验记录 - 然后将证据转化为行动：任何网站的增长分数、完整的增长和付费专区报告、带有托管审核的 UI 更改提案以及您的团队可以执行的增长待办事项。专为创始人、产品经理、设计师和增长团队打造，他们希望决策基于实际交付和赢得的内容，因此可以帮助他们交付有效的功能和增长实验
plugins.productIntroEn: Lazyweb gives ChatGPT real product evidence before you design. Search 281k+ real screens and flows from top apps, 20k+ mobile A/B tests with outcomes, and real experiment write-ups - then turn evidence into action: growth scores for any website, full growth and paywall reports, UI-change proposals with hosted review, and a growth backlog your team can execute.

plugins.name: Steep
plugins.description: 查询 Steep 工作区数据
plugins.productIntro: Steep 可让您查询语义层。检索指标、目标、维度和工作区数据——在工作时保持分析可访问且处于上下文中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Steep lets you query your semantic layer. Retrieve metrics, targets, dimensions, and workspace data — keeping your analytics accessible and in context while you work.

plugins.name: Property Index Dubai
plugins.productIntro: 向 ChatGPT 询问有关迪拜房地产数据的任何信息并获得明智的答复，使您能够以无限的可能性查询 1100 万+ 迪拜房地产销售和租赁记录。深受迪拜最好的房地产经纪人、投资者和房地产专业人士的喜爱。房地产指数经迪拜土地局房地产演变空间计划批准，并由官方 DLD 房地产数据提供支持。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ask ChatGPT anything about Dubai Real Estate data and get informed responses, giving you the ability to query 11m+ Dubai property sales and rental records with infinite possibilities. Loved by Dubai's best real estate brokers, investors, and property professionals.

plugins.name: Juicy Profit Analytics
plugins.productIntro: 该插件提供与 Shopify 应用程序 Juicy 统计数据的连接，其中包含利润、收入和广告支出摘要 - 以及完整的损益报告、包含成本和利润的订单列表以及包括订单项和归因接触点在内的详细订单信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: This plugin gives connect with Shopify app Juicy statistics with a summary of profit, revenue, and ad spend - plus a full Profit & Loss report, order list with costs and margins, and detailed order information including line items and attribution touchpoints.

plugins.name: Damoov Telematics
plugins.description: 探索远程信息处理数据。
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Damoov 远程信息处理数据，并将操作问题转化为清晰、可操作的见解。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to Damoov telematics data and turn operational questions into clear, actionable insights.

plugins.name: PowerDMARC
plugins.productIntro: PowerDMARC 将您的电子邮件身份验证数据带入 ChatGPT。询问任何域的安全状况并获得解释的 DMARC、SPF、DKIM、BIMI 和 MTA-STS 细分。深入研究 DMARC 汇总报告，了解谁在作为您的域发送电子邮件、哪些来源未通过身份验证，以及按国家/地区和组织列出您的邮件来自何处。
plugins.productIntroEn: PowerDMARC brings your email-authentication data into ChatGPT. Ask about any domain's security posture and get an interpreted DMARC, SPF, DKIM, BIMI, and MTA-STS breakdown. Dig into DMARC aggregate reports to see who's sending email as your domain, which sources are failing authentication, and where your mail is coming from by country and organization.

plugins.name: Technis
plugins.productIntro: Technis 是一个空间分析平台，可将您的建筑物、商店和场所转变为清晰、可操作信息的来源。
plugins.productIntroEn: Technis is a spatial analytics platform that turns your buildings, stores, and venues into a source of clear, actionable information.

plugins.name: Finseo
plugins.description: 跟踪 AI 可见性、AEO 和 GEO
plugins.productIntro: Finseo 跟踪您的品牌在人工智能搜索中的可见度——人们从 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Claude 和其他人工智能助手获得的答案。它将您的 AI 可见性、生成引擎优化 (GEO) 和答案引擎优化 (AEO) 数据直接引入 ChatGPT。
plugins.productIntroEn: Finseo tracks how visible your brand is in AI search — the answers people get from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and other AI assistants. It brings your AI visibility, generative engine optimization (GEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO) data directly into ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Daily Command
plugins.productIntro: Daily Command 持续观察您的品牌、活动、预算和市场信号，然后提出建议、路线批准、执行和衡量下一个最佳举措。商业团队停止组装仪表板并开始行动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Daily Command continuously observes your brands, campaigns, budgets, and market signals - then recommends, routes approval, executes, and measures the next best move. Where commercial teams stop assembling dashboards and start acting.

plugins.name: DataAssist-IO
plugins.productIntro: DataAssist 允许组织将上传的 CSV 和连接的数据库作为 MCP 工具公开，以便用户可以发现表、检查元数据、预览行并从 ChatGPT 运行经过验证的 SQL SELECT 查询。工具调用的范围仅限于经过身份验证的组织和用户，仅使用组织公开的表，并支持跨 CSV、SFTP、MySQL、PostgreSQL 和 S3 支持的数据源的自助分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: DataAssist lets organizations expose uploaded CSVs and connected databases as MCP tools so users can discover tables, inspect metadata, preview rows, and run validated SQL SELECT queries from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Keenable SELECT
plugins.description: 使用 SQL 研究网络
plugins.productIntro: Keenable SELECT 通过一次查询而不是十页读取来回答研究问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Keenable SELECT answers a research question with one query instead of ten page reads.

plugins.name: RED Atlas API
plugins.description: PR 和 CO 的房地产数据
plugins.originalDescription: Real estate data for PR & CO
plugins.productIntro: 索取简明语言的 RED Atlas 房地产数据。搜索和过滤波多黎各和哥伦比亚的列表、地块、房产、交易、许可证和税收；拉动市场统计数据和趋势；查找位置和边界多边形；并生成 AVM 和可比估值报告。您使用自己的 RED Atlas 帐户登录，答案基于 Atlas 数据，并带有返回应用程序的链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ask for RED Atlas real-estate data in plain language. Search and filter listings, parcels, properties, transactions, permits and taxes across Puerto Rico and Colombia; pull market statistics and trends; look up locations and boundary polygons; and generate AVM and comparables valuation reports.

plugins.name: Reevl
plugins.productIntro: 直接从聊天窗口查看韩国房地产交易数据。除了全国45,000套公寓大楼外，我们还涵盖别墅（联排、多单元）、写字楼、独栋住宅、预售权、认购、公开租赁、公开拍卖、土地和商铺/写字楼等12种类型。除了销售额，我们还看月租金（押金和月租）。提供条件搜索（面积、价格、户数、年份、出租率、站区、学区等）、仅一项总体指标、单笔实际成交明细（日期、金额、专属面积、楼层）、当前房贷监管数据（LTV、DSR、压力加成率）。
plugins.productIntroEn: 한국 부동산 실거래 데이터를 대화창에서 바로 조회합니다. 전국 아파트 45,000여 단지에 더해 빌라(연립·다세대)·오피스텔·단독다가구·분양권·청약·공공임대·공매·토지·상가/사무실까지 12개 유형을 다룹니다. 매매뿐 아니라 전월세(보증금·월세)도 함께 봅니다. 조건 검색(지역·가격·세대수·연식·전세가율·역세권·학군 등), 단지 하나의 전체 지표, 개별 실거래 내역(날짜·금액·전용면적·층), 주택담보대출 현행 규제 수치(LTV·DSR·스트레스 가산금리)를 제공합니다. 국토교통부 실거래가 공개시스템이 원천이며, 응답에 단위와 기준일을 함께 실어 값을 지어내지 않도록 합니다.

plugins.name: Collecte MTL
plugins.productIntro: Collecte MTL 会告诉您您的废物何时在蒙特利尔岛上的任何地方被收集。输入地址并获取每个流的收集时间表 - 垃圾、回收、食品和有机废物、绿色废物和大件物品 - 包括该确切部门的下一个即将到来的收集日期。
plugins.productIntroEn: Collecte MTL tells you when your waste is collected anywhere on the island of Montréal. Enter an address and get the pickup schedule for every stream — garbage, recycling, food and organic waste, green waste, and bulky items — including the next upcoming collection dates for that exact sector.

plugins.name: WisdomAI
plugins.description: 来自您管理的数据的答案
plugins.productIntro: WisdomAI 是 ChatGPT 内部的企业数据工具，用于解决复杂的分析问题，其答案必须是确定性的、可追溯的和一致的。
plugins.productIntroEn: WisdomAI is the enterprise data harness inside ChatGPT, for the complex analytical questions where the answer has to be deterministic, traceable, and consistent.

plugins.name: Tembi Intelligence
plugins.productIntro: 这个基于 MCP 服务器的插件提供了用于获取有关整个欧洲电子商务市场的见解的工具。
plugins.productIntroEn: This MCP server based plugin provides tools for getting insights about e-commerce market across Europe.

plugins.name: Crustdata
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Crustdata 通过 Chatgpt 中的单个对话搜索、丰富和观察人员和公司。使用 150 多个搜索过滤器（例如职位、行业、资金等）构建 TAM、潜在客户和候选人列表。您还可以通过 350 多个数据点丰富人员和公司资料，例如经过验证的电子邮件、完整的工作经验、教育、资金、员工人数、网络流量、职位发布等。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search, enrich and watch people and companies from a single conversation in Chatgpt with Crustdata. Build TAM, prospect and candidate lists using 150+ search filters such as job title, industry, funding and more.

plugins.name: Feedoptimise
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 管理您的产品源。连接您的帐户即可检查来源、提要、产品、属性映射和更改历史记录，而无需打开平台。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage your product feeds directly from ChatGPT. Connect your account to inspect sources, feeds, products, attribute mappings, and change history without opening the platform.

plugins.name: New Vintage
plugins.description: 您的酒庄数据集中在一处
plugins.originalDescription: Your winery data in one place
plugins.productIntro: 人工智能处理酒厂数据所需的一切。探索 Commerce7、RedChirp、Klaviyo、Mailchimp 等。使用它来报告、细分和识别收入机会。
plugins.productIntroEn: Everything your AI needs to work with your winery's data. Explore Commerce7, RedChirp, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, and more. Use it for reporting, segmentation, and identifying revenue opportunities.

plugins.name: Kanal
plugins.description: 您的 WhatsApp 营销数据
plugins.productIntro: Kanal 是一个针对电商品牌的 WhatsApp 营销平台。 连接您的 Kanal 帐户，向 ChatGPT 询问有关您 WhatsApp 营销绩效的任何信息：归因收入、ROAS 和总渠道成本、活动和自动化统计数据（具体到各个流程步骤）、受众群体和规模以及元模板批准状态。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kanal is a WhatsApp marketing platform for e-commerce brands. Connect your Kanal account to ask ChatGPT anything about your WhatsApp marketing performance: attributed revenue, ROAS and total channel cost, campaign and automation stats down to individual flow steps, audience segments and sizes, and Meta template approval status.

plugins.name: Allium
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Allium 直接在 ChatGPT 中查询和分析区块链数据。发现架构和文档，跨区块链数据集运行 SQL，并将结果转换为可共享的查询、可视化和仪表板。提出诸如“比较跨链的 DEX 交易量”、“分析该钱包的持有量和损益”或“绘制代币价格历史记录”等问题。 Allium 将历史数据集与实时市场和钱包数据相结合，通过一次对话将您从问题带到分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: Query and analyze blockchain data directly in ChatGPT with Allium. Discover schemas and documentation, run SQL across blockchain datasets, and turn results into shareable queries, visualizations, and dashboards. Ask questions like “Compare DEX volume across chains,” “Analyze this wallet’s holdings and P&L,” or “Chart a token’s price history.

plugins.name: Cleverbridge
plugins.productIntro: Cleverbridge 将电子商务洞察和优化数据引入 ChatGPT。使用自然语言分析您的 Cleverbridge 电子商务数据并发现趋势，以帮助您在短短几分钟内提高全球订阅增长。
plugins.productIntroEn: Cleverbridge brings ecommerce insights and optimization data into ChatGPT. Analyze your Cleverbridge ecommerce data with natural language and uncover trends to help improve your subscription growth globally in just a couple of minutes.

plugins.name: Infoparcelle
plugins.productIntro: 以通俗易懂的语言查询法国官方土地和房产数据：9400万份地籍 地块、实际记录销售价格 (DVF)、能源绩效证书、分区 和规划规则、建筑许可证、企业业主、公寓和企业 注册在一个地址。
plugins.productIntroEn: Query official French land and property data in plain language: 94 million cadastral parcels, actual recorded sale prices (DVF), energy performance certificates, zoning and planning rules, building permits, corporate owners, condominiums and businesses registered at an address.

plugins.name: Upspring
plugins.description: 作为 AI 背景的直播广告
plugins.productIntro: 实时广告作为人工智能的结构化、推理准备环境。 MCP 上的挂钩、声明、优惠、登陆页面以及广告商规模等级（支出、流量和销售层估算）。我们处理广告；你的人工智能会思考。
plugins.productIntroEn: Live advertising as structured, reasoning-ready context for your AI. Hooks, claims, offers, landing pages, plus advertiser scale grades (spend, traffic, and sales tier estimates) over MCP. We process the ads; your AI does the thinking.

plugins.name: Microsoft Power BI
plugins.description: 在浏览器中探索报表、制作图表和发布仪表板。
plugins.originalDescription: Explore and author analytics in your browser
plugins.productIntro: Microsoft Power BI 是微软的数据分析与报表平台。此插件通过本地浏览器操作报表、图表和仪表板，适合需要在现有 Power BI 环境中分析与制作内容的任务。
plugins.productIntroEn: Microsoft Power BI is a service that helps you explore and author analytics in your browser. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Lead Recorder
plugins.originalDescription: See where every lead came from
plugins.productIntro: 潜在客户记录器会向您显示潜在客户的实际来源。
plugins.productIntroEn: Lead Recorder shows you where your leads actually came from.

plugins.name: Muffed
plugins.description: 查找经过验证的 NFL 统计数据
plugins.productIntro: 穆菲用已经核实过的数据回答了 NFL 的问题。每个数字都来自基于 nflverse 逐场比赛、NFL 下一代统计数据和 FTN 图表数据构建的门控面板，每个响应都带有自己的来源、验证日期以及数据许可证所需的归属。
plugins.productIntroEn: Muffed answers NFL questions with figures that have already been checked. Every number comes from a gated panel built on nflverse play-by-play, NFL Next Gen Stats and FTN charting data, and every response carries its own source, the date it was verified, and the attribution the data licence requires.

plugins.name: Looki
plugins.productIntro: 将您的 Looki 记忆带入 Codex，以获得基于您现实世界背景的个性化答案。按日期浏览时刻，按含义搜索记忆，打开特定时刻及其媒体，重新访问人工智能生成的精彩片段，或检查最新的实时事件（如果有）。临时媒体链接被视为私有的、短暂的数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring your Looki memories into Codex for personalized answers grounded in your real-world context. Browse moments by date, search memories by meaning, open a specific moment and its media, revisit AI-generated highlights, or check the latest realtime event when available. Temporary media links are treated as private, short-lived data.

plugins.name: Azure Cosmos DB
plugins.productIntro: 官方 Azure Cosmos DB 插件捆绑了一组精选的代理技能，涵盖数据建模、分区键设计、查询优化、SDK 最佳实践（单客户端、批量操作、直接模式）、索引策略（复合、空间、排除未使用）、矢量搜索（DiskANN、平面、量化平面）、全文搜索（BM25、混合查询）、全局分发（多区域写入、冲突解决）、安全性（Entra ID、托管身份、RBAC、网络限制）、吞吐量和扩展（自动扩展、无服务器）、监控和诊断以及设计模式（更改源、事务批处理）。
plugins.productIntroEn: The official Azure Cosmos DB plugin bundles a curated set of agent skills covering data modeling, partition key design, query optimization, SDK best practices (singleton client, bulk operations, direct mode), indexing strategies (composite, spatial, exclude unused), vector search (DiskANN, flat, quantized flat), full-text search (BM25, hybrid queries), global distribution (multi-region w…

plugins.name: Impala
plugins.description: 非营利组织和基金会数据
plugins.productIntro: 更智能的数据，更大的影响力，就在您的人工智能工作流程中。 Impala 的连接器为您提供有关任何美国非营利组织或基金会的即时组织和资助者信息，这些信息是从包含超过 200 万个非营利组织、超过 25 万个资助者以及基于经过验证的注册机构、政府数据库和直接合作伙伴建立的超过 2500 万笔赠款的数据库中实时提取的。
plugins.productIntroEn: Smarter data, greater impact, right inside your AI workflow. Impala's connector gives you instant organization and funder intel on any U.S. nonprofit or foundation, drawn live from a database of 2M+ nonprofits, 250K+ grantmakers, and 25M+ grants built from verified registries, government databases, and direct partnerships.

plugins.name: Unwrap
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Unwrap 搜索并分析您的客户反馈。引入客户反馈主题和轶事，按元数据进行过滤并分析问题随时间变化的趋势。使用您的客户反馈来构建数据支持的路线图、PRD 等！
plugins.productIntroEn: Search and analyze your customer feedback with Unwrap. Pull in customer feedback themes and anecdotes, filter by metadata and analyze trends with issues over time. Use your customers feedback to build data backed roadmaps, PRD's, and more!

plugins.name: Logimu Shopping
plugins.description: 查找亚马逊和沃尔玛产品
plugins.productIntro: 在聊天时查找亚马逊和沃尔玛的真实产品数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Look up real product data from Amazon and Walmart while you chat.

plugins.name: Aria
plugins.productIntro: ARIA 是 ChatGPT 内的消费者情报分析师。询问有关您的类别的问题（高蛋白零食、肠道健康、护肤品、客户关心的任何事情），ARIA 会阅读数百万条基于实际帖子和视频的真实社交对话来回答问题。 不必等待数周的研究平台，而是在聊天中获得答案：什么是趋势以及原因，您的品牌相对于品类领导者的认知如何，哪些主张和吸引力会引起共鸣，以及您的受众实际要求什么。每一个见解都有其背后真实对话的支持，因此您可以信任它并据此采取行动。
plugins.productIntroEn: ARIA is your consumer-intelligence analyst inside ChatGPT. Ask a question about your category — high-protein snacking, gut health, skincare, anything your customers care about — and ARIA reads across millions of real social conversations to answer it, grounded in actual posts and videos.

plugins.name: Peaka
plugins.description: 通往 AI 就绪数据的快车道
plugins.originalDescription: The fast lane to AI-ready data
plugins.productIntro: 通过单一提示即可创建受管控、可重用的数据产品。连接 Peaka 直接从 ChatGPT 管理和查询您的表。以对话方式构建查询、监控缓存和语义目录，并通过简单描述您的需求来生成报告，将数据转化为可操作的见解，而无需离开对话。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create governed, reusable data products from a single prompt. Connect Peaka to manage and query your tables directly from ChatGPT. Build queries conversationally, monitor caches and semantic catalogs, and generate reports by simply describing what you need, turning your data into actionable insights without leaving the conversation.

plugins.name: Aurora
plugins.description: 使用 Consilio 访问数据
plugins.productIntro: Aurora 帮助授权 Consilio 用户从 ChatGPT 搜索其电子取证和法律服务数据。用户可以通过字母代码、客户名称或自由文本查找问题；在可访问内容中列出或搜索工作区；并在工作空间内运行人工智能辅助的文档搜索。结果的范围仅限于用户现有的 Consilio 访问权限，并包括适用的源链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Aurora helps authorized Consilio users search their eDiscovery and legal-services data from ChatGPT. Users can find matters by alpha-code, client name, or free text; list or search workspaces inside accessible matters; and run AI-assisted document searches within a workspace. Results are scoped to the user's existing Consilio access and include source links where applicable.

plugins.name: Recall Scout
plugins.productIntro: “我的汽车座椅被召回了吗？”值得比“去搜索两个政府网站”更好的答案。 Recall Scout 将 NHTSA 和 CPSC 召回数据库放入您的助手中 - 车辆、轮胎、儿童汽车座椅、设备和消费品，每天更新。每个答案都带有危险、补救措施和官方召回链接，因此您可以采取行动，而不仅仅是担心它。诚实的边界：食品、药品和医疗设备召回 (FDA) 不包括在内，该工具也是这么说的。免费使用。由 SimonBuilds 构建和运行。
plugins.productIntroEn: "Is my car seat recalled?" deserves a better answer than "go search two government sites." Recall Scout puts the NHTSA and CPSC recall databases inside your assistant - vehicles, tires, child car seats, equipment, and consumer products, refreshed daily. Every answer carries the hazard, the remedy, and the official recall link, so you can act on it instead of just worrying about it.

plugins.name: MyGeotab MCP
plugins.productIntro: 在 MyGeotab 中监控车辆、分析行程和驾驶员行为，并掌握整个车队的安全异常、诊断、维护、电动汽车充电和合规性。将实时数据导入 ChatGPT，然后对其采取行动：设置区域和规则、确认故障并生成报告，而无需离开对话。作为人工智能工作流程的一部分，了解超速和利用率趋势，用简单的语言回答车队问题，并将洞察转化为行动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Monitor vehicles, analyze trips and driver behavior, and stay on top of safety exceptions, diagnostics, maintenance, EV charging, and compliance across your fleet in MyGeotab. Bring that live data into ChatGPT — then act on it: set up zones and rules, acknowledge faults, and generate reports without leaving the conversation.

plugins.name: Hypha
plugins.description: 从您的文件中得到的答案
plugins.productIntro: Hypha 将您组织的文档转变为结构化、可搜索的数据。将其连接起来，就您上传的所有内容（合同、财务、报告）提出问题，并根据从这些文档中提取的实际事实获得准确的答案，每个答案都可以追溯到其来源。探索 Hypha 为您的组织组织的内容，并准确提取您需要的详细信息，从高级摘要到具体数字。
plugins.productIntroEn: Hypha turns your organization's documents into structured, searchable data. Connect it to ask questions across everything you've uploaded — contracts, financials, reports — and get precise answers grounded in the actual facts pulled from those documents, with every answer traceable back to its source.

plugins.name: Tableau
plugins.description: 搜索 Tableau 内容、查询数据并处理可视化工作簿。
plugins.productIntro: Tableau 是数据可视化与商业智能平台；其插件让 Codex 搜索工作簿和数据源、查询指标，并在获得授权后修改或发布可视化内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tableau is a service that helps you see and understand data. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Riveter
plugins.description: 构建结构化网络数据集
plugins.productIntro: Riveter 将网络研究转化为结构化数据。向 Claude 提供公司、人员或 URL 的列表，并要求提供新列：产品描述、收入、深度分析、公司人数、链接跟踪、定价、技术堆栈分析、联系方式、分类、摘要等。Riveter 每行运行一个 AI 代理，用于搜索、读取页面，并使用源答案填充每个单元格。
plugins.productIntroEn: Riveter turns web research into structured data. Give Claude a list of companies, people, or URLs and ask for new columns: product descriptions, revenue, deep analysis, company headcount, link traces, pricing, tech stack analysis, contact details, a classification, a summary, etc. Riveter runs an AI agent per row that searches, reads pages, and fills in each cell with a sourced answer.

plugins.name: Gainsight Customer Communities
plugins.description: 向 AI 询问社区见解
plugins.productIntro: Gainsight 社区 MCP 将您的客户社区连接到 ChatGPT。通过自然语言提出未解答的问题、确定内容差距并拉动参与趋势。无需等待自定义导出即可查看审核队列、浏览排行榜和审核社区结构。专为大规模管理由 Gainsight 驱动的社区的社区经理和 CS 团队而设计。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Gainsight Community MCP connects your Customer Community to ChatGPT. Surface unanswered questions, identify content gaps, and pull engagement trends through natural language. Review moderation queues, browse leaderboards, and audit community structure without waiting on a custom export. Purpose-built for community managers and CS teams managing Gainsight-powered communities at scale.

plugins.name: USAspending by 1102tools
plugins.productIntro: 由 James Jenrette / 1102tools 使用 USAspending.gov 的公共数据开发的独立非官方应用程序。此应用程序不隶属于美国政府，也不受美国政府认可。
plugins.productIntroEn: Independent, unofficial app developed by James Jenrette / 1102tools using public data from USAspending.gov. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. government.

plugins.name: eCFR by 1102tools

plugins.productIntroEn: Independent, unofficial app developed by James Jenrette / 1102tools using public data from the Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (eCFR). This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. government.

plugins.name: Keyword Tool: Free SEO Ideas
plugins.productIntro: 关键字工具为 ChatGPT 提供免费关键字研究，无需注册、API 密钥或信用卡。将种子转化为最多 1,000 个 Google 和 Bing 自动填充想法（包括建议、问题、介词和相关关键字），然后查看可用搜索量、竞争情况和热门结果的趋势数据。研究 100 多个国家和语言并随时查看您的免费配额。
plugins.productIntroEn: Keyword Tool brings free keyword research into ChatGPT with no sign-up, API key, or credit card. Turn a seed into up to 1,000 Google and Bing autocomplete ideas—including suggestions, questions, prepositions, and related keywords—then view available search volume, competition, and trend data for top results. Research 100+ countries and languages and check your free quota anytime.

plugins.name: Cargo
plugins.description: 您在 ChatGPT 中的 GTM
plugins.productIntro: Cargo 是人工智能助手的 GTM 基础设施。连接此 MCP 服务器和 ChatGPT 可以操作您的 Cargo 工作区：跨 130 多个集成发现并运行操作、执行工具和代理、查询 CRM 和收入模型，以及阅读您的团队已编写的剧本和 ICP 上下文。
plugins.productIntroEn: Cargo is GTM infrastructure for AI assistants. Connect this MCP server and ChatGPT can operate your Cargo workspace: discover and run actions across 130+ integrations, execute tools and agents, query CRM and revenue models, and read the playbooks and ICP context your team already wrote.

plugins.name: OpenRush
plugins.productIntro: 研究关键字、分析竞争对手、检查搜索排名，并使用引用的最新数据跟踪您自己网站的搜索流量。查找值得定位的关键字，了解竞争对手排名优于您的原因，审核网站是否存在技术问题，并在连接这些帐户后查看您自己的 Search Console 和分析，了解点击次数、来源和排名。对于关键词发现、竞争对手差距分析和监控一段时间内的流量很有用。
plugins.productIntroEn: Research keywords, analyze competitors, check search rankings, and track your own site's search traffic with cited, up-to-date data. Find keywords worth targeting, see why a competitor outranks you, audit a site for technical issues, and review your own Search Console and Analytics for clicks, sources, and positions after connecting those accounts.

plugins.name: Trakkr
plugins.description: 跟踪 AI 搜索可见性
plugins.productIntro: 衡量您的品牌在 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Claude 和其他 AI 搜索体验中的显示效果。使用您现有的 Trakkr 帐户查看可见性趋势、模型性能、引用差距、竞争对手、研究和优先行动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Measure how your brand appears across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and other AI search experiences. Review visibility trends, model performance, citation gaps, competitors, research, and prioritized actions using your existing Trakkr account.

plugins.name: Docket Demand MCP
plugins.description: 网站线索和人工智能聊天
plugins.productIntro: Docket Demand MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Docket 帐户，这样您就可以用简单的英语询问有关您的网站 AI 代理正在捕获的需求的问题，而无需打开仪表板。
plugins.productIntroEn: Docket Demand MCP connects ChatGPT to your Docket account so you can ask questions about the demand your website AI agents are capturing — in plain English, without opening a dashboard.

plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT with Official Statistics of India. The list of available datasets can be seen at https://datainnovation.mospi.gov.in/mospi-mcp

plugins.productIntro: 轻松发现隐藏的趋势。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover hidden trends with ease.

plugins.name: TubeAlfred
plugins.productIntro: 搜索 YouTube 并浏览 ChatGPT 中的视频、文字记录、评论、频道和播放列表。使用 TubeAlfred 总结视频、比较频道内容并识别观众评论中反复出现的主题。连接您的 TubeAlfred 帐户以访问其托管的 YouTube 工具。不需要 YouTube 数据 API 密钥。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search YouTube and explore videos, transcripts, comments, channels, and playlists from ChatGPT. Use TubeAlfred to summarize videos, compare channel content, and identify recurring themes in audience comments. Connect your TubeAlfred account to access its hosted YouTube tools. No YouTube Data API key is required.

plugins.name: ThoughtSpot SpotterCode

plugins.productIntroEn: Whether you're a developer building embedded analytics, a product leader shipping AI-powered features, or a data team managing a live data workflow, SpotterCode by ThoughtSpot is your AI pair programmer, turning instructions into execution and delivering AI analytics and management that drive the business forward.

plugins.name: Keyword Tool Pro
plugins.description: 关键词研究和 SEO 数据
plugins.productIntro: Keyword Tool Pro 为 SEO、内容和 PPC 团队将全功能关键词研究引入 ChatGPT。生成最多 1,000 个 Google 或 Bing 关键字提示，获取每个结果的搜索量、竞争情况、趋势和出价数据，分析竞争对手，并对最多 1,000 个关键字进行批量查找。研究 100 多个国家和语言。使用现有的付费 KeywordTool.io 帐户安全登录；使用遵循帐户的当前权利。
plugins.productIntroEn: Keyword Tool Pro brings full-powered keyword research into ChatGPT for SEO, content, and PPC teams. Generate up to 1,000 Google or Bing keyword ideas, get search volume, competition, trends, and bid data for every result, analyze competitors, and run bulk lookups for up to 1,000 keywords. Research 100+ countries and languages. Sign in securely with an existing paid KeywordTool.

plugins.name: Circuitry
plugins.productIntro: Circuitry 将 ChatGPT 连接到您组织的 AI 顾问，因此服务和保修团队可以直接从其工作所依赖的技术文档中获得答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Circuitry connects ChatGPT to your organization's AI Advisors, so service and warranty teams can get answers straight from the technical documentation their work depends on.

plugins.name: Farmbit
plugins.productIntro: Farmbit 将现场特定的卫星和时间证据引入 ChatGPT，以便果园团队可以决定首先在哪里进行侦察以及哪些仍需要地面确认。
plugins.productIntroEn: Farmbit brings field-specific satellite and temporal evidence into ChatGPT so orchard teams can decide where to scout first and what still needs ground confirmation.

plugins.name: Savri
plugins.description: 网络、Google 和 Bing 分析
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 Savri 或 Besökskollen 帐户，以探索您可以访问的网站的访客、流量来源、页面、目标和渠道。连接网站仪表板中的 Google Search Console 或 Bing 网站管理员工具，以读取搜索点击、印象、查询、页面和趋势。 Google 使用共享站点连接； Bing 对每个站点使用您自己的连接。搜索报告可从 Basic 获得。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Savri or Besökskollen account to explore visitors, traffic sources, pages, goals and funnels for sites you can access. Connect Google Search Console or Bing Webmaster Tools in the site dashboard to read search clicks, impressions, queries, pages and trends. Google uses the shared site connection; Bing uses your own connection for each site.

plugins.name: Data Market
plugins.productIntro: 查看巴西在线零售的价格、供货情况和产品历史记录。比较连锁店、商店和渠道之间的相同产品，找到最便宜的地方并监控价格随时间的变化。 Data Market 汇集了每天从 250 多家连锁超市、批发商和区域零售商收集的数据。对可用数据和资源的访问取决于每个用户的数据市场帐户计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: Consulte preços, disponibilidade e histórico de produtos no varejo online no Brasil. Compare o mesmo produto entre redes, lojas e canais, encontre onde está mais barato e acompanhe a variação de preços ao longo do tempo. A Data Market reúne dados coletados diariamente em mais de 250 redes de supermercados, atacarejos e varejistas regionais.

plugins.name: Hologrow

plugins.productIntroEn: Hologrow makes your connected commerce, advertising, analytics, and ERP data available for analysis. Explore performance, compare channels, investigate changes, and create reports using natural language.

plugins.productIntroEn: Agentio is the AI-native platform for Creator advertising. Brands buy Creator media across YouTube, Meta, and beyond.

plugins.name: LocationLists
plugins.productIntro: LocationLists 编制了品牌在其自己的官方商店或经销商定位器中发布的完整地点列表（Bobcat、Caterpillar、STIHL、Generac、Home Depot、Waffle House 等 260 多个）以及按州和协会成员名录列出的授权贸易承包商。

plugins.name: Churn Solution

plugins.productIntroEn: Churn Solution's MCP server gives AI assistants secure access to your cancellation and retention data. Using natural language, investigate why customers leave, measure the impact of your cancel flows, identify at-risk accounts and revenue, track retention trends, and answer complex questions about your subscription business.

plugins.name: Net Zero Insights

plugins.productIntroEn: Research and assess emerging climate and energy markets directly within your AI tool. Discover and screen companies, compare competitors and vendors, conduct first-pass due diligence, build market maps, identify relevant investors, analyse funding activity, and explore commercial agreements, infrastructure projects and corporate activity using Net Zero Insights data.

plugins.name: DolphinX

plugins.productIntroEn: SAGE helps fantasy football players make weekly and draft decisions using Inner Sanctum rankings and analysis. Compare players for start/sit and flex decisions, view weekly positional rankings, get lineup recommendations for a linked league, evaluate individual players, and get draft outlooks based on scoring format and roster context.

plugins.name: Fullstory

plugins.name: RainVis Hourly Weather Charts
