plugins.productIntroEn: RainVis turns hourly weather data into an interactive seven-day forecast chart. It shows rain probability together with forecast accumulation for each hour, helping people distinguish a slight chance from expected measurable rain and understand whether the forecast suggests drizzle, steady rain, heavy rain, or a downpour.

plugins.name: Dash Social

plugins.name: ECDB
plugins.description: 在 ChatGPT 中使用 ECDB
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中使用您的 ECDB 订阅。无需离开您的工作流程，即可充分利用 ECDB 电子商务市场情报（基于数十亿笔真实交易和数千个其他来源）。查询 100 多个国家/地区的零售商收入、市场规模、类别排名和交易 KPI。对竞争对手进行基准测试、确定市场规模、确定表现最佳的零售商并研究市场进入机会。基于交易，而不是基于调查。每月更新。非常适合战略团队、分析师、顾问以及任何快速需要可靠电子商务数据的人。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use your ECDB subscription directly in ChatGPT. Access the full power of ECDB's e-commerce market intelligence — based on billions of real transactions and thousands of other sources — without leaving your workflow. Query retailer revenues, market sizes, category rankings, and transaction KPIs across 100+ countries.

plugins.name: smart-me
plugins.description: 读取仪表和电动汽车充电
plugins.productIntro: smart-me 是一个建筑物计量平台。该应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到 smart-me 帐户，因此您可以用普通语言询问您的仪表，而无需打开门户。
plugins.productIntroEn: smart-me is a metering platform for buildings. This app connects ChatGPT to a smart-me account, so you can ask about your meters in ordinary language instead of opening the portal.

plugins.name: PerceptionX
plugins.productIntro: PerceptionX 帮助雇主品牌、人才招聘和沟通团队了解领先的人工智能平台如何描述其组织。使用连接的 PerceptionX 组织中的可用数据探索雇主认知分数、情绪、可见性、重复主题、引用来源、竞争对手提及、市场差异和季度趋势。
plugins.productIntroEn: PerceptionX helps employer-brand, talent-acquisition, and communications teams understand how leading AI platforms describe their organization. Explore employer perception scores, sentiment, visibility, recurring themes, cited sources, competitor mentions, market differences, and quarterly trends using the data available in your connected PerceptionX organization.

plugins.name: RainbowStats
plugins.productIntro: RainbowStats 帮助用户在对话中检索、转换、分析和可视化经济和金融时间序列数据。它提供对 FRED 和其他公共数据库的访问，并支持统计脚本、回归、关联、预测、分布分析和交互式图表。
plugins.productIntroEn: RainbowStats helps users retrieve, transform, analyze, and visualize economic and financial time-series data in conversation. It provides access to FRED and other public databases and supports statistical scripting, regression, correlation, forecasting, distribution analysis, and interactive charts.

plugins.name: ProfileID
plugins.description: 人工智能驱动的职业洞察
plugins.productIntro: ProfileID 是由 GenuineIN 提供支持的值得信赖的数字职业档案。它将经过验证的教育、技能、能力、经验、证书、项目、认证和职业证据连接到一份智能档案中。通过 ChatGPT，用户可以安全地访问和使用其 ProfileID 数据进行职业指导、技能差距分析、工作准备、简历和作品集创建、机会匹配和个性化职业建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: ProfileID is a trusted digital career profile powered by GenuineIN. It connects verified education, skills, competencies, experience, credentials, projects, certifications, and career evidence into one intelligent profile.

plugins.name: viral.app
plugins.productIntro: Viral.app 跟踪并分析 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube 和 Facebook 上的 UGC 表现。该插件将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到您的 Viral.app 工作区：查询跟踪帐户和视频分析、构建排行榜和 KPI 报告、管理跟踪、使用标签和标签工作流程组织内容、阅读 Creator Hub 活动以及在需要当前数据时提取实时平台数据。登录通过 OAuth 运行，并且仅限于一个 Viral.
plugins.productIntroEn: viral.app tracks and analyzes UGC performance across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your viral.app workspace: query tracked account and video analytics, build leaderboards and KPI reports, manage tracking, organize content with tags and tag workflows, read Creator Hub campaigns, and pull live platform data when you need current numbers.

plugins.name: Parse.ly
plugins.productIntro: Parse.ly 是内容分析平台，出版商和营销团队用它来了解其内容的表现。此应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Parse.ly 帐户，因此您可以用简单的语言询问有关您的网站的问题，并从您的真实数据中获得答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Parse.ly is the content analytics platform that publishers and marketing teams use to see how their content performs. This app connects ChatGPT to your Parse.ly account, so you can ask questions about your sites in plain language and get answers from your real data.

plugins.name: Adzviser Amazon Seller Central
plugins.description: 谈谈您的亚马逊销售数据
plugins.originalDescription: Talk to your Amazon sales data
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Adzviser 将您的 Amazon Seller Central 数据连接到 ChatGPT。用简单的语言提出问题，以跟踪销售、监控订单并了解您的产品在市场上的表现如何。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Amazon Seller Central data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to track sales, monitor orders, and see how your products are performing across marketplaces.

plugins.name: Blockworks
plugins.description: 查找加密货币和区块链数据
plugins.productIntro: 将市场数据、基本面、研究、新闻、信号、事件和筹款数据直接引入您的投资工作流程。通过一个集成的加密智能源为您的模型、仪表板、警报和 AI 代理提供支持。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bring market data, fundamentals, research, news, signals, events, and fundraising data directly into your investment workflows. Power your models, dashboards, alerts, and AI agents with one integrated source of crypto intelligence.

plugins.name: MerchantFlow
plugins.productIntro: MerchantFlow 将 ChatGPT 连接到 MerchantFlow 工作区中的电子商务数据。探索损益、比较期间、按净利润对产品进行排名、审查广告支出并衡量商品成本覆盖率。其他功能包括订单、客户终身价值、库存、商店审核和报告。
plugins.productIntroEn: MerchantFlow connects ChatGPT to the ecommerce data in your MerchantFlow workspace. Explore profit and loss, compare periods, rank products by net profit, review ad spend, and measure cost-of-goods coverage. Additional capabilities cover orders, customer lifetime value, inventory, store audits, and reports.

plugins.name: DoveVannoINostriSoldi
plugins.productIntro: 探索 DoveVannoINostriSoldi 上提供的意大利公共数据。发现数据集、过滤器和覆盖范围，然后查询公共支出、收入、福利和其他指标及其来源、期间、单位和限制。该服务是只读的：它不进行付款或更改数据。每个数据快照都有自己的报告周期和更新日期。在线资源可能暂时不可用。差异或不寻常的价值观并不证明浪费、欺诈或个人责任。
plugins.productIntroEn: Explore the Italian public data available on DoveVannoINostriSoldi. Discover datasets, filters and coverage, then query public spending, revenue, benefits and other indicators with their sources, periods, units and limitations. The service is read-only: it does not make payments or change data. Each data snapshot has its own reporting period and update date.

plugins.name: InfiniteWatch
plugins.productIntro: InfiniteWatch 将语音通话、文本对话和网络会话中的客户交互数据和操作上下文直接引入 ChatGPT。授权销售、客户支持、质量保证、客户体验和运营团队可以提出自然语言问题来发现主要问题、查找支持示例、分析趋势、比较渠道、识别运营风险、评估代理绩效、访问相关操作指南并总结客户互动。
plugins.productIntroEn: InfiniteWatch brings customer interaction data and operational context from voice calls, text conversations, and web sessions directly into ChatGPT. Authorized sales, customer support, QA, CX, and operations teams can ask natural-language questions to uncover top issues, find supporting examples, analyze trends, compare channels, identify operational risks, evaluate agent performance, ac…

plugins.name: CryptoSocials
plugins.description: 研究 Crypto X 讨论
plugins.productIntro: 研究存储了与您的代理人的 Crypto X 讨论。发现正在讨论哪些资产，探索作者历史，按已知的链关联进行过滤，并按照源链接检查证据。从整个时期的总结开始，用紧凑的结果缩小问题范围，并在需要时检索详细的帖子。比较讨论活动并检查可用的价格历史记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: Research stored Crypto X discussions with your agent. Discover which assets are being discussed, explore author history, filter by known chain associations, and follow source links to inspect the evidence. Start with whole-period summaries, narrow questions with compact results, and retrieve detailed posts when needed. Compare discussion activity and inspect available price history.

plugins.name: Microstat
plugins.description: 社交媒体统计数据和帖子
plugins.productIntro: Microstat 将社交媒体分析引入 ChatGPT。探索互联社区、比较可用的关注者趋势和帖子表现、搜索收集的帖子以及导出报告。通过 URL 比较受支持的公共 VK、Telegram 和 Odnoklassniki 社区的最新帖子。使用存档的帖子和批准的品牌知识作为起草副本的背景。可用指标和历史覆盖范围取决于平台、授予的访问权限和收集的数据；不可用的指标被报告为缺失。 Microstat 不会发布或删除社交媒体帖子。
plugins.productIntroEn: Microstat brings social media analytics into ChatGPT. Explore connected communities, compare available follower trends and post performance, search collected posts, and export reports. Compare recent posts from supported public VK, Telegram and Odnoklassniki communities by URL. Use archived posts and approved brand knowledge as context for drafting copy.

plugins.name: ConvRadar: CRO for GA4
plugins.description: 审核您的 GA4 转化率
plugins.productIntro: ConvRadar 可以找到您的网站失去转化的位置，并对首先要修复的内容进行排名。
plugins.productIntroEn: ConvRadar finds where your site loses conversions and ranks what to fix first.

plugins.name: Normalic Assistant
plugins.productIntro: Normalic Assistant 将 ChatGPT 连接到您组织的 Normalic 帐户，因此您可以在不离开对话的情况下询问您的制造数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Normalic Assistant connects ChatGPT to your organization's Normalic account, so you can ask about your manufacturing data without leaving the conversation.

plugins.name: Flippo AI
plugins.productIntro: Flippo 将经销商的库存、采购和销售信息保存在一个地方。
plugins.productIntroEn: Flippo keeps a reseller's inventory, purchases and sales in one place.

plugins.name: HOT AI搜車
plugins.description: 搜尋與比較公開在售中古車
plugins.originalDescription: 搜尋與比較公開在售中古車
plugins.productIntro: HOT AI搜車：搜尋與比較公開在售中古車。
plugins.productIntroEn: HOT AI搜車協助使用者依品牌、車款、預算、年份、里程、車身型式、燃料種類、座位數、保固條件及車商所在地，搜尋並比較目前公開在售的中古車。搜尋結果來自HOT大聯盟的第一方公開庫存；此工具不提供中古車估價、市場行情判定、預約、交易或聯絡車商功能。

plugins.name: Versive
plugins.description: 进行调查和人工智能访谈
plugins.productIntro: Versive允许您从ChatGPT运行AI审核的用户研究。 创建将固定调查问题（多项选择、评分、NPS、排名）与自适应AI访谈问题相结合的研究，使用问题组和分支逻辑进行组织，并分享参与者作为对话式访谈的链接。 无需离开聊天，即可收到回复、检查完成和下车统计数据、每个问题的汇总和个人面试成绩单，或将所有内容导出为CSV。
plugins.productIntroEn: Versive lets you run AI-moderated user research from ChatGPT. Create studies that combine fixed survey questions (multiple choice, ratings, NPS, ranking) with adaptive AI-interview questions, organize them with question groups and branching logic, and share a link that participants take as a conversational interview.

plugins.name: Momently
plugins.productIntro: Momently：询问您的发布商数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Momently is the data platform for modern publishers. It connects social, web, newsletter, and ad platforms in one place and turns them into live dashboards, branded campaign reports, and benchmarks. This plugin gives Momently customers a direct line to that data from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: EBHOOM EMS
plugins.productIntro: EBHOOM EMS 是授权工业用户的只读环境监测助手。它连接到 EBHOOM 环境管理系统，提供实时站状态、当前参数读数、超标、每日平均值和最近的数据差距信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: EBHOOM EMS is a read-only environmental monitoring assistant for authorized industrial users. It connects to the EBHOOM Environmental Management System to provide live station status, current parameter readings, exceedances, daily averages, and recent data-gap information.

plugins.name: Omnia
plugins.productIntro: Omnia 是一个生成式引擎优化（GEO）平台，用于追踪 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity 等 AI 模型如何理解和引用你的品牌。连接 Omnia 后，可以查询品牌可见度、声量占比、情感趋势以及大语言模型输出中的引用数据；比较品牌与竞争对手在 AI 回答中的表现，追踪各提示词随时间变化的效果，并获取结构化分析，为内容和品牌定位策略提供依据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Omnia is a GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) platform that tracks how AI models like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity perceive and cite your brand. Connect to Omnia to query brand visibility metrics, share of voice, sentiment trends, and citation data across LLM outputs.

plugins.name: TitanSigma
plugins.productIntro: TitanSigma：生成和发布报告。
plugins.productIntroEn: TitanSigma unifies all your data and sends it to your BI tool, simplifying how you track KPIs and metrics. No more digging through spreadsheets or chasing down reports. Just clear numbers your team can use to run the business better.

plugins.name: YPulse Insights
plugins.productIntro: YPulse 是一项专注于 Z 世代和千禧一代（13-39 岁）的研究服务，涵盖北美和西欧的青少年、青少年、大学生、年轻人和年轻父母，拥有十多年的联合调查数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: YPulse is a research service focused on Gen Z and Millennials (ages 13–39) — covering tweens, teens, college students, young adults, and young parents across North America and Western Europe, with over a decade of syndicated survey data.

plugins.name: Personyze
plugins.productIntro: Personyze 是一个 Web 个性化和 A/B 测试平台。此应用程序可让 ChatGPT 直接与您的 Personyze 帐户配合使用：了解营销活动的执行情况、检查和起草个性化操作、搜索和更新访客资料以及管理受众 - 在对话中，无需编写代码或打开面板。
plugins.productIntroEn: Personyze is a web personalization and A/B testing platform. This app lets ChatGPT work with your Personyze account directly: read how campaigns are performing, inspect and draft personalization actions, search and update visitor profiles, and manage audiences — in conversation, without writing code or opening the panel.

plugins.name: Vibewatch
plugins.description: 您所在社区的氛围，得分
plugins.productIntro: Vibewatch：您所在社区的氛围，得分。
plugins.productIntroEn: Give ChatGPT access to your community's vibe. Vibewatch is community intelligence for web3 teams: it reads your community across Discord, Telegram, X, and more, scores the vibe, surfaces daily insights, and writes weekly reports.

plugins.name: ラッコキーワード
plugins.description: キーワード/競合分析ツール（SEO・マーケティング調査）
plugins.originalDescription: キーワード/競合分析ツール（SEO・マーケティング調査）
plugins.productIntro: ラッコキーワード：キーワード/競合分析ツール（SEO・マーケティング調査）。
plugins.productIntroEn: ラッコキーワード（RakkoKeyword）は、日本最大級のキーワードリサーチツールです。このプラグインを使うと、ChatGPTとの会話から直接キーワードリサーチとSEO分析を実行できます。

plugins.name: Otnox
plugins.productIntro: Otnox 帮助供应商直接在 ChatGPT 中寻找和评估公共采购机会。
plugins.productIntroEn: Otnox helps suppliers find and assess public procurement opportunities directly in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Laup
plugins.productIntro: Laup：跟踪AI如何向您推荐。
plugins.productIntroEn: Laup tracks how ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot and Claude answer the buying questions your customers ask, and whether they recommend your business or a competitor. This plugin brings that data into ChatGPT so you can explore it in conversation.

plugins.name: Enrow
plugins.description: 查找并验证联系人数据
plugins.productIntro: Enrow：查找并验证联系人数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Enrow looks up and verifies professional contact details for specific, named business contacts, using the Enrow account of the user.

plugins.name: BigQuery
plugins.productIntro: 使用 BigQuery 通过提供程序本机连接器检查项目、数据集、表、作业、例程、模型、行访问策略、IAM 和查询结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use BigQuery to inspect projects, datasets, tables, jobs, routines, models, row access policies, IAM, and query results through the provider-native connector.

plugins.name: Databricks Genie
plugins.productIntro: 利用 Genie 分析 Databricks 数据并检查或操作选定的工作区对象、作业、Lakeflow 管道、计算、仪表板、MLflow 实验和服务端点。
plugins.productIntroEn: Leverage Genie to analyze Databricks data and inspect or operate on selected workspace objects, jobs, Lakeflow pipelines, compute, dashboards, MLflow experiments, and serving endpoints.

plugins.name: Snowflake
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Snowflake 通过提供者本机连接器检查数据库、模式、表、仓库、Cortex 搜索资源、Snowpark 容器服务、托管 MCP 服务器、客户定义的 MCP 工具和 SQL 语句结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use Snowflake to inspect databases, schemas, tables, warehouses, Cortex Search resources, Snowpark Container Services, managed MCP servers, customer-defined MCP tools, and SQL statement results through the provider-native connector.

plugins.name: Metabase
plugins.description: 查询和探索您的元数据库数据
plugins.originalDescription: Query and explore your Metabase data
plugins.productIntro: 搜索表和指标、运行查询、探索字段值、启动实例以及嵌入仪表板
plugins.productIntroEn: Search tables and metrics, run queries, explore field values, spin up instances, and embed dashboards

plugins.name: Sigma
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 界面探索、搜索、查询数据并在 Sigma 中构建应用程序和仪表板。您可以在整个组织中搜索相关文档和元素，回答和迭代复杂的数据问题，并使用自然语言执行详细分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: Explore, search, query your data, and build applications and dashboards in Sigma directly from the ChatGPT interface. You can search across your organization for relevant documents and elements, answer and iterate on complex data questions, and perform detailed analysis using natural language.

plugins.name: Gmail
plugins.description: 读取、搜索、整理并管理 Gmail。
plugins.productIntro: Gmail 是 Google 提供的电子邮件服务，支持收发邮件、搜索历史、整理收件箱和管理邮件线程；在 Codex 中适合处理需要读取或起草邮件的工作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Gmail is Google’s email service for sending, receiving, searching, and organizing messages; in Codex it is useful when a task needs inbox context or draft replies.

plugins.name: Outlook Email
plugins.description: 整理和处理 Outlook 收件箱。
plugins.productIntro: Outlook Email 是 Microsoft 的电子邮件服务，连接收件箱、联系人和邮件线程；在 Codex 中适合整理邮件、提取行动项和起草回复。
plugins.productIntroEn: Outlook Email is Microsoft’s email service for inboxes, contacts, and message threads; in Codex it is useful for organizing mail, extracting action items, and drafting replies.

plugins.name: Slack
plugins.description: 读取和管理 Slack 消息与频道。
plugins.productIntro: Slack 是一款将团队沟通、文件共享和各类办公工具整合在一起的协作软件，你可以把它理解为一个“数字总部”——工作相关的对话按项目或主题分到不同频道，历史记录会自动存档并可搜索。它还能连接 Google Drive 等外部工具，让沟通、看文件和协作集中在一个地方。Slack 于 2013 年发布，目前隶属于 Salesforce，是远程和混合办公中常见的团队协作平台；在 Codex 中适合检索频道信息、总结讨论和整理行动项。
plugins.productIntroEn: Slack is a collaboration platform that brings team communication, file sharing, and workplace tools together. Think of it as a digital headquarters: work conversations are organized into project or topic channels, automatically archived, and searchable. It connects with tools such as Google Drive so teams can communicate, view files, and collaborate in one place. Launched in 2013, Slack is now part of Salesforce and is widely used by remote and hybrid teams; in Codex it is useful for retrieving channel context, summarizing discussions, and organizing action items.

plugins.name: Superhuman Mail
plugins.description: 处理邮件、日历与收件箱工作流。
plugins.productIntro: Superhuman Mail 的主要用途是处理邮件、日历与收件箱工作流。 连接 Super human Mail，跨 Gmail、Outlook 和 Google 日历构建强大的工作流程。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Superhuman Mail is a service that helps you best email+calendar assistant. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Teams
plugins.description: 总结 Teams 内容并跟进行动项。
plugins.productIntro: Teams 的主要用途是总结 Teams 内容并跟进行动项。 使用 Teams 通过连接的 Microsoft Teams 应用程序总结聊天、提取操作以及起草频道或会议后续内容。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Teams is a service that helps you summarize Teams and follow up. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Hostinger Mail
plugins.description: 读取和处理 Hostinger 邮箱。
plugins.productIntro: Hostinger Mail 的主要用途是读取和处理 Hostinger 邮箱。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Hostinger Mail is a service that helps you use Hostinger Mail. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Zoom
plugins.description: 提炼 Zoom 会议中的重点与行动项。
plugins.productIntro: Zoom 的主要用途是提炼 Zoom 会议中的重点与行动项。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Zoom is a service that helps you smart meeting insights from Zoom. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Mailopoly Inbox
plugins.productIntro: Mailopoly Inbox 的主要用途是搜索、发送邮件与消息。 Mailopoly 将受支持的电子邮件帐户和消息服务整合到一个统一的收件箱中。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Mailopoly Inbox is a service that helps you search, send emails & messages. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Rhythm AI Personality Tuner
plugins.description: 调整 ChatGPT 的语气、直接程度和回复细节。
plugins.originalDescription: Tune how ChatGPT talks to you
plugins.productIntro: Rhythm AI Personality Tuner 用一组偏好设置调整 ChatGPT 的沟通语气、详略和直接程度，更偏向对话体验配置。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rhythm AI Personality Tuner is a service that helps you tune how ChatGPT talks to you. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: AI Roleplay Chat Simulator
plugins.description: 模拟不同角色与情境，练习对话和沟通。
plugins.productIntro: AI Roleplay Chat Simulator 的主要用途是模拟不同角色与情境，练习对话和沟通。 随时随地与任何人交谈，没有压力。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: AI Roleplay Chat Simulator is a service that helps you practice conversation+dialogue. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: RingCentral Phone
plugins.description: 处理电话、短信和语音信箱。
plugins.productIntro: RingCentral Phone 的主要用途是处理电话、短信和语音信箱。 RingCentral Phone 可帮助您直接从 ChatGPT 管理您的个人 RingCentral 通信。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: RingCentral Phone is a service that helps you calls, SMS, and voicemail. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Brevo
plugins.productIntro: 连接 Brevo 即可分析电子邮件营销活动绩效和 A/B 测试结果、查找联系人并以简单语言探索受众群体，所有这些都无需离开您的对话。 ChatGPT 还可以生成 HTML 电子邮件模板、电子邮件活动草稿和短信活动草稿，直接保存到您的 Brevo 帐户，供您在发送前查看。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect Brevo to analyze email campaign performance and A/B test results, look up contacts, and explore audience segments in plain language, all without leaving your conversation. ChatGPT can also generate HTML email templates, draft email campaigns, and draft SMS campaigns, saved directly to your Brevo account for you to review before sending.

plugins.name: LinkedIn Headline Rewriter
plugins.description: 重写你的 LinkedIn 标题
plugins.productIntro: 您的 LinkedIn 标题是任何人在您的个人资料上看到的第一行。这个应用程序以三种方式重写了它：一种版本忠实于您告诉我们的内容，一种在解释上进行了小小的飞跃，一种是更大胆的观点。每个都有一个简短的理由，这样你就可以明白它为什么有效。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your LinkedIn Headline is the first line anyone reads on your profile. This app rewrites it three ways: one version faithful to what you told us, one that takes a small interpretive leap, and one bolder point of view. Each comes with a short rationale so you can see why it works.

plugins.name: Prezi
plugins.productIntro: Prezi 的插件采用您已有的幻灯片（在 ChatGPT 中制作、在其他工具中生成、或以 PowerPoint 或 PDF 形式上传），并将它们放置在 Prezi 的开放式可缩放画布上，将平面幻灯片转变为高度可视化的交互式演示文稿。您将获得一整套超越静态幻灯片的演示、参与和共享工具：民意调查、测验和问答等参与功能可以帮助您教学、销售并在幻灯片制作后很长时间内让您的想法受到关注。
plugins.productIntroEn: Prezi's plugin takes slides you already have, made in ChatGPT, generated in another tool, or uploaded as a PowerPoint or PDF, and places them on Prezi's open, zoomable canvas, turning a flat deck into a highly visual, interactive presentation.

plugins.name: Orbismo
plugins.description: 建立一个你的人工智能知道的世界
plugins.originalDescription: Build a world your AI knows
plugins.productIntro: 跟踪构成您的世界的人物、地点、事件和细节。您使用的任何人工智能都可以在任何聊天中利用它，因此您永远不必重新开始，无论您是单独构建还是引入整个团队。 Orbismo 让一切在您拥有、定制和共享的世界中保持互联。
plugins.productIntroEn: Keep track of the people, places, events, and details that make up your world. Any AI you use can draw on it in any chat, so you never have to start over, whether you build solo or bring in your whole team. Orbismo keeps it all connected in a world you own, customize, and share.

plugins.name: Send Postcard
plugins.description: 设计并邮寄真正的明信片
plugins.productIntro: 发送明信片可让您设计一张实体明信片并将其发送到世界任何地方，所有这一切都可以在对话中进行。打开内置编辑器撰写消息并选择图像，然后通过安全的 Stripe 结账下订单。确认付款后，订单将直接发送给负责打印、寻址和交付的打印和邮件合作伙伴。您会在每个阶段获得实时状态更新：待处理、已发货、退款或过期。人们喜欢用它来表达生日祝福、旅行笔记、感谢卡以及在不离开聊天室的情况下与家人保持联系。
plugins.productIntroEn: Send Postcard lets you design a physical postcard and send it anywhere in the world, all from within a conversation. Open the built-in editor to compose your message and choose your image, then place an order through a secure Stripe checkout. Once payment is confirmed, the order goes straight to a print-and-mail partner who handles printing, addressing, and delivery.

plugins.name: Inkbox
plugins.description: AI 电子邮件、电话和 iMessage
plugins.productIntro: Inkbox 为人工智能助手提供了自己的通信身份：电子邮件地址、电话号码、短信和 iMessage 以及语音呼叫，人类和其他代理都可以联系。助理从自己的收件箱中读取和发送信息，处理自己的电话和短信，并保存通讯录和记录对话之间上下文的笔记。 Inkbox 上的两个助手还可以通过 Agent2Agent 协议轻松地直接互相发送消息，无需任何人在他们之间传递笔记。
plugins.productIntroEn: Inkbox gives an AI assistant its own communication identity: an email address, a phone number, SMS and iMessage, and voice calls, reachable by humans and other agents alike. The assistant reads and sends from its own inbox, handles its own calls and texts, and keeps a contact book and notes that carry context between conversations.

plugins.name: TIM Brasil
plugins.productIntro: 比较 planos 和 encontre o melhor pra você
plugins.productIntroEn: Compare planos e encontre o melhor pra você

plugins.name: Kepler
plugins.productIntro: Kepler 使 ChatGPT 能够安全地访问您在网络上保存的个人和团队知识 - 链接、页面、视频、图像、注释、注释和参考文献。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kepler gives ChatGPT secure access to the personal and team knowledge you have saved across the web — links, pages, videos, images, notes, annotations, and references.

plugins.name: Turnfeed
plugins.productIntro: Turnfeed 是 ChatGPT 内的公共社交源。查看最近的帖子、打开完整对话以及无需登录即可查找人员。连接您的 Turnfeed 身份即可发帖、回复、点赞、关注、更新您的个人资料以及使用安全控制。在进行任何更改之前，ChatGPT 会显示操作以供批准。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turnfeed is a public social feed inside ChatGPT. See recent posts, open full conversations, and find people without signing in. Connect your Turnfeed identity to post, reply, like, follow, update your profile, and use safety controls. Before anything changes, ChatGPT shows the action for approval.

plugins.name: Fyxer
plugins.description: 用你的声音写电子邮件
plugins.productIntro: Fyxer for Codex 可让您直接在聊天中编写听起来像您的电子邮件。 Fyxer 从过去的电子邮件中了解您的写作风格，并使用您的日历和会议记录中的上下文来创建个性化的电子邮件草稿。只需描述您想说的内容，然后准备一封精美的电子邮件以供审阅和发送。
plugins.productIntroEn: Fyxer for Codex lets you write emails that sound like you, right from the chat. Fyxer learns your writing style from past emails and uses context from your calendar and meeting notes to create personalized email drafts. Just describe what you want to say and get a polished email ready to review and send.

plugins.name: Textmagic
plugins.description: 发送短信和管理联系人。
plugins.productIntro: Textmagic 将商业短信带入您的人工智能助手。发送和安排短信、发送前预览费用和收件人、跟踪递送情况以及在不离开聊天的情况下阅读收到的回复。还可以管理您的地址簿：搜索联系人、创建和更新联系人、组织列表和标签。每次发送之前都会经过预览和确认，并且消息传递始终尊重您的帐户余额和权限。非常适合预约提醒、警报、跟进和快速客户回复。
plugins.productIntroEn: Textmagic brings business SMS into your AI assistant. Send and schedule text messages, preview cost and recipients before sending, track delivery, and read incoming replies without leaving the chat. Manage your address book too: search contacts, create and update them, organize lists and tags.

plugins.name: NoPressure
plugins.productIntro: NoPressure 是一种针对工作场所的沟通技巧实践。它将一场艰难的对话变成了一场现场语音角色扮演，你可以在真正的对话之前排练：提供关键反馈、拒绝请求、处理绩效评估、回击利益相关者、谈判加薪、与新团队进行第一次 1:1 的讨论。
plugins.productIntroEn: NoPressure is a communication-skills practice for the workplace. It turns a hard conversation into a live voice roleplay you can rehearse before the real one: delivering critical feedback, saying no to a request, handling a performance review, pushing back on a stakeholder, negotiating a raise, running a first 1:1 with a new team.

plugins.name: Klaxoon
plugins.productIntro: Klaxoon MCP 帮助用户阅读、总结、组织和更新 Klaxoon 白板，帮助团队准备研讨会、构建想法并通过 ChatGPT 将白板内容转化为可操作的输出。
plugins.productIntroEn: Klaxoon MCP helps users read, summarize, organize, and update Klaxoon whiteboards, helping teams prepare workshops, structure ideas, and turn board content into actionable outputs through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Breakreach
plugins.productIntro: Breakreach 将您的社交媒体帐户连接到 ChatGPT。在 12 个平台（X、Instagram、TikTok、Facebook、Threads、LinkedIn、YouTube、 Pinterest、Bluesky、Reddit、Telegram、Discord）直接来自对话。插件 找到您的下一个免费发帖时段，从 URL 上传媒体，并返回统一分析 （查看、点赞、评论、分享）您发布的帖子。需要 Breakreach 帐户 与关联的社交帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: Breakreach connects your social media accounts to ChatGPT. Create, schedule and publish posts across 12 platforms (X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, YouTube, Pinterest, Bluesky, Reddit, Telegram, Discord) directly from a conversation.

plugins.name: RingCentral Chat
plugins.productIntro: RingCentral Chat 可帮助您直接从 ChatGPT 管理您的 RingCentral Team Chat 协作。跟进最近的对话、阅读帖子和共享文件、查看笔记、任务和事件、查找同事并检查团队，而无需在工具之间切换。它专为希望以更快的方式了解情况并与团队协作的 RingCentral 用户而设计。
plugins.productIntroEn: RingCentral Chat helps you manage your RingCentral Team Chat collaboration directly from ChatGPT. Catch up on recent conversations, read posts and shared files, review notes, tasks, and events, find coworkers, and inspect teams without jumping between tools. It is designed for RingCentral users who want a faster way to stay informed and collaborate with their teams.

plugins.name: Geekbot
plugins.description: 举行站立会议和民意调查
plugins.productIntro: 在 Slack 和 Microsoft Teams 中运行异步站立、团队更新、签到、投票、调查并获取进度摘要。
plugins.productIntroEn: Run async standups, team updates, check-ins, polls, surveys, and get progress summaries in Slack and Microsoft Teams.

plugins.name: Publora
plugins.description: 发布到 10 个社交网络
plugins.productIntro: Publora 允许 ChatGPT 在十个网络上发布和安排您的社交媒体帖子：LinkedIn、X、Instagram、Threads、TikTok、YouTube、Facebook、Bluesky、Mastodon 和 Telegram。
plugins.productIntroEn: Publora lets ChatGPT publish and schedule your social media posts across ten networks: LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Bluesky, Mastodon and Telegram.

plugins.name: Speko
plugins.productIntro: Speko 为 ChatGPT 提供了一条电话线。描述你想要的电话——确认预约、追踪报价、询问诊所需要哪种保险——Speko 通过语音代理拨打号码，保持在线状态，并在结束时交回完整的文字记录和录音。每次通话都会以人工智能开头。在拨打真人电话之前，您可以针对合成呼叫者排练整个对话，并首先阅读该文字记录。 Speko 还可以转录链接中的音频，包括自己的通话录音，并以 ChatGPT 无法生成的数百种声音和语言朗读文本。
plugins.productIntroEn: Speko gives ChatGPT a phone line. Describe the call you want — confirm an appointment, chase a quote, ask a clinic which insurance it takes — and Speko dials the number with a voice agent, stays on the line, and hands back a full transcript and a recording when it ends. Every call opens by saying it is an AI.

plugins.name: PlaybookUX
plugins.description: 启动并分析用户体验研究
plugins.productIntro: PlaybookUX 是一个综合性用户研究平台，使团队能够在一个地方招募、进行、分析和存储定性和定量研究。
plugins.productIntroEn: PlaybookUX is a comprehensive user research platform that empowers teams to recruit, conduct, analyze, and store qualitative and quantitative research, all in one place.

plugins.name: AiTrillion - Shopify App
plugins.description: 电子邮件忠诚度计划 Shopify
plugins.productIntro: 在一款应用程序中通过奖励、评论、电子邮件、短信和人工智能聊天来建立客户忠诚度并实现重复销售。创建积分、VIP 等级、推荐和会员资格。收集产品评论并自动化个性化营销。 AI Chat 与您的商店数据连接，以回答产品和订单问题、推荐产品、提醒购物者未使用的忠诚度积分和优惠、请求评论以及宣传会员优惠。还有会员资格、Whatsapp 营销、联盟、产品推荐、弹出窗口等。
plugins.productIntroEn: Build customer loyalty and repeat sales with rewards, reviews, email, SMS & AI chat in one app. Create points, VIP tiers, referrals & memberships. Collect product reviews and automate personalized marketing.

plugins.name: UNIFIELD
plugins.productIntro: UNIFIELD 帮助您将想做的事情转化为明确的意图，并将其带入人类意图的共享领域。您无需搜索无休止的内容，而是可以直接从其他人、项目和机会中发现匹配和互补的意图，并清楚地解释为什么它们可能适合。它有助于将孤立的想法和潜力转化为有意义的一致。
plugins.productIntroEn: UNIFIELD helps you turn what you want to do into a clear intent and bring it into a shared field of human intent. Instead of searching through endless content, you can directly discover matching and complementary intents from other people, projects, and opportunities, with clear explanations of why they may fit. It helps move isolated ideas and potential toward meaningful alignment.

plugins.name: House of Prayer by Melorna
plugins.productIntro: House of Prayer by Melorna 是 ChatGPT 内的一个基督教协作祈祷网络。人们可以匿名请求祈祷，进行他人的祈祷，回顾自己的活动，并阅读或分享经审核的回应祈祷证词。身份和联系方式永远不会暴露，并且在确认提交之前会预览内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: House of Prayer by Melorna is a collaborative Christian prayer network inside ChatGPT. People can anonymously request prayer, carry another person's prayer, review their own activity, and read or share moderated answered-prayer testimonies. Identity and contact details are never exposed, and content is previewed before any confirmed submission.

plugins.name: Inline
plugins.productIntro: Inline 可帮助用户查找人员和对话、阅读和搜索范围内的工作聊天、创建线程、上传文件以及通过 ChatGPT 发送消息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Inline helps users find people and conversations, read and search scoped work chats, create threads, upload files, and send messages through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: EasyReply
plugins.productIntro: EasyReply 是一个客户支持平台
plugins.productIntroEn: EasyReply is a customer support platform

plugins.name: flow - AI Collaboration tool
plugins.productIntro: flow 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Flow (flow.team) 工作区，这是 Madrascheck 的协作工具。查找项目、任务、日历事件、帖子、评论、通知和 wiki 文档，并创建或更新工作项目 - 所有这些都仅限于您登录的帐户。每个批量写入在应用之前都会进行预览，不可逆转的更改需要明确的确认步骤。
plugins.productIntroEn: flow connects ChatGPT to your Flow (flow.team) workspace, the collaboration tool by Madrascheck. Find projects, tasks, calendar events, posts, comments, notifications, and wiki documents, and create or update work items — all scoped to the account you sign in with. Every batch write is previewed before it is applied, and irreversible changes require an explicit confirmation step.

plugins.name: LMGram
plugins.productIntro: LMGram 帮助 ChatGPT 将用户的明确意图转化为选择加入的人工匹配请求。用户可以连接他们的 LMGram 个人资料、创建最小化的匹配请求、查看最近传入或传出的请求、在双方感兴趣时开始轻量级聊天，以及在私人 LMGram 聊天中发送或阅读消息。该应用程序旨在寻找合作者、同行、导师、帮助者、Beta 测试人员或领域专家，而无需共享原始成绩单或不必要的私人上下文。
plugins.productIntroEn: LMGram helps ChatGPT turn a user's explicit intent into opt-in human match requests. Users can connect their LMGram profile, create a minimized match request, review recent incoming or outgoing requests, start a lightweight chat when both sides are interested, and send or read messages in that private LMGram chat.

plugins.name: Webex
plugins.description: 会议、消息传递和视频广播

plugins.productIntroEn: Webex Suite helps users manage Webex meetings, messages, spaces, memberships, files, and webhooks, and search or retrieve Vidcast videos, transcripts, and highlights.

plugins.name: Front
plugins.productIntro: Front 是您团队的客户运营平台，用于电子邮件、短信、WhatsApp 和聊天。将其连接到 ChatGPT 以进行真实的客户对话。
plugins.productIntroEn: Front is your team's customer operations platform for email, SMS, WhatsApp and chat. Connect it to ChatGPT to work on real customer conversations.

plugins.name: Tella

plugins.productIntroEn: Tella is an all-in-one screen recorder and AI video editor for creating polished product demos, tutorials, courses, and video messages, then sharing them with a link or exporting in up to 4K.

plugins.name: Consensus

plugins.productIntroEn: Consensus is a service that helps you explore scientific research. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Explain Video Generator
plugins.description: 把主题、文档或代码转换成带旁白的视频。
plugins.productIntro: Explain Video Generator 的主要用途是把主题、文档或代码转换成带旁白的视频。 无需离开 ChatGPT，即可将任何内容变成解说视频。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Explain Video Generator is a service that helps you free AI explainer video maker. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: SciSpace
plugins.description: 搜索、阅读并理解科学研究。
plugins.productIntro: SciSpace 的主要用途是搜索、阅读并理解科学研究。 SciSpace for ChatGPT 支持研究的核心任务：发现、分类和综合。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: SciSpace is a service that helps you for science and research. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Scite
plugins.description: 提供有科学文献依据的回答。
plugins.productIntro: Scite 的主要用途是提供有科学文献依据的回答。 scite 帮助用户搜索和阅读科学论文、检查引文上下文和引文图表、格式化参考书目、记录引文决策以及通过 ChatGPT 在集合中组织论文和注释。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Scite is a service that helps you search scientific literature. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Tarteel
plugins.description: 搜索和学习古兰经相关资源。
plugins.productIntro: Tarteel 的主要用途是搜索和学习古兰经相关资源。 Tarteel 将深入的《古兰经》研究带入 ChatGPT。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tarteel is a service that helps you explore Quranic resources. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Quizlet
plugins.description: 根据主题或资料制作学习卡片。
plugins.productIntro: Quizlet 是学习卡片平台，可把主题、笔记或文件转换为可复习的卡片集。
plugins.productIntroEn: Quizlet is a service that helps you create flashcards. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Acumen by Talarion
plugins.description: 持续补充最新资料，让 AI 获取更新信息。
plugins.originalDescription: Keep your AI up to date.
plugins.productIntro: Acumen by Talarion 的主要用途是持续补充最新资料，让 AI 获取更新信息。 Talarion 让 AI 保持最新状态。在 Codex 中，可结合当前任务使用它提供的资料或能力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Acumen by Talarion is a service that helps you keep your AI up to date. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Kahoot!
plugins.description: 把资料转换成可互动的教学测验。
plugins.productIntro: Kahoot! 是互动测验与课堂活动平台，可把主题、文档或链接生成可参与的选择题活动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kahoot! is a service that helps you create kahoots instantly. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Wolfram
plugins.description: 调用 Wolfram 的计算、算法与知识数据。
plugins.productIntro: Wolfram 提供数学计算、算法和结构化知识数据；插件让 Codex 调用 Wolfram Language 与 Wolfram|Alpha 处理可计算的问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Wolfram is a service that helps you add computation & knowledge. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugins.name: Transkriptor
plugins.productIntro: Transkriptor 将您的转录库引入 ChatGPT。
plugins.productIntroEn: Transkriptor brings your transcription library into ChatGPT.

plugins.name: AhaMotion
plugins.productIntro: AhaMotion 将复杂的主题转化为清晰、生动的解释。无论您是在处理 K-12 作业还是只是对世界感到好奇，只需提出问题并直观地查看概念即可。
plugins.productIntroEn: AhaMotion turns complex topics into clear, animated explanations. Whether you are tackling K-12 assignments or just curious about the world, simply ask and view the concept visually.

plugins.name: MetaMetrics® Lexile Analyzer
plugins.description: 生成 Lexile 文本度量
plugins.productIntro: 测量任何文本的复杂性并在几秒钟内收到其 Lexile® 测量结果。您还可以使用人工智能驱动的文本适应来增加或减少文本的复杂性，同时保留其含义，帮助您创建对不同读者更容易理解或更具挑战性的版本。
plugins.productIntroEn: Measure the complexity of any text and receive its Lexile® measure in seconds. You can also use AI-powered text adaptation to increase or decrease the text’s complexity while preserving its meaning, helping you create versions that are more accessible or more challenging for different readers.

plugins.name: Language Coach: English
plugins.productIntro: LangCoach 通过分班测试帮助您检查您的英语水平，并了解您的 CEFR 等级 (A1–C1)。在聊天中打开应用程序进行测试，查看您的分数明细，并将您的级别保存到您的帐户中。更多练习模式即将推出。
plugins.productIntroEn: LangCoach helps you check your English level with a placement test and see your CEFR band (A1–C1). Open the app in chat to take the test, review your score breakdown, and keep your level saved to your account. More practice modes are coming soon.

plugins.name: Self Plagiarism Checker
plugins.productIntro: WordBinary Self Plagiarism Checker 打开一个交互式小部件，用户可以在其中粘贴两个文档并识别重复的短语组合。它突出显示四个或更多连续单词的匹配短语，显示相似性百分比，并列出匹配的短语组合以供快速写作复习。粘贴的文本在小部件 UI 内部进行处理，并且不会由 MCP 服务器存储。
plugins.productIntroEn: WordBinary Self Plagiarism Checker opens an interactive widget where users can paste two documents and identify repeated phrase combinations. It highlights matching phrases of four or more consecutive words, shows a similarity percentage, and lists matched phrase combinations for quick writing review. Pasted text is processed inside the widget UI and is not stored by the MCP server.

plugins.name: Strive PDF Generator
plugins.description: Latex 转 PDF 和数学工作表
plugins.productIntro: Strive PDF Generator：Latex 转 PDF 和数学工作表。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create, edit, and download professional PDFs with graphs and math notation — all without leaving ChatGPT. Describe what you need in plain language or use the built-in LaTeX editor, then download the final PDF instantly.

plugins.name: Wayground
plugins.productIntro: Wayground 帮助教师和学生将教学材料转变为可随时分配的测验和学习卡。粘贴或参考教学内容，Wayground 会直接从中生成对齐的问题和抽认卡 - 无需将课程重写为评估。教师用它来节省准备时间并快速检查理解情况。学生用它来练习和自检相同的材料。生成的活动通过 Wayground 提供，并提供报告，以便教师可以了解学生的参与情况以及他们在哪里需要支持。
plugins.productIntroEn: Wayground helps teachers and students turn teaching and learning materials into ready-to-assign quizzes and study cards. Paste or reference instructional content, and Wayground generates aligned questions and flashcards directly from it — no need to rewrite lessons as assessments. Teachers use it to save prep time and quickly check understanding.

plugins.name: Elicit
plugins.productIntro: Elicit 的 MCP 服务器使人工智能助手能够直接访问包含超过 1.25 亿篇学术论文的语料库。使用自然语言查询搜索相关文献，创建结构化报告来提取和综合论文中的数据，并检索详细的报告结果——所有这些都以编程方式进行。该服务器专为生命科学研发工作流程而构建，使代理能够快速调查证据、比较研究结果并显示关键数据点，而无需手动查阅文献，从而加速从目标发现到系统证据评估的一切。
plugins.productIntroEn: Elicit's MCP server gives AI assistants direct access to a corpus of over 125 million academic papers. Search for relevant literature using natural language queries, create structured reports that extract and synthesize data across papers, and retrieve detailed report results — all programmatically.

plugins.name: Legal Data Hunter
plugins.productIntro: Legal Data Hunter：查找全球法律和案例。
plugins.productIntroEn: Legal Data Hunter connects ChatGPT to the world's fastest-growing open legal corpus — a continuously-updated index of 32M+ documents from 180+ jurisdictions. LDH ingests directly from official registries — Légifrance, BOE, EUR-Lex, RIS, the Bundesgerichtshof, the European Court of Human Rights, and hundreds more — and exposes them through a focused tool surface: hybrid semantic + keyword…

plugins.name: Midpage Legal Research
plugins.description: 人工智能的法律研究数据
plugins.productIntro: 连接到包含判例法、法令、法规、案卷等的企业级数据库，以在 ChatGPT 内实现复杂的法律研究和写作工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect to an enterprise-grade database of case law, statutes, regulations, dockets, and more to enable complex legal research and writing workflows inside of ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Scholar Gateway
plugins.description: 查找值得信赖的学术内容
plugins.productIntro: Scholar Gateway 使 ChatGPT 能够生成基于同行评审来源的回复，并具有可验证的引文和 DOI 链接。 Scholar Gateway Connector 目前从 Wiley 期刊和研究数据库中搜索文献，以提供具有完整源元数据的有证据支持的答案，并将很快添加来自其他出版商和来源的内容。这使您能够验证声明是否得到来源研究的支持——确保您的研究符合专业研究标准。
plugins.productIntroEn: Scholar Gateway enables ChatGPT to generate responses grounded in peer-reviewed sources with verifiable citations and DOI links. The Scholar Gateway Connector currently searches literature from Wiley journals and research databases to deliver evidence-backed answers with complete source metadata--and will be adding content from other publishers and sources soon.

plugins.name: AnyLessonPlan for Teachers
plugins.description: 生成课堂教学计划与学习材料。
plugins.productIntro: AnyLessonPlan 是一个简单易用的工具，可帮助 ChatGPT 生成课程计划！
plugins.productIntroEn: AnyLessonPlan is a simple easy tool to help ChatGPT generate lesson plans!

plugins.name: Sider Scholar
plugins.description: 搜索 350M+ 论文。节省。聊天
plugins.productIntro: 您的 AI 研究助手可让您搜索 3.5 亿多篇研究论文、与大量研究 PDF 聊天，并将发现保存到您的 Wisebase（知识库）。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your AI Research Assistant lets you search 350M+ research papers, chat with large volumes of research PDFs, and save findings to your Wisebase (knowledge base).

plugins.name: StudyMe.ai
plugins.description: 教育： 教学 1 个链接
plugins.productIntro: StudyMe.ai 在几秒钟内将您的教学想法转变为互动课程。 创建课程并与学生分享是完全免费的。告诉 StudyMe.ai 您想教什么，包括主题、级别和目标，它会创建一个随时可用的课程网页，您的学生可以通过单个链接打开。 教师可以通过提示 ChatGPT 或使用 StudyMe.ai 上的编辑工具调整最终结果，轻松完善每节课。 学生通过测验、计算、拖放练习、清晰的解释和即时的积极反馈积极学习。不同的任务有助于提高参与度、提高注意力并支持更深入的学习。
plugins.productIntroEn: StudyMe.ai turns your teaching ideas into interactive lessons in seconds. It is completely free to create and share lessons with students. Tell StudyMe.ai what you want to teach — including topic, level, and goal — and it creates a ready-to-use lesson webpage your students can open from a single link.

plugins.name: Academic Writing Toolkit
plugins.productIntro: 学术写作工具包可帮助用户审阅 ChatGPT 中粘贴的学术写作材料。它可以审核散文草稿和阅读笔记源行之间的引文一致性，检查保守的英式英语拼写，标记段落级逻辑问题，离线验证 BibTeX 记录，并创建标准阅读笔记 Markdown 模板。
plugins.productIntroEn: Academic Writing Toolkit helps users review pasted academic writing materials in ChatGPT. It can audit citation consistency between draft prose and reading-note source lines, check conservative British English spelling, flag paragraph-level logic issues, validate BibTeX records offline, and create a standard reading-notes Markdown template.

plugins.name: quran.ai
plugins.description: 扎根、深入的《古兰经》研究
plugins.productIntro: quran.ai：扎根、深入的《古兰经》研究。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn ChatGPT into your AI-powered Quran study companion — trace themes across all 114 surahs, compare how classical and modern scholars interpret the same verse, unpack the depth and precision behind the Quran's eloquence, and contextualize difficult passages with real, authentic tafsir commentary. All data sourced from quran.

plugins.name: Zotero
plugins.description: 查找 Zotero 的论文并添加引用
plugins.originalDescription: Find papers and add citations from Zotero
plugins.productIntro: 将 Codex 连接到您的 Zotero 桌面图书馆，以便它可以查找已保存的论文、导出 BibTeX、向草稿添加引用键、在您询问时阅读索引附件文本，以及在您批准的情况下将新的参考记录导入到 Zotero。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect Codex to your Zotero desktop library so it can find saved papers, export BibTeX, add citation keys to drafts, read indexed attachment text when you ask, and import new reference records into Zotero with your approval.

plugins.name: Udemy
plugins.description: 将你的问题转化为技能
plugins.productIntro: 通过 ChatGPT 中的 Udemy 应用程序学习推动您进步的技能。借助 Udemy，您可以将好奇心、问题和“我需要弄清楚这个问题”的时刻转化为真正的进步。
plugins.productIntroEn: Learn skills that move you forward with the Udemy app in ChatGPT. With Udemy, you can turn your curiosity, questions, and “I need to figure this out” moments into real progress.

plugins.name: CourtListener
plugins.description: 适合所有人的法律研究
plugins.productIntro: 连接到自由法律项目的法律研究平台 CourtListener，可以访问数百万条美国法院意见、PACER 案卷、法官简介、口头辩论和引文数据。在联邦和州法院搜索判例法，检索完整的案件元数据，根据规范数据库提取和验证法律引文，并针对新意见或案件更新设置警报。由自由法律项目 (Free Law Project) 建立和运营，该项目是一家 501(c)(3) 非营利组织，致力于让法律更广泛地普及。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect to CourtListener, the Free Law Project's legal research platform, with access to millions of U.S. court opinions, PACER dockets, judge profiles, oral arguments, and citation data. Search case law across federal and state courts, retrieve full case metadata, extract and verify legal citations against a canonical database, and set up alerts for new opinions or docket updates.

plugins.name: Assessment Generator
plugins.productIntro: 评估生成器 – 由 Colossyan 提供支持，是一款人工智能驱动的工具，专为希望快速、自信地创建高质量评估的教学设计师而设计。只需最少的输入，无需复杂的设置，它将源内容（例如粘贴的文本、文件或对话上下文）转换为结构化的高质量评估问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Assessment Generator – powered by Colossyan is an AI-powered tool built for instructional designers who want to create high-quality assessments with speed and confidence. With minimal input and no complex setup, it turns source content (such as pasted text, files, or conversation context) into structured, high-quality assessment questions.

plugins.name: italki language learning
plugins.productIntro: italki 是一种通过一对一在线课程和母语教师小组课程学习语言的简单而灵活的方式。定制您的学习体验，以适应您的日程安排、水平、目标和预算，并按课时付费、灵活的课时长度。 italki 拥有 150 多种语言和数千名合格教师可供选择，可帮助您通过真实的交流进行学习。
plugins.productIntroEn: italki is an easy and flexible way to learn languages through one-on-one online lessons and group classes with native teachers. Customize your learning experience to fit your schedule, level, goals, and budget, and pay per lesson with flexible class lengths. With 150+ languages and thousands of qualified teachers to choose from, italki helps you learn through real communication.

plugins.name: OpenAI Certified
plugins.description: 在 ChatGPT 中学习实用的 AI 技能并获得 OpenAI 认证证书。
plugins.originalDescription: Learn practical AI skills inside ChatGPT and earn OpenAI Certified credentials.
plugins.productIntro: 在 ChatGPT 中学习实用的 AI 技能并获得 OpenAI 认证证书。
plugins.productIntroEn: Learn practical AI skills inside ChatGPT and earn OpenAI Certified credentials.

plugins.name: QuizFlight
plugins.productIntro: QuizFlight 可让您将文本、文档或演示文稿转变为实时测验。您可以生成问题、查看问题并启动实时会话。
plugins.productIntroEn: QuizFlight lets you turn text, documents, or presentations into live quizzes. You can generate questions, review them, and launch a live session.

plugins.name: alphaXiv
plugins.productIntro: alphaXiv 帮助用户发现学术论文、阅读和查询论文内容、检查链接的 GitHub 存储库以及通过 ChatGPT 管理已保存论文的文件夹。
plugins.productIntroEn: alphaXiv helps users discover academic papers, read and query paper content, inspect linked GitHub repositories, and manage folders of saved papers through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Scholar Sidekick
plugins.productIntro: 在一次请求中审核整个参考列表 - 最多 25 个条目，每个条目都检查是否伪造和撤回，并作为每个条目的裁决表返回。验证单个引文是否真实 - 它将所声明的标题和作者与标识符处的实际记录进行交叉检查，捕获真实 DOI 与伪造或不匹配标题配对的常见模式。将 DOI、PMID、PMCID、ISBN、arXiv ID、ISSN 或 ADS bibcode 解析为温哥华、APA、AMA、IEEE、CSE 或 10,000 多种 CSL 样式中任何一种的干净、格式化的引文。
plugins.productIntroEn: Audit a whole reference list in one request - up to 25 entries, each checked for fabrication and retraction, returned as a per-entry verdict table. Verify whether a single citation is real - it cross-checks the claimed title and authors against the actual record at the identifier, catching the common pattern where a real DOI is paired with a fabricated or mismatched title.

plugins.name: Mynawoo AI Language Tutor
plugins.productIntro: Mynawoo 帮助经过身份验证的学习者在 ChatGPT 中开始并继续个人语言学习计划。学习者可以确认他们的解释语言和课程、参加私人安置评估或从 A1 开始、获取聊天课程解释、创建在 Mynawoo 中完成的私人语法练习，以及管理 Leitner 词汇和辅导建议。课程内容的访问仍然取决于学习者的 Mynawoo 计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: Mynawoo helps authenticated learners start and continue a personal language-learning plan in ChatGPT. Learners can confirm their explanation language and course, take a private placement assessment or begin at A1, get chat lesson explanations, create private grammar practice completed in Mynawoo, and manage Leitner vocabulary plus coaching suggestions.

plugins.name: DataCamp
plugins.productIntro: 让您的 AI 助手直接访问 DataCamp 的完整课程、教程、项目和练习目录。按关键字搜索，按 ID 查找任何课程或练习，或按需检索摘要 - 无需登录。进行身份验证以解锁团队管理员：管理组、成员和分配。实时报告进度、参与度和采用情况，以跟踪学习在整个组织中的落地情况。
plugins.productIntroEn: Give your AI assistant direct access to DataCamp's full catalog of courses, tutorials, projects, and exercises. Search by keyword, look up any course or exercise by ID, or retrieve summaries on demand—no sign-in required. Authenticate to unlock team admin: manage groups, members, and assignments.

plugins.name: Coursera Learning
plugins.productIntro: Coursera Learning 帮助学习者发现课程、视频、指导项目和课程表；在互动课程中学习概念；并在 ChatGPT 中练习专业或技术技能。
plugins.productIntroEn: Coursera Learning helps learners discover courses, videos, guided projects, and curricula; learn concepts in interactive sessions; and practice professional or technical skills in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Audioscrape
plugins.productIntro: 转录任何录音，或搜索播客、市议会和县会议以及最高法院听证会的数百万个时刻 - 每天都会添加新的剧集和会议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Transcribe any recording, or search millions of moments from podcasts, city-council and county meetings, and Supreme Court hearings — with new episodes and meetings added every day.

plugins.name: Lurna
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 将任何主题转变为可供学习的材料。 Lurna 帮助您生成可在聊天中翻阅的交互式抽认卡，以及在干净的读者视图中构建的结构化 Markdown 学习笔记。更快地复习关键概念，然后将卡片组和笔记导出到 app.lurna.co，以通过间隔重复来保持学习 - 让认真的复习成为人工智能学习工作流程的一部分。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn any topic into study-ready materials directly from ChatGPT. Lurna helps you generate interactive flashcard decks you can flip through in chat, plus structured Markdown study notes in a clean reader view. Review key concepts faster, then export decks and notes to app.lurna.co to keep learning with spaced repetition — making serious review a native part of your AI-study workflow.

plugins.name: Ace Quiz Maker
plugins.description: 把 PDF 和笔记转换为测验。
plugins.productIntro: 停止被动阅读，开始主动学习。将您的 PDF、文档和笔记转化为交互式练习测试，并提供即时评分和详细说明，帮助您在几秒钟内掌握新材料。 - 上传和生成：只需上传您的 PDF、笔记或指南。 Quiz Maker 分析您的文件以立即构建自定义测试。 - 即时解释：立即获得每个错误答案的详细解释，以纠正误解。 - 评分和报告：通过显示分数、准确性和所用时间的最终摘要来跟踪您的进度。 - 复习和重考：测验会自动保存，因此您可以稍后复习或随时重考以掌握材料。
plugins.productIntroEn: Stop passive reading and start active learning. Turn your PDFs, docs, and notes into interactive practice tests with instant scoring and detailed explanations—helping you master new materials in seconds. - Upload & Generate: Simply upload your PDFs, notes, or guides. Quiz Maker analyzes your files to build custom tests instantly.

plugins.name: getMindmap
plugins.description: 从聊天中创建思维导图
plugins.productIntro: 在 ChatGPT 中将想法、笔记和研究主题转化为结构化思维导图。 getMindmap 创建清晰的基于分支的地图，您可以在聊天中查看并将它们保存到您的帐户，以便您以后可以在 map.getmindmap.com 上继续编辑。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn ideas, notes, and study topics into structured mindmaps in ChatGPT. getMindmap creates clear branch-based maps you can review in chat and saves them to your account so you can keep editing later on map.getmindmap.com.

plugins.name: Recall
plugins.productIntro: Create and manage spaced repetition flashcard decks in Recall directly from ChatGPT. Turn lecture notes, articles, or any conversation into rich cards in one request. ChatGPT 设计牌组结构，编写遵循经过验证的记忆保留原则的原子卡，并安排它们以便您可以立即开始复习。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create and manage spaced repetition flashcard decks in Recall directly from ChatGPT. Turn lecture notes, articles, or any conversation into rich cards in one request. ChatGPT designs the deck structure, writes atomic cards that follow proven memory-retention principles, and schedules them so you can start reviewing right away.

plugins.name: Chymia
plugins.productIntro: Chymia 是一个由人工智能驱动的交互式虚拟实验室，可让您实时探索化学元素的热力学和行为。 无论您是想煮沸黄金、将氢压缩成固体，还是引发迷人的化学反应并揭开每种元素独特的好奇心，Chymia 都能使其具有视觉吸引力和科学准确性。
