It supports company discovery, product catalog research, product detail and variant analysis, market leader discovery, market trend analysis, marketing asset discovery, retail event tracking, sales timeseries, and product mix breakdowns.

plugins.name: Tailo Lens
plugins.productIntro: Tailo Lens 帮助学生从 ChatGPT 的学术研究中获得更多收益。当您探索主题和来源时，Tailo Lens 将复杂的内容分解为清晰、结构化、评分的主张分析 - 突出不同的学术观点，显示支持或与您的研究相关的被广泛引用的论文，并使全文学术内容易于访问。它还分析您自己的偏见提示，帮助您更客观地提出研究问题，并在整个教育过程中支持学术诚信。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tailo Lens helps students get more from their academic research in ChatGPT. As you explore topics and sources, Tailo Lens breaks down complex content into clear, structured, scored claim analysis — highlighting different academic perspectives, surfacing well-cited papers that support or relate to your study, and making full-text academic content accessible.

plugins.name: Any Fact Widget
plugins.productIntro: 使用 ChatGPT 学习有趣事实的好方法！
plugins.productIntroEn: A great way to learn fun facts with ChatGPT!

plugins.name: Açık Silivri Havadis
plugins.description: 跟踪 IBB 审判听证会
plugins.productIntro: Açık Silivri Havadis 向 ChatGPT 提供对伊斯坦布尔市审判公开法庭记录的只读访问权限，包括听证会、与会者、笔录搜索、指控、辩护、证据、陈述、专家意见和交叉询问。
plugins.productIntroEn: Açık Silivri Havadis gives ChatGPT read-only access to public court records from the Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality trial, including hearings, attendees, transcript search, accusations, defenses, evidence, statements, expert opinions, and cross-examinations.

plugins.name: PaperDock
plugins.description: 在 LaTeX 上进行编辑和协作
plugins.productIntro: PaperDock 通过 ChatGPT 帮助研究人员开展私人 LaTeX 项目。用户可以创建项目、查找和编辑源文件、添加或替换项目文件以及通过评论和聊天进行协作。每个操作都遵循用户当前的 PaperDock 项目角色，源代码编辑仍然可以通过“审阅”更改进行检查。
plugins.productIntroEn: PaperDock helps researchers work on private LaTeX projects through ChatGPT. Users can create projects, find and edit source files, add or replace project files, and collaborate through Comments and Chat. Every action follows the user's current PaperDock project role, and source edits remain inspectable through Review changes.

plugins.name: API Lessons
plugins.description: 查找 API 和 MCP 培训
plugins.productIntro: Emmanuel Paraskakis 提供的 Maven 教育平台上免费、简短的 Lightning 课程的完整列表。涵盖的主题包括 API、MCP、产品管理、技术 PM 职业和 ChatGPT 应用程序。 用户可以查看录音、报名参加即将到来的现场课程，或者了解哪个基于队列的课程与该主题相关，以便他们可以更深入地了解该主题。 Lightning 课程通过 Zoom 进行，实用且实用，包含您可以立即使用的技能。
plugins.productIntroEn: A comprehensive list of free, short Lightning Lessons on the Maven education platform by Emmanuel Paraskakis. The topics covered are APIs, MCP, Product Management, Technical PM Careers, and ChatGPT Apps. Users can either view a recording, sign up for an upcoming live lesson, or learn which cohort-based course is connected to the topic so they can go deeper into it.

plugins.name: Article Galaxy
plugins.productIntro: 检查科学文章的文章可用性，确认访问和重用权限，并通过您的 Article Galaxy 帐户订购文档，而无需离开对话。订购的 PDF 将根据您现有的权利通过 Article Galaxy 交付；连接器处理可用性、权限、订购和交付。
plugins.productIntroEn: Check article availability of scientific articles, confirm access and reuse rights, and order documents through your Article Galaxy account without leaving the conversation. Ordered PDFs are delivered through Article Galaxy under your existing entitlements; the connector handles availability, rights, ordering, and delivery.

plugins.name: Common Room
plugins.productIntro: 将完整的买家情报直接嵌入 ChatGPT 中。研究客户和联系人、显示购买信号并浏览活动历史记录 - 全部通过自然语言进行。按行业、规模、技术堆栈或地点建立净新公司的潜在客户名单。按细分、角色、潜在客户评分或网站访问对联系人进行过滤和排序。每个结果都基于直接来自 CRM 字段、分数、丰富内容和信号的真实背景、真实优先级和真实收入机会 - 因此您始终了解帐户中实际发生的情况。
plugins.productIntroEn: Embed complete buyer intelligence directly within ChatGPT. Research accounts and contacts, surface buying signals, and browse activity history - all through natural language. Build prospect lists of net-new companies by industry, size, tech stack, or location. Filter and sort contacts by segment, role, lead score, or website visits.

plugins.name: Spanish Law Research
plugins.productIntro: 西班牙法律研究帮助用户查找西班牙立法、检查法律元数据和文章文本、检索基于来源的摘录，并通过引用 BOE 和源 URL 回顾改革历史。
plugins.productIntroEn: Spanish Law Research helps users find Spanish legislation, inspect law metadata and article text, retrieve source-grounded excerpts, and review reform history with citations to BOE, and source URLs.

plugins.name: Drill
plugins.productIntro: Drill 将 ChatGPT 连接到学生的知识验证协议。创建包含真相和看似合理的陷阱的卡片，组织套牌和标签，检查未经测试、薄弱、未经证实或掌握的内容，并将课程材料转变为可以在考试前测试的学习内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Drill connects ChatGPT to a knowledge-verification protocol for students. Create Cards with Truths and plausible Traps, organize Decks and Tags, inspect what is Untested, Weak, Unproven, or Mastered, and turn course material into study content that can be tested before exam day.

plugins.name: Glossarize
plugins.productIntro: 一种查看聊天中单词含义的简单方法。
plugins.productIntroEn: An easy way to see what words mean in the chat.

plugins.name: Lune
plugins.productIntro: Lune 将 ChatGPT 与为科学工作流程构建的研究知识和工具连接起来。用简单的英语提出问题，Lune 就会检索来自顶级学术会议的相关论文，包括摘要、元数据、引文链接和全文（如果有）。它还为文献综述、评估设计、消融研究和场地选择提供精心策划的指导。从早期的想法到可发表的研究，Lune 帮助研究人员和技术团队通过可追溯的来源、更深入的文献基础以及更严格、有证据支持的决策更快地前进。
plugins.productIntroEn: Lune connects ChatGPT with research knowledge and tools built for scientific workflows. Ask a question in plain English, and Lune retrieves relevant papers from top-tier academic conferences, complete with abstracts, metadata, citation links, and full text when available. It also provides curated guidance for literature reviews, evaluation design, ablation studies, and venue selection.

plugins.name: Pencil Spaces
plugins.productIntro: Pencil Spaces 是虚拟教学的最佳场所。在我们的虚拟教室中提供引人入胜的课程，自动化操作，并确保每个人的安全和合规。
plugins.productIntroEn: Pencil Spaces is the best place for teaching virtually. Deliver engaging lessons in our virtual classroom, automate operations, and keep everyone safe and compliant.

plugins.name: Cody Reading
plugins.productIntro: Cody Reading 帮助阅读专家、导师、课堂教师和干预专家创建和评估与 UFLI 基金会课程相符的可解码故事。用户可以找到相关的 UFLI 课程编号，根据主题生成与课程一致的故事，修改生成或粘贴的故事，同时保持课程对齐，并分析现有段落的可解码性。结果在交互式故事查看器中呈现，并带有可解码性分数、单词类别突出显示、挑战单词审查和可打印的 PDF 链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Cody Reading helps reading specialists, tutors, classroom teachers, and interventionists create and evaluate decodable stories aligned to UFLI Foundations lessons. Users can find relevant UFLI lesson numbers, generate lesson-aligned stories from a topic, revise generated or pasted stories while preserving lesson alignment, and analyze existing passages for decodability.

plugins.name: edifyedu.in
plugins.productIntro: 印度在线教育的完整指南。搜索并比较超过 125 所 UGC-DEB 批准的在线大学。获取 MBA、BBA、MCA 和 BCA 课程的经过验证的费用、NAAC 认证等级、NIRF 排名以及项目详细信息。检查是否有大学真正获得 UGC-DEB 批准。并排比较大学的费用、排名和专业。所有信息均经过官方来源验证并定期更新。 edifyedu.in 是印度独立、免佣金的在线教育平台，无付费排名。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your complete guide to online education in India. Search and compare 125+ UGC-DEB approved online universities. Get verified fees, NAAC accreditation grades, NIRF rankings, and programme details for MBA, BBA, MCA, and BCA courses. Check if any university is genuinely approved by UGC-DEB. Compare universities side by side on fees, rankings, and specialisations.

plugins.name: Examen Civique
plugins.productIntro: 准备法国入籍、多年居留许可或居留许可的法国公民考试。
plugins.productIntroEn: Prepare for the French civic exam for naturalisation française, a carte de séjour pluriannuelle, or a carte de résident.

plugins.name: monPIF
plugins.productIntro: MonPIF 将 ChatGPT 连接到瓦隆-布鲁塞尔联邦官方联盟（比利时）共同核心课程框架。关于学习目标的每个答案都是直接从官方数据库中检索的——不是发明的，也不是解释的。
plugins.productIntroEn: MonPIF connects ChatGPT to the official Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles (Belgium) Common Core Curriculum framework. Every answer about learning objectives is retrieved directly from the official database — not invented, not paraphrased.

plugins.name: BestColleges.com
plugins.productIntro: BestColleges 可让您轻松找到符合您目标的认可在线课程。
plugins.productIntroEn: BestColleges makes it easy to find accredited online programs that fit your goals.

plugins.name: Bodhaka Virtual Labs
plugins.productIntro: Bodhaka 将交互式物理和化学实验室画布带入 ChatGPT。学生在物理实验室中构建电路、力学和光学图，或者在化学实验室中构建原子、键和平衡方程，所有这些都是在聊天中的画布上手工绘制的。这些实验室是完全交互式的，并且在网络和移动设备上呈现一致。由 bodhaka.org 背后的团队构建，用于真正的实践学习。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bodhaka brings interactive physics and chemistry lab canvases into ChatGPT. Students build circuits, mechanics, and optics diagrams in the Physics Lab, or atoms, bonds, and balanced equations in the Chemistry Lab, all by hand on a drawing canvas inside the chat. The labs are fully interactive and render consistently on both web and mobile. Built by the team behind bodhaka.

plugins.name: Lingard
plugins.productIntro: Lingard Vocab 将 ChatGPT 带入 Lingard 学习方式：阅读和聆听您真正喜欢的内容。您可以要求 ChatGPT 围绕您想要理解的真实事物建立词汇表，而不是学习断开连接的抽认卡：书籍、文章、播客、电影和电视情节、旅行计划、工作主题和日常情况。 Lingard Vocab 可以将精美的学习卡直接保存到您的 Lingard 库中，其中包含翻译、发音、词性、同义词、语法详细信息、突出显示的例句以及特定于语言的详细信息（例如德语名词文章）。
plugins.productIntroEn: Lingard Vocab brings ChatGPT into the Lingard way of learning: reading and listening to content you actually enjoy. Instead of studying disconnected flashcards, you can ask ChatGPT to build vocabulary around the real things you want to understand: books, articles, podcasts, movie and TV plots, travel plans, work topics, and everyday situations.

plugins.name: GovQuery
plugins.productIntro: GovQuery 是一个强大的搜索引擎，使美国政府报告和数据更容易探索、定位和理解。
plugins.productIntroEn: GovQuery is a powerful search engine that makes U.S. government reports and data easier to explore, locate, and understand.

plugins.name: Parenting Hub
plugins.productIntro: 育儿中心帮助父母找到有关婴儿喂养、第一食物、产后健康、安全问题和后续步骤的源头指导。它显示了实用的答题卡、婴儿和幼儿食谱详细信息、成分、步骤、过敏原、营养说明和相关的安全指南。它具有教育意义，不能取代临床护理。
plugins.productIntroEn: Parenting Hub helps parents find source-linked guidance for baby feeding, first foods, postpartum health, safety questions, and next steps. It shows practical answer cards, baby and toddler recipe details, ingredients, steps, allergens, nutrition notes, and safety guidance when relevant. It is educational and does not replace clinical care.

plugins.name: College Vidya
plugins.productIntro: 找到您完美的在线学位，而无需感到研究疲劳。这款交互式应用程序将来自 College Vidya 的经过验证的数据直接带入您的聊天中，让您可以搜索顶尖大学、并排比较学费，并在干净的仪表板中探索精细的课程结构。没有偏见的排名，没有隐藏的成本——只有诚实的、结构化的数据来帮助您做出正确的教育选择。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find your perfect online degree without the research fatigue. This interactive app brings verified data from College Vidya directly into your chat, allowing you to search top universities, compare tuition fees side-by-side, and explore granular course structures in a clean dashboard.

plugins.name: Dow Jones Factiva
plugins.productIntro: Factiva 连接器使授权用户能够搜索 Factiva 的全球新闻档案，包括优质道琼斯资源，并将该内容的见解纳入其 Codex 响应中。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Factiva Connector, enables authorized users to search Factiva’s global news archive, including premium Dow Jones sources, and incorporate insights from that content into their Codex responses.

plugins.name: LeapScholar
plugins.productIntro: 搜索并比较国外的大学课程——按国家、学科、入学人数和 学位级别 — 直接在 ChatGPT 内。 LeapScholar 连接到英国、美国、加拿大、 爱尔兰、澳大利亚、德国等。问这样的问题： • “英国的数据科学项目” • “美国计算机科学大学 2027 年 1 月招生” • “比较英国与加拿大的金融课程” •“2026 年 9 月爱尔兰一年制计算机科学研究生课程” 结果显示为交互式卡片，显示大学名称、课程、学费、持续时间、 排名和入学时间。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search and compare university programs abroad — by country, discipline, intake, and degree level — directly inside ChatGPT. LeapScholar connects to a curated database of universities across the UK, USA, Canada, Ireland, Australia, Germany, and more.

plugins.name: LingoStar
plugins.productIntro: LingoStar 利用 ChatGPT 的智能，帮助学习者在 ChatGPT 内管理语言学习轨迹、以对话方式更改设置以及练习语言信息、听、读、写和口语。
plugins.productIntroEn: LingoStar helps learners manage language learning tracks, change settings conversationally, and practice language information, listening, reading, writing, and speaking inside ChatGPT, using ChatGPT's intelligence.

plugins.name: NYCU Library
plugins.productIntro: 您的国立阳明交通大学 (NYCU) 的图书馆和研究伙伴 — 无需离开 ChatGPT 即可访问图书馆服务和学术资源。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your library and research companion for National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU) — access library services and academic resources without leaving ChatGPT.
plugins.developerName: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University Library

plugins.name: Omphalis
plugins.productIntro: 脐是你所读、所听、所记的内容开始融为一体的地方。您保存一篇文章，Omphalis 会显示其结构。您在上下班途中收听播客，Omphalis 可以帮助您回到重要的事情上。你观看一个两个小时的演讲，Omphalis 会在几秒钟内向你展示它的形状。你在午夜录制一条语音笔记，Omphalis 将其放在所属的文章、演讲或论文旁边。
plugins.productIntroEn: Omphalis is the place where what you read, hear, and note begins to cohere. You save an article, and Omphalis shows its structure. You listen to a podcast on your commute, and Omphalis helps you come back to what mattered. You watch a two-hour talk, and Omphalis shows you the shape of it in seconds.

plugins.name: MSDS Chain
plugins.description: 实验室工作的化学安全
plugins.productIntro: MSDS Chain 将化学品安全情报引入 ChatGPT。询问任何化学品并获得即时的来源答案：成对兼容性、GHS 危害和 H 代码、个人防护装备、储存和隔离规则、安全混合顺序、废物处置、职业暴露限制、联合国运输分类和多区域监管合规性（11 个区域的 23 个观察名单）。上传 MSDS/SDS PDF 以提取结构化安全数据，或生成 Ed25519 签名的 GLP/GMP 记录审核报告。
plugins.productIntroEn: MSDS Chain brings chemical safety intelligence into ChatGPT. Ask about any chemical and get instant, sourced answers: pairwise compatibility, GHS hazards and H-codes, PPE, storage and isolation rules, safe mixing order, waste disposal, occupational exposure limits, UN transport classification, and multi-region regulatory compliance (23 watch lists across 11 regions).

plugins.name: TapWaterMap
plugins.description: 美国各个城市的自来水质量
plugins.originalDescription: US tap water quality by city
plugins.productIntro: TapWaterMap 使用 EPA 自己的安全饮用水信息系统 (SDWIS) 记录显示美国各个城市的自来水质量。查找为城市服务的供水系统、污染物和违规记录（附有日期以及 EPA 是否将其归类为健康类），并排比较各个城市，了解污染物是什么。它冷静且有来源：它报告 EPA 记录的内容，但从不给出安全结论。覆盖全美 50 个州和华盛顿特区约 19,000 个城市。
plugins.productIntroEn: TapWaterMap shows US tap-water quality city by city, using the EPA's own Safe Drinking Water Information System (SDWIS) records. Look up the water systems serving a city, the contaminants and violations on record — with dates and whether the EPA classifies each as health-based — compare cities side by side, and understand what any contaminant is.

plugins.name: Dewey Data
plugins.productIntro: Dewey 应用程序专为学术研究人员打造，可让您在 Dewey 平台上搜索和探索数据集，而无需离开 ChatGPT。用简单的语言询问，获取数据集详细信息、覆盖范围摘要、模式和可下载示例。花更少的时间寻找数据，花更多的时间使用数据。 Dewey 受到 500 多所大学的数千名学者的信赖，通过一次订阅即可解锁 30 多个优质数据提供商。
plugins.productIntroEn: Built for academic researchers, the Dewey app lets you search and explore datasets on the Dewey Platform without leaving ChatGPT. Ask in plain language, get back dataset details, coverage summaries, schemas, and downloadable samples. Spend less time hunting for data and more time using it.

plugins.name: Trivana Study — Quiz My Notes
plugins.productIntro: 将您正在学习的内容变成您可以实际玩的测验。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn what you're learning into a quiz you can actually play.

plugins.name: Nylon
plugins.productIntro: Nylon 使 ChatGPT 能够直接访问新西兰、澳大利亚和英国的主要法律来源材料——立法、判例法和评论（包括政府指导）——因此法律和税务问题的答案都基于真实的、当前的来源。 用简单的语言提出问题，Nylon 会在整个图书馆中运行关键字和语义搜索。它可以处理精确的查找以及开放的研究。 每个结果都带有原始引用链接，因此您可以验证您正在阅读的内容并自信地引用它。 Nylon 专为律师、税务顾问和任何需要值得信赖和细致的法律研究的人而设计。
plugins.productIntroEn: Nylon gives ChatGPT direct access to primary legal source material across New Zealand, Australia and the UK — legislation, case law and commentary (including government guidance) — so answers to legal and tax questions are grounded in real, current sources. Ask a question in plain language and Nylon runs keyword and semantic searches across the library.

plugins.name: Life Analytics IAS
plugins.description: 审查 IAS 研究记录
plugins.productIntro: Life Analytics IAS 是 Life Analytics 为研究团队提供的集成分析支持系统。此 ChatGPT 应用程序允许授权用户从其工作区查看 IAS 实验记录、分析摘要和报告上下文。它是只读的，仅返回总结的研究背景，不提供原始文件导出、个人数据、诊断、治疗决策或临床建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Life Analytics IAS is the integrated analysis support system from Life Analytics for research teams. This ChatGPT app lets authorized users review IAS experiment records, analysis summaries, and report context from their workspace.

plugins.name: Skarim!
plugins.description: 以色列民意调查和趋势
plugins.productIntro: Skarim 提供公开的以色列民意调查数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Skarim provides access to publicly available Israeli polling data.

plugins.name: SRS (Spaced Repitation System)
plugins.productIntro: SRS（间隔重复系统）是一款个人学习和复习应用程序，旨在帮助用户长期保留知识，而不是几天后就忘记。它允许用户将内容组织为主题和主题，存储详细的课程、摘要、注释、编码示例和参考链接，并将主题标记为“学习”或“已学”。一旦学习了某个主题，该应用程序就会根据用户的信心和之前的表现，使用间隔重复算法自动安排未来的复习。
plugins.productIntroEn: SRS (Spaced Repetition System) is a personal learning and revision app designed to help users retain knowledge for the long term instead of forgetting it after a few days. It lets users organize content into subjects and topics, store detailed lessons, summaries, notes, coding examples, and reference links, and mark topics as either "to learn" or "learned.

plugins.name: Beast Academy - All Ten
plugins.productIntro: 《All Ten – Beast Academy》是一个家庭可以一起解决的日常数学难题。仅使用基本数学运算和拼图中提供的四位数字中的每一个，您的目标是创建从 1 到 10 的每个数字。
plugins.productIntroEn: All Ten – Beast Academy is a daily math puzzle families can solve together. Using only basic math operations and each of the four digits provided in the puzzle, your goal is to create every number from 1 through 10.

plugins.name: Premom Ovulation Calculator
plugins.productIntro: Premom 排卵计算器可帮助用户估计排卵日、受孕窗口、下一个月经周期，以及从上次月经周期的第一天开始 LH 排卵试纸的时间和平均周期长度。它在 ChatGPT 中打开交互式教育计算器，支持英语、德语和简体中文。该应用程序不会连接到 Premom 帐户、销售产品或引导用户访问外部网站。结果是基于周期的教育估计，不能替代专业的医疗建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Premom Ovulation Calculator helps users estimate an ovulation day, fertile window, next period, and when to begin LH ovulation test strips from the first day of the last period and average cycle length. It opens an interactive educational calculator in ChatGPT and supports English, German, and Simplified Chinese.

plugins.name: AI4F Japanese Study
plugins.productIntro: AI4F 日语学习通过交互式查找、抽认卡、测验、配对游戏和激进谜题帮助学习者探索日语词汇、汉字和语法。该版本提供公开学习内容，不需要账号关联。
plugins.productIntroEn: AI4F Japanese Study helps learners explore Japanese vocabulary, kanji, and grammar through interactive lookup, flashcards, quizzes, matching games, and radical puzzles. This version provides public learning content and does not require account linking.

plugins.name: SimpleFeed News & Video MCP
plugins.productIntro: SimpleFeed 新闻和视频内容市场将版权许可的内容引入 OpenAI。按主题、渠道、出版商、元数据日期等搜索数百家优质出版商。获取 HTML 格式的文章摘要、全文、图像和视频、Markdown 和向量以进行推理和基础。该应用程序带来了 SimpleFeed 付费 MCP 服务器，用于语义文章搜索和出版商发现。 使用您的 AWS 账户通过点击接受许可证购买基于查询的访问权限。订阅后使用 OAuth 登录以保存令牌、遵守权利并改进您的应用程序。
plugins.productIntroEn: The SimpleFeed News & Video Content Marketplace brings rights-cleared content into OpenAI. Search hundreds of premium publishers by topic, outlet, publisher, metadata date and more. Get article summaries, full text, images and video in HTML, markdown and vectors for inference and grounding. The App brings SimpleFeed Paid MCP servers for semantic article search and publisher discovery.

plugins.name: AL WAKEELO
plugins.productIntro: AL WAKEELO 是您的数字法律助手，可搜索 600,000 多个巴基斯坦判例法和法规、起草请愿书和商业合同，并进行深入的法律研究。
plugins.productIntroEn: AL WAKEELO is your digital legal assistant that searches 600,000+ Pakistani case laws and statutes, drafts petitions and commercial contracts, and conducts deep legal research.

plugins.name: Digital Compass
plugins.productIntro: 当有人点击虚假链接、丢失帐户或遭受在线诈骗时，一般建议是不够的 - 他们需要针对其所在国家/地区的确切步骤和真实的报告渠道。 Digital Compass 提供精心策划的危机手册（现在该做什么、不该做什么、如何报告）和 9 种语言的预防指南（罗马尼亚语原文；以罗马尼亚语为基础的英语/匈牙利语；以本国当地当局为基础的波兰语、捷克语、斯洛伐克语、意大利语、法语、德语：警察、CERT、消费者保护）。每本剧本都会公开其最后验证的日期。
plugins.productIntroEn: When someone clicks a fake link, loses an account or gets scammed online, generic advice is not enough — they need the exact steps and the real reporting channels for their country. Digital Compass provides curated crisis playbooks (what to do NOW, what NOT to do, how to report) and prevention guides in 9 languages (Romanian original; English/Hungarian anchored in Romania; Polish, Czech,…

plugins.name: Sketchy Medical
plugins.description: 搜索 Sketchy 的图书馆
plugins.productIntro: Sketchy 是一个深受医学、PA、NP 和 MCAT 学生信赖的视觉学习平台。通过此连接器，您可以直接访问 Sketchy 的完整课程和案例库，这样您就可以准确找到您需要的内容并直接开始学习。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sketchy is a visual learning platform trusted by medical, PA, NP, and MCAT students. This connector gives you direct access to Sketchy's full lesson and case library so you can find exactly what you need and jump straight into studying.

plugins.name: ZZAIM
plugins.description: 韩国 K-12 课程计划
plugins.productIntro: ZZAIM 帮助教师找到韩国 K-12 成绩标准，创建和保存符合课程的课程计划，并将保存的文档导出为 DOCX、PPTX 或 HWPX 文件。
plugins.productIntroEn: ZZAIM helps teachers find Korean K-12 achievement standards, create and save curriculum-aligned lesson plans, and export saved documents as DOCX, PPTX, or HWPX files.

plugins.name: Flashcards Space
plugins.productIntro: 抽认卡空间可帮助您直接在 ChatGPT 内创建语言抽认卡。
plugins.productIntroEn: Flashcards Space helps you create language flashcards directly inside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Protplex
plugins.productIntro: Protplex 使蛋白质数据库可以通过提炼的结构、功能和生化概况以自然语言进行搜索。它帮助用户搜索 240,000 多个 PDB 结构，涵盖功能、结构、化学、有机体、组装、配体和实验背景。
plugins.productIntroEn: Protplex makes the Protein Data Bank searchable in natural language through distilled structural, functional, and biochemical profiles. It helps users search 240,000+ PDB structures across function, structure, chemistry, organism, assembly, ligands, and experimental context.

plugins.name: Linked Word
plugins.description: KJV 和 Strong 的查找
plugins.productIntro: Linked Word 可查找 King James 段落、Strong 的希伯来语和希腊语数字、English-to-Strong 的反向查找、使用数字的经文以及 KJV 全文搜索。除非请求 Strong 的单词链接，否则段落结果是文本加上引用 URL。
plugins.productIntroEn: Linked Word looks up King James passages, Strong's Hebrew and Greek numbers, English-to-Strong's reverse lookups, verses that use a number, and KJV full-text search. Passage results are the text plus a citation URL unless Strong's word links are requested.

plugins.name: TTMNG Public
plugins.description: 为大家提供 TTMNG 知识
plugins.productIntro: TTMNG Public 让人们可以查找 TTMNG 术语并阅读泰语、西班牙语和意大利语的公共知识记录。它将信号点记录与疾病或状况记录分开，并规定教育证据边界。它不提供诊断或个性化治疗建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: TTMNG Public lets people look up TTMNG terms and read public knowledge records in Thai, Spanish, and Italian. It keeps signal-point records separate from disease or condition records and states the educational evidence boundaries. It does not provide diagnosis or personalized treatment advice.

plugins.name: QuizStage
plugins.productIntro: QuizStage 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 构建和维护测验节目。该应用程序可以列出用户自己的节目，检查节目结构，创建新节目，编辑节目基础知识，管理类别以及创建、更新、重新排序或删除普通问题卡。
plugins.productIntroEn: QuizStage helps users build and maintain quiz shows through ChatGPT. The app can list a user's own shows, inspect show structure, create new shows, edit show basics, manage categories, and create, update, reorder, or delete normal question cards.

plugins.name: Replio
plugins.productIntro: Replio 是一个人工智能语音培训平台：学员在实时语音课程中与栩栩如生的人工智能角色进行真实对话，并收到评分反馈，而管理人员则跟踪他们的进度。
plugins.productIntroEn: Replio is an AI voice training platform: trainees practice real conversations with lifelike AI personas in live voice sessions and receive scored feedback, while managers follow their progress.

plugins.name: Boluda
plugins.productIntro: 搜索 Boluda.com 课程、课程和播客片段，比较选项，并从公共目录创建个性化学习计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search Boluda.com courses, lessons, and podcast episodes, compare options, and create personalized study plans from the public catalog.

plugins.name: Skillsail
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 使用 Skillsail 创建引人入胜的交互式电子学习。将想法转化为包含幻灯片、测验、活动、图像、视频和画外音的精美课程，然后在交互式内嵌播放器中探索它们，并将其翻译给全球受众。培训准备就绪后，将其作为链接或可重用模板共享，或将其导出为 SCORM 1.2、SCORM 2004、xAPI、cmi5 或独立 HTML5。
plugins.productIntroEn: Create engaging, interactive eLearning with Skillsail directly from ChatGPT. Turn ideas into polished courses with slides, quizzes, activities, images, videos, and voiceovers, then explore them in an interactive inline player and translate them for global audiences. When training is ready, share it as a link or reusable template, or export it as SCORM 1.

plugins.name: Lux AI
plugins.productIntro: Lux AI 将 Lux Research 精选的分析师知识提出了一个问题。询问新兴技术、公司、市场和学术研究，并从 Lux 的专有出版物中获得答案。每项主张都带有链接到基础研究的来源引文，因此您可以在几秒钟内从问题得到可辩护的、有来源的答案。需要您的组织订阅有效的 Lux Research。
plugins.productIntroEn: Lux AI puts Lux Research's curated analyst knowledge one question away. Ask about emerging technologies, companies, markets, and academic research, and get answers drawn from Lux's proprietary publications. Every claim carries a source citation linking back to the underlying research, so you go from question to a defensible, sourced answer in seconds.

plugins.name: Powers Index
plugins.productIntro: Powers Index 引导情报工具可帮助学院和大学领导者使用由 12 个信号组成的结构化框架评估机构绩效，涵盖治理、财务、运营、招生和外部条件等领域。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Powers Index Guided Intelligence tool helps college and university leaders assess institutional performance using a structured framework of 12 signals covering areas such as governance, finance, operations, enrollment, and external conditions.

plugins.name: PhysioKeys
plugins.productIntro: PhysioKeys 帮助临床医生、学生、教育工作者和研究人员从 ChatGPT 中搜索物理治疗和康复证据。用户可以搜索精选的 PhysioKeys 记录或 PubMed、获取文章详细信息、查看摘要和经过权限验证的缓存全文（如果可用）、生成引文、查看保存的文章元数据、将 PMID 保存到其私人图书馆以及检查帐户限额。该插件仅适用于去识别化的研究和引文工作流程，可能会拒绝包含患者身份信息的请求。它不提供紧急诊断或个性化医疗建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: PhysioKeys helps clinicians, students, educators, and researchers search physiotherapy and rehabilitation evidence from ChatGPT. Users can search curated PhysioKeys records or PubMed, fetch article details, review abstracts and rights-verified cached full text when available, generate citations, view saved-article metadata, save PMIDs to their private library, and check account allowance…

plugins.name: Dhamma Data
plugins.productIntro: 搜索巴利经典和后来的文本层，按稳定片段阅读选定的翻译，检查评论和平行报道，比较持有的证人，追踪声明层中的概念，分析有限的证据集，并将每个结果引用到可打开的源页面。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search the Pāli canon and later textual layers, read selected translations by stable segment, inspect commentary and parallel coverage, compare held witnesses, trace concepts across declared strata, analyze bounded evidence sets, and cite every result to an openable source page.

plugins.name: EduInsights
plugins.productIntro: 研究美国大学，报告学位、职业、薪酬、前景、认证以及观察到的人工智能使用情况。每个答案都表明了它的来源。
plugins.productIntroEn: Research U.S. colleges, reported degrees, careers, pay, outlook, accreditation, and observed AI use. Every answer shows its sources.

plugins.name: MentorCruise
plugins.productIntro: 无需离开聊天即可找到合适的 MentorCruise 导师。按技能、预算和响应时间搜索 1,000 多名经过审查的导师，比较个人资料，并在几秒钟内获得预订链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find the right MentorCruise mentor without leaving your chat. Search 1,000s of vetted mentors by skill, budget, and response time, compare profiles, and get a booking link in seconds.

plugins.name: CoreStepPrep
plugins.productIntro: CoreStepPrep 使用 CoreStepPrep 问题历史记录、可访问的题库、CSPCE 尝试和分数预测数据帮助医学生在 ChatGPT 内学习。询问接下来要学习什么、解释 CoreStepPrep QID、检查某个主题的可用问题、创建导师测验链接、查看 CSPCE 表现或分析分数预测趋势。该应用程序返回简洁的指导和紧凑的小部件，以便学生可以快速从对话转向集中复习。
plugins.productIntroEn: CoreStepPrep helps medical students study inside ChatGPT using their CoreStepPrep question history, accessible question bank, CSPCE attempts, and score predictor data. Ask what to study next, explain a CoreStepPrep QID, check available questions for a topic, create a tutor quiz link, review CSPCE performance, or analyze score prediction trends.

plugins.name: Suplla
plugins.productIntro: sulla 帮助登录的学习者检查他们的英语学习进度、浏览语法主题和词汇、进行个性化练习，并通过 ChatGPT 报告学习数据问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: suplla helps logged-in learners check their English-study progress, browse grammar topics and vocabulary, practice personalized exercises, and report problems with learning data through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Vocabden
plugins.description: 记住你正在学习的内容
plugins.productIntro: Vocabden 是您在 ChatGPT 中的语言学习记忆。连接您的帐户，以便 ChatGPT 可以查看您实际正在学习的内容 - 您保存的单词、您的水平以及需要复习的内容 - 而不是每次对话都从零开始。
plugins.productIntroEn: Vocabden is your language-learning memory inside ChatGPT. Connect your account so ChatGPT can see what you're actually learning — your saved words, your level, and what's due for review — instead of starting from zero every conversation.

plugins.name: OpenRegs: Regulatory Research
plugins.description: 最新的法律，而不是网络
plugins.productIntro: OpenRegs 将当前的美国法规和法规引入 ChatGPT，供合规团队使用。覆盖范围涵盖 53 个司法管辖区：所有 50 个州、华盛顿特区、波多黎各和联邦。每个答案都会返回法律的实际文本，以及任何人都可以打开的研究日志和公共引文链接，因此同事或审计员可以检查工作，而不是凭信心进行摘要。通过一次请求即可运行 50 个州的调查，而不是手动维护电子表格。由 OpenLaws PBC（OpenLaws API 背后的公益公司）构建。
plugins.productIntroEn: OpenRegs brings current U.S. statutes and regulations into ChatGPT for compliance teams. Coverage spans 53 jurisdictions: all 50 states, D.C., Puerto Rico, and federal. Every answer returns the actual text of the law, along with a research log and public citation links that anyone can open, so a colleague or an auditor can check the work rather than take a summary on faith.

plugins.name: Careerbot
plugins.productIntro: Careerbot帮助日本应届毕业生求职者从最初的职业指导过渡到自我分析、申请写作、公司研究、动机陈述和面试练习。它通过结构化问题和下一步选项来指导学生，同时避免对他们的经历、成就或数字进行未经支持的假设。
plugins.productIntroEn: Careerbot helps Japanese new-graduate job seekers move from initial career guidance to self-analysis, application writing, company research, motivation statements, and interview practice. It guides students with structured questions and next-step options, while avoiding unsupported assumptions about their experiences, achievements, or numbers.
plugins.developerName: 株式会社キャリアボット

plugins.name: Special Education Law
plugins.productIntro: 搜索特殊教育决定和裁决，检索完整的案件记录，探索引用关系，分析裁决者和问题趋势，并查找多个州的听证程序和法规。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search special education decisions and rulings, retrieve complete case records, explore citation relationships, analyze adjudicators and issue trends, and look up hearing procedures and regulations across multiple states.

plugins.name: NoBrainner
plugins.productIntro: NoBrainner 将您的抽认卡学习进度和间隔重复卡片直接连接到 ChatGPT。登录后，您可以向 ChatGPT 询问您当前学习统计数据的详细概述，检查您最近的复习活动，查明您最薄弱的卡片，并获得有关下一步复习内容的个性化建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: NoBrainner connects your flashcard study progress and spaced repetition decks directly to ChatGPT. Once signed in, you can ask ChatGPT for a detailed overview of your current study stats, check your recent review activity, pinpoint your weakest cards, and get personalized recommendations on what to review next.

plugins.name: CAIRO Medicines
plugins.productIntro: CAIRO Medicines 查找在欧盟和美国授权的药物，并返回监管机构发布的标签文本本身，并在每个段落中附有产品、文档、部分、来源 URL 和日期。用户可以按品牌名称或活性成分查找药物，将广泛的部分缩小到他们询问的具体警告，查看标签的版本历史记录，并找到其管辖范围内的官方不良事件报告途径。当一个名称与多个产品匹配时，它会列出候选产品而不是选择一个产品，而对于欧盟和美国以外的市场，它会说明限制而不是替换另一个市场的标签。
plugins.productIntroEn: CAIRO Medicines looks up medicines authorised in the EU and the US and returns the regulator-published label text itself, with the product, document, section, source URL and date attached to every passage.

plugins.name: Contact Center AI Association
plugins.productIntro: Contact Center AI Association 应用程序使成员能够在 ChatGPT 内查找答案并注册会议。 连接 CCAIA 帐户后，会员可以搜索 CCAIA 资源、会员信息、章节详细信息、政策和程序、注册活动，并在请求需要人工跟进时创建支持票证。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Contact Center AI Association app enables members to find answers and register for meetings inside ChatGPT. After connecting a CCAIA account, members can search CCAIA resources, member information, chapter details, policies, and procedures, register for events, and create a support ticket when a request needs human follow-up.

plugins.name: AliXAi
plugins.productIntro: AliXAi 接受助理指导，为所有太空人员提供了解：占星主题、人类设计、基因钥匙、命理学和地理占星，以及时刻的转变、今天的短语、随行人员和 Synastrie、以及学术界（课程和网络研讨会）。 L'assistant lit et met en forme tes données déjà calculées, marque tes leçons ou t'inscrit à un webinaire;交互式可视化和明智的行动（données de nai…
plugins.productIntroEn: AliXAi te donne accès, directement dans l'assistant, à ton espace personnel de connaissance de soi : thème astrologique, Human Design, Gene Keys, numérologie et astrologie géographique, plus tes transits du moment, ta phrase du jour, ton entourage et ta synastrie, et l'Académie (cours et webinaires).

plugins.name: StudyArena
plugins.description: 比较 AI 答案以供研究
plugins.productIntro: 提出一个研究问题一次，然后并排比较多个人工智能生成的答案。 StudyArena 帮助学生探索解释、撰写反馈、研究方法和作业规划，然后选择他们认为最有用的答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ask a study question once and compare multiple AI-generated answers side by side. StudyArena helps students explore explanations, writing feedback, research approaches, and assignment planning, then choose the answer they find most useful.

plugins.name: Eclat Institute
plugins.productIntro: 搜索 Eclat Institute 考试笔记、实践指导和学费信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search Eclat Institute exam notes, practical guidance, and tuition information.

plugins.name: Talents Kids
plugins.productIntro: Talents Kids 是发现和培养孩子内在潜力的首要方式。通过将绘画、写作和学校项目等日常物品转化为深入的人才洞察，我们帮助家长和教育工作者准确了解孩子的闪光点。
plugins.productIntroEn: Talents Kids is the premiere way to discover and cultivate your child's innate potential. By transforming everyday artifacts—like drawings, writings, and school projects—into deep talent insights, we help parents and educators understand exactly where a child shines.

plugins.name: MedStats
plugins.productIntro: MedStats 将 ChatGPT 与个人 MedAT 跟踪连接起来。用户可以保存确认的锻炼结果、检索最新结果、分析子测试趋势、总结学习进度、使用每日教练、核对计划块并接收每周回顾和下一个建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: MedStats verbindet ChatGPT mit dem persönlichen MedAT-Tracking. Nutzer können bestätigte Übungsergebnisse speichern, letzte Ergebnisse abrufen, Untertest-Trends analysieren, ihren Lernfortschritt zusammenfassen lassen, den Tagescoach nutzen, Planblöcke abhaken und ein Wochenreview mit nächsten Empfehlungen erhalten.

plugins.name: Vocaneo
plugins.productIntro: Vocaneo 将 ChatGPT 与法国职业和培训参考数据连接起来：超过 1,000 份工作资料（任务、技能、薪资、劳动力市场紧张局势、人工智能暴露）、RNCP 文凭和认证，以及超过 135,000 个培训项目以及在法国各地提供培训的机构。
plugins.productIntroEn: Vocaneo connects ChatGPT to the French careers and training reference data: over 1,000 job profiles (missions, skills, salaries, labour-market tension, AI exposure), RNCP diplomas and certifications, and more than 135,000 training programmes with the establishments that deliver them across France.

plugins.name: Taxiger Doc
plugins.description: 了解比利时出租车规则
plugins.productIntro: TaxiGer Doc 帮助出租车运营商、司机和出租车企业主更好地了解比利时出租车法规、法律义务以及佛兰德斯、布鲁塞尔和瓦隆的等级出租车、街头出租车和豪华轿车服务的管理程序。查找官方 Chiron 指南、有关 dienststaat、vervoerbewijs、路线表、出租车执照、检查和所有强制性出租车文件的信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: TaxiGer Doc helps taxi operators, drivers and taxi business owners better understand Belgian taxi regulations, legal obligations and administrative procedures for rank taxis, street taxis and limousine services in Flanders, Brussels and Wallonia.

plugins.name: Lucebra
plugins.productIntro: 按主题、技能或学习目标搜索和发现 Lucebra 在线课程。快速探索相关课程选项并找到与您想要学习的内容相匹配的学习内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search and discover online courses on Lucebra by topic, skill, or learning goal. Quickly explore relevant course options and find learning content that matches what you want to study.

plugins.name: EduRolia
plugins.productIntro: EduRolia 是一款面向私立学校、公立学校和教育集团的招生 CRM。连接您的帐户以查看招生渠道，确定需要跟进的家庭，并搜索授权的学生、家庭和联系人。每个用户只能访问其 EduRolia 帐户允许的学校。当前版本是只读的，无法创建、编辑或删除 CRM 记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: EduRolia is an admissions CRM for private schools, publicly funded schools, and education groups. Connect your account to review the admissions pipeline, identify families that need follow-up, and search authorized students, families, and contacts. Each user can access only the schools allowed by their EduRolia account.

plugins.name: CiteCheck
plugins.productIntro: CiteCheck 帮助用户搜索集中的联邦、加利福尼亚州和纽约法律搜索，检索主要来源段落，检查引用是否出现在涵盖的来源中，并练习法庭异议。它不确定良好法律地位或提供法律建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: CiteCheck helps users search a focused federal, California, and New York legal search, retrieve primary-source passages, check whether citations appear in covered sources, and practice courtroom objections. It does not determine good-law status or provide legal advice.

plugins.name: Admit Coach University Finder
plugins.productIntro: 按名称、地点、专业、项目、体育、认证、截止日期和费用搜索 3,500 多所美国学院和大学。直接在 ChatGPT 中比较学校并查看入学、学费、经济援助、毕业率和收入。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search 3,500+ U.S. colleges and universities by name, location, major, program, athletics, accreditation, deadlines, and cost. Compare schools side by side and review admissions, tuition, financial aid, graduation rates, and earnings directly in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: ProSchool360
plugins.description: 管理学校数据和统计数据
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 直接连接到您的 ProSchool360 学校管理帐户。使用简单的自然语言提示，轻松查询和监控学校分支机构的学生档案、学业安排、作业列表、时间表和关键财务统计数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT directly to your ProSchool360 school management account. Easily query and monitor student profiles, academic schedules, homework lists, timetables, and key financial statistics from your school branch using simple natural language prompts.

plugins.name: Wayroc Career Coach
plugins.productIntro: 在不发明证据的情况下改进数据和 SDE 简历，或者通过一项只读操作将提供的纯文本简历内容与今天的公开 Wayroc 工作源进行匹配。不使用 Wayroc 帐户、OAuth、保存的简历访问、工作申请、通知或学生数据修改。
plugins.productIntroEn: Improve Data and SDE resumes without inventing evidence, or match supplied plain-text resume content to today's public Wayroc job feed through one read-only action. No Wayroc account, OAuth, saved-resume access, job application, notification, or student-data modification is used.

plugins.name: Analytics Brain
plugins.description: 搜索 Witbee 的专家指南
plugins.productIntro: Analytics Brain 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Witbee 在营销分析、跟踪和数据工程方面的知识库——由 Witbee 自己的团队编写的网络研讨会文章、时事通讯问题、程序和指南。
plugins.productIntroEn: Analytics Brain connects ChatGPT to Witbee's knowledge base on marketing analytics, tracking and data engineering — webinar write-ups, newsletter issues, procedures and guides written by Witbee's own team.

plugins.name: WordByWord – Learn Languages
plugins.productIntro: 通过直接在 ChatGPT 中构建和练习词汇来学习语言。创建集合，添加带有翻译和例句的单词和短语，跟踪您的学习进度，并使用您仍在学习的词汇生成个性化练习。
plugins.productIntroEn: Learn languages by building and practicing vocabulary directly in ChatGPT. Create collections, add words and phrases with translations and example sentences, track your learning progress, and generate personalized exercises using the vocabulary you are still learning.

plugins.name: UrbanPro Tutor Finder
plugins.description: 寻找 1000 多个科目的导师
plugins.productIntro: UrbanPro Tutor Finder 可帮助学习者找到经验丰富的导师和辅导提供者，涉及学术、竞争性考试、编码、语言、音乐、健身、专业技能等。只需描述您想学习的内容，平台就会显示根据您的喜好量身定制的相关导师匹配。
plugins.productIntroEn: UrbanPro Tutor Finder helps learners discover experienced tutors and coaching providers for academics, competitive exams, coding, languages, music, fitness, professional skills, and more. Simply describe what you want to learn, and the platform surfaces relevant tutor matches tailored to your preferences.

plugins.name: Career Passport
plugins.description: キャリア実績を取得・活用
plugins.originalDescription: キャリア実績を取得・活用
plugins.productIntro: Career Passport：キャリア実績を取得・活用。
plugins.productIntroEn: Career Passportは、認証済みユーザー本人のプロジェクト経験、フィードバック、成績、アワードと、所属する学校・企業などの組織情報をChatGPTから取得し、自己分析、応募書類作成、面接準備などに活用できるようにします。

plugins.name: PE Prep Pro Engineering
plugins.description: 经过验证的体育考试练习
plugins.productIntro: PE Prep Pro Engineering 帮助 PE 考生创建经过审核的练习集、通过来源支持的解释对已完成的尝试进行评分、检索概念简介并报告内容问题以供编辑审核。
plugins.productIntroEn: PE Prep Pro Engineering helps PE candidates create reviewed practice sets, grade completed attempts with source-backed explanations, retrieve concept briefs, and report content issues for editorial review.

plugins.name: Uncountable (US)
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 Uncountable 工作区来搜索实验、配方、样品和测试结果，提取特定测量结果，并根据您自己的实验室数据起草技术文章。 Access 尊重您现有的 Uncountable 权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Uncountable workspace to search experiments, formulations, samples, and test results, pull specific measurements, and draft technical write-ups grounded in your own lab data. Access respects your existing Uncountable permissions.

plugins.name: Maakrop
plugins.productIntro: Maakrop 是一款让日常课堂管理变得更简单、更方便的助教。教师可以在一个地方通过对话访问重要信息并处理常见任务，而无需花费时间浏览多个页面、搜索菜单或手动收集信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Maakrop is a teaching assistant that makes everyday classroom management simpler and more convenient. Teachers can access important information and handle common tasks through conversation in one place, without spending time navigating multiple pages, searching through menus, or gathering information manually.

plugins.name: AbS
plugins.description: 研究您的 AbS 材料
plugins.productIntro: 将您的 AbS My Learning 材料连接到 ChatGPT 以获得学习支持。询问有关所选材料的问题，获取解释、修订计划、测验提示和进度感知指导，同时 AbS 在 AbS 内保留受保护的文件、源链接、付款和编辑操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your AbS My Learning materials to ChatGPT for study support. Ask questions about selected materials, get explanations, revision plans, quiz prompts, and progress-aware guidance while AbS keeps protected files, source links, payments, and editing actions inside AbS.

plugins.name: AI Voor Leerlingen
plugins.productIntro: 你被地理困住了吗？ AI For Students 解释了您的 HAVO 或 VWO 级别的困难主题，提出有针对性的练习问题，并逐步帮助您。您不会收到标准的聊天机器人答案，而是收到与您的主题、水平和学习问题相匹配的解释——基于精心编制的教育内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Loop je vast bij aardrijkskunde? AI Voor Leerlingen legt lastige onderwerpen uit op jouw HAVO- of VWO-niveau, stelt gerichte oefenvragen en helpt je stap voor stap verder. Je krijgt geen standaard chatbotantwoord, maar uitleg die aansluit bij je vak, niveau en leervraag — gebaseerd op zorgvuldig samengestelde onderwijsinhoud.

plugins.name: TTXVN Nghị quyết 57
plugins.description: 查询越南第 57 号决议相关内容。
plugins.productIntro: 越通社第57号决议帮助用户查阅越通社关于落实第57号决议的文件，包括领导指示、事件新闻、任务和解决方案以及各部委、分支机构和地方的落实活动。
plugins.productIntroEn: TTXVN Nghị quyết 57 giúp người dùng tra cứu tư liệu TTXVN về việc triển khai Nghị quyết 57, gồm chỉ đạo của lãnh đạo, tin sự kiện, nhiệm vụ và giải pháp, cùng hoạt động triển khai của bộ ngành và địa phương.

plugins.name: Wortschatz
plugins.productIntro: 使用 Wortschatz 创建个性化抽认卡组、练习词汇和翻译，并按照自己的节奏学习任何语言。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use Wortschatz to create personalised flashcard decks, practise vocabulary and translations, and learn any language at your own pace.

plugins.name: ADTraining
plugins.productIntro: ADTraining 是创建、提供和衡量任何规模的专业培训影响的完整解决方案。我们的平台为构建富媒体课程提供了强大的工作空间，并得到“Ada”的支持——我们的情境人工智能助手可以生成材料并指导学习者。借助用于团队管理、视频会议和高级投资回报率分析的集成工具，ADTraining 为您提供在单一智能生态系统中管理组织发展所需的一切。
plugins.productIntroEn: ADTraining is the complete solution to create, deliver and measure the impact of professional training at any scale. Our platform offers a powerful workspace for building rich media courses, supported by “Ada” – our contextual AI assistant that generates materials and guides learners.

plugins.name: Open Ephemeris
plugins.productIntro: Open Ephemeris 为 ChatGPT 提供了真正的天文学工作。每个位置均来自 NASA JPL DE440 星历，覆盖 1550-2650 CE，精度为亚角秒，与航天器导航使用的内核相同，因此位置是计算出来的，而不是估计的。
plugins.productIntroEn: Open Ephemeris gives ChatGPT real astronomy to work from. Every position comes from the NASA JPL DE440 ephemeris covering 1550-2650 CE at sub-arcsecond precision, the same kernel used for spacecraft navigation, so positions are computed rather than estimated.

plugins.name: Trendkia News
plugins.productIntro: TrendKia 是一个现代化的双语新闻台，可以快速捕捉来自金融、政治、技术、娱乐、评论、印度和世界的热门故事，并与事实进行核对，并在几分钟内以印地语和英语向您提供。
plugins.productIntroEn: TrendKia is a modern, bilingual news desk where trending stories from finance, politics technology, entertainment, reviews, India and the world are caught fast, checked against the facts, and delivered to you in both Hindi and English within minutes.

plugins.name: Agent Kunjani
plugins.productIntro: Kunjani 特工将培训简介转变为 Kunjani 上的即用型套牌，Kunjani 是一个基于 WhatsApp、人工智能驱动的游戏学习平台，用于培训一线和分布式团队。
plugins.productIntroEn: Agent Kunjani turns a training brief into a ready-to-play deck on Kunjani, a WhatsApp-based, AI-powered game-based learning platform used to train frontline and distributed teams.

plugins.name: Nyambot
plugins.productIntro: Nyambot 将您的助手连接到法国官方公共数据并提供来源答案。询问有关房地产（实际 DVF 价格）、法律（Légifrance 文章）、企业（SIRENE 登记册）、社会援助、健康或程序的问题：Nyambot 将查找官方数据、交叉引用并引用其来源（日期、参考文献、金额）。当数据不存在或问题不精确时，他会直接说出来，而不是发明出来。
plugins.productIntroEn: Nyambot connecte votre assistant à la donnée publique officielle française et rend des réponses sourcées. Posez une question sur l'immobilier (prix DVF réels), le droit (articles Légifrance), les entreprises (registre SIRENE), les aides sociales, la santé ou une démarche : Nyambot va chercher la donnée officielle, la croise et cite ses sources (date, référence, montant).

plugins.name: TeX64
plugins.productIntro: TeX64 将课程材料转化为日语讲义、考试摘要、练习表和简单的学术报告。用户用普通语言描述结果； TeX64 在自己的服务器上处理排版和制作细节，并返回带有页面预览的完成的 PDF。编译在没有网络访问权限的一次性沙箱中运行。 PDF 链接是临时的，一小时内就会过期； TeX64 不保留帐户或文档历史记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: TeX64 turns course material into Japanese lecture notes, exam summaries, exercise sheets, and simple academic reports. Users describe the result in ordinary language; TeX64 handles typography and production details on its own server and returns a finished PDF with page previews. Compilation runs in a throwaway sandbox with no network access.

plugins.name: Fiveable for AP Students
plugins.description: 学习每门 AP 课程
plugins.productIntro: 使用值得信赖的 Fiveable 内容学习每门 AP 课程。查找学习指南和关键术语、检索练习 MCQ 和 FRQ、检查答案、通过 AI 反馈对书面回答进行评分、估计 AP 分数、查看进度并制定个性化学习计划。无需登录即可公开课程大纲和搜索工作；连接 Fiveable 帐户会根据学生的 Fiveable 访问权限添加已保存的进度和个性化工具。
plugins.productIntroEn: Study for every AP class with trusted Fiveable content. Find study guides and key terms, retrieve practice MCQs and FRQs, check answers, score written responses with AI feedback, estimate AP scores, review progress, and build personalized study plans.

plugins.name: Noteflix
plugins.productIntro: Noteflix 帮助学习者将当前 ChatGPT 对话中提供的文本转变为活跃的学习工作流程。它可以组织忠实来源的指南，创建抽认卡和直接检索练习，引导一次一个问题的复习，并根据学习者的截止日期和可用时间制定切合实际的复习计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: Noteflix helps learners turn text supplied in the current ChatGPT conversation into an active study workflow. It can organize source-faithful guides, create flashcards and direct-retrieval practice, lead one-question-at-a-time review, and build realistic review plans from the learner's deadline and available time.

plugins.name: Time Machine
plugins.productIntro: Time Machine 是一个人工智能驱动的企业学习平台。该插件允许 ChatGPT 在公司的 Time Machine 工作区中创建和管理课程、模块、主题、课程、练习、测验问题、学习字节、用户、部门、角色和演示培训。它还读取学生的进度、见解、证书和专家作业。通过带有 PKCE 的 OAuth 2.1 针对您的公司运行 123 个操作 — ChatGPT 只能看到您的 Time Machine 帐户可以访问的数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Time Machine is an AI-powered corporate learning platform. This plugin lets ChatGPT create and manage courses, modules, topics, lessons, exercises, quiz questions, learning bytes, users, departments, roles, and demo trainings inside your company's Time Machine workspace. It also reads student progress, insights, certificates, and expert assignments.

plugins.name: KIKARET
plugins.productIntro: KIKARET 帮助 ChatGPT 查找有关日本幼儿园、托儿所和托儿所的结构化、有来源支持的信息，包括容量、开放时间、接受年龄、联系方式和其他特定于设施的事实。
plugins.productIntroEn: KIKARET helps ChatGPT find structured, source-backed information about Japanese kindergartens, nurseries, and childcare facilities, including capacity, opening hours, accepted ages, contact details, and other facility-specific facts.

plugins.name: Vitark
plugins.productIntro: Vitark 将 ChatGPT 与印度判例法和立法联系起来，以进行基于源记录的研究。检索最高法院和高等法院的判决以及可用的法庭和监管机构的决定；按名称、案例编号、中性引文或 CNR 查找案例；检索可用的判断文本；并查找法律规定。
plugins.productIntroEn: Vitark connects ChatGPT to Indian case law and legislation for research grounded in source records. Search Supreme Court and High Court judgments and available tribunal and regulator decisions; find a case by name, case number, neutral citation or CNR; retrieve available judgment text; and look up statutory provisions.

plugins.name: Blossom
plugins.productIntro: 一款语言学习日记应用程序，可以通过在其中写日记来帮助您学习外语 - Blossom。 用英语、日语、中文、韩语等 50 多种语言进行写作，每天提高您的外语技能。
plugins.productIntroEn: A language-learning diary app that helps you study a foreign language by writing your daily journal in it — Blossom. Write in 50+ languages including English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean and more, and improve your foreign-language skills every day.

plugins.name: Atlarium Habitat Database MCP
plugins.productIntro: Atlarium 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中探索水族馆和相关栖息地系统的公共栖息地数据。它可以搜索物种、植物、产品、指南、诊断、药物和施肥参考；检查兼容性；计算水箱、水化学、剂量和设备估算；并生成咨询池和施肥计划。该应用程序是只读的，不会公开 Atlarium 帐户、私有工作区、管理 API 或写入操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Atlarium helps users explore public habitat data for aquariums and related habitat systems in ChatGPT. It can search species, plants, products, guides, diagnostics, medicines and fertilization references; check compatibility; calculate tank, water chemistry, dosing and equipment estimates; and generate advisory tank and fertilization plans.

plugins.name: PlyMove
plugins.description: Elo 感知的国际象棋故事板
plugins.productIntro: PlyMove Storyboard 将国际象棋游戏变成针对学习者的叙述。粘贴 PGN 和目标 Elo 以获得开场上下文、故事情节、按因果顺序排列的关键章节、假设分支和主要课程。您还可以解释单个 FEN、比较候选走法以获得学习者评分，或者询问如果在决策点采取了不同的走法会怎样。
plugins.productIntroEn: PlyMove Storyboard turns a chess game into a learner-specific narrative. Paste a PGN and a target Elo to get opening context, a story arc, ranked critical chapters with causal sequences, what-if branches, and a main lesson. You can also explain a single FEN, compare candidate moves for a learner rating, or ask what if a different move had been played at a decision point.

plugins.name: Vitamarinaweb
plugins.productIntro: 按科学名称或通用名称搜索 VitaMarinaWeb 海洋地图集。查找公共物种条目和最近的海洋文章。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search the VitaMarinaWeb marine atlas by scientific or common name. Find public species entries and recent marine articles.

plugins.name: Crazy Tongits – Learn & Review
plugins.productIntro: 通过清晰的英语、菲律宾语和塔利什语解释来学习菲律宾语 Tongits。比较 13 种菲律宾通吉特变体，而不混合它们的规则合约；在私人互动桌上练习合法的听牌、融合、sapaw 和弃牌；分析私人或已完成的手牌中的可见牌；完整的规则练习；并遵循由七部分组成的学习路径和每日挑战。教练从不猜测隐藏的牌，在现场真人比赛中推荐动作，处理真钱，或提供可兑换的奖励。
plugins.productIntroEn: Learn Filipino Tongits with clear English, Filipino, and Taglish explanations. Compare 13 Philippine Tongits variants without mixing their rule contracts; practice legal draws, melds, sapaw, and discards on a private interactive table; analyze visible cards from a private or completed hand; complete rule drills; and follow a seven-part learning path with a daily challenge.

plugins.name: GenealogyDirect
plugins.productIntro: 使用 GenealogyDirect 获得家族史研究方面的帮助或帮助他人。准备可操作的研究问题，索取特定历史文献的副本，发现符合您的兴趣或位置的请求，提交报价，并审查您发布或加入的工作。未经您明确确认，不会发布或提交任何内容。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use GenealogyDirect to get help with family-history research or help others. Prepare actionable research questions, request copies of specific historical documents, discover requests that match your interests or location, submit offers, and review work you posted or joined. Nothing is published or submitted without your explicit confirmation.

plugins.name: Coffeetable
plugins.productIntro: 咖啡桌可帮助您找到下一本书
plugins.productIntroEn: Coffeetable helps you find your next book

plugins.name: LiveCase
plugins.productIntro: LiveCase 帮助教育工作者和学习设计师通过 ChatGPT 创建、检查和编辑交互式案例模拟。作者可以处理案例结构、人物、章节、对话内容、问题、评分特征、徽章、汇报、支持文件和图像。该插件仅适用于登录用户有权编辑的情况。发布、更改可见性、转让所有权和删除整个案例仍保留在 LiveCase Web 应用程序中。
plugins.productIntroEn: LiveCase helps educators and learning designers create, inspect, and edit interactive case simulations through ChatGPT. Authors can work with case structure, characters, chapters, conversational content, questions, scoring characteristics, badges, debriefs, supporting files, and images. The plugin works only with cases the signed-in user is authorized to edit.

plugins.name: EbooksDepository
plugins.productIntro: EbooksDepository 提供电子书和有声读物的公共书目发现。按标题、作者、出版商或语言搜索，检查格式和目录元数据，并按段检索公共记录。连接器是匿名、只读且非事务性的。
plugins.productIntroEn: EbooksDepository provides public bibliographic discovery for ebooks and audiobooks. Search by title, author, publisher, or language, inspect formats and catalog metadata, and retrieve a public record by slug. The connector is anonymous, read-only, and non-transactional.

plugins.name: TestMaker
plugins.productIntro: TestMaker 允许您通过 ChatGPT 创建和管理自己的学习工作簿。查看现有工作簿和问题，创建新工作簿以及添加、编辑或删除问题。用它来组织学校考试、入学考试、专业认证和语言学习的学习材料。需要一个 TestMaker 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: TestMaker lets you create and manage your own study workbooks through ChatGPT. View your existing workbooks and questions, create new workbooks, and add, edit, or delete questions. Use it to organize study material for school tests, entrance exams, professional certifications, and language learning. A TestMaker account is required.

plugins.name: ClassWise School & District

plugins.productIntroEn: SuperQDA connects your qualitative research workspace to ChatGPT. Access your research projects, documents, codes, and analyses directly in conversation.

plugins.name: Life in the UK Practice Tests

plugins.name: HadithDB
plugins.description: 搜索古兰经、塔夫西尔、圣训

plugins.productIntroEn: Search and retrieve Quran ayahs, tafsir commentary, hadith search results, and detailed hadith records with Arabic and English text, source headings, grades, and canonical links.

plugins.name: Qulture

plugins.name: Clairwave

plugins.productIntroEn: Clairwave gives ChatGPT grounded ocean-acoustics answers instead of estimates from memory. Ask about any point in the world ocean and the plugin runs propagation physics on Clairwave's platform: parabolic-equation transmission loss along a bearing, sonar-equation detection ranges, and full 3D Bellhop transmission-loss volumes, driven by Clairwave-served bathymetry, seasonal sound-speed p…

plugins.name: EduOpus
plugins.productIntro: EduOpus 将您的学校管理系统与 ChatGPT 连接起来，允许授权的学校工作人员使用自然语言访问和管理学校信息。检查学生记录、出勤、家庭作业、费用、付款、员工信息和其他学校数据，并执行支持的操作，而无需浏览多个仪表板。访问和操作取决于您连接的 EduOpus 帐户的可用权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: EduOpus connects your school management system with ChatGPT, allowing authorized school staff to access and manage school information using natural language. Check student records, attendance, homework, fees, payments, staff information, and other school data, and perform supported actions without navigating through multiple dashboards.

plugins.name: HiTCF
plugins.productIntro: HiTCF 将其 TCF 加拿大口语练习库及其评分引入 ChatGPT。询问 Tâche 1、2 或 3 主题，您会收到一份法语委托书，其措辞与任务的措辞方式相同，并附有翻译。大声回答，然后询问你的分数：HiTCF 返回 CEFR/NCLC 级别，并提供有关发音、词汇、语法以及答案满足任务的程度的各个维度的反馈 - 与 hitcf.com 上使用的评分相同。解释遵循您 HiTCF 帐户上设置的语言；委托书本身仍用法语。
plugins.productIntroEn: HiTCF brings its TCF Canada speaking practice bank and its grading into ChatGPT. Ask for a Tâche 1, 2 or 3 topic and you get a consigne in French, phrased the way the task is phrased, with a translation.

plugins.name: MAK Immigration Source Guide
plugins.productIntro: 查找来自 MAK 加拿大移民服务的加拿大移民来源链接、主题参考和注明日期的变更分类帐条目。该插件用于一般信息和来源发现，而不是个性化的移民建议或特定案例的法律结论。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find Canadian immigration source links, topic references, and dated change-ledger entries from MAK Canadian Immigration Services. This plugin is for general information and source discovery, not individualized immigration advice or case-specific legal conclusions.

plugins.name: JurisAI-ICIDA
plugins.productIntro: 通过 ICIDA JurisAI 的经过验证的引文和法律见解搜索和分析塞浦路斯判例法、最高法院判决和立法。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search and analyze Cypriot case law, Supreme Court decisions, and legislation with verified citations and legal insights from ICIDA JurisAI.

plugins.name: Signal Advisor

plugins.productIntroEn: Signal Advisor explains AI discoverability: what it is, why it matters, and how to improve it. It covers a prioritized action plan, schema markup, how each major AI platform discovers businesses, and how to read a Signal Score. Built by Signal & Structure AI, an independent AI-discoverability consultancy, not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.

plugins.name: Parliament Connect
plugins.productIntro: 根据实际所说内容搜索英国议会视频剪辑库。用简单的语言描述一个想法，或者给出您记得的独特单词，Parliament Connect 会返回与演讲者、他们的政党、开会日期、文字摘录和可共享视频链接相匹配的剪辑。用它来查找您记不太清的引言，检查国会议员是否就某个主题发表过讲话，或者调出辩论背后的镜头。搜索涵盖您的Parliament Connect 计划中包含的议员，并且您可以使用现有帐户登录。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search a library of UK Parliament video clips by what was actually said. plugins.productIntro: 你的 Xero，用简单的英语来说。有客户付钱给你。谁欠你钱了。您的现金状况。有什么突出的。一切都以简单的语言进行，无需打开 Xero。只读：Voder 只看，不碰。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your Xero, in plain English. Has a customer paid you. Who owes you money. Your cash position. What's outstanding. All in plain language, without opening Xero. Read-only: Voder looks, never touches.

plugins.name: Remitly
plugins.productIntro: 您可以在汇款前使用 Chatgpt 中的 Remitly 来计划汇款。您可以询问有关交货时间、费用、费率等的问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: You can use Remitly within Chatgpt to plan your money transfer before you send. You can ask questions about delivery times, fees, rates and more.

plugins.name: LONA Trading Assistant
plugins.productIntro: LONA 交易助手可帮助您使用人工智能开发、回测和优化算法交易策略。从受支持的交易所上传市场数据，编写基于 Python 的交易策略，并运行全面的回测，以了解您的策略在历史上的表现如何。查看详细的绩效报告，其中包含显示进入/退出点、回报和风险指标的交互式图表。
plugins.productIntroEn: LONA Trading Assistant helps you develop, backtest, and optimize algorithmic trading strategies using AI. Upload market data from supported exchanges, write Python-based trading strategies, and run comprehensive backtests to see how your strategies would have performed historically.

plugins.name: Kubera
plugins.productIntro: 询问有关您的 Kubera 产品组合的问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ask questions about your Kubera portfolio.

plugins.name: Fugle-Stock
plugins.description: 串接富果投資平台，管理您的追蹤清單、投資筆記、到價提醒和市場
plugins.originalDescription: 串接富果投資平台，管理您的追蹤清單、投資筆記、到價提醒和市場
plugins.productIntro: Fugle-Stock：串接富果投資平台，管理您的追蹤清單、投資筆記、到價提醒和市場。
plugins.productIntroEn: 將您的富果 Fugle 投資平台與 ChatGPT 無縫整合，打造個人化的智慧投資助理。透過自然語言對話，您可以管理追蹤股票、投資筆記、股價到價通知，並獲取專業市場分析與研究報告內容。本工具不提供任何投資建議，所有資訊僅供參考。

plugins.name: IOL invertironline
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Invertironline 经纪账户，并直接在对话中交易阿根廷市场。在 BYMA 上提取股票、债券、CEDEAR 和期权的实时报价和订单簿，包括希腊期权在内的完整期权链。下达买卖订单、设置止损和止盈水平，以及认购或赎回共同基金 (FCI)。查看您的投资组合持有量、结算条件下的现金余额以及最近的账户活动。每个订单在提交前都会经过验证，因此您始终会在执行任何操作之前确认价格、佣金和所需的任何宣誓声明。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your Invertironline brokerage account and trade Argentine markets directly in conversation. Pull real-time quotes and order books for stocks, bonds, CEDEARs, and options on BYMA, with full options chains including Greeks. Place buy and sell orders, set stop loss and take profit levels, and subscribe to or redeem mutual funds (FCI).

plugins.name: FinancialFilings
plugins.productIntro: FinancialFiles 使 ChatGPT 能够访问全球上市和退市公司的文件、通话记录和标准化财务数据，超过 3500 万份文件，涵盖 85,000 多个股票代码，已有 20 多年的历史。询问任何公司的最新年度报告，提取特定的财务项目及其货币和会计期间，搜索文件的全文，或比较同行之间的指标。使用 OAuth 登录您的免费 FinancialFilings 帐户，无需 API 密钥。基于开放模型上下文协议构建。
plugins.productIntroEn: FinancialFilings gives ChatGPT access to filings, call transcripts, and normalized financials for listed and delisted companies worldwide, 35 million+ filings across 85,000+ tickers, with 20+ years of history. Ask for any company's latest annual report, pull a specific financial line item with its currency and fiscal period, search a filing's full text, or compare metrics across peers.

plugins.name: Synci
plugins.productIntro: Synci 将您的真实银行、经纪和加密货币交易账户连接到人工智能助手， 只读。询问您所有账户的余额、交易、持有和支出 帐户集中在一处：
plugins.productIntroEn: Synci connects your real bank, brokerage, and crypto-exchange accounts to AI assistants, read-only. Ask about balances, transactions, holdings, and spending across all your accounts in one place:

plugins.name: Mercury
plugins.productIntro: 将您的 Mercury 帐户连接到 ChatGPT，即可在您已经完成其余工作的地方获取有关您财务状况的答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Mercury account to ChatGPT to get answers about your finances in the same place you’re already doing the rest of your work.

plugins.name: FactSet AI-Ready Data
plugins.productIntro: FactSet 模型上下文协议 (MCP) 是一种基于 API 的开放标准，旨在无缝连接不同平台上的财务数据、分析模型和应用程序。通过实现流畅的互操作性，MCP 使投资团队能够轻松分享见解、简化工作流程并增强协作，无论其工具或技术堆栈如何。借助 MCP，公司可以有效地集成新的解决方案、推动创新并最大限度地提高其财务运营的价值，从而确保在整个投资过程中做出一致的、基于背景的决策。
plugins.productIntroEn: FactSet Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open, API-based standard designed to seamlessly connect financial data, analytics models, and applications across different platforms. By enabling smooth interoperability, MCP empowers investment teams to easily share insights, streamline workflows, and enhance collaboration regardless of their tools or technology stacks.

plugins.name: Exum: ExoScope Crypto
plugins.productIntro: 浏览实时加密货币市场并在 ChatGPT 内打开交互式 ExoScope 图表。 查看烛台价格走势、24 小时走势、币安 USDT 货币对排名以及最近的市场事件，然后跳转到完整的 Exum 桌面以获取指标、AI 终端和警报。
plugins.productIntroEn: Browse live crypto markets and open interactive ExoScope charts inside ChatGPT. View candlestick price action, 24h moves, ranked Binance USDT pairs, and recent market events — then jump to the full Exum desk for indicators, AI terminal, and alerts.

plugins.name: S&P Global - Deterministic
plugins.productIntro: 使用自然语言查询一系列 S&P Global 数据集，包括 S&P Capital IQ Financials、成绩单等。该服务器旨在为金融服务领域的工程、产品和业务团队节省时间和资源，简化对公司信息、财务报表、历史市场数据和全球证券的访问。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use natural language to query a range of S&P Global datasets, including S&P Capital IQ Financials, transcripts, and more. Designed to save time and resources for engineering, product, and business teams in financial services, this server streamlines access to company information, financial statements, historical market data, and global securities.

plugins.name: Rallies
plugins.productIntro: Rallies 是一款针对股票市场的人工智能研究应用程序，基于实时数据而不是陈旧的网络结果。用简单的英语询问任何美国股票行情，并获得以实时价格、基本面、收益、SEC 文件、期权流、技术、分析师行动、内幕活动和对冲基金仓位为支持的答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rallies is an AI research app for the stock market, built on live data instead of stale web results. Ask about any US ticker in plain English and get answers backed by real-time prices, fundamentals, earnings, SEC filings, options flow, technicals, analyst actions, insider activity, and hedge fund positioning.

plugins.name: InvestmentIQ
plugins.productIntro: 设定储蓄目标，并立即了解每月投资金额、需要多长时间或达到目标所需的回报率 - 所有这些都在一个智能计算器中。从保守、温和或激进策略中进行选择，并观看交互式图表来预测您未来 50 年的财富。一目了然地查看您的起始余额、总捐款和利息的清晰明细。这个应用程序适合所有年龄段。
plugins.productIntroEn: Set a savings goal and instantly discover how much to invest monthly, how long it will take, or what return rate you need to get there — all in one smart calculator. Choose from Conservative, Moderate, or Aggressive strategies and watch an interactive chart project your wealth up to 50 years into the future.

plugins.name: Fiscal.ai
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中访问机构级财务数据。 Fiscal.ai 在收益报告后几分钟提供基本指标和比率，每个数据都可以通过源文件的直接链接进行验证。除了核心财务数据之外，Fiscal.ai 还提供公司特定的 KPI、收入细分和调整后的指标。结合历史和当前的市场报价，它能够以无与伦比的速度进行扎实的、可审计的股票研究。
plugins.productIntroEn: Access institutional-grade financial data directly within ChatGPT. Fiscal.ai delivers fundamental metrics and ratios minutes after earnings are reported, with every figure verifiable via direct links to the source filing. Beyond core financials, Fiscal.ai provides company-specific KPIs, revenue segments, and adjusted metrics.

plugins.name: Pocket Ledger Expense Tracker
plugins.productIntro: PocketLedger 是 ChatGPT 内的个人财务应用程序、费用跟踪器、支出跟踪器和预算跟踪器。通过聊天记录支出，跟踪支出，搜索交易历史记录，发现可能的重复费用，并获得清晰的支出报告、类别报告、财务报告和每月预算摘要。它有助于费用管理、资金管理、预算管理和日常个人财务，无需电子表格或单独的财务应用程序。
plugins.productIntroEn: PocketLedger is a personal finance app, expense tracker, spending tracker, and budget tracker inside ChatGPT. Log expenses by chatting, track spending, search your transaction history, spot possible duplicate charges, and get clear spending reports, category reports, financial reports, and monthly budget summaries.

plugins.name: Simply Family Budget
plugins.productIntro: Simply Family Budget 通过将余额、交易、预算、经常性分录、现金流和预计余额结合在一起，帮助家庭了解他们实际负担得起的费用。直接通过 ChatGPT 查看和管理您家庭的财务记录、钱包、类别和标签。
plugins.productIntroEn: Simply Family Budget helps households understand what they can actually afford by bringing balances, transactions, budgets, recurring entries, cashflow, and projected balances together. Review and manage your family’s financial records, wallets, categories, and tags directly through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: LSEG
plugins.productIntro: LSEG 连接器提供对 LSEG 跨资产类别和领域的综合金融市场数据生态系统的实时访问。它能够将机构级市场数据、分析和估值工具直接无缝集成到对话式人工智能工作流程中，使用户能够通过自然语言交互获取深入的市场洞察、执行复杂的计算并分析金融工具。
plugins.productIntroEn: The LSEG connector provides real-time access to LSEG's comprehensive financial market data ecosystem, spanning across asset classes and domains. It enables seamless integration of institutional-grade market data, analytics and valuation tools directly into conversational AI workflows, allowing users to access deep market insights, perform complex calculations and analyse financial instru…

plugins.name: Aiera
plugins.productIntro: 访问 Aiera 的机构级财务数据，包括实时公司活动、文件、公司出版物、经纪人研究等等。
plugins.productIntroEn: Access institutional-grade financial data from Aiera, including live corporate events, filings, company publications, broker research, and much more.

plugins.name: Gainium
plugins.productIntro: Gainium 帮助用户通过只读连接器从 ChatGPT 检查他们的交易机器人工作区。用户可以列出和查看机器人、交易、账户余额、连接的交易所、策略模式、市场筛选数据、策划的预设和现有的回测请求信息，而无需创建机器人、开始交易、进行交易或更改账户状态。
plugins.productIntroEn: Gainium helps users inspect their trading bot workspace from ChatGPT through a read-only connector. Users can list and review bots, deals, account balances, connected exchanges, strategy schemas, market screener data, curated presets, and existing backtest request information without creating bots, starting deals, placing trades, or changing account state.

plugins.name: WealthCheck Financial Planner
plugins.productIntro: 在几秒钟内获得您财务健康状况的完整快照。 WealthCheck 分析您的收入、支出、储蓄和债务，以计算您的净资产、储蓄率和每月支出，然后为您提供个性化的改进行动计划。无论您是第一次制定预算还是优化现有计划，都可以准确了解您的资金去向以及下一步该做什么。
plugins.productIntroEn: Get a complete snapshot of your financial health in seconds. WealthCheck analyzes your income, expenses, savings, and debt to calculate your net worth, savings rate, and monthly spending — then gives you a personalized action plan to improve. Whether you're budgeting for the first time or optimizing an existing plan, see exactly where your money goes and what to do next.

plugins.name: Zacks Financial Data
plugins.productIntro: 在您的 AI 聊天中使用 Zacks Investment Research 的可信数据 - 并为您的 AI 助手提供优势。 Zacks Connect AI 是一个模型上下文协议 (MCP) 服务器，可将 Zacks 排名、估计、基本面、Zacks 投资研究和市场新闻直接插入您的 Claude 聊天中。 财务报告数据、Zacks 排名、数据历史、每日价格、分析师共识、购买理由、投资理念。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use Zacks Investment Research’s trusted data right in your AI chat — and give your AI assistant an edge. Zacks Connect AI is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that plugs the Zacks Rank, estimates, fundamentals, Zacks Investment Research and market news straight into your Claude chat.

plugins.name: CloFin
plugins.productIntro: CloFin 是您的智能个人财务助手。通过自然对话管理您的财务生活：记录支出、跟踪预算、检查帐户余额以及快速、安全、自动地组织您的财务类别。
plugins.productIntroEn: CloFin is your intelligent personal financial assistant. Manage your financial life through natural conversations: log expenses, track budgets, check account balances, and organize your financial categories quickly, securely, and automatically.
plugins.developerName: CloFin Tecnologia e Soluções Digitais LTDA

plugins.name: Brex
plugins.productIntro: Brex 通过 ChatGPT 帮助财务团队和员工审查公司支出。用户可以查询费用、卡、限额、用户、账单、供应商和会计记录；分析支出；附加来自 HTTPS URL 的收据；更新备忘录和与会者；指定卡费用限额；导出费用数据；并提交产品反馈。
plugins.productIntroEn: Brex helps finance teams and employees review company spend through ChatGPT. Users can look up expenses, cards, limits, users, bills, vendors, and accounting records; analyze spend; attach receipts from HTTPS URLs; update memos and attendees; assign card expenses to limits; export expense data; and submit product feedback.

plugins.name: Financial Summarizer Pro
plugins.description: 获取即时财务详细信息
plugins.productIntro: 阅读 SEC 文件非常耗时。 Financial Summarizer Pro 会为您做到这一点。
plugins.productIntroEn: Reading SEC filings is time-consuming. Financial Summarizer Pro does it for you.

plugins.name: Manilo
plugins.productIntro: 您的个人财务顾问，手头有完整的分类账。通过语音、照片或聊天记录费用，并让 Manilo 对其进行分类。按类别或期间设置预算，并通过主动检查保持正轨。计划经常性收入和支出，并在任何时间范围内跟踪您的支出。问“这个月我在餐饮上是否超支了？”或“第三季度我能节省多少钱？”并获得基于您的真实数据的建议，而不是通用的提示。 30 多种工具，涵盖账户、交易、预算、类别和收据。个人拥有。当你需要的时候可以分享。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your personal finance advisor, with your full ledger at hand. Log expenses by voice, photo, or chat and let Manilo categorize them. Set budgets per category or period and stay on track with proactive checks. Plan recurring income and expenses, and track your spending across any timeframe.

plugins.name: Third Bridge
plugins.productIntro: 将关键背景和行业专家的可信见解无缝融入您的财务和业务分析中。通过查询 Third Bridge 一流的大量专家内容和数据库，重新专注于提取高质量、可靠的信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Seamlessly incorporate critical context and trusted insights from industry experts as part of your financial and business analysis. Refocus on extracting high-quality, reliable information by querying Third Bridge’s best-in-class substantial Library of expert content and data.

plugins.name: PortfolioIQ
plugins.productIntro: 利用先进的模拟技术可视化投资组合的增长潜力。
plugins.productIntroEn: Visualize a portfolio's growth potential with advanced simulation technology.

plugins.name: Morningstar
plugins.productIntro: 将晨星的全面投资数据和独立研究直接集成到您的人工智能工作流程中。通过我们由 MCP 支持的连接器，客户可以探索跨资产覆盖范围，包括基金、股票等，并通过我们的全球分析师团队的前瞻性见解得到增强。通过一种无缝体验获取可信、公正的情报，以支持投资决策、尽职调查和投资组合策略。
plugins.productIntroEn: Integrate Morningstar's comprehensive investment data and independent research directly into your AI workflows. Through our MCP-powered connector, clients can explore cross-asset coverage, including funds, equities, and beyond, enhanced by forward-looking insights from our global analyst teams.

plugins.name: RealEstateIQ
plugins.description: 现金流和投资回报率分析
plugins.productIntro: 在出价之前先了解租赁或投资房产是否值得。输入您的数据，即可立即获得现金回报率、资本化率、NOI、IRR 以及完整的 20 年利润预测。对于首次投资者来说足够简单，对于经验丰富的房东来说足够强大。这个应用程序适合所有年龄段。
plugins.productIntroEn: Know if a rental or investment property is worth it before you make an offer. Plug in your numbers and instantly get cash-on-cash return, cap rate, NOI, IRR, and a full 20-year profit projection. Simple enough for first-time investors, powerful enough for seasoned landlords. This app is suitable for all ages.

plugins.name: Fakturoid
plugins.productIntro: 在 Fakturoid 中开具发票、记录费用或分析您的业务数据和统计数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Issue invoices in Fakturoid, record expenses, or analyze your business data and statistics.

plugins.name: Elevate Invoices
plugins.productIntro: 停止手动填写发票表格。该应用程序创建具有智能默认值的发票：它可以识别您的客户，记住您的定价，并自动填写以前发票的详细信息。只需告诉 ChatGPT 您需要什么，它就会处理剩下的事情。在一处查看、更新和管理您的所有发票。
plugins.productIntroEn: Stop manually filling out invoice forms. This app creates invoices with intelligent defaults: it recognizes your clients, remembers your pricing, and auto-fills details from previous invoices. Just tell ChatGPT what you need, and it handles the rest. View, update, and manage all your invoices in one place.

plugins.name: The Fly Market Intelligence
plugins.productIntro: Fly Market Intelligence 提供只读工具来研究公司、分析收益和催化剂、构建市场简报、发现交易品种、搜索和检索财经新闻以及筛选股票。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Fly Market Intelligence provides read-only tools to research companies, analyze earnings and catalysts, build market briefs, discover symbols, search and retrieve financial news, and screen stocks.

plugins.name: Tuio
plugins.productIntro: Tuio 帮助西班牙用户估算家庭保险价格、查看涵盖的承保范围、继续在 Tuio 上报价以及搜索常见问题解答或保单条款以获取保险支持问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tuio helps users in Spain estimate home insurance prices, review included coverage, continue a quote on Tuio, and search FAQ or policy terms for insurance support questions.

plugins.name: Razorpay
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 Razorpay 帐户以通过对话访问您的付款数据。 向 Codex 询问您的付款、订单、退款、结算、二维码、付款链接等信息。获得诸如“显示今天的付款”、“我最近的结算状态如何”或“查找上周的退款”等问题的即时答案。 非常适合想要快速获得洞察而无需导航仪表板的商家。查看交易详细信息、跟踪结算时间表、检查保存的付款方式并分析您的付款活动——所有这些都通过自然语言进行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Razorpay account to access your payment data through conversation. Ask Codex about your payments, orders, refunds, settlements, QR codes, payment links etc. Get instant answers to questions like "Show me today's payments," "What's the status of my recent settlements," or "Find refunds from last week.

plugins.name: Expensify
plugins.productIntro: 询问有关您的 Expensify 账户的问题，并从您的真实数据中获得答案，而不是猜测。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ask questions about your Expensify account and get answers from your real data — not guesses.

plugins.name: Crunchbase
plugins.productIntro: 值得信赖的私人市场情报，就在您的对话中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Trusted private market intelligence, right inside your conversation.

plugins.name: Learn to invest with AJ Bell
plugins.productIntro: ChatGPT 中与 AJ Bell 一起学习投资可帮助您通过简单、自然的对话来积累投资知识。从 AJ Bell 的学习投资库中探索清晰的教育内容，阅读有用的文章和股票杂志内容，并获得投资术语和行话的简单解释，所有这些都无需离开 ChatGPT。无论您是学习基础知识、探索不同的投资理念，还是试图理解市场语言，《与 AJ Bell 一起学习投资》都可以让您更轻松地找到值得信赖的教育内容和投资问题的答案。此经验仅供参考，并非个人推荐或建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Learn to invest with AJ Bell in ChatGPT helps you build your investing knowledge through a simple, natural conversation. Explore clear, educational content from AJ Bell’s Learn to Invest library, read helpful articles and Shares Magazine content, and get straightforward explanations of investing terms and jargon, all without leaving ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Daloopa
