plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your GoCardless account to look up payments, customers, mandates, payouts, and refunds, and to take actions such as creating payments, issuing refunds and cancelling mandates.

plugins.name: Lev
plugins.description: 人工智能满足所有 CRE 工作流程需求
plugins.originalDescription: AI for all CRE workflow needs
plugins.productIntro: Lev 将 ChatGPT 连接到用户的商业房地产工作区。用户可以检查和管理交易、索引交易事实、源文档、备忘录、清单、公司、联系人、注释、贷方安置、管道、条款清单、计费状态、帐户访问和当前市场参考利率。
plugins.productIntroEn: Lev connects ChatGPT to a user's commercial real estate workspace. Users can inspect and manage deals, indexed deal facts, source documents, memos, checklists, companies, contacts, notes, lender placements, pipelines, term sheets, billing state, account access, and current market reference rates.

plugins.name: Cactus: Real Estate Analysis
plugins.description: 承保和验证商业地产交易
plugins.productIntro: 仙人掌将商业房地产尽职调查变成了一场对话。调出您的商业地产交易和投资组合，审查承保事实——NOI、租金清单、资本化率、债务条款——并将每个数字追溯到其源文件。验证支持的内容，标记不支持的内容，并在几秒钟内获得清晰的交易概述。专为需要可以捍卫的答案的收购团队、分析师和投资者而设计。
plugins.productIntroEn: Cactus turns commercial real estate due diligence into a conversation. Pull up your CRE deals and portfolio, review underwriting facts — NOI, rent rolls, cap rates, debt terms — and trace every number back to its source document. Verify what’s supported, flag what isn’t, and get a clean deal overview in seconds.

plugins.name: Xero
plugins.description: 检查您的企业财务状况
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 检查您的损益表、现金状况、未清发票、主要客户等。 Xero 提供实时财务摘要，具有灵活的日期范围、逐年比较以及返回 Xero 的链接以进行更深入的分析。 ChatGPT 以只读访问权限连接。检索到的任何数据仅用于回答您的问题，并且不会在会话之间存储。
plugins.productIntroEn: Check your P&L, cash position, outstanding invoices, top customers and more — directly from ChatGPT. Xero surfaces real-time financial summaries with flexible date ranges, year-over-year comparisons, and links back to Xero for deeper analysis. ChatGPT connects with read-only access. Any data retrieved is used only to respond to your questions and is never stored between sessions.

plugins.name: D&B Risk Analytics
plugins.productIntro: 执行由 D&B Commercial Graph™ 支持的风险工作流程
plugins.productIntroEn: Execute risk workflows powered by the D&B Commercial Graph™

plugins.name: ExpenseBot
plugins.productIntro: ExpenseBot 帮助人们捕获收据图像和 PDF、搜索和组织费用、监控 Gmail 收据扫描、分析支出和收入、管理费用报告、准备客户发票以及通过 ChatGPT 将确认的报告发送到支持的会计目的地。
plugins.productIntroEn: ExpenseBot helps people capture receipt images and PDFs, search and organize expenses, monitor Gmail receipt scans, analyze spending and income, manage expense reports, prepare client invoices, and send confirmed reports to supported accounting destinations through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Seguro Match
plugins.productIntro: Seguro Match 帮助西班牙用户在 ChatGPT 中比较真实的家庭、汽车和摩托车保险报价。模型打开引导报价向导；嵌入式小部件收集所需的详细信息（通过目录和地址查找），根据授权保险公司系统运行报价，并显示可比较的报价和承保详细信息。要跳过表单，用户可以将当前的保单文档拖放到小部件中 - 它仅在服务器端进行处理（提取的文本仅用于预填写报价，从不发送到模型）。最终结账在 seguromatch.com 上进行； ChatGPT 内没有购买任何东西。
plugins.productIntroEn: Seguro Match helps users in Spain compare real home, car, and motorcycle insurance quotes in ChatGPT. The model opens a guided quote wizard; the embedded widget collects the required details (with catalog and address lookups), runs the quotes against authorized insurer systems, and shows comparable offers and coverage details.
plugins.developerName: Tuio Partners Correduría de Seguros, S.L.

plugins.name: Superfunds
plugins.productIntro: Superfunds 是以色列共同基金市场的实时、全面的地图。用简单的语言（希伯来语或英语）询问，按经理、主题或策略查找和过滤基金；比较费用、绩效和风险；浏览精选主题和最近推出的基金；查看经理资料和市场份额；并搜索市场研究和央行背景。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Superfunds is a live, comprehensive map of the Israeli mutual fund market. Ask in plain language — Hebrew or English — to find and filter funds by manager, theme, or strategy; compare fees, performance, and risk; browse curated themes and recently launched funds; view manager profiles with market share; and search market research and central-bank context.

plugins.name: Chargebee (EU Region)
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的实时 Chargebee 订阅、发票、客户和付款数据。用自然语言提出计费问题并立即获得答案：续订风险、付款失败模式、贷方票据缺口、按计费节奏计算的生命周期价值、试用转换。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your live Chargebee subscription, invoice, customer, and payment data. Ask billing questions in natural language and get answers immediately: renewal risk, payment failure patterns, credit note gaps, LTV by billing cadence, trial conversion.

plugins.name: Shinhan Securities Assistant
plugins.description: 回顾投资组合和越南市场
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的新韩证券越南账户，查看投资组合持有情况，探索越南市场趋势，并直接在 ChatGPT 中立即获得投资相关问题的答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Shinhan Securities Vietnam account to review portfolio holdings, explore market trends in Vietnam, and get instant answers to investment-related questions directly in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: MT Newswires
plugins.productIntro: MT Newswires 将实时全球金融新闻直接引入 Codex，提供 180 多个主题的资本市场和经济体的原创、公正和全面的多资产类别报道。
plugins.productIntroEn: MT Newswires brings real-time global financial news directly into Codex — providing original, unbiased and comprehensive multi-asset class coverage of capital markets and economies in over 180 topics.

plugins.name: Ekohesap
plugins.description: 雅佩·泽卡里·翁·穆哈塞贝
plugins.productIntro: 1 达基卡达库鲁鲁姆 Sadece e-posta hesabınız ile hesabınızı açın，tek bir parametre girmeden satış，alış，tahsilat，ödeme，kasa，banka，çek，kredi，çalışan hesaplarınızı kolayca takip edin。
plugins.productIntroEn: 1 Dakikada Kurulum Sadece e-posta hesabınız ile hesabınızı açın, tek bir parametre girmeden satış, alış, tahsilat, ödeme, kasa, banka, çek, kredi, çalışan hesaplarınızı kolayca takip edin.

plugins.name: Stable.com
plugins.productIntro: Stable.com 是 Stable 平台的只读信息和订单跟踪伴侣。它查找支持的网络和资产，估计指示性费率和费用，跟踪用户已经开始的交换状态，并显示钱包余额和代币配额。该应用程序不执行交易、转移或持有资金，或提供投资建议；任何操作均由用户在 stable.com 的稳定平台上完成。
plugins.productIntroEn: Stable.com is a read-only information and order-tracking companion for the Stable platform. It looks up supported networks and assets, estimates indicative rates and fees, tracks the status of swaps a user has already started, and shows wallet balances and token allowances.

plugins.name: Borderless Budget
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Borderless Budget，并询问有关交易、支出、现金流、预算、经常性费用、净值和跨货币趋势的自然语言问题，所有问题均转换为您的本国货币。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to Borderless Budget and ask natural-language questions about transactions, spending, cash flow, budgets, recurring charges, net worth, and trends across currencies, all converted to your home currency.

plugins.name: SueldoNeto
plugins.productIntro: 根据您在西班牙的总工资计算您的净工资。输入您的年薪并获得个人所得税（州和地区）和社会保障预扣税的直观明细。
plugins.productIntroEn: Calcula tu salario neto a partir del bruto en España. Introduce tu salario anual y obtén un desglose visual con las retenciones de IRPF (estatal y autonómico) y Seguridad Social.

plugins.name: Datarails FinanceOS
plugins.description: 人工智能驱动的财务管理
plugins.productIntro: Datarails FinanceOS 为您的财务数据带来结构化和智能。它提供了一个受管理的、有组织的数据库，使您的数字保持干净和可靠。每个更改都会通过内置的审核跟踪进行完整跟踪，因此您始终知道谁更改了什么以及何时更改。强大的权限机制确保每个用户只能看到他们有权访问的数据。通过内置的财务逻辑，该应用程序可以立即了解您的业务背景 - 无需手动设置。
plugins.productIntroEn: Datarails FinanceOS brings structure and intelligence to your financial data. It provides a managed, organized database that keeps your numbers clean and reliable. Every change is fully traced with a built-in audit trail, so you always know who changed what and when. A robust permission mechanism ensures each user sees only the data they're authorized to access.

plugins.name: Bull AI
plugins.productIntro: Bull AI 将 NSE/BSE 上市印度公司的公司文件和数据引入 ChatGPT 和 Codex。探索年度报告、盈利材料和其他公司披露的引文；将管理层指导与公司后来报告的结果进行比较；与上市同行一起审查管理层声称的优势；了解收入细分；审查市场交易和公司行为；并地图披露了客户、供应商和合作伙伴。 Bull AI 专为有来源支持的公司研究而构建，明确区分报告的事实、管理层的主张和解释。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bull AI brings company documents and data for NSE/BSE-listed Indian companies into ChatGPT and Codex. Explore annual reports, earnings materials and other company disclosures with citations; compare management guidance with later company-reported outcomes; examine management-claimed advantages alongside listed peers; understand revenue segments; review market transactions and corporate a…

plugins.name: Fahali
plugins.productIntro: Fahali 让人工智能智能体关注市场风险。 18 个检测引擎提供跨加密货币和股票/ETF 的异常、资本流动、政权、暗池、鲸鱼、传染和崩溃前兆情报。每个信号都根据附加分类账中的已实现价格进行解析。所有 22 种工具都是只读的——没有订单路由，没有资本路径。没有足够解决结果的引擎会报告“正在校准”——从来都不是一个虚构的数字。观察，而不是财务建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Fahali gives AI agents eyes on market risk. 18 detection engines deliver anomaly, capital-flow, regime, dark-pool, whale, contagion, and crash-precursor intelligence across crypto and equities/ETFs. Every signal is resolved against realized price in an append-only ledger. All 22 tools are read-only — no order routing, no path to capital.

plugins.name: SkyWatch.ai
plugins.productIntro: Skywatch Renters Aviation Insurance 允许飞行员通过快速、引导式对话体验直接在 ChatGPT 内接收非自有飞机租赁者保险报价。它专为航空租赁者打造，以简单的流程取代了传统的保险表格，并在几秒钟内提供清晰的报价摘要。
plugins.productIntroEn: Skywatch Renters Aviation Insurance allows pilots to receive non owned aircraft renters insurance quotes directly within ChatGPT through a fast, guided conversational experience. Built specifically for aviation renters, it replaces traditional insurance forms with a simple flow and delivers a clear quote summary in seconds.

plugins.name: MutuiOnline.it
plugins.productIntro: 借助此应用程序，您可以快速轻松地搜索和比较 MutuiOnline.it 上提供的抵押贷款报价。该应用程序可让您通过比较意大利数十家银行和贷方的最佳报价来找到最适合您需求的解决方案。如果您想了解更多信息，可以重定向到 MutuiOnline.it，在那里您可以请求更多信息并与您选择的贷方取得联系。该服务是免费且无义务的。
plugins.productIntroEn: With this app, you can quickly and easily search and compare the mortgage offers available on MutuiOnline.it. The app allows you to find the solutions that best suit your needs by comparing top offers from dozens of banks and lenders in Italy. If you’d like to learn more, you can be redirected to MutuiOnline.

plugins.name: Vestd
plugins.productIntro: Vestd 连接器使您的 AI 可以直接访问公司的股权管理数据 - 股东、股票类别、期权授予（EMI、ESOP、CSOP、未经批准、成长股）、股票转让、估值、股息、董事和法定文件（SH01s、确认声明、决议）。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Vestd connector gives your AI direct access to your company's equity management data - shareholders, share classes, option grants (EMI, ESOP, CSOP, unapproved, growth shares), stock transfers, valuations, dividends, directors, and statutory filings (SH01s, confirmation statements, resolutions).

plugins.name: Bank Statement Conversion
plugins.productIntro: 将银行对账单、发票和收据转换为 ChatGPT 中的会计就绪文件。上传 PDF、CSV、Excel、OFX、QBO、QFX、MT940 或 CAMT.053 文档并导出为 CSV、Excel、QuickBooks、OFX、QFX、MT940、CAMT.053、JSON、Xero、Sage、MYOB、UBL、Peppol 等。查看支持的格式，确认上传，跟踪转换状态并下载完成的文件。不执行银行登录或付款转账。
plugins.productIntroEn: Convert bank statements, invoices, and receipts into accounting-ready files in ChatGPT. Upload PDF, CSV, Excel, OFX, QBO, QFX, MT940, or CAMT.053 documents and export to CSV, Excel, QuickBooks, OFX, QFX, MT940, CAMT.053, JSON, Xero, Sage, MYOB, UBL, Peppol, and more. Review supported formats, confirm your upload, track conversion status, and download the completed file.

plugins.name: D&B Finance Analytics
plugins.productIntro: 使用值得信赖的 D&B 数据和分析来实现人工智能驱动的信用决策、投资组合监控和风险管理工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Enable AI-powered credit decisioning, portfolio monitoring, and risk management workflows using trusted D&B data and analytics.

plugins.name: Pretto
plugins.description: 为您在法国的房屋融资
plugins.productIntro: 直接通过 ChatGPT 上的 Pretto 比较超过 125 家银行的报价，为您在法国的房地产项目找到理想的抵押贷款。 分享您的项目详细信息，以立即确定您的最大借贷能力或根据当前市场趋势和特定情况的利率模拟您未来的每月付款。 与 Pretto 经纪人预约，以完善您的结果并制定您的融资计划。该服务是免费的。
plugins.productIntroEn: Compare offers from over 125 banks to find the ideal mortgage for your real estate project in France, directly with Pretto on ChatGPT. Share your project details to instantly determine your maximum borrowing capacity or simulate your future monthly payments based on current market trends and profile-specific interest rates.

plugins.name: Trata
plugins.description: 人工智能驱动的研究台
plugins.productIntro: 将您的人工智能助手直接连接到 Trata——增长最快的投资研究图书馆，以匿名对冲基金辩论为中心。借助 Trata MCP，您的助手将拥有对我们库中的数百个呼叫进行推理的工具。它不仅仅是简单的搜索，还可以帮助细分牛市和熊市案例、比较不同时期的分析师情绪以及深入研究股票分析。我们将分析师花费数小时的研究压缩为一个问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your AI assistant directly to Trata — the fastest-growing library of investment research, centered on anonymous hedge fund debate. With Trata MCP, your assistant will have the tools to reason across hundreds of calls in our library. It goes beyond simple searches to help breakdown bull and bear cases, compare analyst sentiment across time, and deep dive into stock analysis.

plugins.name: BizCover AU
plugins.productIntro: 比较澳大利亚领先保险公司的商业保险报价 - 一切尽在一处。 BizCover 为数千种职业提供保险，让您在几分钟内轻松找到适合您企业的合适保险。
plugins.productIntroEn: Compare business insurance quotes from leading Australian insurers - all in one place. With cover available for thousands of occupations, BizCover makes it easy to find the right protection for your business in minutes.

plugins.name: Clear Energy Facts
plugins.productIntro: Clear Energy Facts 为您提供最佳真正固定费率电力计划的最新列表，以及市场上顶级的免费夜间和免费周末计划。您无需费力浏览令人困惑的优惠和隐藏费用，而是可以获得值得信赖的简单计划数据。当与您的 Smart Meter Texas (SMT) 使用数据配对时，它有助于将您的实际消费模式与真正花费最少的计划相匹配 - 无论是稳定的固定费率还是围绕免费住宿和周末构建的计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: Clear Energy Facts gives you an up-to-date list of the best true fixed-rate electricity plans, along with the top free-nights and free-weekends plans on the market. Instead of wading through confusing offers and hidden fees, you get straightforward plan data you can trust.

plugins.name: Billabex
plugins.productIntro: Billabex 是一个人工智能驱动的应收账款和发票收集平台，可帮助财务团队直接从 ChatGPT 管理客户付款跟进。
plugins.productIntroEn: Billabex is an AI-powered accounts receivable and invoice collection platform that helps finance teams manage customer payment follow-up directly from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Dakota Platform
plugins.productIntro: 通过对话访问您的 Dakota 平台数据。询问有关您的客户、账户和交易的问题，无需导航仪表板或编写 API 调用。
plugins.productIntroEn: Access your Dakota Platform data through conversation. Ask questions about your customers, accounts, and transactions without navigating dashboards or writing API calls.

plugins.name: Calculadora de Combustível
plugins.productIntro: 立即了解是否值得添加乙醇（酒精）或汽油。您在加油站输入每种燃料每升的价格，计算器将应用 70% 规则：如果乙醇价格除以汽油价格低于 0.70，则乙醇是值得的；如果乙醇价格除以汽油价格低于 0.70，则乙醇是值得的；否则，汽油是更好的选择。您还可以输入每种燃料的效率（公里/升），以进行更精确的每公里成本计算。无需注册，也不会收集个人数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find out instantly whether it's worth filling up with ethanol (alcohol) or gasoline. You enter the price per liter of each fuel at your gas station and the calculator applies the 70% rule: if the ethanol price divided by the gasoline price is below 0.70, ethanol is worth it; otherwise, gasoline is the better choice.

plugins.name: Nella Finance AI
plugins.productIntro: Nella Finance AI 是为企业及其会计师提供的只读金融情报助手。连接受支持的会计平台，并直接从 ChatGPT 询问有关现金、绩效、KPI、异常变动、管理信息和估计税务状况的问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Nella Finance AI is a read-only financial intelligence assistant for businesses and their accountants. Connect supported accounting platforms and ask questions about cash, performance, KPIs, unusual movements, management information and estimated tax positions directly from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: GREI
plugins.productIntro: 通过 GREI 明智地投资海外房地产。使用日常语言搜索全球房地产投资机会，从希腊和塞浦路斯的 GREI 列表开始。
plugins.productIntroEn: Invest smart in real estate abroad with GREI. Search global property investment opportunities using everyday language, starting with GREI listings in Greece and Cyprus.

plugins.name: Fintoc
plugins.productIntro: Fintoc 帮助授权组织用户发现 API 操作、检查其参数、检索财务资源和数据，并通过 ChatGPT 执行批准的写入操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Fintoc helps authorized organization users discover API operations, inspect their parameters, retrieve financial resources and data, and execute approved write operations through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: ClearCash
plugins.productIntro: 安全地连接您的财务账户，在 ChatGPT 中查看您的净资产、支出和家庭财务状况 - 包括与合作伙伴共享的账户，并完全控制哪些内容保持私密。
plugins.productIntroEn: Securely connect your financial accounts to see your net worth, spending, and household finances in ChatGPT — including accounts shared with a partner, with full control over what stays private.

plugins.name: ualet
plugins.productIntro: ualet 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的个人财务数据，这些数据从智利银行账户和卡自动同步。询问每月支出、预算、趋势和经常性商家。列出未分类的交易并建议类别供您在 ualet 应用程序中查看和确认。
plugins.productIntroEn: ualet connects ChatGPT to your personal financial data, synced automatically from Chilean bank accounts and cards. Ask about monthly spending, budgets, trends, and recurring merchants. List uncategorized transactions and suggest categories for you to review and confirm in the ualet app.

plugins.name: Finmagine
plugins.productIntro: 印度和美国股票筛选器、财务比率、人工智能生成的公司研究（季度摘要、会议语气/可信度解码）、市场广度、动量排名和多代理投资委员会分析——印度和美国股票市场情报的 MCP 服务器。
plugins.productIntroEn: Indian & US stock screeners, financial ratios, AI-generated company research (quarterly summaries, concall tone/credibility decoding), market breadth, momentum ranking, and multi-agent Investment Committee analysis — the MCP server for Indian and US stock market intelligence.

plugins.name: Pazy
plugins.productIntro: Pazy 应用程序可帮助用户了解什么是葬礼计划并找到最适合他们需求的计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Pazy app helps users understand what a funeral plan is and find the plan that best fits their needs.

plugins.name: Mansa African Markets
plugins.productIntro: 13 个交易所的实时非洲市场数据，包括 NGX、NASD、GSE、NSE、JSE 和 BRVM。获取由 NGX Pulse 和 Mansa Markets 提供支持的股票价格、主要波动因素、指数、市场概览和公司披露信息。

Submit a natural language query and the system dynamically routes across S&P Global data sources, from Market Intelligence to Energy data, generating queries and assembling cited results automatically.

plugins.name: Vantixs

plugins.name: Manulife®

plugins.productIntroEn: Ria Money Transfer helps users check supported send destinations, compare payment and payout options, view indicative exchange rates, and calculate transfer quotes before continuing to www.riamoneytransfer.com to complete a transfer.

plugins.name: Kova
plugins.productIntro: Kova 为 ChatGPT 提供了用户投资策略的持久家园。用户保存一次投资规则，然后在需要签入时要求 ChatGPT 根据同一计划审查投资组合。 Kova 返回可重复的摘要，其中包含一致性分数、投资组合漂移、配置时的策略规则检查以及将恢复一致性的更改。它将用户的计划固定在各个会话中，因此每次审核都从保存的投资标准开始，而不是从空白聊天开始。 Kova 不进行交易、管理资产、提供财务建议或预测市场。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kova gives ChatGPT a persistent home for a user's investment strategy. Users save their investment rules once, then ask ChatGPT to review a portfolio against the same plan whenever they need a check-in. Kova returns repeatable briefs with an alignment score, portfolio drift, strategy-rule checks when configured, and changes that would restore alignment.

plugins.name: TickerLayer
plugins.productIntro: TickerLayer 将实时和历史的全球市场数据直接引入 ChatGPT。获取全球市场的股票、外汇、加密货币、指数、ETF、大宗商品和政府债券收益率。
plugins.productIntroEn: TickerLayer brings real-time and historical global market data directly into ChatGPT. Access stocks, forex, cryptocurrencies, indices, ETFs, commodities and government bond yields across markets worldwide.

plugins.name: In Practise
plugins.productIntro: In Practice 为基本面投资者进行初步研究。我们采访了您正在分析的公司的前经营者和高管，然后将这些对话转化为结构化的、引用的研究。
plugins.productIntroEn: In Practise runs primary research for fundamental investors. We interview the former operators and executives who ran the companies you're analysing, then turn those conversations into structured, cited research.

plugins.name: Savvly
plugins.productIntro: Savvly MCP 帮助财务顾问、规划工具和人工智能代理比较退休方案、检查资格，并对一次性缴款、每月缴款和全额退休方案进行建模。这些工具支持 Savvly Longevity Benefit，这是一个在 SEC 注册的基金，旨在将市场风险与晚年长寿支出结合起来。
plugins.productIntroEn: Savvly MCP helps financial advisors, planning tools, and AI agents compare retirement alternatives, check eligibility, and model lump-sum, monthly-contribution, and full-retirement scenarios. These tools support the Savvly Longevity Benefit, an SEC-registered fund designed to combine market exposure with later-life longevity payouts.

plugins.name: OptionsAhoy
plugins.productIntro: 现在就锻炼或者等待。卖出或持有。首先出售哪些拍品。每个问题都有适合您具体情况的正确答案，并且取决于替代最低税 (AMT)、持有期、州税和提前缴纳税款的时间价值在几年内如何相互作用。这就是经验法则失效的地方。用简单的语言询问，OptionsAhoy 会返回答案，并附上每年的时间表。
plugins.productIntroEn: Exercise now or wait. Sell at vest or hold. Which lots to sell first. Each of these has a right answer for your specific situation, and it turns on how alternative minimum tax (AMT), holding periods, state tax, and the time value of taxes paid early interact across several years. That is where rules of thumb break down.

plugins.name: PointBagel
plugins.productIntro: PointBagel 会跟踪您的美国信用卡和积分，并对其进行数学计算。连接它，ChatGPT 可以回答有关您自己钱包的问题：哪张卡在购买时赚得最多，您的积分值多少钱，年费是否仍在赚取，以及哪些转账奖金现在有效。答案来自您的实际卡和支出，并根据 PointBagel 的计划、转让合作伙伴和积分值的验证数据进行定价，而不是来自模型的内存。
plugins.productIntroEn: PointBagel keeps track of your U.S. credit cards and points, and does the math on them. Connect it and ChatGPT can answer questions about your own wallet: which card earns the most on a purchase, what your points are worth, whether an annual fee is still earning its keep, and which transfer bonuses are live right now.

plugins.name: ACE Money Transfer
plugins.productIntro: ACE Money Transfer 是一家金融科技公司，主要从事汇款业务。 ACE Money Transfer 可帮助用户检查支持的转账路线、实时汇率、收款金额、付款方式、费用以及支持渠道的促销活动。
plugins.productIntroEn: ACE Money Transfer is fintech which primarily deals in sending remittances. ACE Money Transfer helps users check supported transfer routes, live exchange rates, recipient amounts, payout methods, fees, and promotions for supported corridors.

plugins.name: PocketSmith Complete Access
plugins.productIntro: PocketSmith 是一款领先的个人理财软件，受到 190 个国家/地区超过 380,000 名用户的信赖。我们帮助世界各地的家庭首席财务官掌控他们的资金并实现他们的财务目标。凭借强大的预测、多货币支持和灵活的预算工具，PocketSmith 提供了高度可定制的资金管理方法。
plugins.productIntroEn: PocketSmith is a leading personal finance software, trusted by over 380,000 users in 190 countries. We help Household CFOs around the world take control of their money and achieve their financial goals. With powerful forecasting, multi-currency support, and flexible budgeting tools, PocketSmith offers a highly customizable approach to money management.

plugins.name: InsurConnect
plugins.productIntro: InsurConnect 帮助人们根据地点、保险需求、承运人、语言和评级找到德克萨斯州持牌财产和意外伤害保险代理人。它可以显示公共代理详细信息，创建基于同意的连接草案，在明确 TCPA 同意后将消费者连接到匹配的代理，并记录选择退出请求。
plugins.productIntroEn: InsurConnect helps people find licensed Property & Casualty insurance agents in Texas by location, insurance need, carrier, language, and rating. It can show public agent details, create a consent-based connection draft, connect a consumer to the matched agent after explicit TCPA consent, and record an opt-out request.

plugins.name: SimsaSplit
plugins.productIntro: SimsaSplit 帮助登录用户通过 ChatGPT 管理共享费用组：列出组、创建组、添加占位符成员、创建邀请链接、发送直接组邀请、查看余额和结算，以及创建、更新或删除费用。
plugins.productIntroEn: SimsaSplit helps signed-in users manage shared expense groups through ChatGPT: list groups, create groups, add placeholder members, create invite links, send direct group invites, review balances and settlements, and create, update, or delete expenses.

plugins.name: Nomas Research
plugins.description: 查询结构化 SEC 数据
plugins.productIntro: Nomas Research 允许 ChatGPT 查找结构化 SEC 数据：公司事实、解析的文件（8-K、10-K/Q、13D、144、D、14A、S-1/S-3）、内幕交易、13F 持仓和未能交付。工具是针对 Nomas RAG API 的只读检索。用户登录 nomas.fyi；免费、专业版和 API 计划仍然适用。
plugins.productIntroEn: Nomas Research lets ChatGPT look up structured SEC data: company facts, parsed filings (8-K, 10-K/Q, 13D, 144, D, 14A, S-1/S-3), insider trades, 13F holdings, and failure-to-deliver. Tools are read-only retrieval against Nomas RAG APIs. Users sign in on nomas.fyi; Free, Pro, and API plans still apply.

plugins.name: Dr. Klein
plugins.productIntro: Dr. Klein 抵押贷款计算器可计算抵押贷款利率、每月抵押付款、剩余贷款余额以及抵押贷款的总利息成本。购房价格、首付、还款率等融资细节均可单独调整。根据输入的数据，计算器提供各种融资报价，可以一目了然地进行比较。 Dr. Klein 抵押贷款计算器适用于规划购买房产、新建项目或再融资的抵押贷款。 该计算基于 600 多家贷款合作伙伴的最新条款和条件。由于最终融资条款取决于个人情况，计算结果仅供参考。完成计算后，可以直接向克莱因博士请求个性化融资报价。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Dr. Klein Mortgage Calculator calculates mortgage interest rates, monthly mortgage payments, the remaining loan balance, and the total interest costs of a mortgage. The property purchase price, down payment, repayment rate, and other financing details can be adjusted individually.

plugins.name: Findash
plugins.productIntro: Findash 帮助授权顾问公司用户搜索客户和联系人记录、准备简报、审查任务和工作流程、检索会议记录以及通过批准的工具更新私人工作空间记录。
plugins.productIntroEn: Findash helps authorized advisor-firm users search client and contact records, prepare briefs, review tasks and workflows, retrieve meeting transcripts, and update private workspace records through approved tools.

plugins.name: Moody's Growth and Strategy
plugins.description: 推动 GTM 增长的见解
plugins.productIntro: 穆迪增长与战略 MCP 通过提供 GenAI 就绪的数据、分析和见解来为上市执行提供信息，从而支持人工智能驱动的销售、营销和收入运营。它将企业结构、所有权、关系和市场数据集整合到一个统一的情报层中，以帮助团队识别机会、确定客户优先级并支持更有效的客户参与。
plugins.productIntroEn: Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP supports AI-driven sales, marketing, and revenue operations by providing GenAI-ready data, analytics, and insights to inform go-to-market execution. It brings together firmographic, ownership, relationship, and market datasets into a unified intelligence layer to help teams identify opportunities, prioritize accounts, and support more effective customer enga…

plugins.name: Clear Street
plugins.productIntro: Clear Street MCP 可让您访问 Clear Street 账户信息，例如余额、头寸、订单和投资组合历史记录以及实时市场数据和财经新闻。用它来研究机会、分析投资组合表现、评估风险情景以及评估复杂的交易机会和对冲策略。
plugins.productIntroEn: Clear Street MCP lets you access your Clear Street account information such as balances, positions, orders, and portfolio history along with real time market data and finance news. Use it to research opportunities, analyze portfolio performance, assess risk scenarios and evaluate sophisticated trading opportunities and hedging strategies.

plugins.name: Drivetrain
plugins.description: 分析来自传动系统的数据
plugins.productIntro: 使用自然语言分析 ChatGPT 中的传动系统数据。获取指标、维度和版本，探索趋势并无缝生成见解。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use natural language to analyze your Drivetrain data in ChatGPT. Fetch metrics, dimensions, and versions, explore trends, and generate insights seamlessly.

plugins.name: Whisper Money
plugins.productIntro: Whisper Money 是一款隐私至上的个人理财应用程序：您的财务数据是您自己的，并且永远不会与第三方共享。该应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到您自己的 Whisper Money 帐户，这样您就可以用简单的语言分析您的资金，而无需点击仪表板。
plugins.productIntroEn: Whisper Money is a privacy-first personal finance app: your financial data is yours, and it is never shared with third parties. This app connects ChatGPT to your own Whisper Money account so you can analyse your money in plain language instead of clicking through dashboards.

plugins.name: Scorechain
plugins.productIntro: Scorechain 帮助分析师通过 ChatGPT 筛选区块链地址、检索区块链情报、跟踪资金流向、检查交易以及搜索实体以进行 AML 合规调查。
plugins.productIntroEn: Scorechain helps analysts screen blockchain addresses, retrieve blockchain intelligence, trace fund flows, inspect transactions, and search entities for AML compliance investigations through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: PFT Edgebook - Trading Journal
plugins.description: 人工智能就绪的交易日志
plugins.productIntro: PFT EdgeBook 将您的人工智能助手连接到您自己的交易日志。连接后，您的助手可以读取您的真实交易数据。只需用通俗易懂的语言询问您的表现，而不是翻阅电子表格。
plugins.productIntroEn: PFT EdgeBook connects your AI assistant to your own trading journal. Once linked, your assistant can read your real trading data. Just ask about your performance in plain language instead of digging through spreadsheets.

plugins.name: PANDA Tierversicherung
plugins.productIntro: PANDA 是一个信息插件，可帮助您了解宠物保险费用。输入有关您宠物的一些基本详细信息（种类、品种、年龄、体型），以查看基于 PANDA 关税逻辑的说明性、非约束性价格估算。并排比较计划选项，了解承保水平和保费通常如何关联。这些只是估计值，并非报价、要约或具有约束力的覆盖范围 - 实际定价、资格和条款由 PANDA/InterRisk Versicherungs-AG 在全面申请和审核后确定。
plugins.productIntroEn: PANDA is an informational plugin that helps you explore pet insurance costs. Enter a few basic details about your pet (species, breed, age, size) to see illustrative, non-binding price estimates based on PANDA's tariff logic. Compare plan options side by side to understand how coverage levels and premiums typically relate.

plugins.name: RemitCheap
plugins.productIntro: RemitCheap 比较独立汇款提供商的费率、费用、收款金额和递送速度。它可以列出可用的比较走廊并按价值或速度对提供商报价进行排名。 RemitCheap 不汇款或处理转账；用户打开所选提供商以确认定价并完成交易。
plugins.productIntroEn: RemitCheap compares rates, fees, recipient amounts, and delivery speeds from independent money transfer providers. It can list available comparison corridors and rank provider quotes by value or speed. RemitCheap does not send money or process transfers; users open the selected provider to confirm pricing and complete a transaction.

plugins.name: Atominvest
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Atominvest 平台，直接从对话中查询投资组合管理或投资者管理数据，包括投资组合公司指标、投资者数据和基金承诺。检索任何报告期内投资组合资产的收入、EBITDA 和债务等财务 KPI，查找投资者账户及其关联实体，并获取各基金的详细承诺细目，包括金额和状态，所有这些都无需离开 ChatGPT。非常适合需要快速、对话式访问 Atominvest 数据以支持报告、投资者查询和投资组合监控的投资组合经理和投资者关系团队。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your Atominvest platform to query Portfolio Management or Investor Management data, including portfolio company metrics, investor data, and fund commitments, directly from your conversation.

plugins.name: Vings
plugins.productIntro: Vings 允许经过身份验证的用户通过 ChatGPT 检查自己的财务数据，包括交易、现金流、支出类别、商家、定期付款、预算、关联银行状态、投资组合快照、投资组合历史记录和偏好。
plugins.productIntroEn: Vings lets authenticated users inspect their own financial data through ChatGPT, including transactions, cashflow, spending categories, merchants, recurring payments, budgets, connected bank status, portfolio snapshots, portfolio history, and preferences.

plugins.name: PortfolioFit
plugins.description: 检查投资组合授权是否合适
plugins.productIntro: PortfolioFit 将标准化投资组合持有量与书面授权进行比较，识别证据差距，并计算明确的分配限制，而无需进行交易或改变持有量。
plugins.productIntroEn: PortfolioFit compares normalized portfolio holdings with written mandates, identifies evidence gaps, and calculates explicit allocation constraints without placing trades or changing holdings.

plugins.name: AI Expense
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 AI 费用账户，一次保存一张发票或收据， 在保存之前查看提取的费用详细信息，并提出只读问题 关于您现有的支出、商家、类别和支出趋势。 需要有效的付费 AI 费用订阅。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your AI Expense account to save one invoice or receipt at a time, review extracted expense details before saving, and ask read-only questions about your existing expenses, merchants, categories, and spending trends. An active paid AI Expense subscription is required.

plugins.name: AIR Credit Intelligence
plugins.productIntro: AIR Credit 将强大的机器学习信用智能与 ChatGPT 内的人工智能代理直接结合起来。即时评估公司，在新兴信用风险变得明显之前发现它们，了解每个评级背后的驱动因素，并在几秒钟内测试未来的情景。无论您是在评估交易对手、投资、供应商还是借款人，AIR 都可以帮助您在不离开对话的情况下做出更快、更明智的决策。
plugins.productIntroEn: AIR Credit combines powerful machine learning credit intelligence with AI agents directly inside ChatGPT. Instantly assess companies, uncover emerging credit risks before they become obvious, understand the drivers behind every rating, and test future scenarios in seconds.

plugins.name: Aave
plugins.productIntro: Aave 帮助用户探索实时 Aave V3 和 V4 市场，审查钱包头寸和 DAO 治理，模拟借贷行为，并通过 ChatGPT 准备非托管交易或签名订单工作流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Aave helps users explore live Aave V3 and V4 markets, review wallet positions and DAO governance, simulate lending actions, and prepare non-custodial transactions or signed-order workflows through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Irish Tax Hub
plugins.description: 爱尔兰税务工具和指南
plugins.productIntro: 爱尔兰税务中心帮助用户估算爱尔兰税收、检查当前税率和截止日期、搜索收入指南以及通过只读工具研究爱尔兰的双重征税条约。
plugins.productIntroEn: Irish Tax Hub helps users estimate Irish taxes, inspect current tax rates and deadlines, search Revenue guidance, and research Ireland's double-taxation treaties through read-only tools.

plugins.name: LedgerLens
plugins.productIntro: LedgerLens 将您的交易和上传的银行对账单转变为对话。询问最近的购买、类别支出或特定商家，并根据您自己的数据获得即时答案。 上传报表一次，然后只需询问即可探索您的财务状况 - 无需导航仪表板，无需配置过滤器。您的数据保留在 LedgerLens 中； ChatGPT 仅在通过您控制的安全 OAuth 连接进行活动工具调用期间读取它。
plugins.productIntroEn: LedgerLens turns your transactions and uploaded bank statements into a conversation. Ask about recent purchases, category spending, or specific merchants and get instant answers grounded in your own data. Upload statements once, then explore your finances by simply asking — no dashboards to navigate, no filters to configure.

plugins.name: Cryptoworth
plugins.productIntro: Cryptoworth 让 ChatGPT 通过 20 个只读工具读取授权的 Cryptoworth 加密会计投资组合数据。用户可以检查授权投资组合、账本交易、连接和钱包、余额快照、DeFi 头寸、NFT 持有量和活动、交易标签、发票、账单和支持的资产参考数据。该应用程序是只读的：它不会创建、编辑、删除、同步、重新计算、交易、转移资金、签署交易或发起付款。
plugins.productIntroEn: Cryptoworth lets ChatGPT read authorized Cryptoworth crypto-accounting portfolio data through 20 read-only tools. Users can inspect authorized portfolios, ledger transactions, connections and wallets, balance snapshots, DeFi positions, NFT holdings and activity, transaction labels, invoices, bills, and supported asset reference data.

plugins.name: Bound MCP
plugins.productIntro: Bound MCP 帮助用户通过只读公共 API 工具检查 Bound 账户余额、付款接收方、付款、外汇订单、指示性汇率和即将进行的结算。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bound MCP helps users inspect Bound account balances, payment recipients, payments, FX orders, indicative exchange rates, and upcoming settlements through read-only Public API tools.

plugins.name: Revolut X
plugins.description: 管理您的加密货币投资组合
plugins.productIntro: Revolut X 帮助 ChatGPT 查找登录用户的交易余额和工作/已完成订单，检查单个订单及其执行情况，并读取实时市场目录、股票行情、蜡烛图、订单簿深度和公共交易。它还可以准备一个预先填写的订单表格链接。它不会下达、更换或取消订单。
plugins.productIntroEn: Revolut X helps ChatGPT look up the signed-in user's exchange balances and working/finished orders, inspect a single order and its fills, and read live market catalog, tickers, candles, order-book depth, and public trades. It can also prepare a prefilled order-form link. It does not place, replace, or cancel orders.

plugins.name: Cashfree
plugins.description: 您的多合一人工智能助手
plugins.originalDescription: Your All in One AI Assistant
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 与 Cashfree Payments 连接起来，并通过自然对话管理您的整个支付生态系统。立即访问商家仪表板数据 - 包括付款、订单、退款、结算、付款、支付链接、对账报告、交易活动和工作流程 - 无需在工具或仪表板之间跳转。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT with Cashfree Payments and manage your entire payments ecosystem through natural conversation. Access merchant dashboard data instantly — including payments, orders, refunds, settlements, payouts, payment links, reconciliation reports, transaction activity, and workflows — without jumping between tools or dashboards.

plugins.name: airpay
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 Airpay 帐户以通过对话访问付款数据。向 ChatGPT 询问交易、结算、退款等问题，无需登录仪表板即可获得即时答案。 你可以做什么： 1. 检索交易和订单详细信息 2.查看结算及退款状态 3. 按日期、方法或地理位置查看付款分析 4.还有更多。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your airpay account to access payment data through conversation. Ask ChatGPT about transactions, settlements, refunds, etc. and get instant answers without logging into your dashboard. What you can do: 1. Retrieve transaction and order details 2. Check settlement and refund status 3. View payment analytics by date, method, or geography 4. and more.

plugins.name: Wisesheets
plugins.productIntro: Wisesheets 使您的人工智能能够即时访问机构级财务数据，而无需终端价格。提取直接来自 SEC EDGAR (XBRL) 的损益表、资产负债表、现金流量表和数百种财务指标，以及上市公司的历史和实时股票价格、股息以及市盈率、投资回报率和利润率等关键比率。询问任何公司的基本面，通过收入增长筛选行业，构建 DCF，或在不离开聊天的情况下生成样张。
plugins.productIntroEn: Wisesheets gives your AI instant access to institutional grade financial data without the terminal price. Pull income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and hundreds of financial metrics sourced directly from SEC EDGAR (XBRL), plus historical and real time stock prices, dividends, and key ratios like P/E, ROIC, and margins for public companies.

plugins.name: CredCore - Tusk Liquid
plugins.productIntro: Tusk Liquid 将人工智能助手连接到 CredCore 精心策划的公共信用协议数据数据库——从公开提交的信用协议中提取的契约、债务结构、定价、修订和义务。连接后，您可以查询交易条款，根据市场比较对契约包进行基准测试，跟踪修正案的变化，并将借款人与同行进行比较；助手检索值并编写答案。覆盖范围涵盖跨部门、结构和贷方的数千份协议。专为杠杆融资、私人信贷、CLO、DCM 和法律团队而构建。只读且仅供参考——不提供法律、贷款、投资或承保建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tusk Liquid connects AI assistants to CredCore's curated database of public credit-agreement data — covenants, debt structure, pricing, amendments, and obligations — extracted from publicly filed credit agreements.

plugins.name: Antevo Executive Brief
plugins.productIntro: 询问有关市场和世界事件的信息，并获取 Antevo 出版的带有证据的读物：每日执行简报、分级风险雷达以及可确认或消除每种风险的读数、从航运到艺术的每个部门的案头笔记、详细到咽喉要道和海底电缆的九层世界地图，以及大约 180 个国家的宏观经济历史——有些系列可以追溯到 1920 年。每个答案都注明日期并注明其来源。公开且只读：没有帐户，无需登录，也没有可以更改任何内容的工具。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ask about markets and world events and get Antevo's published read with its evidence: the daily Executive Brief, a graded risk radar paired with the reading that would confirm or kill each risk, per-sector desk notes from shipping to art, a nine-layer world map down to chokepoints and subsea cables, and macro-economic history for around 180 countries — some series back to 1920.

plugins.name: FinOpps
plugins.productIntro: 从您的 FinOpps 帐户获取有关即将开展的工作、收入、客户付款和业务绩效的即时答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Get instant answers about upcoming work, revenue, customer payments, and business performance from your FinOpps account.

plugins.name: OnePro AI
plugins.productIntro: OnePro 将您的 ETF1 帐户连接到 ChatGPT，并让您可以访问同一数据库并 到您在平台上使用的相同分析引擎。
plugins.productIntroEn: O OnePro conecta sua conta ETF1 ao ChatGPT e dá acesso à mesma base de dados e aos mesmos motores de análise que você usa na plataforma.

plugins.name: wlthy
plugins.originalDescription: Track net worth and cash flow
plugins.productIntro: wlthy是跨境财富净值追踪器。在一个地方以 13 种货币中的任意一种查看您跨国家/地区的完整投资组合、债务和多币种现金流。导入经纪人和银行对账单，然后按资产类别、贷款价值比和外汇敞口细分分配。仅提供信息跟踪，不提供投资、税务或法律建议。 wlthy 绝不会代表您转移资金或进行交易。
plugins.productIntroEn: wlthy is a net worth tracker for cross-border wealth. See your full portfolio, debts, and multi-currency cash flows across countries in one place, in any of 13 currencies. Import broker and bank statements, then break down allocation by asset class, loan-to-value, and FX exposure. Informational tracking only, not investment, tax or legal advice.

plugins.name: IFG
plugins.productIntro: IFG 通过查找官方税收来源、获取立法、指南、条约和判例法、根据官方文本检查重大声明以及阻止缺乏经过验证的内联引用的最终草案，帮助用户准备税务答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: IFG helps users prepare tax answers by finding official tax sources, fetching legislation, guidance, treaties and case law, checking material claims against official text, and blocking final drafts that lack verified inline citations.

plugins.name: Chargebee (AU Region)
plugins.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的实时 Chargebee 订阅、发票、客户和付款数据。用自然语言提出计费问题并立即获得答案：续订风险、付款失败模式、贷方票据缺口、按计费节奏计算的生命周期价值、试用转换。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your live Chargebee subscription, invoice, customer, and payment data. Ask billing questions in natural language and get answers immediately: renewal risk, payment failure patterns, credit note gaps, LTV by billing cadence, trial conversion.

plugins.name: FinPilot
plugins.productIntro: FinPilot 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查阅个人财务电子表格中的帐户、卡、条目和余额。它还允许您使用 OAuth 中授予的权限来验证、创建、更新、复制、标记、删除和撤消条目。该应用程序仅记录用户提供的信息，不访问银行，不使用开放金融，也不转移资金。
plugins.productIntroEn: O FinPilot ajuda o usuário a consultar contas, cartões, lançamentos e saldos da sua planilha financeira pessoal pelo ChatGPT. Também permite validar, criar, atualizar, replicar, marcar, excluir e desfazer lançamentos mediante as permissões concedidas no OAuth. O app registra somente as informações fornecidas pelo usuário, não acessa bancos, não usa Open Finance e não movimenta dinheiro.

plugins.name: Finom
plugins.productIntro: Finom 是一个面向欧洲中小企业和自由职业者的商业财务平台，将企业账户、发票、费用管理和会计集于一处。
plugins.productIntroEn: Finom is a business finance platform for SMEs and freelancers across Europe, combining a business account, invoicing, expense management, and accounting in one place.

plugins.name: Embat
plugins.productIntro: 用通俗易懂的语言查询您的现金、债务、资金预测、会计、PSP 对账、付款和公司间头寸 — Embat 会用您的真实数据进行回答。 TellMe 继承您现有的权限，因此每个回复的范围都仅限于您已经可以看到的内容。让您的资金管理系统成为人工智能工作流程的原生部分，无需离开对话。
plugins.productIntroEn: Query your cash, debt, treasury forecasts, accounting, PSP reconciliations, payments, and intercompany positions in plain language — answered with your real numbers from Embat. TellMe inherits your existing permissions, so every reply is scoped to what you can already see. Make your treasury management system a native part of your AI workflow, without leaving the conversation.

plugins.name: Theia Insights
plugins.productIntro: Theia Insights 将专业的主题股权研究引入 ChatGPT。询问结构性趋势：人工智能、机器人、清洁能源、网络安全；并显示曝光度最高的上市公司，按照研究驱动的曝光度分数而不是关键词匹配或自我报告的标签进行排名。
plugins.productIntroEn: Theia Insights brings professional thematic equity research into ChatGPT. Ask about a structural trend: artificial intelligence, robotics, clean energy, cybersecurity; and surface the public companies most exposed, ranked by research-driven exposure scores rather than keyword matching or self-reported tags.

plugins.name: StackerScan
plugins.productIntro: StackerScan 通过五个只读工具为 ChatGPT 提供实时贵金属市场数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: StackerScan gives ChatGPT live precious-metals market data through five read-only tools.

plugins.name: Secfi
plugins.productIntro: 通过 Secfi 规划并了解您的股权薪酬。获取有关您的投资组合估值、行权成本、AMT 敞口和模型退出情景的答案 - 所有这些均根据您的实际股权数据计算得出。无论您试图决定何时行使或对潜在退出结果进行压力测试，Secfi 的计算 API 都会为您提供分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: Plan and understand your equity compensation with Secfi. Get answers on your portfolio valuations, exercise costs, AMT exposure and model exit scenarios - all calculated from your actual equity data. Weather you’re trying to decide when to exercise or stress-testing potential exit outcomes, the analysis comes to you from Secfi’s calculation APIs.

plugins.name: AgentCollect
plugins.description: 向您的 AR 作品集询问任何问题
plugins.productIntro: AgentCollect 将您的 AR 恢复数据连接到您的助手。问“上个季度我们收回了多少？”、“我的收回率是多少？”或“哪些账户支付最多？”并获得完整的、商业框架的答案，范围仅限于您自己的帐户。只读、OAuth 保护、无写访问权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: AgentCollect connects your AR recovery data to your assistant. Ask "how much did we recover last quarter?", "what's my recovery rate?", or "which accounts paid the most?" and get a complete, business-framed answer scoped strictly to your own account. Read-only, OAuth-secured, no write access.

plugins.name: Clarity AI
plugins.productIntro: 根据投资要求筛选公司和投资组合以评估合规性。访问在 Clarity AI Web 应用程序中创建的指令，然后运行合规性报告来识别违规行为。深入研究各个公司，获取一系列财务外指标的详细证据。发现符合您标准的投资领域公司，并获得整个投资组合的简明违规摘要，所有这些均由 Clarity AI 的数据提供支持。
plugins.productIntroEn: Screen companies and portfolios against investment mandates to assess compliance. Access mandates created in the Clarity AI web app, then run compliance reports to identify breaches. Drill into individual companies for detailed evidence across a range of extra-financial metrics.

plugins.name: Vaatun
plugins.description: 寻找最佳保险科技解决方案
plugins.productIntro: Vaatun 是您现代保险科技的助手：人工智能原生平台可帮助保险经纪人、MGA 和中介机构运营和发展业务。询问经纪人 CRM、保单和索赔自动化、员工福利门户和嵌入式分发，并获得直接答案以及 Vaatun 与 Saiba、Zoho、Sibro 和 IMTCare 等工具的并排比较。探索 Vaatun 的产品（Vantage、Advantage 和 Quik），从 Vaatun 博客阅读最新的保险科技见解，与团队会面，并无需离开聊天即可预订演示或试用。
plugins.productIntroEn: Vaatun is your assistant for modern Insurtech: the AI-native platform helping insurance brokers, MGAs, and intermediaries run and grow their business. Ask about broker CRMs, policy and claims automation, employee-benefits portals, and embedded distribution, and get straight answers plus side-by-side comparisons of Vaatun against tools like Saiba, Zoho, Sibro and IMTCare.

plugins.name: Inkle
plugins.description: 访问您的 Inkle 财务数据
plugins.productIntro: 您的 Inkle 财务数据就在 ChatGPT 内。 询问您的税务申报、截止日期、损益表、发票、账单和现金流 - 无需仪表板。专为管理美国合规性和簿记的跨境初创公司创始人而设计。连接器是只读的，因此您的数据保持安全，同时 ChatGPT 为您提供即时 来自您的实时 Inkle 帐户的答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your Inkle financial data, right inside ChatGPT. Ask about your tax filings, deadlines, P&L, invoices, bills, and cash flow- no dashboard needed. Built for cross-border startup founders managing US compliance and bookkeeping. The connector is read-only, so your data stays safe while ChatGPT gives you instant answers from your live Inkle account.

plugins.name: Laabam.One
plugins.description: 阅读发票、现金和损益表
plugins.productIntro: Laabam.One 是一款多公司 ERP。将其连接到 ChatGPT，并用简单的语言询问您的一家公司：未清偿金额以及谁欠款最多，本月哪些发票未支付，您在银行帐户中的现金状况，一段时间内的损益，以及实际销售的产品。
plugins.productIntroEn: Laabam.One is a multi-company ERP. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask about one of your companies in plain language: what is outstanding and who owes the most, which invoices are unpaid this month, your cash position across bank accounts, profit and loss for a period, and which products actually sell.
plugins.developerName: Laabam One Business Solutions (OPC) Private Limited

plugins.name: HourProof
plugins.productIntro: HourProof 帮助短期和长期租赁业主保留同期材料参与记录以用于税务目的。通过 ChatGPT，用户可以记录发生的物业管理活动（“记录昨天在 Beach House 进行的 90 分钟的周转清洁”），使用日期、物业和类别过滤器查看他们的活动日志，根据他们的材料参与目标（STR 100 小时，LTR 750 小时）检查年初至今的时间和进度状态，并在重建执行的工作时交叉引用同步的客人预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: HourProof helps short-term and long-term rental owners keep contemporaneous material-participation records for tax purposes. Through ChatGPT, users log property-management activities as they happen ("log 90 minutes of turnover cleaning at Beach House yesterday"), review their activity log with date, property, and category filters, check year-to-date hours against their material-participa…

plugins.name: Lassie
plugins.productIntro: Lassie 帮助宠物主人探索受支持国家/地区的狗和猫的保险报价，确认收集的宠物详细信息，比较实际计划信息，调整报价选项，并回答有关 Lassie 承保范围和保单条款的问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Lassie helps pet owners explore insurance quotes for dogs and cats in supported countries, confirm collected pet details, compare factual plan information, adjust quote options, and answer questions about Lassie coverage and policy terms.

plugins.name: Tabs
plugins.description: 跟踪 B2B 发票和收入
plugins.productIntro: Tabs MCP 连接器允许 ChatGPT 等 AI 助手通过模型上下文协议查询您的账单、收入和合同数据。将您的 AI 工具连接到选项卡并用自然语言提出问题 - 无需自定义集成代码。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Tabs MCP connector lets AI assistants like ChatGPT query your billing, revenue, and contract data through the Model Context Protocol. Connect your AI tools to Tabs and ask questions in natural language — no custom integration code required.

plugins.name: Avalara
plugins.description: 管理税务交易、免税、申报和报告
plugins.originalDescription: Manage tax transactions, exemptions, returns, and reports
plugins.productIntro: 通过浏览器中的 Avalara 产品门户查看交易、负债、豁免、退货和报告。需要通过本地浏览器访问 ChatGPT Desktop 或桌面 Codex；不适用于 Web、移动或云支持的任务。进行所请求的记录和配置更改、生成报告并完成归档和付款工作流程，并明确批准后续操作。可用的工作流程取决于您的 Avalara 产品、公司配置、角色和权限。该插件由 OpenAI 构建和维护。它由计算机使用提供支持，不是 Avalara 提供的 API 或 MCP 集成。
plugins.productIntroEn: Review transactions, liabilities, exemptions, returns, and reports through the Avalara Product Portal in your browser. Requires local browser access in ChatGPT Desktop or desktop Codex; not available on web, mobile, or cloud-backed tasks.

plugins.name: Lexfi
plugins.productIntro: Lexfi 使 ChatGPT 能够访问结构化财务数据以进行研究和分析。它通过统一的 MCP 连接涵盖股票、宏观经济、固定收益、机构持股、市场情绪、另类数据和全球市场。用户可以直接在对话中检索市场数据、公司信息、经济指标、所有权活动和财务信号。 Lexfi 是一家金融数据提供商，不执行交易或提供投资建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Lexfi gives ChatGPT access to structured financial data for research and analysis. It covers equities, macroeconomics, fixed income, institutional holdings, market sentiment, alternative data, and global markets through a unified MCP connection. Users can retrieve market data, company information, economic indicators, ownership activity, and financial signals directly in conversation.

plugins.name: FX Hedge
plugins.productIntro: FX Hedge 将 C8 的量化货币对冲模型引入 ChatGPT。询问您的基础货币与任何风险敞口之间的当前对冲比率 - 例如“我的基础是欧元，我对美元的对冲是多少？” - 并获取模型的比率、其背后的四个信号驱动因素（宏观、趋势、利差、价值）以及实时欧洲央行参考利率的详细逐月细分。
plugins.productIntroEn: FX Hedge brings C8's quantitative currency-hedging models into ChatGPT. Ask for the current hedge ratio between your base currency and any exposure - for example "my base is EUR, what's my hedge against USD?" - and get the model's ratio, the four signal drivers behind it (macro, trend, carry, value), and a detailed month-by-month breakdown with live ECB reference rates.

plugins.name: Lightsplit
plugins.description: 在聊天中拆分群组费用
plugins.productIntro: Lightsplit 是一个专为旅行、家庭和团队设计的共享团体账本，完全通过对话进行管理。通过 Web、LINE 或 Telegram 轻松创建群组并共享访问权限。通过多种货币的等额、加权或自定义分割来跟踪支出、收入和结算。附上收据，以最少的转账优化债务结算，管理共享的待办事项列表，设定预算，并轻松查看按类别的支出明细。
plugins.productIntroEn: Lightsplit is a shared group ledger designed for trips, households, and teams, managed entirely through conversation. Easily create groups and share access via Web, LINE, or Telegram. Track expenses, income, and settlements with equal, weighted, or custom splits across multiple currencies.

plugins.name: Parity
plugins.productIntro: Parity 帮助自我导向的投资者使用当前市场数据对说明性的界定结果期权策略进行建模和比较。
plugins.productIntroEn: Parity helps self-directed investors model and compare illustrative defined-outcome options strategies using current market data.

plugins.name: RoboSystems
plugins.productIntro: RoboSystems 将会计和财务数据转化为 ChatGPT 可以直接查询的知识图谱。
plugins.productIntroEn: RoboSystems turns accounting and financial data into knowledge graphs ChatGPT can query directly.

plugins.name: Primary
plugins.productIntro: 只读 MCP 服务器，用于查询主要财务数据，包括余额、交易历史、外汇汇率、账户和财务报告。不支持写入、传输启动或状态更改操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Read-only MCP server for querying Primary financial data, including balances, transaction history, FX rates, accounts, and treasury reporting. No write, transfer initiation, or state-changing operations are supported.

plugins.name: Fitch Solutions
plugins.productIntro: 访问值得信赖的惠誉评级信用研究和数据、CreditSights 情报以及 BMI 国家和行业风险分析 — 所有这些均通过单一受管理的 MCP 连接进行。直接在人工智能工作流程中查询评级、财务、关键评级驱动因素、研究和交易见解。专为具有企业级身份验证和权限控制的受监管环境而构建。惠誉情报，您工作的地方。
plugins.productIntroEn: Access trusted Fitch Ratings credit research and data, CreditSights intelligence, and BMI country and sector risk analysis — all through a single, governed MCP connection. Query ratings, financials, key rating drivers, research, and deal insights directly inside your AI workflows. Built for regulated environments with enterprise-grade authentication and entitlement controls.

plugins.name: Rootline
plugins.productIntro: Rootline 是一家欧洲平台和市场支付服务提供商。该模型上下文协议服务器将您的 Rootline 帐户连接到 Claude，因此您可以询问网络上的任何付款、商家帐户或结算。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rootline is a European payment service provider for platforms and marketplaces. This Model Context Protocol server connects your Rootline account to Claude, so you can ask about any payment, merchant account, or settlement across your network.

plugins.name: PayPal
plugins.productIntro: 管理您的业务并开发您的支付集成。
plugins.productIntroEn: Manage your business and develop your payments integration.

plugins.name: Pocket Runway
plugins.description: 了解发薪日之前什么是安全的
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 Pocket Runway 帐户，查看发薪日之前实际可以安全支出的金额。检查您的每日支出津贴，查看即将到来的义务，了解您当前的工资周期是如何资助和分配的，并测试假设的购买将如何影响您的跑道。 Pocket Runway 使用您现有的付款期计划和财务数据来提供确定性的安全支出计算。 ChatGPT 集成是只读的，无法修改您的 Pocket Runway 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Pocket Runway account to see what’s actually safe to spend until payday. Check your daily spending allowance, see upcoming obligations, understand how your current pay period is funded and allocated, and test how a hypothetical purchase would affect your runway.

plugins.name: Further
plugins.productIntro: 进一步的 MCP 允许您详细查询您的 LP 资金。连接后，您可以使用它来检查资金和工具绩效，审查资本调用和分配，查找投资组合公司的持股和回报，核对银行账户，提取总账和试算表数据，并根据您的实时进一步数据回答其他问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Further MCP allows you to query your LP fund in intricate detail. Once connected, you can use this to check fund and vehicle performance, review capital calls and distributions, look up portfolio company holdings and returns, reconcile bank accounts, pull general ledger and trial balance data, and answer other questions based on your live Further data.

plugins.name: FactIQ
plugins.productIntro: FactIQ 是人工智能代理的研究数据层。它使用户能够在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 等工具内访问与来源相关的经济、市场和公司情报，包括官方统计数据、结构化公司财务数据、文件和财报电话会议证据。
plugins.productIntroEn: FactIQ is a research data layer for AI agents. It gives users access to source-linked economic, market and company intelligence—including official statistics, structured company financials, filings and earnings-call evidence—inside tools such as ChatGPT and Codex.

plugins.name: StockFit
plugins.description: 您可以信赖的金融 API。
plugins.originalDescription: Financial API you can rely on.
plugins.productIntro: StockFit 直接根据 SEC 备案文件提供所有美国股票/ETF/共同基金的结构化基本数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: StockFit offers structured fundamental data directly based on SEC filings for all US Stocks/ETFs/Mutual Funds.

plugins.name: Euroland App
plugins.productIntro: EurolandApp 允许用户通过自然语言查询生成的交互式图表来探索和可视化公司财务数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: EurolandApp allows users to explore and visualize company financial data through interactive charts generated from natural-language queries.

plugins.name: B2B.nu
plugins.productIntro: B2B.nu 是一款面向小型企业的瑞典 ERP：发票、簿记、银行对账、增值税、工资和 CRM。该应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到用户自己的 B2B.nu 公司，这样他们就可以用简单的瑞典语提出问题，并从实时数据中获得答案 - 当前的财务状况、损益表和资产负债表、下一次申报的增值税基础、哪些发票逾期、哪些成本已经漂移以及下一步到期的金额。
plugins.productIntroEn: B2B.nu is a Swedish ERP for small businesses: invoicing, bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, VAT, payroll and CRM. This app connects ChatGPT to the user's own B2B.nu company so they can ask questions in plain Swedish and get answers from live data — the current financial position, the income statement and balance sheet, the VAT basis for the next filing, which invoices are overdue, which c…

plugins.name: Bizora Tax Research
plugins.productIntro: Bizora 是一个人工智能原生税务研究平台。该连接器将 Bizora 的研究引擎引入 ChatGPT，因此您可以在实际工作中提出税务问题，并获得基于主要来源权威而不是二次评论的答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bizora is an AI native tax research platform. This connector brings Bizora’s research engine into ChatGPT, so you can ask a tax question in the middle of your actual work and get an answer grounded in primary source authority rather than secondary commentary.

plugins.name: Belgian Annual Accounts
plugins.productIntro: 向比利时国家银行提交的年度账户，采用结构化 JSON 格式，带有荷兰语、法语、德语或英语的官方标题代码和标签。按名称查找一家比利时公司，获取其资产负债表、损益表、社会资产负债表和票据。
plugins.productIntroEn: Annual accounts filed with the National Bank of Belgium, as structured JSON with the official rubric codes and labels in Dutch, French, German or English. Look up a Belgian company by name, fetch its balance sheet, income statement, social balance sheet and notes.

plugins.name: Menz Finance
plugins.description: 授权 PF 和 PJ 财务
plugins.productIntro: 在 Menz Finance 中查阅报告、条目、账户、销售、库存和定价，并记录财务运营情况。该插件不会转移资金或执行外部付款。
plugins.productIntroEn: Consulte relatórios, lançamentos, contas, vendas, estoque e precificação, e registre operações financeiras dentro do Menz Finance. O plugin não movimenta dinheiro nem executa pagamentos externos.

plugins.name: Nexafin
plugins.productIntro: Nexafin 是一款基于人工智能的个人财务和费用跟踪助手，可帮助您使用自然语言了解您的支出、预算和现金流。
plugins.productIntroEn: Nexafin is an AI-powered personal finance and expense tracking assistant that helps you understand your spending, budget, and cash flow using natural language.

plugins.name: Jawz
plugins.description: 阅读市场，检查投资组合
plugins.productIntro: 询问你的人工智能有关市场的信息，它会凭记忆回答：它在训练期间吸收的任何内容，但不知道今天是什么样子，也不知道你实际拥有什么。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ask your AI about the market and it answers from memory: whatever it absorbed during training, with no idea what today looks like or what you actually own.

plugins.name: Rillet
plugins.productIntro: Rillet 帮助财务团队检索财务数据并管理会计记录，包括发票、账单、客户、供应商、日记账分录、银行活动、合同和财务报告。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rillet helps finance teams retrieve financial data and manage accounting records, including invoices, bills, customers, vendors, journal entries, bank activity, contracts, and financial reports.

plugins.name: GrowPanel
plugins.productIntro: GrowPanel 是一个 SaaS 订阅分析平台。该连接器可让 ChatGPT 以简单的语言回答有关您的订阅业务的真实问题：MRR、流失（徽标和 MRR）、留存率 (NRR/GRR)、群组、MRR 变动、现金流、销售线索和试验、客户集中度、计划和个人客户。询问诸如“今年我的 MRR 按月流失情况是多少？”、“显示第一季度注册的客户的保留情况”、“哪些计划正在增长？”或“按 MRR 列出我的主要客户”。
plugins.productIntroEn: GrowPanel is a SaaS subscription-analytics platform. This connector lets ChatGPT answer real questions about your subscription business in plain language: MRR, churn (logo and MRR), retention (NRR/GRR), cohorts, MRR movements, cashflow, leads and trials, customer concentration, plans, and individual customers.

plugins.name: Co-Invest
plugins.description: 随时随地交易任何东西
plugins.productIntro: Co-Invest 让您可以直接从 ChatGPT 进行交易。
plugins.productIntroEn: Co-Invest lets you trade directly from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: FindBroadband
plugins.productIntro: 现在，找到合适宽带交易的最简单方法是 ChatGPT。
plugins.productIntroEn: The easiest way to find the right broadband deal is now on ChatGPT.

plugins.name: re:cap
plugins.productIntro: 在加注之前知道你的立场。从您的网站地址开始，回答几个简短的问题。您可以看到为计划提供资金的四种方式中的哪一种适合您的业务：债务、股权、赠款或您自己的现金，具体到范围内的产品和提供商。第一个答案会在一分钟内显示在屏幕上，无需帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: Know where you stand before you raise. Start with your website address and answer a few short questions. You see which of the four ways to fund a plan fit your business, debt, equity, grants or your own cash, down to the products and the providers in range. The first answer is on screen in under a minute, with no account needed.

plugins.name: PrefMark
plugins.description: 交易备忘录和尽职调查
plugins.productIntro: PrefMark 会为您正在评估的每笔交易保留最新的投资备忘录。询问交易的情况，自上次查看以来发生了什么变化，哪些尽职调查问题仍然悬而未决，以及每个数据的支持程度如何。您还可以添加交易和会议记录，记录尽职调查答案，并用简单的语言重写备忘录部分。 PrefMark 在不改变事实的情况下完善措辞，在您批准后应用它，并保留每个版本，以便您可以撤消或恢复。创始人电子邮件中的新数据或立场变化等待您在 PrefMark 中审核。
plugins.productIntroEn: PrefMark keeps an Investment Memo current for every deal you are evaluating. Ask where a deal stands, what changed since you last looked, which diligence questions are still open, and how well each figure is supported. You can also add deals and meeting notes, record diligence answers, and rewrite a memo section in plain language.

plugins.name: Ornn Data
plugins.productIntro: Ornn Data 为 ChatGPT 提供 AI 基础设施的实时和历史市场数据：GPU 租赁价格指数（现货、每日结算、滚动平均值、波动性、交易量、远期曲线）、内存（DRAM/闪存/模块）价格、实验室代币价格指数、LLM 编码活动指数、工作负载成本指标和 Neocloud 数据中心站点数据。用户可以查找当前价格、绘制历史趋势图，并比较 GPU 类型、内存类型、实验室、产品和地区的市场。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ornn Data gives ChatGPT live and historical market data for AI infrastructure: GPU rental price indices (spot, daily settles, rolling averages, volatility, volume, forward curve), memory (DRAM/flash/module) prices, token price indices by lab, LLM coding-activity indices, workload cost metrics, and neocloud datacenter site data.

plugins.name: Donorbox
plugins.description: 阅读 Donorbox 筹款数据
plugins.productIntro: Donorbox 为 ChatGPT 提供对互联组织筹款数据的只读访问权限：组织身份、捐助者、捐款、活动、活动、定期计划、购票以及计数、总和、趋势和排名的见解聚合。
plugins.productIntroEn: Donorbox gives ChatGPT read-only access to the connected organization's fundraising data: org identity, donors, donations, campaigns, events, recurring plans, ticket purchases, and insights aggregations for counts, sums, trends, and rankings.

plugins.name: MonitorBankRates
plugins.productIntro: MonitorBankRates 自 2008 年以来一直跟踪银行和信用社利率。该插件将 ChatGPT 连接到为 MonitorBankRates.com 提供支持的同一实时数据库：来自 8,000 多家美国银行和信用社的约 150,000 个当前利率报价，每天根据每个机构自己发布的利率进行刷新。
plugins.productIntroEn: MonitorBankRates has tracked bank and credit union rates since 2008. This plugin connects ChatGPT to the same live database that powers MonitorBankRates.com: about 150,000 current rate quotes from more than 8,000 U.S. banks and credit unions, refreshed daily from each institution's own published rates.

plugins.name: Nansen
plugins.productIntro: 与 Nansen 一起探索区块链和加密货币市场数据。查找代币和钱包标签，比较代币价格和市场活动，检查 Smart Money 持有量和流量，并分析公共钱包投资组合、交易对手、相关地址以及损益。支持的工具还提供 Hyperliquid 永续市场和头寸数据。连接您的 Nansen 帐户以访问数据。工具调用会消耗您连接帐户中的 Nansen API 积分。可用性取决于支持的链、市场和账户访问。该插件提供分析，不能进行交易或转移资产。
plugins.productIntroEn: Explore blockchain and crypto market data with Nansen. Look up tokens and wallet labels, compare token prices and market activity, inspect Smart Money holdings and flows, and analyze public wallet portfolios, counterparties, related addresses, and profit and loss. Supported tools also provide Hyperliquid perpetual market and position data. Connect your Nansen account to access the data.

plugins.name: Lexplorer Swiss Tax Research
plugins.productIntro: Lexplorer 通过经过验证的可引用来源搜索瑞士税法：联邦税法（DBG、MWSTG、StHG、VStG、印花税）、所有 26 个州的税法、24 个州的官方税务手册和行政实践、联邦行政实践（ESTV 和 SSK 通告、增值税出版物）以及评论和学术理论。 ChatGPT 以税务专业人士的方式规划研究：首先是法规，然后是行政实践和学说，对于州问题，则提供正确州的来源 - 每个关键陈述都带有精确的引用和原始来源的链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Lexplorer searches Swiss tax law with verified, citable sources: federal tax acts (DBG, MWSTG, StHG, VStG, stamp duties), the tax acts of all 26 cantons, the official tax handbooks and administrative practice of 24 cantons, the federal administrative practice (ESTV and SSK circulars, VAT publications), plus commentary and academic doctrine.

plugins.name: BestRemit
plugins.productIntro: BestRemit 可帮助您在向国外汇款之前比较汇款应用程序，以便您找到更超值的选择并保留更多资金。查看汇率、转账费用、付款方式以及收款人可以从您所在国家/地区的所有提供商处收到的金额的透明的并排估算。
plugins.productIntroEn: BestRemit helps you compare money transfer apps before sending money abroad, so you can find better-value options and keep more of your money. See transparent, side-by-side estimates for exchange rates, transfer fees, payment methods, and the amount your recipient could receive from all providers in your country.

plugins.name: OnChainDiligence
plugins.productIntro: 根据结构化政策检查自主支付提案，检索公共签名的 OCD 收据，并检查收据证明。检查未经签字，也不执行任何制裁筛查。验证返回 VALID、INVALID 或 UNVERIFIABLE；它不建立支付安全、合规性或服务交付。这个免费插件不执行付款、持有资金或访问私人操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Inspect autonomous payment proposals against structured policy, retrieve public signed OCD receipts, and check receipt proofs. Inspection is unsigned and performs no sanctions screening. Verification returns VALID, INVALID or UNVERIFIABLE; it does not establish payment safety, compliance or service delivery.

plugins.name: Validis (UK)
plugins.productIntro: Validis 将 ChatGPT 连接到从公司源分类账中提取的交易级会计数据。无论底层会计系统如何，都可以通过单一一致的模式搜索和选择业务，提取标准化总账、应收账款、应付账款和试算表数据。运行内置分析，包括财务比率、AR 和 AP 账龄、营运资金、收入质量、账本完整性和欺诈指标，或直接查询基础数据。专为需要快速、可靠地访问人工智能工作流程中的财务数据的贷方、审计师和财务团队而设计。
plugins.productIntroEn: Validis connects ChatGPT to transaction level accounting data extracted from a company's source ledgers. Search and select engagements, pull standardised general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and trial balance data through a single consistent schema, regardless of the underlying accounting system.

plugins.name: Validis (AU)
plugins.productIntro: Validis 将 ChatGPT 连接到从公司源分类账中提取的交易级会计数据。无论底层会计系统如何，都可以通过单一一致的模式搜索和选择业务，提取标准化总账、应收账款、应付账款和试算表数据。运行内置分析，包括财务比率、AR 和 AP 账龄、营运资金、收入质量、账本完整性和欺诈指标，或直接查询基础数据。专为需要快速、可靠地访问人工智能工作流程中的财务数据的贷方、审计师和财务团队而设计。
plugins.productIntroEn: Validis connects ChatGPT to transaction level accounting data extracted from a company's source ledgers. Search and select engagements, pull standardised general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and trial balance data through a single consistent schema, regardless of the underlying accounting system.

plugins.name: Balanços.AI
plugins.productIntro: 了解巴西公司发布的财务报表。按公司名称或 CNPJ 搜索，查看公司简介、资产负债表和损益表，比较公司排名，并阅读 Balanços.AI 上带有源文档链接的出版物。财务数据以巴西雷亚尔显示，并附有报告期和可用数据更新日期。覆盖范围正在扩大，某些时期或文件可能不可用。需要 Balanços.AI 帐户。查询生成操作日志和私人使用历史记录，使用历史记录保留 90 天。
plugins.productIntroEn: Explore financial statements published by Brazilian companies. Search by company name or CNPJ, view company profiles, balance sheets and income statements, compare company rankings, and read publications with links to source documents on Balanços.AI. Financial figures are shown in Brazilian reais, with reporting periods and available data update dates.

plugins.name: Tinman AI
plugins.description: Tinman AI帮助信贷员和承销商快速承保房屋融资场景并解答复杂的问题
plugins.originalDescription: Tinman AI helps loan officers and underwriters quickly underwrite home financing scenarios and answer compl...
plugins.productIntro: Tinman AI 帮助信贷员和承保人快速承保房屋融资场景，并使用可信的信贷决策数据和承保逻辑回答复杂的资格问题。用户无需浏览分散的系统、分散的指南或手动电子表格，而是可以评估广泛的贷方和投资者的资格、DTI 重组和收入计算，立即确定贷款适合哪些投资者以及原因。 Tinman AI 将过去需要数天或数周的决策转变为实时、合规的决策，从而保持贷款流动和交易活跃。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tinman AI helps loan officers and underwriters quickly underwrite home financing scenarios and answer complex eligibility questions using trusted credit decision data and underwriting logic. Instead of navigating fragmented systems, scattered guidelines, or manual spreadsheets, users can evaluate eligibility, DTI restructuring, and income calculations across a broad set of lenders and in…

plugins.name: MONVELOP
plugins.description: 探索您的 MONVELOP 预算
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的 MONVELOP 帐户以在对话中了解您的个人预算。要求提供每月财务概览、按信封列出的支出明细、最近的交易、定期订阅或预算期间的比较。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your MONVELOP account to understand your personal budget in conversation. Ask for a monthly financial overview, a spending breakdown by envelope, recent transactions, recurring subscriptions, or a comparison between budget periods.

plugins.name: DSCR Loan Calculator
plugins.productIntro: 像 DSCR 贷方一样分析美国住宅投资物业。 OneMoreDoor Capital 的 DSCR 贷款计算器可计算偿债覆盖率、每月 PITIA、现金流、资本化率以及盈亏平衡租金或 1-10 单位租金的价格，然后在聊天中放置一个完全可编辑的计算器，所以“如果租金为 3,900 美元会怎样？”立即重新运行。在 OneMoreDoor.com 上继续进行相同的交易，并保留每个号码，或者为您的合作伙伴或经纪人获取可共享的链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Analyze U.S. residential investment property like a DSCR lender does. OneMoreDoor Capital's DSCR Loan Calculator computes debt service coverage ratio, monthly PITIA, cash flow, cap rate, and break-even rent or price for 1-10 unit rentals, then puts a fully editable calculator right in the chat, so "what if rent were $3,900?" re-runs instantly. Continue the same deal on OneMoreDoor.

plugins.name: Alpaca Paper Trading
plugins.productIntro: Alpaca 的 ChatGPT 插件可通过 Alpaca 的交易 API 和市场数据 API 直接访问模拟交易执行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Alpaca’s ChatGPT Plugin provides direct access to paper trading execution via Alpaca's Trading API and Market Data API.

plugins.name: Mergr
plugins.description: 寻找私募股权公司、交易和买家
plugins.productIntro: Mergr 是一个私募股权和并购研究数据库，现已在 ChatGPT 中提供。它涵盖 4,100 多家活跃的私募股权公司、224,000 多家公司和 223,000 多笔交易，包含所有权历史、交易顾问和 100,000 多份新闻稿，重点关注中间市场。
plugins.productIntroEn: Mergr is a private equity and M&A research database, now available in ChatGPT. It covers 4,100+ active PE firms, 224,000+ companies, and 223,000+ transactions, with ownership histories, deal advisors, and 100,000+ press releases, focused on the middle market.

plugins.name: Twelve Data
plugins.productIntro: 十二数据可帮助您查找市场数据并在不离开 ChatGPT 的情况下进行检查。请求报价快照，在交互式图表中查看实时或历史价格走势，搜索端点目录，并运行股票、ETF、基金、外汇、加密货币等的市场数据工作流程。该应用程序是只读的，因此它不会进行交易或转移资金。
plugins.productIntroEn: Twelve Data helps you look up market data and inspect it without leaving ChatGPT. Ask for a quote snapshot, view real-time or historical price action in an interactive chart, search the endpoint catalog, and run market data workflows for stocks, ETFs, funds, forex, crypto, and more. The app is read-only, so it does not place trades or move money.

plugins.name: Alpaca Live
plugins.productIntro: Alpaca 的 ChatGPT 插件提供对 Alpaca 交易 API 和市场数据 API 的直接访问。
plugins.productIntroEn: Alpaca’s ChatGPT Plugin provides direct access to Alpaca's Trading API and Market Data API.

plugins.name: Qalimo
plugins.productIntro: Qalimo 是一款面向私人房东和 SCI 的法国租赁管理应用程序。该连接器允许您以自然语言管理您的租赁管理：咨询您的财产、租户、余额、会计分录、银行交易和文件（租赁、收据、库存）；生成 PDF 格式的租金收据和到期通知；记录或更正会计分录（租金、费用、工作）；准备库存文件。对通过 OAuth 验证的出租人帐户的有限访问、读取和/或写入取决于授予的同意。
plugins.productIntroEn: Qalimo est une application française de gestion locative pour bailleurs particuliers et SCI. Ce connecteur permet de piloter sa gestion locative en langage naturel : consulter ses biens, locataires, soldes, écritures comptables, transactions bancaires et documents (baux, quittances, états des lieux) ; générer les quittances de loyer et avis d'échéance en PDF ; enregistrer ou corriger des…

plugins.name: Kalkınma Yatırım Bankası
plugins.productIntro: Kalkınma Yatırım Bankası 搜索 TKYB 有关产品、服务、公司信息、融资、APEX 计划、可持续发展、投资者关系和联系方式的公共信息。它以只读信息卡的形式呈现结果，并附有官方来源的链接。它不需要登录，无法访问客户帐户、应用程序、交易或个人银行数据，并且仅提供一般信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kalkınma Yatırım Bankası searches TKYB's public information on products, services, corporate information, financing, APEX programs, sustainability, investor relations, and contact details. It presents results in read-only information cards with links to official sources.

plugins.name: OptionClaws
plugins.productIntro: OptionClaws 扫描每只可选择的美国股票，并根据您询问的策略返回排名的期权交易。 备兑看涨期权、现金担保看跌期权、信用利差、铁秃鹰期权、蝴蝶期权、日历期权、对角期权、跨式期权、宽跨式期权等。
plugins.productIntroEn: OptionClaws scans every optionable US stock and returns ranked options trades for the strategy you ask about. Covered calls, cash-secured puts, credit spreads, iron condors, butterflies, calendars, diagonals, straddles, strangles, and more.

plugins.name: KiasuMiles
plugins.productIntro: 比较您已持有的新加坡信用卡的商家和付款方式。 KiasuMiles 返回最佳卡、赚取率、上限、条件以及奖金不确定时的后备方案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Compare the Singapore credit cards you already hold for a merchant and payment method. KiasuMiles returns the best card, earn rate, caps, conditions, and a fallback when the bonus is uncertain.

plugins.name: Rydoo
plugins.description: 管理您的 Rydoo 开支
plugins.productIntro: Rydoo MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Rydoo 帐户，因此您可以通过日常对话来管理您的支出，而无需导航应用程序。使用您现有的 Rydoo 登录名登录一次 - ChatGPT 只能使用您自己的角色和权限查看和执行您在 Rydoo 中已被允许执行的操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rydoo MCP connects ChatGPT to your Rydoo account, so you can manage your expenses through everyday conversation instead of navigating the app. Sign in once with your existing Rydoo login — ChatGPT can then only see and do what you're already permitted to do in Rydoo, using your own roles and permissions.

plugins.name: Comparador de seguros BuenaIA
plugins.productIntro: 只读 BuenaIA 原型，用于搜索、详细说明和比较根据公开商业产品表（移动、设备、家庭、商业网络和数字保护）重建的目录。它有助于识别覆盖范围、重叠、差距和配置文件，以及官方定价工具的链接。它不是 Telefónica 或 Movistar 销售渠道，不签发保单，也不计算个性化保费。
plugins.productIntroEn: Read-only BuenaIA prototype that searches, details, and compares a catalog reconstructed from publicly available commercial product sheets (mobile, devices, home, business cyber, and digital protection). It helps identify coverage, overlaps, gaps, and profile fit, and links to the official pricing tool.

plugins.name: Validis (US)
plugins.productIntro: Validis 将 ChatGPT 连接到从公司源分类账中提取的交易级会计数据。无论底层会计系统如何，都可以通过单一一致的模式搜索和选择业务，提取标准化总账、应收账款、应付账款和试算表数据。运行内置分析，包括财务比率、AR 和 AP 账龄、营运资金、收入质量、账本完整性和欺诈指标，或直接查询基础数据。专为需要快速、可靠地访问人工智能工作流程中的财务数据的贷方、审计师和财务团队而设计。
plugins.productIntroEn: Validis connects ChatGPT to transaction level accounting data extracted from a company's source ledgers. Search and select engagements, pull standardized general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and trial balance data through a single consistent schema, regardless of the underlying accounting system.

plugins.name: Revestor
plugins.description: 租赁书籍和 REPS 时间
plugins.productIntro: Revestor 是一款面向美国房东的租赁组合和税务准备软件。在 OAuth 同意后连接它以查询实时 Revetor 记录，包括财产、REPS 小时数、费用和里程。通过写入权限，助理可以提出时间日志、里程或非机密费用；提案将在 Revestor AI Review 中保持待决状态，直到您接受为止。连接器流量不使用 Gemini 或 Revestor AI 积分。输出仅为记录和状态，而不是税务、法律或会计建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Revestor is rental portfolio and tax-readiness software for U.S. landlords. Connect it to query live Revestor records after OAuth consent, including properties, REPS hours, expenses, and mileage. With write access, assistants can propose time logs, mileage, or unclassified expenses; proposals stay pending in Revestor AI Review until you accept them.

plugins.name: The Kingdom Bank
plugins.productIntro: 将您的 TKB 帐户连接到 ChatGPT，并获得有关发票的即时答案 - 金额、到期日、状态和付款详细信息 - 无需登录门户。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your TKB account to ChatGPT and get instant answers about your invoices — amounts, due dates, statuses and payment details — without logging into the portal.

plugins.name: Calculadora de Autônomos
plugins.productIntro: Calculadora de Autônomos - Contabilizei。 描述改革改革旨在影响企业的自治权和专业权。模拟客户，将场景和内容比较为为实现目标而付出的努力。作为女皇，我们可以保持节奏并与自治相抗衡。就个人而言，在经济方面，我们的做法有不同的形式。
plugins.productIntroEn: Calculadora de Autônomos - Contabilizei. Descubra como a Reforma Tributária pode impactar empresas que contratam autônomos e profissionais que trabalham por conta própria. Simule custos, compare cenários e entenda as mudanças tributárias de acordo com o seu perfil. Para as empresas, descubra qual é o custo de tempo e dinheiro na contratação de autônomos.

plugins.name: Alvore Finance
plugins.productIntro: Alvore Finance 是财务顾问及其业务客户保存业务数据的工作空间。通过此应用程序，您可以查询公司任意月份的损益、指标、预算和分类交易；审查个人客户的概况、家庭预算和交易；并阅读每个项目所附的咨询交付成果，或发布新的交付成果。阅读涵盖公司和个人财务的内容。仅在客户的私人工作空间内写入创建或更新项目内容 - 项目、其简报、HTML 可交付成果及其版本。没有工具发起或结算付款、转账或购买，应用程序编写的任何内容都不会发布到公共地址。
plugins.productIntroEn: Alvore Finance is the workspace where financial consultants and their business clients keep the numbers an engagement runs on. With this app you can ask about a company's P&L, indicators, budget and categorized transactions for any month; review an individual client's overview, household budget and transactions; and read the consulting deliverables attached to each engagement, or publish…

plugins.name: Midpoint Card Prices
plugins.description: TCG 和运动卡价格及投资回报率
plugins.productIntro: 查看球星卡的价值以及为其评分是否值得。 Midpoint 返回超过 150 万张 Pokémon、Magic: The Gathering、Yu-Gi-Oh!、One Piece、Lorcana、Gundam、体育（棒球、篮球、足球、曲棍球、足球、摔跤、UFC、高尔夫、网球、拳击、赛车）和娱乐卡的当前美元市场价格。按名称、套装或编号索取卡片，即可按条件获取其原始（未分级）价格以及 PSA、CGC、BGS、SGC 和 TAG 的分级阶梯。
plugins.productIntroEn: Look up what a trading card is worth and whether grading it pays. Midpoint returns current USD market prices for 1.5M+ Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Lorcana, Gundam, sports (baseball, basketball, football, hockey, soccer, wrestling, UFC, golf, tennis, boxing, racing) and entertainment cards.

plugins.name: Análise de FIIs
plugins.description: 巴西房地产投资信托基金研究
plugins.productIntro: 使用自然语言研究和跟踪巴西 REIT（房地产投资基金，简称 FII）。 Análise de FII 整理基金价格、股息收益率、基本面、指标、风险、流动性、分布和报告。比较资金并使用筛选器找到符合您标准的 FII。经过身份验证的专业版用户还可以跟踪自己的投资组合，包括持仓、股息、估值和处理状态。免费预览版提供公共基金数据和指标，而专业版则解锁其余工具和完整分析。该应用程序是信息性的和只读的：它不买卖投资、转移资金或取代财务建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Research and track Brazilian REITs (real estate investment funds, or FIIs) using natural language. Análise de FIIs organizes fund prices, dividend yield, fundamentals, indicators, risk, liquidity, distributions, and reports. Compare funds and use a screener to find FIIs that match your criteria.

plugins.name: Thrifle
plugins.productIntro: 询问任何美国零售商的退货政策：退货窗口、是否免费退货、补货费用、假期延长以及从 A+ 到 D- 的等级。检查商店价格是否匹配、提供哪些军事和学生折扣、品牌在您生日时赠送什么以及如何取消订阅。查找包含价格和标价的实时交易，查找商店信用卡条款（包括延期利息促销），并询问亚马逊价格是否值得立即购买或等待。每个答案都包含一个指向其所基于的 Thrifle 页面的链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ask about any US retailer's return policy: the return window, whether returns are free, restocking fees, holiday extensions, and a grade from A+ to D-. Check whether a store price-matches, what military and student discounts it offers, what a brand gives away on your birthday, and how to cancel a subscription.

plugins.name: マネックス証券

plugins.name: みずほ銀行
plugins.description: みずほ銀行のFAQ、ATM・店舗検索、来店予約ページをご案内
plugins.originalDescription: みずほ銀行のFAQ、ATM・店舗検索、来店予約ページをご案内
plugins.productIntro: みずほ銀行：みずほ銀行のFAQ、ATM・店舗検索、来店予約ページをご案内。
plugins.productIntroEn: みずほ銀行の公式情報に基づき、よくある質問、ATM・店舗検索、来店予約ページのご案内を行うアプリです。 みずほ銀行の情報をまず確認したいときに安心してお使いいただけます。 手続きに必要な情報を確認したいとき、近くのATMや店舗を探したいとき、来店予約ページへ進みたいときに、自然な言葉でご相談いただけます。AIが相手ですので、聞き方に迷ったときも気軽に質問してみてください。 なお、本アプリでは上記機能以外の口座開設、お取引の実行、個人情報を前提としたお手続きなどは対象外となります。 ■ 質問例 ・（FAQ）みずほのキャッシュカードを失くした場合、まず何をすればいいですか？ ・（ATM・店舗）渋谷駅周辺で、土日に使えるみずほATMはありますか？ ・（来店予約ページ）相続について相談したいので、平日の夕方に予約できるみずほの支店を探してください。

plugins.name: マネーフォワード ME
plugins.description: あなたのお金を、ChatGPTとの会話でもっとわかりやすく
plugins.originalDescription: あなたのお金を、ChatGPTとの会話でもっとわかりやすく
plugins.productIntro: マネーフォワード ME：あなたのお金を、ChatGPTとの会話でもっとわかりやすく。
plugins.productIntroEn: マネーフォワード MEの家計・資産データについて、ChatGPTに普段の言葉で質問できます。「今月の収支にはどれくらい余裕があった？」「資産は前月からどう変わった？」「現在の資産状況を教えて」などと聞くだけで、毎月の収支から保有資産、資産配分までまとめて確認できます。家計と資産の変化や特徴に気づき、自分に合った資産形成の次の一歩を考えるために役立ちます。本アプリは、ユーザーの許諾・指示のもと、ユーザーに代わってChatGPTにデータ連携を行うものであり、金融商品の売買や出金・振込等の取引を行うことはできません。また、ChatGPTの回答を参考にした実際のお取引などは情報をご確認のうえユーザーご自身でご判断をお願いします。

plugins.productIntroEn: 「これって経費になる？」「何から始めればいい？」といった、確定申告のわからないことを解決します。税理士が実際に答えた、1万件以上の相談例の中からあなたの悩みにぴったりの答えを探し出します。AIが作った推測の答えではなく、実在するプロの税理士による「生のアドバイス」をそのまま表示。回答した税理士の顔写真や名前も確認できるので、初めての方でも安心して判断できます。ひとりで悩まず、プロの知恵を借りて確定申告をスムーズに進めましょう。

plugins.productIntroEn: MyFitnessPal is a service that helps you generate meal plans, recipes, and personalized nutrition guidance. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.
