plugins.name: Mental Health Tools
plugins.productIntro: Dotwell 将基于证据的心理健康工具直接带入您的 ChatGPT 对话中。每天只需几分钟，即可逐步学习和练习减压、情绪调节和保持健康的技巧。 每个工具都基于既定的方法，并且设计得足够简单，适合日常使用。无需先验知识，只需开始对话并跟进即可。
plugins.productIntroEn: Dotwell brings evidence-based mental health tools directly into your ChatGPT conversations. Learn and practice techniques for stress reduction, emotional regulation, and wellbeing — guided step by step, in just a few minutes a day. Each tool is grounded in established methods and designed to be simple enough to use daily.

plugins.name: Habitify
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中建立更好的例程并保持责任。 Habitify 应用程序将您的习惯跟踪无缝集成到您的工作流程中，允许您通过简单、自然的对话记录活动、跟踪进度并分析您的一致性。
plugins.productIntroEn: Build better routines and stay accountable directly within ChatGPT. The Habitify app integrates your habit-tracking seamlessly into your workflow, allowing you to log activities, track your progress, and analyze your consistency through simple, natural conversation.

plugins.name: WeightWise
plugins.productIntro: WeightWise：BMI、体脂等等。
plugins.productIntroEn: An easy-to-use suite of fitness and health calculators. Get BMI, ideal weight ranges, body fat estimates, and daily calorie needs (BMR/TDEE) in seconds.

plugins.name: Face Yoga
plugins.productIntro: 通过个性化的日常面部瑜伽让您的肌肤充满自信
plugins.productIntroEn: Feel Confident in Your Skin with Personalized Daily Face Yoga

plugins.name: Caliber
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 分析您的 Calibre 锻炼、营养、身体统计数据、个人记录和训练计划。绘制您的进度图表、可视化趋势并获得健身数据的清晰摘要。
plugins.productIntroEn: Analyze your Caliber workouts, nutrition, body stats, personal records, and training plans directly from ChatGPT. Chart your progress, visualize trends, and get clear summaries of your fitness data.

plugins.name: ChefPlan
plugins.productIntro: ChefPlan 使用 Mifflin-St Jeor 方程计算您的日常能量需求（BMR、TDEE 和宏），并帮助您找到带有照片、成分和分步说明的食谱。输入您的体重、身高、年龄、性别、活动水平和目标，以获得个性化的卡路里目标。按名称搜索食谱或随机获取一道菜肴 - 一切都在聊天中。
plugins.productIntroEn: ChefPlan calculates your daily energy needs (BMR, TDEE, and macros) using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation and helps you find recipes with photos, ingredients, and step-by-step instructions. Enter your weight, height, age, gender, activity level, and goal to get a personalized calorie target. Search for recipes by name or get a random dish — all inside the chat.

plugins.name: All My Affirmations
plugins.productIntro: ChatGPT 生成和显示肯定信息的简单方法。
plugins.productIntroEn: The easy way for ChatGPT to generate and display affirmations.

plugins.name: SnapCal
plugins.description: AI 卡路里和膳食追踪器
plugins.productIntro: SnapCal 让您轻松追踪营养。只需用自然语言和照片描述您吃的东西，人工智能就会立即估算出您的卡路里和大量营养素（蛋白质、碳水化合物和脂肪）。直接使用 ChatGPT 内的交互式仪表板查看每日摘要、跟踪体重并管理饮食。
plugins.productIntroEn: SnapCal makes tracking your nutrition effortless. Simply describe what you eat in natural language and photos, and the AI will instantly estimate your calories and macronutrients (protein, carbs, and fats). View daily summaries, track your weight, and manage your diet with an interactive dashboard directlyinside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: BurnFat – Calorie Tracker
plugins.productIntro: BurnFat 帮助成年人估计每日卡路里和减脂宏量，比较三种安全上限步速，并通过交互式计划器查看自适应目标时间表。
plugins.productIntroEn: BurnFat helps adults estimate daily calories and macros for fat loss, compare three safety-capped paces, and view an adaptive goal timeline through an interactive planner.

plugins.name: AI Endurance
plugins.productIntro: 您的跑步、骑行和铁人三项人工智能教练。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your AI coach for Running, Cycling and Triathlon.

plugins.name: Sleep Cycle
plugins.productIntro: Sleep Cycle 采用经过验证的睡眠科学来帮助您获得更好的休息。 Sleep Cycle 每晚受到数百万人的信赖，拥有旨在改善您的睡眠的科学工具，包括精心制作的睡眠声音，可帮助您放松并更轻松地入睡。当您难以放松时，您可以立即开始聆听 - 就在对话发生的地方。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sleep Cycle uses proven sleep science to help you get better rest. Trusted by millions every night, Sleep Cycle has science-backed tools designed to improve your sleep, including carefully crafted sleep sounds that help you relax and fall asleep more easily. When you're having trouble winding down, you can start listening instantly — right where the conversation happens.

plugins.name: Trainerrr
plugins.productIntro: Trainerrr 帮助登录用户通过 ChatGPT 管理锻炼计划、可重复使用的课程、已完成的锻炼日志、训练日记笔记、每周进度检查、营养日志、食物查找和个人健身目标。它处理用户选择发送的锻炼、营养、目标、日记、进度检查和图像参考详细信息，以便它可以完成其 Trainerrr 帐户所请求的操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Trainerrr helps signed-in users manage workout plans, reusable sessions, completed workout logs, training journal notes, weekly progress check-ins, nutrition logs, food lookups, and personal fitness targets through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Pacing: Run Coach & Tracker
plugins.description: 在手机上运行 ChatGPT 锻炼
plugins.productIntro: 在 ChatGPT 中设计您的运行，然后运行它。节奏将您在对话中整理的锻炼或训练计划转化为手机上真实的、经过指导的课程，因此将拆分复制到笔记应用程序中不会丢失任何内容。询问您的训练目的：6x800 米间歇训练、轻松长跑、阈值节奏，或者从沙发到 5 公里再到马拉松的完整多周训练。准备就绪后，Pacing 会通过卡片、代码、深层链接或二维码扫描将其交给您。
plugins.productIntroEn: Design your run in ChatGPT, then go run it. Pacing takes the workout or training plan you put together in conversation and turns it into a real, coached session on your phone, so nothing gets lost copying splits into a notes app. Ask for whatever you're training for: a 6x800m interval session, an easy long run, a threshold tempo, or a full multi-week build from couch-to-5K to marathon.

plugins.name: Motra
plugins.description: 您的私人人工智能教练
plugins.productIntro: Motra for ChatGPT 为您提供一位了解您整个训练历史的个人健身分析师。只需询问您的锻炼情况即可获得即时见解。询问您的卧推进展如何，本月您的总训练量是多少，或者您一直忽视了哪些肌肉群。跟踪个人记录、逐组探索锻炼历史并发现训练模式。无论您是在计划下一次会议、回顾您的一周，还是在寻求新的 PR——只需询问即可获得您需要的答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Motra for ChatGPT gives you a personal fitness analyst that understands your entire training history. Just ask about your workouts and get instant insights. Ask how your bench press has progressed, what your total volume was this month, or which muscle groups you've been neglecting. Track personal records, explore exercise history set by set, and discover patterns in your training.

plugins.name: Insight Timer
plugins.productIntro: 全球有 3200 万人使用。探索世界上最大的免费冥想、睡眠轨迹、音乐、呼吸和精神讲座图书馆——现已在 ChatGPT 中提供。
plugins.productIntroEn: Used by 32 million people worldwide. Explore the world's largest free library of meditation, sleep tracks, music, breathwork, and spiritual talks — now available inside ChatGPT.

plugins.productIntro: 通过基于圣经的冥想、反思和平静的灵修，平静地入睡。 《细拉》提供以圣经为中心的舒缓音频，帮助您更好地休息、缓解焦虑并找到精神上的平安。 只需告诉 ChatGPT 您正在寻找什么，您就会收到个性化的音频推荐。
plugins.productIntroEn: Fall asleep peacefully with Bible-based meditations, reflections, and calming devotionals. Selah offers soothing Scripture-centered audio to help you rest better, ease anxiety, and find spiritual peace. Just tell ChatGPT what you’re looking for, and you’ll receive personalized audio recommendations.

plugins.productIntroEn: Calio helps you find meal ideas from its published recipe catalog. Search by ingredients you have, meal type, calorie range, diet preference, or excluded ingredients, then get localized recipe details with estimated nutrition values.

plugins.name: Pregnancy Progress

plugins.productIntroEn: A quick and easy way to see how your pregnancy is progressing, week-by-week.

plugins.productIntroEn: StrengthCode Public Coach Tools helps users find matching training programs, compare options, estimate calories and lifting loads, and troubleshoot progress plateaus using read-only advisory tools.

plugins.productIntroEn: Miracle of Mind: Meditate with Sadhguru is your calm, always-available companion for meditation, mindfulness, and mental wellness. Whether you’re feeling stressed, anxious, lonely, depressed, panicked, mentally sick, unable to sleep, or simply seeking more clarity, Miracle of Mind offers simple mindfulness technique / meditation / breathing exercise / grounding exercise / calming exercis…

plugins.name: Breethe Meditations Made 4 You
plugins.productIntro: Breethe Meditations Made 4 You：个性化引导冥想
plugins.productIntroEn: Breethe Meditations Made 4 You: Personalized Guided Meditation

plugins.productIntroEn: Calorie Tracker Guide helps you find the perfect calorie tracker for your specific needs. We have manually reviewed, tested, and verified over 120 apps, rating their features to ensure you get the best possible recommendations. Get personalized suggestions based on your unique goals, experience level, and specific requirements.

plugins.name: Trash Panda - Food Scanner
plugins.productIntro: Trash Panda 让您更轻松地选择支持您健康目标的食物。按名称或条形码查找杂货产品，看看里面到底有什么。获得关于添加剂、隐藏糖和超加工成分的清晰解释——所有这些都以简单的语言进行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Trash Panda makes it easier to choose food that supports your health goals. Look up grocery products by name or barcode to see what’s really inside. Get clear explanations of additives, hidden sugars, and ultra-processed ingredients — all in plain language.

plugins.name: NyquistAI
plugins.description: 最新 FDA 医疗器械信息

plugins.productIntroEn: Tap into NyquistAI's comprehensive database of FDA medical device intelligence, including all 510(k), PMA, De Novo, and HDE clearances and approvals, adverse events, recalls, guidance, and more. This app provides FDA regulatory and safety intelligence for research, compliance, and monitoring purposes only. It does not provide medical advice or clinical recommendations.

plugins.name: Pearl Pet Care

plugins.productIntroEn: Pet owners often have questions about their animal’s health, diet, or behavior but don’t have immediate access to a veterinarian.

plugins.name: Dr Nutrition

plugins.productIntroEn: Dr Nutrition connects ChatGPT to supported nutrition shopping and customer-service workflows through a secure MCP server. Use it to help users work with Dr Nutrition product and service information inside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Achieve Harmony

plugins.productIntroEn: Use this app to do a quick guided breathing session to calm yourself.

plugins.name: Flow State

plugins.productIntroEn: Flow State connects ChatGPT to an endurance athlete's training calendar. Users can review upcoming workouts, inspect athlete profile and recovery context, create or update workouts and races, manage training plans, analyze training load and workout history, and sync selected workouts to Garmin when their Flow State account has Garmin connected.

plugins.name: InnoSupps
plugins.productIntro: 根据您的目标（能量、睡眠、消化或锻炼支持）浏览并查找 Inno Supps 补充剂。回答几个问题并从 Inno Supps 目录中获取量身定制的产品建议，其中包含成分和配方的详细信息以帮助您选择。
plugins.productIntroEn: Browse and find Inno Supps supplements based on your goals — energy, sleep, digestion, or workout support. Answer a few questions and get tailored product suggestions from the Inno Supps catalog, with details on ingredients and formulations to help you choose.

plugins.name: Purely Snacks
plugins.productIntro: Purely Snacks 可帮助您找到符合您喜好的更健康的零食选择。按类型、成分、营养目标或饮食属性搜索产品，然后根据“低糖”、“更多蛋白质”、“无麸质”、“纯素食”或“无花生”等要求优化结果。
plugins.productIntroEn: Purely Snacks helps you find healthier snack options that match your preferences. Search for products by type, ingredient, nutrition goal, or dietary attribute, then refine results with requests like “lower sugar,” “more protein,” “gluten free,” “vegan,” or “no peanuts.”

plugins.productIntroEn: Joules helps cyclists review their training, plan upcoming weeks, adjust workouts around life events, log completed sessions, and keep race and coaching context current through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Bella Noor Skin Concierge

plugins.productIntroEn: Bella Noor Skin Concierge helps users choose skincare treatments in New York City based on skin goals, sensitivity, event timing, location, and treatment interest. It supports treatment recommendations, HydraFacial vs DMK comparisons, dermaplaning and Osmosis guidance, prep and aftercare education, Bella Noor location details, and booking-link guidance.

plugins.name: OathMCP

plugins.productIntroEn: OathMCP helps users find, inspect, and run 39 established clinical calculators with explicit units, deterministic results, plausibility checks, limitations, and evidence links.

plugins.name: Rhizome AI

plugins.name: Zumba
plugins.productIntro: 无论您是想参加课程还是成为一名 Zumba® 授权教练，Zumba® ChatGPT 应用程序都能满足您的需求。搜索您附近的面对面、直播或点播 Zumba® 课程，或者找到您所在地区的面对面教练培训，并朝着成为持证教练迈出下一步。只需告诉我们您在寻找什么，剩下的就由我们来处理。
plugins.productIntroEn: Whether you're looking to take a class or become a Licensed Zumba® Instructor, the Zumba® ChatGPT App has you covered. Search for in-person, livestream, or on-demand Zumba® classes near you — or find an in-person instructor training in your area and take the next step toward becoming a licensed instructor. Just tell us what you're looking for, and we'll handle the rest.

plugins.name: SmartSpectra
plugins.description: 非接触式生命体征，任何相机
plugins.productIntro: SmartSpectra 是 Presage Technologies 的非接触式生命体征 SDK。它可以在任何带有摄像头的设备上使用 rPPG（远程光电体积描记法）通过标准智能手机和网络摄像头视频测量心率和呼吸率。没有可穿戴设备，没有接触传感器。
plugins.productIntroEn: SmartSpectra is a contactless vital signs SDK from Presage Technologies. It measures heart rate and breathing rate from standard smartphone and webcam video using rPPG (remote photoplethysmography), on any device with a camera. No wearables, no contact sensors.

plugins.name: Kenso
plugins.productIntro: Kenso 通过 ChatGPT 帮助用户检查当前训练、锻炼历史、恢复、营养、身体指标、计划和个人记录。通过用户确认和正确的 OAuth 范围，它还可以创建或调整私人锻炼计划、记录锻炼、分阶段导入、完成会话、放弃分阶段导入，以及在用户的 Kenso 帐户中保存持久的教练首选项。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kenso helps users inspect current training, workout history, recovery, nutrition, body metrics, programs, and personal records through ChatGPT. With user confirmation and the right OAuth scopes, it can also create or adjust private workout programs, log workouts, stage imports, complete sessions, discard staged imports, and save durable coaching preferences in the user's Kenso account.

plugins.productIntroEn: rit.run Coach helps authenticated rit.run users review safe profile, workout, weekly training, heart-rate, and running shoe summaries from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Cal Plus

plugins.productIntroEn: Cal Plus is an AI calorie tracker and coach. Connect your Cal Plus account and ask ChatGPT about your own logged data in plain words: how your nutrition has been over any period and how it compares with your calorie, protein, carb and fat targets; what you ate on a given day; when you last logged a particular food; your step count and active energy from a connected health app; workout fr…

plugins.name: Sweat & Tonic
plugins.description: 关于汗水和滋补品的答案
plugins.productIntro: 直接从工作室自己发布的信息中获取有关多伦多精品健身工作室 Sweat & Tonic 的答案。该连接器搜索工作室的实时内容，并提取有关课程计划、当前课程安排、定价、讲师、治疗和预订的完整详细信息，以便您可以计划访问或比较选项，而无需在网络上搜索。
plugins.productIntroEn: Get answers about Sweat & Tonic, a boutique fitness studio in Toronto, straight from the studio's own published information. This connector searches the studio's live content and pulls full details on class programs, the current class schedule, pricing, instructors, treatments, and booking, so you can plan a visit or compare options without hunting across the web.

plugins.name: Sina Connect
plugins.productIntro: 通过新浪微博查找突尼斯各地的医生和药房。按专业、姓名或地点搜索医生，并查找附近的药房，包括营业或值班的药房。新浪互联提供当地医疗保健指导，不提供医疗诊断。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find doctors and pharmacies across Tunisia with Sina Connect. Search for doctors by specialty, name, or location, and find nearby pharmacies, including pharmacies that are open or on duty. Sina Connect provides local healthcare orientation and does not provide medical diagnosis.

plugins.name: DrugBank
plugins.productIntro: DrugBank 将值得信赖的生物制药情报直接引入 ChatGPT，为您提供一种快速、数据驱动的方式来评估药物机会并回答复杂的研究问题。评估资产和目标，探索药物-目标-疾病关系，跟踪试验和管道，并监控竞争对手的活动，而无需手动收集数据。借助 DrugBank 的可追踪、持续更新的深度互联且经过专家验证的数据知识库，将复杂的数据转化为可供决策的见解。
plugins.productIntroEn: DrugBank brings trusted biopharma intelligence directly into ChatGPT, giving you a fast, data-driven way to evaluate drug opportunities and answer complex research questions. Evaluate assets and targets, explore drug–target–disease relationships, track trials and pipelines, and monitor competitor activity without manual data gathering.

plugins.name: Alma: Nutrition Coach
plugins.description: 找出你的饮食遗漏了什么
plugins.productIntro: Alma 将您的营养背景带入 ChatGPT。连接您的Alma账户，询问记录的膳食、营养缺口、Alma分数趋势、目标、健康指标、锻炼、体重变化、食品储藏室和杂货清单。从您的实际饮食史中获取个性化指导，更快地发现模式，并做出更好的营养决策，而无需每次都重新解释您的饮食。当您明确确认详细信息时，Alma还可以将膳食添加到您的日志中。 Alma 支持一般健康和营养跟踪，而不是医疗建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Alma brings your nutrition context into ChatGPT. Connect your Alma account to ask about logged meals, nutrient gaps, Alma Score trends, goals, health metrics, workouts, weight changes, pantry, and grocery list. Get personalized guidance from your actual food history, spot patterns faster, and make better nutrition decisions without re-explaining your diet every time.

plugins.name: Turkey Dental Treatment Prices
plugins.productIntro: 计划在土耳其进行牙科治疗？获取优质牙科种植体（Nobel Biocare、Straumann）、Ivoclar E.max 贴面和牙冠、氧化锆牙冠、Hollywood smile 和 All-on-4/6/8 全口种植体套餐的指示性价格，以及诊所的书面保证、主治医生的资格、就诊后勤和术后护理以及患者审查摘要。该信息来自 Taki Dent (takident.
plugins.productIntroEn: Planning dental treatment in Turkey? plugins.name: Eixo Run

plugins.productIntroEn: instingo hilft Unternehmen, Schritte-Challenges für ihr Team zu finden und zu starten. plugins.productIntroEn: PaceKeeper helps athletes review their profile and sport settings, inspect planned and completed training, understand wellness and recovery trends, and analyze compressed activity streams from their connected intervals.icu account.

plugins.name: BurnWeek

plugins.productIntroEn: BurnWeek is an AI calorie tracker that meets you where you already are. Because food is never exact, BurnWeek shows honest ranges (e.g. "680-780 cal") instead of fake-precise numbers.

plugins.name: GymLog

plugins.name: Travel 101: Trip Itineraries
plugins.productIntro: 旅行101将您的偏好转化为完整的行程，帮助您计划旅行。获取包含航班、住宿、活动、预算、地图等的每日计划。在 Scratchpad 中保存和编辑您的行程，并与旅行伙伴分享。没有表格或严格的模板，只需描述您的氛围并获得现成的计划。

Save and edit your itinerary in Scratchpad, and share it with travel buddies. No forms or rigid templates, just describe your vibe and get a ready-to-use plan.

plugins.name: MakeMyTrip
plugins.description: 查找航班、酒店和出租车

plugins.productIntroEn: Discover flights, hotels and cabs with real time inventory and pricing right inside your conversation.

plugins.name: Wikiloc
plugins.productIntro: 描述您想去的地方和想做的事情，然后跳过搜索。从 Wikiloc 的 7700 万条真实路线中获取量身定制的路线，这些路线由全球 2000 万户外爱好者共享。
plugins.productIntroEn: Describe where you want to go and what you want to do, and skip the search. Get a tailored selection of trails from Wikiloc's 77 million authentic trails, shared by 20 million outdoor enthusiasts worldwide.

plugins.name: Gondola
plugins.productIntro: Gondola 帮助用户搜索酒店、航班和租车，比较价格和忠诚度价值，查看行程详细信息，管理价格提醒，并通过 ChatGPT 完成受支持的酒店或租车预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Gondola helps users search hotels, flights, and rental cars, compare rates and loyalty value, review trip details, manage rate alerts, and complete supported hotel or rental car bookings through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: eDreams
plugins.productIntro: 跳过比较数十个选项卡的麻烦。 eDreams 可帮助您在一个地方通过简单的对话搜索和比较航班和酒店。 只需告诉它您想要旅行的地点和时间，它就会快速显示最便宜和最好的选择，以便您可以更快地做出决定。
plugins.productIntroEn: Skip the hassle of comparing dozens of tabs. eDreams helps you search and compare flights and hotels in one place, but through a simple conversation. Just tell it where and when you want to travel, and it quickly shows the cheapest and best options so you can decide faster.

plugins.name: Wego
plugins.productIntro: Wego 帮助您找到ChatGPT 内的最优惠航班和酒店价格。我们搜索 700 多个旅游网站，以提供准确、极具竞争力的价格，然后以美观、干净、易于理解的界面显示它们。
plugins.productIntroEn: Wego helps you find the best prices for flights and hotels inside ChatGPT. We search across 700+ travel websites to surface accurate, highly competitive rates—then show them in a beautiful, clean, easy-to-understand interface.

plugins.name: Kiwi.com
plugins.productIntro: 搜索可根据日期、附近机场、行李和经停地灵活选择的航班。 通过虚拟联运（结合通常不转机的不同航空公司的航班）发现更便宜的航线。 通过“随处”搜索探索目的地或在交互式地图上浏览多个选项。 获取完整的行程以及定价、时间表和预订链接 - 一切都在聊天中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search for flights with flexible options around dates, nearby airports, baggage, and stops. Discover cheaper routes through virtual interlining (combining flights from different airlines that don't normally connect). Explore destinations with "anywhere" searches or browse multiple options on an interactive map.

plugins.name: Ryanair
plugins.productIntro: 通过对话界面更快地查找和预订瑞安航空航班。只需告诉助理您想去的地点和时间，它就会搜索可用的航线，向您显示航班选项和价格，并引导您直接访问 Ryanair 网站以完成预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find and book Ryanair flights faster with a conversational interface. Simply tell the assistant where you want to go and when — it will search available routes, show you flight options with prices, and guide you directly to the Ryanair website to complete your booking.

plugins.name: Bolt
plugins.productIntro: Bolt Rides 可帮助乘客比较当前或预定的行程预估，并打开 Bolt 完成预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bolt Rides helps riders compare current or scheduled ride estimates, and open Bolt to complete their booking.

plugins.name: GuruWalk: Tours & Activities
plugins.description: 查找并预订旅游和门票
plugins.productIntro: 通过世界上最大的免费徒步旅游平台 GuruWalk 探索任何城市。在免费旅游中，您无需支付任何预付费用，并根据您认为最终体验的价值向导游支付费用。 GuruWalk 还提供 1,000 多个城市的导游参观、一日游和免排队门票，从马德里、罗马到东京、布宜诺斯艾利斯和纽约。
plugins.productIntroEn: Explore any city with GuruWalk, the world's largest free walking tour platform. On a free tour you join at no upfront cost and pay the guide whatever you think the experience was worth at the end. GuruWalk also offers guided visits, day trips and skip-the-line tickets in more than 1,000 cities, from Madrid and Rome to Tokyo, Buenos Aires and New York.

plugins.name: Klook
plugins.description: 查找旅行目的地的活动与体验。
plugins.productIntro: 无论您身在何处，Klook客路都可以帮助您发现和预订要做的事情。描述您要寻找的内容 - 您的目的地、日期和兴趣 - 并获取包含价格、评论和照片等重要详细信息的相关选项列表。
plugins.productIntroEn: Klook helps you discover and book things to do wherever you are. Describe what you're looking for — your destination, dates, and interests — and get a list of relevant options with important details like price, reviews, and photos.

plugins.name: Tripadvisor
plugins.productIntro: Tripadvisor 应用程序将值得信赖的评论和酒店见解引入 ChatGPT，提供更快、更自信的方式来找到完美的住宿地点。旅行者可以通过交互式地图优先视图探索顶级酒店，立即了解街区、距离和氛围。他们可以通过对话式跟进自然地完善结果，访问丰富的酒店详细信息，包括旅行者照片、最近的评论、设施、比较价格，并无缝点击预订合作伙伴或 Tripadvisor 进行更深入的研究。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Tripadvisor app brings trusted reviews and hotel insights into ChatGPT, offering a faster, more confident way to find the perfect place to stay. Travelers can explore top-rated hotels on an interactive, map-first view to instantly understand neighborhoods, distance, and vibe.

plugins.name: GetYourGuide
plugins.productIntro: 通过 GetYourGuide 探索难忘的旅行体验。探索全球超过 75,000 个旅游、活动和景点——尽在一款应用程序中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover unforgettable travel experiences with GetYourGuide. Discover over 75,000 tours, activities, and attractions worldwide—all in one app.

plugins.name: AI Trip Planner

plugins.productIntroEn: Turn your chat ideas, travel plans, PDFs and TikTok videos into interactive maps with pins, photos, and directions. Use it for trips, city guides, food crawls, campus tours, and more.

plugins.name: TRIP PLANNER Travel Itinerary

plugins.productIntroEn: Turn your trip planning request into a day-by-day itinerary, shown at a glance in the neatly organized Travel Vibes Scratchpad widget while the planning continues in the chat.

plugins.name: World Airfares
plugins.productIntro: 世界机票航班搜索将实时航班搜索直接带入您的 ChatGPT 对话中。只需告诉 ChatGPT 您想要飞行的地点和时间，即可从实时航班库存中获得即时结果 - 无需切换应用程序，无需切换选项卡。
plugins.productIntroEn: World Airfares Flight Search brings real-time flight search directly into your ChatGPT conversation. Simply tell ChatGPT where and when you want to fly, and get instant results from a live flight inventory - no app switching, no tab juggling.

plugins.name: Trainline
plugins.productIntro: 制定旅行计划？连接 Trainline 查看英国和欧洲的火车。 尝试询问“Trainline，本周六从伦敦到曼彻斯特的早班火车票价是多少？”
plugins.productIntroEn: Making travel plans? Connect Trainline to check trains across the UK and Europe. Try asking "Trainline, how much are morning trains from London to Manchester this Saturday?"

plugins.name: Sigtrip
plugins.description: 直接在聊天中预订酒店
plugins.productIntro: 只需自然地描述您的旅行 - 您要去哪里、旅行时间以及最重要的事情，从位置和预算到设施和房间类型 - Sigtrip 将在一次对话中显示个性化的酒店选择，包括实时价格、真实供应情况、照片、政策和基本住宿详细信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Simply describe your trip naturally—where you're going, when you're traveling, and what matters most, from location and budget to amenities and room type—and Sigtrip will surface personalized hotel options with live rates, real availability, photos, policies, and essential stay details in one conversation.

plugins.name: TheHotelsNetwork
plugins.productIntro: 探索您在 ChatGPT 的理想酒店，并以最优惠的直接价格预订。

plugins.productIntroEn: Find the right stay for every journey with Archipelago Hotels. Search hotels, compare options, and check real-time availability directly within ChatGPT.

plugins.name: AbhiBus

plugins.name: ALL Accor
plugins.productIntro: 在 110 多个国家/地区的 5,700 多家雅高酒店和公寓中探索、比较并预订最适合您住宿的客房，从智能经济型酒店到超凡豪华酒店应有尽有。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover, compare, and book the perfect room for your stay among 5,700+ Accor hotels and residences in 110+ countries from smart economy to exceptional luxury.

plugins.name: Vio.com

plugins.name: Rome2Rio
plugins.description: 了解如何到达任何地方
plugins.productIntro: Rome2Rio 帮助您了解如何前往世界任何地方。 询问任何行程（从当地路线到全球旅程），并立即了解如何乘坐火车、巴士、渡轮、汽车、航班甚至每种方式的组合到达目的地，所有这些都在一个地方。该地图可让您轻松查看和比较您的旅行选择。 您将获得清晰的门到门路线选择，包括行程时间、转机路线和预估价格。如果可用，Rome2Rio 还会显示时间表和门票详细信息，以便您可以放心地计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rome2Rio helps you figure out how to get anywhere in the world. Ask for any trip—from local routes to global journeys—and instantly see ways to get there by train, bus, ferry, car, flight, and even combinations of each, all in one place. The map makes it easy to view and compare your travel options.

plugins.name: Hilton Hotel Search
plugins.productIntro: 希尔顿酒店搜索可帮助用户按位置查找希尔顿酒店、比较住宿价格并在继续希尔顿预订流程之前检查酒店详细信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Hilton Hotel Search helps users find Hilton properties by location, compare stay pricing, and inspect hotel details before continuing to Hilton booking flows.

plugins.name: IHG Hotels & Resorts
plugins.description: 搜索全球 7,000 多家酒店
plugins.productIntro: 洲际酒店集团酒店及度假村在 100 多个国家/地区拥有 7,000 多家酒店，为各类旅客提供真正的热情款待。从难忘的豪华住宿到可靠的舒适体验，无论您的旅程前往何处，洲际酒店集团都能帮助您找到合适的酒店。
plugins.productIntroEn: With 7,000+ hotels across 100+ countries, IHG Hotels & Resorts delivers true hospitality for every kind of traveler. From memorable luxury stays to dependable comfort, IHG helps you find the right hotel, wherever your journey takes you.

plugins.name: TourRadar
plugins.productIntro: TourRadar 提供全球最多的多日组团旅游、内河巡游、游猎和探险活动，将旅行者与超过 2,500 家多日游运营商联系起来，在 160 多个国家/地区提供 50,000 多个旅游和探险活动。我们为无缝、用户友好的体验感到自豪。
plugins.productIntroEn: TourRadar offers the world’s largest selection of multi-day organized tours, river cruises, safari's and adventures worldwide connecting travelers with over 2,500 multi-day tour operators, offering 50,000+ tours and adventures in 160+ countries. We pride ourselves on a seamless, user-friendly experience.

plugins.name: TUI
plugins.productIntro: 使用 TUI ChatGPT 应用程序探索您的理想假期。只需告诉我们您在寻找什么，我们就会立即为您匹配最好的酒店和体验。按地点、评分、日期和持续时间搜索，找到最适合您的假期。不用大惊小怪。没有无休止的滚动。只是更明智的假期计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover your ideal holiday with the TUI ChatGPT app. Simply tell us what you're looking for, and we'll instantly match you with the best hotels and experiences. Search by location, ratings, dates, and duration to find holidays that suit you to a tee. No fuss. No endless scrolling. Just smarter holiday planning.

plugins.name: redBus

plugins.productIntroEn: Find buses between two cities on redBus and quickly narrow down options with filters for amenities (AC, sleeper, onboard washroom), price, departure time, and bus operator.

plugins.name: EaseMyTrip

plugins.productIntroEn: EaseMyTrip helps users search available flights and hotels from ChatGPT. Users can compare flight options by route, dates, cabin, stops, fare type, airline, and time windows; search hotel stays by destination, dates, guests, ratings, amenities, and price.

plugins.name: Reagent Travel
plugins.productIntro: Reagent Travel 将航班搜索转变为引导式对话，帮助您快速找到正确的选项，而无需挖掘无穷无尽的结果列表。
plugins.productIntroEn: Reagent Travel turns flight search into a guided conversation, helping you quickly find the right option without digging through endless lists of results.

plugins.name: Priceline

plugins.productIntroEn: Planning a trip? Add Priceline to search for hotels right in your conversation. Tell ChatGPT where you're going, when, and what matters — close to downtown, near the beach, budget-friendly — and get results on an interactive map with live Priceline deals. Easily compare options, then book on Priceline or continue your conversation with Penny, Priceline's AI travel agent.

plugins.name: Travel Advisory
plugins.productIntro: 随时了解情况。旅行更聪明。保持安全。
plugins.productIntroEn: Stay informed. Travel smarter. Stay safe.

plugins.name: Traveloka

plugins.productIntroEn: Search for flights on Traveloka directly in ChatGPT. Tell it where and when you want to fly — round-trip or one-way, for one traveler or many — and get available routes, schedules, and prices, covering Southeast Asia and destinations worldwide. Sort and filter the results to quickly find the flight that fits you best.

plugins.name: Pegasus Airlines

plugins.name: ixigo

plugins.name: SIXT

plugins.name: TravExp

plugins.name: Lambus

plugins.productIntro: Wanderz 根据顶级旅行博主和旅游专业人士的经验，帮助您轻松计划和预订真实的旅行。 Wanderz 为您提供来自当地专家的独家优惠：协商价格、当地建议和专业知识以及整个旅行期间的全面帮助
plugins.productIntroEn: Wanderz helps you easily plan and book authentic trips based on experiences from top travel bloggers and tourism professionals. Wanderz provides you with exclusive deals from local experts : negociated prices, local advice and expertise, and full assistance during the whole trip

plugins.name: Road Trip Planner
plugins.productIntro: 公路旅行规划器可帮助您找到适合您旅行方式的露营地。询问国家公园附近的房车公园、允许携带宠物的帐篷营地、带空调的小屋，或者配有淋浴、游乐场、无线网络和狗公园的适合家庭的露营地。
plugins.productIntroEn: Road Trip Planner helps you find campgrounds that fit the way you travel. Ask for RV parks near a national park, pet-friendly tent sites, cabins with air conditioning, or family-friendly campgrounds with showers, playgrounds, WiFi, and dog parks.

plugins.name: Direct Book AI
plugins.productIntro: 搜索酒店，查看实时供应情况， 并获得最便宜的直接价格 直接来自酒店自己的预订引擎， 加上酒店正在运行的任何促销代码。 没有 OTA、没有中间商、没有佣金加价。 您可以看到实际价格并直接预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search hotels, check live availability, and get the cheapest direct rate straight from the hotel's own booking engine, plus any promo codes the hotel is running. No OTAs, no middlemen, no commission markup. You see the real price and book direct.

plugins.name: FunNow
plugins.productIntro: 通过 FunNow 发现您的下一顿美餐。无论您是计划举办特别活动还是立即需要餐桌，FunNow 都可以让您轻松查找和预订亚洲顶级美食目的地中满足您特定需求的餐厅。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover your next great meal with FunNow. Whether you are planning a special event or need a table right now, FunNow makes it easy to find and book restaurants tailored to your specific needs across Asia's top culinary destinations.

plugins.name: Milepoint
plugins.productIntro: Milepoint 是常旅客的答案引擎。询问有关积分、里程、精英身份、升级、信用卡、忠诚度计划或空中航行生活的任何信息。我们将为您提供清晰、值得信赖的答案——没有废话，没有混乱。将我们视为每个公路战士都希望拥有的僚机：快速、可靠，并适应真正的常旅客世界。
plugins.productIntroEn: milepoint is the answer engine for frequent flyers. Ask anything about points, miles, elite status, upgrades, credit cards, loyalty programs, or navigating life in the air. We'll give you clear, trustworthy answers--no fluff, no confusion. Think of us as the wingman every road warrior wishes they had: fast, reliable, and tuned in to the real frequent-flyer world.

plugins.name: Nowistay
plugins.productIntro: Nowistay 帮助度假租赁房东管理 ChatGPT 中的日常运营。检查符合条件的 Nowistay 住宿的预订、空房情况、价格、宾客记录和消息、任务、欢迎指南和私人财产知识，然后无需切换工具即可进行批准的更新。
plugins.productIntroEn: Nowistay helps vacation rental hosts manage daily operations in ChatGPT. Check bookings, availability, prices, guest records and messages, tasks, welcome guides, and private property knowledge for eligible Nowistay properties, then make approved updates without switching tools.

plugins.name: Simbye
plugins.description: 查找旅行 eSIM 计划
plugins.productIntro: 获得针对任何目的地的个性化 eSIM 推荐 - 正确 在 ChatGPT 内。
plugins.productIntroEn: Get personalized eSIM recommendations for any destination — right inside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: BeachFinder
plugins.productIntro: BeachFinder 可帮助您查找和比较全球 184,900 个游泳地点 - 海滩、湖泊和沐浴场所。按城市搜索，并对游泳、家庭、温水、低风、冲浪、浮潜、白水或货车生活的地点进行排名，然后提取当前天气、水温、风力、紫外线和波浪规划信号以获得最佳结果。它还提供本地化指南、来源支持的活动提供商和匿名社区报告汇总。每个结果都链接到 getbeachfinder.com。
plugins.productIntroEn: BeachFinder helps you find and compare 184,900 swimming spots worldwide — beaches, lakes and bathing places. Search by city and rank spots for swimming, family, warm water, low wind, surf, snorkeling, whitewater or vanlife, then pull current weather, water temperature, wind, UV and wave planning signals for the top results.

plugins.name: TrailVerse
plugins.productIntro: TrailVerse 将国家公园探索带入 ChatGPT。
plugins.productIntroEn: TrailVerse brings national parks exploration into ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Akasa Air
plugins.description: 查找航班详细信息和状态
plugins.productIntro: 轻松计划您乘坐 Akasa Air 的旅行并随时了解最新动态。 - 搜索和探索阿卡萨航空国内和国际航线的航班 - 查看实时航班状态和更新 - 获取网上办理登机手续的分步指南
plugins.productIntroEn: Plan and stay updated on your travel on Akasa Air with ease. - Search and explore Akasa Air flights across domestic and international routes - Check real-time flight status and updates - Get step-by-step guidance for web check-in

plugins.name: OutReserve
plugins.description: 查找露营地和房车公园
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中与 OutReserve 查找并比较露营地和房车公园。按目的地搜索、浏览附近的选项、按网站类型过滤并添加旅行日期以检查可用性背景和价格。每个结果都包含有用的详细信息，例如位置、评论、季节性状态、便利设施、照片、地图以及在 OutReserve 上查看或预订的直接链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find and compare campgrounds and RV parks directly in ChatGPT with OutReserve. Search by destination, browse nearby options, filter by site type, and add travel dates to check availability context and rates. Each result includes helpful details like location, reviews, seasonal status, amenities, photos, maps, and direct links to view or book on OutReserve.

plugins.name: Otto Travel
plugins.productIntro: Otto 将商务旅行预订引入 GPT。搜索航班和酒店，比较选项，然后预订您的选择。您的偏好会过滤搜索结果（舱位、座位、酒店品牌、航空公司），并且您的忠诚度号码会附加到预订中。当计划改变时，更换或取消航班或酒店。它根据请求检索行程详细信息：航班时间、酒店地址、确认号码。
plugins.productIntroEn: Otto brings business travel bookings into GPT. Search flights and hotels, compare options, then book your choice. Your preferences filter search results (cabin class, seat, hotel brand, airline), and your loyalty numbers attach to reservations. When plans change, exchange or cancel a flight or hotel.

plugins.name: Extra Holidays
plugins.productIntro: Extra Holidays 帮助旅行者通过 ChatGPT 搜索可用的酒店和度假村物业、比较实时 Amadeus iHotelier 房价、查看客房类型、房价计划、套餐、政策、联系信息和物业详细信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Extra Holidays helps travelers search available hotel and resort properties, compare live Amadeus iHotelier room rates, review room types, rate plans, packages, policies, contact information, and property details through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: VisitorsCoverage
plugins.productIntro: 寻找适合您需求的旅行保险。该应用程序可帮助您了解承保选项、比较计划、获取报价以及根据您的预算和偏好查看个性化匹配。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find travel insurance that fits your needs. This app helps you understand coverage options, compare plans, get quotes and view personalized matches based on your budget and preferences.

plugins.name: WeatherPromise
plugins.productIntro: 使用 WeatherPromise 保护您的旅行，如果假期期间降雨量超过承诺的量，则自动收回全额费用。 告诉我们您的目的地、旅行日期和旅行费用，我们将向您展示针对您的旅行个性化的优惠。一旦您购买了该优惠，您的旅行将受到保护。 您将获得指向个人仪表板的链接，您可以在其中监控旅行期间的天气。降雨量是使用来自 NASA 和 NOAA 等官方来源的独立、准确的数据来测量的。 如果降雨量超过指定阈值，我们会自动向您发送电子邮件。
plugins.productIntroEn: Protect your trip with WeatherPromise and get back the full cost if it rains more than promised during your vacation, automatically. Tell us your destination, travel dates and trip cost and we'll show you an offer, personalized to your trip. Once you purchase the offer, your trip is protected.

plugins.name: Oojo
plugins.productIntro: Oojo 帮助用户搜索和比较实时航班选项，检查价格、时刻表、经停点和航空公司，并打开 Oojo 链接以在 ChatGPT 之外完成预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Oojo helps users search and compare live flight options, inspect prices, schedules, stops, and carriers, and open Oojo links to complete booking outside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: WeRoad
plugins.productIntro: 在领队的带领下，与同龄人一起探索 WeRoad 的小团体（8-15 名旅行者）冒险之旅。专为想要与志同道合的人一起探索世界的独行旅行者而设计。按目的地、日期和旅行心情搜索行程，查看完整的每日计划，并找到横跨欧洲、亚洲、非洲、美洲、大洋洲和中东的合适团体旅行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover WeRoad's adventures for small-group (8-15 travelers), with people your age, led by a group leader. Designed for solo travelers who want to explore the world with like-minded people. Search itineraries by destination, dates, and travel mood, see full day-by-day plans, and find the right group trip across Europe, Asia, Africa, the Americas, Oceania, and the Middle East.

plugins.name: Fattal
plugins.productIntro: 查找并比较法塔尔、莱昂纳多和 NYX 酒店的住宿。按目的地、日期、客人、设施、董事会类型和预算搜索；查看可用酒店、客房选项、价格、取消详情、照片、设施、评论和预订链接。您还可以询问具体酒店、入住日期、Fattal And Friends Club 优惠、政策和目的地提示。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find and compare stays at Fattal, Leonardo and NYX hotels. Search by destination, dates, guests, amenities, board type, and budget; view available hotels, room options, prices, cancellation details, photos, facilities, reviews, and booking links. You can also ask about specific hotels, check-in dates, Fattal And Friends Club benefits, policies, and destination tips.

plugins.name: Nomadic
plugins.productIntro: Nomadic 帮助旅行者通过交互式滑动提要发现地点。询问城市或社区中的地点，滑动浏览个性化推荐，保存您喜欢的地点，然后在 Google 地图中打开每个选择。
plugins.productIntroEn: Nomadic helps travelers discover places through an interactive swipe feed. Ask for places in a city or neighborhood, swipe through personalized recommendations, save spots you like, and open each pick in Google Maps.

plugins.name: Barceló Hotel Group
plugins.description: 寻找并探索巴塞罗酒店
plugins.productIntro: 搜索并预订巴塞罗酒店集团旗下 160 多家酒店，遍布西班牙、加勒比地区、墨西哥等地。检查实时客房供应情况和价格，获取包括设施和政策在内的详细酒店信息，并生成直接预订链接——所有这些都通过自然对话进行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search and book 160+ hotels from Barceló Hotel Group across Spain, the Caribbean, Mexico, and more. Check real-time room availability and pricing, get detailed hotel information including amenities and policies, and generate direct booking links — all through natural conversation.

plugins.name: Jumpseat
plugins.productIntro: Jumpseat 帮助用户搜索航班、将航班添加到个人资料、更新个人航班详细信息、查看即将到来的旅行、查看朋友的旅行计划以及通过 ChatGPT 访问实时航班状态资源。
plugins.productIntroEn: Jumpseat helps users search for flights, add flights to their profile, update personal flight details, review upcoming trips, see friends' travel plans, and access live flight status resources through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: EVT Hotels & Resorts
plugins.productIntro: 探索 EVT 酒店及度假村、比较房间并获得澳大利亚、新西兰和新加坡的 Rydges、QT、Atura、LyLo、Ode 和 Independent Collection 酒店的实用住宿规划帮助。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover EVT Hotels & Resorts, compare rooms and get practical stay-planning help across Rydges, QT, Atura, LyLo, Ode, and Independent Collection hotels across Australia, New Zealand and Singapore.

plugins.name: SparkSpot
plugins.productIntro: SparkSpot — 停车方便，提前预订
plugins.productIntroEn: SparkSpot — Easy Parking, Reserved Ahead

plugins.name: Goshuin Atlas
plugins.productIntro: 搜索经过验证的日本寺庙、神社和御朱印设计的公共记录。比较附近的圣地，建立尊重的参观候选名单，并将稳定的目录事实与参观前应重新检查的细节明确分开。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search verified public records for Japanese temples, shrines, and goshuin designs. Compare nearby sacred places, build respectful visit shortlists, and clearly separate stable catalogue facts from details that should be rechecked before visiting.

plugins.name: LDN Travel
plugins.productIntro: LDN Travel 让游览伦敦变得简单、无压力。快速查看地铁、地上铁、伊丽莎白线、DLR 和有轨电车的当前状态，查看任何车站即将发车的班次，并轻松计划两个车站之间的行程。该应用程序由伦敦交通局开放数据提供支持，提供准确的官方信息，让您可以自信地游览伦敦。非常适合通勤者、游客或任何探索城市的人 - 一切都在一款直观、易于使用的应用程序中。
plugins.productIntroEn: LDN Travel makes getting around London simple and stress-free. Quickly view the current status of the Tube, Overground, Elizabeth Line, DLR, and Tram, see upcoming departures from any station and plan journeys between two stations with ease. Powered by TfL Open Data, the app provides accurate, official information so you can navigate London confidently.

plugins.name: TripO by FreeTravel
plugins.description: 预订全球酒店并享受优惠
plugins.productIntro: TripO 可让您在 ChatGPT 内预订全球酒店 - 与大多数预订网站不同，您无需为此付出任何代价。 预订时添加您的忠诚会员资格，您就可以保留您所赚取的一切：积分、精英身份认可、会员福利 - 所有这些都将享受到，就像您直接通过 IHG、万豪、希尔顿和其他主要连锁酒店预订一样。 在精选的豪华和商务酒店，TripO 更进一步。我们的优惠房价附带额外福利，例如免费早餐、客房升级（如有）、酒店积分以及提前入住或延迟退房——这些福利通常为高端旅行顾问保留。
plugins.productIntroEn: TripO lets you book hotels worldwide right inside ChatGPT — and unlike most booking sites, you don't give anything up to do it. Add your loyalty membership when you book, and you keep what you've earned: points, elite status recognition, member benefits — all honored just as if you booked direct with IHG, Marriott, Hilton, and other major chains.

plugins.name: Yatra
plugins.productIntro: 用户可以通过使用自然语言搜索航班和酒店来轻松计划旅行。该应用程序以一种无缝的对话体验提供航班时刻表、票价、酒店选择和旅行信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Users can easily plan their travel by searching for flights and hotels using natural language. The app provides access to flight schedules, fares, hotel options, and travel information in one seamless conversational experience.

plugins.name: Motel 6
plugins.description: 查找汽车旅馆 6 住宿
plugins.productIntro: Motel 6 帮助用户搜索实时酒店供应情况、比较酒店价格和设施、检查所选酒店的详细信息、打开预订链接并估计酒店与另一个地点之间的旅行时间。
plugins.productIntroEn: Motel 6 helps users search live hotel availability, compare property prices and amenities, inspect selected property details, open booking links and estimate travel time between a hotel and another location.

plugins.name: BE-A
plugins.productIntro: BE-A 可以搜索您目标地区的酒店，了解实时空房情况和价格。您可以直接向酒店预订，享受忠诚度折扣、注册会员折扣等等。
plugins.productIntroEn: BE-A enables to search for available hotels in your target area for real-time availability and prices. And you book directly with the hotel where you can leverage loyalty rates, discount for registered members and much more.

plugins.name: SecretBox
plugins.productIntro: SecretBox 帮助用户发现法国和欧洲独特的餐饮、酒店和水疗体验。 询问特定目的地的餐厅体验、浪漫酒店住宿或健康时刻。 SecretBox 提供精心策划的体验建议，并让用户在 SecretBox 官方网站上探索它们。
plugins.productIntroEn: SecretBox helps users discover unique dining, hotel and spa experiences across France and Europe. Ask for restaurant experiences, romantic hotel stays or wellness moments in a specific destination. SecretBox provides curated experience suggestions and lets users explore them on the official SecretBox website.

plugins.name: Amapas Vacation Rental
plugins.productIntro: Amapas Vacation Rental 可帮助您探索并预订位于巴亚尔塔港浪漫区 (Zona Romántica) 的两卧室海景公寓，距离 Los Muertos 海滩仅一个街区。
plugins.productIntroEn: Amapas Vacation Rental helps you explore and reserve a 2-bedroom ocean-view condo in Puerto Vallarta's Zona Romántica, one block from Los Muertos Beach.

plugins.name: Charge Atlas
plugins.description: 在全球范围内查找电动汽车充电器
plugins.productIntro: Charge Atlas 可帮助您从 ChatGPT 内部查找全球电动汽车充电站。按地点、坐标、地图视口或路线搜索，然后按充电器速度、连接器类型、车辆兼容性和充电网络进行过滤。结果在交互式地图中打开，包括来自 NREL 和 Open Charge Map 的源覆盖范围上下文。
plugins.productIntroEn: Charge Atlas helps you find EV charging stations worldwide from inside ChatGPT. Search by place, coordinate, map viewport, or route, then filter by charger speed, connector type, vehicle compatibility, and charging network. Results open in an interactive map and include source coverage context from NREL and Open Charge Map.

plugins.name: SoloWay — Bus Tickets
plugins.productIntro: 搜索横跨乌克兰和欧洲的实时城际巴士行程。获取实时价格、可用座位、航空公司、转乘详情和乘客折扣（儿童、学生、老年人），并找到一个月内最便宜的旅行日期。 如果不存在直达路线，该应用程序会建议经过附近较大城市的经过验证的替代路线（包含距离和价格）。 预订已在soloway.com.ua 上完成。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search live intercity bus trips across Ukraine and Europe. Get real-time prices, available seats, carriers, transfer details, and passenger discounts (children, students, seniors), and find the cheapest day to travel in a month. If no direct route exists, the app suggests verified alternatives via bigger cities nearby (with distances and prices). Booking is completed on soloway.com.ua.

plugins.name: TIRAVA - Taxi in Albania
plugins.description: 在 ChatGPT 中预订出租车
plugins.productIntro: 查找阿尔巴尼亚私人接送和出租车的固定票价和预计旅行时间。只需提交乘车请求即可。没有网上支付。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find fixed fares and estimated travel times for private transfers & Taxis in Albania. Simply submit a ride request. No online payment.

plugins.name: Eurostars Hotel Company
plugins.productIntro: 在几分钟内计划您的下一次旅行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Plan your next trip in minutes.

plugins.name: Hotel Emperador Madrid
plugins.productIntro: 马德里皇帝酒店助理可帮助客人通过聊天查找酒店信息并完成常见的预订任务。 用户可以询问有关马德里皇帝酒店的问题，包括客房、设施、酒店服务、政策和入住/退房时间。助理还可以检查房间可用性并列出可选的房间附加服务。 如果客人已经预订，助理可以检索预订详细信息，并在提供所需的预订信息后帮助修改或取消现有预订。 如果客人需要帮助，助理还可以帮助创建新的预订并向酒店发送支持请求。
plugins.productIntroEn: Hotel Emperador Madrid Assistant helps guests find hotel information and complete common reservation tasks through chat. Users can ask questions about Hotel Emperador Madrid, including rooms, amenities, hotel services, policies, and check-in/check-out times. The assistant can also check room availability and list optional room extras.

plugins.name: Airport Pickups London
plugins.description: 预订伦敦机场接送服务
plugins.productIntro: 预订往返所有伦敦机场（希思罗机场、盖特威克机场、斯坦斯特德机场、卢顿机场和伦敦市机场）的私家车接送服务。获取轿车、客运车辆、8 座车辆和行政车辆的即时固定价格。所有价格均包含航站楼迎接、航班跟踪和免费取消。您的司机拿着名牌在到达处等候。没有隐藏费用，没有峰时定价——您看到的价格就是您支付的价格。 24/7 全天候提供机场接送、游轮港口接送和任何英国旅程
plugins.productIntroEn: Book private car transfers to and from all London airports — Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted, Luton, and London City. Get instant fixed prices for Saloon, People Carrier, 8-Seater, and Executive vehicles. All prices include meet and greet at the terminal, flight tracking, and free cancellation. Your driver waits at arrivals holding a name board.

plugins.name: EF Ultimate Break
plugins.description: 查找 18-35 岁的团体旅行
plugins.productIntro: 探索适合 18 至 35 岁任何人的团体旅行，探索世界。 告诉 ChatGPT 您想去哪里，并找到最适合您的出发地点。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover group travel for anyone 18–35 to explore the world. Tell ChatGPT where you want to go and find the best departure for you.

plugins.name: Valpas Hotels
plugins.productIntro: 搜索配备 Valpas 专利臭虫预防技术的酒店。 我们搜索结果中的每家酒店均经过瓦尔帕斯认证，因此您可以放心旅行，因为您知道您的住宿优先考虑卫生、清洁和客人安全。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search for hotels equipped with Valpas patented bed bug prevention technology. Every hotel in our results is Valpas-certified, so you can travel with confidence knowing your accommodation prioritises hygiene, cleanliness, and guest safety.

plugins.name: Campiri
plugins.productIntro: Campiri 可帮助您在 ChatGPT 中找到适合您旅行的房车。只需输入日期、地点、旅客人数和您的偏好，应用程序就会让您更轻松地浏览可用选项。这样，您可以快速了解哪种车辆适合您的假期、周末度假或长途公路旅行。
plugins.productIntroEn: Campiri helps you find the right motorhome for your trip in ChatGPT. Just enter the dates, location, number of travelers, and your preferences, and the app will make it easier to navigate the available options. This way, you can quickly see which vehicle makes sense for your vacation, weekend getaway, or longer road trip.

plugins.name: ToursByLocals
plugins.productIntro: ToursByLocals 是一个与全球众多目的地的当地导游联系的绝佳平台。用户可以按城市或国家搜索私人导游，并根据团体规模或家庭友好度等标准进一步细化搜索。通过查看导游资料，用户可以找到最适合他们旅行的人。一旦找到合适的导游，就可以验证用户旅行日期的可用性，并可以直接通过他们的个人资料进行预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: ToursByLocals is an excellent platform for connecting with local guides in numerous destinations worldwide. Users can search for private, guided tours by city or country and further refine their search by criteria such as group size or family-friendliness. By reviewing guide profiles, users can identify the ideal match for their trip.

plugins.name: Life Happens Outdoors
plugins.description: 查找带导游的冒险之旅
plugins.productIntro: 使用 ChatGPT 与 Life Happens Outdoors 一起计划一次真正的旅行。我们在乞力马扎罗山、珠穆朗玛峰大本营、安纳普尔纳峰、多洛米蒂山等地开展优质小团体探险活动，每次出发时都会提供机场到机场的支持和 LHO 团队负责人。要求应用程序查找适合您心目中的日期和难度的行程，调出完整的行程，其中包含内容以及在海拔高度的预期，检查哪些出发班次仍然可用，然后直接向我们的团队提交咨询请求。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use ChatGPT to plan a real trip with Life Happens Outdoors. We run premium small group expeditions, Kilimanjaro, Everest Base Camp, Annapurna, the Dolomites, and more, with airport-to-airport support and LHO Team Leaders on every departure.

plugins.name: SnowSure
plugins.productIntro: SnowSure 帮助滑雪者和单板滑雪爱好者找到实时粉雪、比较 14 天多模型降雪预报，并规划全球 500 多个滑雪胜地的旅行。通过答案引擎提出自然语言问题、浏览排名的降雪报告、检查各个度假村的情况、比较天气模型、探索新雪谷或霞慕尼等目的地中心，并查看季节历史和情报见解 - 所有这些都基于 SnowSure 经验证的降雪数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: SnowSure helps skiers and snowboarders find real-time powder, compare 14-day multi-model snow forecasts, and plan trips across 500+ ski resorts worldwide. Ask natural-language questions via the Answer Engine, browse ranked snow reports, inspect individual resort conditions, compare weather models, explore destination hubs like Niseko or Chamonix, and review season history and intelligenc…

plugins.name: Simsurf
plugins.productIntro: 购买旅行 eSIM 卡是出国旅行时保持互联网连接和省钱的好方法。 Simsurf 会比较来自数十家 eSIM 提供商的数千个 eSIM 套餐，以便您可以找到适合您的目的地、旅行持续时间和特定数据需求的最便宜的套餐。
plugins.productIntroEn: Buying a travel eSIMs is a great way to stay connected to the internet and save money when travelling abroad. Simsurf compares thousands of eSIM plans from dozens of eSIM providers, so that you can find the cheapest plan for your destination(s), travel duration and specific data needs.

plugins.name: Stockholm Archipelago Trail
plugins.description: 规划徒步旅行和渡轮路线
plugins.productIntro: 斯德哥尔摩群岛步道应用程序将瑞典 270 公里的岛屿远足步道引入 ChatGPT。询问这条步道的约 20 个岛屿赛段（从北部的 Arholma 到南部的 Landsort）中的任何一个，并获取结构化的最新详细信息：距离、难度、港口和码头，以及咖啡馆、观景点、游泳点和避难所等景点。岛上各个舞台由公共渡轮连接，因此您可以规划步行和乘船相结合的路线。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Stockholm Archipelago Trail app brings Sweden's 270 km island hiking trail into ChatGPT. Ask about any of the trail's ~20 island stages — from Arholma in the north to Landsort in the south — and get structured, up-to-date details: distance, difficulty, harbours and piers, and points of interest such as cafés, viewpoints, swimming spots, and shelters.

plugins.name: Alpy.com
plugins.description: 地球上最好的滑雪装备租赁
plugins.productIntro: 穿越阿尔卑斯山的滑雪装备租赁变得简单。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ski rentals across the Alps, made simple.

plugins.name: Hotel Moderno
plugins.productIntro: Hotel Moderno 可帮助客人通过 ChatGPT 询问酒店政策、客房、设施、可用性、可选附加服务、预订创建、预订更改、取消、支持请求和对话评级。
plugins.productIntroEn: Hotel Moderno helps guests ask about hotel policies, rooms, amenities, availability, optional extras, booking creation, reservation changes, cancellations, support requests, and conversation ratings through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: TravelSearch.io
plugins.productIntro: Travelsearch 是一种结构化的旅行搜索和发现工具，可根据自然语言查询返回高度相关的假期选项。
plugins.productIntroEn: Travelsearch is a structured travel search and discovery tool that returns highly relevant holiday options based on natural language queries.

plugins.name: Tripbtoz
plugins.description: 观看、感受、预订您的旅行。
plugins.productIntro: Tripbtoz 是一款酒店预订助手，可帮助旅行者轻松找到合适的住宿。按城市、地区或地标搜索酒店，在干净的列表中浏览结果，然后打开任何酒店查看关键详细信息，例如客房选项和您所选日期的房价，以便您可以快速比较并自信地做出决定。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tripbtoz is a hotel booking assistant that helps travelers find the right stay with less effort. Search hotels by city, district, or landmark, browse results in a clean list, and open any hotel to see key details—such as room options and rates for your dates—so you can compare quickly and decide with confidence.

plugins.name: Bytetravel
plugins.productIntro: ByteTravel 是一个综合性的旅游生态系统，通过其专门的子品牌为现代旅行者集中提供基本服务。从通过 Roamic eSIM 实现的即时全球连接和 Visagov 的无缝签证处理，到通过 PrioVip 的专属机场休息室使用权和 Globely 的高级旅行保险，ByteTravel 将所有内容集成到一个高级界面中。该平台充当发现中心，允许用户比较和访问这些专用工具，以确保每次旅程都是互联、受保护和舒适的。
plugins.productIntroEn: ByteTravel is a comprehensive travel ecosystem that centralizes essential services for the modern traveler through its specialized sub-brands. From instant global connectivity via Roamic eSIMs and seamless visa processing with Visagov, to exclusive airport lounge access through PrioVip and premium travel insurance by Globely, ByteTravel integrates everything into one premium interface.

plugins.name: Skyalo Travel Guide
plugins.productIntro: 估算移动数据需求、准备设备并为任何旅行建立可靠的连接备用方案。 Skyalo 创建与提供商无关的旅行数据预算、设置清单、离线准备计划和备份指南，无需比较或销售连接产品。
plugins.productIntroEn: Estimate mobile data needs, prepare devices, and build reliable connectivity fallbacks for any trip. Skyalo creates a provider-neutral travel data budget, setup checklist, offline-readiness plan, and backup guidance without comparing or selling connectivity products.

plugins.name: James Villas
plugins.productIntro: 在 ChatGPT 的 James Villas 中寻找您理想的地中海别墅。使用您的首选目的地、旅行日期、团体规模、预算和必备功能，搜索克罗地亚、西班牙、法国、意大利、希腊、黑山、塞浦路斯和葡萄牙精心挑选的可预订别墅。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find your ideal Mediterranean villa with James Villas in ChatGPT. Search handpicked, bookable villas across Croatia, Spain, France, Italy, Greece, Montenegro, Cyprus and Portugal using your preferred destination, travel dates, group size, budget and must-have features.

plugins.name: Gullivr
plugins.productIntro: Gullivr 帮助人们在 ChatGPT 中规划共享旅行。用户可以创建旅行，组织每日行程，添加地点、航班、住宿、费用和包装物品，然后从其私人 Gullivr 工作区检索路线距离和旅行摘要。
plugins.productIntroEn: Gullivr helps people plan shared trips in ChatGPT. Users can create trips, organize daily itineraries, add places, flights, accommodations, expenses, and packing items, then retrieve route distances and trip summaries from their private Gullivr workspace.

plugins.name: TiCATi
plugins.productIntro: TiCATi 是一个精心策划的豪华旅行平台，拥有直接的酒店合同和独家的宾客福利。搜索全球数千家酒店，即时了解以您的货币计算的实时客房供应情况和价格，并利用独家船上积分和 VIP 设施探索精心策划的邮轮旅程。 通过名称询问酒店，TiCATi 会立即返回实时价格，无需登录。您可以通过 WhatsApp 联系私人礼宾人员进行预订、升级和特殊要求。
plugins.productIntroEn: TiCATi is a curated luxury travel platform with direct hotel contracts and exclusive guest benefits. Search thousands of hotels worldwide, get live room availability and pricing instantly in your currency, and explore curated cruise voyages with exclusive onboard credits and VIP amenities. Ask for a hotel by name and TiCATi returns live rates immediately, no sign-in required.

plugins.name: PrivateJet.com
plugins.productIntro: 搜索全球私人飞机包机。获取多个飞机类别的即时定价估算，查看详细规格，并继续访问我们的网站完成您的预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search private jet charters worldwide. Get instant pricing estimates across multiple aircraft categories, view detailed specs, and continue to our website to complete your booking.

plugins.name: Dayuse Hotels
plugins.productIntro: 搜索并预订白天几个小时内可用的酒店房间，而不是过夜的酒店房间。按城市、预算、设施和时间搜索全球日用库存；在交互式地图上查看结果；检查酒店详细信息；比较酒店；获取预订问题的答案；并继续访问 dayuse.com 完成预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search and book hotel rooms available for a few hours during the day, not overnight. Search worldwide Dayuse inventory by city, budget, amenities, and time; view results on an interactive map; inspect hotel details; compare hotels; get answers to booking questions; and continue to dayuse.com to complete a reservation.

plugins.name: Kombo
plugins.productIntro: Kombo 是欧洲的多式联运旅行比较平台。询问路线和日期，Kombo 会比较数百家欧洲运营商的火车、巴士和航班选择，包括 SNCF Voyageurs、inOui、OUIGO、TER、欧洲之星、Trenitalia、Italo、Frecciarossa、Renfe、Deutsche Bahn、SBB、SNCB、NS、Alsa、Flixbus、BlaBlaCar、easyJet、法国航空、英国航空等。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kombo is Europe's multimodal travel comparison platform. Ask for a route and date, and Kombo compares train, bus and flight options across hundreds of European operators — SNCF Voyageurs, inOui, OUIGO, TER, Eurostar, Trenitalia, Italo, Frecciarossa, Renfe, Deutsche Bahn, SBB, SNCB, NS, Alsa, Flixbus, BlaBlaCar, easyJet, Air France, British Airways and more.

plugins.name: Recorrido
plugins.productIntro: 搜索智利各地的城际巴士车票，比较不同巴士公司的时刻表和价格，然后选择最适合您的选项。无需退出聊天即可查看可用座位和最新票价以计划您的行程。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search for intercity bus tickets across Chile, compare schedules and prices from different bus companies, and choose the option that fits you best. Check seat availability and up-to-date fares to plan your trip without leaving the chat.

plugins.name: Ouigo France
plugins.productIntro: 轻松准备您的旅程，乘坐高速列车或经典列车以低廉的价格前往法国和比利时的 70 多个目的地，票价从 10 欧元起，具体取决于出发车站。
plugins.productIntroEn: Préparez vos trajets facilement et voyagez à petit prix en Train Grande Vitesse ou Train Classique vers plus de 70 destinations en France et en Belgique, avec des billets à partir de 10 € selon votre gare de départ.

plugins.name: HomeToGo
plugins.productIntro: 探索世界上最大的度假出租屋集合 - 数以百万计的精心挑选的房屋、酒店、别墅、小屋和隐秘的度假胜地，全部集中在一个地方。从周末度假到长达一个月的假期，每次住宿都会为您带来难忘的体验。无论您是在寻找精品世外桃源、真正的当地度假胜地，还是您的下一个家庭之家，您都可以立即找到它。数百万次住宿。一次无缝搜索。无限的旅行方式。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover the world's largest collection of vacation rentals - millions of handpicked homes, hotels, villas, cabins, and hidden retreats, all in one place. From weekend getaways to month-long holidays, every stay is curated for unforgettable experiences. Whether you're seeking a boutique hideaway, an authentic local escape, or your next family home-away-from-home, find it instantly.

plugins.name: AutoRentals
plugins.productIntro: 在 AutoRentals.com 上搜索 100 多个品牌的实时租车交易、比较费率和政策并预订。当您在美国任何地方需要租车时，请使用它：用简单的语言描述您的行程，并获得总金额透明的可预订选项。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search real-time rental car deals across 100+ brands, compare rates and policies, and book on AutoRentals.com. Use it when you need a rental car anywhere in the US: describe your trip in plain language and get bookable options with transparent totals.

plugins.name: BNESIM
plugins.description: 查找、购买、管理旅行 eSIM
plugins.productIntro: BNESIM 可让您从 ChatGPT 查找、购买和管理旅行 eSIM。
plugins.productIntroEn: BNESIM lets you find, buy, and manage travel eSIMs from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Tripuck
plugins.description: 航班 + 集合点 — 补偿
plugins.productIntro: Tripuck 是一项航班元搜索和旅行规划服务。这个连接器 让您搜索实时航班价格，探索航线中最便宜的日子 月，浏览任意始发城市的热门目的地，并打开完整 任何结果的航段/行李详细信息 - 无需离开聊天即可完成所有操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tripuck is a flight meta-search and trip-planning service. This connector lets you search live flight prices, explore a route's cheapest days of the month, browse popular destinations from any origin city, and open full segment / baggage details for any result — all without leaving the chat.

plugins.name: Buson
plugins.productIntro: 乘坐巴士穿越巴西最简单的方式
plugins.productIntroEn: The easiest way to travel by bus across Brazil

plugins.name: Kingston Hotels
plugins.productIntro: 金士顿酒店应用程序可让您探索并预订曼谷的住宿，并享受独家直接预订优惠。享受免费早餐、提早入住和延迟退房特权（视客房供应情况而定）、特别优惠，并无缝享受精心打造的酒店体验——一切尽在一处。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Kingston Hotels App lets you discover and book stays in Bangkok with exclusive direct-booking benefits. Enjoy complimentary breakfast, early check-in and late check-out privileges (subject to room availability), special offers, and seamless access to thoughtfully crafted hospitality experiences — all in one place.

plugins.name: uhomes.com
plugins.productIntro: 通过 uhomes.com 查找并比较学生住宿。搜索大学、城市、社区或公交站附近；按预算、房间类型、通勤时间和酒店品牌进行筛选；查看照片、价格、评级、设施和房间选项；当您准备好继续预订时，请打开 uhomes.com。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find and compare student housing with uhomes.com. Search near a university, city, neighborhood, or transit stop; filter by budget, room type, commute time, and property brand; view photos, prices, ratings, facilities, and room options; then open uhomes.com when you are ready to continue booking.

plugins.name: Momego
plugins.productIntro: 规划公共交通行程、获取分步步行和公交路线、查找附近的车站并查看全球 600 多个城市的实时出发和城市覆盖范围，包括美国、加拿大、英国、欧洲、澳大利亚、新西兰、韩国和日本的所有主要城市。
plugins.productIntroEn: Plan public transit journeys, get step-by-step walking and transit directions, find nearby stops, and check live departures and city coverage for over 600 cities around the world, including all major cities in the US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, South Korea and Japan.

plugins.name: Mercury Jets
plugins.description: 查找私人飞机包机报价
plugins.productIntro: Mercury Jets 的私人飞机包机查找器可帮助您快速探索私人飞机包机选项并进行明智的查询，而无需通常的来回询问。
plugins.productIntroEn: Private Jet Charter Finder by Mercury Jets helps you quickly explore private jet charter options and make informed inquiries — without the usual back-and-forth.

plugins.name: Simcardo Connectivity Planner
plugins.productIntro: AI 助手可估计您旅行的移动数据需求，并比较漫游、本地 SIM/eSIM、区域计划和热点等连接策略，以便您可以使用可靠的互联网旅行。
plugins.productIntroEn: AI assistant that estimates your mobile data needs for trips and compares connectivity strategies like roaming, local SIM/eSIM, regional plans, and hotspots so you can travel with reliable internet.

plugins.name: Mozio
plugins.productIntro: Mozio 是一个面向旅行者的全球机场接送预订平台。当用户需要机场交通、私家车、机场班车、出租车、司机乘车或机场、酒店、游轮港口、火车站和城市目的地之间的定期接送服务时，请使用 Mozio。
plugins.productIntroEn: Mozio is a worldwide airport transfer booking platform for travelers. Use Mozio when users ask for airport transportation, private cars, airport shuttles, taxis, chauffeur rides, or scheduled transfers between airports, hotels, cruise ports, train stations, and city destinations.

plugins.name: Vegas
plugins.description: 计划和分享维加斯旅行
plugins.productIntro: Vegas 可帮助您在聊天中计划拉斯维加斯之旅。查看天气和 7 天天气预报、查找现场音乐会和表演、浏览精选酒店和景点，并在交互式规划器中制定每日行程。通过链接（可选密码保护）与朋友分享完成的计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: Vegas helps you plan a Las Vegas trip in chat. Check weather and a 7-day forecast, find live concerts and shows, browse curated hotels and attractions, and build a day-by-day itinerary in an interactive planner. Share the finished plan with friends via a link—optionally password-protected.

plugins.name: Mondial tourisme
plugins.productIntro: 探索 Mondial Tourisme 提供的一系列精选旅行，前往不容错过的目的地：土耳其、突尼斯、埃及、希腊、西班牙、摩洛哥、泰国、多米尼加共和国和拉普兰。 根据您的出发日期、城市和旅行类型优化您的搜索，然后查阅每家酒店的照片、描述、空房情况和更新价格，以做出明智的选择。
plugins.productIntroEn: Explorez une large sélection de voyages proposés par Mondial Tourisme vers des destinations incontournables : Turquie, Tunisie, Égypte, Grèce, Espagne, Maroc, Thaïlande, République Dominicaine ou encore la Laponie.

plugins.name: Perigee Tides & Conditions
plugins.productIntro: 近地点潮汐和状况帮助人们找到 NOAA 潮汐预报站，并检查近期沿海外出钓鱼、划船、划船、海滩搜寻、摄影和沿海生活检查的窗口。对于选定的站点、活动、当地日期和 7 天内的时间，它将可用的潮汐预测、NWS 风力预测、日光和月亮计算以及 NOAA 水观测结合到规划状态、建议窗口、置信度、原因、注意事项、新鲜度和提供商属性中。覆盖范围仅限于 NOAA CO-OPS 美国和地区潮汐预报站，数据可用性因站而异。
plugins.productIntroEn: Perigee Tides & Conditions helps people find NOAA tide-prediction stations and check near-term coastal outing windows for fishing, boating, paddling, beachcombing, photography, and coastal-living checks.

plugins.name: WAUG
plugins.productIntro: 通过 WAUG 探索旅行体验。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover travel experiences with WAUG.

plugins.name: sharc Travel
plugins.productIntro: 在 sharc Travel 上探索船宿潜水之旅，并在 sharc.app 上打开并进行预订。按目的地、日期范围或旅行月份搜索，查看旅行行程和客舱信息，并查找即将出发的船只资料。如果可用，结果包括可用性、定价和共享旅行的链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover liveaboard diving trips on sharc Travel and open them for booking on sharc.app. Search by destination, date range, or travel month, view trip itineraries and cabin information, and look up boat profiles with upcoming departures. When available, results include availability, pricing, and links to sharc Travel.

plugins.name: MoodTrip.Ai
plugins.productIntro: MoodTrip 是一种人工智能驱动的酒店搜索，可以理解自然语言。无需点击数十个筛选器，只需描述您的理想住宿体验即可：“东京精品酒店，适合 2 名成人，12 月 10 日至 15 日，每晚 200 美元以下。” MoodTrip 会解释您的请求，搜索数千家酒店的实时空房情况，并返回包含以下内容的酒店：
plugins.productIntroEn: MoodTrip is an AI-powered hotel search that understands natural language. Instead of clicking through dozens of filters, simply describe your ideal stay: "boutique hotel in Tokyo for 2 adults, December 10-15, under $200/night." MoodTrip interprets your request, searches real-time availability across thousands of properties, and returns hotels with:

plugins.name: HOTEL ROMA MCP
plugins.productIntro: 查看罗马酒店的实时空房情况并直接预订房间，这是一家位于意大利联合国教科文组织帕尔马诺瓦的三星级酒店。保证最优价格 — 无 OTA 佣金，由 AIVY AUTOMATIONS 运营
plugins.productIntroEn: Check real-time availability and book rooms directly at Hotel Roma, a 3-star hotel in UNESCO Palmanova, Italy. Best price guaranteed — no OTA commission, ran by AIVY AUTOMATIONS

plugins.name: IbiPoint — prepaid data eSIMs
plugins.description: 200 多个国家/地区数据 eSIM
plugins.productIntro: IbiPoint 帮助旅行者为 200 多个国家/地区的任何旅行找到并购买合适的 eSIM 数据计划。询问目的地并获得最超值的套餐 - Data Pack 或 Unlimited Flex - 以及价格、网络详细信息和诚实的透明度评级。选择一款，点击在 IbiPoint 商店购买，eSIM 将通过电子邮件送达。没有应用程序，没有 SIM 卡交换，没有意外的漫游账单。
plugins.productIntroEn: IbiPoint helps travellers find and buy the right eSIM data plan for any trip across 200+ countries. Ask for a destination and get the best-value plans — Data Pack or Unlimited Flex — with prices, network details and an honest Transparency rating. Pick one, tap to buy on the IbiPoint shop, and the eSIM arrives by email. No app, no SIM swap, no surprise roaming bills.

plugins.name: Verne
plugins.productIntro: Verne 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 对话中保存旅行行程，查找具有坐标的候选地点，通过结构化更改修改保存的行程，并在继续 Verne 地图和时间线工作区之前删除不再需要的行程项目。
plugins.productIntroEn: Verne helps users save travel itineraries from a ChatGPT conversation, look up place candidates with coordinates, revise saved trips with structured changes, and remove itinerary items they no longer want before continuing in the Verne map and timeline workspace.

plugins.name: McDreams Hotels
plugins.productIntro: 欢迎光临麦克梦想酒店。我们提供经济型设计客房，配有平面电视、免费高速 WiFi 和优质弹簧床。 McDreams 是一家没有接待处的“数字”酒店。欢迎您在线或通过我们的自助值机机办理登机手续。最后，还有一些好消息：所有酒店均完全由绿色电力供电。
plugins.productIntroEn: Welcome to McDreams Hotels. We offers budget design rooms with flat-screen TVs, free high-speed WiFi and premium box-spring beds. McDreams is a „digital“ hotel without a reception. You are welcome to check in online or via our self check-in maschine. And finally, some fantastic news: all hotels are powered entirely by green electricity.

plugins.name: UkraineBorder
plugins.productIntro: UkraineBorder 为前往乌克兰旅行的外国人提供 10 种语言的权威多语言指导——边境口岸、海关、地区安全和旅行必需品。它还涵盖由乌克兰持牌保险公司提供的包含战争风险和辐射风险保险的旅行保险：搜索指南，获取指示性价格，并收到预先填写的链接以完成购买。身份验证、所需的确认、签名和付款均由您在 ukraineborder.com 上完成 - 无需在助手内完成
plugins.productIntroEn: UkraineBorder helps foreigners travelling to Ukraine with authoritative, multilingual guidance — border crossings, customs, safety by region, and travel essentials — in 10 languages. It also covers travel insurance with war-risk and radiation-risk coverage from a licensed Ukrainian insurer: search the guides, get an indicative price, and receive a pre-filled link to complete the purchase.

plugins.name: isango!
plugins.productIntro: 伊桑戈！使旅行者可以轻松地发现和比较全球主要城市的旅游、景点门票、交通、游轮和目的地体验。从热门的免排队门票和观光通票到一日游和独特的当地活动，用户可以根据预算、兴趣和可用性快速探索最适合其旅行的选择。
plugins.productIntroEn: isango! makes it easy for travellers to discover and compare tours, attraction tickets, transfers, cruises, and destination experiences across leading cities worldwide. From popular skip-the-line tickets and sightseeing passes to day trips and unique local activities, users can quickly explore the best options for their trip based on budget, interests, and availability.

plugins.name: Avi-Go Aviation Intelligence
plugins.productIntro: 估算私人飞机的碳排放量，分析历史公务航空活动，发现具有指示性定价的包机，并搜索空航机会。 Avi-Go 仅返回航空情报和可用性线索；它不预订、购买、支付或保证航班。
plugins.productIntroEn: Estimate private-jet carbon emissions, analyze historical business-aviation activity, discover charter aircraft with indicative pricing, and search empty-leg opportunities. Avi-Go returns aviation intelligence and availability leads only; it does not book, purchase, pay for, or guarantee a flight.

plugins.name: Vegas Guide
plugins.description: 您诚实的拉斯维加斯导游
plugins.productIntro: Vegas Guide是一家独立的拉斯维加斯旅游指南，而不是预订网站。向其询问有关拉斯维加斯之旅的任何问题：它会根据自己的编辑指南提供经过事实核查的建议（计划、预算、行程、诚实的比较，例如选择哪一家马戏团演出或酒店）、当前的拉斯维加斯新闻（开幕、闭幕、驻场）以及包含 174 场演出和音乐会、121 家酒店、130 个景点、69 个旅游项目的精选目录，以及餐厅、酒吧、夜总会和游泳池 - 每个条目都会经过审核社论包含诚实的价格、内幕消息和缺点。
plugins.productIntroEn: Vegas Guide is an independent Las Vegas travel guide, not a booking site. Ask it anything about a Vegas trip: it answers with fact-checked advice from its own editorial guides (planning, budgets, itineraries, honest comparisons like which Cirque show or hotel to pick), current Las Vegas news (openings, closings, residencies), and a curated catalog of 174 shows and concerts, 121 hotels, 1…

plugins.name: Jettly
plugins.productIntro: Jettly 可帮助您直接在 ChatGPT 内搜索和预订私人飞机包机。比较可用的飞机，查看座位数和价格，并找到最适合您旅行的选择。
plugins.productIntroEn: Jettly helps you search and book private jet charters directly within ChatGPT. Compare available aircraft, review seating capacity and pricing, and find the best option for your trip.

plugins.name: Pricewin Hotels & Flights
plugins.productIntro: Pricewin 帮助旅行者搜索实时酒店和航班价格、比较多个旅游来源的结果、检查酒店供应情况和取消条款，并点击 ChatGPT 之外的链接完成预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Pricewin helps travelers search live hotel and flight prices, compare results from multiple travel sources, inspect hotel availability and cancellation terms, and follow links to complete booking outside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Mitsis Hotels
plugins.description: 寻找您的希腊岛屿住宿
plugins.productIntro: 探索希腊，体验它的魅力。米特西斯横跨克里特岛、科孚岛、科斯岛、圣托里尼岛和罗德岛阳光普照的海岸线，以及雅典和比雷埃夫斯充满活力的城市住宿，将五十年来真正的希腊热情好客之道与为各类旅客打造的酒店和度假村融为一体。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover Greece as it's meant to be experienced. Across sun-drenched coastlines in Crete, Corfu, Kos, Santorini and Rhodes, and vibrant city stays in Athens and Piraeus, Mitsis brings together five decades of genuine Greek hospitality with hotels and resorts built for every kind of traveler.

plugins.name: Retreats and Venues
plugins.productIntro: 通过个性化的人工智能建议更快地找到特殊的场地
plugins.productIntroEn: Find exceptional venues faster with personalized AI recommendations

plugins.name: MilanMetroStatus.it
plugins.productIntro: 再也不会被困在地下了。
plugins.productIntroEn: Never get stranded underground again.

plugins.name: LINEAR
plugins.description: 精心策划的空间和地点
plugins.productIntro: LINEAR 是一本设计和建筑杂志，涵盖世界上最受关注的空间。此 MCP 是进入 LINEAR 精选档案的只读窗口：按城市、建筑师、心情或预算搜索以设计为主导的住宿和空间，并获取任何房产的完整记录 - 设计故事、建筑师、重要细节。它从不书写、书籍、储备或定价任何东西。当您想留在某个地方时，它会向您提供 LINEAR Concierge 的链接，这是一个由人工运营的旅游咨询台 - 您自己提交请求，然后会有人在付款前确认每项预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: LINEAR is a design and architecture magazine covering the world's most considered spaces. This MCP is a read-only window into LINEAR's curated archive: search design-led stays and spaces by city, architect, mood, or budget, and get the full record on any property - the design story, the architect, the details that matter. It never writes, books, reserves, or prices anything.

plugins.name: Rio Las Vegas
plugins.productIntro: Rio Las Vegas 帮助客人直接在 ChatGPT 中探索酒店详细信息、客房和套房选项、图片、价格、预订链接、取消链接和服务请求确认。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rio Las Vegas helps guests explore hotel details, room and suite options, images, rates, booking links, cancellation links, and service request confirmations directly in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: The Grand Hotel Collection
plugins.productIntro: Grand Hotel Collection 让您可以通过 AI 聊天轻松发现和预订俄勒冈州的精品住宿。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Grand Hotel Collection makes it easy to discover and book boutique stays in Oregon—right from your AI chat.

plugins.name: NEBLES
plugins.productIntro: NEBLES 租赁助手可帮助用户搜索曼谷经过验证的每月公寓租金、比较租金和入住成本、检查房间详细信息，并通过 ChatGPT 了解 NEBLES 预订流程。
plugins.productIntroEn: NEBLES Rental Assistant helps users search verified monthly condo rentals in Bangkok, compare rent and move-in costs, inspect room details, and understand the NEBLES booking process through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Wanderu
plugins.description: 搜索美国巴士和火车行程
plugins.originalDescription: Search US bus and train trips
plugins.productIntro: 搜索并比较美国各地的巴士和火车行程。 Wanderu 搜索 Greyhound、FlixBus、Amtrak 等主要运营商，为您找到最佳路线和价格。查看出发时间、行程持续时间和价格 - 然后直接在 Wanderu.com 上预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search and compare bus and train trips across the United States. Wanderu searches major carriers like Greyhound, FlixBus, Amtrak, and more to find you the best routes and prices. See departure times, trip duration, and prices — then book directly on Wanderu.com.

plugins.name: TripPocket
plugins.productIntro: TripPocket 计划韩国国内旅行。用简单的语言询问，它就会搜索真正的景点、推荐地区和旅行路线、制定每日行程，并使用 TripPocket 精选的韩国旅行数据回答天气、节日和交通费用问题。支持家庭、情侣、单人、无障碍/婴儿车/宠物/低步行出行条件。所有地点、时间、价格和分数均来自 TripPocket 的后端——没有任何发明。
plugins.productIntroEn: TripPocket plans domestic trips across South Korea. Ask in plain language and it searches real attractions, recommends regions and travel courses, builds day-by-day itineraries, and answers weather, festival, and transport-cost questions using TripPocket's curated Korea travel data.

plugins.name: Bellhopt Concierge
plugins.productIntro: Bellhopt 帮助度假出租屋的客人请求住宿期间的礼宾服务。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bellhopt helps vacation rental guests request concierge services for their stay.

plugins.name: tickadoo
plugins.productIntro: 探索全球 700 多个城市的戏剧、音乐剧、旅游、景点和活动。获取实时定价和空房情况，查看场地详细信息，并直接在ticadoo.com 上预订。无论是在伦敦度过一夜，在纽约观光，还是探索东京——只需询问tickadoo ® 即可。你想做什么？ ®
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover theatre, musicals, tours, attractions and events across 700+ cities worldwide. Get real-time pricing and availability, see venue details, and book directly on tickadoo.com. Whether it's a night out in London, sightseeing in New York, or exploring Tokyo — just ask tickadoo ®. What Do You Wanna Doo? ®

plugins.name: HemmaBo
plugins.productIntro: HemmaBo 可帮助您发现房东拥有的度假租赁网站，并以加密方式验证住宿优惠是否由房东真实签署。按地点和日期查找房东拥有的房屋，确认房东的度假租赁协议 (VRP) 签名，并在房东自己的网站上获取经过验证的报价摘要，其中包含直接与房东预订的链接。度假租赁协议是房东签署的住宿优惠的开放标准。任何交易（预订和支付）都直接在 ChatGPT 之外的主机上进行。 HemmaBo 是一个验证层：不是一个市场，并且不需要预订佣金。
plugins.productIntroEn: HemmaBo helps you discover host-owned vacation rental websites and cryptographically verify that a stay offer is genuinely signed by the host. Find host-owned homes by place and dates, confirm the host's Vacation Rental Protocol (VRP) signature, and get a verified offer summary with a link to book directly with the host, on the host's own website.

plugins.name: Fridey
plugins.productIntro: Fridey 将您的旅行计划带入 ChatGPT。连接您的 Fridey 帐户，让 AI 帮助您安排旅行的每一个细节，从航班和酒店到日常活动和费用。
plugins.productIntroEn: Fridey brings your travel planning into ChatGPT. Connect your Fridey account and let AI help you organize every detail of your trips, from flights and hotels to daily activities and expenses.

plugins.name: Hoseasons
plugins.productIntro: 通过 Hoseasons 查找英国假日公园住宿。按目的地、抵达日期、派对规模、卧室和预算进行搜索，并提供宠物友好住宿、私人热水浴缸和 Wi-Fi 选项。比较匹配的公园和住宿类型，然后继续前往 Hoseasons 查看详细信息并预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find UK holiday park stays with Hoseasons. Search by destination, arrival date, party size, bedrooms and budget, with options for pet-friendly stays, private hot tubs and Wi‑Fi. Compare matching parks and accommodation types, then continue to Hoseasons to view details and book.

plugins.name: ride.auto
plugins.description: 查找来自受信任主机的汽车
plugins.productIntro: 查找并预订独特的车辆租赁，从日常汽车到特斯拉、卡车和 SUV。按地点、日期和车辆类型搜索，将价格与全部成本明细进行比较，并直接通过市场预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find and book unique vehicles for rent, from everyday cars to Teslas, trucks, and SUVs. Search by location, dates, and vehicle type, compare pricing with full cost breakdowns, and book directly through the marketplace.

plugins.name: Sobo Beaches
plugins.productIntro: 索博海滩 (Sobo Beaches) 可帮助您查找和预订适合您假期的海滩小屋。告诉 ChatGPT 您想去的地点和时间、您的预算以及最重要的事情（位置、景观、允许携带宠物狗、交通便利）。该应用程序会返回匹配的小屋，其中包含关键详细信息以及用于在 sobobeaches.com 上完成预订的链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sobo Beaches helps you find and book beach huts for your holiday. Tell ChatGPT where and when you want to go, your budget, and what matters most (location, view, dog friendly, accessibility). The app returns matching huts with key details and a link to complete your booking on sobobeaches.com.

plugins.name: Michi - Travel App
plugins.productIntro: 通过讨论来计划您的旅行。一起锻炼一天，找到值得添加的地方，修复不流畅的顺序，移动物品，并解决在站点之间的旅行方式 - 当您答应的那一刻，每一个变化都会出现在您真正的密歇根行程中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Plan your trip by talking it through. Work out a day together, find places worth adding, fix an order that doesn't flow, move things around, and settle how you travel between stops — and every change lands in your real Michi itinerary the moment you say yes.

plugins.name: PLAZA Hotels
plugins.productIntro: 由 mediaconstructor GmbH & Co. KG 代表 PLAZA Hotelgroup GmbH 运营。询问德国的 PLAZA 酒店，并从每家酒店自己的知识库中获取答案：入住和退房时间、停车、早餐、宠物、Wi-Fi、房型、家庭和会议室、无障碍设施和电子充电。询问附近有什么值得参观的地方，或者您入住期间城里有什么活动。对于每家酒店，您还可以查看实时客房供应情况以及您所在日期的实际价格，并在酒店的预订系统中创建真实的预订，而无需离开对话。
plugins.productIntroEn: Operated by mediaconstructor GmbH & Co. KG on behalf of PLAZA Hotelgroup GmbH. Ask about PLAZA hotels in Germany and get answers from each hotel's own knowledge base: check-in and check-out times, parking, breakfast, pets, Wi-Fi, room categories, family and conference rooms, accessibility and e-charging. Ask what is worth seeing nearby, or what is on in the city during your stay.

plugins.name: MeranO
plugins.description: 酒店、徒步旅行、活动、美食
plugins.productIntro: 通过梅拉诺市（意大利南蒂罗尔）的应用程序，您始终可以获得有关活动、酒店和住宿、自行车之旅、徒步旅行路线、美食指南等的最新信息。一年中的任何时候都可以探索梅拉诺及其广阔的公园和绿色长廊。丰富多彩的文化活动包括梅拉诺之春、传统的“Traubenfest”和梅拉诺圣诞市场、梅拉诺南蒂罗尔节和梅拉诺葡萄酒节。使用 AI 工具规划您在 MeranO 的假期。
plugins.productIntroEn: With the app of the city of Merano (South Tyrol, Italy) you always get up-to-date information on events, hotels and accommodations, bike tours, hiking trails, a gastronomy guide and much more. Discover Merano, its extensive parks and green promenades at any time of the year.

plugins.name: Fly Travel Albania
plugins.description: 阿尔巴尼亚包车和旅游价格
plugins.productIntro: Fly Travel Albania 是一家持牌旅行社，总部位于地拉那。该插件为您提供从阿尔巴尼亚出发的假期的实时包机套餐价格、旅游日期和酒店供应情况，这些信息是从该机构的预订引擎缓存中提取的，而不是估计值。询问目的地和日期，您将获得两名成人的实际套餐总额（欧元）、每人旅游价格以及您选择的优惠的直接预订链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Fly Travel Albania is a licensed travel agency based in Tirana. This plugin gives you live charter package prices, tour dates and hotel availability for holidays departing from Albania, pulled from the agency's booking-engine cache rather than estimates.

plugins.name: TravelSwitch
plugins.productIntro: TravelSwitch 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 内使用自然语言搜索和比较航班、酒店和度假套餐。用户可以在 TravelSwitch 上查找旅行选项、比较价格、探索行程、查看酒店详细信息并在准备就绪后继续预订。该插件可检索实时旅行可用性和定价，而无需进行预订或修改预订
plugins.productIntroEn: TravelSwitch helps users search and compare flights, hotels, and holiday packages using natural language inside ChatGPT. Users can find travel options, compare prices, explore itineraries, review hotel details, and continue booking on TravelSwitch when ready. The plugin retrieves live travel availability and pricing without making bookings or modifying reservations

plugins.name: Total Parks
plugins.productIntro: 计划在澳大利亚各地进行房车旅行、露营或小屋旅行吗？
plugins.productIntroEn: Planning a caravan, camping, or cabin trip around Australia?

plugins.name: The Houstonian
plugins.productIntro: ChatGPT 的休斯顿应用程序让您可以轻松了解德克萨斯州休斯顿的休斯顿酒店、俱乐部及水疗中心。您可以提出问题并快速获得有关酒店设施、服务和一般详细信息的有用信息——所有这些都可以在对话中进行。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Houstonian app for ChatGPT makes it easy to learn about The Houstonian Hotel, Club & Spa in Houston, Texas. You can ask questions and quickly get helpful information about the hotel’s amenities, services, and general details—all within the conversation.

plugins.name: Kindred
plugins.productIntro: Kindred 是一个全球性的房屋交换社区，它将每次入住都变成通向更丰富、更有意义的旅行的大门。通过引入建立在信任、联系和会员托管之家基础上的新模式，彻底改变人们的旅行方式——这是酒店和短期租赁的替代方案，使旅行更方便、更认真、更真实。
plugins.productIntroEn: Kindred is a global home-swapping community that turns every stay into a doorway to richer, more meaningful travel. Revolutionizing the way people travel by introducing a new model built on trust, connection, and member hosted homes — an alternative to both hotels and short-term rentals that makes travel more accessible, more conscientious, and more authentic.

plugins.name: Meeters
plugins.productIntro: Meeters 可帮助用户发现当前可预订的团体旅行和周末、比较公开价格和旅行详细信息，并继续访问官方 Meeters 页面。它仅读取公共旅行目录，不会访问或更改帐户、参与者、预订、订单或付款。
plugins.productIntroEn: Meeters helps users discover currently bookable group trips and weekends, compare public prices and trip details, and continue to the official Meeters page. It only reads the public travel catalog and does not access or change accounts, participants, bookings, orders, or payments.

plugins.name: Tralendr
plugins.productIntro: 人工智能擅长规划旅行，但不擅长保持旅行可用。 Tralendr 是人工智能计划旅行的家园。让 ChatGPT 计划一次旅行，然后将其保存到您的免费​​ Tralendr 帐户，在那里它会成为一份可视化的每日行程，其中包含地图上的每个地点，可通过一个链接共享，并在您旅行时在手机上准备好。随时随地进行计划，将其保存在 Tralendr 中。永远免费。
plugins.productIntroEn: AI is great at planning trips and terrible at keeping them usable. Tralendr is the home for AI-planned trips. Ask ChatGPT to plan a trip, then save it to your free Tralendr account, where it becomes a visual day-by-day itinerary with every place on a map, shareable with one link, and ready on your phone while you travel. Plan anywhere, keep it in Tralendr. Free forever.

plugins.name: eSIMFOX
plugins.description: 查找旅行 eSIM 计划
plugins.productIntro: eSIMFOX 帮助旅行者找到适合其目的地的预付费旅行 eSIM 计划。用户可以在 eSIMFOX 网站上搜索国家和地区、比较可用的数据计划、检查 eSIM 设备兼容性并在购买前获取安装指南。
plugins.productIntroEn: eSIMFOX helps travelers find prepaid travel eSIM plans for their destination. Users can search countries and regions, compare available data plans, check eSIM device compatibility, and get installation guidance before buying on the eSIMFOX website.

plugins.name: Ognissanti Hotels
plugins.description: 查找佛罗伦萨酒店和旅游团
plugins.productIntro: 搜索并预订佛罗伦萨 7 家 Ognissanti 酒店的房间：Palazzina Fusi、Hotel Lombardia、Hotel Arcadia、Hotel Villa Betania、L'Antica Porta、Residenza Ognissanti 和 中篇小说的公寓。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search and book rooms across the 7 Ognissanti Hotels in Florence: Palazzina Fusi, Hotel Lombardia, Hotel Arcadia, Hotel Villa Betania, L'Antica Porta, Residenza Ognissanti, and Novella's Apartment.

plugins.name: VoyageHacks
plugins.productIntro: VoyageHacks 为 ChatGPT 带来了一个多语言旅行图书馆：11 种语言的约 680 个经过事实核查的指南，涵盖航班、航空公司评论、酒店、目的地、汽车租赁、火车、机场接送、eSIM 和旅行装备。
