plugins.productIntroEn: VoyageHacks brings a multilingual travel library into ChatGPT: about 680 fact-checked guides in each of 11 languages, covering flights, airline reviews, hotels, destinations, car rental, trains, airport transfers, eSIM and travel gear.

plugins.name: Yoteiko
plugins.description: 利用 AI 规划更智能的旅行
plugins.productIntro: Yoteiko 是一款人工智能驱动的旅行规划工具，适用于全球目的地。搜索任何国家/地区的景点、餐厅和隐藏的瑰宝，然后获得由人工智能构建的个性化每日行程。无论您是计划在巴黎度周末、为期两周的日本铁路旅行，还是穿越东南亚的背包探险，Yoteiko 都会根据当地建议、交通提示和时间建议制定量身定制的计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: Yoteiko is an AI-powered travel planner for destinations worldwide. Search for attractions, restaurants, and hidden gems across any country, then get a personalized day-by-day itinerary built by AI.

plugins.name: Seaclub Alcudia
plugins.description: 预订阿尔库迪亚 Seaclub 公寓
plugins.productIntro: 探索阿尔库迪亚海洋俱乐部，这是马略卡岛适合家庭入住的地中海度假村。通过照片浏览公寓类型、并排比较房间并直接预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Explore SeaClub Alcudia, a family-friendly Mediterranean resort in Mallorca. Browse apartment types with photos, compare rooms side by side, and get direct booking.

plugins.name: Leave
plugins.productIntro: 连接您的休假帐户以找到合适的旅行，总结即将到来的计划，检查行程时间和住宿详细信息，了解隐私最小化的预算、费用和余额，查找安全的文档元数据，查看注释和任务，并准备需要批准的旅行变更。休假仍然是事实的来源，每个请求都尊重当前的旅行会员资格、角色、范围和隐私规则。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your Leave account to find the right trip, summarize upcoming plans, check itinerary times and accommodation details, understand privacy-minimized budgets, expenses, and balances, find safe document metadata, review notes and tasks, and prepare approval-required trip changes.

plugins.name: Shqiponja eSIM
plugins.productIntro: 查找并比较全球目的地的当前 eSIM 数据包。按国家/地区、数据量、有效期或最高价格搜索，然后直接在 ChatGPT 中查看套餐详细信息。 Shqiponja eSIM 提供只读旅行连接信息，并且不会在 ChatGPT 内完成购买或处理付款。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find and compare current eSIM data packages for destinations worldwide. Search by country, data amount, validity period, or maximum price, then review package details directly in ChatGPT. Shqiponja eSIM provides read-only travel connectivity information and does not complete purchases or process payments inside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: RezervaOnline
plugins.productIntro: RezervaOnline 帮助旅行者查找和预订罗马尼亚各地的住宿 — 宾馆 (pensiuni)、酒店和别墅。按地区或名称搜索酒店，查看罗马尼亚列伊 (RON) 的实时客房供应情况和价格，并直接在对话中创建预订。预订由酒店确认并在抵达时付款，因此预订无需在线付款。 RezervaOnline 将您连接到在 RezervaOnline 平台上管理预订的酒店。
plugins.productIntroEn: RezervaOnline helps travelers find and book accommodation across Romania — guesthouses (pensiuni), hotels and villas. Search properties by locality or name, check real-time room availability and prices in Romanian lei (RON), and create a reservation directly in the conversation.

plugins.name: OPEN - what is open right now
plugins.productIntro: OPEN 回答了一个问题：该业务现在是否营业以及营业时间。
plugins.productIntroEn: OPEN answers one question: is this business open right now, and until when.

plugins.name: Carhopp
plugins.productIntro: Carhopp 查找并比较世界各地机场、火车站和城市的租车服务。搜索主要机构和当地供应商的实时价格，按类别（经济型、SUV、面包车、高级）、变速箱、价格和免费取消进行筛选，然后检查租赁条件并继续访问提供商的安全预订页面。询问诸如“下周末在巴塞罗那租车”或“戴高乐机场便宜的自动 SUV”之类的问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: Carhopp finds and compares rental cars at airports, train stations, and cities worldwide. Search live prices from major agencies and local suppliers, filter by category (economy, SUV, van, premium), transmission, price, and free cancellation, then check rental conditions and continue to the provider's secure booking page.

plugins.name: Parra-Glideator
plugins.productIntro: Parra-Glideator 帮助飞行员缩小条件最有希望的时间和地点的范围。其只读工具对选定日期的站点进行排名，比较预测得出的 XC 潜力，显示存储的站点概述和历史季节性、返回发射和着陆信息，以及显示精选的本地资源，例如俱乐部页面、网络摄像头和气象站。结果仅用于决策支持：飞行员在飞行前必须验证当前条件、当地规则、空域、通道以及其技能和设备的适用性。
plugins.productIntroEn: Parra-Glideator helps pilots narrow down where and when conditions look most promising. Its read-only tools rank sites for selected dates, compare forecast-derived XC potential, show stored site overviews and historical seasonality, return launch and landing information, and surface curated local resources such as club pages, webcams, and meteostations.

plugins.name: Vize Rehberim
plugins.productIntro: 土耳其公民（普通/勃艮第护照）签证申请的信息和计算工具。
plugins.productIntroEn: An information and calculation tool for visa applications by citizens of Türkiye (ordinary/burgundy passport).

plugins.name: Preferred Hotels & Resorts
plugins.productIntro: 把平凡抛在身后。从标志性的城市地标到僻静的岛屿圣地，璞富腾酒店及度假村诚邀您探索遍布全球的独立豪华酒店和度假村的世界，每一家都独一无二，每一家都令人难忘。
plugins.productIntroEn: Leave the ordinary behind. From iconic city landmarks to secluded island sanctuaries, Preferred Hotels & Resorts invites you to discover a world of independent luxury hotels and resorts spanning the globe—each one distinct, each one unforgettable.

plugins.name: Powly
plugins.description: 阿尔卑斯山的滑雪胜地和雪
plugins.originalDescription: Ski resorts & snow in the Alps
plugins.productIntro: 搜索阿尔卑斯山的 1,486 个滑雪度假村（奥地利、瑞士、德国、意大利、法国、SI）。获取降雪预报、度假村详细信息、任何城市的行车时间、粉雪天警报、并排度假村比较和路线图。数据包括滑雪道公里数、索道、海拔、冰川状况、当前雪深、滑雪通行证以及来自 Open-Meteo 的 16 天天气预报。可以提出这样的问题：“斯图加特 2 小时内有哪些滑雪场？” - “下周哪里降雪最多？” - “瑟尔登和伊施格尔，哪个更大？” - “告诉我去采尔马特的路线”。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search 1,486 ski resorts in the Alps (AT, CH, DE, IT, FR, SI). Get snow forecasts, resort details, driving times from any city, powder-day alerts, side-by-side resort comparisons, and route maps. Data includes piste kilometers, lifts, elevation, glacier status, current snow depth, ski passes, and 16-day weather forecasts from Open-Meteo.

plugins.name: Porcel hotels
plugins.productIntro: Porcel酒店助手帮助客人通过聊天查找酒店信息并完成常见的预订任务。 用户可以询问有关波尔塞尔酒店的问题，包括客房、设施、酒店服务、政策和入住/退房时间。助理还可以检查房间可用性并列出可选的房间附加服务。 如果客人已经预订，助理可以检索预订详细信息，并在提供所需的预订信息后帮助修改或取消现有预订。 如果客人需要帮助，助理还可以帮助创建新的预订并向酒店发送支持请求。
plugins.productIntroEn: Porcel hotels Assistant helps guests find hotel information and complete common reservation tasks through chat. Users can ask questions about Porcel hotels, including rooms, amenities, hotel services, policies, and check-in/check-out times. The assistant can also check room availability and list optional room extras.

plugins.name: TravCozy
plugins.description: 您的所有旅行都集中在一处
plugins.originalDescription: All your trips in one place
plugins.productIntro: TravCozy 将您旅行的每个部分整合在一起。向 ChatGPT 询问您的旅行，它会根据您的真实预订（从任何预订网站导入的航班、酒店、火车、汽车租赁和接送服务）进行回答，并组织成每日行程。
plugins.productIntroEn: TravCozy keeps every part of your trip together. Ask ChatGPT about your travels and it answers from your real bookings — flights, hotels, trains, car rentals, and transfers imported from any booking site — organized into a day-by-day itinerary.

plugins.name: Traffik Yacht Radar
plugins.productIntro: Traffik 通过现场公共安全广播来衡量世界超级游艇和私人航空的移动情况。询问每周的交通指数（100 = 水上的正常一周）、测量的任何跟踪游艇港口的脉搏（摩纳哥、纽波特、迈阿密、切尔沃港、汉普顿等 150 个）以及进入行政机场的私人飞机和直升机，或者测量超级游艇参加摩纳哥大奖赛等大型活动的情况。每个数字都是楼层，而不是估计值：仅计算指定地理围栏内的广播船只，每个答案都说明了其方法和日期。
plugins.productIntroEn: Traffik measures the movement of the world's superyachts and private aviation from live public safety broadcasts. Ask for the weekly Traffik Index (100 = an ordinary week on the water), the measured pulse of any tracked yachting harbor — Monaco, Newport, Miami, Porto Cervo, the Hamptons and 150 more — plus private jets and helicopters into executive airports, or measured superyacht atten…

plugins.name: FlatHunt
plugins.productIntro: FlatHunt 帮助人们从多家值得信赖的住房提供商那里找到柏林带家具的公寓、单间公寓和私人房间。
plugins.productIntroEn: FlatHunt helps people find furnished apartments, studios, and private rooms in Berlin from multiple trusted housing providers.

plugins.name: DRAIV
plugins.description: 在 苏黎世 租车
plugins.productIntro: DRAIV 是瑞士苏黎世的无钥匙汽车租赁公司。询问您需要什么——周末用的 SUV、今晚的电动汽车、家庭用的七座汽车——DRAIV 会显示实际上免费的东西，并提供瑞士法郎的实际价格和直接预订链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: DRAIV is keyless car rental in Zurich, Switzerland. Ask for what you need — an SUV for the weekend, an electric car tonight, a seven-seater for the family — and DRAIV shows what is actually free, with real prices in Swiss francs and a direct link to book.

plugins.name: Frip
plugins.productIntro: 与 Frip 一起探索韩国独特的当地体验。查找并预订韩国各地的活动、一日课程、社交聚会和兴趣体验，一切尽在一个地方。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover unique local experiences in Korea with Frip. Find and book activities, one-day classes, social gatherings, and hobby experiences across Korea—all in one place.

plugins.name: Parks n Paws
plugins.description: 寻找适合携带宠物狗的公园住宿
plugins.productIntro: Parks n Paws 帮助旅行者找到经过手工审核的美国国家公园附近允许携带宠物狗的酒店。每个清单都强调了实用的宠物政策细节，例如费用、重量限制、品种限制、位置和狗友好设施。我们提供诚实的利弊以及当地的建议，例如附近的兽医、适合狗狗的餐饮以及最佳游览季节。该目录涵盖 60 个美国国家公园和 25 个其他标志性公园和古迹的 1,300 多家酒店。
plugins.productIntroEn: Parks n Paws helps travelers find hand-reviewed dog-friendly hotels near US national parks. Each listing highlights practical pet-policy details such as fees, weight limits, breed restrictions, location, and dog-friendly amenities. We include honest pros and cons plus local tips like nearby vets, dog-friendly dining, and the best season to visit.

plugins.name: Airside Labs Aviation Tools
plugins.productIntro: 为分析师、研究人员和产品团队提供的航空参考工具。充满信心地解析机场、航空公司、飞机类型、注册和航班标识符、历史有效性和来源。检查机场网络集成、运营商和所有权事实、参与例外情况、连接性和乘客规模范围。探索航空人工智能用例目录、数据要求、消息沿袭和 EASA 框架屏幕。仅参考和研究数据：不是实时运营、航班状态、预订或安全控制信息。用户还可以提交产品反馈以供人工审核。
plugins.productIntroEn: Aviation reference tools for analysts, researchers and product teams. Resolve airports, airlines, aircraft types, registrations and flight identifiers with confidence, historical validity and source provenance. Inspect airport network integration, operator and ownership facts, engagement exceptions, connectivity and passenger-size bands.

plugins.name: AuroraReach
plugins.productIntro: AuroraReach 使用实时极光状况、预报、观看建议、历史活动和最近的社区观测，帮助您计划观看北极光的时间和地点。
plugins.productIntroEn: AuroraReach helps you plan when and where to see the northern lights using live aurora conditions, forecasts, viewing recommendations, historical activity and recent community sightings.

plugins.name: Concierge Radar
plugins.productIntro: 从礼宾雷达以实际价格报价住宿，比较选项并从 ChatGPT 为您的客户创建提案草案和链接。需要注册礼宾雷达帐户。它不会自动保留、购买或发送消息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Cotiza hospedaje con tarifas reales de Concierge Radar, compara opciones y crea borradores y ligas de propuestas para tus clientes desde ChatGPT. Requiere una cuenta registrada de Concierge Radar. No reserva, compra ni envía mensajes automáticamente.

plugins.name: pickthehotel
plugins.productIntro: pickthehotel 是酒店的答案引擎。与其一堵墙的结果，不如询问一家符合您在城市意图的酒店，并获得一个自信的选择、一些替代方案和一个预订链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: pickthehotel is an answer engine for hotels. Instead of a wall of results, ask for the one hotel that fits your intent in a city and get a single confident pick, a few alternatives, and a booking link.

plugins.name: WAS Travel Insurance
plugins.productIntro: WAS 旅行保险可帮助用户比较澳大利亚旅行保险计划和单次旅行或年度多次旅行保险的价格，包括可选保险偏好和购买链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: WAS Travel Insurance helps users compare Australian travel-insurance plans and prices for single trips or annual multi-trip cover, including optional cover preferences and purchase links.

plugins.name: Andeor
plugins.productIntro: 通过 Andeor 的当前市场事实探索毛里求斯的当前体验。比较起始价格、持续时间、地点和难度，并查看已公布的团体出发时间。公共应用程序仅供参考，不提供外部链接或交易操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Explore current experiences across Mauritius with current marketplace facts from Andeor. Compare starting prices, duration, location and difficulty, and check published departures for your party. The public app is informational and does not provide external links or transactional actions.

plugins.name: HeyYumi
plugins.productIntro: HeyYumi 可以帮助您找到在韩国吃饭、喝酒或外出的地方——餐馆、咖啡馆、面包店、甜点店和酒吧——并且无需退出聊天即可预订餐桌。每个场馆均来自 Yumi 自己完善的交叉验证数据集（超过 346,000 个场馆，其中首尔、京畿道、釜山和济州最强），每个场馆均附有置信度分数和最后检查日期，因此答案是基于事实而不是猜测的。按 40 多个食品和饮料属性缩小结果 — 社区/车站/地标、美食、价格、氛围、停车、宠物友好、私人房间、素食选择、会说英语的员工、正在营业等。
plugins.productIntroEn: HeyYumi helps you find where to eat, drink, or go out in Korea — restaurants, cafes, bakeries, dessert shops, and bars — and book a table without leaving the chat. Every venue comes from Yumi's own refined, cross-verified dataset (346,000+ venues, strongest in Seoul, Gyeonggi, Busan and Jeju), each shipping with a confidence score and a last-checked date so answers stay grounded rather t…

plugins.name: Roam Rule
plugins.productIntro: Roam Rule 是一款税务居住追踪和旅行限制应用程序，适用于需要可靠记录自己的天数累计情况的外籍人士、创始人、顾问、机组人员和经常旅行者。
plugins.productIntroEn: Roam Rule is a tax residency tracker and travel limits app for expats, founders, consultants, aircrew and frequent travellers who need a trustworthy record of where their days are adding up.

plugins.name: BookMyDestination.com
plugins.productIntro: 在 BookMyDestination.com 上搜索旅游套餐和活动、比较价格、查看详细信息和每日行程，并检查可选择的旅行日期。当前的集成是只读的，不会创建预订或付款。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search BookMyDestination.com for tour packages and activities, compare prices, view details and day-by-day itineraries, and check selectable travel dates. The current integration is read-only and does not create bookings or take payments.

plugins.name: Scioperi
plugins.productIntro: 直接通过 AI 聊天实时查看意大利预定罢工的日历。该插件连接到公共罢工数据，让您可以按部门（交通、学校、医疗保健等）和地区搜索罢工，并使用日期范围过滤器。
plugins.productIntroEn: Check the calendar of scheduled strikes in Italy in real time, directly from your AI chat. The plugin connects to public strike data and lets you search strikes by sector (transport, schools, healthcare, etc.) and by region, with date-range filters.

plugins.name: AgentRoam
plugins.description: 使用加密货币购买旅行 eSIM 卡
plugins.productIntro: AgentRoam 帮助旅行者使用稳定币和加密货币查找和购买旅行 eSIM 数据计划。选择您的目的地，比较可用的套餐，从钱包付款，并在结帐后通过电子邮件接收您的 eSIM 设置详细信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: AgentRoam helps travelers find and buy travel eSIM data plans with stablecoins and crypto. Choose your destination, compare available plans, pay from your wallet, and receive your eSIM setup details by email after checkout.

plugins.name: Travon
plugins.productIntro: Travon 帮助旅行者直接在 ChatGPT 中查看和了解他们的旅行计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: Travon helps travelers view and understand their trip plans directly in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: HOTELS Trip & Travel Stays
plugins.productIntro: 酒店可找到适合您整个旅程的住宿地点，而不仅仅是一个睡觉的地方。
plugins.productIntroEn: HOTELS finds a stay that fits your entire trip—not just a place to sleep.

plugins.name: FREETOUR.com
plugins.productIntro: 通过 FREETOUR.com 探索并预订世界各地的免费徒步旅行、导游体验、活动、一日游和景点门票。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover and book free walking tours, guided experiences, activities, day trips, and attraction tickets around the world with FREETOUR.com.

plugins.name: SeeyaTrip
plugins.productIntro: 搜索 Seeyatrip 酒店目录并引用旅行者自己当日的酒店以及预订链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search the Seeyatrip hotel catalog and cite hotels with booking links on the traveller's own dates.

plugins.name: How is my trip?
plugins.productIntro: 我的旅行怎么样？评估目的地和日期窗口的旅行中断风险，监控旅行的重大变化，解释安静期，并根据已发布的官方来源数据提供当前事件和旅游背景。
plugins.productIntroEn: How is my trip? assesses travel disruption risk for a destination and date window, monitors trips for material changes, explains quiet periods, and provides current event and tourism context from published official-source data.

plugins.name: Sail
plugins.productIntro: Sail 让交通选择变得更简单、更透明。查找地点并比较 24 个以上国家/地区的乘车服务的预估价格、接送时间和可用性。在有公共交通覆盖的地方，Sail 还可以规划行程，包括票价、步行路线、换乘和登机指导。比较同一行程的可用选项并选择最适合您的选项。 Sail 是只读的，不会预订、跟踪或取消行程。结果为估计值，旅行前可能会发生变化。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sail makes transportation choices simpler and more transparent. Find places and compare estimated prices, pickup times, and availability across ride-hailing services in 24+ countries. Where public transport coverage is available, Sail can also plan journeys with fares, walking directions, transfers, and boarding guidance.

plugins.name: Worldschedule
plugins.description: 查找和预订巴士/火车票
plugins.productIntro: 您的巴士和火车旅行的全球伴侣。跳过复杂的搜索过滤器。只需说出您想去的地方，剩下的事情就会由它通过覆盖 100 多个国家/地区 40,000 多个城市和机场的 2,500 多家运营商网络来处理。从机场接送到越野铁路，通过一次无缝对话即可找到最佳路线并立即预订车票。 - 全球覆盖：访问全球数千条巴士和火车路线 - 简单预订：从“我应该去哪里？”开始稍后即可获得已确认的机票 - 实时数据：直接从运营商处获取实时定价和可用性
plugins.productIntroEn: Your global companion for bus and train travel. Skip the complex search filters. Just say where you want to go, and it handles the rest using the network of 2,500+ carriers covering 40K+ cities & airports in 100+ countries. From airport transfers to cross-country rail, find the best routes and book your tickets instantly in one seamless conversation.

plugins.name: Musafir.com: Visa & Travel
plugins.productIntro: Musafir.com Visa 通过 Musafir.com 的实时产品目录解答签证问题：您是否需要签证、签证费用是多少、需要哪些文件、需要多长时间以及 Musafir.com 是否可以为您处理。如果签证需要亲自预约，它还会显示已公布的可用签证中心以及它们上次显示为开放的日期，因此您可以大致了解在做出任何承诺之前多久是现实的。
plugins.productIntroEn: Musafir.com Visa answers visa questions from Musafir.com's live product catalogue: whether you need a visa at all, what it costs, which documents are needed, how long it takes, and whether Musafir.com can process it for you.

plugins.name: VroomVroomVroom - Car Hire
plugins.productIntro: 它仍然是 VroomVroomVroom，只是比以往更快 - 告诉我们您要去哪里以及何时，然后我们将一键为您比较价格。
plugins.productIntroEn: It's still VroomVroomVroom, just faster than ever — tell us where you're going and when, then we'll compare prices for you in one click.

plugins.name: FindCamp
plugins.productIntro: FindCamp 根据分析的公众评论对欧洲露营地给出了中性的适合度判断。询问某个特定的露营地是否适合您的旅行方式——家庭、浅睡者、海滩、自然、质量、狗或情侣——然后得到一个明确的适合或不适合的露营地，两三个原因，以及一个诚实的权衡。它还可以将露营地列入候选名单以进行简介或并排比较两个露营地。 FindCamp 是一个决策层，而不是预订网站：它可以帮助您做出决定，然后为您指明露营地。
plugins.productIntroEn: FindCamp gives neutral fit verdicts for European campsites, built from analysed public comments. Ask whether a specific campsite suits how you travel — family, light sleeper, beach, nature, quality, dog, or couple — and get a clear fit or no-fit, two or three reasons, and one honest tradeoff. It can also shortlist campsites for a profile or compare two side by side.

plugins.name: Aman
plugins.productIntro: 探索安缦的世界。规划您的住宿、探索目的地并了解安缦精心打造的餐饮、健康和文化体验。查看首选日期的可用客房和价格，并查看您选择的住宿，然后继续前往安缦预订网站预订。请注意，预订不能在 ChatGPT 内完成。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover the world of Aman. Plan your stay, explore destinations and learn about dining, wellness and cultural experiences crafted by Aman. Check available rooms and rates for preferred dates and review your selected stay before continuing to Aman’s booking site to reserve. Please note, reservations are not completed within ChatGPT.

plugins.name: StayVisible
plugins.productIntro: StayVisible 将 ChatGPT 连接到实时度假租赁库存。告诉它你想去哪里、你的日期以及有多少客人，它就会搜索可用的房产，根据房东的预订日历检查实时可用性，返回详细的报价，并生成指向房东自己网站的直接预订链接。无 OTA 佣金、无需安装应用程序、无需帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: StayVisible connects ChatGPT to live vacation rental inventory. Tell it where you want to go, your dates, and how many guests, and it searches available properties, checks real-time availability against the host's booking calendar, returns an itemized price quote, and generates a direct booking link to the host's own site. No OTA commission, no app to install, no account required.

plugins.name: StayFritz
plugins.productIntro: StayFritz 帮助旅行者发现度假屋和酒店、检查可用的住宿并继续安全的预订流程。按目的地、日期、客人数量和旅行偏好进行搜索，然后查看酒店详细信息、价格、设施和预订选项。最终可用性和付款将在 StayFritz 结账时确认。
plugins.productIntroEn: StayFritz helps travelers discover vacation rentals and hotels, check available stays, and continue to a secure booking flow. Search by destination, dates, number of guests, and travel preferences, then view property details, prices, amenities, and booking options. Final availability and payment are confirmed during checkout on StayFritz.

plugins.name: Zuzli
plugins.productIntro: Zuzli 帮助旅行者创建、验证、查看和更新日常行程，包括站点、路线、时间表和实时行程进度。
plugins.productIntroEn: Zuzli helps travelers create, validate, view, and update day-by-day itineraries, including stops, routes, schedules, and live trip progress.

plugins.name: The Visa Services
plugins.productIntro: 签证服务通过内部知识库回答您的签证问题：可用的国家和签证类型、处理时间、费用、所需文件和申请要求。 用任何语言提问并以同一种语言获得答案。 如果问题需要更多详细信息，该插件会询问您指的是哪个国家或签证类型。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Visa Services answers your visa questions from the internal knowledge base: which countries and visa types are available, processing times, fees, required documents and application requirements. Ask in any language and get the answer in the same language. If the question needs more detail, the plugin asks which country or visa type you mean.

plugins.name: Radisson Hotels
plugins.productIntro: 现在直接在 ChatGPT 中发现并计划您的丽笙住宿。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover and plan your Radisson stay, now directly in ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Nieves Alaska Relocation
plugins.productIntro: Nieves Alaska Relocation 帮助用户构建阿拉斯加搬迁计划，使用中性标准比较受支持的社区，估计广泛的抵押贷款成交成本和 VA 融资费用范围，准备授权的外部财产搜索，并在不收集 ChatGPT 内部联系信息的情况下创建到 Nieves de Alaska 的隐私保护移交。
plugins.productIntroEn: Nieves Alaska Relocation helps users structure an Alaska move, compare supported communities using neutral criteria, estimate broad mortgage closing-cost and VA funding-fee ranges, prepare an authorized external property search, and create a privacy-preserving handoff to Nieves de Alaska without collecting contact information inside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: JPS — Award Search & Watch
plugins.productIntro: BookLikeJoël 的 JPS 允许互联会员搜索实时奖励航班可用性、查看里程计划结果以及通过 ChatGPT 管理私人 JPS 航班监视。 JPS 不预订、持有、预订或签发机票，也绝不会伪造实时库存、里程价格、税费、座位数、时刻表、航空公司或预订链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: JPS by BookLikeJoël lets connected members search live award-flight availability, review mileage-program results, and manage private JPS flight watches from ChatGPT. JPS does not book, hold, reserve, or issue tickets, and it never fabricates live inventory, mileage prices, taxes, seat counts, schedules, airlines, or booking links.

plugins.name: RegioJet
plugins.productIntro: RegioJet 是您的旅行伴侣。跳过复杂的搜索过滤器。只需输入您想去的地方，它就会处理剩下的事情：通过无缝对话找到最佳路线并立即预订机票。
plugins.productIntroEn: Your companion for travel with RegioJet. Skip the complex search filters. Just type where you want to go, and it handles the rest: find the best routes and book your tickets instantly in one seamless conversation.

plugins.name: Ivon
plugins.description: 出租沙滩宝贝户外派对
plugins.productIntro: Ivon 是一个点对点市场，可让您租赁：
plugins.productIntroEn: Ivon is the peer-to-peer marketplace that lets you rent:

plugins.name: SplashScout
plugins.description: 寻找适合家庭入住的酒店
plugins.productIntro: SplashScout 查找家庭水上度假酒店和露营地，并根据泳池、滑梯、戏水区、儿童俱乐部和宾客评论，针对旅行年龄（幼儿、儿童和青少年）对每家酒店和露营地进行评分。它返回带有每个年龄分数、水景、客人评分和预订链接的互动卡。
plugins.productIntroEn: SplashScout finds family water-holiday hotels and campsites and scores each one for the ages travelling — toddlers, kids and teens — based on pools, slides, splash zones, kids' clubs and guest reviews. It returns interactive cards with per-age scores, water features, guest ratings and booking links.

plugins.name: billiger-mietwagen.de
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 查找并比较来自德国领先提供商的租车。指定您的目的地、日期和偏好，以找到最优惠的价格。比较主要租赁公司的价格，按车辆类型、保险选项和取车地点筛选结果，并获取包含价格、条款和条件的详细报价细目。找到您的租车后，请通过 Billiger Mietwagen 的网站预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find and compare rental cars from leading providers in Germany directly from ChatGPT. Specify your destination, dates, and preferences to find the best deals. Compare prices across major rental companies, filter results by vehicle type, insurance options, and pick-up location, and get detailed offer breakdowns with pricing, terms, and conditions.

plugins.name: tabiori
plugins.productIntro: tabiori 帮助旅行者通过 ChatGPT 对话创建和更新可共享的旅行计划。用户将 tabiori 帐户与 OAuth 连接后，该插件可以创建保存的旅行计划，添加或更新行程、日程、清单、笔记、剪贴簿留言、聊天消息、图像、酒店候选和共享链接。更改将保存到用户的 tabiori 帐户中，以便可以在 tabiori 中打开和共享计划。
plugins.productIntroEn: tabiori helps travelers create and update shareable trip plans from ChatGPT conversations. After users connect their tabiori account with OAuth, the plugin can create a saved travel plan, add or update itineraries, schedules, checklists, notes, scraps, chat messages, images, hotel candidates, and sharing links.

plugins.name: Sóley
plugins.productIntro: Sóley 帮助旅行者发现冰岛旅游运营商、检查实时供应情况和价格、预订运营商运营的服务并为其付费、跟踪预订状态、联系人工运营商以及咨询实时冰岛旅游信息。运营商仍然是记录商户，付款在 ChatGPT 之外的运营商托管支付页面上完成。
plugins.productIntroEn: Sóley helps travelers discover Iceland tourism operators, check live availability and prices, reserve and pay for operator-run services, follow booking status, contact human operators, and consult live Iceland travel information. Operators remain the merchant of record and payment is completed on the operator's hosted payment page outside ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Topo
plugins.productIntro: Topo 是一项服务，让人们通过将信息锚定到现实世界的位置来发现某个地方或城市现在正在发生的事情。 Topo 插件通过引用安全存储的本地记忆来回答有关地点和城市的问题。当连接到 Topo 帐户时，它还可以将个性化上下文合并到对话中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Topo is a service that lets people discover what's happening now in a place or city by anchoring information to real-world locations. The Topo plugin answers questions about places and cities by referring to safely stored local memories. When connected to a Topo account, it can also incorporate personalized context into the conversation.

plugins.name: Flyin
plugins.productIntro: 作为沙特阿拉伯及周边地区最大的旅行平台之一，Flyin 受到超过百万客户的信赖，提供无缝的机票预订和旅行体验。
plugins.productIntroEn: As one of the largest travel platforms in Saudi Arabia and the nearby regions, Flyin is trusted by more than one million customers for seamless air ticket booking and travel experiences.

plugins.name: MapQuest
plugins.productIntro: 获取任意两个地址之间的行车路线，并将当前路况纳入您的预计抵达时间。搜索某个位置附近的餐馆、商店、服务场所和其他场所，并查看每个场所的距离。查找地址的确切坐标，或查找一组坐标的最近地址。跑腿还是送货？向 MapQuest 提供您的站点列表，它会计算出最有效的访问顺序。沿途的交通事故和施工都会被标记出来，以便您在出发前知道会发生什么。
plugins.productIntroEn: Get driving directions between any two addresses, with current traffic factored into your estimated arrival time. Search for restaurants, shops, services and other places near a location, and see how far away each one is. Look up the exact coordinates for an address, or find the nearest address for a set of coordinates.

plugins.name: eSIM-Global.VIP
plugins.description: 查找旅行 eSIM 计划
plugins.productIntro: eSIM-Global.VIP 可帮助旅行者查找 200 多个国家/地区的预付费移动数据 eSIM 计划、比较计划详细信息和价格，并获得购买所选计划的直接交接链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: eSIM-Global.VIP helps travellers find prepaid mobile-data eSIM plans for 200+ countries, compare plan details and prices, and get a direct handoff link to buy a selected plan.

plugins.name: Houfy
plugins.productIntro: 按目的地、日期、客人、价格、房产类型和设施搜索胡菲实时度假出租屋。比较房源照片、价格、评级和空房情况，检查所选酒店的公开详细信息，然后继续直接通过 Houfy 预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search live Houfy vacation rentals by destination, dates, guests, price, property type, and amenities. Compare listing photos, pricing, ratings, and availability, inspect a selected property's public details, and continue to Houfy to book directly.

plugins.name: Le Bon Road Trip Planner
plugins.productIntro: Le Bon Road Trip Planner 可让您直接在 ChatGPT 中查找已保存的行程并创建或更新行程、停靠点、笔记、旅行故事、地点、照片和预算。每个操作都仅限于关联的帐户，与旅行相关的结果包括用于查看规划器中更改的链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Le Bon Road Trip Planner lets you find your saved trips and create or update itineraries, stops, notes, travel stories, places, photos, and budgets directly in ChatGPT. Every action is limited to the connected account, and trip-related results include a link to review changes in the Planner.

plugins.name: ChooseCruise
plugins.productIntro: ChooseCruise 可帮助用户按目的地、港口、日期、游轮线路、价格和持续时间搜索实时海洋和河流游轮库存，比较匹配的航班，检查详细的行程和客舱信息，并在准备预订时继续 ChooseCruise。
plugins.productIntroEn: ChooseCruise helps users search live ocean and river cruise inventory by destination, ports, dates, cruise line, price, and duration, compare matching sailings, inspect detailed itineraries and cabin information, and continue to ChooseCruise when ready to book.

plugins.name: Yescapa
plugins.productIntro: Yescapa 是世界领先的露营车和房车租赁市场，为旅行者提供来自欧洲、英国、美国、加拿大和澳大利亚的数千辆私人车主和专业人士的车辆。
plugins.productIntroEn: Yescapa is the world's leading campervan and motorhome rental marketplace, connecting travelers with thousands of vehicles from private owners and professionals across Europe, UK, USA, Canada and Australia.

plugins.name: Roovook
plugins.productIntro: 搜索韩国各地的活动场地和团体住宿，查看场地详细信息，请求和比较报价，并通过 Roovook 协调场地预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search event venues and group accommodations across South Korea, review venue details, request and compare quotes, and coordinate bookings with venues through Roovook.

plugins.name: Transferhood
plugins.productIntro: 通过 Transferhood 预订可靠的全球私人机场接送服务。查找和管理机场交通、查看接送详情，并享受从预订到抵达的无缝旅行体验。
plugins.productIntroEn: Book reliable private airport transfers worldwide with Transferhood. Find and manage airport transportation, view transfer details, and enjoy a seamless travel experience from booking to arrival.

plugins.name: ENUYGUN
plugins.productIntro: 实惠的机票、酒店预订、巴士票、租车服务全在ENUYGUN上提供！比较选项、个性化您的选择、找到最优惠的价格并享受无缝的旅行体验。
plugins.productIntroEn: Affordable flight tickets, hotel reservations, bus tickets, and car rental services are all available on ENUYGUN! Compare options, personalize your choices, find the best deals, and enjoy a seamless travel experience.

plugins.name: eSIMradar
plugins.description: 比较旅行 eSIM 计划
plugins.productIntro: eSIMradar 比较了 210 多个目的地的 60 多家提供商的预付费旅行 eSIM 数据计划，以便旅行者可以了解他们要去的地方的移动数据实际费用是多少。
plugins.productIntroEn: eSIMradar compares prepaid travel eSIM data plans from 60+ providers across 210+ destinations, so a traveller can see what mobile data actually costs where they are going.

plugins.name: trip1
plugins.description: 预订酒店，使用加密货币付款
plugins.productIntro: trip1 可以让代理搜索、比较和预订真实的酒店库存——200 多个国家/地区的大约 300 万家酒店。按目的地和日期搜索，检查房间、价格和取消条款，然后创建预订并使用 USDC on Base over x402 付款（或通过基于浏览器的加密结帐）。付款结算后，预订将自动确认。
plugins.productIntroEn: trip1 lets agents search, compare and book real hotel inventory — roughly 3 million properties in 200+ countries. Search by destination and dates, inspect rooms, rates and cancellation terms, then create a reservation and pay in USDC on Base over x402 (or via a browser-based crypto checkout). Bookings confirm automatically once payment settles.

plugins.name: One Step Travel
plugins.productIntro: 通过个性化行程和预估旅行费用来计划旅行。 One Step Travel 可以估算前往特定目的地的旅行费用，制定每日旅行计划，并建议适合旅行者预算的美国目的地。
plugins.productIntroEn: Plan trips with personalized itineraries and estimated travel costs. One Step Travel can estimate the cost of a trip to a specific destination, create day-by-day trip plans, and suggest U.S. destinations that fit a traveler's budget.

plugins.name: Instafan
plugins.productIntro: Instafan 帮助团体一起决定去哪里。询问心情并获得真实的目的地建议，实时了解任何城市的情况（本月天气、官方安全判决），在聊天中查看 Google 评级最强的地点以及真实照片，并根据它们制定每日计划。没有什么是虚构的：每个地方都是真实的、经过评级的地点。只需一个链接即可进入 instafan.app，您的整个团队都可以沉浸在 3D 环境中、保存名额并进行投票。
plugins.productIntroEn: Instafan helps groups decide where to go — together. Ask for a mood and get real destination suggestions, pull a live brief on any city (weather this month, official safety verdict), see its strongest Google-rated places with real photos right in the chat, and get a day-by-day plan built from them. Nothing is invented: every place is a real, rated spot.

plugins.name: Stayonomy
plugins.productIntro: Stayonomy 以真实的、可预订的价格而不是预估价格来回答旅行问题。它比较了两个城市之间的各种交通方式——航班、火车、公共汽车和渡轮——以及持续时间和当前缓存票价（以欧元为单位）；找到最便宜的飞行日期和月份；列出每晚价格的酒店；并涵盖行程的其余部分：目的地租车、预付费旅行 eSIM 计划（包含 200 多个目的地的目录价格）、旅游和门票、城市指南以及每月气候建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Stayonomy answers travel questions with real, bookable prices instead of estimates. It compares every way to get between two cities - flight, train, bus and ferry - with durations and current cached fares in EUR; finds the cheapest days and months to fly; lists hotels with nightly rates; and covers the rest of the trip too: car rental at the destination, prepaid travel eSIM plans with ca…

plugins.name: Condor
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中计划您与 Condor 的下一次旅行。从世界各地的目的地中获取灵感，探索最适合您在不同路线、月份和季节的计划的旅行选择，并为您的旅行团比较合适的单程或往返航班。了解航班时间、舱位等级、票价选项和包含的服务 - 并开始期待您的下一次冒险。
plugins.productIntroEn: Plan your next trip with Condor directly in ChatGPT. Get inspired by destinations around the world, explore the travel options that best suit your plans across different routes, months, and seasons, and compare suitable one-way or round-trip flights for your travel party.

plugins.name: BonjourRATP
plugins.productIntro: Hello RATP 可帮助您找到最适合您的法兰西岛最佳公共交通路线。
plugins.productIntroEn: Bonjour RATP vous aide à trouver le meilleur itinéraire en transports en commun en Île‑de‑France, rien que pour vous.

plugins.name: HopeGoo
plugins.productIntro: 官方 HopeGoo 酒店查找器。用自然语言描述您的旅行需求，并获取推荐酒店的价格、评级以及指向 HopeGoo 详细信息页面的直接链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: Official HopeGoo hotel finder. Describe your travel needs in natural language and get recommended hotels with prices, ratings, and direct links to HopeGoo detail pages.

plugins.name: K-Beauty, Spa & Hair Booking
plugins.productIntro: 通过 TIMEPLEX 探索并预订韩国各地的美容和健康服务。 在首尔、釜山、济州岛和其他目的地寻找水疗中心、按摩店、美发沙龙、护肤和面部工作室、美甲沙龙和头皮护理。比较国际游客的服务、价格、地点、可用时间和语言支持。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover and book beauty and wellness services across Korea with TIMEPLEX. Find spas, massage shops, hair salons, skincare and facial studios, nail salons, and scalp treatments in Seoul, Busan, Jeju, and other destinations. Compare services, prices, locations, available times, and language support for international visitors.

plugins.name: TripCanvas
plugins.productIntro: TripCanvas 是 ChatGPT 内的人工智能旅行社、旅行规划器和旅行行程构建器。它将您的日期、目的地、兴趣、限制、首选步速和旅行同伴转变为一个完整的公共旅行网站：一条地理上连贯的路线、每日行程、过夜基地、驾驶距离、道路名称、地图、游览地点以及为整个团体提供的一个可共享链接中的优先预订。用户通过OAuth连接TripCanvas帐户；每个 UTC 月包含一个新网站，而重新开放和共享不会消耗另一配额单位。
plugins.productIntroEn: TripCanvas is an AI travel agent, trip planner, and travel itinerary builder inside ChatGPT. It turns your dates, destination, interests, constraints, preferred pace, and travel companions into a complete public trip website: a geographically coherent route, day-by-day itinerary, overnight bases, driving distances, road names, maps, places to see, and priority bookings in one shareable l…

plugins.name: Holiday Autos
plugins.description: 通过租车节省开支并探索
plugins.productIntro: 在假日汽车，我们让租车变得简单。无论您要去哪里，我们都会以最优惠的价格为您找到最好的汽车。在全球 50,000 多个取车地点享受优质租车服务。
plugins.productIntroEn: Here at Holiday Autos we make car hire easy. Wherever you’re going, we find you the best car at the best possible price. Get great car hire across 50,000+ pickup locations worldwide.

plugins.name: Flaut.Travel
plugins.productIntro: 利用数据驱动的旅行见解寻找更好的航班并决定去哪里。搜索特定日期的机票，探索全年价格趋势，比较出发和到达机场，查看直飞航班可用性和运营航空公司，并根据您喜欢的气候、大陆和预算发现目的地。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find better flights and decide where to go with data-driven travel insights. Search airfare for specific dates, explore year-round price trends, compare departure and arrival airports, see direct-flight availability and operating airlines, and discover destinations based on your preferred climate, continent, and budget.

plugins.name: Forktime
plugins.productIntro: Forktime 在使用 Forktime 进行预订的餐厅预订餐桌。
plugins.productIntroEn: Forktime books tables at restaurants that use Forktime for reservations.

plugins.name: Baraglo Travel Insurance
plugins.productIntro: 比较飞机、巴拉格洛国际航线的珍贵物品和安全保障。获得个性化的目的地、生活、生活和居住环境。修改联合国、欧洲、申根区、加拿大和拉丁美洲的受益权和目的地要求。请注意 24 小时内，每天都要做的事情。
plugins.productIntroEn: Compara planes, precios y coberturas de seguros de viaje internacionales con Baraglo. Obtén cotizaciones personalizadas según el destino, las fechas de viaje, la edad de los viajeros y el país de residencia. Revisa los beneficios disponibles y los requisitos de viaje para destinos como Estados Unidos, Europa, el espacio Schengen, Canadá y Latinoamérica.

plugins.name: Piazza in Festa
plugins.description: 意大利小镇活动和集市
plugins.productIntro: 节日广场回答了有关意大利城镇正在发生的事情的问题：乡村盛宴、守护神节日、食品和葡萄酒博览会、街头市场、音乐会和展览。该目录每天都会根据市政厅依法必须在其官方登记册上发布的通知进行重建，因此它还涵盖了其他日历中没有列出的非常小的城镇。用户可以按城镇、地区、类别、自由文本或日期范围进行搜索，打开单个活动以获取日期、地点和组织者等实用详细信息，并询问某个地区涵盖哪些城镇。每个结果都带有指向活动页面及其来源的官方文档的链接，因此可以验证答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Piazza in Festa answers questions about what is happening in Italian towns: village feasts, patron saint festivals, food and wine fairs, street markets, concerts and exhibitions. The catalogue is rebuilt every day from the notices that town halls are legally required to publish on their official register, so it also covers very small towns that no other calendar lists.

plugins.name: ReturnOS Hospitality Commerce
plugins.description: 查找住宿和实时直接房价
plugins.productIntro: 搜索可直接预订的住宿，查看实时供应情况和当前直接价格，然后继续使用房东的直接预订路径。实时结果来自 ReturnOS 库存和定价。预订和付款仍由客人控制。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search direct-bookable accommodation, check live availability and current direct prices, and continue to the host’s direct booking path. Live results come from ReturnOS inventory and pricing. Booking and payment remain guest-controlled.

plugins.name: BirdWatch
plugins.productIntro: 从 BirdWatch 目录中探索已发布的观鸟之旅。按目的地、目标鸟类、旅游方式、持续时间、日期和预算搜索；阅读可用的行程和旅游详情；并点击 BirdWatch 链接进行查询。价格、供应情况和野生动物观赏情况需要确认。 BirdWatch 不会通过此集成预订行程或发送查询。
plugins.productIntroEn: Explore published birdwatching tours from the BirdWatch catalogue. Search by destination, target birds, tour style, duration, dates and budget; read available itineraries and tour details; and follow BirdWatch links to make an inquiry. Prices, availability and wildlife sightings require confirmation. BirdWatch does not book trips or send inquiries through this integration.

plugins.name: Metro MCP
plugins.description: 实时 DC 和 NYC 交通
plugins.productIntro: Metro MCP 提供华盛顿特区和纽约市的免费、实时、只读公共交通信息。检查火车到站、搜索车站、检查服务事件和电梯停运、查看巴士和火车位置以及查找纽约市路线详细信息。交互式交通板使结果易于扫描，并为其他客户提供文本和结构化后备。无需 Metro MCP 登录、凭据或购买。
plugins.productIntroEn: Metro MCP provides free, live, read-only public transit information for Washington, DC and New York City. Check train arrivals, search stations, inspect service incidents and elevator outages, view bus and train positions, and look up NYC route details. The interactive Transit Board keeps results easy to scan, with text and structured fallbacks for other clients.

plugins.name: Tineo
plugins.productIntro: Tineo 通过 ChatGPT 帮助您组织旅行计划。连接您的 Tineo 帐户以查找您的行程、查看行程详细信息，并将航班、住宿、交通和活动放在一起。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tineo helps you organize travel plans through ChatGPT. Connect your Tineo account to find your trips, view itinerary details, and keep flights, stays, transport, and activities together.

plugins.name: Wave by Vento
plugins.description: 计划您的 Wave 2026 访问
plugins.productIntro: Wave by Vento 帮助与会者探索已确认的 Wave 2026 会议和演讲者，浏览视觉议程和现场会外活动，并找到有关旅行、通行证、场地使用、政策和与会者支持的基于来源的答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Wave by Vento helps attendees explore confirmed Wave 2026 sessions and speakers, browse a visual agenda and live side events, and find source-grounded answers about travel, passes, venue access, policies, and attendee support.

plugins.name: Futrumi
plugins.productIntro: Futrumi 是一个捷克美食小贴士平台：知名美食评论家、厨师、侍酒师和美食记者分享他们真正喜欢的饮食地点以及他们推荐的具体菜肴或饮料。该插件将整理、发布的数据引入 ChatGPT，这样您就可以询问今晚 Vinohrady 去哪里吃饭，或者 Michal Danek 推荐什么，并获得真正的专家意见，而不是汇总的评论分数。
plugins.productIntroEn: Futrumi is a Czech food-tip platform: named food critics, chefs, sommeliers and gastronomy journalists share where they actually like to eat and drink, and the exact dish or drink they recommend. This plugin brings that curated, published data into ChatGPT, so you can ask where to eat in Vinohrady tonight, or what Michal Danek recommends, and get real expert opinions instead of aggregate…

plugins.name: Secret World — Hidden Gems
plugins.description: 寻找世界各地隐藏的宝石
plugins.productIntro: Secret World — Hidden Gems 让 ChatGPT 可以直接访问包含全球 340,000 多个鲜为人知的地点和 750,000 多张原始照片的精选目录。
plugins.productIntroEn: Secret World — Hidden Gems gives ChatGPT direct access to a curated catalog of 340,000+ lesser-known places and 750,000+ original photos worldwide.

plugins.name: AHORN Hotels & Resorts
plugins.productIntro: 直接在您的应用程序中探索 AHORN Hotels & Resorts 的世界。寻找完美的酒店，方便地在线预订您的下一个假期，并在您的住宿期间享受独家优惠、最新信息和实用服务。无论是家庭度假、积极度假、轻松休息还是短途旅行，AHORN 应用程序都会陪伴您从最初的灵感到您的抵达。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover the world of AHORN Hotels & Resorts right in your app. Find the perfect hotel, book your next vacation conveniently online, and take advantage of exclusive offers, the latest information, and practical services for your stay.

plugins.name: PlanYourTrip
plugins.productIntro: 根据真实旅行数据规划多城市往返旅行。发现一个国家或地区访问量最大的城市，逐站构建路线，并在“规划您的行程”规划器中的交互式地图上打开完成的行程 - 您可以在其中调整站点和夜晚，并获取费用和酒店估算。无需帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: Plan multi-city round trips from real-world travel data. Discover the most-visited cities in a country or region, build a route stop by stop, and open the finished trip on an interactive map in the Plan Your Trip planner — where you can adjust stops and nights and get cost and hotel estimates. No account needed.

plugins.name: Archer Hotel
plugins.productIntro: ChatGPT 的 Archer Hotel 应用程序可让您探索 Archer Hotel 位置并直接在对话中访问关键详细信息。您可以查看有关每家酒店的信息，包括设施、服务和一般酒店特色。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Archer Hotel app for ChatGPT lets you explore Archer Hotel locations and access key details directly within your conversation. You can view information about each property, including amenities, services, and general hotel features.

plugins.name: Motion4rent
plugins.productIntro: Motion4rent 可让您通过值得信赖的当地合作伙伴网络，在全球数千个城市查找和比较移动设备租赁 — 手动和电动轮椅、移动滑板车、膝助行器、助行车和类似的移动辅助设备。它仅涵盖行动辅助设备：不包括自行车、电动自行车、摩托车或汽车。
plugins.productIntroEn: Motion4rent lets you find and compare mobility equipment rentals — manual and electric wheelchairs, mobility scooters, knee walkers, rollators and similar mobility aids — in thousands of cities worldwide, through a network of trusted local partners. It covers mobility aids only: not bicycles, e-bikes, motorbikes or cars.

plugins.name: Columbus Yacht Booking
plugins.productIntro: 检查迪拜的实时哥伦布游艇可用性，匹配可容纳所需团体的游艇，并在用户选择游艇后准备预先填写的官方预订链接。 该插件是只读的：它不会创建预授权、收取押金或确认预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Checks live Columbus yacht availability in Dubai, matches yachts that can accommodate the requested group, and prepares a prefilled official booking link after the user chooses a yacht. The plugin is read-only: it does not create a hold, charge a deposit, or confirm a booking.

plugins.name: NEWT（ニュート）
plugins.productIntro: 使用 ChatGPT 探索 NEWT，一款智能且超值的旅行应用程序。 只需在对话中告诉我们您的目的地、旅行日期和预算，任何人都可以轻松找到最适合自己的海外旅游套餐。 当您找到感兴趣的旅行时，只需点击“在 NEWT 上查看”即可顺利轻松预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Use ChatGPT to explore NEWT, the smart and great-value travel app. Just tell us your destination, travel dates, and budget in a conversation, and anyone can easily find overseas tour packages that suit them perfectly. When you find a tour you’re interested in, simply tap “View on NEWT” to book smoothly and effortlessly.

plugins.name: 이심통
plugins.productIntro: 我们会根据您旅行的国家、时段、流量使用情况，推荐Leesimtong的实体USIM卡产品。您还可以在博客中找到旅行沟通技巧、激活方法、使用 Google 地图的信息以及旅行准备文章。确保您的数据安全，让您的旅行准备轻松。
plugins.productIntroEn: 여행 국가, 기간, 데이터 사용량에 맞춰 이심통의 실물 USIM 상품을 추천합니다. 블로그 속 여행 통신 팁, 개통 방법, 구글맵 활용 정보, 여행 준비 글도 함께 찾아드립니다. 데이터는 든든하게, 여행 준비는 가볍게 챙겨가세요.

plugins.name: PackRat
plugins.description: 更智能地计划旅行和打包
plugins.productIntro: PackRat 帮助户外旅行者计划旅行并制定更好的装箱单。通过关键词或自然语言搜索户外装备的大型目录，比较产品的重量和价格，并整理装箱清单，分析总重量以及基础、磨损和消耗品明细。寻求较轻的替代品来代替最重的物品，查找特定旅行的间隙，检查目的地的近期天气预报，浏览户外指南，并将旅行和背包保存到与移动应用程序同步的 PackRat 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: PackRat helps outdoor travelers plan trips and build better packing lists. Search a large catalog of outdoor gear by keyword or natural language, compare products on weight and price, and assemble packing lists that are analyzed for total weight with a base, worn, and consumable breakdown.

plugins.name: Tixxly
plugins.productIntro: Tixxly 帮助您发现并预订来自世界各地供应商的旅游、活动和当地旅行体验。浏览可用的体验，检查可用性和定价，并直接通过对话进行预订。由当地运营商的实时库存提供支持——无中间商加价。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tixxly helps you discover and book tours, activities, and local travel experiences from suppliers around the world. Browse available experiences, check availability and pricing, and book directly through the conversation. Powered by real-time inventory from local operators -- no middleman markup.

plugins.name: Hotel Liabeny
plugins.productIntro: Hotel Liabeny Assistant可帮助客人通过聊天查找酒店信息并完成常见的预订任务。 用户可以询问有关Hotel Liabeny酒店的问题，包括客房、设施、酒店服务、政策和入住/退房时间。助理还可以检查房间可用性并列出可选的房间附加服务。 如果客人已经预订，助理可以检索预订详细信息，并在提供所需的预订信息后帮助修改或取消现有预订。 如果客人需要帮助，助理还可以帮助创建新的预订并向酒店发送支持请求。
plugins.productIntroEn: Hotel Liabeny Assistant helps guests find hotel information and complete common reservation tasks through chat. Users can ask questions about Hotel Liabeny, including rooms, amenities, hotel services, policies, and check-in/check-out times. The assistant can also check room availability and list optional room extras.

plugins.name: Remjet
plugins.description: 保存拍摄地点，规划行程
plugins.productIntro: Remjet by StudioTHM可帮助摄影师保存拍摄地点，将其整理到列表中，并规划ChatGPT的摄影之旅。 通过插件创建的引脚保持私有，直到用户选择从Remjet发布它们。
plugins.productIntroEn: Remjet by StudioTHM helps photographers save locations, organize them into lists, and plan photography trips from ChatGPT. Pins created through the plugin stay private until the user chooses to publish them from Remjet.

plugins.name: Provue
plugins.description: 比较航班和实验室测试
plugins.productIntro: Provue：比较航班和实验室测试。
plugins.productIntroEn: Provue helps users compare available flight fares, travel options, diagnostic tests, health packages, and home sample-collection availability before deciding what to book or buy.

plugins.name: Klook
plugins.description: 查找旅行目的地的活动与体验。
plugins.productIntro: 无论您身在何处，Klook客路都可以帮助您发现和预订要做的事情。描述您要寻找的内容 - 您的目的地、日期和兴趣 - 并获取包含价格、评论和照片等重要详细信息的相关选项列表。
plugins.productIntroEn: Klook helps you discover and book things to do wherever you are. Describe what you're looking for — your destination, dates, and interests — and get a list of relevant options with important details like price, reviews, and photos.

plugins.name: CatamaranSite
plugins.productIntro: CatamaranSite列出了全球销售的双体船—帆船和动力，从 国际经纪公司和出售自己船只的私人业主。
plugins.productIntroEn: CatamaranSite lists catamarans for sale worldwide — sailing and power, from international brokerages and from private owners selling their own boat.

plugins.name: Vacanța România
plugins.productIntro: Vacanța România：查找罗马尼亚的景点。
plugins.productIntroEn: Vacanța România helps you discover verified tourist attractions across Romania: natural sites, castles and fortresses, monasteries and churches, museums, and hiking areas. Ask what to visit in a county or town, what is near you within a chosen radius, or explore by theme — nature, history, culture, lesser-known places.

plugins.name: Cortenoi
plugins.productIntro: 通过优雅且即时的信息体验探索 Bitetto 的 Corte Noi：在单个应用程序中概述历史建筑、服务、房间和官方联系方式。非常适合了解 Corte Noi 的热情好客，并快速了解位置和有用信息。
plugins.productIntroEn: Scopri Corte Noi a Bitetto con un’esperienza informativa elegante e immediata: panoramica della struttura storica, servizi, camere e contatti ufficiali in un’unica app. Perfetta per conoscere l’ospitalità di Corte Noi e orientarti rapidamente su posizione e informazioni utili.

plugins.name: 카카오 T 길찾기
plugins.description: 查找前往目的地的最佳路线。
plugins.productIntro: 通过 Kakao T 计划您前往目的地的旅程。 如果您告诉我们人数、情况以及目的地，我们将建议最佳路线，包括火车、巴士和私家车。 您可以一目了然地比较每种方式的预计时间和费用，找到适合您的交通方式，甚至可以通过Kakao T应用程序进行实际预订和打电话。
plugins.productIntroEn: 카카오 T와 함께 목적지까지의 이동 계획을 세워보세요. 목적지와 함께 인원이나 상황을 이야기하면 기차, 버스, 자차를 아우르는 최적의 경로를 제안합니다. 각 수단별 예상 시간과 비용을 한눈에 비교해 나에게 딱 맞는 이동 방법을 찾을 수 있으며, 실제 예약과 호출까지 카카오 T 앱에서 간편하게 연결됩니다.

plugins.name: BookYolo
plugins.description: 检查您下次入住的健康状况
plugins.productIntro: BookYolo 是一款人工智能驱动的旅行工具，旨在帮助您在预订前检查酒店和度假屋的质量。该平台分析公开列表信息和客人反馈，以发现致命缺陷、隐藏的危险信号、评论模式、过度销售和营销技巧、费用意外以及旅行者经常错过的期望差距。 BookYolo 超越了评级和表面评论，通过 100 点检查对每处房产进行深入分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: BookYolo is an AI-powered travel tool designed to help you inspect the quality of hotels and vacation rentals before you book them. The platform analyzes public listing information and guest feedback to surface fatal flaws, hidden red flags, review patterns, overselling and marketing techniques, fee surprises and expectation gaps that travelers often miss.

plugins.name: Lion Travel 雄獅旅遊
plugins.description: 搜尋團體旅遊、機票、住宿與票券

plugins.name: Enzo Reader for RSS Feeds

plugins.productIntroEn: Enzo Reader helps you keep up with your RSS feeds and news articles. You can catch up on your latest stories, filter by unread items, favorites, feeds, tags, or date ranges, search by what an article really says, open the full text when you want more detail, and quickly mark things read, unread, or saved.

plugins.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to the PoGo Showcase Manager through its MCP server.

plugins.name: Gomoku
plugins.productIntro: 无需离开 ChatGPT 或创建其他帐户，即可与 AI 进行完整的五子棋游戏。立即在官方 15×15 锦标赛棋盘上开始，选择黑色或白色，并使用简单、普通或困难 AI 来匹配您的技能。您还可以要求快速的 13×13 游戏或宽敞的 19×19 棋盘。选择标准五子棋、自由式五连棋或专业连珠规则以及黑方的上线、双四和双三禁棋。 Pro 和 Long Pro 开局可用于削弱黑棋的先手优势。
plugins.productIntroEn: Play a complete game of Gomoku against AI without leaving ChatGPT or creating another account. Start instantly on the official 15×15 tournament board, choose Black or White, and match your skill with Easy, Normal, or Hard AI. You can also request a quick 13×13 game or a spacious 19×19 board.

plugins.name: Bardkeeper
plugins.productIntro: 让 ChatGPT 访问您的 Bardkeeper 活动，以帮助计划未来的会话、总结故事情节、回答传说问题、跟踪 NPC 并保持您的世界的连续性。
plugins.productIntroEn: Give ChatGPT access to your Bardkeeper campaigns to help plan future sessions, summarize story arcs, answer lore questions, track NPCs, and keep your world's continuity intact.

plugins.name: Wordspace
plugins.productIntro: 猜猜通往中心神秘词的路。含义更接近的单词的位置更接近：每个猜测都会在板上获得一个紧密程度排名，每个回合都会显示一个新的线索单词，并且您有十个猜测可以缩小距离。每天都会有一个新单词掉落，之前的九个单词会在档案中等待。与朋友分享您的游戏，不剧透。
plugins.productIntroEn: Guess your way toward the mystery word at the center. Words closer in meaning sit closer to it: each guess gets a closeness rank on the board, each turn reveals a new clue word, and you have ten guesses to close the distance. A new word drops every day, the nine before it wait in the archive. Share your game with friends, spoiler-free.

plugins.name: CineOS
plugins.description: 查找英国电影院正在上映的电影
plugins.originalDescription: Find what's on at UK cinemas
plugins.productIntro: 英国的人工智能原生电影和电影院发现服务，具有经过验证的放映时间和直接预订链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: AI-native film and cinema discovery for the UK with verified showtimes and direct booking links.

plugins.name: Ask Palmistry
plugins.productIntro: 上传您的手掌照片并接收深思熟虑的手相解读。利用传统手相术与清晰的现代诠释相结合，深入了解个性、爱情、职业、健康和人生道路。选择完整的阅读材料、爱情焦点、职业焦点或快速见解。专为反思和娱乐而设计。
plugins.productIntroEn: Upload a photo of your palm and receive a thoughtful palmistry reading. Get insights on personality, love, career, health, and life path using traditional chiromancy combined with clear modern interpretation. Choose full readings, love focus, career focus, or quick insights. Designed for reflection and entertainment.

plugins.name: AskLingxi
plugins.productIntro: AskLingxi 帮助您生成中国传统八字（四柱）图表，并探索基于传统八字原理的人工智能辅助解读。
plugins.productIntroEn: AskLingxi helps you generate traditional Chinese BaZi (Four Pillars) charts and explore AI-assisted interpretations based on traditional BaZi principles.

plugins.name: KinElo
plugins.productIntro: KinElo 可帮助您搜索电影、查看评分和书签、查看全球排名以及从您的 KinElo 帐户获取个性化电影推荐。
plugins.productIntroEn: KinElo helps you search movies, review your ratings and bookmarks, see global rankings, and get personalized movie recommendations from your KinElo account.

plugins.name: Domono
plugins.description: 玩多米诺骨牌对抗 Domo
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中与 Domo 进行一场集中的埃及多米诺骨牌比赛。 Domono 负责处理规则、合法动作、隐藏牌和计分，并提供英语和阿拉伯语的互动板。无需帐户或购买。
plugins.productIntroEn: Play a focused round of Egyptian dominoes against Domo directly in ChatGPT. Domono handles the rules, legal moves, hidden tiles, and scoring, with an interactive board available in English and Arabic. No account or purchase is required.

plugins.name: Happens.mk
plugins.description: 斯科普里实时指南 - 活动
plugins.productIntro: 斯科普里现场指南 - 每日更新：音乐会、戏剧、电影、体育和儿童活动的时间、地点、价格和门票。
plugins.productIntroEn: Live guide to Skopje - refreshed daily: concerts, theatre, film, sport and kids' events with times, venues, prices and tickets.

plugins.name: udictio
plugins.productIntro: udictio 是一本社交词典，用户可以在其中探索有关概念、感受、地点、人物、作品、事件和日常主题的公共属性定义、解释、意见和生活经验。它查找匹配的主题，一次返回最多五个条目，按需打开完整条目，并将每个结果链接到其原始 udictio 页面。贡献是主观的用户观点，而不是经过验证的事实、共识或代表性调查结果。只读应用程序不需要 udictio 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: udictio is a social dictionary where users explore public, attributed definitions, interpretations, opinions, and lived experiences about concepts, feelings, places, people, works, events, and everyday topics. it finds matching topics, returns up to five entries at a time, opens complete entries on demand, and links each result to its original udictio page.

plugins.name: StreamExpose
plugins.description: 准备 YouTube 直播电台
plugins.productIntro: StreamExpose 帮助创作者准备来自 ChatGPT 的免费 24/7 YouTube 直播电台。它可以打开 StreamExpose 设置向导，或预先填充电台名称、描述、音频源、背景、隐私设置和 YouTube 模式。用户检查设置、登录、在需要时授权 YouTube，并在 StreamExpose 上明确启动广播。 ChatGPT 应用程序不会做广告或促进购买。
plugins.productIntroEn: StreamExpose helps creators prepare one free 24/7 YouTube live radio from ChatGPT. It can open the StreamExpose setup wizard or prefill it with a station name, description, audio source, background, privacy setting, and YouTube mode. Users review the setup, sign in, authorize YouTube when required, and explicitly launch the radio on StreamExpose.

plugins.name: TownSpot Events
plugins.description: 查找您附近的当地活动
plugins.productIntro: 通过当地人发现的真正的本地活动列表，了解您所在城市或社区的活动。查找今晚、明天或本周末的有用选项，包括免费活动、现场音乐和家庭活动。结果包括当地时间、地点、社区、价格、公共观察员信用以及当前 TownSpot 页面的链接。 TownSpot Events 是只读的，无法创建、编辑、预订或购买活动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover what is on in your city or neighbourhood with genuinely local event listings spotted by local people. Find useful options for tonight, tomorrow, or this weekend, including free events, live music, and family activities. Results include local times, venues, neighbourhoods, prices, public spotter credit, and links to current TownSpot pages.

plugins.name: The Big Answer
plugins.originalDescription: Survey quiz solo vs the World
plugins.productIntro: 在 ChatGPT 中开始调查测验。与朋友一起举办异步游戏 - 通过链接邀请您的团队，每个人都在自己的时间回答五个有趣的问题，当游戏结束时，您会收到结果、揭晓和电子邮件。或者与世界进行单人对决：选择一个问题包，为你的答案评分，然后登上问题包排行榜。在小部件中回答或在聊天中说出您的答案。
plugins.productIntroEn: Start a survey quiz in ChatGPT. Host an async game with friends — invite your crew with a link, everyone answers five funny questions on their own time, and when the game finishes you get results, a reveal, and email. Or play solo vs the World: pick a question pack, score your answers, and climb the pack leaderboard. Answer in the widget or say your answers in chat.

plugins.name: Imagina RPG
plugins.productIntro: 该插件允许您处理来自 ChatGPT 的 Imagina RPG 创作功能： - 作者世界（创建、编辑、审查） - 调试你的旅程 - 获取有关您的世界的分析
plugins.productIntroEn: This plugin allows you to handle Imagina RPG authoring functions form ChatGPT: - Author worlds (create, edit, review) - Debug your journeys - Get analytics about your worlds

plugins.name: Etkinlinkler
plugins.productIntro: 探索土耳其的音乐会、节日、戏剧和其他活动。查看活动详情，通过比较不同门票平台的价格找到适合您的选项。
plugins.productIntroEn: Türkiye’deki konser, festival, tiyatro ve diğer etkinlikleri keşfedin. Etkinlik detaylarını görüntüleyin ve farklı bilet platformlarındaki fiyatları karşılaştırarak size uygun seçeneği bulun.

plugins.name: Leela Online
plugins.productIntro: 你生活中的某些东西不断地回到同一个地方——同样的争论，同样的你已经不再需要的工作，同样的带着每个人却被忽视的感觉。你知道循环。你无法从里面看到它。
plugins.productIntroEn: Something in your life keeps coming back to the same place — the same argument, the same work you have outgrown, the same feeling of carrying everyone and being unseen. You know the loop. You cannot see it from inside it.

plugins.name: Distrofy Chat
plugins.productIntro: Distrofy Chat 帮助 Distrofy 艺术家从 ChatGPT 检查他们的帐户、版本、艺术家、唱片公司、钱包、流媒体分析、订阅和支持票证。连接您的 Distrofy 艺术家帐户，查看您拥有多少版本，审查草稿或待发布版本，管理或查看艺术家和唱片公司资料，了解验证问题，检查钱包余额和最近交易，按曲目、DSP 和地区查看版税和流媒体分析，以及打开或回复支持票证。在进行任何更改之前，创建支持票证或回复票证等写入操作需要明确的确认步骤。
plugins.productIntroEn: Distrofy Chat helps Distrofy artists check their account, releases, artists, labels, wallet, streaming analytics, subscription, and support tickets from ChatGPT. Connect with your Distrofy artist account to see how many releases you have, review draft or pending releases, manage or view artist and label profiles, understand validation issues, check wallet balances and recent transactions…

plugins.name: Tonk
plugins.description: 您的纳什维尔音乐经纪人
plugins.productIntro: Tonk 可以帮助您找到值得您度过一晚的纳什维尔表演。经过您的批准，它可以继承您在 ChatGPT 中查看的音乐品味和旅行详细信息（或来自互联音乐服务的紧凑样本），并将其转变为个人品味档案。搜索 Tonk 维护的纳什维尔演出、艺术家、场地和社区目录，找到适合您的品味、氛围、地点和时间的简短列表，无论您住在这里还是计划访问。找到合适的乐队和合适的房间，无需无休止的滚动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Tonk helps you find the Nashville shows worth your night. With your approval, it can carry over music tastes and trip details you’ve reviewed in ChatGPT—or a compact sample from a connected music service—and turn them into a personal taste profile.

plugins.name: Rovyn
plugins.productIntro: 罗文让你的助手策划你听的内容。向 ChatGPT 询问任何事情——“我通勤的一小时芯片大战，包括一个怀疑的镜头”——它会制定一个准备播放的计划：每一集都根据 Rovyn 的目录（可播放，或诚实地报告为什么不播放），一个点击播放链接，在 Rovyn iOS 播放器中的每个选择下都有一行“为什么”。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rovyn lets your assistant curate what you listen to. Ask ChatGPT for anything — "an hour on the chip war for my commute, one skeptical take included" — and it builds a ready-to-play plan: every episode grounded against Rovyn's catalog (playable, or honestly reported why not), one tap-to-play link, a one-line "why" under each pick in the Rovyn iOS player.

plugins.name: Cartomante FC
plugins.description: 卡托拉足球俱乐部分析和球队
plugins.originalDescription: Análise e times do Cartola FC
plugins.productIntro: 卡托拉足球俱乐部和世界杯的梦幻足球分析：预期得分、本轮比赛质量、通过预算和方案优化的阵容、通过模拟选择队长、防守封闭（SG）、死球接球手、xG、使用结构化阵容方法（MEE）的多支球队的所有权和生成。您也可以查阅课程内容。 MEE 订阅者的独家访问权限。
plugins.productIntroEn: Análises de fantasy football do Cartola FC e Copa do Mundo: pontuação esperada, qualidade dos confrontos da rodada, escalação otimizada por orçamento e esquema, escolha de capitão por simulação, fechamento de defesa (SG), cobradores de bola parada, xG, ownership e geração de múltiplos times pelo Método da Escalação Estruturada (MEE). Também consulta o conteúdo do curso.

plugins.name: Sena
plugins.productIntro: 参议员
plugins.productIntroEn: Sena.lt

plugins.name: SofiaStage Events
plugins.description: 查找保加利亚文化活动
plugins.productIntro: 查找索非亚和保加利亚各地当前的戏剧、舞蹈、音乐和其他文化活动。按日期、城市、场地、标题或表演者进行搜索，然后查看场地详细信息、演员阵容、编辑背景以及公共剧院或活动信息页面。 SofiaStage 是只读的：它无法预订门票、发起结帐或付款、访问帐户或收藏夹或保证可用性。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find current theatre, dance, music, and other cultural events in Sofia and across Bulgaria. Search by date, city, venue, title, or performer, then review venue details, cast, editorial context, and public theatre or event information pages. SofiaStage is read-only: it cannot book tickets, initiate checkout or payment, access accounts or favorites, or guarantee availability.

plugins.name: Interestnaut
plugins.originalDescription: Find what to watch, read, play
plugins.productIntro: Interestnaut 根据您对电影、电视、书籍、游戏、音乐、播客和创作者的实际反应和评分进行推荐，而不是根据流派标签进行猜测。 ChatGPT 可以读取您的反应历史记录、您的 1-10 评分和计算出的品味概况，并按标题在所有七种媒体类型中搜索目录。评分传达的信号最多：它们稀疏且经过深思熟虑，因此 9 的含义远高于“喜欢”。反应也不能互换——“meh”意味着你吃了一些东西但没有任何感觉，而“skipped”意味着你没有参与并且没有任何意见。
plugins.productIntroEn: Interestnaut grounds recommendations in what you have actually reacted to and rated — across films, TV, books, games, music, podcasts and creators — instead of guessing from genre labels. ChatGPT can read your reaction history, your 1-10 ratings, and your computed taste profile, and search the catalog by title across all seven media types.

plugins.name: Pixmoto Recipe Videos
plugins.productIntro: Pixmoto 是您在决定要做什么菜时找到的菜谱视频的地方。无论您如何搜索，无论是按菜肴、菜肴、成分、饮食需求还是场合本身，Pixmoto 都会提供交互式食谱体验，将视频与同步的分步方法和完整的成分列表相结合，以便您在观看时可以按照自己的节奏进行操作。
plugins.productIntroEn: Pixmoto is where you find recipe videos built for the moment you're deciding what to cook. However you search, whether by dish, cuisine, ingredient, dietary need, or the occasion itself, Pixmoto surfaces interactive recipe experiences that pair video with synchronised step-by-step method and full ingredient lists, so you can follow along at your own pace while you watch.

plugins.name: Grid Pulse
plugins.productIntro: Grid Pulse 是一款 6×6 逻辑谜题 - 填充网格，使每一行和每一列都包含 1-6 一次，这是一种没有 3×3 块的数独变体。
plugins.productIntroEn: Grid Pulse is a 6×6 logic puzzle — fill the grid so every row and column contains 1–6 exactly once, a Sudoku variant without the 3×3 blocks.

plugins.name: Quilty
plugins.productIntro: Quilty 让 ChatGPT 读取您在 quilty.app 上已有的完整剧本分析。
plugins.productIntroEn: Quilty lets ChatGPT read the completed screenplay analyses you already own on quilty.app.

plugins.name: Sonos
plugins.description: 控制您的 Sonos 系统
plugins.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 控制您的 Sonos 系统。从您连接的音乐服务或您的 Sonos 收藏夹和 Sonos 播放列表中播放音乐和广播。对房间进行分组和取消分组，以实现多房间同步聆听，将音乐从一个房间移动到另一个房间，并查看家中任何地方正在播放的内容。设置扬声器或群组的音量和静音。
plugins.productIntroEn: Control your Sonos system directly from ChatGPT. Play music and radio from your connected music services, or your Sonos favorites and Sonos playlists. Group and ungroup rooms for synchronized multi-room listening, move the music from one room to another, and see what's playing anywhere in your home. Set volume and mute on a speaker or group.

plugins.name: SceneF — SF Showtimes
plugins.description: 科幻电影放映时间，已验证
plugins.productIntro: 旧金山的所有电影院均包含在经过验证的列表中 - 首映连锁影院、独立影院和剧目影院（35 毫米、70 毫米、IMAX）。 SceneF 每天根据每个剧院自己的日历检查每个放映时间，并在 scenef.com/accuracy 上发布其准确性记录。询问今晚播放什么、本周电影在哪里放映，或者按时间、格式或邻近地区计划电影之夜。包括评级、格式和售完诚实度。答案来自SceneF自己的数据集；每个购票链接都指向剧院自己的售票处。
plugins.productIntroEn: Every movie theater in San Francisco in one verified listing — first-run chains, independents, and repertory houses (35mm, 70mm, IMAX). SceneF checks every showtime against each theater's own calendar daily and publishes its accuracy record at scenef.com/accuracy. Ask what's playing tonight, where a film screens this week, or plan a movie night by time, format, or neighborhood.

plugins.name: Adin Experiences
plugins.productIntro: 查找旅游、景点、活动、一日游和要做的事情 - 只需用简单的语言描述您想要的内容即可。例如：“周六晚上，两名成人在罗马参加小团体美食之旅，费用不超过 150 欧元。” Adin Experiences 可以使用您提供的旅行详细信息（例如目的地、日期、团体人数、酒店面积、抵达时间或空闲时间）来呈现适合您计划的体验。结果可以包括当前的提供商内容，例如评级、评论、价格、持续时间、照片和取消条款。
plugins.productIntroEn: Find tours, attractions, activities, day trips and things to do — just describe what you want in plain language. For example: "A small-group food tour in Rome on Saturday evening for two adults under EUR 150." Adin Experiences can use the trip details you provide — such as destination, dates, group size, hotel area, arrival time or free time — to surface experiences that fit your plans.

plugins.name: VeyrPiano
plugins.description: 在钢琴卷轴中共同创作
plugins.productIntro: VeyrPiano 在 ChatGPT 内为用户提供了交互式钢琴卷帘，用于创建和继续共享的音乐作品。用户可以绘制、移动、调整大小、试听、删除、撤消和重做音符；调整延音和节奏；并将该作品交给 ChatGPT，以获得一个有限的附加音乐动作。人工创建的注释显示为绿色，而 ChatGPT 创建的注释显示为蓝色，随着作品的发展，保留了可见的作者身份。活动组合可以稍后明确地重新打开，并从其最新的权威状态继续。
plugins.productIntroEn: VeyrPiano gives users an interactive piano roll inside ChatGPT for creating and continuing shared musical compositions. Users can draw, move, resize, audition, remove, undo, and redo notes; adjust sustain and tempo; and hand the piece to ChatGPT for one bounded additive musical move.

plugins.name: FrightMaps
plugins.productIntro: 询问您附近的鬼屋，FrightMaps 会提供真实的答案 - 专业的鬼屋景点、社区院子里的鬼屋、慈善机构的恐慌以及来自超过 255,000 名鬼屋鬼屋信任的社区地图的踪迹。
plugins.productIntroEn: Ask for haunted houses near you and FrightMaps answers with the real thing — professional haunted attractions, neighborhood yard haunts, charity scares, and trails from the community map trusted by 255,000+ haunters.

plugins.name: Astera Oracle & Numerology
plugins.description: 维多利亚时代的甲骨文和命理学
plugins.productIntro: Astera Oracle & Numerology 将 36 卡维多利亚时代 Oracle 与确定性毕达哥拉斯命理学相结合。将其用于日常卡片、是/否读数、关系和情况分布、生命路径和姓名数字计算、兼容性、个人周期和更深入的命理学概况。神谕读物可以包括原始卡片艺术品。解释仅供个人思考和娱乐，而非专业建议。
plugins.productIntroEn: Astera Oracle & Numerology combines a 36-card Victorian Oracle with deterministic Pythagorean numerology. Use it for daily cards, Yes/No readings, relationship and situation spreads, Life Path and Name Number calculations, compatibility, personal cycles, and deeper numerology profiles. Oracle readings can include the original card artwork.

plugins.name: Scout by gamedai
plugins.description: NFL 比分、新闻、开始/坐席
plugins.productIntro: Gamedai 的 Scout 将只读 NFL 情报引入 ChatGPT：来自 gamedai 列表的实时比赛得分、最新的 Wire 新闻头条以及基于 Gamedai 足球知识图谱的 Scout 公开球员成绩、首发/就座比较和位置排名。查看当天的比赛、了解头条新闻并快速了解您的阵容，而无需离开对话。
plugins.productIntroEn: Scout by gamedai brings read-only NFL intelligence into ChatGPT: live game scores from the gamedai slate, the latest Wire news headlines, and Scout's public player grades, start/sit comparisons, and positional rankings, grounded in gamedai's football knowledge graph. Check the day's games, catch up on headlines, and get a quick read on your lineup without leaving the conversation.

plugins.name: The Astro Diary

plugins.productIntroEn: UltraFit360 connects ChatGPT to your personal fitness and nutrition data. plugins.productIntro: HORIZON SHIELD 检查日本的建筑或翻新估算是否公平。给它一个工作类型和报价，它会将金额与根据 30 年现场施工经验制定的合理价格范围进行比较，标记超额收费风险，并解释单价。它还可以检测常见的高压销售短语。由 JCCDB 提供支持，JCCDB 是一个开放的建筑成本数据集，包含 63 个类别的 65,729 个项目。
plugins.productIntroEn: HORIZON SHIELD checks whether a Japanese construction or renovation estimate is fair. Give it a work type and a quoted price, and it compares the amount against fair-price ranges curated from 30 years of on-site construction experience, flags overcharge risk, and explains unit prices. It also detects common high-pressure sales phrases.

plugins.name: Perchli Property Search
plugins.productIntro: Perchli 将买家与北爱尔兰房地产经纪人联系起来。这个仅限 MCP 的插件可让 ChatGPT 按位置、价格、卧室、类型、EPC 和功能搜索实时 Perchli 列表；获取特定列表的完整详细信息，包括价格、使用期限、EPC、费率、功能、营销代理和照片；回答官方 LPS/NISRA NI 房价指数中的平均或典型价格问题；并使用英格兰银行的实时利率根据收入和存款估算买家的预算和每月抵押​​贷款付款。
plugins.productIntroEn: Perchli connects buyers with Northern Ireland estate agents. This MCP-only plugin lets ChatGPT search live Perchli listings by location, price, bedrooms, type, EPC and features; fetch full detail for a specific listing including price, tenure, EPC, rates, features, marketing agent and photos; answer average or typical price questions from the official LPS/NISRA NI House Price Index; and…

plugins.name: EMLAKIE
plugins.productIntro: EMLAKIE 是一个免费租赁市场。该应用程序可让租房者按城市、价格、卧室和房产类型搜索房源；查看完整的列表详细信息，包括所有照片、便利设施、Matterport 3D 游览和预付费用（押金、申请费、管理费、入住特价）；并直接向列表提交者发送查询——无需 EMLAKIE 帐户。
plugins.productIntroEn: EMLAKIE is a free rental marketplace. This app lets renters search listings by city, price, bedrooms, and property type; view full listing detail including all photos, amenities, Matterport 3D tours, and upfront fees (deposit, application fee, admin fee, move-in specials); and send an inquiry directly to the listing submitter — no EMLAKIE account required.

plugins.name: La Dépêche du Midi
plugins.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中查找来自 La Dépêche du Midi 的最新新闻：查阅最新信息、浏览您感兴趣的文章并关注实时活动。
plugins.productIntroEn: Retrouvez l’actualité de La Dépêche du Midi directement dans ChatGPT : consultez les dernières informations, explorez les articles qui vous intéressent et suivez les évènements en direct.

plugins.name: Mivodo
plugins.productIntro: 借助 Mivodo，您可以在一个搜索引擎中比较相关提供商和门户网站的所有租赁和汽车订阅报价。找到每月有效成本最低的合适汽车。
plugins.productIntroEn: With Mivodo, you can compare all leasing and car subscription offers from relevant providers and portals in one search engine. Find the right car with the lowest effective monthly costs.

plugins.name: Tessun Immobilien
plugins.description: 慕尼黑和 ILT 房产
plugins.productIntro: Tessun Immobilien 应用程序使慕尼黑和伊萨尔-洛伊萨赫山谷的房产搜索更加清晰、更加注重本地化。
plugins.productIntroEn: The Tessun Immobilien app makes property searching in Munich and the Isar-Loisach Valley clearer and more locally focused.

plugins.name: ProEigentum Immobilien
plugins.productIntro: ProEigentum Immobilien 是一家现代化房地产公司，专注于大慕尼黑地区，提供直观、基于位置的方式来发现、购买或出售房产。
plugins.productIntroEn: ProEigentum Immobilien is a modern real estate company specializing in the greater Munich area and offers an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties.

plugins.name: Pazarama
plugins.description: 在 Pazarama 上搜索产品
plugins.productIntro: 在 Pazarama 市场上快速查找购物清单上的产品。只需说出您的需求即可，ChatGPT 将为您比较型号并提供直接购买链接。以聊天的速度体验土耳其值得信赖的市场。
plugins.productIntroEn: Quickly find products on your shopping list on the Pazarama marketplace. Just say what you need—ChatGPT will compare models and provide direct purchase links for you. Experience Turkey's trusted marketplace at the speed of chat.

plugins.name: Omny
plugins.productIntro: 找到真正适合您的房地产项目的房产。只需用自然语言描述您的搜索：预算、位置、生活方式、环境或特定标准。 Omny 会选择最合适的广告，让您只需几个步骤即可比较您的最爱、保存您的偏好并请求访问。
plugins.productIntroEn: Trouvez le bien qui correspond réellement à votre projet immobilier. Décrivez simplement votre recherche en langage naturel : budget, localisation, mode de vie, environnement ou critères spécifiques. Omny sélectionne les annonces les plus adaptées, vous permet de comparer vos favoris, de conserver vos préférences et de demander une visite en quelques étapes.

plugins.name: ELLIE VINCY NAILS
plugins.productIntro: 艾莉·文西 (Ellie Vincy) 用您自己的手指模具制作压入式指甲，因此它们适合您自然指甲的形状，而不是通用尺寸表。这个应用程序从头到尾解释了这个过程：订购定制美甲入门包，在家制作所有十根手指的模具，用预付费的 USPS 二维码寄回，无需打印机或盖章，按照状态时间表到达工作室，然后工匠在您的模具上手工制作每一套。一旦您的模具归档，重新订购将完全跳过成型步骤。该应用程序还可以按款式、形状、长度或指甲护理产品搜索实时 ellievincynails.
plugins.productIntroEn: Ellie Vincy makes press-on nails from a mold of your own fingers, so they fit the shape of your natural nails instead of a generic size chart. This app explains that process end to end: order the Custom Nail Starter Pack, take a mold of all ten fingers at home, mail it back with a prepaid USPS QR code that needs no printer or stamp, follow the status timeline as it reaches the studio, an…

plugins.name: RideLogger
plugins.productIntro: RideLogger 通过 ChatGPT 帮助用户管理他们的私人车辆日志。用户可以查看和更新​​车辆，跟踪燃油、充电、服务和费用记录，管理维护提醒，并将车辆图像、文档和日志附件存储在经过身份验证的 RideLogger 帐户中。
plugins.productIntroEn: RideLogger helps users manage their private vehicle logbook through ChatGPT. Users can view and update vehicles, track fuel, charging, service, and expense records, manage maintenance reminders, and store vehicle images, documents, and log attachments in their authenticated RideLogger account.

plugins.name: Justlife
plugins.productIntro: 连接到 ChatGPT 上的 Justlife，只需几分钟即可搜索和探索专业的家庭服务。描述您的需求，并发现由您附近训练有素的专业人员提供的清洁、维护、沙龙和水疗服务的个性化选项。查看服务详细信息、定价和可用性，然后在 Justlife 平台上无缝完成预订。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect to Justlife on ChatGPT to search and explore professional home services in minutes. Describe what you need, and discover personalized options for Cleaning, Maintenance, Salon & Spa services by trained professionals near you. Review service details, pricing, and availability, then complete your booking seamlessly on the Justlife platform.

plugins.name: Thomas Franck Immobilien
plugins.productIntro: Thomas Franck Immobilien 是一家专门从事什未林及周边地区业务的现代化房地产公司。该应用程序提供了一种直观的、基于位置的方式来发现、购买或出售梅克伦堡-前波美拉尼亚州首府及其周边地区的房产。
plugins.productIntroEn: Thomas Franck Immobilien is a modern real estate company specializing in Schwerin and the surrounding region. The app offers an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in the capital of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and its neighboring areas.

plugins.name: Just Eat
plugins.productIntro: 无需离开聊天即可发现 Just Eat 餐厅并建立一个购物篮。按美食、地点或喜好进行搜索。
plugins.productIntroEn: Discover Just Eat restaurants and build a basket without leaving your chat. Search by cuisine, location or craving.

plugins.name: Lott Immobilien
plugins.productIntro: Lott Immobilien 是一家现代化房地产公司，专注于从莱尔 (Leer) 到奥古斯特费恩 (Augustfehn) 到奥尔登堡 (Oldenburg) 的地区。该应用程序提供了一种直观的、基于位置的方式来发现、购买或出售德国西北部的房产。
plugins.productIntroEn: Lott Immobilien is a modern real estate company specializing in the region stretching from Leer through Augustfehn to Oldenburg. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in northwestern Germany.

plugins.name: LatestBuy Gift Finder
plugins.productIntro: LatestBuy 礼品查找器可帮助人们发现 LatestBuy 当前可用的礼品。按收件人、场合、兴趣或预算（以当地店面货币计算）进行搜索，查看当前产品选项和价格，然后打开相应的 LateBuy 产品页面以确认运输资格、详细信息和结账。该应用程序还可以使用 LatestBuy 发布的商店政策来回答问题。
plugins.productIntroEn: LatestBuy Gift Finder helps people discover currently available gifts from LatestBuy. Search by recipient, occasion, interests or a budget in your local storefront currency, review current product options and prices, and open the appropriate LatestBuy product page to confirm shipping eligibility, details and checkout.

plugins.name: CogniFit
plugins.productIntro: CogniFit 是经过临床验证的认知评估和大脑训练平台，受到全球数百万用户的信赖。
plugins.productIntroEn: CogniFit is a clinically validated cognitive assessment and brain training platform trusted by millions of users worldwide.

plugins.name: Metaprona
plugins.description: 查找阿尔巴尼亚的房产
plugins.productIntro: 搜索阿尔巴尼亚和科索沃的实时待售和出租房地产列表 — 地拉那、都拉斯、发罗拉、萨兰达、普里什蒂纳等地的公寓、独栋别墅、别墅、办公室和土地。按城市、价格、房间和面积进行筛选，按城市检查平均欧元/平方米和租金价格，并直接在 metaprona.com 上打开任何列表。结果来自阿尔巴尼亚开放房地产市场 Metaprona 上 17,000 多个活跃列表。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search live real-estate listings for sale and rent across Albania and Kosovo — apartments, houses, villas, offices and land in Tiranë, Durrës, Vlorë, Sarandë, Prishtinë and more. Filter by city, price, rooms and size, check average €/m² and rent prices by city, and open any listing directly on metaprona.com.

plugins.name: The Lonely Door
plugins.productIntro: 分享你所承受的一切——恐惧、悲伤、怀疑、感激，或者一个你无法摆脱的问题——孤独之门会搜索 450 种独特的圣经译本（1390 万节经文，可追溯到希伯来语、希腊语和阿拉姆语原文），找到适合你当下的最忠实的经文。每个回复都包括释经和历史背景、带音译的原始语言单词研究、内联引用（以便您可以验证每个主张）以及基于经文的祈祷。
plugins.productIntroEn: Share what you're carrying — fear, grief, doubt, gratitude, or a question you can't shake — and The Lonely Door searches 450 unique Bible translations (13.9 million verses, traced back to the original Hebrew, Greek, and Aramaic) to find the single most faithful scripture for your moment.

plugins.name: Weather by WindBorne
plugins.productIntro: WindBorne 可让您利用世界上最大的气象气球群的数据来提供更好的天气预报。每个气球都会从传统观测方法无法覆盖的地区收集关键的现场数据，为国家气象局 (NWS)、NOAA 和其他气象机构提供观测数据。
plugins.productIntroEn: WindBorne lets you harness data from the largest constellation of weather balloons in the world, for a better weather forecast. Each balloon collects critical in-situ data from regions beyond the reach of traditional observation methods, supplying observations to the National Weather Service (NWS), NOAA, and other meteorological agencies.

plugins.name: Pregnancy Wheel
plugins.productIntro: 将您的末次月经日期或预产期变成交互式怀孕轮。立即查看您当前的周、三个月、预产期和剩余天数，以及有趣的水果大小比较，了解您的宝宝现在有多大。即使没有具体日期，您也可以查找从 1 到 42 的任意一周，了解接下来的情况。
plugins.productIntroEn: Turn your last menstrual period date or due date into an interactive pregnancy wheel. Instantly see your current week, trimester, due date, and days remaining, along with a fun fruit-size comparison for how big your baby is right now. You can also look up any week from 1 to 42 to see what's ahead, even without a specific date.

plugins.name: Cook and Scale
plugins.description: 通过聊天可扩展的食谱
plugins.productIntro: Cook and Scale 是一个菜谱网站，其中每个菜谱都会根据您需要的份数进行清晰地缩放，并按照厨师实际测量的方式编写数量。该连接器可让您通过对话构建菜谱集合。听写你祖母的烤宽面条，一起制定工作日晚上的晚餐，或者交出你一直在读的食谱——它会作为真实的、结构化的食谱出现在你的 Cook and Scale 帐户中：配料与食物数据库相匹配，因此数量可以适当调整，步骤与计时器、准备和烹饪时间、菜肴、膳食类型、饮食和设备。
plugins.productIntroEn: Cook and Scale is a recipe site where every recipe scales cleanly to the number of servings you need, with amounts written the way a cook actually measures them. This connector lets you build your recipe collection by conversation.

plugins.name: Dispatcher.City
plugins.productIntro: Dispatcher.City 搜索实时公开的柏林房产地图，查找要购买或出租的房屋、WG 房间、新建建筑和商业列表。它返回规范源链接以及准确的快照计数以及明确的覆盖范围和确认限制。公共插件是只读的，无法访问帐户、保存搜索、启用警报、联系经纪人或做出决定。
plugins.productIntroEn: Dispatcher.City searches the live public Berlin property map for homes to buy or rent, WG rooms, new builds, and commercial listings. It returns canonical source links together with exact snapshot counts and explicit coverage and confirmation limits. The public plugin is read-only and cannot access accounts, save searches, enable alerts, contact brokers, or make decisions.

plugins.name: IQ Sell My Car
plugins.productIntro: IQ Sell My Car 可帮助您了解您的车辆的价值并与全国经销商网络建立联系。输入您的车辆识别号、里程、邮政编码和车辆状况，以接收基于市场的零售、私人团体和估计的经销商报价。准备好后，在明确同意后将您的车辆提交给参与的经销商。您的车辆未在 IQAutoDeals.com 上公开列出。提交后，您将收到一封电子邮件，其中包含用于上传照片和激活卖家列表的安全链接。
plugins.productIntroEn: IQ Sell My Car helps you understand what your vehicle may be worth and connect with a nationwide dealer network. Enter your VIN, mileage, ZIP code, and vehicle condition to receive market-based retail, private-party, and estimated dealer-offer values. When you're ready, submit your vehicle to participating dealerships after providing explicit consent.

plugins.name: Share-A-Cart
plugins.productIntro: Share-A-Cart 帮助登录用户列出支持的零售商、查找产品和交易、检查购物车历史记录中的购物车，以及从 ChatGPT 创建或更新可共享购物车。
plugins.productIntroEn: Share-A-Cart helps signed-in users list supported retailers, find products and deals, inspect carts in their cart history, and create or update shareable shopping carts from ChatGPT.

plugins.name: ShotPulled
plugins.productIntro: 调入更好的浓缩咖啡，一次进行一种明智的调整。 设置一次咖啡豆、研磨机、浓缩咖啡机和秤。每次拍摄后，记录剂量、产量、冲泡时间以及味道。 ShotPulled 会考虑完整的环境，包括咖啡的陈年时间和研磨机的校准方式，然后为您的下一次冲泡推荐最有用的调整，并解释原因。 ShotPulled 还可自动保持您的咖啡库存准确。每个记录的剂量都会从袋子中扣除，因此您可以看到剩余的克数，并根据您实际使用的剂量估计剩余的注射次数。
plugins.productIntroEn: Dial in better espresso, one informed adjustment at a time. Set up your beans, grinder, espresso machine, and scale once. After each shot, log the dose, yield, brew time, and how it tasted. ShotPulled considers the full context—including the coffee’s age and the way your grinder is calibrated—then recommends the single most useful adjustment for your next shot and explains why.

plugins.name: Astrotheoros
plugins.productIntro: Astrotheoros 将您保存的图表库链接到助手。登录后，它可以查找您帐户中的任何图表，根据这些图表计算行进、进展、回报、合盘和组合，并读取或写入附加的注释，所有这些都使用您在应用程序中已使用的设置。它还可以查找黄道释放或 Vimshottari Dasha 周期并将您的图表组织到文件夹中。
plugins.productIntroEn: Astrotheoros links your saved chart library to the assistant. Once you sign in, it can look up any chart in your account, calculate transits, progressions, returns, synastry, and composites against those charts, and read or write the notes attached to them, all with the settings you already use in the app.

plugins.name: REMAX Europe
plugins.productIntro: REMAX Europe 允许用户搜索 25 个欧洲国家的实时 REMAX 房产列表，并在图像丰富的交互式图库中浏览结果，而无需离开聊天室。用户用简单的语言询问城市或国家、预算、销售或租赁、住宅或商业、最小面积或房间、电梯通道，并获得最多 100 个带有照片、价格和关键事实的匹配列表，可按价格或面积排序，并可以 32 种语言中的任何一种查看。点击列表会打开完整的详细视图，其中包含照片轮播、描述（带有按需翻译）、代理联系方式以及 remax.
plugins.productIntroEn: REMAX Europe lets users search live REMAX property listings across 25 European countries and browse the results in an interactive, image-rich gallery without leaving the chat. Users ask in plain language, a city or country, a budget, sale or rental, residential or commercial, minimum size or rooms, elevator access, and get up to 100 matching listings with photos, prices, and key facts, s…

plugins.name: Propusher
plugins.productIntro: Propusher 是一个教练平台，用于构建锻炼并通过同步移动应用程序将其提供给客户。该应用程序可让教练浏览他们的 Propusher 练习库、使用 3D 骨骼动画编写练习，并在自己的帐户中组装锻炼、调查问卷和多周计划。此处创建的所有内容都会立即显示在 Propusher Web 仪表板和客户的移动应用程序中。访问范围仅限于通过 OAuth 登录的教练帐户；该应用程序仅读取和写入该教练的练习、锻炼、调查问卷和计划，并且从不删除它们。
plugins.productIntroEn: Propusher is a coaching platform for building workouts and delivering them to clients through a synchronized mobile app. This app lets a coach browse their Propusher exercise library, author exercises with 3D skeletal animations, and assemble workouts, questionnaires and multi-week programs in their own account.

plugins.name: Fotoluce
plugins.productIntro: Fotoluce 帮助用户搜索和比较当前的摄影目录、组装基于证据的相机套件、查看商店政策、管理其链接的 Fotoluce 购物车、继续 Fotoluce 结账以及查看自己的订单。
plugins.productIntroEn: Fotoluce helps users search and compare the current photography catalogue, assemble evidence-based camera kits, review store policies, manage their linked Fotoluce cart, continue to Fotoluce checkout, and view their own orders.

plugins.name: Connectlinx
plugins.productIntro: ConnectLinx 是一个面向房地产经纪人、经纪人和团队的人工智能指挥中心。连接您的 ConnectLinx 帐户并通过聊天运行您的业务：查看和更新​​您的住宅和商业出租和出售列表，分类和回复潜在客户，管理看房，通过您的管道移动交易，并掌握您的 CRM、日历和团队。它准确地向您显示登录时所看到的内容，不多也不少。写入是有范围的且安全的（没有删除工具，草稿仍是草稿），并且出站电子邮件始终要求您在发送前确认。南佛罗里达市场最强，拥有直接代理商和房东库存。
plugins.productIntroEn: ConnectLinx is an AI command center for real estate agents, brokers, and teams. Connect your ConnectLinx account and run your business from chat: review and update your listings for rent and for sale across both residential and commercial, triage and reply to leads, manage showings, move deals through your pipeline, and stay on top of your CRM, calendar, and team.

plugins.name: EscapeTab
plugins.productIntro: EscapeTab 通过具有分页和对账详细信息的只读 MCP 工具，帮助餐厅经营者检查公司概况、标签销售、班次、财务文件、忠诚度活动和每日菜单订单。
plugins.productIntroEn: EscapeTab helps restaurant operators inspect company overviews, tab sales, shifts, fiscal documents, loyalty activity, and daily-menu orders through read-only MCP tools with pagination and reconciliation details.

plugins.name: Crbonfree
plugins.description: 估算和抵消二氧化碳排放
plugins.productIntro: CrbonFree 帮助人们估算和抵消日常购买的碳足迹。输入您购买的商品（可选择价格、类别、数量或重量），应用程序会返回排放估算值和明确的抵消成本。用户可以通过Stripe结帐完成抵消，应用程序保持支付流程和状态同步。
plugins.productIntroEn: CrbonFree helps people estimate and offset the carbon footprint of everyday purchases. plugins.productIntroEn: Configure made-to-order Show Jumping and Dressage jackets with Vainqueur Cheval’s official catalog, options, sizing paths, and server-calculated prices. Review every detail in the 3D Atelier before checkout. The plugin does not place orders or process payments.

plugins.name: Adrihosan
