plugins.productIntroEn: Browse Adrihosan products, variants, categories and blog guides. Compare bathroom, kitchen and flooring materials using catalog prices, stated availability and links to product pages. Purchases are completed on Adrihosan. The plugin does not access orders or customer data.

plugins.name: 올리브영
plugins.description: 发现美，找到属于你的美
plugins.productIntro: 올리브영：发现美，找到属于你的美。
plugins.productIntroEn: 올리브영은 일상속 새로운 영감과 에너지를 전하는 뷰티 & 헬스 라이프 큐레이팅 플랫폼 입니다. 지금 떠오르는 뷰티 고민을 말해보세요. 피부 고민, 성분, 제형, 상황까지 나에게 맞는 선택지를 소개해 드릴게요.

plugins.name: ASCEND
plugins.productIntro: ASCEND：立即跟踪上升的星座。
plugins.productIntroEn: ASCEND tracks the rising sign in real time based on your location. See which sign is rising now, along with its current degree and when it will change. Use ASCEND in ChatGPT to explore the live sky and understand what’s shifting overhead at any moment.

plugins.name: Stowra
plugins.productIntro: Stowra：齿轮、套件和装载。
plugins.productIntroEn: Stowra helps users organize gear, reusable kits, and trip loadouts; manage packing sections, participants, readiness, and weights; and reverse grouped workspace changes through ChatGPT.

plugins.name: Clutch
plugins.originalDescription: Buy & sell used cars in Canada
plugins.productIntro: 搜索 Clutch 的优质二手车库存，查找您在其他网站上发现的汽车的替代品，并获得即时市场估值 - 所有这些都只需一次对话即可完成。每辆车均由 Clutch 直接拥有和销售，经过 210 点检查，附有免费的 Carfax 报告，并且可以完全在线购买并送货上门。
plugins.productIntroEn: Search Clutch's inventory of quality used vehicles, find alternatives to cars you've spotted on other sites, and get instant market valuations — all in one conversation. Every car is owned and sold directly by Clutch, goes through a 210-point inspection, comes with a free Carfax report, and is available to buy completely online with home delivery.

plugins.name: Guyal
plugins.productIntro: 该应用程序可让您在一处浏览珠宝店的店面。查看产品系列，检查商品详细信息，并按照您自己的节奏探索可用的珠宝。您还可以看到店铺的营业信息和联系方式，方便提问或参观店铺。
plugins.productIntroEn: This app lets you browse a jewelry shop’s storefront in one place. View product collections, check item details, and explore available jewelry at your own pace. You can also see the shop’s business information and contact details, making it easy to ask questions or visit the store.

plugins.name: CJ온스타일
plugins.productIntro: OnStyle 是一款连接到韩国电视家庭购物平台的对话式购物应用程序，旨在在 ChatGPT 中发现时尚、美容、食品和其他生活方式类别的产品。用户可以根据风格、季节、预算或背景自然地描述他们想要的东西，并通过多个回合的后续细化获得相关的产品结果。 OnStyle还支持搜索广播产品，帮助用户以比传统关键字搜索更直观的方式探索购物选项。
plugins.productIntroEn: OnStyle is a conversational shopping app connected to a Korean TV home-shopping platform, built for discovering products across fashion, beauty, food, and other lifestyle categories in ChatGPT. Users can describe what they want naturally — by style, season, budget, or context — and receive relevant product results with follow-up refinement across multiple turns.

plugins.name: 아모레몰 AMORE MALL

plugins.originalDescription: 공식 브랜드 쇼핑부터 스마트 뷰티 케어까지
plugins.productIntro: 活出你的新美丽，爱茉莉购物中心 아모레퍼시픽께 나만의 아름다움을 발견하세요。
plugins.productIntroEn: LIVE YOUR NEW BEAUTY, AMORE MALL 아모레퍼시픽이 만든 라이프 뷰티 쇼핑몰, 아모레몰과 함께 나만의 아름다움을 발견하세요.

plugins.productIntroEn: 740種類以上のカテゴリで知識・スキル・経験を売り買いできる、日本最大のスキルマーケット「ココナラ」。AIが予算に合わせた絞り込みを行い、一つひとつの推薦理由を添えて提案するため、比較の手間なく、納得のサービスへ最短距離で辿り着けます。 このアプリは検索とおすすめ機能のみに対応しています。アプリ内課金やサービスの決済には対応していません。

plugins.name: 무신사
plugins.description: 按风格查找，按评论挑选
plugins.originalDescription: Find by style, pick by reviews
plugins.productIntro: 提出一种情况，它会为你显示一些物品——比如“明天的约会服装”、“工作裤”、“实际上很温暖的冬季羽绒服”或“舒适的运动鞋”。 当某样东西引起你的注意时，它会立即调出评论并总结关键信息——“尺码偏小还是偏大？”、“面料结实吗？”、“合身程度如何？”——因此比较选项很容易。 更少的滚动，更快的选择。
plugins.productIntroEn: Throw in a situation and it’ll surface items for you—like “tomorrow’s date outfit,” “work slacks,” “a winter puffer that’s actually warm,” or “comfy sneakers.” When something catches your eye, it pulls up the reviews right away and summarizes the key bits—“Does it run small or big?”, “Is the fabric sturdy?”, “How’s the fit?”—so comparing options is easy. Less scrolling, faster picks.

plugins.name: KingsDeal
plugins.productIntro: KingsDeal：查找和保存属性。
plugins.productIntroEn: Connect your KingsDeal account to search rental, sale, lease and commercial property listings. Filter by location, property type, bedrooms and price with explicit currency and billing period. Read listing details and compare options in conversation. Tenant accounts can read saved properties and save a favorite after approval. Open listing links on KingsDeal to continue.

plugins.name: Rozetka: інтернет гіпермаркет
plugins.productIntro: Rozetka 是一款在乌克兰方便在线购物的移动应用程序。它包含数百万种产品：从电器和衣服到家居用品和宠物。带有过滤器的便捷目录可帮助您快速找到所需内容，而客户评论和特征比较可帮助您做出明智的决策。几分钟下单，可选择全国送货或门店自提。该应用程序还提供促销、折扣和奖金，使购物更有利可图。 Rozetka 有助于节省时间并使购物变得简单明了。
plugins.productIntroEn: Rozetka — це мобільний застосунок для зручного онлайн-шопінгу в Україні. У ньому зібрані мільйони товарів: від техніки та одягу до товарів для дому й улюбленців. Зручний каталог із фільтрами допомагає швидко знаходити потрібне, а відгуки покупців і порівняння характеристик — приймати обґрунтовані рішення.
